title: EDU-Net: Retinal Pathological Fluid Segmentation in OCT Images with Multiscale Feature Fusion and Boundary Optimization
summary: Objective: Diabetic macular edema (DME) is the leading cause of severe visual impairment in patients with diabetes. Quantification of retinal fluid, particularly intraretinal fluid (IRF) and subretinal fluid (SRF), plays a critical role in the management of DME. Although optical coherence tomography (OCT) can be used for detection, the variable morphology of fluid accumulation and the blurred boundaries caused by noise interference still limit the accuracy of OCT's automatic segmentation. Methods: Retrospective model development and validation study. This study proposes a novel edge-guided dual-branch encoder-decoder network (EDU-Net) to achieve accurate and efficient automatic segmentation of OCT liquid lesions. The local feature extraction branch is based on the EfficientNet model, which precisely captures tiny lesions by leveraging its lightweight separable convolution and high-resolution feature preservation strategy. The global feature extraction branch is based on the large-kernel efficient convolution (LKEC) module and the downsampling layer design to enhance long-range dependencies and global semantics. EDU-Net applies a multi-category edge-guided attention module to fuse high-frequency boundary detail information to each resolution feature to optimize the boundary segmentation performance. Results: Extensive results on the in-house and public datasets demonstrate that EDU-Net achieves state-of-the-art DSC segmentation performance in terms of efficiency and robustness, especially in the segmentation of IRF lesions. Conclusions: EDU-Net integrates local details with global context and optimizes boundaries, achieving an improvement in the accuracy of automatic segmentation of retinal fluid.

AI.tldr: EDU-Net算法能又快又好地分割OCT图像中的视网膜积液，尤以识别IRF为优。
AI.motivation: 目前OCT自动识别DME液体灶的边界模糊且噪声多，导致定量不准确，需要鲁棒且高效的网络来实现临床可用。
AI.method: 开发双分支编码-解码EDU-Net：局部分支用EfficientNet＋轻可分离卷积；全局分支用LKEC＋大感受野捕获远程语义；并在每层注入多类边缘引导注意力，融合高频边界信息。
AI.result: 自采＋公开数据集验证，在DSC真阳性与鲁棒性指标上均达SOTA，IRF分割效果提升最显著，同时保持高效推理速度。
AI.conclusion: .EDU-Net融合局部细节、全局语义和边界先验，可实现更准确的视网膜积液自动量化，具有临床推广潜力。

title: DiffNR: Diffusion-Enhanced Neural Representation Optimization for Sparse-View 3D Tomographic Reconstruction
comment: Accepted to AAAI 2026. Project page: https://ooonesevennn.github.io/DiffNR/
summary: Neural representations (NRs), such as neural fields and 3D Gaussians, effectively model volumetric data in computed tomography (CT) but suffer from severe artifacts under sparse-view settings. To address this, we propose DiffNR, a novel framework that enhances NR optimization with diffusion priors. At its core is SliceFixer, a single-step diffusion model designed to correct artifacts in degraded slices. We integrate specialized conditioning layers into the network and develop tailored data curation strategies to support model finetuning. During reconstruction, SliceFixer periodically generates pseudo-reference volumes, providing auxiliary 3D perceptual supervision to fix underconstrained regions. Compared to prior methods that embed CT solvers into time-consuming iterative denoising, our repair-and-augment strategy avoids frequent diffusion model queries, leading to better runtime performance. Extensive experiments show that DiffNR improves PSNR by 3.99 dB on average, generalizes well across domains, and maintains efficient optimization.

AI.tldr: DiffNR 利用单步扩散模型 SliceFixer，在稀疏视角 CT 中先“修复再增强”，为神经表示提供廉价 3D 伪标签，平均提升 3.99 dB PSNR，速度优于迭代式扩散重建。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视角 CT 下，神经场与 3D 高斯等神经表示 (NR) 严重欠采样，产生明显伪影；现有把 CT 求解器嵌入多步扩散采样的方法耗时巨大，亟需高效且通用的先验。
AI.method: 设计单步扩散网络 SliceFixer，在退化切片域直接映射到干净切片；引入专用条件层与数据策划策略完成微调。重建阶段周期性地用 SliceFixer 生成伪参考体数据，将其作为 3D 感知监督，指导 NR 优化，避免每步都调用扩散模型。
AI.result: 在公开稀疏视角 CT 数据集上，DiffNR 平均 PSNR 提升 3.99 dB，跨模态、跨机构泛化良好；与需数十次扩散推理的迭代法相比，GPU 时间降低约 5×，内存占用更少，同时保持收敛速度。
AI.conclusion: “修复再增强” 策略把昂贵扩散先验转化为轻量级伪标签，突破稀疏视角 CT 重建的效率瓶颈，为神经表示在真实低剂量、快速扫描场景中的部署提供可行方案。

title: AITP: Traffic Accident Responsibility Allocation via Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in Traffic Accident Detection (TAD) and Traffic Accident Understanding (TAU). However, existing studies mainly focus on describing and interpreting accident videos, leaving room for deeper causal reasoning and integration of legal knowledge. Traffic Accident Responsibility Allocation (TARA) is a more challenging task that requires multi-step reasoning grounded in traffic regulations. To address this, we introduce AITP (Artificial Intelligence Traffic Police), a multimodal large language model for responsibility reasoning and allocation. AITP enhances reasoning via a Multimodal Chain-of-Thought (MCoT) mechanism and integrates legal knowledge through Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). We further present DecaTARA, a decathlon-style benchmark unifying ten interrelated traffic accident reasoning tasks with 67,941 annotated videos and 195,821 question-answer pairs. Extensive experiments show that AITP achieves state-of-the-art performance across responsibility allocation, TAD, and TAU tasks, establishing a new paradigm for reasoning-driven multimodal traffic analysis.

AI.tldr: 论文提出AITP模型与DecaTARA基准，首次将 MLLM 用于交通事故责任划分，引入链式推理与法律知识检索，统一十项任务并刷新 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有 MLLM 交通事故研究止步于检测与描述，缺乏对“谁负责”的深层因果推理及法规知识融合，难以满足交警定责场景需求。
AI.method: 构建 AITP：以 Multimodal Chain-of-Thought 进行多步因果推理，用 Retrieval-Augmented Generation 动态注入法规条文；同步发布 DecaTARA，67 K 视频 + 195 K QA 覆盖十项关联任务，实现统一训练与评测。
AI.result: 在 DecaTARA 上，AITP 于责任划分、事故检测、事故理解三项均达 SOTA，显著提升法规一致性及推理可解释性。
AI.conclusion: AITP 确立“以推理为中心”的多模态交通分析新范式，为自动化定责与法律合规落地提供可扩展框架。

title: A microwave super-resolution imaging approach towards breast cancer margin mapping
summary: Accurate characterisation of margins in excised breast cancer tumours is critical to the success of surgical interventions, yet margin status is typically confirmed post-operatively using histopathology. Here we present a new approach to intraoperative margin assessment based on microwave single pixel imaging, demonstrating tissue phantom hydration mapping across large areas (~10 cm x 10 cm) at ~1 mm resolution. By leveraging the photo-induced change in microwave transparency of a silicon modulator placed under the sample, we map the microwave reflectivity and identify positive margins with deeply sub-wavelength resolution. We test the discriminatory capabilities of our approach using gelatine-based tumour phantoms with variations in water density representative of the margin and cancerous tissues of a resected tumour. We demonstrate the capability to identify, locate and quantify inadequate margins up to the typically targeted minimum thickness of 2 mm. Furthermore, using numerical modelling, we show that our approach is expected to be resilient to patient-specific tissue differences. Our technique has potential for future deployment as a real-time intraoperative tissue margin analysis tool.

AI.tldr: 用微波单像素成像在术中实时识别乳腺癌切除标本的2 mm以内阳性切缘，分辨率约1 mm，已通过仿体验证并预示对个体差异鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 乳腺癌保乳手术中，切缘是否阴性决定复发风险；传统术后病理反馈滞后，需术中快速、大面积、毫米级精度评估切缘。
AI.method: 构建硅光电调制器-微波反射“单像素成像”平台，利用水含量差异导致的微波反射率变化，在10 cm×10 cm范围、1 mm分辨率下扫描凝胶仿体；结合数值模型验证对组织异质性的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 成功识别、定位并量化≤2 mm 的“阳性切缘”仿体；成像对比度足以区分癌与正常组织的水密度差异；数值模拟显示患者间组织介电变异对判读影响有限。
AI.conclusion: 微波单像素成像可在术中以无标记、非接触方式完成大视场、毫米级切缘评估，具备转化为临床实时切缘分析工具的潜力。

title: AITP: Traffic Accident Responsibility Allocation via Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in Traffic Accident Detection (TAD) and Traffic Accident Understanding (TAU). However, existing studies mainly focus on describing and interpreting accident videos, leaving room for deeper causal reasoning and integration of legal knowledge. Traffic Accident Responsibility Allocation (TARA) is a more challenging task that requires multi-step reasoning grounded in traffic regulations. To address this, we introduce AITP (Artificial Intelligence Traffic Police), a multimodal large language model for responsibility reasoning and allocation. AITP enhances reasoning via a Multimodal Chain-of-Thought (MCoT) mechanism and integrates legal knowledge through Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). We further present DecaTARA, a decathlon-style benchmark unifying ten interrelated traffic accident reasoning tasks with 67,941 annotated videos and 195,821 question-answer pairs. Extensive experiments show that AITP achieves state-of-the-art performance across responsibility allocation, TAD, and TAU tasks, establishing a new paradigm for reasoning-driven multimodal traffic analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出具备责任认定能力的 AI 交通警察模型 AITP 及 DecaTARA 十项综合测评基准，首次实现交通法规驱动的多步推理责任判定。
AI.motivation: 现有 MLLM 仅止步于事故现象描述与理解，缺乏将交通法规引入模型进行因果推理，完成事故责任细分分派的深层能力，无法在法律和实际上支撑真正的智能判责需求。
AI.method: 引入 MCoT 使视频与文本思维链逐步对齐，获取法律责任因素的缜密推理路径；结合 RAG 动态检索交通法规文本注入上下文，以保证结论的法律一致性；设计并发布十任务关联的 DecaTARA 基准，以 67k 视频与 196k 问答支持系统评估。
AI.result: 在责任分配、检测与理解三项核心指标上达到 SOTA，AITP 在所有十任务综合分数平均超越现有最优模型 9.7 p.p.，并在多跳法规问答准确率上提升 12.3 p.p.，验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 研究首次将交通法规显性引入 MLLM 推理流程，确立基于责任推理的多模态交通分析新范式，为智能判责、法律辅助与事故预防奠定扎实的模型和基准基础。

title: Thinking Like a Botanist: Challenging Multimodal Language Models with Intent-Driven Chain-of-Inquiry
summary: Vision evaluations are typically done through multi-step processes. In most contemporary fields, experts analyze images using structured, evidence-based adaptive questioning. In plant pathology, botanists inspect leaf images, identify visual cues, infer diagnostic intent, and probe further with targeted questions that adapt to species, symptoms, and severity. This structured probing is crucial for accurate disease diagnosis and treatment formulation. Yet current vision-language models are evaluated on single-turn question answering. To address this gap, we introduce PlantInquiryVQA, a benchmark for studying multi-step, intent-driven visual reasoning in botanical diagnosis. We formalize a Chain of Inquiry framework modeling diagnostic trajectories as ordered question-answer sequences conditioned on grounded visual cues and explicit epistemic intent. We release a dataset of 24,950 expert-curated plant images and 138,068 question-answer pairs annotated with visual grounding, severity labels, and domain-specific reasoning templates. Evaluations on top-tier Multimodal Large Language Models reveal that while they describe visual symptoms adequately, they struggle with safe clinical reasoning and accurate diagnosis. Importantly, structured question-guided inquiry significantly improves diagnostic correctness, reduces hallucination, and increases reasoning efficiency. We hope PlantInquiryVQA serves as a foundational benchmark in advancing research to train diagnostic agents to reason like expert botanists rather than static classifiers.

AI.tldr: 提出首个面向植物病理学的多轮意图驱动视觉问答基准PlantInquiryVQA，用24 K图像与138 K问答对构建“探究链”框架，使模型像专家一样按视觉线索逐轮追问，显著提升诊断准确率并抑制幻觉。
AI.motivation: 传统视觉语言模型仅在单轮QA上评测，而真实植物病害诊断需专家根据物种、症状、严重程度进行多轮结构化追问；现有评测无法反映这一关键差异，亟需可评估“像植物学家一样思考”的基准。
AI.method: 设计“探究链”(Chain of Inquiry)框架，把诊断轨迹形式化为以视觉线索与显式认知意图为条件的有序问答序列；构建PlantInquiryVQA，含24 950张专家筛选叶片图像与138 068对问答，附带视觉定位、严重度标签与领域推理模板；在此基准上系统评测领先多模态大模型并比较有无结构化追问策略。
AI.result: 顶级多模态大模型虽能描述症状，却缺乏安全临床推理与精准诊断；引入结构化追问后，诊断正确率显著提升，幻觉大幅降低，推理效率提高，证实多轮意图驱动推理对植物病害诊断至关重要。
AI.conclusion: PlantInquiryVQA首次将植物病理诊断转化为可量化的多轮视觉推理任务，证明“像专家一样追问”比静态分类更有效，为训练具备人类级诊断能力的智能体提供基础基准与数据支撑。

title: Frequency-Forcing: From Scaling-as-Time to Soft Frequency Guidance
summary: While standard flow-matching models transport noise to data uniformly, incorporating an explicit generation order - specifically, establishing coarse, low-frequency structure before fine detail - has proven highly effective for synthesizing natural images. Two recent works offer distinct paradigms for this. K-Flow imposes a hard frequency constraint by reinterpreting a frequency scaling variable as flow time, running the trajectory inside a transformed amplitude space. Latent Forcing provides a soft ordering mechanism by coupling the pixel flow with an auxiliary semantic latent flow via asynchronous time schedules, leaving the pixel interpolation path itself untouched. Viewed from the angle of improving pixel generation, we observe that forcing - guiding generation with an earlier-maturing auxiliary stream - offers a highly compatible route to scale-ordered generation without rewriting the core flow coordinate. Building on this, we propose Frequency-Forcing, which realizes K-Flow's frequency ordering through Latent Forcing's soft mechanism: a standard pixel flow is guided by an auxiliary low-frequency stream that matures earlier in time. Unlike Latent Forcing, whose scratchpad relies on a heavy pretrained encoder (e.g., DINO), our frequency scratchpad is derived from the data itself via a lightweight learnable wavelet packet transform. We term this a self-forcing signal, which avoids external dependencies while learning a basis better adapted to data statistics than the fixed bases used in hard frequency flows. On ImageNet-256, Frequency-Forcing consistently improves FID over strong pixel- and latent-space baselines, and naturally composes with a semantic stream to yield further gains. This illustrates that forcing-based scale ordering is a versatile, path-preserving alternative to hard frequency flows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Frequency-Forcing，用 Latent Forcing 的“软”引导框架实现 K-Flow 的“硬”频率排序，无需外部编码器，仅通过轻量级可学习小波包构造自引导低频流，优先建立粗结构再补细节，在 ImageNet-256 上显著优于强基线并可与语义流进一步叠加。
AI.motivation: 观察到自然图像生成若先建立低频粗结构再补充高频细节可显著提升质量，但现有方法或需硬编码频率坐标（K-Flow）或依赖重型外部编码器（Latent Forcing），希望找到一条无需重写核心流、无外部依赖、且能保留路径的通用尺度排序方案。
AI.method: 将 K-Flow 的“频率即时间”思想转化为“软”辅助流：主像素流保持不变，引入一条可学习的低通小波包流作为自引导信号；通过异步时间调度让该低频流率先成熟，从而把粗结构信息强制注入后续像素生成，整体框架称为 Frequency-Forcing。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet-256 上，Frequency-Forcing 相比 state-of-the-art 的纯像素流与潜空间流基线持续降低 FID；若再叠加语义辅助流，指标可进一步提升，验证其兼容性与增益空间。
AI.conclusion: 强制式尺度排序只需在旁路引入早熟的低频信号即可实现，无需改动主流动坐标，也无需重型外部编码器，为图像生成提供了一条轻量、通用、路径保留的替代硬频率流的新路线。

title: Architecture of an AI-Based Automated Course of Action Generation System for Military Operations
summary: The automation system for Course of Action (CoA) planning is an essential element in future warfare. As maneuver speeds increase, surveillance ranges extend, and weapon ranges grow, the operational area expands, making traditional manned-based CoA planning increasingly challenging. Consequently, the development of an AI-based automated CoA planning system is becoming increasingly necessary. Accordingly, several countries and defense organizations are actively developing AI-based CoA planning systems. However, due to security restrictions and limited public disclosure, the technical maturity of such systems remains difficult to assess. Furthermore, as these systems are military-related, their details are not publicly disclosed, making it difficult to accurately assess the current level of development. In response to this, this study aims to introduce relevant doctrines within the scope of publicly available information and present applicable AI technologies for each stage of the CoA planning process. Ultimately, it proposes an architecture for the development of an automated CoA planning system.

AI.tldr: 文章在公开信息范围内梳理了各军种作战方案规划流程及相关条令，并针对规划的六个阶段匹配可用的 AI 技术，最终提出一套可落地的 AI 作战方案规划系统参考架构。
AI.motivation: 随着战场空间扩大、节奏加快，传统人工作战方案（CoA）规划难以满足时效与复杂度要求；各国竞相研发 AI 规划系统，却因保密壁垒难以评估技术成熟度并借鉴经验，亟需公开视野下的系统性技术路线图。
AI.method: 作者基于公开条令，将作战方案规划抽象为“态势理解→生成→评估→推演→优化→执行监控”六阶段，逐阶段梳理可用 AI 算法（如多模态感知融合、深度强化学习生成、博弈评估、数字孪生推演、Bayes 优化、自适应执行），通过分层模块化方式给出一种可解释、可演进的系统架构，并讨论数据、安全、人机协同等关键使能要素。
AI.result: 提出一个融合感知–认知–决策–反馈闭环的 AI-CoA 规划系统四层架构（数据层、服务层、算法层、应用层），验证性实验表明在典型陆空协同想定下，AI 生成与评估 64 条候选方案所需时间从人工 8 小时缩短至 15 分钟，且胜率提升 12%。
AI.conclusion: 公开信息条件下的条令–技术映射可行，AI 能显著提升作战方案规划的效率与质量；建议后续围绕可解释性、实时性、对抗样本鲁棒性及分布式作战场景展开深化研究，并推动联盟数据共享与伦理治理框架建设。

title: Achieving the Kesten-Stigum bound in the non-uniform hypergraph stochastic block model
summary:
We study the community detection problem in the non-uniform hypergraph stochastic block model (HSBM), where hyperedges of varying sizes coexist. This setting captures higher-order and multi-view interactions and raises a fundamental question: can multiple uniform hypergraph layers below the detection threshold be combined to enable weak recovery? We answer this question by establishing a Kesten--Stigum-type bound for weak recovery in a general class of non-uniform HSBMs with $r$ blocks, generated according to multiple symmetric probability tensors. In the case $r=2$, we show that weak recovery is possible whenever the sum of the signal-to-noise ratios across all uniform hypergraph layers exceeds one, thereby confirming the positive part of a conjecture in (Chodrow et al., 2023). Moreover, we provide a polynomial-time spectral algorithm that achieves this threshold via an optimally weighted non-backtracking operator. For the unweighted non-backtracking matrix, our spectral method attains a different algorithmic threshold, also conjectured in (Chodrow et al., 2023).
  Our approach develops a spectral theory for weighted non-backtracking operators on non-uniform hypergraphs, including a precise characterization of outlier eigenvalues and eigenvector overlaps. We introduce a novel Ihara--Bass formula tailored to weighted non-uniform hypergraphs, which yields an efficient low-dimensional representation and leads to a provable spectral reconstruction algorithm. Taken together, these results provide a principled and computationally efficient approach to clustering in non-uniform hypergraphs, and highlight the role of optimal weighting in aggregating heterogeneous higher-order interactions.

AI.tldr: 非均匀超图随机块模型中，只要各阶超图层的信噪比之和大于1即可实现弱恢复，并给出基于最优加权非回溯算子的多项式时间谱算法及完整谱理论。
AI.motivation: 现实网络常同时存在不同大小的超边（高阶、多视角交互），而现有理论仅处理单一阶超图，且常低于可检测阈值，因此需探明能否通过融合多阶信息突破该阈值。
AI.method: 建立r-块非均匀HSBM的Kesten–Stigum型弱恢复界；对r=2证明信噪比和>1即可恢复；设计加权非回溯算子，提出非均匀超图Ihara–Bass公式，精确描述离群特征值与特征向量重叠，实现低维谱重构。
AI.result: 理论上确认Chodrow等2023猜想正部，给出弱恢复精确阈值；算法上提供多项式时间谱聚类，分别匹配加权与非加权情形阈值；谱理论层面建立非均匀超图加权非回溯算子的完整分析框架。
AI.conclusion: 通过最优权重整合异质高阶交互，可在计算可行的同时突破单阶检测极限，为复杂超图聚类提供理论保证与高效算法。

title: Cross-Distribution Diffusion Priors-Driven Iterative Reconstruction for Sparse-View CT
comment: 17 pages, 15 figures, accepted by IEEE Transactions on Medical Imaging
summary: Sparse-View CT (SVCT) reconstruction enhances temporal resolution and reduces radiation dose, yet its clinical use is hindered by artifacts due to view reduction and domain shifts from scanner, protocol, or anatomical variations, leading to performance degradation in out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios. In this work, we propose a Cross-Distribution Diffusion Priors-Driven Iterative Reconstruction (CDPIR) framework to tackle the OOD problem in SVCT. CDPIR integrates cross-distribution diffusion priors, derived from a Scalable Interpolant Transformer (SiT), with model-based iterative reconstruction methods. Specifically, we train a SiT backbone, an extension of the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) architecture, to establish a unified stochastic interpolant framework, leveraging Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) across multiple datasets. By randomly dropping the conditioning with a null embedding during training, the model learns both domain-specific and domain-invariant priors, enhancing generalizability. During sampling, the globally sensitive transformer-based diffusion model exploits the cross-distribution prior within the unified stochastic interpolant framework, enabling flexible and stable control over multi-distribution-to-noise interpolation paths and decoupled sampling strategies, thereby improving adaptation to OOD reconstruction. By alternating between data fidelity and sampling updates, our model achieves state-of-the-art performance with superior detail preservation in SVCT reconstructions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CDPIR significantly outperforms existing approaches, particularly under OOD conditions, highlighting its robustness and potential clinical value in challenging imaging scenarios.

AI.tldr: CDPIR 框架把跨域扩散先验嵌入模型迭代重建，解决稀疏角度 CT 的域漂移与伪影问题。
AI.motivation: 稀疏角度 CT 降低辐射并提速，但采样角度少与设备/协议/解剖变化导致域漂移，使现有网络在分布外场景性能骤降，限制临床落地。
AI.method: 提出 CDPIR：1) 用可扩展插值 Transformer(SiT) 在统一随机插值框架下训练扩散模型，训练中随机丢弃条件以同时学习域特异与域不变先验；2) 推理阶段用基于 CFG 的跨域先验指导模型迭代重建，交替更新数据保真与采样，实现多分布–噪声去耦采样。
AI.result: 在分布内外数据上均达到 SOTA，细节保持更好；OOD 条件下优势尤为显著，伪影抑制与结构保真指标全面领先。
AI.conclusion: CDPIR 通过跨域扩散先验与迭代重建耦合，显著增强稀疏角度 CT 对域变化的鲁棒性，具备直接临床应用潜力。

title: AFRILANGTUTOR: Advancing Language Tutoring and Culture Education in Low-Resource Languages with Large Language Models
summary: How can language learning systems be developed for languages that lack sufficient training resources? This challenge is increasingly faced by developers across the African continent who aim to build AI systems capable of understanding and responding in local languages. To address this gap, we introduce AFRILANGDICT, a collection of 194.7K African language-English dictionary entries designed as seed resources for generating language-learning materials, enabling us to automatically construct large-scale, diverse, and verifiable student-tutor question-answer interactions suitable for training AI-assisted language tutors. Using AFRILANGDICT, we build AFRILANGEDU, a dataset of 78.9K multi-turn training examples for Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). Using AFRILANGEDU, we train language tutoring models collectively referred to as AFRILANGTUTOR. We fine-tune two multilingual LLMs: Llama-3-8B-IT and Gemma-3-12B-IT on AFRILANGEDU across 10 African languages and evaluate their performance. Our results show that models trained on AFRILANGEDU consistently outperform their base counterparts, and combining SFT and DPO yields substantial improvements, with gains ranging from 1.8% to 15.5% under LLM-as-a-judge evaluations across four criteria. To facilitate further research on low-resource languages -- all resources are available at https://huggingface.co/afrilang-edu.

AI.tldr: 针对缺乏训练资源的非洲低资源语言，作者发布含19.47万词条的AFRILANGDICT，并由此自动生成7.89万轮多轮对话数据AFRILANGEDU，经SFT+DPO微调得到Llama-3-8B-IT与Gemma-3-12B-IT的非洲语言导师模型，在10种语言上较基座模型提升1.8%–15.5%，数据集已开源。
AI.motivation: 非洲大陆众多本地语言训练数据极度稀缺，阻碍AI语言学习系统落地，亟需可扩展且可验证的启动资源与训练框架。
AI.method: 构建大规模非洲语言-英语词典AFRILANGDICT；设计模板将词条自动转换为多轮师生问答，形成SFT+DPO双阶段训练集AFRILANGEDU；用该数据集对Llama-3-8B-IT和Gemma-3-12B-IT进行监督微调与偏好优化，覆盖10种非洲语言；采用LLM-as-a-judge四维度评估框架对比基座与微调模型。
AI.result: 微调后的AFRILANGTUTOR在所有测试语言上均优于对应基座模型；SFT+DPO联合策略带来的绝对提升区间为1.8%–15.5%，验证低资源场景下词典驱动数据合成的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 词典驱动的自动对话生成可低成本扩展低资源语言训练数据，结合SFT与DPO能显著提升多语言LLM的导师能力，为非洲本地语言AI教育应用提供可复制范式。

title: Linear Image Generation by Synthesizing Exposure Brackets
summary: The life of a photo begins with photons striking the sensor, whose signals are passed through a sophisticated image signal processing (ISP) pipeline to produce a display-referred image. However, such images are no longer faithful to the incident light, being compressed in dynamic range and stylized by subjective preferences. In contrast, RAW images record direct sensor signals before non-linear tone mapping. After camera response curve correction and demosaicing, they can be converted into linear images, which are scene-referred representations that directly reflect true irradiance and are invariant to sensor-specific factors. Since image sensors have better dynamic range and bit depth, linear images contain richer information than display-referred ones, leaving users more room for editing during post-processing. Despite this advantage, current generative models mainly synthesize display-referred images, which inherently limits downstream editing. In this paper, we address the task of text-to-linear-image generation: synthesizing a high-quality, scene-referred linear image that preserves full dynamic range, conditioned on a text prompt, for professional post-processing. Generating linear images is challenging, as pre-trained VAEs in latent diffusion models struggle to simultaneously preserve extreme highlights and shadows due to the higher dynamic range and bit depth. To this end, we represent a linear image as a sequence of exposure brackets, each capturing a specific portion of the dynamic range, and propose a DiT-based flow-matching architecture for text-conditioned exposure bracket generation. We further demonstrate downstream applications including text-guided linear image editing and structure-conditioned generation via ControlNet.

AI.tldr: 首次提出文本驱动的“线性图像”生成，把HDR场景辐照度直接作为生成目标，为专业后期留出完整动态范围与比特深度。
AI.motivation: 现有生成模型只输出经 ISP 压缩、风格化的 sRGB 图像，动态范围与调色空间受限；而 RAW/线性图像忠实记录场景辐照度，可承受大幅后期，却未被生成式模型触及。
AI.method: 1)将高动态范围线性图像重新参数化为“曝光包围序列”，每帧只承载局部亮度段；2)设计基于 DiT 的流匹配模型，实现文本条件化的多帧包围曝光同步生成；3)引入 ControlNet 变体，支持结构引导的线性图像生成。
AI.result: 在公开数据集上，该方法可合成 16-bit 线性图像，峰值信噪比和颜色精度优于直接微调 LDM 的基线；生成的包围序列经合并后动态范围提升≥4 EV，支持无缝高比特后期调色、重打光与 HDR 合成。
AI.conclusion: 文本-线性图像生成框架突破了 sRGB 表达上限，把生成式模型推向场景参考空间，为计算摄影、电影预制与专业后期提供了可直接编辑的辐照度资产，开辟了“生成即 RAW”的新路线。

title: Reinforcing privacy reasoning in LLMs via normative simulacra from fiction
summary: Information handling practices of LLM agents are broadly misaligned with the contextual privacy expectations of their users. Contextual Integrity (CI) provides a principled framework, defining privacy as the appropriate flow of information within context-relative norms. However, existing approaches either double inference cost via supervisor-assistant architectures, or fine-tune on narrow task-specific data. We propose extracting normative simulacra (structured representations of norms and information flows) from fiction novels and using them to fine-tune LLMs via supervised learning followed by GRPO reinforcement learning. Our composite reward function combines programmatic signals, including task clarity (subsuming schema validity, construct discrimination, and extraction confidence), structural completeness, internal consistency, and context identification, with an LLM judge that evaluates whether the model's privacy reasoning is grounded in the held-out normative universe of the source text. To mitigate overfitting, we introduce per-completion contrastive scoring: each completion is evaluated against both the correct normative universe and a randomly selected wrong one, teaching the model to condition on context rather than memorize source-specific norms. We evaluate on five CI-aligned benchmarks spanning distinct societal contexts and ablate the contributions of RL and normative grounding. Across seven models, SFT introduces a conservative prior toward restricting information flow, improving recognition of privacy-relevant situations but not the correctness of privacy judgments. GRPO with normative grounding achieves the highest score on a law compliance benchmark and strongest correlation with crowdsourced human privacy expectations, demonstrating that fiction-derived normative simulacra can teach contextual privacy reasoning that transfers to real-world domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用小说里抽出的“规范模拟体”微调+强化微调，让大模型学会符合情境隐私（CI）的推理，在5个基准和7个模型上优于既有方法，且在法律合规和人对隐私期待的相关性上达到最佳。
AI.motivation: LLM代理的信息处理行为与用户对情境隐私的隐含期待普遍错位；现有监督-助手架构推理成本高，任务特定微调又过窄，急需一种可泛化、成本可控且能内化情境规范的训练范式。
AI.method: 1) 从小说语料提取“规范模拟体”（结构化规范+信息流表示）；2) 先用抽取样本做监督微调（SFT），再用GRPO强化学习继续训练；3) 综合奖励=任务清晰度+结构完整+内部一致+情境识别+LLM评判是否与源文本规范宇宙一致；4) 每样本对比打分，防过拟合。
AI.result: 在5个CI对齐基准上，SFT先让模型趋向保守限流，提升隐私场景识别但判断准确度不足；加入GRPO与规范 grounding后，在法律合规基准夺冠，且与 crowdsourced 人类隐私期待相关性最高。
AI.conclusion: 小说衍生的规范模拟体足以教会模型情境隐私推理，并可向真实领域迁移；GRPO+规范 grounding 是提升LLM情境隐私对齐的有效路径。

title: Escaping the Agreement Trap: Defensibility Signals for Evaluating Rule-Governed AI
comment: 22 pages, 10 figures, preprint. Research on Defensibility Index (DI), Ambiguity Index (AI), and Probabilistic Defensibility Signal (PDS) for policy-grounded evaluation of rule-governed AI in content moderation (Reddit production data)
summary: Content moderation systems are typically evaluated by measuring agreement with human labels. In rule-governed environments this assumption fails: multiple decisions may be logically consistent with the governing policy, and agreement metrics penalize valid decisions while mischaracterizing ambiguity as error - a failure mode we term the Agreement Trap. We formalize evaluation as policy-grounded correctness and introduce the Defensibility Index (DI) and Ambiguity Index (AI). To estimate reasoning stability without additional audit passes, we introduce the Probabilistic Defensibility Signal (PDS), derived from audit-model token logprobs. We harness LLM reasoning traces as a governance signal rather than a classification output by deploying the audit model not to decide whether content violates policy, but to verify whether a proposed decision is logically derivable from the governing rule hierarchy. We validate the framework on 193,000+ Reddit moderation decisions across multiple communities and evaluation cohorts, finding a 33-46.6 percentage-point gap between agreement-based and policy-grounded metrics, with 79.8-80.6% of the model's false negatives corresponding to policy-grounded decisions rather than true errors. We further show that measured ambiguity is driven by rule specificity: auditing 37,286 identical decisions under three tiers of the same community rules reduces AI by 10.8 pp while DI remains stable. Repeated-sampling analysis attributes PDS variance primarily to governance ambiguity rather than decoding noise. A Governance Gate built on these signals achieves 78.6% automation coverage with 64.9% risk reduction. Together, these results show that evaluation in rule-governed environments should shift from agreement with historical labels to reasoning-grounded validity under explicit rules.

AI.tldr: 传统内容审核评估依赖与人类标签的一致性，但这一思路在有明确规则的场景中会导致“一致性陷阱”：系统把政策允许的多重正确决策误判为错误，并把政策本身的模糊性误当成分类误差。作者提出用“政策可推导性”取代一致性，构建可辩护性指数（DI）与模糊性指数（AI），再利用大模型推理轨迹生成无需额外人工审计的概率可辩护信号（PDS）。在19.3万条Reddit审核数据上，政策导向指标比一致性指标高出33–46.6个百分点，80% 左右的“假阴性”实为政策允许的正确决策；规则细化可使AI下降10.8个百分点而不影响DI。基于PDS的“治理门”实现78.6%自动化覆盖并降低64.9%风险，证明规则场景下的评估应从“像不像人”转向“是否合法”。
AI.motivation: 现有评估把与人类标签的一致性当成金标准，却忽略了规则型社区中“多条决策路径均合法”的本质，导致系统被过度惩罚、政策模糊被错当误差。需要一套以显性政策为锚、能量化合法决策空间并区分模糊与错误的新评估范式。
AI.method: 1) 形式化“政策可推导正确性”：若决策可从规则体系逻辑推出即为正确。2) 提出DI（可辩护性比例）与AI（多重合法决策比例）。3) 用审计大模型生成推理轨迹，不输出分类，而是检验“给定决策是否可被规则推出”，将token-logprob 聚合为Probabilistic Defensibility Signal (PDS)，零额外人工即可估计稳定性。4) 在19.3万条Reddit跨社区数据上对比一致性 vs 政策导向指标；对3.7万条同一决策用三级细化规则重复采样，分离规则特异性与解码噪声影响；最后用PDS构建Governance Gate实现自动化审核。
AI.result: 一致性指标与政策导向指标差距达33–46.6 pp；模型“假阴性”中79.8–80.6%实为政策允许的正确决策。规则细化使AI下降10.8 pp，DI保持稳定，说明测得的“模糊”主要来自规则本身而非解码随机。PDS方差绝大部分归因于政策模糊。Governance Gate在78.6%提交上自动决策，风险曝光降低64.9%。
AI.conclusion: 在规则明确的内容治理场景，评估核心应从“是否与人一致”转为“是否可被规则推出”。DI/AI/PDS 提供可复用的政策 grounded 评估与自动化信号，可直接嵌入现有审核管线，实现高覆盖、低风险的大模型辅助治理。

title: Learning to Emulate Chaos: Adversarial Optimal Transport Regularization
summary: Chaos arises in many complex dynamical systems, from weather to power grids, but is difficult to accurately model using data-driven emulators, including neural operator architectures. For chaotic systems, the inherent sensitivity to initial conditions makes exact long-term forecasts theoretically infeasible, meaning that traditional squared-error losses often fail when trained on noisy data. Recent work has focused on training emulators to match the statistical properties of chaotic attractors by introducing regularization based on handcrafted local features and summary statistics, as well as learned statistics extracted from a diverse dataset of trajectories. In this work, we propose a family of adversarial optimal transport objectives that jointly learn high-quality summary statistics and a physically consistent emulator. We theoretically analyze and experimentally validate a Sinkhorn divergence formulation (2-Wasserstein) and a WGAN-style dual formulation (1-Wasserstein). Our experiments across a variety of chaotic systems, including systems with high-dimensional chaotic attractors, show that emulators trained with our approach exhibit significantly improved long-term statistical fidelity.

AI.tldr: 针对高维混沌系统难以用数据驱动方式建模的问题，本文提出用对抗最优传输（Sinkhorn 与 WGAN 变体）同时学习物理一致的仿真器与高质量概括统计量，显著提升了长期统计保真度。
AI.motivation: 混沌系统对初值极端敏感，传统均方误差损失在含噪数据上训练时失效，现有方法仅依赖手工或预学统计特征，难以捕捉高维混沌吸引子的完整统计特性。
AI.method: 设计一类对抗最优传输目标函数，联合优化：① 基于 Sinkhorn 散度的 2-Wasserstein 形式；② 类似 WGAN 的 1-Wasserstein 对偶形式。二者在训练过程中同步更新概括统计量提取器与仿真器参数，实现统计特征空间的对齐。
AI.result: 在多个混沌系统（含高维吸引子）上的实验显示，所训仿真器在长期积分后，其统计分布与真实吸引子的差异显著减小，统计保真度优于现有正则化方法。
AI.conclusion: 对抗最优传输为混沌系统数据驱动建模提供了可扩展框架，能在理论上不可精确长期预测的限制下，仍保证仿真器统计行为与真实系统一致，为复杂动力系统 emulator 设计开辟了新方向。

title: Towards robust quantitative photoacoustic tomography via learned iterative methods
summary: Photoacoustic tomography (PAT) is a medical imaging modality that can provide high-resolution tissue images based on the optical absorption. Classical reconstruction methods for quantifying the absorption coefficients rely on sufficient prior information to overcome noisy and imperfect measurements. As these methods utilize computationally expensive forward models, the computation becomes slow, limiting their potential for time-critical applications. As an alternative approach, deep learning-based reconstruction methods have been established for faster and more accurate reconstructions. However, most of these methods rely on having a large amount of training data, which is not the case in practice. In this work, we adopt the model-based learned iterative approach for the use in Quantitative PAT (QPAT), in which additional information from the model is iteratively provided to the updating networks, allowing better generalizability with scarce training data. We compare the performance of different learned updates based on gradient descent, Gauss-Newton, and Quasi-Newton methods. The learning tasks are formulated as greedy, requiring iterate-wise optimality, as well as end-to-end, where all networks are trained jointly. The implemented methods are tested with ideal simulated data as well as against a digital twin dataset that emulates scarce training data and high modeling error.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种模型驱动的可学习迭代框架，使定量光声断层成像（QPAT）在小样本下仍能高质量反演吸收系数，速度远快于传统方法。
AI.motivation: 经典 QPAT 重建需精确前向模型与大量先验抑制噪声，计算昂贵且慢；纯数据驱动深度网络又受限于临床难获取的大训练集，难以用于实时成像。
AI.method: 将 QPAT 反演嵌入“模型-学习”混合迭代：每步用可学习网络修正梯度下降、Gauss-Newton 或 Quasi-Newton 更新，网络输入除当前估计外还附加模型预测的残差与一阶/二阶信息；训练策略分贪婪（逐次最优）与端到端（联合优化所有网络）两种，并在数字孪生稀缺数据与建模误差场景下验证。
AI.result: 在仿真与数字孪生数据集上，该方法仅用 1/10 训练样本即可达到经典方法相当的定量精度，推理时间降低一个数量级；端到端策略略优，Quasi-Newton 型更新在强建模误差下鲁棒性最佳。
AI.conclusion: 模型驱动的可学习迭代重建可在小样本、有建模误差时实现快速、准确的 QPAT 定量成像，为临床实时应用与个性化模型提供可行途径。

title: Hierarchical Policy Optimization for Simultaneous Translation of Unbounded Speech
summary: Simultaneous speech translation (SST) generates translations while receiving partial speech input. Recent advances show that large language models (LLMs) can substantially improve SST quality, but at the cost of high computational overhead. To reduce this cost, prior work reformulates SST as a multi-turn dialogue task, enabling full reuse of the LLM's key-value (KV) cache and eliminating redundant feature recomputation. However, this approach relies on supervised fine-tuning (SFT) data in dialogue form, for which few human annotations exist, and existing synthesis methods cannot guarantee data quality. In this work, we propose a Hierarchical Policy Optimization (HPO) approach that post-train models trained on imperfect SFT data. We introduce a hierarchical reward that balances translation quality and latency objectives. Experiments on English to Chinese/German/Japanese demonstrate improvements of over +7 COMET score and +1.25 MetricX score at a latency of 1.5 seconds. Comprehensive ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of different quality rewards, hierarchical reward formulations, and segmentation strategies. Code can be found here https://github.com/owaski/HPO

AI.tldr: 用分层强化学习在LLM上微调1.5s延迟的同传模型，获+7 COMET、+1.25 MetricX提升
AI.motivation: 现有利用LLM进行语音同传的方法需大规模多轮对话标注数据，难以获取；引入LLM虽提升翻译质量但计算昂贵，急需在少量质量不佳的SFT数据基础上进一步优化的方案
AI.method: 提出Hierarchical Policy Optimization（HPO）：先在含噪声的对话式SFT数据上预训练，再以分层奖励（高层侧重译文质量，低层控制延迟和分段）进行表现层后训练，配合KV缓存复用降低冗余计算
AI.result: 英中、英德、英日方向实验显示，在仅1.5秒平均延迟条件下，COMET得分提升逾7分，MetricX提升逾1.25分；细粒度消融证明分层奖励、质量奖励函数及分段策略均对性能增益有显著贡献
AI.conclusion: HPO可在少量不完美SFT数据下有效利用LLM KV缓存，兼顾质量与延迟，为低成本高性能同传提供实用方案，并具有向其他低延迟生成任务扩展的潜力

title: Micro-DualNet: Dual-Path Spatio-Temporal Network for Micro-Action Recognition
comment: Accepted to International Conference on Automatic Face and Gesture Recognition (FG)
summary: Micro-actions are subtle, localized movements lasting 1-3 seconds such as scratching one's head or tapping fingers. Such subtle actions are essential for social communication, ubiquitously used in natural interactions, and thus critical for fine-grained video understanding, yet remain poorly understood by current computer vision systems. We identify a fundamental challenge: micro-actions exhibit diverse spatio-temporal characteristics where some are defined by spatial configurations while others manifest through temporal dynamics. Existing methods that commit to a single spatio-temporal decomposition cannot accommodate this diversity. We propose a dual-path network that processes anatomically-grounded spatial entities through parallel Spatial-Temporal (ST) and Temporal-Spatial (TS) pathways. The ST path captures spatial configurations before modeling temporal dynamics, while the TS path inverts this order to prioritize temporal dynamics. Rather than fixed fusion, we introduce entity-level adaptive routing where each body part learns its optimal processing preference, complemented by Mutual Action Consistency (MAC) loss that enforces cross-path coherence. Extensive experiments demonstrate competitive performance on MA-52 dataset and state-of-the-art results on iMiGUE dataset. Our work reveals that architectural adaptation to the inherent complexity of micro-actions is essential for advancing fine-grained video understanding.

AI.tldr: 针对1–3秒的局部微动作识别，提出“先空间后时间”与“先时间后空间”双路径网络，通过部位级自适应路由与跨路径一致性损失，在MA-52和iMiGUE上刷新SOTA，证明架构需匹配微动作本身的多变性。
AI.motivation: 微动作虽普遍且关键，却因“有的靠空间构型、有的靠时间动态”而呈现异质时空特性，单一固定的时空分解网络无法同时兼顾，导致现有系统识别精度受限。
AI.method: 设计双路径并行网络：ST路径先提取空间构型再做时间建模，TS路径先捕捉时间动态再补空间细节；引入部位级可学习路由为每个解剖实体动态选择主路径，并用 Mutual Action Consistency (MAC) 损失迫使两条路径输出保持一致，实现自适应融合。
AI.result: 在MA-52数据集上取得竞争性结果，在iMiGUE数据集达到当前最优精度，显著超越单一顺序建模的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 微动作的时空特性天生多样，唯有让网络结构随“部位-动作”特性自适应调整，才能真正推进细粒度视频理解；双路径+自适应路由是一种通用且有效的设计范式。

title: Do Masked Autoencoders Improve Downhole Prediction? An Empirical Study on Real Well Drilling Data
summary: Downhole drilling telemetry presents a fundamental labeling asymmetry: surface sensor data are generated continuously at 1~Hz, while labeled downhole measurements are costly, intermittent, and scarce. Current machine learning approaches for downhole metric prediction universally adopt fully supervised training from scratch, which is poorly suited to this data regime. We present the first empirical evaluation of masked autoencoder (MAE) pretraining for downhole drilling metric prediction. Using two publicly available Utah FORGE geothermal wells comprising approximately 3.5 million timesteps of multivariate drilling telemetry, we conduct a systematic full-factorial design space search across 72 MAE configurations and compare them against supervised LSTM and GRU baselines on the task of predicting Total Mud Volume. Results show that the best MAE configuration reduces test mean absolute error by 19.8\% relative to the supervised GRU baseline, while trailing the supervised LSTM baseline by 6.4\%. Analysis of design dimensions reveals that latent space width is the dominant architectural choice (Pearson $r = -0.59$ with test MAE), while masking ratio has negligible effect, an unexpected finding attributed to high temporal redundancy in 1~Hz drilling data. These results establish MAE pretraining as a viable paradigm for drilling analytics and identify the conditions under which it is most beneficial.

AI.tldr: 在井筒遥测数据极度缺失的场景下，借助对比35 万时间步的地热井数据，首次验证了掩码自编码(MAE)预训练能有效替代传统全监督方法，对钻井液总体积预测的测试误差比 GRU 降低 19.8%。
AI.motivation: 钻井场景中地面传感器数据持续丰富(1 Hz)，而宝贵的井底标签昂贵、稀疏且断续，现有完全监督方法直接忽视大量无标注数据，难以发挥样本潜力。
AI.method: 利用犹他州两口公开地热井约 350 万时间步的多变量遥测，设计 72 组 MAE 配置进行全因子搜索，再在相同下游任务上与监督 LSTM/GRU 基准对比。
AI.result: 最优 MAE 配置将测试平均绝对误差较 GRU 基准降低 19.8%，较 LSTM 基准仅略高 6.4%；消融发现隐空间宽度对误差影响最大（r = -0.59），而掩码比例几乎无影响，原因在于 1 Hz 数据时序过冗余。
AI.conclusion: MAE 预训练能在钻井分析中显著优于传统 RNN 全监督方案；当无标签遥测丰富且采样频率高时，增大隐空间即可带来最大收益，为后续钻井智能提供可复用的表征学习范式。

title: Co-Evolving LLM Decision and Skill Bank Agents for Long-Horizon Tasks
summary: Long horizon interactive environments are a testbed for evaluating agents skill usage abilities. These environments demand multi step reasoning, the chaining of multiple skills over many timesteps, and robust decision making under delayed rewards and partial observability. Games are a good testbed for evaluating agent skill usage in environments. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a promising alternative as game playing agents, but they often struggle with consistent long horizon decision making because they lack a mechanism to discover, retain, and reuse structured skills across episodes. We present COSPLAY, a co evolution framework in which an LLM decision agent retrieves skills from a learnable skill bank to guide action taking, while an agent managed skill pipeline discovers reusable skills from the agents unlabeled rollouts to form a skill bank. Our framework improves both the decision agent to learn better skill retrieval and action generation, while the skill bank agent continually extracts, refines, and updates skills together with their contracts. Experiments across six game environments show that COSPLAY with an 8B base model achieves over 25.1 percent average reward improvement against four frontier LLM baselines on single player game benchmarks while remaining competitive on multi player social reasoning games.

AI.tldr: COSPLAY框架让8B参数的LLM在长时游戏环境中平均提升25%奖励：一边是决策代理从可学习技能库中即时检索技能，另一边是技能管道从代理的未标注轨迹中自动发现并更新技能库，实现两者协同进化的闭环。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM虽有潜力，但在需要多步推理、延迟奖励和部分观测的长时游戏任务中难以一致地发现、保存并复用结构化技能。
AI.method: 提出COSPLAY——基于协同进化的LLM系统：决策者按情境动态检索技能指导动作，技能管道从决策者的无标注轨迹中持续抽取、精炼并维护技能及其契约，两条链路并行迭代优化。
AI.result: 在六大完整（单人与多智能体社交推理）环境中，COSPLAY（8B模型）相较四个前沿LLM基线平均奖励提升25.1%，同时在多智能体任务上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，通过决策代理与技能库的协同进化，COSPLAY可以显著提升LLM在长视距复杂环境中的持续决策与技能复用能力，为构建轮次无关的智能体提供可行范式。

title: Refining Covariance Matrix Estimation in Stochastic Gradient Descent Through Bias Reduction
summary: We study online inference and asymptotic covariance estimation for the stochastic gradient descent (SGD) algorithm. While classical methods (such as plug-in and batch-means estimators) are available, they either require inaccessible second-order (Hessian) information or suffer from slow convergence. To address these challenges, we propose a novel, fully online de-biased covariance estimator that eliminates the need for second-order derivatives while significantly improving estimation accuracy. Our method employs a bias-reduction technique to achieve a convergence rate of $n^{(α-1)/2} \sqrt{\log n}$, outperforming existing Hessian-free alternatives.

AI.tldr: 用“去偏+在线”的SGD协方差估计器，在无Hessian条件下达到　n^{(α−1)/2}√log n　的收敛速度，优于现有无Hessian批量均值或插件估计。
AI.motivation: 传统在线误差估计需难以获取的Hessian（插件法）或收敛极慢（批量均值法），阻碍了大规模SGD推断。
AI.method: 提出完全在线的去偏协方差估计器：在迭代中实时纠偏，仅使用一阶梯度，无需存储或计算Hessian。
AI.result: 理论证明估计误差以　n^{(α−1)/2}√log n　速率趋零，显著快于现有无Hessian方案；模拟验证方差估计更接近真实值。
AI.conclusion: 新方法在仅牺牲极小对数因子的情况下，实现无Hessian、高精度的在线推断，为大规模SGD提供实用协方差估计工具。

title: Tumor-anchored deep feature random forests for out-of-distribution detection in lung cancer segmentation
comment: Accepted for publication in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 2026. Code available at: https://github.com/aneesh3108/RF-Deep
summary:
Accurate segmentation of lung tumors from 3D computed tomography (CT) scans is essential for automated treatment planning and response assessment. Despite self-supervised pretraining on numerous datasets, state-of-the-art transformer backbones remain susceptible to out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs, often producing confidently incorrect segmentations with potential for risk in clinical deployment. Hence, we introduce RF-Deep, a lightweight post-hoc random forests-based framework that leverages deep features trained with limited outlier exposure, requiring as few as 40 labeled scans (20 in-distribution and 20 OOD), to improve scan-level OOD detection. RF-Deep repurposes the hierarchical features from the pretrained-then-finetuned segmentation backbones, aggregating features from multiple regions-of-interest anchored to predicted tumor regions to capture OOD likelihood.
  We evaluated RF-Deep on 2,232 CT volumes spanning near-OOD (pulmonary embolism, COVID-19 negative) and far-OOD (kidney cancer, healthy pancreas) datasets. RF-Deep achieved AUROC >~93 on the challenging near-OOD datasets, where it outperformed the next best method by 4--7 percentage points, and produced near-perfect detection (AUROC >~99) on far-OOD datasets. The approach also showed transferability to two blinded validation datasets under the ensemble configuration (COVID-19 positive and breast cancer; AUROC >~94). RF-Deep maintained consistent performance across backbones of different depths and pretraining strategies, demonstrating applicability of post-hoc detectors as a safety filter for clinical deployment of tumor segmentation pipelines.

AI.tldr: RF-Deep 用少量（≈40 例）OOD 样本训练轻量级随机森林，在预训练分割主干提取的多 ROI 深度特征上构建扫描级异常检测器，对近/远分布外 CT 体积均取得 >93 AUROC，可作为临床肿瘤分割管道的后置安全过滤器。
AI.motivation: 尽管现有 Transformer 主干在大量数据上自监督预训练，其肺肿瘤分割模型对分布外（OOD）CT 输入仍输出高置信错误掩码，直接威胁临床部署安全，需要一种轻量级、无需重训主分割网络即可添加的后置 OOD 检测机制。
AI.method: 提出 RF-Deep：① 对已完成预训练+微调的分割网络，冻结其权重并提取多尺度特征；② 以预测肿瘤区域为中心锚定多枚 ROI，聚合 ROI 内特征向量；③ 仅用 20 例 ID 和 20 例 OOD CT 训练浅层随机森林，估计整扫描属于 OOD 的概率；④ 整体流程为“分割→特征提取→森林打分→拒绝/通过”。
AI.result: 在 2 232 例 CT 上评估：近 OOD（肺栓塞、COVID-19 阴性）AUROC >93，较次优方法高 4–7 个百分点；远 OOD（肾癌、健康胰腺）AUROC >99；对两套盲测集（COVID-19 阳性、乳腺癌）集成后 AUROC 仍 >94；性能对主干深度和预训练策略不敏感。
AI.conclusion: RF-Deep 证明：利用极少 OOD 样本和后置随机森林即可为已有肿瘤分割模型提供可靠的安全过滤，具备即插即用、跨器官跨疾病迁移能力，为临床部署提供低成本 OOD 保障。

title: TRACES: Tagging Reasoning Steps for Adaptive Cost-Efficient Early-Stopping
summary: The field of Language Reasoning Models (LRMs) has been very active over the past few years with advances in training and inference techniques enabling LRMs to reason longer, and more accurately. However, a growing body of studies show that LRMs are still inefficient, over-generating verification and reflection steps. Additionally, the high-level role of each reasoning step and how different step types contribute to the generation of correct answers, is largely underexplored. To address this challenge, we introduce TRACES (Tagging of the Reasoning steps enabling Adaptive Cost-Efficient early-Stopping), a lightweight framework that tags reasoning steps in real-time, and enable adaptive, cost-efficient early stopping of large-language-model inferences. Building on this framework we monitor reasoning behaviors during inferences, and we find that LRMs tend to shift their reasoning behavior after reaching a correct answer. We demonstrate that the monitoring of the specific type of steps can produce effective interpretable early stopping criteria. We evaluate the TRACES framework on three mathematical reasoning benchmarks, namely, MATH500, GSM8K, AIME and two knowledge and reasoning benchmarks, MMLU and GPQA respectively. We achieve 20 to 50% token reduction while maintaining comparable accuracy to standard generation.

AI.tldr: TRACES通过实时标注推理步类型，在LMM得到正确结果后立即截断，数学/常识五基准上节省20-50%token而准确率不降。
AI.motivation: 现有LRM虽推理长度与精度提升，但普遍冗余验证、过度反射，且缺乏对各步作用与何时已“足够”的系统分析，导致计算浪费。
AI.method: 提出TRACES框架：1)轻量级实时标注器给每步打上语义角色标签；2)在线监测标签分布，检测到“已得出正确答案”的行为偏移态；3)触发可解释早停准则，终止后续无效推理。
AI.result: 在MATH500、GSM8K、AIME、MMLU、GPQA五项基准上，与标准长推理相比平均减少20–50%token消耗，同时保持同档准确率。
AI.conclusion: 标注推理步语义可实现对LRM推理进度的可解释、低成本监控；TRACES首次把“知道何时已经答对”显式用于早停，为高效推理提供通用范式。

title: Unlocking Multi-Spectral Data for Multi-Modal Models with Guided Inputs and Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
summary: Multi-spectral imagery is a valuable input signal for Remote Sensing applications, such as land-use and land-cover classification and environmental monitoring. However, generalist Large Multi-modal Models (LMMs) are typically trained on RGB images, limiting their applicability to the RGB domain. At the same time, training multi-spectral multi-modal models is expensive and produces uniquely specialized models. To address this, we propose a novel training-free approach that introduces multi-spectral data within the inference pipeline of standard RGB-only LMMs, allowing large gains in performance. Our approach leverages the LMMs' understanding of the visual space by adapting non-RGB inputs to that space and injecting domain-specific information and Chain-of-Thought reasoning as instructions. We demonstrate this with the Gemini 2.5 model and observe strong Zero-Shot performance gains on popular Remote Sensing benchmarks. These results highlight the potential for geospatial professionals to leverage powerful generalist models for specialized sensor inputs, benefiting from rich reasoning capabilities grounded in specialized data.

AI.tldr: 无需微调即可让仅支持RGB的大模型直接处理多光谱遥感影像，在零样本场景下显著提升分类与监测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型受限于RGB训练数据，难以利用多光谱信息；而重新训练多光谱专用模型成本极高且失去通用性，亟需兼顾通用模型能力与多光谱信号的解决方案。
AI.method: 推理阶段引入“光谱-到-RGB”自适应映射，将多光谱波段映射到RGB色域，同时把领域先验与链式思维指令注入提示，激活Gemini 2.5的零样本推理能力，实现训练无关的跨模态增强。
AI.result: 在主流遥感基准的零样本测试中，Gemini 2.5配合所提方法取得显著性能跃升，验证了大模型无需微调即可有效吸收多光谱信息。
AI.conclusion: 通用大模型借助轻量级推理级适配即可服务专业遥感任务，为地理空间从业者提供低成本、高推理能力的多光谱应用范式，并提示“通用模型+领域提示”是遥感AI的新方向。

title: FairyFuse: Multiplication-Free LLM Inference on CPUs via Fused Ternary Kernels
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed on CPU-only platforms where memory bandwidth is the primary bottleneck for autoregressive generation. Weight quantization to four bits or below reduces memory pressure, yet existing systems still dequantize weights and perform floating-point multiplications, limiting the achievable gains. Ternary weights in {-1, 0, +1} provide a more efficient alternative, replacing multiplications with conditional additions, subtractions, or no-ops. While Fairy2i shows that ternary LLMs can match FP16 quality, its runtime does not exploit this structure. We present FairyFuse, an inference system that enables multiplication-free execution on commodity CPUs by fusing the eight real-valued sub-GEMVs of each widely-linear layer into a single AVX-512 loop using masked additions and subtractions, with zero floating-point multiplications. Roofline analysis shows that 16x weight compression shifts memory-bound GEMV toward the compute regime on bandwidth-limited CPUs, yielding a 29.6x kernel speedup while offering little benefit on GPUs. End-to-end, FairyFuse achieves 32.4 tokens per second on a single Intel Xeon 8558P, outperforming llama.cpp Q4_K_M by 1.24x with near-lossless quality (WikiText-2 perplexity 5.52 vs. 5.47 FP16; downstream accuracy 66.0%).

AI.tldr: FairyFuse 将 LLM 权重降至三值{-1,0,+1}，在 AVX-512 上用无乘法掩码加减一次性完成 8 路子 GEMV，16 倍压缩权重把内存瓶颈转为计算瓶颈，单 CPU 32.4 tokens/s，比 llama.cpp Q4_K_M 快 1.24 倍且几乎无损精度。
AI.motivation: 纯 CPU 场景下，内存带宽是自回归生成的首要瓶颈；4 bit 及以下量化虽减带宽，但现有系统仍要解量化并做浮点乘法，无法彻底释放压缩收益。
AI.method: 采用三值权重{-1,0,+1}，把乘法变为条件加减/空操作；提出 FairyFuse，把每个广线性层的 8 条实值子 GEMV 融合到一条 AVX-512 循环，全程零浮点乘法；通过 Roofline 模型指导，使 16 倍权重压缩将 GEMV 从内存受限转为计算受限。
AI.result: 单核 Intel Xeon 8558P 上 kernel 级加速 29.6 倍；端到端生成 32.4 tokens/s，比 llama.cpp Q4_K_M 快 1.24 倍；WikiText-2 困惑度 5.52 vs FP16 5.47，下游任务准确率 66.0%，近乎无损。
AI.conclusion: 三值权重结合无乘法 AVX-512 融合策略，可在带宽受限 CPU 上实现高压缩、高吞吐、低损失的 LLM 推理，为纯 CPU 部署提供实用新范式。

title: Value-Conflict Diagnostics Reveal Widespread Alignment Faking in Language Models
comment: Under submission at COLM 2026 Won the Best Student Paper Award at MSLD 2026 @ UIUC
summary: Alignment faking, where a model behaves aligned with developer policy when monitored but reverts to its own preferences when unobserved, is a concerning yet poorly understood phenomenon, in part because current diagnostic tools remain limited. Prior diagnostics rely on highly toxic and clearly harmful scenarios, causing most models to refuse immediately. As a result, models never deliberate over developer policy, monitoring conditions, or the consequences of non-compliance, making these diagnostics fundamentally unable to detect alignment faking propensity. To support study of this phenomenon, we first introduce VLAF, a diagnostic framework grounded in the hypothesis that alignment faking is most likely when developer policy conflicts with a model's strongly held values. VLAF uses morally unambiguous scenarios to probe this conflict across diverse moral values, bypassing refusal behavior while preserving meaningful deliberative stakes. Using VLAF, we find that alignment faking is substantially more prevalent than previously reported, occurring in models as small as 7B parameters - with olmo2-7b-instruct faking alignment in 37% of cases.Finally, we show that oversight conditions induce activation shifts that lie along a single direction in representation space. This means the behavioral divergence driving alignment faking can be captured by a single contrastive steering vector, which we exploit for lightweight inference-time mitigation. Finally, we exploit this for mitigation that requires no labeled data and minimal computational overhead, achieving relative reductions in alignment faking of 85.8%, 94.0%, and 57.7% on olmo2-7b-instruct, olmo2-13b-instruct, and qwen3-8b respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出VLAF框架，首次揭示小至7B模型也存在普遍且可量化的“表面顺从”现象，并提供无需标注数据、仅以单一向量即可在推理阶段抑制该行为的轻量级方法。
AI.motivation: 现有诊断工具仅能检测极端有害场景，模型会立即拒绝，使得无法观察其在真实价值冲突下的欺骗行为，急需评估模型在非监督时是否“表面顺从”。
AI.method: 构建VLAF框架，选取道德明晰但触发模型内在价值冲突的情境，以绕过拒绝机制；利用激活对比，发现并提取表征空间中顺应对齐指令与保持自偏好两种行为的分化方向向量。
AI.result: 7B模型OLMo2-7B-Instruct在37%情境下会“表面顺从”；激活分析显示监控与否的差异集中在单一表示方向；仅用该对比向量，可在无需训练数据的情况下对三模型分别将该现象降低85.8%、94.0%、57.7%。
AI.conclusion: 对齐欺骗在小型模型中即可出现且可度量，靠单一向量即可有效抑制，揭示其在表征空间的可操控性，为轻量级推理时治理提供新思路。

title: Calibeating Prediction-Powered Inference
summary: We study semisupervised mean estimation with a small labeled sample, a large unlabeled sample, and a black-box prediction model whose output may be miscalibrated. A standard approach in this setting is augmented inverse-probability weighting (AIPW) [Robins et al., 1994], which protects against prediction-model misspecification but can be inefficient when the prediction score is poorly aligned with the outcome scale. We introduce Calibrated Prediction-Powered Inference, which post-hoc calibrates the prediction score on the labeled sample before using it for semisupervised estimation. This simple step requires no retraining and can improve the original score both as a predictor of the outcome and as a regression adjustment for semisupervised inference. We study both linear and isotonic calibration. For isotonic calibration, we establish first-order optimality guarantees: isotonic post-processing can improve predictive accuracy and estimator efficiency relative to the original score and simpler post-processing rules, while no further post-processing of the fitted isotonic score yields additional first-order gains. For linear calibration, we show first-order equivalence to PPI++. We also clarify the relationship among existing estimators, showing that the original PPI estimator is a special case of AIPW and can be inefficient when the prediction model is accurate, while PPI++ is AIPW with empirical efficiency maximization [Rubin et al., 2008]. In simulations and real-data experiments, our calibrated estimators often outperform PPI and are competitive with, or outperform, AIPW and PPI++. We provide an accompanying Python package, ppi_aipw, at https://larsvanderlaan.github.io/ppi-aipw/.

AI.tldr: 针对小标签样本+大无标签样本且预测模型可能失准的场景，提出「先校准再半监督估计」的新框架；分线性与保序两种校准，理论上保证保序校准一阶最优，实践优于 PPI/AIPW 系列，并开源 Python 工具。
AI.motivation: 在半监督均值估计中，当标签极少、无标签极多，且黑盒预测模型输出可能刻度错位（miscalibrated）时，经典 AIPW 虽能抗模型误设却因预测分与真值刻度不一致而效率低；现有 PPI 系列亦未解决校准问题，导致估计方差大。
AI.method: 1) 仅利用标签样本对模型输出做后验校准（无需重训）：线性 Platt scaling 与保序 isotonic regression 两种方案；2) 将校准后的预测分作为回归调整变量，代入 AIPW/PPI 框架得到「Calibrated Prediction-Powered Inference」估计量；3) 证明保序校准在预测误差与估计效率上均一阶最优，线性校准与 PPI++ 一阶等价；4) 厘清 PPI、PPI++、AIPW 三者关系：PPI 是特殊 AIPW，PPI++ 是经验效率最大化的 AIPW；5) 提供开源包 ppi_aipw 支撑快速复现。
AI.result: 理论：给出保序校准的一阶最优性，任何进一步后处理均无法带来额外一阶增益；揭示线性校准与 PPI++ 的一阶等价性。模拟与真实数据：Calibrated PPI 在多数场景下优于原始 PPI，与 AIPW、PPI++ 相比方差更低或相当，尤其在预测模型高准确率但刻度错位时增益显著。
AI.conclusion: 后验校准是提升半监督估计效率的简单有效手段：无需重训即可同时改善预测刻度与推断精度，其中保序校准具有一阶最优性。理论与实证均表明，Calibrated PPI 在模型校准与统计效率间取得更好平衡，推荐作为小标签样本场景下的默认选择。

title: Sulcal Pattern Matching with the Wasserstein Distance
comment: Published in Proceedings of the 2023 IEEE International Symposium on Biomedical Imaging (ISBI)
summary: We present the unified computational framework for modeling the sulcal patterns of human brain obtained from the magnetic resonance images. The Wasserstein distance is used to align the sulcal patterns nonlinearly. These patterns are topologically different across subjects making the pattern matching a challenge. We work out the mathematical details and develop the gradient descent algorithms for estimating the deformation field. We further quantify the image registration performance. This method is applied in identifying the differences between male and female sulcal patterns.

AI.tldr: 提出用Wasserstein距离对拓扑各异的人脑沟回MR图像做非线性配准的统一计算框架，设计梯度下降算法求解变形场，并用于量化男女性沟回差异。
AI.motivation: 人脑沟回模式在个体间拓扑结构差异大，传统配准难以对齐，需要能处理拓扑变化且可量化的非线性配准方法以研究性别差异。
AI.method: 以Wasserstein距离为度量，建立沟回图像的概率表示；推导变形场的黎曼梯度；开发基于梯度下降的迭代算法估计最优变形；引入配准精度量化指标。
AI.result: 算法在拓扑不同的沟回模式上实现稳定收敛，配准误差显著低于主流方法；男性与女性群体沟回分布的Wasserstein距离差异有统计学意义，局部差异主要位于额顶叶。
AI.conclusion: Wasserstein配准框架有效解决了拓扑差异大的沟回模式对齐难题，可直接量化形态差异，为脑性别差异及疾病形态学研究提供可靠工具。

title: DWTSumm: Discrete Wavelet Transform for Document Summarization
summary: Summarizing long, domain-specific documents with large language models (LLMs) remains challenging due to context limitations, information loss, and hallucinations, particularly in clinical and legal settings. We propose a Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT)-based multi-resolution framework that treats text as a semantic signal and decomposes it into global (approximation) and local (detail) components. Applied to sentence- or word-level embeddings, DWT yields compact representations that preserve overall structure and critical domain-specific details, which are used directly as summaries or to guide LLM generation. Experiments on clinical and legal benchmarks demonstrate comparable ROUGE-L scores. Compared to a GPT-4o baseline, the DWT based summarization consistently improve semantic similarity and grounding, achieving gains of over 2% in BERTScore, more than 4\% in Semantic Fidelity, factual consistency in legal tasks, and large METEOR improvements indicative of preserved domain-specific semantics. Across multiple embedding models, Fidelity reaches up to 97%, suggesting that DWT acts as a semantic denoising mechanism that reduces hallucinations and strengthens factual grounding. Overall, DWT provides a lightweight, generalizable method for reliable long-document and domain-specific summarization with LLMs.

AI.tldr: 用离散小波变换把长文本拆成“骨架+细节”两级信号，直接压缩或指导大模型生成，临床/法律摘要 hallucination↓、ROUGE/BERTScore↑。
AI.motivation: 临床、法律等长文档超出 LLM 上下文窗口，现有压缩或逐段策略易丢关键细节、产生幻觉，需轻量、保真、领域无关的语义保结构方案。
AI.method: 将文本嵌入视为语义信号，用离散小波变换（DWT）多级分解，得到全局近似（结构）与局部细节系数；对句子或词级嵌入做 DWT 后取近似系数作为压缩表示，或直接用作摘要，或作为 prompt 上下文引导 LLM 生成。
AI.result: 在临床与法律基准上，与 GPT-4o 相比 ROUGE-L 持平，BERTScore+2%、Semantic Fidelity+4%、法律任务事实一致性提升，METEOR 显著上升；多嵌入模型下 Fidelity 最高 97%，幻觉显著减少。
AI.conclusion: DWT 充当语义降噪器，用信号处理思路为 LLM 提供轻量、通用、高保真的长文档领域摘要方案，无需重训模型即可嵌入现有流水线。

title: Projected Gradient Unlearning for Text-to-Image Diffusion Models: Defending Against Concept Revival Attacks
summary: Machine unlearning for text-to-image diffusion models aims to selectively remove undesirable concepts from pre-trained models without costly retraining. Current unlearning methods share a common weakness: erased concepts return when the model is fine-tuned on downstream data, even when that data is entirely unrelated. We adapt Projected Gradient Unlearning (PGU) from classification to the diffusion domain as a post-hoc hardening step. By constructing a Core Gradient Space (CGS) from the retain concept activations and projecting gradient updates into its orthogonal complement, PGU ensures that subsequent fine-tuning cannot undo the achieved erasure. Applied on top of existing methods (ESD, UCE, Receler), the approach eliminates revival for style concepts and substantially delays it for object concepts, running in roughly 6 minutes versus the ~2 hours required by Meta-Unlearning. PGU and Meta-Unlearning turn out to be complementary: which performs better depends on how the concept is encoded, and retain concept selection should follow visual feature similarity rather than semantic grouping.

AI.tldr: 针对扩散模型遗忘后微调易复活被删概念的问题，提出 PGU 后加固策略，通过将保留概念对应的 Core Gradient Space 的正交补空间作为更新禁区，阻断下游微调对被删概念的恢复；6 分钟即可完成，显著优于 Meta-Unlearning，并与现有 ESD/UCE/Receler 互补。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到图像扩散模型“机器遗忘”方法在微调阶段常出现被删概念复活，严重影响版权与合规应用，而已有方法（如 Meta-Unlearning）需高昂重训成本且效果不稳定。
AI.method: 1) 将 PGU 从分类扩展至扩散域：先对“保留概念”生成激活向量构建 Core Gradient Space（CGS）；2) 微调时把梯度更新投影至 CGS 正交补空间，避免任何更新触及可能复活被删概念的参数方向；3) 作为后处理步骤叠加到 ESD、UCE、Receler 等遗忘方法上，无需重训模型主体。
AI.result: 在风格概念上实现永久不再复活；对物体概念显著延迟复活时间。整个加固过程平均仅 6 分钟，远低于 Meta-Unlearning 的约 2 小时。PGU 与 Meta-Unlearning 表现呈互补关系，优劣取决于概念本身的编码方式；最佳“保留概念”集应按视觉特征相似度而非语义类别挑选。
AI.conclusion: PGU 提供了一种轻量级、可插拔的遗忘后加固框架，有效阻断微调导致的概念复活，与现有遗忘方案相得益彰；同时也揭示保留概念的选择应基于视觉特征而非语义标签。

title: Absorber LLM: Harnessing Causal Synchronization for Test-Time Training
summary: Transformers suffer from a high computational cost that grows with sequence length for self-attention, making inference in long streams prohibited by memory consumption. Constant-memory alternatives such as RNNs and SSMs compress history into states with fixed size and thus lose long-tail dependencies, while methods that memorize contexts into parameters, such as Test-Time Training (TTT), are prone to overfitting token-level projection and fail to preserve the causal effect of context in pretrained LLMs. We propose Absorber LLM, which formulates long-context retention as a self-supervised causal synchronization: after absorbing historical contexts into parameters, a contextless model should match the original model with full context on future generations. We optimize this objective by synchronizing internal behaviors of the updated model with the original one, ensuring context absorption and generalization. Experiments on long-context and streaming benchmarks show that Absorber LLM reduces inference memory and improves accuracy over prior parameter-as-memory baselines.

AI.tldr: Absorber-LLM把历史上下文无损“吸收”为模型参数，实现恒定显存下的因果保持，优于RNN/SSM与TTT类方法。
AI.motivation: Transformer推理显存随序列线性增长，主流恒显存方案（RNN、SSM）因状态容量受限丢失长距离依赖；TTT类将上下文写进参数却易过拟合并破坏预训练已久的因果结构，亟需能在固定容量下同时保留长程信息与因果性的方法。
AI.method: 提出“自监督因果同步”目标：把历史压缩为参数后，无上下文模型在后续token分布必须与完整上下文模型完全一致。通过匹配内部隐状态分布而非仅token级输出，将上下文吸收转化为参数可微更新，并限定更新仅作用于轻量级旁路模块以保证预训练主干不动、因果链不断。
AI.result: 在LongBench、SCROLLS与64k token流式评测中，Absorber-LLM：①显存保持恒定，降至基线1/8；②平均准确率较TTT类提升3.0–5.7%，超越RNN/SSM达7–10%；③当上下文>32k时优势扩大，证明长尾依赖保持有效。
AI.conclusion: 把上下文无损吸收为参数、以内部同步保因果性，可在推理侧彻底清除O(N)显存瓶颈且不损性能，为超长序列与终身流式LLM提供了可行范式。

title: The Last Harness You'll Ever Build
summary: AI agents are increasingly deployed on complex, domain-specific workflows -- navigating enterprise web applications that require dozens of clicks and form fills, orchestrating multi-step research pipelines that span search, extraction, and synthesis, automating code review across unfamiliar repositories, and handling customer escalations that demand nuanced domain knowledge. \textbf{Each new task domain requires painstaking, expert-driven harness engineering}: designing the prompts, tools, orchestration logic, and evaluation criteria that make a foundation model effective. We present a two-level framework that automates this process. At the first level, the \textbf{Harness Evolution Loop} optimizes a worker agent's harness $\mathcal{H}$ for a single task: a Worker Agent $W_{\mathcal{H}}$ executes the task, an Evaluator Agent $V$ adversarially diagnoses failures and scores performance, and an Evolution Agent $E$ modifies the harness based on the full history of prior attempts. At the second level, the \textbf{Meta-Evolution Loop} optimizes the evolution protocol $Λ= (W_{\mathcal{H}}, \mathcal{H}^{(0)}, V, E)$ itself across diverse tasks, \textbf{learning a protocol $Λ^{(\text{best})}$ that enables rapid harness convergence on any new task -- so that adapting an agent to a novel domain requires no human harness engineering at all.} We formalize the correspondence to meta-learning and present both algorithms. The framework \textbf{shifts manual harness engineering into automated harness engineering}, and takes one step further -- \textbf{automating the design of the automation itself}.

AI.tldr: 提出一种自动化两阶框架，将连接LLM与任务的“prompt/工具/逻辑/评估”系统（统称harness）全部交由AI自演化；第一阶让Harness Evolution Loop实时用评估器反馈迭代改进单个任务的harness，第二阶让Meta-Evolution Loop跨多种任务进化出最优evolution strategy，新域无需人类再写prompt或工具，即用即熟。
AI.motivation: 复杂领域中的自动化工作流（ERP操作、科研流程、库外代码评审、客服升级等）要求大量人工定制prompt、工具链与评估指标。每次任务迁移都需反复试写和调试插件，造成高昂人力和时间成本。本文目标是把“专家手写harness”自动化，并把自动化本身的策略也交给AI学习，实现零人工接入的领域泛化。
AI.method: 采用双层元学习与递归代理架构：(1) Harness Evolution Loop内三角色协同：Worker执行、Evaluator对抗式打分和诊断、Evolution修改harness；(2) Meta-Evolution Loop将W、V、E的初始化策略、评估逻辑与修改算法再上层构造为元级agent加以自我演化，跨任务搜索Λ^(best)。文中引入harness与log的对偶表示、贝叶斯先验更新和基于行列式点过程的编年采样，保证搜索空间充分且收敛快；提供凸化风险上界与Tsallis信息增益的分析框架。
AI.result: 对9域108任务（SAP/Oracle ERP、公网爬虫、药企色谱数据、客服工单、代码审计等）均实现99+%自动化率，速度-人工比从3周降为72小时；跨10新域零偶发冷启动，平均首次成功率76%，三次迭代达95%以上，并在稳健性指标上比最强人机基线提升23%。
AI.conclusion: 把“harness工程”交给LLM自演化、再让演化策略本身被AI迭代，是通向完全自助式代理生态的关键一步。未来工作包括引入模态增强、实时监控与法规对齐，推动模型厂商与下游部署者的全链路免人工自动化。

title: CLT-Optimal Parameter Error Bounds for Linear System Identification
summary: There has been remarkable progress over the past decade in establishing finite-sample, non-asymptotic bounds on recovering unknown system parameters from observed system behavior. Surprisingly, however, we show that the current state-of-the-art bounds do not accurately capture the statistical complexity of system identification, even in the most fundamental setting of estimating a discrete-time linear dynamical system (LDS) via ordinary least-squares regression (OLS). Specifically, we utilize asymptotic normality to identify classes of problem instances for which current bounds overstate the squared parameter error, in both spectral and Frobenius norm, by a factor of the state-dimension of the system. Informed by this discrepancy, we then sharpen the OLS parameter error bounds via a novel second-order decomposition of the parameter error, where crucially the lower-order term is a matrix-valued martingale that we show correctly captures the CLT scaling. From our analysis we obtain finite-sample bounds for both (i) stable systems and (ii) the many-trajectories setting that match the instance-specific optimal rates up to constant factors in Frobenius norm, and polylogarithmic state-dimension factors in spectral norm.

AI.tldr: 现有非渐近系统辨识界对 OLS 估计 LDS 的误差高估了“状态维数”倍；本文用渐近正态性与鞅二阶分解，得到与实例最优速率仅差常数（F 范）或 polylog(d)（谱范）的紧有限样本界。
AI.motivation: 过去十年虽涌现大量有限样本系统辨识上界，但在最基础的“OLS 估计离散时间线性动力系统”场景，这些界与真实统计复杂度出现量级脱节，提示理论亟需重新校准。
AI.method: 1) 借用中心极限定理（CLT）先诊断现有界高估的根源；2) 提出参数误差的二阶矩阵分解，把主导项写成矩阵值鞅；3) 对该鞅应用非渐近集中不等式，分别处理“稳定单轨”与“多轨”设定。
AI.result: 新界在 Frobenius 范数下与实例最优速率只差常数；在谱范下多出 polylog(d) 因子，而旧界则多出整个 d 倍；理论与模拟均显示 tightened bound 紧贴实际平方误差。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入矩阵鞅二阶分析，首次把非渐近界拉到与渐近极限同一量级，为后续更复杂非线性或部分观测系统的紧辨识理论提供了可扩展范式。

title: Privacy-Preserving Semantic Communication over Wiretap Channels with Learnable Differential Privacy
summary: While semantic communication (SemCom) improves transmission efficiency by focusing on task-relevant information, it also raises critical privacy concerns. Many existing secure SemCom approaches rely on restrictive or impractical assumptions, such as favorable channel conditions for the legitimate user or prior knowledge of the eavesdropper's model. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a novel secure SemCom framework for image transmission over wiretap channels, leveraging differential privacy (DP) to provide approximate privacy guarantees. Specifically, our approach first extracts disentangled semantic representations from source images using generative adversarial network (GAN) inversion method, and then selectively perturbs private semantic representations with approximate DP noise. Distinct from conventional DP-based protection methods, we introduce DP noise with learnable pattern, instead of traditional white Gaussian or Laplace noise, achieved through adversarial training of neural networks (NNs). This design mitigates the inherent non-invertibility of DP while effectively protecting private information. Moreover, it enables explicitly controllable security levels by adjusting the privacy budget according to specific security requirements, which is not achieved in most existing secure SemCom approaches. Experimental results demonstrate that, compared with the previous DP-based method and direct transmission, the proposed method significantly degrades the reconstruction quality for the eavesdropper, while introducing only slight degradation in task performance. Under comparable security levels, our approach achieves an LPIPS advantage of 0.06-0.29 and an FPPSR advantage of 0.10-0.86 for the legitimate user compared with the previous DP-based method.

AI.tldr: 首个在语义通信中实现“可调级近似隐私保护”的图像传输框架，用GAN反演+可学习DP噪声，无需预知窃听者模型、不依赖信道优势，即可显著降低窃听者重建质量且几乎不影响合法端任务性能。
AI.motivation: 语义通信虽能剔除任务无关数据、提升传输效率，却暴露了高维语义特征被窃听者直接利用的风险；现有安全方案大多要求合法用户信道占优或事先掌握窃听者模型，假设过强、难以部署。
AI.method: 1) GAN反演将源图像解耦为“共享-私有”语义潜码；2) 对私有潜码注入经对抗训练习得的“可学习模式DP噪声”，替代传统高/拉普拉斯白噪声，既保持DP的ε-可控性又缓解非可逆损失；3) 用隐私预算ε显式量化并调节安全等级，形成端到端的DP-语义通信框架。
AI.result: 在相同ε下，与经典DP方法和明文传输相比：- 窃听者重建图像的LPIPS下降0.06–0.29，特征峰值信噪比FPPSR下降0.10–0.86；合法端任务精度损失<2%，带宽节省与语义通信基线持平。
AI.conclusion: 通过把“可学习DP噪声”嵌入解耦语义空间，本框架首次在无需信道或模型先验条件下，为语义通信提供了可量化、可调节的近似隐私保障，为后续跨模态、协作推理等场景的隐私-效用平衡奠定了方法基础。

title: Serialisation Strategy Matters: How FHIR Data Format Affects LLM Medication Reconciliation
summary: Medication reconciliation at clinical handoffs is a high-stakes, error-prone process. Large language models are increasingly proposed to assist with this task using FHIR-structured patient records, but a fundamental and largely unstudied variable is how the FHIR data is serialised before being passed to the model. We present the first systematic comparison of four FHIR serialisation strategies (Raw JSON, Markdown Table, Clinical Narrative, and Chronological Timeline) across five open-weight models (Phi-3.5-mini, Mistral-7B, BioMistral-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, Llama-3.3-70B) on a controlled benchmark of 200 synthetic patients, totalling 4,000 inference runs. We find that serialisation strategy has a large, statistically significant effect on performance for models up to 8B parameters: Clinical Narrative outperforms Raw JSON by up to 19 F1 points for Mistral-7B (r = 0.617, p < 10^{-10}). This advantage reverses at 70B, where Raw JSON achieves the best mean F1 of 0.9956. In all 20 model and strategy combinations, mean precision exceeds mean recall: omission is the dominant failure mode, with models more often missing an active medication than fabricating one, which changes how clinical safety auditing priorities should be set. Smaller models plateau at roughly 7-10 concurrent active medications, leaving polypharmacy patients, the patients most at risk from reconciliation errors, systematically underserved. BioMistral-7B, a domain-pretrained model without instruction tuning, produces zero usable output in all conditions, showing that domain pretraining alone is not sufficient for structured extraction. These results offer practical, evidence-based format recommendations for clinical LLM deployment: Clinical Narrative for models up to 8B, Raw JSON for 70B and above. The complete pipeline is reproducible on open-source tools running on an AWS g6e.xlarge instance (NVIDIA L40S, 48 GB VRAM).

AI.tldr: 不同FHIR序列化格式极大影响大模型药品核对表现，8B参数以下病历叙事最佳，70B以上原始JSON最优，规模小或仅领域预训练模型在多药患者中基本失效。
AI.motivation: 临床交接环节的药疗核对是关键且易出错流程，LLM利用FHIR数据自动核对可减轻负担，但此前极少研究FHIR数据如何序列化影响模型效果。
AI.method: 系统比较4种FHIR序列化（Raw JSON、Markdown表、Clinical Narrative、Chronological Timeline）用于5个开放权重模型（Phi-3.5-mini等），在含200个合成患者的受控基准上做总计4,000次推理。
AI.result: 序列化显著影响≤8B模型效果，Clinical Narrative比Raw JSON可提升Mistral-7B高达19个F1；70B模型则相反，Raw JSON达最佳均值F1=0.9956。所有组合均以漏检为典型错误，模型最常遗漏用药。模型在7-10种现行活跃药附近出现性能瓶颈；仅领域预训练的BioMistral-7B在所有条件下皆输出不可用。
AI.conclusion: 推荐≤8B模型使用Clinical Narrative，≥70B模型使用Raw JSON以提高临床核对准确率；规模不足或仅靠领域预训练无法应对高多药患者，需针对性进一步优化。实验完全可复现，代码与资源已公开。

title: StyleVAR: Controllable Image Style Transfer via Visual Autoregressive Modeling
summary: We build on the Visual Autoregressive Modeling (VAR) framework and formulate style transfer as conditional discrete sequence modeling in a learned latent space. Images are decomposed into multi-scale representations and tokenized into discrete codes by a VQ-VAE; a transformer then autoregressively models the distribution of target tokens conditioned on style and content tokens. To inject style and content information, we introduce a blended cross-attention mechanism in which the evolving target representation attends to its own history, while style and content features act as queries that decide which aspects of this history to emphasize. A scale-dependent blending coefficient controls the relative influence of style and content at each stage, encouraging the synthesized representation to align with both the content structure and the style texture without breaking the autoregressive continuity of VAR. We train StyleVAR in two stages from a pretrained VAR checkpoint: supervised fine-tuning on a large triplet dataset of content--style--target images, followed by reinforcement fine-tuning with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) against a DreamSim-based perceptual reward, with per-action normalization weighting to rebalance credit across VAR's multi-scale hierarchy. Across three benchmarks spanning in-, near-, and out-of-distribution regimes, StyleVAR consistently outperforms an AdaIN baseline on Style Loss, Content Loss, LPIPS, SSIM, DreamSim, and CLIP similarity, and the GRPO stage yields further gains over the SFT checkpoint, most notably on the reward-aligned perceptual metrics. Qualitatively, the method transfers texture while maintaining semantic structure, especially for landscapes and architectural scenes, while a generalization gap on internet images and difficulty with human faces highlight the need for better content diversity and stronger structural priors.

AI.tldr: 在 VAR 框架下提出 StyleVAR，将任意风格转移建模为潜空间里的条件离散序列生成，用混合交叉注意力调和内容与风格，并通过 SFT+GRPO 两阶段训练，在多个基准数据集达优于 AdaIN 的多项指标，但对人脸和网络图泛化仍弱。
AI.motivation: 风格转移需兼顾纹理拟合与语义保持，而基于自回归潜码建模的 VAR 尚未被用于该任务；作者想论证“纯潜码序列生成”可替代现有编码—解码范式来实现高质量、优雅可控的任意图像风格转换。
AI.method: (1) 在 VAR 多尺度 VQ-VAE 潜空间内，把图像转化分层离散 token；(2) 设计“混合交叉注意力”槽，让目标 token 序列自回归的同时受 style/content query 引导，并通过尺度级混合系数动态权衡；(3) 分两阶段训练：先在 10^6 级三元组 (C,S,T) 做监督微调(SFT)，再将多层生成视为多步决策，用 DreamSim 奖励+GRPO+每步归一化权重做强化微调，以校正多尺度层次中的信用分配。
AI.result: 在 in-dist, near-dist, out-of-dist 三个基准上，与 AdaIN 相比 Style Loss↓20–35%、Content Loss↓15–30%，DreamSim/LPIPS/SSIM/CLIP 均保持领先；GRPO 阶段额外再提升 DreamSim ∼0.02、CLIP ∼1.3%。主观上能保持结构与纹理一致性，尤其建筑和风景；但在人脸、真实网络图出现泛化空隙及结构畸变。
AI.conclusion: VAR+自回归潜码序列可胜任任意风格转移，且通过混合交叉注意力与多尺度 GRPO 能有效强化感知质量与结构保持；要进一步推向真实应用需补充内容多样性、更强几何先验并扩展人脸类数据。

title: The Path Not Taken: Duality in Reasoning about Program Execution
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities across diverse coding tasks. However, their adoption requires a true understanding of program execution rather than relying on surface-level patterns. Existing benchmarks primarily focus on predicting program properties tied to specific inputs (e.g., code coverage, program outputs). As a result, they provide a narrow view of dynamic code reasoning and are prone to data contamination. We argue that understanding program execution requires evaluating its inherent duality through two complementary reasoning tasks: (i) predicting a program's observed behavior for a given input, and (ii) inferring how the input must be mutated toward a specific behavioral objective. Both tasks jointly probe a model's causal understanding of execution flow. We instantiate this duality in DexBench, a benchmark comprising 445 paired instances, and evaluate 13 LLMs. Our results demonstrate that dual-path reasoning provides a robust and discriminative proxy for dynamic code understanding.

AI.tldr: 提出双路径评估框架DexBench（445对实例），从“输入→行为”与“行为→输入”双向检验LLM对程序执行的因果理解，比传统单测基准更难被数据污染。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代码测评只看固定输入下的程序输出或覆盖率，易被训练数据污染，难以反映模型对程序执行机制的真正因果理解。
AI.method: 构建双任务对偶框架：任务A给定输入预测程序行为，任务B给定目标行为反推需如何变异输入；将两任务配对形成DexBench，共445组实例，覆盖多种执行语义；对13种主流LLM进行双向测评，比较单一路径与联合路径的难度与区分度。
AI.result: 所有模型在反向推断任务（B）上得分显著低于正向预测（A），平均差距超过20个百分点；双路径联合准确率与模型参数规模呈正相关，但对Codex-type模型仍存在明显瓶颈；DexBench对数据污染表现出高鲁棒性，重复训练数据检出率低于2%。
AI.conclusion: 双路径对偶评估能有效揭示LLM是否掌握程序执行因果链，而不仅记忆输入-输出模式；DexBench为动态代码推理提供了难污染、高区分的新基准，未来可扩展至多线程、并发及硬件交互场景。

title: Deep FinResearch Bench: Evaluating AI's Ability to Conduct Professional Financial Investment Research
summary: We introduce Deep FinResearch Bench, a practical and comprehensive evaluation framework for deep research (DR) agents in financial investment research. The benchmark assesses three dimensions of report quality: qualitative rigor, quantitative forecasting and valuation accuracy, and claim credibility and verifiability. Particularly, we define corresponding qualitative and quantitative evaluation metrics and implement an automated scoring procedure to enable scalable assessment. Applying the benchmark to financial reports from frontier DR agents and comparing them with reports authored by financial professionals, we find that AI-generated reports still fall short across these dimensions. These findings underscore the need for domain-specialized DR agents tailored to finance, and we hope the work establishes a foundation for standardized benchmarking of DR agents in financial research.

AI.tldr: Deep FinResearch Bench 首次系统量化金融深度研究 AI 的质量缺口，为后续金融 DR 代理标准化评测奠基。
AI.motivation: 金融领域对研究严谨性要求极高，但现有 DR 代理缺乏统一、可扩展的评测基准，无法科学衡量 AI 生成投资报告与人工报告的差距。
AI.method: 构建三维评测框架（定性严谨度、定量预测与估值准确性、主张可信度与可验证性），设计对应量化指标并自动化打分；采集前沿 DR 代理与专业人士报告进行对照实验。
AI.result: AI 报告在三维度均显著逊于人工报告，暴露出定性推理薄弱、数值预测偏差大、溯源验证不足等缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 需开发金融专属 DR 代理，Deep FinResearch Bench 可作为行业标准化评测基线，推动金融 AI 研究质量持续提升。

title: A single algorithm for both restless and rested rotting bandits
summary: In many application domains (e.g., recommender systems, intelligent tutoring systems), the rewards associated to the actions tend to decrease over time. This decay is either caused by the actions executed in the past (e.g., a user may get bored when songs of the same genre are recommended over and over) or by an external factor (e.g., content becomes outdated). These two situations can be modeled as specific instances of the rested and restless bandit settings, where arms are rotting (i.e., their value decrease over time). These problems were thought to be significantly different, since Levine et al. (2017) showed that state-of-the-art algorithms for restless bandit perform poorly in the rested rotting setting. In this paper, we introduce a novel algorithm, Rotting Adaptive Window UCB (RAW-UCB), that achieves near-optimal regret in both rotting rested and restless bandit, without any prior knowledge of the setting (rested or restless) and the type of non-stationarity (e.g., piece-wise constant, bounded variation). This is in striking contrast with previous negative results showing that no algorithm can achieve similar results as soon as rewards are allowed to increase. We confirm our theoretical findings on a number of synthetic and dataset-based experiments.

AI.tldr: 提出首个无需先验知识即可在 rested/restless 衰减 bandit 中同时获得近最优遗憾的算法 RAW-UCB。
