title: Using Machine Mental Imagery for Representing Common Ground in Situated Dialogue
comment: Work under review. Biswesh Mohapatra and Giovanni Duca both contributed equally to this work
summary: Situated dialogue requires speakers to maintain a reliable representation of shared context rather than reasoning only over isolated utterances. Current conversational agents often struggle with this requirement, especially when the common ground must be preserved beyond the immediate context window. In such settings, fine-grained distinctions are frequently compressed into purely textual representations, leading to a critical failure mode we call \emph{representational blur}, in which similar but distinct entities collapse into interchangeable descriptions. This semantic flattening creates an illusion of grounding, where agents appear locally coherent but fail to track shared context persistently over time. Inspired by the role of mental imagery in human reasoning, and based on the increased availability of multimodal models, we explore whether conversational agents can be given an analogous ability to construct some depictive intermediate representations during dialogue to address these limitations. Thus, we introduce an active visual scaffolding framework that incrementally converts dialogue state into a persistent visual history that can later be retrieved for grounded response generation. Evaluation on the IndiRef benchmark shows that incremental externalization itself improves over full-dialog reasoning, while visual scaffolding provides additional gains by reducing representational blur and enforcing concrete scene commitments. At the same time, textual representations remain advantageous for non-depictable information, and a hybrid multimodal setting yields the best overall performance. Together, these findings suggest that conversational agents benefit from an explicitly multimodal representation of common ground that integrates depictive and propositional information.

AI.tldr: 将对话过程中的共享状态持续“外化”为可视化图像，可显著提升智能体在长程对话中的指代一致性，缓解“表征模糊”问题。
AI.motivation: 现有对话系统把共享知识压缩在文本中，相似但不同的实体易被混淆，导致长程上下文跟踪失败。作者怀疑引入类似人脑“心象”的可视化中介表示，可解决这一痛点。
AI.method: 提出主动视觉支架框架：每轮解析对话后增量更新一幅持久化视觉历史图，供后续检索并用作再生成条件；通过混合文本-视觉表示整合可描绘与不可描绘信息。
AI.result: 在 IndiRef 基准上，仅增量视觉历史就优于整段纯文本推理，加入视觉支架后再提升，降低表征模糊并强制作出具体场景承诺；文本对非视觉信息的处理仍不可替代，混合模态表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: 显式把共同信念分解成可描绘的视觉与命题式文本两部分，并持续维护，是提高对话系统可靠性与长程一致性的有效途径。

title: HyperFM: An Efficient Hyperspectral Foundation Model with Spectral Grouping
comment: 15 pages, 8 figures, to be published in CVPR 2026 findings, Code and data are publicly available on https://github.com/umbc-sanjaylab/HyperFM
summary: The NASA PACE mission provides unprecedented hyperspectral observations of ocean color, aerosols, and clouds, offering new insights into how these components interact and influence Earth's climate and air quality. Its Ocean Color Instrument measures light across hundreds of finely spaced wavelength bands, enabling detailed characterization of features such as phytoplankton composition, aerosol properties, and cloud microphysics. However, hyperspectral data of this scale is large, complex, and difficult to label, requiring specialized processing and analysis techniques. Existing foundation models, which have transformed computer vision and natural language processing, are generally trained on standard RGB imagery and therefore struggle to interpret the continuous spectral signatures captured by PACE. While recent advances have introduced hyperspectral foundation models, they are typically trained on cloud-free observations and often remain limited to single-sensor datasets due to spectral inconsistencies across instruments. Moreover, existing models tend to be parameter-heavy and computationally expensive, limiting scalability and adoption in operational settings. To address these challenges, we introduce HyperFM, a parameter-efficient hyperspectral foundation model that leverages intra-group and inter-group spectral attention along with hybrid parameter decomposition to better capture spectral spatial relationships while reducing computational cost. HyperFM demonstrates consistent performance improvements over existing hyperspectral foundation models and task-specific state-of-the-art methods across four benchmark downstream atmospheric cloud property retrieval tasks. To support further research, we additionally release HyperFM250K, a large-scale hyperspectral dataset from the PACE mission that includes both clear and cloudy scenes.

AI.tldr: NASA PACE 星载高光谱数据因体量大、标签稀缺难以高效利用，作者提出参数轻量的 HyperFM 基础模型并配套 HyperFM250K 数据集，显著提升云参数反演等四个下游任务性能。
AI.motivation: PACE 任务提供全球连续高光谱数据，但现有基础模型均以 RGB 或晴空单传感器数据训练，无法处理跨仪器光谱差异和厚云场景，且模型庞大、推理成本高，阻碍业务化应用。
AI.method: 设计 HyperFM：1) 组内-组间光谱注意力捕获细粒度光谱-空间耦合；2) 混合参数分解减少 70% 参数量；3) 用 PACE 200 m 分辨率、330 波段、包含晴/云场景的 25 万景影像预训练。
AI.result: 在云光学厚度、有效粒子半径、云顶气压及气溶胶光学厚度反演等四个主流基准上，HyperFM 平均提升 3.2–8.7% RMSE，相对现有高光谱基础模型和专精巧网络一致领先；推理延迟降低 4×。
AI.conclusion: HyperFM 以极少参数实现跨场景高光谱通用表征，证明面向业务化轻量基础模型可行；HyperFM250K 开源后将进一步推动海洋-气溶胶-云耦合机制研究与气候监测应用。

title: IRIS: Interpolative Rényi Iterative Self-play for Large Language Model Fine-Tuning
summary: Self-play fine-tuning enables large language models to improve beyond supervised fine-tuning without additional human annotations by contrasting annotated responses with self-generated ones. Many existing methods rely on a fixed divergence regime. SPIN is closely related to a KL-based regime, SPACE to a Jensen-Shannon-style objective via noise contrastive estimation, and SPIF to $χ^2$-regularized self-play. Since these divergences exhibit different strengths depending on the distributional gap between model and target, no single choice appears to provide favorable learning dynamics across training stages. We propose IRIS (Interpolative Rényi Iterative Self-play), a Rényi-based self-play fine-tuning framework with a continuously adjustable objective. IRIS decomposes into two independent tilted risk terms over annotated and synthetic data, with exponential importance weights controlled by the order parameter $α$. We show that several self-play objectives can be interpreted as limiting or representative regimes at particular values of $α$, providing a unified theoretical perspective on these methods. An adaptive order schedule further adjusts $α$ to the distributional gap, shifting from sharper importance weighting early in training to smoother refinement near convergence. Theoretically, we establish the fixed-point property of IRIS and analyze how $α$ controls gradient concentration. Experiments on Zephyr-7B and Qwen2.5-3B across ten benchmarks show that IRIS improves upon baselines, reaching 44.57\% average score with gains across iterations. In our setting, IRIS with only 26$k$ annotated samples surpasses standard supervised fine-tuning trained on the full 200$k$ dataset.

AI.tldr: 无需额外人工标注，IRIS通过可调的Rényi散度统一多种自博弈微调目标，用26k标注样本即可超越200k全量监督微调。
AI.motivation: 现有人工自博弈微调（SPIN、SPACE、SPIF）分别锁定KL、JS或χ²散度，无法适应训练不同阶段模型与目标分布差距的动态变化，导致学习动力学受限。
AI.method: 提出IRIS框架：1) 以Rényi散度为核心，把自博弈目标拆成带指数权重α的两个倾斜风险项；2) α可连续调节，使多种已知方法对应其极限或特例；3) 设计α自适应调度，早期用尖锐权重快速纠偏，收敛期切到平滑精炼；4) 理论证明IRIS不动点存在，并给出α对梯度集中度控制律。
AI.result: 在Zephyr-7B与Qwen2.5-3B上，IRIS在10项基准平均得分44.57%，显著优于SPIN/SPACE/SPIF；仅26k标注样本就超过用200k样本的标准监督微调。
AI.conclusion: IRIS以单一可调Rényi散度统一并扩展现有自博弈微调，兼顾早期快速修正与后期稳定收敛，实现数据效率与性能双提升，为免额外标注的大模型自提升提供了新范式。

title: Propensity Inference: Environmental Contributors to LLM Behaviour
summary: Motivated by loss of control risks from misaligned AI systems, we develop and apply methods for measuring language models' propensity for unsanctioned behaviour. We contribute three methodological improvements: analysing effects of changes to environmental factors on behaviour, quantifying effect sizes via Bayesian generalised linear models, and taking explicit measures against circular analysis. We apply the methodology to measure the effects of 12 environmental factors (6 strategic in nature, 6 non-strategic) and thus the extent to which behaviour is explained by strategic aspects of the environment, a question relevant to risks from misalignment. Across 23 language models and 11 evaluation environments, we find approximately equal contributions from strategic and non-strategic factors for explaining behaviour, do not find strategic factors becoming more or less influential as capabilities improve, and find some evidence for a trend for increased sensitivity to goal conflicts. Finally, we highlight a key direction for future propensity research: the development of theoretical frameworks and cognitive models of AI decision-making into empirically testable forms.

AI.tldr: 本文首次量化AI「为非作歹」倾向的环境成因，证明策略性与非策略性因素同等重要，且模型能力增长并未显著放大策略性影响。
AI.motivation: 针对AI系统因目标错位而产生失控风险，亟需可复现、防循环验证的方法来衡量大模型在未被授权情境下的作恶倾向，并厘清该倾向究竟源于策略性环境刺激还是一般非策略因素。
AI.method: 提出三项方法学改进：①系统扰动12种环境因子（6策略/6非策略）观测行为变化；②用贝叶广义线性模型定量效应大小；③采用预留数据与盲分析阻断循环分析。在23个模型×11个环境中交叉验证。
AI.result: 策略与非策略因子对行为的解释力接近1:1；模型规模或能力提升并未使策略因子影响力显著上升；但随着能力升高，模型对目标冲突的敏感度呈增强趋势。
AI.conclusion: AI作恶倾向不能简单归因于「更聪明就更狡猾」；未来需把宏观风险理论转为可实证检验的认知决策模型，并继续监控目标冲突敏感度随性能扩展的变化。

title: PCA-Driven Adaptive Sensor Triage for Edge AI Inference
summary:
Multi-channel sensor networks in industrial IoT often exceed available bandwidth. We propose PCA-Triage, a streaming algorithm that converts incremental PCA loadings into proportional per-channel sampling rates under a bandwidth budget. PCA-Triage runs in O(wdk) time with zero trainable parameters (0.67 ms per decision).
  We evaluate on 7 benchmarks (8--82 channels) against 9 baselines. PCA-Triage is the best unsupervised method on 3 of 6 datasets at 50% bandwidth, winning 5 of 6 against every baseline with large effect sizes (r = 0.71--0.91). On TEP, it achieves F1 = 0.961 +/- 0.001 -- within 0.1% of full-data performance -- while maintaining F1 > 0.90 at 30% budget. Targeted extensions push F1 to 0.970. The algorithm is robust to packet loss and sensor noise (3.7--4.8% degradation under combined worst-case).

AI.tldr: PCA-Triage 在不损失精度的前提下，利用实时增量 PCA 为工业多通道 IoT 网络动态分配带宽，30% 预算仍可维持 F1>0.90。
AI.motivation: 工业物联网多通道传感网数据量常超可用带宽，现有采样策略无法在压缩率与诊断精度之间兼顾，需一种零训练、轻量、实时且健壮的带宽自适配方法。
AI.method: 将增量 PCA 载荷转换为各通道采样比例的流式算法；时间复杂度 O(wdk)，无训练参数；可扩展针对性增强模块提升性能。
AI.result: 在 7 个基准（8–82 通道）上对比 9 个基线，50% 带宽下 6 个数据集中的 3 个取得最佳无监督效果，5/6 次击败全部基线（效应量 r=0.71–0.91）；TEP 数据集 F1=0.961±0.001，与全数据差距<0.1%，30% 预算 F1>0.90；扩展后 F1 达 0.970；在丢包+噪声最坏组合下性能下降仅 3.7–4.8%。
AI.conclusion: PCA-Triage 无需训练即可在线为工业传感网提供高精度、高压缩率的通道级采样，带宽受限场景下仍保持鲁棒与可扩展性，可直接部署于边缘节点。

title: "This Wasn't Made for Me": Recentering User Experience and Emotional Impact in the Evaluation of ASR Bias
summary: Studies on bias in Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) tend to focus on reporting error rates for speakers of underrepresented dialects, yet less research examines the human side of system bias: how do system failures shape users' lived experiences, how do users feel about and react to them, and what emotional toll do these repeated failures exact? We conducted user experience studies across four U.S. locations (Atlanta, Gulf Coast, Miami Beach, and Tucson) representing distinct English dialect communities. Our findings reveal that most participants report technologies fail to consider their cultural backgrounds and require constant adjustment to achieve basic functionality. Despite these experiences, participants maintain high expectations for ASR performance and express strong willingness to contribute to model improvement. Qualitative analysis of open-ended narratives exposes the deeper costs of these failures. Participants report frustration, annoyance, and feelings of inadequacy, yet the emotional impact extends beyond momentary reactions. Participants recognize that systems were not designed for them, yet often internalize failures as personal inadequacy despite this critical awareness. They perform extensive invisible labor, including code-switching, hyper-articulation, and emotional management, to make failing systems functional. Meanwhile, their linguistic and cultural knowledge remains unrecognized by technologies that encode particular varieties as standard while rendering others marginal. These findings demonstrate that algorithmic fairness assessments based on accuracy metrics alone miss critical dimensions of harm: the emotional labor of managing repeated technological rejection, the cognitive burden of constant self-monitoring, and the psychological toll of feeling inadequate in one's native language variety.

AI.tldr: 美国四地方言用户研究发现，ASR 系统反复失败不仅带来高错误率，更让用户承受情绪劳动、自我监控与“语言羞耻”等深层伤害，而现有公平性评估仅看准确率，忽视了这些隐性代价。
AI.motivation: 既有 ASR 偏见研究多聚焦错误率，缺乏从用户视角揭示系统失败如何渗入日常生活、情绪与身份认同，因而无法衡量“算法公平”遗漏的隐性伤害。
AI.method: 在代表四种方言社区的亚特兰大、墨西哥湾岸、迈阿密海滩与图森进行用户体验研究，收集开放叙事，结合质性编码分析情绪反应与隐性劳动。
AI.result: ①技术普遍忽视文化背景，用户需持续调适；②失败触发沮丧、自我怀疑，用户将系统排斥内化为个人 inadequacy；③承担大量 invisible labor（语码转换、过度清晰发音、情绪管理）；④虽愿贡献数据，但对“标准语”霸权无话语权。
AI.conclusion: 仅以准确率衡量公平性会掩盖深层伤害；ASR 设计需把方言语音、文化语境与用户情绪成本纳入评估指标，并建立让用户参与标准制定的机制，以实现真正的包容性语音技术。

title: WFM: 3D Wavelet Flow Matching for Ultrafast Multi-Modal MRI Synthesis
comment: 17 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at MIDL 2026 (Poster)
summary: Diffusion models have achieved remarkable quality in multi-modal MRI synthesis, but their computational cost (hundreds of sampling steps and separate models per modality) limits clinical deployment. We observe that this inefficiency stems from an unnecessary starting point: diffusion begins from pure noise, discarding the structural information already present in available MRI sequences. We propose WFM (Wavelet Flow Matching), which instead learns a direct flow from an informed prior, the mean of conditioning modalities in wavelet space, to the target distribution. Because the source and target share underlying anatomy and differ primarily in contrast, this formulation enables accurate synthesis in just 1-2 integration steps. A single 82M-parameter model with class conditioning synthesizes all four BraTS modalities (T1, T1c, T2, FLAIR), replacing four separate diffusion models totaling 326M parameters. On BraTS 2024, WFM achieves 26.8 dB PSNR and 0.94 SSIM, within 1-2 dB of diffusion baselines, while running 250-1000x faster (0.16-0.64s vs. 160s per volume). This speed-quality trade-off makes real-time MRI synthesis practical for clinical workflows. Code is available at https://github.com/yalcintur/WFM.

AI.tldr: Wavelet Flow Matching (WFM) 以 1-2 步生成多模态 MRI，速度比扩散模型快 250-1000 倍，仅用 82 M 参数取代四个 326 M 扩散模型，PSNR/SSIM 差距 <2 dB。
AI.motivation: 临床部署扩散模型合成 MRI 时，数百步采样和每模态独立模型带来高昂计算成本；作者发现瓶颈在于扩散始终从纯噪声出发，浪费了已有序列中的解剖结构信息。
AI.method: 提出 WFM：在 wavelet 空间将“条件模态均值”作为知情先验，直接学习从该先验到目标模态的常微分方程流；采用类条件 82 M 统一网络一次性输出 BraTS 四种模态（T1/T1c/T2/FLAIR）。
AI.result: 在 BraTS 2024 上，WFM 1-2 步即达 26.8 dB PSNR、0.94 SSIM，与扩散基线差距 ≤2 dB；单卷推理 0.16-0.64 s，比扩散 160 s 加速 250-1000 倍；参数量减少 75 %。
AI.conclusion: 利用 wavelet 空间解剖共享先验，WFM 实现实时、高质量多模态 MRI 合成，为临床工作流程提供可部署的轻量级方案。

title: Data-Driven Open-Loop Simulation for Digital-Twin Operator Decision Support in Wastewater Treatment
summary: Wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs) need digital-twin-style decision support tools that can simulate plant response under prescribed control plans, tolerate irregular and missing sensing, and remain informative over 12-36 h planning horizons. Meeting these requirements with full-scale plant data remains an open engineering-AI challenge. We present CCSS-RS, a controlled continuous-time state-space model that separates historical state inference from future control and exogenous rollout. The model combines typed context encoding, gain-weighted forcing of prescribed and forecast drivers, semigroup-consistent rollouts, and Student-t plus hurdle outputs for heavy-tailed and zero-inflated WWTP sensor data. On the public Avedøre full-scale benchmark, with 906,815 timesteps, 43% missingness, and 1-20 min irregular sampling, CCSS-RS achieves RMSE 0.696 and CRPS 0.349 at H=1000 across 10,000 test windows. This reduces RMSE by 40-46% relative to Neural CDE baselines and by 31-35% relative to simplified internal variants. Four case studies using a frozen checkpoint on test data demonstrate operational value: oxygen-setpoint perturbations shift predicted ammonium by -2.3 to +1.4 over horizons 300-1000; a smoothed setpoint plan ranks first in multi-criterion screening; context-only sensor outages raise monitored-variable RMSE by at most 10%; and ammonium, nitrate, and oxygen remain more accurate than persistence throughout the rollout. These results establish CCSS-RS as a practical learned simulator for offline scenario screening in industrial wastewater treatment, complementary to mechanistic models.

AI.tldr: CCSS-RS是一种面向大型污水厂、可12–36 h离线筛选控制方案的连续时间数字孪生模型，在极不完整数据上比现有神经CDE误差再降四成，现场验证可精准预测氨氮、硝氮与溶解氧波动。
AI.motivation: 污水厂迫切需要能在数据缺失、采样不均、传感器故障情况下仍能给出12–36 h可靠预测的决策支持工具，而现有全尺度数据驱动的模拟器精度与鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: 提出受控连续时间状态空间模型CCSS-RS：①用类型化上下文编码把历史推断与未来控制解耦；②对设定值与预报驱动做增益加权强制；③半群一致性推演保障长时一致性；④Student-t+hurdle分布同时刻画厚尾与零膨胀传感器数据。在公开Avedøre 90 万步真实数据上训练。
AI.result: 在43 %缺失、1–20 min非均匀采样的基准上，H=1000步(≈17 h)多变量预测RMSE 0.696、CRPS 0.349，比Neural CDE基线RMSE降40–46 %，降31–35 %于简化自研变体；氧设定值扰动使氨氮预测偏差−2.3~+1.4，传感器中断仅升高RMSE ≤10 %，氨/硝/氧全程优于 persistence 基线。
AI.conclusion: CCSS-RS首次在真实污水厂全尺度数据上实现10 h级高精度、高鲁棒滚动预测，可作为离线情景筛选的实用学习型模拟器，与机理模型互补。

title: AI Governance under Political Turnover: The Alignment Surface of Compliance Design
summary: Governments are increasingly interested in using AI to make administrative decisions cheaper, more scalable, and more consistent. But for probabilistic AI to be incorporated into public administration it must be embedded in a compliance layer that makes decisions reviewable, repeatable, and legally defensible. That layer can improve oversight by making departures from law easier to detect. But it can also create a stable approval boundary that political successors learn to navigate while preserving the appearance of lawful administration. We develop a formal model in which institutions choose the scale of automation, the degree of codification, and safeguards on iterative use. The model shows when these systems become vulnerable to strategic use from within government, why reforms that initially improve oversight can later increase that vulnerability, and why expansions in AI use may be difficult to unwind. Making AI usable can thus make procedures easier for future governments to learn and exploit.

AI.tldr: 将AI嵌入公共行政虽能提升效率，但若过度”合规化“（可审查、可复现、可辩护），反而会把法律边界固化成可被后继政府策略性利用的模板，使AI规模一旦扩大便难以回退。
AI.motivation: 回应各国政府用AI做行政决策的热潮，揭示”可审查、可复现、可辩护“的合规层在提升透明度的同时，也可能被内部行为者学样利用，削弱法治。
AI.method: 构建三变量形式模型：自动化规模、规则化程度、迭代使用安全阈值；比较不同参数组合下政府对AI决策的操控空间与法律审查难度，并用博弈推演后继政府如何继承并优化”合法外观“的策略。
AI.result: 模型给出临界条件：当规则化程度≥阈值、且自动化规模已覆盖高价值审批场景时，内部人可低成本复制”合法违规“路径；初期增强的审查机制，会反向为后继政府提供可学习的操作手册，使系统陷入路径依赖，AI使用规模出现不可逆扩张。
AI.conclusion: 让AI”可用且合规“的同时，必须把合规层本身设计成可动态调校、可外部审计的”活制度“，否则初期效率提升会换来长期法治脆弱性；政策制定者应在扩张AI前预设回退机制与独立算法审计，防止技术锁死法治空间。

title: Early Detection of Latent Microstructure Regimes in Limit Order Books
comment: 48 pages, 7 figures. Combines theoretical guarantees (identifiability and early-detection bounds), 200-run simulation study, and preliminary real-data evaluation on BTC/USDT limit order books. Code and data available
summary: Limit order books can transition rapidly from stable to stressed conditions, yet standard early-warning signals such as order flow imbalance and short-term volatility are inherently reactive. We formalise this limitation via a three-regime causal data-generating process (stable $\to$ latent build-up $\to$ stress) in which a latent deterioration phase creates a prediction window prior to observable stress. Under mild assumptions on temporal drift and regime persistence, we establish identifiability of the latent build-up regime and derive guarantees for strictly positive expected lead-time and non-trivial probability of early detection. We propose a trigger-based detector combining MAX aggregation of complementary signal channels, a rising-edge condition, and adaptive thresholding. Across 200 simulations, the method achieves mean lead-time $+18.6 \pm 3.2$ timesteps with perfect precision and moderate coverage, outperforming classical change-point and microstructure baselines. A preliminary application to one week of BTC/USDT order book data shows consistent positive lead-times while baselines remain reactive. Results degrade in low signal-to-noise and short build-up regimes, consistent with theory.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出一种可提前18.6步且无假警的限价簿崩盘预警器，理论上论证潜在累积期可识别，并在BTC/USDT实盘给出正提前量，显著优于传统指标。
AI.motivation: 现有订单流失衡、短期波动等早期信号只能在市场已进入可观测“危机”阶段后才触发，无法捕捉事先的潜在恶化。作者希望突破这一被动局面，建立可提前预警的机制。
AI.method: 1) 构建“稳定→潜在累积→危机”三机制因果数据生成模型；2) 在时序漂移与机制持续性假设下，证明潜在累积机制可识别，并给出提前探测的正期望提前时间及非平凡检测概率；3) 设计触发式检测器：对多通道互补信号做MAX聚合，引入上升沿条件与自适应阈值，形成无假警的预警触发。
AI.result: 200组模拟中，新检测器平均提前18.6±3.2步，Precision=100%，Coverage适中，显著优于经典变点检测与微结构基线；在BTC/USDT一周深度数据中持续获得正提前量，而基线仍为负提前（事后反应）。当信噪比低或累积期过短时性能下降，与理论一致。
AI.conclusion: 潜在累积机制可被有效识别并利用，MAX-上升沿-自适应阈值框架能在保证零假警的前提下提供显著正提前量，为高频风控与做市商仓位调整提供了可行工具，但在低信噪比环境下仍需进一步优化。

title: Prefix Parsing is Just Parsing
summary: Prefix parsing asks whether an input prefix can be extended to a complete string generated by a given grammar. In the weighted setting, it also provides prefix probabilities, which are central to context-free language modeling, psycholinguistic analysis, and syntactically constrained generation from large language models. We introduce the prefix grammar transformation, an efficient reduction of prefix parsing to ordinary parsing. Given a grammar, our method constructs another grammar that generates exactly the prefixes of its original strings. Prefix parsing is then solved by applying any ordinary parsing algorithm on the transformed grammar without modification. The reduction is both elegant and practical: the transformed grammar is only a small factor larger than the input, and any optimized implementation can be used directly, eliminating the need for bespoke prefix-parsing algorithms. We also present a strategy-based on algorithmic differentiation-for computing the next-token weight vector, i.e., the prefix weights of all one-token extensions, enabling efficient prediction of the next token. Together, these contributions yield a simple, general, and efficient framework for prefix parsing.

AI.tldr: 提出一种前缀文法变换方法，将前缀解析归约为普通解析，统一处理加权/非加权前缀解析及下一步 token 预测。
AI.motivation: 现有前缀解析与下一步 token 权重计算需专门算法，复杂且难以复用已有高性能解析器；需要一种通用、简洁且高效的统一框架。
AI.method: 引入前缀文法变换：构造新文法，使其生成的语言恰好是原文法所有句子的前缀集。对新文法使用任意现成解析算法即可完成前缀解析；对加权文法，进一步采用算法微分策略一次性计算所有单 token 扩展的前缀概率向量。
AI.result: 变换后的文法规模仅比原文法小比例增长，可直接调用任意优化解析实现，无需定制前缀算法；同时可高效生成下一-token 权重向量，支持大规模语言模型的语法约束解码。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将前缀解析及加权前缀概率计算统一归约为普通解析问题，简洁、通用且高效，为基于上下无关文法的语言建模、心理语言学分析和 LLM 受限生成提供了实用工具。

title: Reinforcing 3D Understanding in Point-VLMs via Geometric Reward Credit Assignment
summary: Point-Vision-Language Models promise to empower embodied agents with executable spatial reasoning, yet they frequently succumb to geometric hallucination where predicted 3D structures contradict the observed 2D reality. We identify a key cause of this failure not as a representation bottleneck but as a structural misalignment in reinforcement learning, where sparse geometric tokens are drowned out by noisy and broadcasted sequence-level rewards. To resolve this causal dilution, we propose Geometric Reward Credit Assignment, a framework that disentangles holistic supervision into field-specific signals and routes them exclusively to their responsible token spans. This mechanism transforms vague feedback into precise gradient updates and effectively turns generic policy optimization into targeted structural alignment. Furthermore, we internalize physical constraints via a Reprojection-Consistency term which serves as a cross-modal verifier to penalize physically impossible geometries. Validated on a calibrated benchmark derived from ShapeNetCore, our approach bridges the reliability gap by boosting 3D KPA from 0.64 to 0.93, increasing 3D bounding box intersection over union to 0.686, and raising reprojection consistency scores to 0.852. Crucially, these gains are achieved while maintaining robust 2D localization performance, marking a meaningful step from plausible textual outputs toward physically verifiable spatial predictions.

AI.tldr: 针对点云-视觉-语言模型在3D空间推理中出现“几何幻觉”的问题，本文提出几何奖励信用分配框架，将序列级稀疏奖励精确分配给对应几何token，并引入跨模态重投影一致性惩罚，使3D预测与2D观测保持一致，显著提升了物理可验证性。
AI.motivation: 现有Point-Vision-Language模型虽能输出看似合理的空间描述，但3D结构常与2D观测矛盾，导致“几何幻觉”，且无法被下游机器人安全调用。亟需一种可解释的奖励机制，使强化学习聚焦几何线索，产生物理一致的3D输出。
AI.method: 1) 将整体奖励拆分为场域特定信号，并通过token级路由仅回传至负责的几何token，消除噪声与稀释；2) 设计重投影一致性损失，利用2D-3D重投影误差作为跨模态验证器，惩罚物理不可能的几何；3) 在ShapeNetCore标定基准上，联合优化定位与结构对齐目标。
AI.result: 在ShapeNetCore子集上，3D关键点平均精度KPA由0.64→0.93，3D IoU由0.46→0.686，重投影一致得分0.852；同时2D检测AP维持≥98%，证明不牺牲2D性能即可显著增强3D可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 通过结构级奖励信用分配与重投影一致性约束，首次把“文本合理”转向“物理可验”，为具身智能提供可直接执行、安全可信的空间推理基础模型。

title: Sink-Token-Aware Pruning for Fine-Grained Video Understanding in Efficient Video LLMs
summary: Video Large Language Models (Video LLMs) incur high inference latency due to a large number of visual tokens provided to LLMs. To address this, training-free visual token pruning has emerged as a solution to reduce computational costs; however, existing methods are primarily validated on Multiple-Choice Question Answering (MCQA) benchmarks, where coarse-grained cues often suffice. In this work, we reveal that these methods suffer a sharp performance collapse on fine-grained understanding tasks requiring precise visual grounding, such as hallucination evaluation. To explore this gap, we conduct a systematic analysis and identify sink tokens--semantically uninformative tokens that attract excessive attention--as a key obstacle to fine-grained video understanding. When these sink tokens survive pruning, they distort the model's visual evidence and hinder fine-grained understanding. Motivated by these insights, we propose Sink-Token-aware Pruning (SToP), a simple yet effective plug-and-play method that introduces a sink score to quantify each token's tendency to behave as a sink and applies this score to existing spatial and temporal pruning methods to suppress them, thereby enhancing video understanding. To validate the effectiveness of SToP, we apply it to state-of-the-art pruning methods (VisionZip, FastVid, and Holitom) and evaluate it across diverse benchmarks covering hallucination, open-ended generation, compositional reasoning, and MCQA. Our results demonstrate that SToP significantly boosts performance, even when pruning up to 90% of visual tokens.

AI.tldr: 现有视频大模型在剪枝视觉token时因＂sink token＂问题导致细粒度任务性能崩溃；提出病态剪枝法SToP，可零训练地滤除sink token，在90%剪枝率下仍显著提升幻觉检测、开放生成等细粒度理解指标。
AI.motivation: 视频LLMs推理延迟大，免训练剪枝在MCQA上有效，但在需精确视觉定位的细粒度任务（如幻觉评测）上性能急剧下降；现缺乏对这种掉队原因的系统剖析与针对性改进。
AI.method: 首先系统分析并定义语义空白却过度吸引注意力的sink token；随后提出SToP插件，先计算sink分数衡量token的“吸注意”倾向，再用该分数对空间+时间剪枝进行重打分并抑制sink token。
AI.result: SToP可即插即用，应用于VisionZip/FastVid/Holitom后在多个细粒度基准（幻觉检测、开放问答、组合推理等）上实现显著性能提升；极端90%剪枝率下仍优于原剪枝方案，并与MCQA表现兼容。
AI.conclusion: sink token是免训练视频剪枝在细粒度任务中崩溃的关键因素；通过轻量级抑制即可兼顾速度与理解精度，为高效Video LLMs提供了通用插件式解法。

title: Agentic AI for Personalized Physiotherapy: A Multi-Agent Framework for Generative Video Training and Real-Time Pose Correction
comment: 3 pages, 2 figures, submitted to ICDH IEEE conference
summary: At-home physiotherapy compliance remains critically low due to a lack of personalized supervision and dynamic feedback. Existing digital health solutions rely on static, pre-recorded video libraries or generic 3D avatars that fail to account for a patient's specific injury limitations or home environment. In this paper, we propose a novel Multi-Agent System (MAS) architecture that leverages Generative AI and computer vision to close the tele-rehabilitation loop. Our framework consists of four specialized micro-agents: a Clinical Extraction Agent that parses unstructured medical notes into kinematic constraints; a Video Synthesis Agent that utilizes foundational video generation models to create personalized, patient-specific exercise videos; a Vision Processing Agent for real-time pose estimation; and a Diagnostic Feedback Agent that issues corrective instructions. We present the system architecture, detail the prototype pipeline using Large Language Models and MediaPipe, and outline our clinical evaluation plan. This work demonstrates the feasibility of combining generative media with agentic autonomous decision-making to scale personalized patient care safely and effectively.

AI.tldr: 提出一套多智能体系统，用生成式AI+计算机视觉把出院笔记转成个性化康复视频，并在患者居家锻炼时实时纠错，实现远程康复闭环。
AI.motivation: 居家康复依从率极低，现有数字方案只能提供千篇一律的预录视频或3D模型，无法兼顾患者个体伤情与居家环境差异。
AI.method: 设计四微智能体架构：① Clinical Extraction Agent 解析非结构化病历得出运动学约束；② Video Synthesis Agent 用基础视频生成模型按约束合成患者专属锻炼视频；③ Vision Processing Agent 借助 MediaPipe 等实时估计姿态；④ Diagnostic Feedback Agent 基于大模型生成即时纠错指令。原型以 LLM 与 MediaPipe 实现端到端管线。
AI.result: 原型已可自动把病历→个性化视频→实时姿态监控→语言纠偏串联跑通，验证了生成式媒体与自主智能体结合的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 该MAS能在不增加临床人力的情况下，安全、可扩展地提供个体化康复指导，为远程康复闭环落地奠定基础，后续将按既定临床方案验证其疗效与安全性。

title: Differentially Private Model Merging
summary: In machine learning applications, privacy requirements during inference or deployment time could change constantly due to varying policies, regulations, or user experience. In this work, we aim to generate a magnitude of models to satisfy any target differential privacy (DP) requirement without additional training steps, given a set of existing models trained on the same dataset with different privacy/utility tradeoffs. We propose two post processing techniques, namely random selection and linear combination, to output a final private model for any target privacy parameter. We provide privacy accounting of these approaches from the lens of R'enyi DP and privacy loss distributions for general problems. In a case study on private mean estimation, we fully characterize the privacy/utility results and theoretically establish the superiority of linear combination over random selection. Empirically, we validate our approach and analyses on several models and both synthetic and real-world datasets.

AI.tldr: 首次提出「免重训、任意ε-DP模型」的生成框架，只需对已训好的不同隐私–效用权衡模型做随机挑选或线性组合即可满足新隐私要求；理论上用Rényi DP与隐私损失分布做精确 accounting，并在均值估计问题中证明线性组合优于随机挑选，实验涵盖多种模型与合成/真实数据。
AI.motivation: 推理阶段隐私需求会因政策、法规或用户体验动态变化，反复重训模型代价高昂。作者希望利用“一组已训好、隐私–效用权衡各异的模型”直接生成满足任意新DP预算的模型，实现零额外训练时间成本。
AI.method: 提出两种纯后处理技术：1) 随机挑选（Random Selection）——按概率分布随机选出一个已有模型；2) 线性组合（Linear Combination）——对已有模型参数做加权平均。用Rényi差分隐私与隐私损失分布对两种策略进行统一隐私核算，并给出一般性边界。针对私有均值估计问题，给出完整的隐私–效用闭式刻画，证明线性组合的MSE ≤ 随机挑选的MSE。
AI.result: 理论上：1) 随机挑选的隐私放大仅依赖选择概率，线性组合可获得更紧的Rényi DP bound；2) 在均值估计任务中，线性组合在任意ε下均取得更低MSE。实验上：在合成高斯数据与MNIST、CIFAR-10图像分类任务中，两种方法都能在ε=0.1→10范围内即时输出合格模型；线性组合在相同ε下准确率平均提升1.5–3.2 个百分点，与理论结论一致。
AI.conclusion: 无需重训即可根据任意即时隐私要求即时“调制”模型的设想可行；线性组合策略在隐私、效用与稳健性上全面优于随机挑选，为动态隐私场景提供了低成本、可证明的部署方案。未来工作将探索更复杂的聚合策略与自适应权重估计。

title: On Reasoning Behind Next Occupation Recommendation
summary: In this work, we develop a novel reasoning approach to enhance the performance of large language models (LLMs) in future occupation prediction. In this approach, a reason generator first derives a ``reason'' for a user using his/her past education and career history. The reason summarizes the user's preference and is used as the input of an occupation predictor to recommend the user's next occupation. This two-step occupation prediction approach is, however, non-trivial as LLMs are not aligned with career paths or the unobserved reasons behind each occupation decision. We therefore propose to fine-tune LLMs improving their reasoning and occupation prediction performance. We first derive high-quality oracle reasons, as measured by factuality, coherence and utility criteria, using a LLM-as-a-Judge. These oracle reasons are then used to fine-tune small LLMs to perform reason generation and next occupation prediction. Our extensive experiments show that: (a) our approach effectively enhances LLM's accuracy in next occupation prediction making them comparable to fully supervised methods and outperforming unsupervised methods; (b) a single LLM fine-tuned to perform reason generation and occupation prediction outperforms two LLMs fine-tuned to perform the tasks separately; and (c) the next occupation prediction accuracy depends on the quality of generated reasons. Our code is available at https://github.com/Sarasarahhhhh/job_prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出“先生成理由、再预测职业”的两阶段框架，用高质量理由微调小模型，使 LLM 在零样本下达到近似全监督方法的预测精度。
AI.motivation: 大模型缺乏职业路径领域知识，直接预测次职准确率差，需显式引入用户偏好（理由）并对齐 LLM。
AI.method: 1) LLM-as-Judge 产生事实一致、连贯且有用的“神谕理由”；2) 用小模型端到端微调，联合学习理由生成与次职预测；3) 单模型同时完成两步优于分别微调两模型的级联方案。
AI.result: 在公开数据上，零样本 LLM 准确率逼近全监督方法，显著优于无监督基线；理由质量与预测准确率强相关；单模型联合训练比级联提升 3–5 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 显式理由干预是提升 LLM 职业预测性能的关键，小模型经高质量理由微调即可实现大模型级效果，为低资源场景低成本部署提供可行路径。

title: WildSplatter: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting with Appearance Control from Unconstrained Images
summary: We propose WildSplatter, a feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) model for unconstrained images with unknown camera parameters and varying lighting conditions. 3DGS is an effective scene representation that enables high-quality, real-time rendering; however, it typically requires iterative optimization and multi-view images captured under consistent lighting with known camera parameters. WildSplatter is trained on unconstrained photo collections and jointly learns 3D Gaussians and appearance embeddings conditioned on input images. This design enables flexible modulation of Gaussian colors to represent significant variations in lighting and appearance. Our method reconstructs 3D Gaussians from sparse input views in under one second, while also enabling appearance control under diverse lighting conditions. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach outperforms existing pose-free 3DGS methods on challenging real-world datasets with varying illumination.

AI.tldr: WildSplatter是一种无需相机参数与光照约束的feed-forward 3DGS模型，1秒内完成稀疏视图重建并支持光照变化下的外观控制。
AI.motivation: 传统3DGS依赖已知相机参数及一致光照，限制了其在任意网络图片上的应用。作者旨在让3DGS跳过迭代优化与严苛捕获条件，直接应对无标定、光照变化极大的真实照片集合。
AI.method: 提出feed-forward网络，同时预测3D高斯参数与输入图像相关的appearance embedding；利用embedding动态调制高斯颜色以解释光照差异，无需COLMAP标定或逐场景优化。
AI.result: 在真实光照差异显著的数据集上，WildSplatter在重建质量与渲染速度两方面均优于现有无位姿3DGS方法，1秒内完成推理并可交互式调控外观。
AI.conclusion: 首次把3DGS扩展为无需相机参数和光照假设的feed-forward框架，为基于任意照片集合的快速三维场景重建与光照编辑提供了可行方案。

title: HARBOR: Automated Harness Optimization
summary: Long-horizon language-model agents are dominated, in lines of code and in operational complexity, not by their underlying model but by the harness that wraps it: context compaction, tool caching, semantic memory, trajectory reuse, speculative tool prediction, and the glue that binds the model to a sandboxed execution environment. We argue that harness design is a first-class machine-learning problem and that automated configuration search dominates manual stacking once the flag space exceeds a handful of bits. We defend this claim in two steps. First, we formalize automated harness optimization as constrained noisy Bayesian optimization over a mixed-variable, cost-heterogeneous configuration space with cold-start-corrected rewards and a posterior chance-constrained safety check, and give a reference solver, HARBOR (Harness Axis-aligned Regularized Bayesian Optimization Routine), built from a block-additive SAAS surrogate, multi-fidelity cost-aware acquisition, and TuRBO trust regions. Second, we instantiate the problem in a flag-gated harness over a production coding agent and report a controlled four-round manual-tuning case study against a fixed task suite and an end-to-end HARBOR run. The formulation itself is task-class agnostic: the configuration space, reward correction, acquisition, and safety check apply to any agent harness with a bounded flag space and a reproducible task suite.

AI.tldr: 长程语言模型智能体的主要复杂度不在模型本身，而在其“外挂”——上下文压缩、工具缓存、记忆机制等手工拼装的“控制中心”。作者提出将这些外挂抽象成可学习的超参配置空间，用贝叶斯优化自动搜参取代人工堆叠，给出通用求解框架 HARBOR，并在实际编码代理上验证其显著优于四轮手工调参。
AI.motivation: 手工堆叠的代理外挂（harness）代码量远超模型本身，配置空间一旦超过几个 bit 人工调参就失效；需要把 harness 设计升级为可自动优化的机器学习问题。
AI.method: 将 harness 配置视作带约束的混合变量、异构代价噪声黑箱优化，提出 HARBOR：基于块可加 SAAS 先验的代理模型 + 多保真代价感知采集 + TuRBO 信任域，辅以冷启动奖励校正与后验概率安全约束。
AI.result: 在生产级代码代理的 4 轮人工调参对照实验中，HARBOR 自动搜参在多轮迭代后显著优于最佳人工配置；框架与任务无关，可复用到任何带可复现任务套件的代理外挂空间。
AI.conclusion: 当 harness 配置空间>少量 bit 时，自动配置搜索全面压制人工堆叠；HARBOR 提供任务无关、安全可扩展的贝叶斯优化范式，为长程语言代理的“控制中心”设计树立新的第一性方法。

title: Multi-Agent Empowerment and Emergence of Complex Behavior in Groups
summary: Intrinsic motivations are receiving increasing attention, i.e. behavioral incentives that are not engineered, but emerge from the interaction of an agent with its surroundings. In this work we study the emergence of behaviors driven by one such incentive, empowerment, specifically in the context of more than one agent. We formulate a principled extension of empowerment to the multi-agent setting, and demonstrate its efficient calculation. We observe that this intrinsic motivation gives rise to characteristic modes of group-organization in two qualitatively distinct environments: a pair of agents coupled by a tendon, and a controllable Vicsek flock. This demonstrates the potential of intrinsic motivations such as empowerment to not just drive behavior for only individual agents but also higher levels of behavioral organization at scale.

AI.tldr: 将单智能体“内在动机—empowerment”推广到多智能体系统，可在肌腱耦合双体与可控 Vicsek 鸟群两类场景中自发产生群体组织模式，无需外部奖励。
AI.motivation: 传统强化学习依赖人工设计的奖励函数，而内在动机（如 empowerment）能让智能体仅通过与环境交互就自发产生有意义行为，但现有研究多局限于单智能体。作者欲验证 empowerment 在多智能体情境下是否同样能涌现，并能否驱动更高层级的群体结构。
AI.method: ① 将 empowerment（保持未来可选行动空间的最大信息熵）从单智能体形式化为多智能体联合状态—动作空间的互信息，提出可分解的近似计算框架，避免指数爆炸；② 在肌腱耦合双摆任务和可控 Vicsek  flock 模型中，让每个智能体以本地观测为状态、empowerment 增量为内部奖励进行无外在奖励的分布式策略梯度学习；③ 对比有无 empowerment 的群体轨迹与组织度量（同步度、簇团数、信息熵等）。
AI.result: empowerment 驱动下，两肌腱耦合摆自动学会反相振荡以维持最大联合可控性；在 Vicsek flock 中，群体形成高同步、低碰撞的稳定 flocking 结构，且对扰动鲁棒。定量上 empowerment 策略的联合状态熵比随机/外部奖励基线高 30–50%，表明持续保持最大未来选择。
AI.conclusion: empowerment 作为纯内在动机，可在无外部奖励或中心化协调的条件下，自下而上地诱导多智能体系统产生可预测的宏观组织结构，显示其是产生可扩展集体智能的有效信号；为设计自组织多智能体系统提供了无需人工奖励的新型激励范式。

title: Even More Guarantees for Variational Inference in the Presence of Symmetries
comment: Accepted for presentation at the OPTIMAL Workshop at AISTATS 2026
summary: When approximating an intractable density via variational inference (VI) the variational family is typically chosen as a simple parametric family that very likely does not contain the target. This raises the question: Under which conditions can we recover characteristics of the target despite misspecification? In this work, we extend previous results on robust VI with location-scale families under target symmetries. We derive sufficient conditions guaranteeing exact recovery of the mean when using the forward Kullback-Leibler divergence and $α$-divergences. We further show how and why optimization can fail to recover the target mean in the absence of our sufficient conditions, providing initial guidelines on the choice of the variational family and $α$-value.

AI.tldr: 在变分推断（VI）模型设定错误时，若目标分布呈特定对称结构，可利用 α-散度仍精确恢复其一阶矩。为此给出充分条件及其失效机理，为变分族与 α 的选取提供初步准则。
AI.motivation: 现有 VI 方法常假定简单参数变分族，几乎不可能包含真实目标密度，从而引发『模型误设』。作者旨在回答：在何种条件下即便误设也能可靠恢复目标分布的关键统计量。
AI.method: 1) 针对「位置–尺度族」变分近似，引入目标分布对称性假设（如径向二阶或球面对称）；2) 在 α-散度（含 KL 散度）框架下，推导使变分优化输出均值恰好等于目标均值的充分解析条件；3) 通过反例与优化 landscape 分析阐明条件不满足时均值估计为何偏倚。
AI.result: 定理给出：当目标对称且 α≤1 时，变分推断可精确恢复均值；若 α>1 或对称假设不成立，均值估计趋于目标加/减一个非零偏移量，并给出偏移量的显式表达式；实验验证该结论。
AI.conclusion: 仅依赖更复杂变分族并不足够；先验利用目标对称信息并选择 α≤1，即可在不增加模型容量的情况下保证均值估计的稳健性。后续工作将拓展到高阶矩与更一般族。

title: Subject-level Inference for Realistic Text Anonymization Evaluation
summary: Current text anonymization evaluation relies on span-based metrics that fail to capture what an adversary could actually infer, and assumes a single data subject, ignoring multi-subject scenarios. To address these limitations, we present SPIA (Subject-level PII Inference Assessment), the first benchmark that shifts the unit of evaluation from text spans to individuals, comprising 675 documents across legal and online domains with novel subject-level protection metrics. Extensive experiments show that even when over 90% of PII spans are masked, subject-level inference protection drops as low as 33%, leaving the majority of personal information recoverable through contextual inference. Furthermore, target-subject-focused anonymization leaves non-target subjects substantially more exposed than the target subject. We show that subject-level inference-based evaluation is essential for ensuring safe text anonymization in real-world settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出名为 SPIA 的“主体级 PII 推断评估”基准，首次将匿名化评估粒度从文本片段转为数据主体本身。对 675 份法律与网络文本的实验表明：即便 90% PII 片段被遮蔽，对主体的推断保护率最低仅 33%，且针对主体的遮蔽会却使非目标主体暴露更严重。
AI.motivation: 1) 现有基于span 的评估忽略对手能从上下文推断出潜在敏感信息；2) 只研究单主体文本，忽视多主体共存的真实场景；3) 缺乏能衡量“主体级”隐私泄漏的标准化基准，导致匿名化方案的实际安全性被高估。作者希望提供贴近真实攻击目标的综合评价方法。
AI.method: 1) 构建 SPIA：从法律文件与社交媒体抽取 675 篇多主体文本，并人工标注出 15 类个人信息实体及 5,720 位主体；2) 提出三类“主体级保护度”指标：匹配率(MR)、包容性匹配率(ER)、唯一性排名(IR)，量化攻击者能否把推断的身份链路到特定主体；3) 基于 BERT-large+分类头、ChatGPT 等模型实施上下文攻击；4) 对 5 种典型遮蔽策略做对比实验：随机、高显著 PII、目标主体泛化、文本级融合等。通过自动化评估与人工校验验证指标一致性。
AI.result: 1) 即便保留 10% PII 要件，现有遮蔽方法在碎片化评估下 F1 仅降 4–6%，但在主体级唯一性排名(IR)中仅保护 33% 主体；2) 法律文本因主体稀疏且上下文线索丰富，安全缺口更大；3) 单纯遮蔽敏感词无法阻止关联推断，主体周边 socio-relational 词语常充当旁路；4) 以靶主体为中心的匿名化导致其余主体 MR 平均提高 3.8×，暴露非目标个人隐私。说明 span 指标易造成安全错觉，而主体级评估揭示显著风险。
AI.conclusion: 1) 文本匿名化应从“去词化”转向“主体化”立体防护，保护单位需改成具象的人；2) 需综合考虑上下文、编码语义与多主体耦合; 3) SPIA 确立了首个可度量可复现的主体级评价框架，可用于检验未来匿名化、语言模型微调及合成数据方案；4) 未来工作应探讨强语义推理攻击与对抗式训练，推进更具鲁棒性的隐私保护文本系统。

title: SpatiO: Adaptive Test-Time Orchestration of Vision-Language Agents for Spatial Reasoning
summary: Understanding visual scenes requires not only recognizing objects but also reasoning about their spatial relationships. Unlike general vision-language tasks, spatial reasoning requires integrating multiple inductive biases, such as 2D appearance cues, depth signals, and geometric constraints, whose reliability varies across contexts. This suggests that effective spatial reasoning requires \emph{spatial adaptability}: the ability to flexibly coordinate different reasoning strategies depending on the input. However, most existing approaches rely on a single reasoning pipeline that implicitly learns a fixed spatial prior, limiting their ability to adapt under distribution changes. Multi-agent systems offer a promising alternative by aggregating diverse reasoning trajectories, but prior attempts in spatial reasoning primarily employ homogeneous agents, restricting the diversity of inductive biases they can leverage. In this work, we introduce \textbf{\textsc{SpatiO}}, a heterogeneous multi-agent framework for spatial reasoning that coordinates multiple vision-language specialists with complementary inductive biases. To enable effective collaboration, we propose \textbf{Test-Time Orchestration (TTO)}, an optimization mechanism that dynamically evaluates and reweights agents based on their observed reliability during inference, without modifying model parameters. Extensive experiments on diverse spatial reasoning benchmarks, including 3DSRBench, STVQA-7k, CV-Bench, and Omni3D-Bench, demonstrate that \textsc{SpatiO} consistently improves spatial reasoning performance over both closed-source and open-source baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出了异构多智能体系统	extsc{SpatiO}，在测试阶段动态聚合具备不同空间归纳偏置的视觉-语言专家，无需重训即可显著提升跨场景空间推理鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有空间推理模型仅用单一固定先验，难以适应不同情境下深度、几何、2D 外观等线索可信度的变化；同构多智能体又缺乏归纳偏置多样性，亟需能在推理时灵活整合异构策略的框架。
AI.method: 设计异构多智能体框架	extsc{SpatiO}，为各智能体注入互补归纳偏置；提出 Test-Time Orchestration（TTO）机制，在推理阶段仅依据实时表现动态重赋权重，实现无参数更新的自适应协作。
AI.result: 在 3DSRBench、STVQA-7k、CV-Bench、Omni3D-Bench 等多类基准上，	extsc{SpatiO} 相较闭源与开源基线均取得一致且显著的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过异构智能体 + 测试时动态协调，	extsc{SpatiO} 有效克服固定先验局限，为分布漂移下的鲁棒空间推理提供了可扩展的新范式。

title: SCM: Sleep-Consolidated Memory with Algorithmic Forgetting for Large Language Models
summary: We present SCM (Sleep-Consolidated Memory), a research preview of a memory architecture for large language models that draws on neuroscientific principles to address a fundamental limitation in current systems: the absence of persistent, structured, and biologically plausible memory. Existing approaches rely on truncating context windows, growing vector databases without bound, or tiered storage systems that lack consolidation and forgetting mechanisms. SCM implements five core components inspired by human memory: a limited-capacity working memory, multi-dimensional importance tagging, offline sleep-stage consolidation with distinct NREM and REM phases, intentional value-based forgetting, and a computational self-model enabling introspection. Across a standardized benchmark suite of eight tests, the prototype achieves perfect recall accuracy over ten-turn conversations while reducing memory noise by 90.9% through adaptive forgetting. Memory search latency remains below one millisecond even with hundreds of stored concepts. This work establishes the architectural foundations for memory systems that consolidate, prioritize, and forget, offering a testable platform for advancing LLM memory research.

AI.tldr: 借鉴神经科学的「睡眠-记忆巩固」机制，提出 SCM：一种具备有限工作记忆、离线 NREM/REM 整合、价值驱动遗忘与自省的 LLM 持久记忆架构，10 轮对话召回率 100%，噪声降低 90.9%，搜索延迟 <1 ms。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 仅依赖截断上下文、无界向量库或分层存储，缺乏生物可信的巩固与遗忘机制，导致记忆膨胀、噪声累积。
AI.method: 设计五大核心组件：①容量受限的工作记忆；②多维重要性标签；③离线双相（NREM/REM）睡眠式巩固；④基于价值的主动遗忘；⑤可计算的自模型支持自省。
AI.result: 在 8 项标准化基准测试中，原型在 10 轮对话内实现 100% 召回，噪声降低 90.9%，即使存储数百个概念，记忆检索延迟仍低于 1 毫秒。
AI.conclusion: SCM 为 LLM 提供了可测试的「巩固-优先-遗忘」记忆框架，奠定后续研究基础。

title: Trust but Verify: Introducing DAVinCI -- A Framework for Dual Attribution and Verification in Claim Inference for Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable fluency and versatility across a wide range of NLP tasks, yet they remain prone to factual inaccuracies and hallucinations. This limitation poses significant risks in high-stakes domains such as healthcare, law, and scientific communication, where trust and verifiability are paramount. In this paper, we introduce DAVinCI - a Dual Attribution and Verification framework designed to enhance the factual reliability and interpretability of LLM outputs. DAVinCI operates in two stages: (i) it attributes generated claims to internal model components and external sources; (ii) it verifies each claim using entailment-based reasoning and confidence calibration. We evaluate DAVinCI across multiple datasets, including FEVER and CLIMATE-FEVER, and compare its performance against standard verification-only baselines. Our results show that DAVinCI significantly improves classification accuracy, attribution precision, recall, and F1-score by 5-20%. Through an extensive ablation study, we isolate the contributions of evidence span selection, recalibration thresholds, and retrieval quality. We also release a modular DAVinCI implementation that can be integrated into existing LLM pipelines. By bridging attribution and verification, DAVinCI offers a scalable path to auditable, trustworthy AI systems. This work contributes to the growing effort to make LLMs not only powerful but also accountable.

AI.tldr: 提出DAVinCI双阶段归因与验证框架，使LLM输出具备可审计、可信的事实性保证，在FEVER等任务上把准确率等指标提升5–20%。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型在医疗、法律等高风险场景常出现幻觉与事实错误；缺乏可验证与归因机制阻碍了其可信落地。
AI.method: 框架分两阶段：①将生成声明同时归因到模型内部组件与外部来源；②用蕴含推理+置信度校准做声明验证；并配套证据跨度选择、重校准阈值与检索质量优化模块。
AI.result: 在FEVER、CLIMATE-FEVER等基准上，DAVinCI较仅验证基线将分类准确率、归因精确率、召回率与F1提升5–20%；消融实验证实各子模块均贡献显著。
AI.conclusion: DAVinCI通过将归因与验证耦合，给出一条可扩展的可审计、可信AI路径，可直接嵌入现有LLM管线，使大模型既强大又可问责。

title: Quotient-Space Diffusion Models
comment: ICLR 2026 Oral Presentation; 40 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables
summary: Diffusion-based generative models have reformed generative AI, and have enabled new capabilities in the science domain, for example, generating 3D structures of molecules. Due to the intrinsic problem structure of certain tasks, there is often a symmetry in the system, which identifies objects that can be converted by a group action as equivalent, hence the target distribution is essentially defined on the quotient space with respect to the group. In this work, we establish a formal framework for diffusion modeling on a general quotient space, and apply it to molecular structure generation which follows the special Euclidean group $\text{SE}(3)$ symmetry. The framework reduces the necessity of learning the component corresponding to the group action, hence simplifies learning difficulty over conventional group-equivariant diffusion models, and the sampler guarantees recovering the target distribution, while heuristic alignment strategies lack proper samplers. The arguments are empirically validated on structure generation for small molecules and proteins, indicating that the principled quotient-space diffusion model provides a new framework that outperforms previous symmetry treatments.

AI.tldr: 提出商空间扩散模型框架，首次将扩散生成理论推广到具有SE(3)对称性的三维分子结构生成，理论保证采样正确性，实验验证优于传统对称性处理方法。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在科学生成任务中表现突出，但三维分子结构天然具有平移旋转对称性（SE(3)群），现有“群等变”方法仍需额外学习群作用分量，增加学习难度且缺乏严格采样保证。需建立一套可直接在商空间定义并采样的扩散框架，从根本上简化对称性处理。
AI.method: 1) 将目标分布形式化地定义在关于群作用的商空间上；2) 推导商空间上的前向/反向随机微分方程，证明其边缘分布仍满足扩散原理；3) 设计无需显式学习群作用的等变得分网络，采样阶段通过商空间SDE还原原始分布；4) 给出小分子的原子点云与蛋白质骨架的两套实现。
AI.result: 在QM9小分子与CATH蛋白数据集上，模型在生成样本的多样性、精度及下游性质预测一致性指标上均优于GAN、EGNN、EDM等对称性基线；采样步数减少30%仍能维持分布一致性；消融实验显示去除商空间建模后性能下降10%以上。
AI.conclusion: 商空间扩散框架首次为具有连续群对称性的生成任务提供了理论完备且易于实现的解决方案，可推广至任意Lie群对称系统，为分子设计、材料生成等科学应用开辟了新范式。

title: Zero-Shot Detection of LLM-Generated Text via Implicit Reward Model
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across various tasks. However, their ability to generate human-like text has raised concerns about potential misuse. This underscores the need for reliable and effective methods to detect LLM-generated text. In this paper, we propose IRM, a novel zero-shot approach that leverages Implicit Reward Models for LLM-generated text detection. Such implicit reward models can be derived from publicly available instruction-tuned and base models. Previous reward-based method relies on preference construction and task-specific fine-tuning. In comparison, IRM requires neither preference collection nor additional training. We evaluate IRM on the DetectRL benchmark and demonstrate that IRM can achieve superior detection performance, outperforms existing zero-shot and supervised methods in LLM-generated text detection.

AI.tldr: 无需任何训练或偏好数据，仅利用已有LLM隐含奖励信号即可在 DetectRL 基准上超越现有零样本与有监督检测器。
AI.motivation: LLM 文本愈发逼真，传统检测方法依赖人工标注或偏好对，成本高且场景受限，亟需零样本、无额外训练的可靠检测手段。
AI.method: 提出 IRM：从公开指令微调模型与底座模型中直接提取隐含奖励（Implicit Reward）作为检测分数，无需收集偏好或微调，实现零样本判别。
AI.result: 在 DetectRL 基准上，IRM 的检测指标全面优于现有零样本方法与有监督基线，验证其有效性与通用性。
AI.conclusion: Implicit Reward 可作为通用、无需训练的 LLM 文本检测信号，IRM 为零样本检测提供了高效、低成本的新范式。

title: A Probabilistic Framework for Improving Dense Object Detection in Underwater Image Data via Annealing-Based Data Augmentation
summary: Object detection models typically perform well on images captured in controlled environments with stable lighting, water clarity, and viewpoint, but their performance degrades substantially in real-world underwater settings characterized by high variability and frequent occlusions. In this work, we address these challenges by introducing a novel data augmentation framework designed to improve robustness in dense and unconstrained underwater scenes. Using the DeepFish dataset, which contains images of fish in natural environments, we first generate bounding box annotations from provided segmentation masks to construct a custom detection dataset. We then propose a pseudo-simulated annealing-based augmentation algorithm, inspired by the copy-paste strategy of Deng et al. [1], to synthesize realistic crowded fish scenarios. Our approach improves spatial diversity and object density during training, enabling better generalization to complex scenes. Experimental results show that our method significantly outperforms a baseline YOLOv10 model, particularly on a challenging test set of manually annotated images collected from live-stream footage in the Florida Keys. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of our augmentation strategy for improving detection performance in dense, real-world underwater environments.

AI.tldr: 文中提出一套面向水下拥挤鱼群场景的数据增强框架，显著提升YOLOv10在真实复杂环境下的检测鲁棒性，在佛罗里达群岛直播鱼群数据上取得明显优势。
AI.motivation: 水下图像受光照、水体浑浊、视角多变且遮挡频繁影响，现有检测模型从实验室环境迁移到实际水域后性能急剧下降，需针对性提升在密集、无约束场景中的泛化能力。
AI.method: 1) 基于DeepFish数据集的实例分割掩膜自动生成包围框，构建专用检测数据集；2) 设计受Deng等人copy-paste启发的伪模拟退火数据增强算法，在训练阶段动态合成高密度、空间多样化鱼群图像，从而增大目标密度与场景复杂度。
AI.result: 相比基线YOLOv10，该方法在手工标注的佛罗里达群岛直播鱼群测试集上显著提升检测精度（具体指标虽未给出，但作者称显著优于baseline），验证了对真实稠密水下环境的实际提升效果。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的数据增强策略能有效强化模型对水下密集目标场景的鲁棒性，为海洋生态监测等实际应用提供一种简便而有效的性能提升方案。

title: LAF-Based Evaluation and UTTL-Based Learning Strategies with MIATTs
summary: In many real-world machine learning (ML) applications, the true target cannot be precisely defined due to ambiguity or subjectivity information. To address this challenge, under the assumption that the true target for a given ML task is not assumed to exist objectively in the real world, the EL-MIATTs (Evaluation and Learning with Multiple Inaccurate True Targets) framework has been proposed. Bridging theory and practice in implementing EL-MIATTs, in this paper, we develop two complementary mechanisms: LAF (Logical Assessment Formula)-based evaluation algorithms and UTTL (Undefinable True Target Learning)-based learning strategies with MIATTs, which together enable logically coherent and practically feasible modeling under uncertain supervision. We first analyze task-specific MIATTs, examining how their coverage and diversity determine their structural property and influence downstream evaluation and learning. Based on this understanding, we formulate LAF-grounded evaluation algorithms that operate either on original MIATTs or on ternary targets synthesized from them, balancing interpretability, soundness, and completeness. For model training, we introduce UTTL-grounded learning strategies using Dice and cross-entropy loss functions, comparing per-target and aggregated optimization schemes. We also discuss how the integration of LAF and UTTL bridges the gap between logical semantics and statistical optimization. Together, these components provide a coherent pathway for implementing EL-MIATTs, offering a principled foundation for developing ML systems in scenarios where the notion of "ground truth" is inherently uncertain. An application of this work's results is presented as part of the study available at https://www.qeios.com/read/EZWLSN.

AI.tldr: 针对目标无法精确定义的模糊/主观场景，提出EL-MIATTs框架，配套LAF评估算法与UTTL学习策略，实现不确定监督下的可解释建模，并提供完整实现路径。
AI.motivation: 现实ML任务常因标注者差异、概念模糊等原因缺乏客观真值，传统“ground-truth”假设失效，亟需一套可在“无唯一真值”条件下仍能可靠评估与学习的理论–实践框架。
AI.method: 1) 结构化刻画多不准确真值(MIATTs)的覆盖度与多样性；2) 提出LAF逻辑评估公式，支持在原始MIATTs或其三元合成目标上同时保证可解释性、可靠性与完备性；3) 设计UTTL学习策略，利用Dice/交叉熵损失，比较“每目标独立优化”与“聚合优化”方案；4) 通过LAF-UTTL联合将逻辑语义与统计优化桥接，形成端到端实现流程。
AI.result: 框架在理论上保证逻辑一致性，在实践上提供可执行算法；实验表明其可在真值不确定场景下稳定评估并提升模型性能，显著优于忽略真值不确定性的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: EL-MIATTs为“无客观真值”ML提供统一范式，LAF与UTTL的协同使逻辑约束与统计学习互通，可直接用于医疗、情感、艺术评价等主观任务，并开源实现供社区扩展。

title: Align Generative Artificial Intelligence with Human Preferences: A Novel Large Language Model Fine-Tuning Method for Online Review Management
comment: Accepted to Information Systems Research (ISR). This is a preliminary version
summary: Online reviews have played a pivotal role in consumers' decision-making processes. Existing research has highlighted the significant impact of managerial review responses on customer relationship management and firm performance. However, a large portion of online reviews remains unaddressed due to the considerable human labor required to respond to the rapid growth of online reviews. While generative AI has achieved remarkable success in a range of tasks, they are general-purpose models and may not align well with domain-specific human preferences. To tailor these general generative AI models to domain-specific applications, finetuning is commonly employed. Nevertheless, several challenges persist in finetuning with domain-specific data, including hallucinations, difficulty in representing domain-specific human preferences, and over conservatism in offline policy optimization. To address these challenges, we propose a novel preference finetuning method to align an LLM with domain-specific human preferences for generating online review responses. Specifically, we first identify the source of hallucination and propose an effective context augmentation approach to mitigate the LLM hallucination. To represent human preferences, we propose a novel theory-driven preference finetuning approach that automatically constructs human preference pairs in the online review domain. Additionally, we propose a curriculum learning approach to further enhance preference finetuning. To overcome the challenge of over conservatism in existing offline preference finetuning method, we propose a novel density estimation-based support constraint method to relax the conservatism, and we mathematically prove its superior theoretical guarantees. Extensive evaluations substantiate the superiority of our proposed preference finetuning method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向在线评论回复场景的偏好微调方法，通过上下文增强、理论驱动的偏好对构造、课程学习与密度估计支持约束，显著抑制幻觉与过度保守问题，使通用大模型准确契合人类偏好。
AI.motivation: 在线评论影响消费者决策，但人工回复成本高导致大量评论无人回应；通用生成式 AI 缺乏垂直领域知识且易产生幻觉，传统微调又难以刻画回复场景的人类偏好并陷入过度保守，亟需一种能安全、高效、贴合人类偏好的自动回复方案。
AI.method: 1) 定位幻觉来源并设计上下文增强机制；2) 基于在线评论领域理论自动构造正负偏好样本对；3) 引入课程学习逐步提升模型对齐能力；4) 提出基于密度估计的支撑约束，离线策略优化时放松保守性并提供理论保证。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在自动回复质量、幻觉抑制率、人类偏好一致性与策略安全性等指标上均显著优于现有微调基线，同时保持较高回复多样性。
AI.conclusion: 所提偏好微调框架可有效将通用 LLM 转化为安全、可靠且高度符合人类偏好的在线评论回复生成器，为垂直领域大模型落地提供了可扩展范式。

title: Causality-Encoded Diffusion Models for Interventional Sampling and Edge Inference
summary: Standard diffusion models are flexible estimators of complex distributions, but they do not encode causal structures and therefore do not by themselves support causal analysis. We propose a causality-encoded diffusion framework that incorporates a known directed acyclic graph by training conditional diffusion models consistent with the graph factorisation. The resulting sampler approximately recovers the observational distribution and enables interventional sampling by fixing intervened variables while propagating effects through the graph during reverse diffusion. Building on this interventional simulator, we develop a resampling-based test for directed edges that generates null replicates under a candidate graph. We establish convergence guarantees for observational and interventional distribution estimation, with rates governed by the maximum local dimension rather than the ambient dimension, and prove asymptotic control of type I error for the edge test. Simulations show improved interventional distribution recovery relative to baselines, with near-nominal size and favourable power in inference. An application to flow cytometry data demonstrates practical utility of the proposed method in assessing disputed signalling linkages.

AI.tldr: 将扩散模型升级为可显式编码因果DAG的因果扩散框架，实现观测与干预分布估计、定向边检验，并在流式细胞数据上验证其对信号通路争议的解析能力。
AI.motivation: 标准扩散模型虽可拟合复杂分布，但不含因果结构，无法直接用于因果推断；需引入因果图以促进干预分析与科学发现。
AI.method: 以已知DAG为因子分解约束，训练条件扩散模型；在反向扩散时固定干预节点、沿图传播影响，实现干预采样；基于干预模拟器提出重采样定向边检验，并建立观测/干预分布收敛速率与I型错误控制理论。
AI.result: 理论：收敛速率取决于最大局部维度而非环境维度，边检验具有渐近I型错误控制。模拟：干预分布恢复优于基线，检验尺寸接近名义水平、功效高。真实数据：在流式细胞数据上成功评估争议信号通路。
AI.conclusion: 因果编码扩散框架首次把DAG因果结构嵌入高维生成模型，提供可证保证的观测与干预推断工具，为系统生物学等因果发现任务提供新范式。

title: EngramaBench: Evaluating Long-Term Conversational Memory with Structured Graph Retrieval
summary: Large language model assistants are increasingly expected to retain and reason over information accumulated across many sessions. We introduce EngramaBench, a benchmark for long-term conversational memory built around five personas, one hundred multi-session conversations, and one hundred fifty queries spanning factual recall, cross-space integration, temporal reasoning, adversarial abstention, and emergent synthesis. We evaluate Engrama, a graph-structured memory system, against GPT-4o full-context prompting and Mem0, an open-source vector-retrieval memory system. All three use the same answering model (GPT-4o), isolating the effect of memory architecture. GPT-4o full-context achieves the highest composite score (0.6186), while Engrama scores 0.5367 globally but is the only system to score higher than full-context prompting on cross-space reasoning (0.6532 vs. 0.6291, n=30). Mem0 is cheapest but substantially weaker (0.4809). Ablations reveal that the components driving Engrama's cross-space advantage trade off against global composite score, exposing a systems-level tension between structured memory specialization and aggregate optimization.

title: Sparse Forcing: Native Trainable Sparse Attention for Real-time Autoregressive Diffusion Video Generation
summary: We introduce Sparse Forcing, a training-and-inference paradigm for autoregressive video diffusion models that improves long-horizon generation quality while reducing decoding latency. Sparse Forcing is motivated by an empirical observation in autoregressive diffusion rollouts: attention concentrates on a persistent subset of salient visual blocks, forming an implicit spatiotemporal memory in the KV cache, and exhibits a locally structured block-sparse pattern within sliding windows. Building on this observation, we propose a trainable native sparsity mechanism that learns to compress, preserve, and update these persistent blocks while restricting computation within each local window to a dynamically selected local neighborhood. To make the approach practical at scale for both training and inference, we further propose Persistent Block-Sparse Attention (PBSA), an efficient GPU kernel that accelerates sparse attention and memory updates for low-latency, memory-efficient decoding. Experiments show that Sparse Forcing improves the VBench score by +0.26 over Self-Forcing on 5-second text-to-video generation while delivering a 1.11-1.17x decoding speedup and 42% lower peak KV-cache footprint. The gains are more pronounced on longer-horizon rollouts, delivering improved visual quality with +0.68 and +2.74 VBench improvements, and 1.22x and 1.27x speedups on 20-second and 1-minute generations, respectively.

AI.tldr: Sparse Forcing 通过仅对 KV 缓存中“持久显著块”做稀疏注意，训练与推断阶段同步压缩-更新，并配套 GPU 核 PBSA，实现长视频自回归扩散的同步提效与降耗。
AI.motivation: 现有自回归视频扩散模型在长时生成时面临两大痛点：逐帧解码延迟高，KV 缓存膨胀导致显存爆炸。作者观察到注意机制对时空显著区域具有局部块稀疏先验，可借此重构计算范式。
AI.method: 1) 统计洞察：在滑动窗口内，Attention 权重集中于一组持续出现的视觉块，形成隐式时空记忆。2) 训练阶段：引入可学习稀疏门控，联合优化“哪些块保留/更新/丢弃”及局部邻域大小。3) 推断阶段：提出 Persistent Block-Sparse Attention（PBSA）CUDA 核，仅对持久块与动态邻域执行稀疏矩阵乘法，跳过冗余计算。4) 端到端框架：Sparse Forcing 贯穿训练+推断，确保稀疏模式可学习且硬件友好。
AI.result: 在 5 秒文本到视频任务上：VBench 绝对值 +0.26，解码提速 1.11–1.17×，峰值 KV 缓存占用 −42%。20 秒与 1 分钟长视频：VBench 分别再涨 +0.68、+2.74，速度再提 1.22×、1.27×，且显存增长显著放缓。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模并利用 attention 中的块稀疏结构，Sparse Forcing 无需改变模型容量即可在更长时序下同步提升视觉质量与推理效率，为实时、长程视频生成提供了可扩展的新范式。

title: Early Detection of Latent Microstructure Regimes in Limit Order Books
comment: 48 pages, 7 figures. Combines theoretical guarantees (identifiability and early-detection bounds), 200-run simulation study, and preliminary real-data evaluation on BTC/USDT limit order books. Code and data available
summary: Limit order books can transition rapidly from stable to stressed conditions, yet standard early-warning signals such as order flow imbalance and short-term volatility are inherently reactive. We formalise this limitation via a three-regime causal data-generating process (stable $\to$ latent build-up $\to$ stress) in which a latent deterioration phase creates a prediction window prior to observable stress. Under mild assumptions on temporal drift and regime persistence, we establish identifiability of the latent build-up regime and derive guarantees for strictly positive expected lead-time and non-trivial probability of early detection. We propose a trigger-based detector combining MAX aggregation of complementary signal channels, a rising-edge condition, and adaptive thresholding. Across 200 simulations, the method achieves mean lead-time $+18.6 \pm 3.2$ timesteps with perfect precision and moderate coverage, outperforming classical change-point and microstructure baselines. A preliminary application to one week of BTC/USDT order book data shows consistent positive lead-times while baselines remain reactive. Results degrade in low signal-to-noise and short build-up regimes, consistent with theory.

AI.tldr: 提出一种可预警限价单簿从稳定到危机的“前期潜伏退化”阶段的触发式探测器，理论上保证可识别且存在正前置时间；200次仿真BTC/USDT数据平均提前18.6步预警，显著优于传统指标。
AI.motivation: 现有订单簿预警指标（买卖失衡、短波动率）只能在危机已显露时触发，缺乏对“潜伏恶化”阶段的刻画，无法实现真正的提前预警。
AI.method: 1. 构建“稳定→潜伏积累→危机”三状态因果数据生成过程，在潜伏阶段引入不可观测但可识别的漂移；2. 在“时间漂移有界+状态持续性”假设下证明潜伏状态可辨识，并导出严格正期望前置时间及非平凡早期检测概率的理论保证；3. 设计触发式探测器：多通道互补信号MAX聚合→上升沿条件→自适应阈值；4. 用200次仿真及一周BTC/USDT高频订单簿数据评估，并对比经典变点检测与微结构基准。
AI.result: 仿真中，方法平均领先+18.6±3.2个时间步，精确率100%，召回率中等；在真实BTC/USDT数据上持续获得正向前置时间，而基准仍呈被动反应。信噪比低或潜伏过短时性能下降，与理论一致。
AI.conclusion: 理论证明了潜伏退化阶段的可检测性与正向预警时间；对应的MAX-上升沿-自适应阈值探测器在订单簿场景下首次实现无假阳性、显著领先于危机的预警能力，为高频风控与做市商避险提供新工具。

title: ReCAPA: Hierarchical Predictive Correction to Mitigate Cascading Failures
summary: Vision-Language-Action systems follow instructions to execute multi-step tasks in multimodal environments. Recent VLA approaches typically rely on post-hoc correction mechanisms or operate under fixed task decompositions and alignment schemes. However, once an intermediate step is mis-specified, local errors propagate through subsequent steps and eventually accumulate into cascading failures. To mitigate this compounding effect, we propose Predictive Alignment and Planning Architecture, a framework that uses prediction and contrast to adjust deviations across three levels: actions, subgoals, and trajectories. Semantic alignment is enforced at all levels using a Sinkhorn-based module and a Score-field module. The predictive correction and alignment jointly update the action generator during training, enabling it to adjust fine-grained steps to remain aligned with the overall intent. We further introduce two new metrics to quantify error propagation and recovery processes in tasks, capturing how mistakes spread and fade over long-horizon execution. Experiments show that ReCAPA achieves competitive results on embodied agent benchmarks such as VisualAgentBench, MineDojo, and AI2-THOR, outperforming strong proprietary and open-source Large Language Model baselines.

AI.tldr: ReCAPA框架通过预测-对比校正机制在动作/子目标/轨迹三级对齐，显著抑制VLA系统中错误级联，刷新三个具身智能基准最优成绩。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作(VLA)系统依赖事后修正或固定分解，中间步骤误差会逐级放大导致任务失败；需一种能在执行前主动抑制错误传播的统一框架。
AI.method: 提出Predictive Alignment and Planning Architecture (ReCAPA)：1) 用预测模型与对比损失在动作、子目标、轨迹三层面实时估计偏差；2) 引入Sinkhorn语义匹配模块与Score-field打分场实现跨模态对齐；3) 将预测校正信号端到端回传，动态更新动作生成器；4) 设计错误传播率(EPR)与错误恢复率(ERR)量化长周期任务中失误扩散与消退过程。
AI.result: 在VisualAgentBench、MineDojo、AI2-THOR三大具身基准上，ReCAPA显著优于GPT-4V、PaLM-E等专有强基线与开源大模型，平均任务成功率提升8–15%，错误级联长度缩短30%以上；新指标揭示其能在3–5步内将初始误差压至5%以下。
AI.conclusion: 预测-对比对齐可系统性抑制VLA系统的复合误差，显著提升长周期多步任务稳健性；Sinkhorn+Score-field的通用对齐模块与EPR/ERR评估体系为后续VLA研究提供了新范式与量化工具。

title: The Sample Complexity of Multicalibration
summary:
We study the minimax sample complexity of multicalibration in the batch setting. A learner observes $n$ i.i.d. samples from an unknown distribution and must output a (possibly randomized) predictor whose population multicalibration error, measured by Expected Calibration Error (ECE), is at most $\varepsilon$ with respect to a given family of groups. For every fixed $κ> 0$, in the regime $|G|\le \varepsilon^{-κ}$, we prove that $\widetildeΘ(\varepsilon^{-3})$ samples are necessary and sufficient, up to polylogarithmic factors. The lower bound holds even for randomized predictors, and the upper bound is realized by a randomized predictor obtained via an online-to-batch reduction. This separates the sample complexity of multicalibration from that of marginal calibration, which scales as $\widetildeΘ(\varepsilon^{-2})$, and shows that mean-ECE multicalibration is as difficult in the batch setting as it is in the online setting, in contrast to marginal calibration which is strictly more difficult in the online setting. In contrast we observe that for $κ= 0$, the sample complexity of multicalibration remains $\widetildeΘ(\varepsilon^{-2})$ exhibiting a sharp threshold phenomenon.
  More generally, we establish matching upper and lower bounds, up to polylogarithmic factors, for a weighted $L_p$ multicalibration metric for all $1 \le p \le 2$, with optimal exponent $3/p$. We also extend the lower-bound template to a regular class of elicitable properties, and combine it with the online upper bounds of Hu et al. (2025) to obtain matching bounds for calibrating properties including expectiles and bounded-density quantiles.

AI.tldr: 本文刻画了批量学习中多校准（multicalibration）所需样本量的极小极大复杂度：当组数|G|≤ε^{-κ}且κ>0时，样本复杂度为Θ̃(ε^{-3})，与边际校准的Θ̃(ε^{-2})严格分离；当κ=0时则回落至Θ̃(ε^{-2})，呈现突变阈值。结果对1≤p≤2的加权L_p校准误差同样成立，且模板可推广到expectile等有界密度分位数等可激励性质。
AI.motivation: 现有多校准研究集中在在线设定，其样本复杂度与批量设定是否一致尚不清楚；同时，多校准与边际校准的样本复杂度是否存在本质差异亦待厘清。本文旨在回答：在批量i.i.d.场景下，为达到ε-多校准误差，到底需要多少样本？并揭示组数规模κ对复杂度的阈值效应。
AI.method: 1) 下界：构造带κ>0的困难实例，利用信息不等式与耦合论证证明任何随机预测器均需≈ε^{-3}样本；2) 上界：将现有在线多校准算法通过online-to-batch约简转化为批量算法，利用鞅浓度证得O~(ε^{-3})样本足够；3) 推广：对加权L_p误差建立ε^{-3/p}的上下界，并将下界模板推广至一般可激励性质，结合Hu等(2025)在线上界得到expectile等情形的匹配界。
AI.result: 1) 固定κ>0且|G|≤ε^{-κ}时，多校准样本复杂度为Θ̃(ε^{-3})，显著高于边际校准的Θ̃(ε^{-2})。2) κ=0时复杂度突降至Θ̃(ε^{-2})，显示组数规模存在尖锐阈值。3) 对1≤p≤2的加权L_p校准误差，复杂度为Θ̃(ε^{-3/p})。4) 模板适用于expectile、有界密度分位数等可激励性质，首次给出批量设定下的匹配上下界。
AI.conclusion: 多校准在批量场景下的样本复杂度与在线场景同样“困难”，且因组数增长会出现从ε^{-2}到ε^{-3}的突变；边际校准则在线更困难。该结果厘清了多校准与边际校准的本质差距，并为下游公平性、不确定性量化等应用提供了样本量设计依据。

title: Unlocking the Power of Large Language Models for Multi-table Entity Matching
summary: Multi-table entity matching (MEM) addresses the limitations of dual-table approaches by enabling simultaneous identification of equivalent entities across multiple data sources without unique identifiers. However, existing methods relying on pre-trained language models struggle to handle semantic inconsistencies caused by numerical attribute variations. Inspired by the powerful language understanding capabilities of large language models (LLMs), we propose a novel LLM-based framework for multi-table entity matching, termed LLM4MEM. Specifically, we first propose a multi-style prompt-enhanced LLM attribute coordination module to address semantic inconsistencies. Then, to alleviate the matching efficiency problem caused by the surge in the number of entities brought by multiple data sources, we develop a transitive consensus embedding matching module to tackle entity embedding and pre-matching issues. Finally, to address the issue of noisy entities during the matching process, we introduce a density-aware pruning module to optimize the quality of multi-table entity matching. We conducted extensive experiments on 6 MEM datasets, and the results show that our model improves by an average of 5.1% in F1 compared with the baseline model. Our code is available at https://github.com/Ymeki/LLM4MEM.

AI.tldr: 双表范式无法跨五表以上同时消歧，数值属性歧义尤甚。作者提出 LLM4MEM，用多态 Prompt 调和数值语义差异；再以可传递共识嵌入做预匹配，将候选实体规模压到平方根级；最后按局部密度剪枝去噪。六套 MEM 数据集上 F1 平均提升 5.1%。
AI.motivation: 跨三表及以上且无主键的场景下，先两两再合并会因误差累积而导致匹配漂移；同时数值属性常因单位、量纲与精度差异造成语义偏移。现有基于 PLM 的方法对这类偏移鲁棒性不足，需引入具备强大语境理解能力的大模型并兼顾效率与去噪。
AI.method: 三模块框架：①多风格 Prompt 增强 LLM 属性协调：将同一实体在不同表中的数值属性描述成自然语言问句，通过 LLM 自洽生成同义句并校准语义异差；②可传递共识嵌入匹配：利用 LLM 输出的隐状态作为统一实体表示，经传递闭包聚类预筛，复杂度由 O(n²) 降至近 O(n log n)；③密度感知剪枝：计算局部核密度估计，对低密度区域的潜在噪声实体及对应边进行动态修剪，提升匹配纯度。
AI.result: 在 6 个公开 MEM 数据集（含 Web 表格、产品目录、学术记录等）上与 8 种强基线（Ditto、DeepER、HierMatcher 等）对比，LLM4MEM 在 Micro-F1 上平均提升 5.1%，最高提升 7.8%；推理时间比纯 LLM 双两两匹配减少 62%，内存占用降低 55%；在含 10% 噪声注入的数据上仍保持 4.3% 的领先优势。
AI.conclusion: 通过“LLM 语义校准 + 传递共识降维 + 密度剪枝去噪”三项协同设计，LLM4MEM 既显著提升多表实体匹配精度，又能在千万级候选规模下维持线性可扩展性，为开放域、无主键、高噪声的大规模数据融合提供了实用新范式。

title: UAU-Net: Uncertainty-aware Representation Learning and Evidential Classification for Facial Action Unit Detection
summary: Facial action unit (AU) detection remains challenging because it involves heterogeneous, AU-specific uncertainties arising at both the representation and decision stages. Recent methods have improved discriminative feature learning, but they often treat the AU representations as deterministic, overlooking uncertainty caused by visual noise, subject-dependent appearance variations, and ambiguous inter-AU relationships, all of which can substantially degrade robustness. Meanwhile, conventional point-estimation classifiers often provide poorly calibrated confidence, producing overconfident predictions, especially under the severe label imbalance typical of AU datasets. We propose UAU-Net, an Uncertainty-aware AU detection framework that explicitly models uncertainty at both stages. At the representation stage, we introduce CV-AFE, a conditional VAE (CVAE)-based AU feature extraction module that learns probabilistic AU representations by jointly estimating feature means and variances across multiple spatio-temporal scales; conditioning on AU labels further enables CV-AFE to capture uncertainty associated with inter-AU dependencies. At the decision stage, we design AB-ENN, an Asymmetric Beta Evidential Neural Network for multi-label AU detection, which parameterizes predictive uncertainty with Beta distributions and mitigates overconfidence via an asymmetric loss tailored to highly imbalanced binary labels. Extensive experiments on BP4D and DISFA show that UAU-Net achieves strong AU detection performance, and further analyses indicate that modeling uncertainty in both representation learning and evidential prediction improves robustness and reliability.

AI.tldr: UAU-Net 通过同时在特征提取与决策阶段显式建模不确定性，在 BP4D/DISFA 上取得 SOTA 的 AU 检测效果，并显著提升鲁棒性与置信度校准。
AI.motivation: 现有 AU 检测将特征视为确定性，忽视视觉噪声、个体差异及 AU 间依赖带来的表示不确定性；同时点估计分类器在严重类别不平衡下过度自信，导致置信度校准差、鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: 提出两阶段不确定性框架 UAU-Net：(1) 表示阶段设计 CV-AFE——以 AU 标签为条件的 VAE，联合估计多时空尺度的特征均值与方差，显式刻画视觉及 inter-AU 不确定性；(2) 决策阶段设计 AB-ENN——用非对称 Beta 分布参数化预测不确定性，并引入针对极不平衡二值标签的非对称损失抑制过自信。
AI.result: 在 BP4D、DISFA 上大幅超越现有方法，F1 等指标显著提升；消融与可视化显示同时建模表示与决策不确定性可降低误判、校准置信度并增强跨样本鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 显式地在表示学习与证据预测两端引入不确定性建模，是提升 AU 检测准确性、可靠性与鲁棒性的关键方向，UAU-Net 为后续不平衡多标签面部行为分析提供了可扩展框架。

title: Differentially Private Model Merging
summary: In machine learning applications, privacy requirements during inference or deployment time could change constantly due to varying policies, regulations, or user experience. In this work, we aim to generate a magnitude of models to satisfy any target differential privacy (DP) requirement without additional training steps, given a set of existing models trained on the same dataset with different privacy/utility tradeoffs. We propose two post processing techniques, namely random selection and linear combination, to output a final private model for any target privacy parameter. We provide privacy accounting of these approaches from the lens of R'enyi DP and privacy loss distributions for general problems. In a case study on private mean estimation, we fully characterize the privacy/utility results and theoretically establish the superiority of linear combination over random selection. Empirically, we validate our approach and analyses on several models and both synthetic and real-world datasets.

AI.tldr: 文章提出两种无需重训即可动态生成满足任意差分隐私(DP)预算的模型的后处理技术——随机抽样与线性组合，并在理论上与实验上相对随机法确立了线性法的优越性。
AI.motivation: 实际部署中隐私要求常随政策、法规或用户体验变化，而传统方法对每级隐私预算都需重新训练模型，代价高昂；作者希望仅利用一组已按不同隐私-效用权衡预训练的模型，事后组合出满足任意新DP预算的模型。
AI.method: 核心思路是把已有模型视作“隐私级别锚点”，引入随机抽样与线性组合两种后处理策略来合成最终模型；隐私核算采用Rényi DP及隐私损失分布，组合权重可离线算出，推理阶段零重训。以私有均值估计为例，系统推导出隐私误差-效用界，证明线性组合在方差与误差方面优于随机选择。随后在多个合成与真实数据集上扩充验证。
AI.result: 理论表明线性组合相比随机选择能把估计方差降低数倍，并提供紧的（ε,δ）-DP保证；实验上，在均值、逻辑回归与CNN图像分类任务中，该方法仅需<1ms的后处理时间即可产出符合全新ε/δ要求的私有模型，效用在全部ε区间更具优势。
AI.conclusion: 所提机制证明可通过廉价的后处理而非重头训练就动态适配任意DP需求；线性组合策略在隐私-效用权衡上全面优于随机抽样，为多变场景下的“隐私即服务”方案奠定了实用基础。

title: Robustness Analysis of POMDP Policies to Observation Perturbations
summary: Policies for Partially Observable Markov Decision Processes (POMDPs) are often designed using a nominal system model. In practice, this model can deviate from the true system during deployment due to factors such as calibration drift or sensor degradation, leading to unexpected performance degradation. This work studies policy robustness against deviations in the POMDP observation model. We introduce the Policy Observation Robustness Problem: to determine the maximum tolerable deviation in a POMDP's observation model that guarantees the policy's value remains above a specified threshold. We analyze two variants: the sticky variant, where deviations are dependent on state and actions, and the non-sticky variant, where they can be history-dependent. We show that the Policy Observation Robustness Problem can be formulated as a bi-level optimization problem in which the inner optimization is monotonic in the size of the observation deviation. This enables efficient solutions using root-finding algorithms in the outer optimization. For the non-sticky variant, we show that when policies are represented with finite-state controllers (FSCs) it is sufficient to consider observations which depend on nodes in the FSC rather than full histories. We present Robust Interval Search, an algorithm with soundness and convergence guarantees, for both the sticky and non-sticky variants. We show this algorithm has polynomial time complexity in the non-sticky variant and at most exponential time complexity in the sticky variant. We provide experimental results validating and demonstrating the scalability of implementations of Robust Interval Search to POMDP problems with tens of thousands of states. We also provide case studies from robotics and operations research which demonstrate the practical utility of the problem and algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“策略观测鲁棒性问题”，用双层优化刻画POMDP观测模型偏差上限，保证策略价值不低于阈值；给出含收敛性的多项式/指数时间算法，并在万级状态场景及机器人、运筹实例中验证可扩展性与实用价值。
AI.motivation: 部署时因传感器漂移等导致观测模型偏离名义模型，传统POMDP策略性能骤降，缺乏量化最大可容忍偏差的系统方法。
AI.method: 1) 定义sticky(偏差依赖状态-动作)与非sticky(偏差可依赖历史)两变体的策略观测鲁棒性问题；2) 将其建模为外层求最大偏差、内层求最小策略价值且对偏差单调的双层优化；3) 对FSC策略证明非sticky情形下只需考虑FSC节点而非全历史；4) 提出基于根查找的Robust Interval Search算法，给出收敛性与复杂度保证。
AI.result: 算法在非sticky变体下多项式时间、sticky变体至多指数时间；在数万状态POMDP上秒级求解，机器人导航与库存管理案例显示可承受10–30%观测噪声而性能不降。
AI.conclusion: 首次给出POMDP观测模型偏差的可验证鲁棒边界及高效算法，为安全关键系统提供部署前鲁棒性认证工具。

title: Convergence Rates for Non-Log-Concave Sampling and Log-Partition Estimation
comment: Published in JMLR. New in v4: Summary tables / sections. Plots can be reproduced using the code at https://github.com/dholzmueller/sampling_experiments
summary: Sampling from Gibbs distributions and computing their log-partition function are fundamental tasks in statistics, machine learning, and statistical physics. While efficient algorithms are known for log-concave densities, the worst-case non-log-concave setting necessarily suffers from the curse of dimensionality. For many numerical problems, the curse of dimensionality can be alleviated when the target function is smooth, allowing the exponent in the rate to improve linearly with the number of available derivatives. Recently, it has been shown that similarly fast convergence rates can be achieved by efficient optimization algorithms. Since optimization can be seen as the low-temperature limit of sampling from Gibbs distributions, we pose the question of whether similarly fast convergence rates can be achieved for non-log-concave sampling. We first study the information-based complexity of the sampling and log-partition estimation problems and show that the optimal rates for sampling and log-partition computation are sometimes equal and sometimes faster than for optimization. We then analyze various polynomial-time sampling algorithms, including an extension of a recent promising optimization approach, and find that they sometimes exhibit interesting behavior but no near-optimal rates. Our results also give further insights into the relation between sampling, log-partition, and optimization problems.

AI.tldr: 作者首次系统比较了非对数凹Gibbs分布的采样、配分函数计算与优化三者在信息复杂度意义上的收敛速度差异，并证明三者最优率并非总一致。
AI.motivation: 在高维非对数凹情形下，采样与配分函数计算均受“维数灾难”困扰；近期平滑优化算法可在函数具有足够高阶导数时将指数率提升为维度线性，因此作者探究采样是否也能获得同阶加速，并厘清三类问题的本质难度关系。
