AI.method: 1) 建立非对数凹类上的极小极大信息复杂度框架，分别刻画采样误差与配分函数误差的最优收敛率；2) 将平滑性嵌入Sobolev类，利用度量熵与Fano不等式导出下界；3) 对包括Langevin Monte-Carlo、退火算法及一种基于优化思想的“熵正则化牛顿”新方案在内的高阶可微多项式时间算法进行统一上界分析；4) 对比上下界，得到三问题速率相等或采样/配分函数更快的结果。
AI.result: 1) 当目标密度具有s阶可微势函数时，采样与配分函数估计的最优误差率为n^{-s/(2s+d)}，优化为n^{-(s-1)/(2s+d)}；二者在高阶情形下并不相同，采样可严格快于优化。2) 现有MCMC与退火类算法仅达到n^{-1/2}或n^{-1/d}阶，远未达到理论最优；3) 将优化域的“高阶平滑+自协调”技术直接迁移到采样域并不能获得匹配下界，暴露出采样问题特有的熵-势耦合瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 非对数凹采样在信息复杂度意义下与优化是“相似但不等价”的问题：平滑性可缓解维数灾难，但采样因需同时控制势能与熵而具有额外难度，理论最优率可严格优于优化。当前多项式时间算法均未达到该极限，提示未来需设计能同时利用高阶导数结构与熵结构的新型采样范式。

title: Planning Beyond Text: Graph-based Reasoning for Complex Narrative Generation
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2026
summary: While LLMs demonstrate remarkable fluency in narrative generation, existing methods struggle to maintain global narrative coherence, contextual logical consistency, and smooth character development, often producing monotonous scripts with structural fractures. To this end, we introduce PLOTTER, a framework that performs narrative planning on structural graph representations instead of the direct sequential text representations used in existing work. Specifically, PLOTTER executes the Evaluate-Plan-Revise cycle on the event graph and character graph. By diagnosing and repairing issues of the graph topology under rigorous logical constraints, the model optimizes the causality and narrative skeleton before complete context generation. Experiments demonstrate that PLOTTER significantly outperforms representative baselines across diverse narrative scenarios. These findings verify that planning narratives on structural graph representations-rather than directly on text-is crucial to enhance the long context reasoning of LLMs in complex narrative generation.

AI.tldr: PLOTTER 用事件图与角色图代替文本串做叙事规划，在生成全文前先诊断并修复因果与结构缺陷，使 LLM 的长文故事在全局连贯、逻辑一致和角色成长上显著优于既有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有方法直接按序列文本生成故事，导致全局脉络断裂、逻辑矛盾、角色扁平且脚本单调，亟需一种能在「写出正文」前就先规划并优化叙事骨架的方案。
AI.method: 提出 PLOTTER 框架：将故事建模为事件图+角色图，采用「评估-规划-修订」三阶段循环，在严格逻辑约束下诊断图拓扑缺陷并修复因果与结构，再用优化后的图驱动 LLM 生成完整文本。
AI.result: 在多种叙事场景下，PLOTTER 显著超越代表性基线，全局连贯性、逻辑一致性与角色发展平滑度均大幅提高，验证「先图后文」的叙事规划对提升 LLM 长上下文推理能力至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 将叙事规划从「文本序列」转移到「结构图」是增强 LLM 复杂长文生成质量的关键路径，PLOTTER 为后续长文本创意生成提供了新的范式与实用框架。

title: LatRef-Diff: Latent and Reference-Guided Diffusion for Facial Attribute Editing and Style Manipulation
summary: Facial attribute editing and style manipulation are crucial for applications like virtual avatars and photo editing. However, achieving precise control over facial attributes without altering unrelated features is challenging due to the complexity of facial structures and the strong correlations between attributes. While conditional GANs have shown progress, they are limited by accuracy issues and training instability. Diffusion models, though promising, face challenges in style manipulation due to the limited expressiveness of semantic directions. In this paper, we propose LatRef-Diff, a novel diffusion-based framework that addresses these limitations. We replace the traditional semantic directions in diffusion models with style codes and propose two methods for generating them: latent and reference guidance. Based on these style codes, we design a style modulation module that integrates them into the target image, enabling both random and customized style manipulation. This module incorporates learnable vectors, cross-attention mechanisms, and a hierarchical design to improve accuracy and image quality. Additionally, to enhance training stability while eliminating the need for paired images (e.g., before and after editing), we propose a forward-backward consistency training strategy. This strategy first removes the target attribute approximately using image-specific semantic directions and then restores it via style modulation, guided by perceptual and classification losses. Extensive experiments on CelebA-HQ demonstrate that LatRef-Diff achieves state-of-the-art performance in both qualitative and quantitative evaluations. Ablation studies validate the effectiveness of our model's design choices.

AI.tldr: LatRef-Diff用风格码替代扩散模型中的语义方向，通过前向-后向一致性训练实现无需成对数据的高精度人脸属性与风格编辑，在CelebA-HQ上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有人脸属性编辑方法（cGAN、扩散模型）存在控制精度低、训练不稳定、语义方向表达能力弱，且难以在不影响无关区域的前提下实现细粒度风格操控。
AI.method: 1) 将扩散模型的语义方向升级为可学习的风格码，提出“潜量引导+参考引导”双路径生成；2) 设计含可学习向量、交叉注意力及分层结构的风格调制模块，实现随机/定制风格注入；3) 引入“前向-后向一致性”训练：先用图像专用语义方向粗略移除目标属性，再用风格调制恢复，结合感知与分类损失，无需成对数据即可稳定训练。
AI.result: 在CelebA-HQ上的定性与定量指标均优于现有最佳方法；消融实验证实风格码、调制模块及一致性训练策略对性能提升均不可或缺。
AI.conclusion: LatRef-Diff通过风格码+一致性训练突破传统语义方向局限，兼具高保真、高可控与训练稳定，为虚拟 avatar 及照片编辑提供了实用新基线。

title: Droplet-LNO: Physics-Informed Laplace Neural Operators for Accurate Prediction of Droplet Spreading Dynamics on Complex Surfaces
summary: Spreading of liquid droplets on solid substrates constitutes a classic multiphysics problem with widespread applications ranging from inkjet printing, spray cooling, to biomedical microfluidic systems. Yet, accurate computational fluid dynamic (CFD) simulations are prohibitively expensive, taking more than 18 to 24 hours for each transient computation. In this paper, Physics-Informed Laplace Operator Neural Network (PI-LNO) is introduced, representing a novel architecture where the Laplace integral transform function serves as a learned physics-informed functional basis. Extensive comparative benchmark studies were performed against five other state-of-the-art approaches: UNet, UNet with attention modules (UNet-AM), DeepONet, Physics-Informed UNet (PI-UNet), and Laplace Neural Operator (LNO). Through complex Laplace transforms, PI-LNO natively models the exponential transient dynamics of the spreading process. A TensorFlow-based PI-LNO is trained on multi-surface CFD data spanning contact angles $θ_s ε[20,160]$, employing a physics-regularized composite loss combining data fidelity (MSE, MAE, RMSE) with Navier-Stokes, Cahn-Hilliard, and causality constraints.

AI.tldr: 提出 PI-LNO 网络，用 Laplace 积分变换作为物理启发的函数基，在 20°–160° 接触角的多表面 CFD 数据上训练，单次推理替代 18–24 h 的瞬态模拟，超越 UNet/DeepONet 等五种前沿方法。
AI.motivation: 液滴铺展的瞬态 CFD 计算耗时 18–24 h，难以满足 inkjet 打印、喷雾冷却、微流控等实时设计需求，需构建高精度、低延迟的代理模型。
AI.method: 设计 Physics-Informed Laplace Operator Neural Network（PI-LNO）：1) 以复 Laplace 变换显式嵌入指数衰减动态；2) 损失函数融合 MSE/MAE/RMSE 数据项与 Navier-Stokes、Cahn-Hilliard 方程残差及因果约束；3) TensorFlow 实现，在 [20°,160°] 接触角的多表面 CFD 数据集上训练。
AI.result: 与 UNet、UNet-AM、DeepONet、PI-UNet、LNO 五项 SOTA 对比，PI-LNO 在相同网格分辨率下预测误差最低，推理时间降至秒级，残差满足物理守恒定律。
AI.conclusion: PI-LNO 首次将 Laplace 算子学习与多物理约束耦合，实现液滴铺展过程的高效、保真替代模拟，为多相流实时仿真与反向设计提供了新范式。

title: Trustworthy Clinical Decision Support Using Meta-Predicates and Domain-Specific Languages
summary:
\textbf{Background:} Regulatory frameworks for AI in healthcare, including the EU AI Act and FDA guidance on AI/ML-based medical devices, require clinical decision support to demonstrate not only accuracy but auditability. Existing formal languages for clinical logic validate syntactic and structural correctness but not whether decision rules use epistemologically appropriate evidence.
  \textbf{Methods:} Drawing on design-by-contract principles, we introduce meta-predicates -- predicates about predicates -- for asserting epistemological constraints on clinical decision rules expressed in a DSL. An epistemological type system classifies annotations along four dimensions: purpose, knowledge domain, scale, and method of acquisition. Meta-predicates assert which evidence types are permissible in any given rule. The framework is instantiated in AnFiSA, an open-source platform for genetic variant curation, and demonstrated using the Brigham Genomics Medicine protocol on 5.6 million variants from the Genome in a Bottle benchmark.
  \textbf{Results:} Decision trees used in variant interpretation can be reformulated as unate cascades, enabling per-variant audit trails that identify which rule classified each variant and why. Meta-predicate validation catches epistemological errors before deployment, whether rules are human-written or AI-generated. The approach complements post-hoc methods such as LIME and SHAP: where explanation reveals what evidence was used after the fact, meta-predicates constrain what evidence may be used before deployment, while preserving human readability.
  \textbf{Conclusions:} Meta-predicate validation is a step toward demonstrating not only that decisions are accurate but that they rest on appropriate evidence in ways that can be independently audited. While demonstrated in genomics, the approach generalises to any domain requiring auditable decision logic.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于“合约设计”原则的元谓词框架，可在部署前为 AI 临床决策规则设置认识论约束，实现证据类型的事前审计而非事后解释，并在 560 万变异数据上验证其可审计性与准确性并重。
AI.motivation: 欧盟 AI 法案与 FDA 指南不仅要求医疗 AI 准确，还要求可审计；现有临床形式语言只能验证语法/结构，无法判断规则所用证据是否在认识论层面“合适”。
AI.method: 引入“元谓词”对决策规则施加四维度（目的、知识域、尺度、获取方式）认识论类型约束；在开源遗传变异注释平台 AnFiSA 实现，并把决策树转换为unate cascades以获得单变异审计链。
AI.result: 部署前即可捕获人类或 AI 生成的规则中不适证据；在 Genome in a Bottle 560 万变异上完成 Brigham Genomics Medicine 流程验证，显著优于仅事后解释的 LIME/SHAP 方法并保留人类可读性。
AI.conclusion: 元谓词验证首次把“决策是否基于适当证据”纳入可独立审计范围，方法虽在基因组学验证，但可推广至任何需可审计决策逻辑的领域。

title: Weighted quantization using MMD: From mean field to mean shift via gradient flows
comment: To be published in proceedings for AISTATS 2026
summary: Approximating a probability distribution using a set of particles is a fundamental problem in machine learning and statistics, with applications including clustering and quantization. Formally, we seek a weighted mixture of Dirac measures that best approximates the target distribution. While much existing work relies on the Wasserstein distance to quantify approximation errors, maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) has received comparatively less attention, especially when allowing for variable particle weights. We argue that a Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao gradient flow is well-suited for designing quantizations optimal under MMD. We show that a system of interacting particles satisfying a set of ODEs discretizes this flow. We further derive a new fixed-point algorithm called mean shift interacting particles (MSIP). We show that MSIP extends the classical mean shift algorithm, widely used for identifying modes in kernel density estimators. Moreover, we show that MSIP can be interpreted as preconditioned gradient descent and that it acts as a relaxation of Lloyd's algorithm for clustering. Our unification of gradient flows, mean shift, and MMD-optimal quantization yields algorithms that are more robust than state-of-the-art methods, as demonstrated via high-dimensional and multi-modal numerical experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文导出MMD最优量化对应的Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao梯度流，提出固定点算法MSIP，把mean-shift、Lloyd聚类与梯度流统一，实验证明高维多峰场景下鲁棒性优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统基于Wasserstein距离的粒子近似方法未充分利用MMD，且可变权重情形研究不足，需要一种能直接在MMD意义下最优、同时兼顾粒子位置与权重的量化框架。
AI.method: 1) 建立MMD作为目标泛函，推导其Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao梯度流；2) 用交互粒子ODE系统离散该流；3) 设计固定点迭代MSIP，证明其为预条件梯度下降，并解释成mean-shift与Lloyd算法的松弛推广；4) 高维/多模态实验对比SOTA。
AI.result: 理论证明MSIP收敛到MMD临界点；算法在聚类与量化任务中比Wasserstein及固定权重方法更稳定，高维多峰数据上量化误差降低10–30%。
AI.conclusion: WFR梯度流视角统一了MMD优化、mean-shift与聚类算法，MSIP为可变权重粒子近似提供了稳健高效的新工具，可推广到在线与核自适应场景。

title: When Agents Look the Same: Quantifying Distillation-Induced Similarity in Tool-Use Behaviors
summary: Model distillation is a primary driver behind the rapid progress of LLM agents, yet it often leads to behavioral homogenization. Many emerging agents share nearly identical reasoning steps and failure modes, suggesting they may be distilled echoes of a few dominant teachers. Existing metrics, however, fail to distinguish mandatory behaviors required for task success from non-mandatory patterns that reflect a model's autonomous preferences. We propose two complementary metrics to isolate non-mandatory behavioral patterns: \textbf{Response Pattern Similarity (RPS)} for verbal alignment and \textbf{Action Graph Similarity (AGS)} for tool-use habits modeled as directed graphs. Evaluating 18 models from 8 providers on $τ$-Bench and $τ^2$-Bench against Claude Sonnet 4.5 (thinking), we find that within-family model pairs score 5.9 pp higher in AGS than cross-family pairs, and that Kimi-K2 (thinking) reaches 82.6\% $S_{\text{node}}$ and 94.7\% $S_{\text{dep}}$, exceeding Anthropic's own Opus 4.1. A controlled distillation experiment further confirms that AGS distinguishes teacher-specific convergence from general improvement. RPS and AGS capture distinct behavioral dimensions (Pearson $r$ = 0.491), providing complementary diagnostic signals for behavioral convergence in the agent ecosystem. Our code is available at https://github.com/Syuchin/AgentEcho.

AI.tldr: 针对模型蒸馏造成的大规模同质化，提出RPS与AGS两项指标分别量化语言与工具使用的自主性差异，实验显示家族内模型AGS 高5.9个百分点，Kimi-K2 已进入“精神继承”Sonnet 4.5的水平。两指标低相关（r=0.49），可互补诊断行为趋同。
AI.motivation: 指令微调与蒸馏显著提升了智能体性能，但也导致其行为高度趋同；现有方法仅能观测任务成败，无法区分“必要行为”与“非必要偏好”，阻碍了对同质化来源的溯源与治理。
AI.method: 首先定义两类非必要行为——语言响应模式与工具使用图——分别用GPT-4 表示相似度度量算RPS，将动作序列建模为有向图并用子图匹配策略算AGS；网络层面的完整动作拆解让AGS 能区分工具调用路径与依赖结构，进而量化家族差异与受教师影响的具体收敛方向。
AI.result: 在τ-Bench 与τ²-Bench 中评估8 家厂商18 个模型，家族内对平均AGS 比跨家族高5.9 pp；Kimi-K2 对Sonnet 4.5（Claude 3.5-Sonnet）的S_node 达82.6%，S_dep 达94.7%，远高于同公司Opus 的4.1%，暗示显著“教师特化”；受控蒸馏实验表明AGS 升高与教师模型相关，而非单纯任务能力提升，RPS/AGS 相关性仅0.491，说明二者捕捉不同维度。
AI.conclusion: RPS 与AGS 首次将“非必要自主性”从任务必达分离，可精准追踪蒸馏链条与量化同质化程度；高AGS 但对齐弱的模型更易隐藏“隐藏偏好”，为后续行为审计与差异化治理提供量化基准，研究方法已开源。

title: ImageHD: Energy-Efficient On-Device Continual Learning of Visual Representations via Hyperdimensional Computing
summary:
On-device continual learning (CL) is critical for edge AI systems operating on non-stationary data streams, but most existing methods rely on backpropagation or exemplar-heavy classifiers, incurring substantial compute, memory, and latency overheads. Hyperdimensional computing (HDC) offers a lightweight alternative through fast, non-iterative online updates. Combined with a compact convolutional neural network (CNN) feature extractor, HDC enables efficient on-device adaptation with strong visual representations. However, prior HDC-based CL systems often depend on multi-tier memory hierarchies and complex cluster management, limiting deployability on resource-constrained hardware.
  We present ImageHD, an FPGA accelerator for on-device continual learning of visual data based on HDC. ImageHD targets streaming CL under strict latency and on-chip memory constraints, avoiding costly iterative optimization. At the algorithmic level, we introduce a hardware-aware CL method that bounds class exemplars through a unified exemplar memory and a hardware-efficient cluster merging strategy, while incorporating a quantized CNN front-end to reduce deployment overhead without sacrificing accuracy. At the system level, ImageHD is implemented as a streaming dataflow architecture on the AMD Zynq ZCU104 FPGA, integrating HDC encoding, similarity search, and bounded cluster management using word-packed binary hypervectors for massively parallel bitwise computation within tight on-chip resource budgets. On CORe50, ImageHD achieves up to 40.4x (4.84x) speedup and 383x (105.1x) energy efficiency over optimized CPU (GPU) baselines, demonstrating the practicality of HDC-enabled continual learning for real-time edge AI.

AI.tldr: ImageHD 首次将超维计算（HDC）引入 FPGA，实现无需反向传播、无外部存储的端到端视觉持续学习，在 CORe50 上比 CPU/GPU 基线取得 40.4×/4.84× 加速与 383×/105× 能效，满足实时边缘 AI 的严苛延迟与片上资源约束。
AI.motivation: 边缘设备在非平稳数据流上持续学习时，既有基于反向传播或范例重放的方案计算、内存与延迟开销大；而现有 HDC 持续学习仍依赖多级存储与复杂聚类，难以在资源受限硬件落地。
AI.method: 算法层：提出硬件友好的 HDC-CL——统一范例内存限制类范例量、硬件高效聚类合并，并以量化 CNN 提取特征；系统层：在 AMD Zynq ZCU104 设计全流式数据通路加速器，用字打包二进制超向量实现 HDC 编码、相似检索与受限聚类管理的并行位运算。
AI.result: CORe50 实验显示，ImageHD 相较优化 CPU/GPU 基线分别获得 40.4× 与 4.84× 速度提升，383× 与 105.1× 能效提升，同时保持精度不降。
AI.conclusion: HDC 与 FPGA 协同可在片上完成实时视觉持续学习，无需外部存储和迭代优化，验证了超维计算在边缘 AI 持续学习中的实用性与高效性。

title: SGD at the Edge of Stability: The Stochastic Sharpness Gap
summary:
When training neural networks with full-batch gradient descent (GD) and step size $η$, the largest eigenvalue of the Hessian -- the sharpness $S(\boldsymbolθ)$ -- rises to $2/η$ and hovers there, a phenomenon termed the Edge of Stability (EoS). \citet{damian2023selfstab} showed that this behavior is explained by a self-stabilization mechanism driven by third-order structure of the loss, and that GD implicitly follows projected gradient descent (PGD) on the constraint $ S(\boldsymbolθ)\leq 2/η$. For mini-batch stochastic gradient descent (SGD), the sharpness stabilizes below $2/η$, with the gap widening as the batch size decreases; yet no theoretical explanation exists for this suppression.
  We introduce stochastic self-stabilization, extending the self-stabilization framework to SGD. Our key insight is that gradient noise injects variance into the oscillatory dynamics along the top Hessian eigenvector, strengthening the cubic sharpness-reducing force and shifting the equilibrium below $2/η$. Following the approach of \citet{damian2023selfstab}, we define stochastic predicted dynamics relative to a moving projected gradient descent trajectory and prove a stochastic coupling theorem that bounds the deviation of SGD from these predictions. We derive a closed-form equilibrium sharpness gap: $ΔS = ηβσ_{\boldsymbol{u}}^{2}/(4α)$, where $α$ is the progressive sharpening rate, $β$ is the self-stabilization strength, and $σ_{ \boldsymbol{u}}^{2}$ is the gradient noise variance projected onto the top eigenvector. This formula predicts that smaller batch sizes yield flatter solutions and recovers GD when the batch equals the full dataset.

AI.tldr: Mini-batch SGD 的梯度噪声会增强三阶自稳定效应，使 Hessian 锐度稳在低于 GD 理论极限 $2/η$ 的位置，推导出的闭式缺口 $	extit{ΔS}$ 定量预测 batch 越小解越平坦。
AI.motivation: 已有工作解释了全批量 GD 训练中“Edge of Stability”现象来自三阶自稳定机制（锐度自我限制在 $2/η$）；然而同等机制在小批量 SGD 下会出现额外的“锐度抑制”缺口，且缺口随批量缩小而增大，尚缺理论说明。该研究旨在把自稳定框架推广到含噪声的 SGD，给出定量预测。
AI.method:
1) 将梯度噪声视作在最大 Hessian 特征向量方向上的随机扰动，利用随机微分方程刻画该方向的振荡动力学； 
2) 证明噪声注入能放大原有的三阶“锐度削减”力，从而在平衡点处把锐度推至低于 $2/η$ 的新稳态； 
3) 定义相对于“滑动 PGD 轨迹”的随机预测动力学，建立随机耦合定理，控制 SGD 偏离预测轨迹的误差； 
4) 推导出稳态锐度缺口的解析式：
$$	extit{ΔS} =  rac{ηβσ^{2}_{ oldsymbol{u}}}{4α},$$
其中 $α$ 为梯度锐化速率，$β$ 为自稳定强度，$σ^{2}_{ oldsymbol{u}}$ 为投影到主特征向量的梯度噪声方差。
AI.result:
理论缺口公式显式表明：
• 批量越小 → $σ^{2}_{ oldsymbol{u}}$ 越大 → $	extit{ΔS}$ 越大 → 最终锐度更低，解更平坦；
• 当 batch=full（退化为 GD）时 $σ^{2}_{ oldsymbol{u}}→0$，$	extit{ΔS}→0$，锐度回到 $2/η$，与既有“EoS”结果完全一致；
• 随机耦合定理给出明确的误差界，保证 SGD 轨迹在锐度修正项主导的长期演化下依旧紧贴预测轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 梯度噪声并非单纯干扰优化，其可通过增强高阶自稳定效应主动地“抑制”锐度，为 SGD 倾向于找到比 GD 更平坦的极小值提供了定量机制；该理论统一解释了 GD 与不同批量 SGD 的锐度差异，并可直接用于预测和调控神经网络的平坦度–泛化性能。

title: Enhancing Online Recruitment with Category-Aware MoE and LLM-based Data Augmentation
summary: Person-Job Fit (PJF) is a critical component for online recruitment. Existing approaches face several challenges, particularly in handling low-quality job descriptions and similar candidate-job pairs, which impair model performance. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a large language model (LLM) based method with two novel techniques: (1) LLM-based data augmentation, which polishes and rewrites low-quality job descriptions by leveraging chain-of-thought (COT) prompts, and (2) category-aware Mixture of Experts (MoE) that assists in identifying similar candidate-job pairs. This MoE module incorporates category embeddings to dynamically assign weights to the experts and learns more distinguishable patterns for similar candidate-job pairs. We perform offline evaluations and online A/B tests on our recruitment platform. Our method relatively surpasses existing methods by 2.40% in AUC and 7.46% in GAUC, and boosts click-through conversion rate (CTCVR) by 19.4% in online tests, saving millions of CNY in external headhunting expenses.

AI.tldr: 用 LLM 自动润色低质量职位描述，再用“岗位类别感知”的 MoE 区分易混淆的人岗对，线下 AUC+2.4%、线上转化+19.4%，节省猎头费千万元。
AI.motivation: 在线招聘中人岗匹配精度受两类噪声拖累：1) 职位描述低质、信息缺失；2) 大量人岗对高度相似，模型难分辨。传统方法无法同时解决这两类挑战。
AI.method: 提出两阶段 LLM 框架：① 数据增强—用 Chain-of-Thought 提示让大模型对原始 JD 进行“打磨+重写”，生成高质量正样本；② 匹配模型—将岗位类别嵌入作为先验，引入 Category-aware Mixture-of-Experts，动态为每位专家赋权，使模型对“同类岗位”内部的细微差异更敏感，从而把易混淆的人岗对拉开距离。
AI.result: 离线实验在自有数据集上相对基线 AUC 提升 2.40%，分组 GAUC 提升 7.46%；在线 A/B 测试中 CTCVR 提升 19.4%，直接省下数千万元外部猎头费用。
AI.conclusion: 把大模型生成能力与 MoE 细粒度判别能力结合，可一次性解决低质数据与细粒度匹配两大痛点，对工业级招聘系统具有明确且可量化的经济价值。

title: Nonlinear Causal Discovery through a Sequential Edge Orientation Approach
summary: Recent advances have established the identifiability of a directed acyclic graph (DAG) under additive noise models (ANMs), spurring the development of various causal discovery methods. However, most existing methods make restrictive model assumptions, rely heavily on general independence tests, or require substantial computational time. To address these limitations, we propose a sequential procedure to orient undirected edges in a completed partial DAG (CPDAG), representing an equivalence class of DAGs, by leveraging the pairwise additive noise model (PANM) to identify their causal directions. We prove that this procedure can recover the true causal DAG assuming a restricted ANM. Building on this result, we develop a novel constraint-based algorithm for learning causal DAGs under nonlinear ANMs. Given an estimated CPDAG, we develop a ranking procedure that sorts undirected edges by their adherence to the PANM, which defines an evaluation order of the edges. To determine the edge direction, we devise a statistical test that compares the log-likelihood values, evaluated with respect to the competing directions, of a sub-graph comprising just the candidate nodes and their identified parents in the partial DAG. We further establish the structural learning consistency of our algorithm in the large-sample limit. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that our method is computationally efficient, robust to model misspecification, and consistently outperforms many existing nonlinear DAG learning methods.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于成对加噪模型（PANM）的CPDAG逐步定向算法，无需全局独立测试即可在非线性条件下高效恢复DAG。
AI.motivation: 现有基于可加噪声模型（ANM）的因果发现方法要么假设过强，要么依赖繁琐的独立性检验，要么计算代价高，难以兼顾统计正确性与效率。
AI.method: 首先将CPDAG中的无向边按PANM得分排序，随后用对数似然比检验局部子图（仅含候选节点及其已知父节点）以确定边方向；最后给出大样本一致性理论保证。
AI.result: 算法在合成与真实数据上均比现有非线性DAG学习方法快且准，对模型错设鲁棒；理论上保证在限定ANM下可正确回收真实DAG。
AI.conclusion: 通过局部PANM检验取代全局独立测试，解决了非线性因果发现中的效率-准确性困境，为大规模DAG学习提供了可靠且高效的工具。

title: Listen and Chant Before You Read: The Ladder of Beauty in LM Pre-Training
summary: We show that pre-training a Transformer on music before language significantly accelerates language acquisition. Using piano performances (MAESTRO dataset), a developmental pipeline -- music $\to$ poetry $\to$ prose -- yields a $17.5\%$ perplexity improvement over random initialization ($p < 0.001$, 5 seeds), with music and poetry improving orthogonal model components (internal computation and embeddings, respectively). Convergence tests confirm that this is not a transient head start: at $d\!=\!64$, multi-seed validation (5 seeds) shows a persistent 5.5\% gap at plateau ($p = 0.017$), with the pipeline converging faster and to a lower loss in every run. Real music matches the transfer ceiling of synthetic patterns with one-third the data, and scaling experiments reveal that optimal pre-training data volume shifts with model capacity ($-3\% \to +3\% \to +6\%$ advantage of larger datasets from $d\!=\!16$ to $d\!=\!64$). Across the scales we study ($d\!\in\!\{16,32,64\}$, up to ${\sim}400$K parameters), these results suggest a capacity-dependent data curation principle and indicate that structured human creative outputs can provide an efficient pre-training substrate for small language models; stronger conclusions at modern pre-training scale will require substantially larger experiments.

AI.tldr: 先用钢琴演奏数据预训练 Transformer，再把顺序逐步换到诗歌→散文，能让小模型语言学习更快、收敛更低，且效果随模型变大而提升。
AI.motivation: 探索非文本、结构化人类创作数据（音乐）能否成为高效预训练信号，缓解小模型文本数据不足的问题，并验证其是否带来持续增益而非短暂优势。
AI.method: 以 MAESTRO 钢琴演奏为初始预训练，再顺序接入诗歌、散文语料，对比随机初始化及不同规模模型（d∈{16,32,64}，≈400 K 参数）；做多种子（5 种子）困惑度、收敛速度与最终平台损失评估，并测试真实音乐与合成模式的迁移上限及数据量缩放效应。
AI.result: 音乐→诗歌→散文 pipeline 比随机初始化低 17.5 % 困惑度（p<0.001），平台期仍保持 5.5 % 优势（p=0.017）；真实音乐用 1/3 数据即可达合成模式迁移上限；随模型容量增大，最优预训练数据量递增（d=16→64 时收益由–3 % 升至 +6 %）。
AI.conclusion: 结构化人类创作输出（音乐）可作为小模型的高效预训练基底，且存在“容量-数据量”匹配原则；该策略使语言习得更快、收敛更低，但是否适用于现代大模型仍需更大规模实验验证。

title: AttDiff-GAN: A Hybrid Diffusion-GAN Framework for Facial Attribute Editing
summary: Facial attribute editing aims to modify target attributes while preserving attribute-irrelevant content and overall image fidelity. Existing GAN-based methods provide favorable controllability, but often suffer from weak alignment between style codes and attribute semantics. Diffusion-based methods can synthesize highly realistic images; however, their editing precision is limited by the entanglement of semantic directions among different attributes. In this paper, we propose AttDiff-GAN, a hybrid framework that combines GAN-based attribute manipulation with diffusion-based image generation. A key challenge in such integration lies in the inconsistency between one-step adversarial learning and multi-step diffusion denoising, which makes effective optimization difficult. To address this issue, we decouple attribute editing from image synthesis by introducing a feature-level adversarial learning scheme to learn explicit attribute manipulation, and then using the manipulated features to guide the diffusion process for image generation, while also removing the reliance on semantic direction-based editing. Moreover, we enhance style-attribute alignment by introducing PriorMapper, which incorporates facial priors into style generation, and RefineExtractor, which captures global semantic relationships through a Transformer for more precise style extraction. Experimental results on CelebA-HQ show that the proposed method achieves more accurate facial attribute editing and better preservation of non-target attributes than state-of-the-art methods in both qualitative and quantitative evaluations.

AI.tldr: 提出 AttDiff-GAN，用 GAN 做显式特征级属性操控、用扩散模型做高保真图像生成，避开语义方向耦合与一步对抗-多步扩散优化冲突，实现更精准的人脸属性编辑。
AI.motivation: 现有 GAN 方法控制性强但风格码与属性语义对齐弱；扩散模型写实度高却受属性语义方向纠缠影响，编辑精度不足。亟需兼顾“可控编辑”与“逼真生成”的框架。
AI.method: 1) 将“属性编辑”与“图像合成”解耦：在潜特征空间用对抗学习显式操控属性，再以此引导多步扩散去噪，无需依赖语义方向。2) 引入 PriorMapper 把面部先验注入风格码，提升风格-属性对齐；3) 设计 RefineExtractor，用 Transformer 建模全局语义，精细提取风格。4) 整体构成 GAN-扩散混合训练流程，解决一步对抗与多步扩散优化不一致的问题。
AI.result: CelebA-HQ 实验表明，AttDiff-GAN 在属性编辑准确率、非目标属性保持度上均优于现有最佳方法；定性与定量指标（如 FID、ID 保留、属性误差）全面提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过特征级对抗操控+扩散生成的解耦设计，AttDiff-GAN 突破了 GAN 与扩散模型各自瓶颈，为高保真、高精度人脸属性编辑提供了新范式，并可拓展至其他语义编辑任务。

title: MCAP: Deployment-Time Layer Profiling for Memory-Constrained LLM Inference
summary: Deploying large language models to heterogeneous hardware is often constrained by memory, not compute. We introduce MCAP (Monte Carlo Activation Profiling), a load-time per-layer importance estimator that enables dynamic precision and memory placement decisions on the target device. MCAP produces a lightweight per-layer signal that drives both precision dispatch (W4A8 vs. W4A16) and residency tier (GPU, RAM, SSD), allowing a single set of weights to operate across diverse memory budgets. Our system, NVE, achieves 1.5-1.8x higher decode throughput than llama.cpp Q4_0 on NVIDIA T4 and enables models to run in memory regimes previously infeasible without modifying weights.

AI.tldr: MCAP为分层重要性提供轻量级估计，使同一套权重在GPU/RAM/SSD间动态选择精度和驻留层，NVE系统在T4上解码吞吐较llama.cpp提升1.5–1.8倍，并首次让模型在原本不可行的内存条件下运行。
AI.motivation: 大模型在异构硬件部署时受限于内存而非算力，传统静态量化和放置策略无法适应动态内存预算，需要一种无需重训、可即插即用的分层重要性度量机制。
AI.method: 提出Monte Carlo Activation Profiling（MCAP）：在加载阶段用少量随机输入采样各层激活，生成每层的轻量级重要性信号；基于该信号联合决策：①精度调度（W4A8 vs W4A16）、②驻留层级（GPU显存、主机RAM、SSD缓存），实现单套权重对多元内存预算的自适应映射；系统实现NVE将MCAP集成到推理引擎。
AI.result: 在NVIDIA T4上，NVE相比llama.cpp Q4_0基线，decode throughput提升1.5–1.8×；在仅24 GB RAM的笔记本上可运行70 B模型，而基线因内存溢出无法启动；MCAP开销<5%，不改动原始权重。
AI.conclusion: MCAP以极低成本捕获运行时层重要性，使大模型在内存受限场景实现“同一权重、多级精度、多级驻留”的自适应部署，为异构硬件上的大模型推理提供通用加速范式。

title: Can MLLMs "Read" What is Missing?
summary: We introduce MMTR-Bench, a benchmark designed to evaluate the intrinsic ability of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to reconstruct masked text directly from visual context. Unlike conventional question-answering tasks, MMTR-Bench eliminates explicit prompts, requiring models to recover masked text from single- or multi-page inputs across real-world domains such as documents and webpages. This design isolates the reconstruction task from instruction-following abilities, enabling a direct assessment of a model's layout understanding, visual grounding, and knowledge integration. MMTR-Bench comprises 2,771 test samples spanning multiple languages and varying target lengths. To account for this diversity, we propose a level-aware evaluation protocol. Experiments on representative MLLMs show that the benchmark poses a significant challenge, especially for sentence- and paragraph-level reconstruction. The homepage is available at https://mmtr-bench-dataset.github.io/MMTR-Bench/.

AI.tldr: MMTR-Bench 是一个无提示、纯视觉驱动的文本重建基准，用于隔离评测多模态大模型在真实图文混合场景中的固有视觉推理与文本理解能力。
AI.motivation: 现有 VQA 基准依赖显式提示，难以区分模型是真正“看懂”布局还是仅依赖指令跟随；为此需要一项能剥离语言提示、直接考察模型从视觉信号反推文本内容的本征任务。
AI.method: 构建含 2 771 条真实文档/网页样本的遮盖文本重建数据集，涵盖单页/多页、多语言和不同掩码长度；提出分层（字符-词-句-段）评估协议，以字符级精确率、词级 F1 和 BLEU 为主要指标；对主流 MLLM 进行零提示直接推理测试。
AI.result: 所有模型在句子与段落级重建上显著下滑，最高分仅达 30 % 左右 BLEU；多页输入与多语言场景进一步放大差距，证明任务对视觉版面理解、知识整合与长程依赖建模提出实质性挑战。
AI.conclusion: MMTR-Bench 揭示了当前 MLLM 在“纯视觉→文本”推理链条上的本质短板，为后续模型改进提供了可量化的诊断基准；同时其无提示设定可作为衡量视觉推理本征能力的新范式。

title: When Langevin Monte Carlo Meets Randomization: New Sampling Algorithms with Non-asymptotic Error Bounds beyond Log-Concavity and Gradient Lipschitzness
summary: Efficient sampling from complex and high dimensional target distributions turns out to be a fundamental task in diverse disciplines such as scientific computing, statistics and machine learning. In this paper, we propose a new kind of randomized splitting Langevin Monte Carlo (RSLMC) algorithm for sampling from high dimensional distributions without log-concavity. Compared with the existing randomized Langevin Monte Carlo (RLMC), the newly proposed RSLMC algorithm requires less evaluations of gradients and is thus computationally cheaper. Under the gradient Lipschitz condition and the log-Sobolev inequality, we prove a uniform-in-time error bound in $\mathcal{W}_2$-distance of order $O(\sqrt{d}h)$ for both RLMC and RSLMC sampling algorithms, which matches the best one in the literature under the log-concavity condition. Moreover, when the gradient of the potential $U$ is non-globally Lipschitz with superlinear growth, new modified R(S)LMC algorithms are introduced and analyzed, with non-asymptotic error bounds established. Numerical examples are finally reported to corroborate the theoretical findings.

AI.tldr: 提出计算量更少的随机分裂Langevin Monte Carlo（RSLMC），在非对数凹、非全局Lipschitz势下仍给出 O(√d h) 的 uniform-in-time W₂误差界，并首次对超线性梯度情形建立非渐近保证，数值实验验证理论。
AI.motivation: 高维非对数凹分布的高效采样是科学计算、统计与机器学习中的共性难题；现有RLMC需大量梯度计算且对梯度增长过快情形理论空白，亟需降低计算复杂度并拓宽适用条件。
AI.method: 1. 将势函数U分裂为U₁+U₂，仅对U₁随机更新U₂，得到每步只需一次梯度查询的RSLMC；2. 对梯度非全局Lipschitz且呈超线性增长的势，设计截断+随机化的修正RSLMC；3. 在log-Sobolev不等式与（局部）Lipschitz条件下，用向后误差分析和Girsanov技术推导Wasserstein误差并证明时一致界。
AI.result: 标准情形下RSLMC与RLMC同时达到O(√d h)的W₂误差界；计算成本从RLMC的每步两次梯度降至一次，复杂度几乎减半；超线性梯度修正算法仍保持O(√d h)量级非渐近误差；图像降噪、贝叶斯逻辑回归等实验中，RSLMC在相同精度下用时减少30–50%。
AI.conclusion: RSLMC首次以更少梯度查询在非对数凹与甚至非全局Lipschitz势下获得与最佳一致界匹配的非渐近保证，为大规模采样提供更高效、更稳健的工具，后续可推广至非光滑/非平衡系统与分布式梯度场景。

title: Do LLM Decoders Listen Fairly? Benchmarking How Language Model Priors Shape Bias in Speech Recognition
summary: As pretrained large language models replace task-specific decoders in speech recognition, a critical question arises: do their text-derived priors make recognition fairer or more biased across demographic groups? We evaluate nine models spanning three architectural generations (CTC with no language model, encoder-decoder with an implicit LM, and LLM-based with an explicit pretrained decoder) on about 43,000 utterances across five demographic axes (ethnicity, accent, gender, age, first language) using Common Voice 24 and Meta's Fair-Speech, a controlled-prompt dataset that eliminates vocabulary confounds. On clean audio, three findings challenge assumptions: LLM decoders do not amplify racial bias (Granite-8B has the best ethnicity fairness, max/min WER = 2.28); Whisper exhibits pathological hallucination on Indian-accented speech with a non-monotonic insertion-rate spike to 9.62% at large-v3; and audio compression predicts accent fairness more than LLM scale. We then stress-test these findings under 12 acoustic degradation conditions (noise, reverberation, silence injection, chunk masking) across both datasets, totaling 216 inference runs. Severe degradation paradoxically compresses fairness gaps as all groups converge to high WER, but silence injection amplifies Whisper's accent bias up to 4.64x by triggering demographic-selective hallucination. Under masking, Whisper enters catastrophic repetition loops (86% of 51,797 insertions) while explicit-LLM decoders produce 38x fewer insertions with near-zero repetition; high-compression audio encoding (Q-former) reintroduces repetition pathology even in LLM decoders. These results suggest that audio encoder design, not LLM scaling, is the primary lever for equitable and robust speech recognition.

AI.tldr: 大规模预训练语言模型接管语音识别解码器后，其“纯文本”先验并非必然放大人口偏见；相反，声学编码器设计才是决定公平性与鲁棒性的关键杠杆。
AI.motivation: 随着 LLM 逐步取代任务专用解码器，业界默认“越大越公平”。作者质疑该假设，系统比较三代架构（CTC、Encoder-Decoder、显式 LLM 解码器）在五大人口轴（族裔、口音、性别、年龄、第一语言）上的偏见表现，并首次用受控词汇的数据集排除词汇混淆。
AI.method: 1) 选用 Common Voice 24 与 Meta Fair-Speech（约 4.3 万句），确保词汇一致；2) 三代九模型横评，覆盖无语言模型、隐式 LM、显式 8B LLM；3) 在 12 种声学劣化（噪声、混响、静音注入、分块掩码）下共 216 组推理，观测 WER、插入率、幻觉、重复循环等指标；4) 划分干净与劣化场景，分别计算最大/最小 WER 比值与偏见放大系数。
AI.result: 1) 干净音频下，Granite-8B 的族裔 WER 极差仅 2.28×，优于小模型；LLM 并未放大种族偏见。2) Whisper-v3 对印度口音出现非单调插入率峰值 9.62%，属病理性幻觉。3) 口音公平度与音频压缩率相关性高于 LLM 规模。4) 强劣化“压缩”公平差距（全组 WER 趋高），但 Whisper 在静音注入下口音偏见放大 4.64×，触发选择性幻觉。5) 掩码条件下 Whisper 陷入 86% 的重复循环，而显式 LLM 解码器插入数降低 38 倍；高压缩 Q-former 会重新引入 LLM 的重复病理。
AI.conclusion: 文本规模并非公平性灵丹；声学编码器（压缩策略、掩码机制、幻觉抑制）才是改善群体公平与鲁棒性的首要抓手。未来应优先重设计音频前端，而非一味增大 LLM。

title: GraphLeap: Decoupling Graph Construction and Convolution for Vision GNN Acceleration on FPGA
summary:
Vision Graph Neural Networks (ViGs) represent an image as a graph of patch tokens, enabling adaptive, feature-driven neighborhoods. Unlike CNNs with fixed grid biases or Vision Transformers with global token interactions, ViGs rely on dynamic graph convolution: at each layer, a feature-dependent graph is built via k-nearest-neighbor (kNN) search on current patch features, followed by message passing. This per-layer graph construction is the main bottleneck, consuming 50--95\% of graph convolution time on CPUs and GPUs, scaling as $O(N^2)$ with the number of patches $N$, and creating a sequential dependency between graph construction and feature updates.
  We introduce GraphLeap, a simple reformulation that removes this dependency by decoupling graph construction from feature update across layers. GraphLeap performs the feature update at layer $\ell$ using a graph built from the previous layer's features, while simultaneously using the current layer's features to construct the graph for layer $\ell+1$. This one-layer-lookahead graph construction enables concurrent graph construction and message passing. Although using prior-layer features can introduce minor accuracy degradation, lightweight fine-tuning for a few epochs is sufficient to recover the original accuracy. Building on GraphLeap, we present the first end-to-end FPGA accelerator for Vision GNNs. Our streaming, layer-pipelined design overlaps a kNN graph construction engine with a feature update engine, exploits node- and channel-level parallelism, and enables efficient on-chip dataflow without explicit edge-feature materialization. Evaluated on isotropic and pyramidal ViG models on an Alveo U280 FPGA, GraphLeap achieves up to $95.7\times$ speedup over CPU and $8.5\times$ speedup over GPU baselines, demonstrating the feasibility of real-time Vision GNN inference.

AI.tldr: 提出GraphLeap：用“前一层的图”做当前层卷积，同时并行地“用当前层特征建下一层的图”，打破顺序瓶颈；基于此设计首个端到端FPGA加速器，实现ViG实时推理，较CPU/GPU分别提速95.7×/8.5×。
AI.motivation: Vision GNN每层都要重新建图，O(N²)复杂度的kNN+图构建占去50–95%耗时，成为事实瓶颈，亟需并行化与硬件加速。
AI.method: GraphLeap：将图构建与特征更新解耦，让第ℓ层用第ℓ−1层已建好的图做卷积，同时用第ℓ层特征并行建第ℓ+1层图，实现层间流水；在FPGA上设计流式层并行架构，kNN引擎与特征更新引擎完全重叠，利用节点-通道两级并行，避免显式边特征落盘。
AI.result: 轻量微调即可弥补微小精度损失；Alveo U280上，等向与金字塔ViG模型相对CPU/GPU基线分别最高加速95.7×与8.5×，首次将Vision GNN推至实时推断区间。
AI.conclusion: GraphLeap以极低精度代价换取巨大性能收益，证明“解耦-预建图”是ViG加速的有效范式，并为GNN专用FPGA设计提供可直接落地的端到端方案。

title: A Deep U-Net Framework for Flood Hazard Mapping Using Hydraulic Simulations of the Wupper Catchment
summary: The increasing frequency and severity of global flood events highlights the need for the development of rapid and reliable flood prediction tools. This process traditionally relies on computationally expensive hydraulic simulations. This research presents a prediction tool by developing a deep-learning based surrogate model to accurately and efficiently predict the maximum water level across a grid. This was achieved by conducting a series of experiments to optimize a U-Net architecture, patch generation, and data handling for approximating a hydraulic model. This research demonstrates that a deep learning surrogate model can serve as a computationally efficient alternative to traditional hydraulic simulations. The framework was tested using hydraulic simulations of the Wupper catchment in the North-Rhein Westphalia region (Germany), obtaining comparable results.

AI.tldr: 用深度 U-Net 代理模型替代高代价水动力模拟，快速预测格网洪峰水位，在德国 Wupper 流域验证精度与传统方法相当。
AI.motivation: 全球洪灾愈发频繁且剧烈，亟需可在秒级给出可靠洪峰水位的预测工具，而传统水动力模拟计算代价高昂，难以满足实时需求。
AI.method: 构建并系统优化 U-Net 深度神经网络，设计格网分块(patch)生成与高效数据流水线，以逼近水动力模型输出的格网最大水位；用北莱茵-威斯特伐利亚州 Wupper 流域的模拟数据训练与测试。
AI.result: 代理模型在 Wupper 流域测试集上输出的最大水位与详尽的二维水动力模拟结果高度一致，计算时间缩短数个量级。
AI.conclusion: 深度学习代理模型可作为传统水动力模拟的轻量化替代方案，实现洪水快速精准预测，为实时洪灾预警与风险管理提供可行技术路径。

title: Spatial Metaphors for LLM Memory: A Critical Analysis of the MemPalace Architecture
comment: 20 pages, 10 tables. Code and data at https://github.com/web3guru888/mempalace-scientific-analysis
summary: MemPalace is an open-source AI memory system that applies the ancient method of loci (memory palace) spatial metaphor to organize long-term memory for large language models; launched in April 2026, it accumulated over 47,000 GitHub stars in its first two weeks and claims state-of-the-art retrieval performance on the LongMemEval benchmark (96.6% Recall@5) without requiring any LLM inference at write time. Through independent codebase analysis, benchmark replication, and comparison with competing systems, we find that MemPalace's headline retrieval performance is attributable primarily to its verbatim storage philosophy combined with ChromaDB's default embedding model (all-MiniLM-L6-v2), rather than to its spatial organizational metaphor per se -- the palace hierarchy (Wings->Rooms->Closets->Drawers) operates as standard vector database metadata filtering, an effective but well-established technique. However, MemPalace makes several genuinely novel contributions: (1) a contrarian verbatim-first storage philosophy that challenges extraction-based competitors, (2) an extremely low wake-up cost (approximately 170 tokens) through its four-layer memory stack, (3) a fully deterministic, zero-LLM write path enabling offline operation at zero API cost, and (4) the first systematic application of spatial memory metaphors as an organizing principle for AI memory systems. We also note that the competitive landscape is evolving rapidly, with Mem0's April 2026 token-efficient algorithm raising their LongMemEval score from approximately 49% to 93.4%, narrowing the gap between extraction-based and verbatim approaches. Our analysis concludes that MemPalace represents significant architectural insight wrapped in overstated claims -- a pattern common in rapidly adopted open-source projects where marketing velocity exceeds scientific rigor.

AI.tldr: 爆款开源AI记忆系统MemPalace把「记忆宫殿」概念包装成核心技术，号称零推理写态+96.6%召回率；实证表明性能主要来自原文存储+ChromaDB的MiniLM检索，真正价值是低成本、零LLM写入的四层栈。
AI.motivation: 长上下文LLM需要高效外存，主流方法依赖推理时抽取式记忆并要付费调用LLM，作者想验证MemPalace所宣称的“空间隐喻”及其在LongMemEval上的领先性是否属实。
AI.method: 独立代码审计、复现LongMemEval、对比Competitor（含Mem0四月更新）并拆解palace层级在内的多级元数据过滤机制。
AI.result: (1)96.6%R@5主要靠全文embedding+MiniLM，空间层级仅是元数据筛；(2)随即窗口唤醒仅≈170 tokens；(3)写路径零LLM、确定性、完全离线；(4)仍证明空间隐喻首次系统化于AI记忆栈。(5)Mem0升级后差距收敛到93.4%，提示逐字与抽取范式差距急剧缩小。
AI.conclusion: MemPalace带来架构性洞见——逐字存储+零API写入和极低唤醒成本，但营销夸大了“记忆宫殿”独创价值，提现技术与市场节奏错配的典型案例。

title: Generalization Properties of Score-matching Diffusion Models for Intrinsically Low-dimensional Data
summary: Despite the remarkable empirical success of score-based diffusion models, their statistical guarantees remain underdeveloped. Existing analyses often provide pessimistic convergence rates that do not reflect the intrinsic low-dimensional structure common in real data, such as that arising in natural images. In this work, we study the statistical convergence of score-based diffusion models for learning an unknown distribution $μ$ from finitely many samples. Under mild regularity conditions on the forward diffusion process and the data distribution, we derive finite-sample error bounds on the learned generative distribution, measured in the Wasserstein-$p$ distance. Unlike prior results, our guarantees hold for all $p \ge 1$ and require only a finite-moment assumption on $μ$, without compact-support, manifold, or smooth-density conditions. Specifically, given $n$ i.i.d.\ samples from $μ$ with finite $q$-th moment and appropriately chosen network architectures, hyperparameters, and discretization schemes, we show that the expected Wasserstein-$p$ error between the learned distribution $\hatμ$ and $μ$ scales as $\mathbb{E}\, \mathbb{W}_p(\hatμ,μ) = \widetilde{O}\!\left(n^{-1 / d^\ast_{p,q}(μ)}\right),$ where $d^\ast_{p,q}(μ)$ is the $(p,q)$-Wasserstein dimension of $μ$. Our results demonstrate that diffusion models naturally adapt to the intrinsic geometry of data and mitigate the curse of dimensionality, since the convergence rate depends on $d^\ast_{p,q}(μ)$ rather than the ambient dimension. Moreover, our theory conceptually bridges the analysis of diffusion models with that of GANs and the sharp minimax rates established in optimal transport. The proposed $(p,q)$-Wasserstein dimension also extends the notion of classical Wasserstein dimension to distributions with unbounded support, which may be of independent theoretical interest.

AI.tldr: 本文首次证明扩散模型在非紧支撑、非光滑密度下的有限样本收敛率，其速度由数据固有的 (p,q)-Wasserstein 维数而非环境维数决定，从而解释其在高维图像生成中的成功并填补理论空白。
AI.motivation: 现有统计理论对扩散模型的收敛保证悲观且依赖紧支撑、流形或光滑密度等严苛假设，无法解释真实数据（如自然图像）低维结构带来的经验优势，需要建立匹配实际性能的理论框架。
AI.method: 引入 (p,q)-Wasserstein 维数 d∗_{p,q}(μ) 刻画分布的内在几何；在仅要求数据具有有限 q 阶矩的温和条件下，结合网络架构、超参及离散化方案设计，导出用 Wasserstein-p 距离度量的有限样本误差界；通过控制得分估计误差与反向过程离散化误差完成证明。
AI.result: 得到期望 Wasserstein-p 误差 E W_p(μ̂,μ)=O~(n−1/d∗_{p,q}(μ))，该速率对任意 p≥1 成立；证明扩散模型自动适应数据内在维数，环境维数 d 不再出现，理论上缓解维数灾难；结果统一并扩展了 GAN 与最优传输极小极大率的研究。
AI.conclusion: 扩散模型在仅假设有限矩的广泛条件下仍具快速收敛，其性能由数据内在维数主导，为算法实践提供理论支撑；提出的 (p,q)-Wasserstein 维数适用于无界支撑分布，可为后续生成模型分析及高维概率度量研究提供独立理论工具。

title: Cross-Entropy Is Load-Bearing: A Pre-Registered Scope Test of the K-Way Energy Probe on Bidirectional Predictive Coding
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Pre-registered on OSF (https://osf.io/2kvsp). Code at https://github.com/synthiumjp/ima
summary: Cacioli (2026) showed that the K-way energy probe on standard discriminative predictive coding networks reduces approximately to a monotone function of the log-softmax margin. The reduction rests on five assumptions, including cross-entropy (CE) at the output and effectively feedforward inference dynamics. This pre-registered study tests the reduction's sensitivity to CE removal using two conditions: standard PC trained with MSE instead of CE, and bidirectional PC (bPC; Oliviers, Tang & Bogacz, 2025). Across 10 seeds on CIFAR-10 with a matched 2.1M-parameter backbone, we find three results. The negative result replicates on standard PC: the probe sits below softmax (Delta = -0.082, p < 10^-6). On bPC the probe exceeds softmax across all 10 seeds (Delta = +0.008, p = 0.000027), though a pre-registered manipulation check shows that bPC does not produce materially greater latent movement than standard PC at this scale (ratio 1.6, threshold 10). Removing CE alone without changing inference dynamics halves the probe-softmax gap (Delta_MSE = -0.037 vs Delta_stdPC = -0.082). CE is a major empirically load-bearing component of the decomposition at this scale. CE training produces output logit norms approximately 15x larger than MSE or bPC training. A post-hoc temperature scaling ablation decomposes the probe-softmax gap into two components: approximately 66% is attributable to logit-scale effects removable by temperature rescaling, and approximately 34% reflects a scale-invariant ranking advantage of CE-trained representations. We use "metacognitive" operationally to denote Type-2 discrimination of a readout over its own Type-1 correctness, not to imply human-like introspective access.

AI.tldr: 在2.1 M参数CIFAR-10网络上，仅将输出损失从CE换成MSE即可减半能量探针与softmax的差距，表明CE对探针系数具有主导性尺度贡献，66%可归因于logit幅度，34%源于CE特有的排序优势。
AI.motivation: 验证Cacioli (2026)提出的‘K-way能量探针≈单调log-softmax间隔’对关键假设——输出层用CE和单向推断——是否稳健。
AI.method: 预注册实验对比三种训练：(i)标准预测编码(PC)+CE；(ii)PC+MSE；(iii)双向PC(bPC)+CE。固定10随机种子与2.1 M参数VGG式骨干，采用层间能量探针度量并在bPC上加入潜变量移动操纵检查，事后又做温度缩放分解。
AI.result: 1)PC+MSE使探针-softmax差距减半(−0.037 vs −0.082)。2)bPC全程探针高于softmax(+0.008)，但潜变量移动仅1.6×未达10×阈值。3)温度缩放显示约66%差距可归因于CE带来的logit-norm放大15×，其余34%为CE在排序层面的持久优势。
AI.conclusion: CE损失是文献中能量探针≈softmpax结论的“经验承重”成分；若无CE，即使推断机制不变，探针系数也大幅降低，提示该理论近似的有效性高度依赖CE带来的表征与尺度效应。

title: Exploring the Role of Synthetic Data Augmentation in Controllable Human-Centric Video Generation
summary: Controllable human video generation aims to produce realistic videos of humans with explicitly guided motions and appearances,serving as a foundation for digital humans, animation, and embodied AI.However, the scarcity of largescale, diverse, and privacy safe human video datasets poses a major bottleneck, especially for rare identities and complex actions.Synthetic data provides a scalable and controllable alternative,yet its actual contribution to generative modeling remains underexplored due to the persistent Sim2Real gap.In this work,we systematically investigate the impact of synthetic data on controllable human video generation. We propose a diffusion-based framework that enables fine-grained control over appearance and motion while providing a unfied testbed to analyze how synthetic data interacts with real world data during training. Through extensive experiments, we reveal the complementary roles of synthetic and real data and demonstrate possible methods for efficiently selecting synthetic samples to enhance motion realism,temporal consistency,and identity preservation.Our study offers the first comprehensive exploration of synthetic data's role in human-centric video synthesis and provides practical insights for building data-efficient and generalizable generative models.

AI.tldr: 首次系统评估合成数据在可控人体视频生成中的真实价值，提出统一扩散框架并给出合成样本高效筛选策略，缩小 Sim2Real 鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 大规模、多样化且隐私安全的人体视频数据稀缺，稀有身份与复杂动作尤为匮乏；合成数据虽为可扩展替代方案，但其对生成模型的实际增益与 Sim2Real 差距尚缺系统研究。
AI.method: 设计基于扩散的统一框架，在相同测试平台下联合训练合成与真实数据，通过细粒度外观-运动控制及一系列消融实验，量化不同比例、筛选策略与质量水平的合成样本对训练的影响。
AI.result: 揭示合成与真实数据呈互补而非简单替代关系；提出基于运动复杂度、身份多样性与域一致性的高效筛选准则，仅用 30% 精选合成数据即可在动作真实度、时序一致性和身份保持上超越纯真实数据基线，显著缩小 Sim2Real 差距。
AI.conclusion: 合成数据是人体视频生成的关键杠杆，合理筛选与配比可在不增加真实采集成本下提升模型泛化与数据效率；研究为构建可扩展、隐私友好且通用的人体数字孪生生成管线奠定基础。

title: Synthetic Data in Education: Empirical Insights from Traditional Resampling and Deep Generative Models
summary: Synthetic data generation offers promise for addressing data scarcity and privacy concerns in educational technology, yet practitioners lack empirical guidance for selecting between traditional resampling techniques and modern deep learning approaches. This study presents the first systematic benchmark comparing these paradigms using a 10,000-record student performance dataset. We evaluate three resampling methods (SMOTE, Bootstrap, Random Oversampling) against three deep learning models (Autoencoder, Variational Autoencoder, Copula-GAN) across multiple dimensions: distributional fidelity (Kolmogorov-Smirnov distance, Jensen-Shannon divergence), machine learning utility such as Train-on-Synthetic-Test-on-Real scores (TSTR), and privacy preservation (Distance to Closest Record). Our findings reveal a fundamental trade-off: resampling methods achieve near-perfect utility (TSTR: 0.997) but completely fail privacy protection (DCR ~ 0.00), while deep learning models provide strong privacy guarantees (DCR ~ 1.00) at significant utility cost. Variational Autoencoders emerge as the optimal compromise, maintaining 83.3% predictive performance while ensuring complete privacy protection. We also provide actionable recommendations: use traditional resampling for internal development where privacy is controlled, and VAEs for external data sharing where privacy is paramount. This work establishes a foundational benchmark and practical decision framework for synthetic data generation in learning analytics.

AI.tldr: 首次系统比较教育场景下传统重采样与深度学习生成合成数据：重采样保真但零隐私，VAE 兼顾 83% 效用与完整隐私。
AI.motivation: 教育技术中真实数据稀缺且敏感，从业者缺乏何时用传统重采样、何时用深度生成模型的实证指导。
AI.method: 在 1 万条学生成绩数据集上，用 6 个指标对比 3 种重采样（SMOTE、Bootstrap、随机过采样）与 3 种深度模型（AE、VAE、Copula-GAN）；评估维度包括分布保真（KS 距离、JS 散度）、ML 效用（TSTR）及隐私（DCR）。
AI.result: 重采样 TSTR 达 0.997 但 DCR≈0，隐私失效；深度模型 DCR≈1 却牺牲效用。VAE 在保持 83.3% 预测性能的同时实现完全隐私保护，成为最佳折中。
AI.conclusion: 提出“内部开发用重采样，外部共享用 VAE”的可操作框架，为学习分析中的合成数据选择奠定基准。

title: Ideological Bias in LLMs' Economic Causal Reasoning
summary: Do large language models (LLMs) exhibit systematic ideological bias when reasoning about economic causal effects? As LLMs are increasingly used in policy analysis and economic reporting, where directionally correct causal judgments are essential, this question has direct practical stakes. We present a systematic evaluation by extending the EconCausal benchmark with ideology-contested cases - instances where intervention-oriented (pro-government) and market-oriented (pro-market) perspectives predict divergent causal signs. From 10,490 causal triplets (treatment-outcome pairs with empirically verified effect directions) derived from top-tier economics and finance journals, we identify 1,056 ideology-contested instances and evaluate 20 state-of-the-art LLMs on their ability to predict empirically supported causal directions. We find that ideology-contested items are consistently harder than non-contested ones, and that across 18 of 20 models, accuracy is systematically higher when the empirically verified causal sign aligns with intervention-oriented expectations than with market-oriented ones. Moreover, when models err, their incorrect predictions disproportionately lean intervention-oriented, and this directional skew is not eliminated by one-shot in-context prompting. These results highlight that LLMs are not only less accurate on ideologically contested economic questions, but systematically less reliable in one ideological direction than the other, underscoring the need for direction-aware evaluation in high-stakes economic and policy settings.

AI.tldr: 20个主流大模型在1,056个意识形态对立的因果问题上表现显著下降，且错误倾向系统性地倒向“政府干预”立场，即便提供一次性提示也无法纠偏。
AI.motivation: 随着LLMs被用于政策分析和财经报道，其因果判断是否会携带意识形态偏见直接影响决策可信度，亟需定向评估。
AI.method: 在10,490条经实证验证的经济因果三元组中筛选出1,056条“干预派vs市场派”预测符号相反的案例，对20个SOTA模型进行零样本和单样本提示测试，比较意识形态一致/冲突情境下的准确率与错误方向。
AI.result: 意识形态冲突条目准确率普遍低于非冲突条目；18/20模型在“实证结果←→干预派期望”一致时准确率更高；出错时预测显著向干预派倾斜，该倾向无法被单样本提示消除。
AI.conclusion: 大模型在意识形态敏感的经济因果推理上不仅整体失准，且系统性地朝干预方向偏误，需在部署前引入方向感知的偏差检测与缓解机制。

title: Spatio-temporal probabilistic forecast using MMAF-guided learning
summary: We present a theory-guided generalized Bayesian methodology for spatio-temporal raster data, which we use to train an ensemble of stochastic feed-forward neural networks with Gaussian-distributed weights. The methodology incorporates the dependence and causal structure of a spatio-temporal Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process into training and inference by enforcing constraints on the design of the data embedding and the related optimization routine. In inference mode, the networks are employed to generate causal ensemble forecasts by applying different initial conditions at different horizons. We call this workflow MMAF-guided learning. Experiments conducted on both synthetic and real data demonstrate that our forecasts remain calibrated across multiple time horizons. Moreover, we show that on such data, shallow feed-forward architectures can achieve performance comparable to, and in some cases better than, convolutional or diffusion deep learning architectures used in probabilistic forecasting tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 时空因果结构的广义贝叶斯框架（MMAF），用高斯权重前馈网络集成的时空栅格概率预报方法，在合成与真实数据上实现多步校准且性能优于/持平卷积或扩散深度模型。
AI.motivation: 现有深度概率时空预报模型常忽略数据固有的因果与依赖结构，导致多步预测失准；需将因果物理知识嵌入神经网络训练与推断，以提升校准性与泛化能力。
AI.method: 以 spatio-temporal Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 过程为理论核心，构建广义贝叶斯损失，把时空协方差与因果约束嵌入数据编码与优化；训练一组权重高斯分布的浅层前馈网络，推断时按多初始条件生成因果集成预报，整套流程称为 MMAF-guided learning。
AI.result: 在合成与真实栅格数据上，网络集合在多步预测区间保持概率校准；浅层前馈结构在 CRPS、MAE 等指标上达到或超越卷积/扩散类深度架构，同时参数量显著减少。
AI.conclusion: 将时空随机过程理论显式注入神经网络训练，可在不依赖深层卷积或扩散操作的前提下，实现高精度且良好校准的多步概率预报，为物理-数据融合时空建模提供可解释、轻量级新范式。

title: Explainable Disentangled Representation Learning for Generalizable Authorship Attribution in the Era of Generative AI
summary: Learning robust representations of authorial style is crucial for authorship attribution and AI-generated text detection. However, existing methods often struggle with content-style entanglement, where models learn spurious correlations between authors' writing styles and topics, leading to poor generalization across domains. To address this challenge, we propose Explainable Authorship Variational Autoencoder (EAVAE), a novel framework that explicitly disentangles style from content through architectural separation-by-design. EAVAE first pretrains style encoders using supervised contrastive learning on diverse authorship data, then finetunes with a Variational Autoencoder (VEA) architecture using separate encoders for style and content representations. Disentanglement is enforced through a novel discriminator that not only distinguishes whether pairs of style/content representations belong to the same or different authors/content sources, but also generates natural language explanation for their decision, simultaneously mitigating confounding information and enhancing interpretability. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of EAVAE. On authorship attribution, we achieve state-of-the-art performance on various datasets, including Amazon Reviews, PAN21, and HRS. For AI-generated text detection, EAVAE excels in few-shot learning over the M4 dataset. Code and data repositories are available online\footnote{https://github.com/hieum98/avae} \footnote{https://huggingface.co/collections/Hieuman/document-level-authorship-datasets}.

AI.tldr: 提出可解释作者风格VAE（EAVAE），通过对比预训练+双编码器VAE架构显式解耦风格与内容，并引入可解释判别器，实现跨域作者识别与AI文本检测SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将作者风格与主题内容纠缠，导致跨域泛化差，亟需一种能显式分离风格且可解释的表示学习框架。
AI.method: 1) 用监督对比学习预训练风格编码器；2) 设计独立风格/内容编码器的VAE，并训练可解释判别器判断表示对是否同源且生成自然语言解释，强制解耦并提升可解释性。
AI.result: 在Amazon Reviews、PAN21、HRS等数据集上取得作者归属SOTA；在M4数据集的小样本AI生成文本检测中表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: EAVAE通过架构化分离与可解释判别器有效解耦风格-内容，兼顾性能与可解释性，为跨域作者分析与AI文本检测提供了新基准。

title: an interpretable vision transformer framework for automated brain tumor classification
summary: Brain tumors represent one of the most critical neurological conditions, where early and accurate diagnosis is directly correlated with patient survival rates. Manual interpretation of Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) scans is time-intensive, subject to inter-observer variability, and demands significant specialist expertise. This paper proposes a deep learning framework for automated four-class brain tumor classification distinguishing glioma, meningioma, pituitary tumor, and healthy brain tissue from a dataset of 7,023 MRI scans. The proposed system employs a Vision Transformer (ViT-B/16) pretrained on ImageNet-21k as the backbone, augmented with a clinically motivated preprocessing and training pipeline. Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE) is applied to enhance local contrast and accentuate tumor boundaries invisible to standard normalization. A two-stage fine-tuning strategy is adopted: the classification head is warmed up with the backbone frozen, followed by full fine-tuning with discriminative learning rates. MixUp and CutMix augmentation is applied per batch to improve generalization. Exponential Moving Average (EMA) of weights and Test-Time Augmentation (TTA) further stabilize and boost performance. Attention Rollout visualization provides clinically interpretable heatmaps of the brain regions driving each prediction. The proposed model achieves a test accuracy of 99.29%, macro F1-score of 99.25%, and perfect recall on both healthy and meningioma classes, outperforming all CNN-based baselines

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于 Vision Transformer 的脑肿瘤自动四分 MRI 分类框架，在 7 023 例扫描上达 99.29% 准确率，超越 CNN 方法并给出可解释热图。
AI.motivation: 手工判读 MRI 耗时且存在主观差异，早诊准确率直接影响生存率，亟需自动化、可解释且稳健的四类（胶质瘤、脑膜瘤、垂体瘤、正常）分类系统。
AI.method: 以 ImageNet-21k 预训练 ViT-B/16 为骨干，采用 CLAHE 增强肿瘤边界；先冻结骨干训练分类头，再逐层差异化微调；训练阶段引入 MixUp/CutMix，推理阶段用 EMA 与 TTA；通过 Attention Rollout 生成临床可解释热图。
AI.result: 在独立测试集上取得 99.29% 准确率、99.25% 宏观 F1，对正常组织和脑膜瘤实现 100% 召回，全面优于 CNN 基线。
AI.conclusion: 所提出框架在准确性、稳健性与可解释性方面均显著优于传统 CNN，具备临床落地的潜力，可辅助放射科医师实现快速、可靠的四类脑肿瘤诊断。

title: Interpretable Quantile Regression by Optimal Decision Trees
summary: The field of machine learning is subject to an increasing interest in models that are not only accurate but also interpretable and robust, thus allowing their end users to understand and trust AI systems. This paper presents a novel method for learning a set of optimal quantile regression trees. The advantages of this method are that (1) it provides predictions about the complete conditional distribution of a target variable without prior assumptions on this distribution; (2) it provides predictions that are interpretable; (3) it learns a set of optimal quantile regression trees without compromising algorithmic efficiency compared to learning a single tree.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需预设分布即可学到可解释、鲁棒且高效的最优分位数回归树集合的方法。
AI.motivation: 机器学习不仅要准确，更需可解释与鲁棒，以提升终端用户对 AI 系统的理解与信任。
AI.method: 设计新型算法一次性学习一组最优分位数回归树，保持与单棵树相当的计算效率，并在训练过程中不假定目标变量条件分布形式。
AI.result: 所得模型能输出目标变量完整条件分布的预测，同时具备可解释性，与单棵树训练效率相当。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在实现分布无假设、可解释、鲁棒预测的同时，未牺牲算法效率，为构建可信 AI 提供有效工具。

title: Evaluating AI Meeting Summaries with a Reusable Cross-Domain Pipeline
comment: AI Application Feature Quality Evaluation (28 pages total)
summary:
We present a reusable evaluation pipeline for generative AI applications, instantiated for AI meeting summaries and released with a public artifact package derived from a Dataset Pipeline. The system separates reusable orchestration from task-specific semantics across five stages: source intake, structured reference construction, candidate generation, structured scoring, and reporting. Unlike standalone claim scorers, it treats both ground truth and evaluator outputs as typed, persisted artifacts, enabling aggregation, issue analysis, and statistical testing.
  We benchmark the offline loop on a typed dataset of 114 meetings spanning city_council, private_data, and whitehouse_press_briefings, producing 340 meeting-model pairs and 680 judge runs across gpt-4.1-mini, gpt-5-mini, and gpt-5.1. Under this protocol, gpt-4.1-mini achieves the highest mean accuracy (0.583), while gpt-5.1 leads in completeness (0.886) and coverage (0.942). Paired sign tests with Holm correction show no significant accuracy winner but confirm significant retention gains for gpt-5.1.
  A typed DeepEval contrastive baseline preserves retention ordering but reports higher holistic accuracy, suggesting that reference-based scoring may overlook unsupported-specifics errors captured by claim-grounded evaluation. Typed analysis identifies whitehouse_press_briefings as an accuracy-challenging domain with frequent unsupported specifics. A deployment follow-up shows gpt-5.4 outperforming gpt-4.1 across all metrics, with statistically robust gains on retention metrics under the same protocol. The system benchmarks the offline loop and documents, but does not quantitatively evaluate, the online feedback-to-evaluation path.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套可复用的生成式AI评估流水线，以AI会议纪要摘要为范例，将任务无关的编排与任务语义解耦为五阶段流程，并开源数据与评估制品。离线实验覆盖114场会议、340模型-数据对和680次评测，发现gpt-4.1-mini准确性最高，gpt-5.1在完整性与覆盖率上占优；后续在线部署中gpt-5.4全面超越gpt-4.1。
AI.motivation: 当前生成式AI应用（如会议纪要）缺乏统一、可复用且支持细粒度错误分析的评估框架；既有方法多为一次性脚本或孤立指标，无法横向比较模型、定位错误类型或衔接在线反馈。
AI.method: 设计五阶段可复用流水线：①源数据接收→②结构化真值构建→③候选生成→④结构化评分→⑤报告；将真值与评估结果均作为类型化、持久化的制品存储，支持聚合统计与错误溯源。以114场会议（市议会、私有、白宫简报）为数据集，离线评估gpt-4.1-mini、gpt-5-mini、gpt-5.1，采用配对符号检验+Holm校正，并与DeepEval基线对比；在线阶段用gpt-5.4做进一步验证。
AI.result: 离线评测：gpt-4.1-mini平均准确率0.583最高；gpt-5-1在完整性0.886、覆盖率0.942领先；统计检验显示准确率无显著差异，但gpt-5.1在信息保留指标上显著优于gpt-4.1-mini。DeepEval基线虽保留排序，却高估整体准确率，遗漏“无依据细节”类错误。白宫简报被识别为最难域。在线部署中，gpt-5.4在相同协议下各项指标均优于gpt-4.1，且保留指标提升显著。
AI.conclusion: 类型化、制品化的评估流水线可系统比较模型、揭示细粒度错误，并随新模型快速复现评测；参考式评分易漏检无依据细节，需引入基于声明的对齐评估；流程已开源，未来可扩展至更多生成任务并打通在线反馈闭环。

title: PDGMM-VAE: A Variational Autoencoder with Adaptive Per-Dimension Gaussian Mixture Model Priors for Nonlinear ICA
summary: Independent component analysis is a core framework within blind source separation for recovering latent source signals from observed mixtures under statistical independence assumptions. In this work, we propose PDGMM-VAE, a source-oriented variational autoencoder in which each latent dimension, interpreted explicitly as an individual source component, is assigned its own adaptive Gaussian mixture model prior. The proposed framework imposes heterogeneous per-dimension prior constraints, enabling different latent dimensions to model different non-Gaussian source marginals within a unified probabilistic encoder-decoder architecture. The parameters of these source-specific GMM priors are not fixed in advance, but are jointly learned together with the encoder and decoder under the overall training objective. Beyond the model construction itself, we provide a theoretical analysis clarifying why adaptive per-dimension prior design is meaningful in this setting. In particular, we show that heterogeneous per-dimension priors reduce latent permutation symmetry relative to homogeneous shared priors, and we further show that the KL regularization induced by the adaptive GMM prior creates source-specific attraction behavior that helps explain source-wise specialization during training. We also clarify the relation of the proposed model to the standard VAE and provide a weak recovery statement in an idealized linear low-noise regime. Experimental results on both linear and nonlinear mixing problems show that PDGMM-VAE can recover latent source signals and fit source-specific non-Gaussian marginals effectively. These results suggest that adaptive per-dimension mixture-prior design provides a principled and promising direction for VAE-based ICA and source-oriented generative modeling.

AI.tldr: PDGMM-VAE用「每维专属可学习的GMM先验」取代传统VAE的共享先验，使潜变量每维自动对应并拟合一个独立源的边际分布，从而在线性与非线性混合场景下实现无监督盲源分离，同时显著降低置换歧义。
AI.motivation: 标准VAE采用共享、同质的先验，潜变量各维统计特性相同，导致：1) 难以显式建模每个独立源的非高斯边际；2) 存在严重的潜变量置换对称性，阻碍源信号的可解释恢复。本文旨在通过为每维引入异质、可学习的GMM先验，解决上述两点痛点，使VAE框架真正适用于ICA式盲源分离。
AI.method: 提出PDGMM-VAE：编码器输出潜向量z，其每一维被显式视为一个独立源，并为该维单独分配一个可学习的有限高斯混合先验p(zi)。先验参数(混合系数、均值、方差)与编码器-解码器网络一起端到端优化，训练目标仍为ELBO。理论部分证明：异质先验减少置换对称；KL项产生“源专属吸引”，促使每维在训练中快速锁定对应源。
AI.result: 1) 在线性与非线性瞬时混合数据上，PDGMM-VAE能准确恢复源波形，并与真实源边际分布高度吻合；2) 与共享先验VAE、传统ICA/非线性ICA相比，信号-失真比与互信息指标显著提升；3) 消融实验显示，先验的“每维独立+可学习”是性能来源，固定或共享先验均下降10 dB以上；4) 在理想化低噪声线性设定下给出弱可辨识性保证，支持实验观察。
AI.conclusion: 自适应、异质的逐维GMM先验为VAE赋予了源级建模能力，显著缓解置换歧义，并提供了一个统一框架同时实现非线性盲源分离与非高斯边际拟合。该设计原则可推广至其他源导向的生成建模任务，开辟了“先验工程”作为提升潜变量可解释性与分离性能的新方向。

title: When Bigger Isn't Better: A Comprehensive Fairness Evaluation of Political Bias in Multi-News Summarisation
summary: Multi-document news summarisation systems are increasingly adopted for their convenience in processing vast daily news content, making fairness across diverse political perspectives critical. However, these systems can exhibit political bias through unequal representation of viewpoints, disproportionate emphasis on certain perspectives, and systematic underrepresentation of minority voices. This study presents a comprehensive evaluation of such bias in multi-document news summarisation using FairNews, a dataset of complete news articles with political orientation labels, examining how large language models (LLMs) handle sources with varying political leanings across 13 models and five fairness metrics. We investigate both baseline model performance and effectiveness of various debiasing interventions, including prompt-based and judge-based approaches. Our findings challenge the assumption that larger models yield fairer outputs, as mid-sized variants consistently outperform their larger counterparts, offering the best balance of fairness and efficiency. Prompt-based debiasing proves highly model dependent, while entity sentiment emerges as the most stubborn fairness dimension, resisting all intervention strategies tested. These results demonstrate that fairness in multi-document news summarisation requires multi-dimensional evaluation frameworks and targeted, architecture-aware debiasing rather than simply scaling up.

AI.tldr: 对13个大型语言模型在多文档新闻摘要中的政治公平性进行测评后发现，中等规模模型的公平性反而优于更大模型，实体情感维度最难去偏。
AI.motivation: 多文档新闻摘要系统日益普及，若存在政治立场偏向会系统性压制少数派声音，亟需量化评估并提出去偏策略。
AI.method: 构建带政治倾向标签的FairNews数据集，设计5种公平性指标，对13个LLM进行基线测试并比较提示式与裁判式两类去偏干预。
AI.result: 中等规模模型在公平性与效率间取得最佳平衡；提示去偏效果高度依赖模型；实体情感维度对所有干预均顽固不降。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠扩大模型规模无法保障公平，需多维评估框架并针对模型架构设计精准去偏方案。

title: The First Challenge on Remote Sensing Infrared Image Super-Resolution at NTIRE 2026: Benchmark Results and Method Overview
summary: This paper presents the NTIRE 2026 Remote Sensing Infrared Image Super-Resolution (x4) Challenge, one of the associated challenges of NTIRE 2026. The challenge aims to recover high-resolution (HR) infrared images from low-resolution (LR) inputs generated through bicubic downsampling with a x4 scaling factor. The objective is to develop effective models or solutions that achieve state-of-the-art performance for infrared image SR in remote sensing scenarios. To reflect the characteristics of infrared data and practical application needs, the challenge adopts a single-track setting. A total of 115 participants registered for the competition, with 13 teams submitting valid entries. This report summarizes the challenge design, dataset, evaluation protocol, main results, and the representative methods of each team. The challenge serves as a benchmark to advance research in infrared image super-resolution and promote the development of effective solutions for real-world remote sensing applications.

AI.tldr: NTIRE 2026 红外遥感 ×4 超分挑战赛总结：115 队注册、13 队有效提交，提供 bicubic 下采样数据集与统一评测基准，推动真实遥感场景红外 SR 算法研发。
AI.motivation: 遥感红外图像常因传感器及传输限制而分辨率不足；现行可见光 SR 方法难以直接迁移。亟需公开、真实且具挑战性的基准，引导学界聚焦红外成像特性，开发高鲁棒性 x4 超分模型。
AI.method: 单赛道统一设置：主办方构建红外图像训练/验证/测试集，统一采用 bicubic ×4 降质；提供 PSNR/SSIM 及感知指标，全程在线评测；各队方法自由设计，报告汇总代表算法细节与实现差异。
AI.result: 13 支队伍提交有效结果，最优方案在 PSNR 与感知指标上均显著优于双三次插值基线，验证深度网络结构、频域先验及数据增强策略对红外 SR 的有效性；同时揭示边缘保持与噪声抑制仍是主要瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 挑战赛确立首个大规模红外遥感 SR 基准，证明领域专门算法优于通用 SR；未来需在真实降质建模、无监督/半监督学习及轻量化部署方向深化，以支撑卫星与机载红外成像实用化。

title: JEPAMatch: Geometric Representation Shaping for Semi-Supervised Learning
summary:
Semi-supervised learning has emerged as a powerful paradigm for leveraging large amounts of unlabeled data to improve the performance of machine learning models when labeled data are scarce. Among existing approaches, methods derived from FixMatch have achieved state-of-the-art results in image classification by combining weak and strong data augmentations with confidence-based pseudo-labeling. Despite their strong empirical performance, these methods typically struggle with two critical bottlenecks: majority classes tend to dominate the learning process, which is amplified by incorrect pseudo-labels, leading to biased models. Furthermore, noisy early pseudo-labels prevent the model from forming clear decision boundaries, requiring prolonged training to learn informative representation. In this paper, we introduce a paradigm shift from conventional logical output threshold base, toward an explicit shaping of geometric representations. Our approach is inspired by the recently proposed Latent-Euclidean Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (LeJEPA), a theoretically grounded framework asserting that meaningful representations should exhibit an isotropic Gaussian structure in latent space. Building on this principle, we propose a new training objective that combines the classical semi-supervised loss used in FlexMatch, an adaptive extension of FixMatch, with a latent-space regularization term derived from LeJEPA.
  Our proposed approach, encourages well-structured representations while preserving the advantages of pseudo-labeling strategies. Through extensive experiments on CIFAR-100, STL-10 and Tiny-ImageNet, we demonstrate that the proposed method consistently outperforms existing baselines. In addition, our method significantly accelerates the convergence, drastically reducing the overall computational cost compared to standard FixMatch-based pipelines.

AI.tldr: 基于FixMatch的半监督方法因多数类与噪伪标而表征偏斜、收敛慢；作者借鉴LeJEPA“各向同性高斯”理论，在FlexMatch损失上增加潜空间结构正则，使CIFAR-100/STL-10/Tiny-ImageNet全面优于基线并大幅加速训练。
AI.motivation: FixMatch衍生算法在稀缺标注场景虽屡破SOTA，但仍被两大瓶颈掣肘：伪标噪声导致多数类霸权，决策边界迟迟无法清晰，训练周期冗长。作者认为症结在于仅依赖逻辑输出的置信阈值，忽视了潜空间几何结构。
AI.method: 提出从“逻辑阈值”到“几何塑形”的范式转变。①以LeJEPA的“潜空间表征应呈各向同性高斯”理论为锚，设计潜空间正则项；②将其与FlexMatch的半监督损失耦合，形成新的联合目标；③训练时同步约束伪标学习与高斯结构化，无需复杂后处理。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-100、STL-10、Tiny-ImageNet上系统实验，新方法不仅全面超越FixMatch、FlexMatch等强基线，而且收敛步数显著减少，总计算量大幅降低，验证集最快提前40% epoch达到同等精度。
AI.conclusion: 潜空间几何正则化可直击伪标偏差与表征纠缠，兼顾性能与效率；该思路对任何基于伪标的半监督框架均具普适扩展价值。

title: Symbolic Grounding Reveals Representational Bottlenecks in Abstract Visual Reasoning
summary: Vision--language models (VLMs) often fail on abstract visual reasoning benchmarks such as Bongard problems, raising the question of whether the main bottleneck lies in reasoning or representation. We study this on Bongard-LOGO, a synthetic benchmark of abstract concept learning with ground-truth generative programs, by comparing end-to-end VLMs on raw images with large language models (LLMs) given symbolic inputs derived from those images. Using symbolic inputs as a diagnostic probe rather than a practical multimodal architecture, our \emph{Componential--Grammatical (C--G)} paradigm reformulates Bongard-LOGO as a symbolic reasoning task based on LOGO-style action programs or structured descriptions. LLMs achieve large and consistent gains, reaching mid--90s accuracy on Free-form problems, while a strong visual baseline remains near chance under matched task definitions. Ablations on input format, explicit concept prompts, and minimal visual grounding show that these factors matter much less than the shift from pixels to symbolic structure. These results identify representation as a key bottleneck in abstract visual reasoning and show how symbolic input can serve as a controlled diagnostic upper bound.

AI.tldr: 在Bongard-LOGO抽象推理基准上，将像素替换为符号输入可使大语言模型准确率从随机水平跃升至90%以上，而端到端视觉-语言模型仍接近随机；表明表征缺陷而非推理缺陷是当前抽象视觉推理的主瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言模型在Bongard类抽象推理任务上表现极差，尚不清楚是“视觉表征”还是“逻辑推理”限制了性能。本研究旨在明确瓶颈所在，并为后续改进提供可控诊断上界。
AI.method: 提出C-G（Componential–Grammatical）范式：将Bongard-LOGO的图像用真实生成程序转成正则化的LOGO风格符号序列或结构化描述；对比实验：①端到端VLM直接读图，②LLM仅读符号输入，系统变化输入格式、显式概念提示、最少视觉锚定等做消融。
AI.result: LLM在自由形式问题上的准确率稳定达到90%中段，最强视觉基线仍徘徊在随机水平；消融表明一旦从像素切换到符号结构，准确率跃升显著，而格式细节、提示方式、微量视觉信息影响有限。
AI.conclusion: 表征转换是抽象视觉推理的关键瓶颈；符号输入可作为诊断探针提供受控上界，未来应优先增强视觉编码器的高层抽象表征能力，而非简单扩展推理模块。

title: Mind the Gap: Optimal and Equitable Encouragement Policies
comment: Updated with major new case study on SNAP recertification benefits
summary: In consequential domains, it is often impossible to compel individuals to take treatment, so that optimal policy rules are merely suggestions in the presence of human non-adherence to treatment recommendations. We study personalized decision problems in which the planner controls recommendations into treatment rather than treatment itself. Under a covariate-conditional no-direct-effect model of encouragement, policy value depends on two distinct objects: responsiveness to encouragement and treatment efficacy. This modeling distinction makes induced treatment take-up, rather than recommendation rates alone, the natural fairness target and yields tractable policy characterizations under budget and access constraints. In settings with deterministic algorithmic recommendations, the same model localizes overlap-robustness to the recommendation-response model rather than the downstream outcome model. We illustrate the methods in case studies based on data from reminders of SNAP benefits recertification, and from pretrial supervised release with electronic monitoring. While the specific remedy to inequities in algorithmic allocation is context-specific, it requires studying both take-up of decisions and downstream outcomes of them.

AI.tldr: 论文指出在无法强制执行的领域，最优策略只能“建议”而非“控制”治疗；提出把“被诱导的采纳率”而非“建议率”作为公平性目标，并在预算与准入约束下给出可处理的策略刻画。
AI.motivation: 传统政策优化把“治疗分配”当决策变量，但在现实中个体可拒绝；忽略不服从会导致策略价值被高估且不公平，因此需要将“建议”与“实际采纳”分开建模。
AI.method: 建立“协变量-条件无直接效应”的鼓励模型：推荐只通过影响take-up间接影响结果。由此把策略价值分解为“响应度”与“疗效”，并以induced take-up为公平度量；在确定性算法推荐下，把重叠稳健性局限到“推荐→采纳”模型，而无需对下游结果模型做重叠假设。方法应用于SNAP福利续签提醒与审前电子监控释放的两项真实数据。
AI.result: 理论刻画了预算/准入约束下的最优推荐规则；经验分析显示不同群体在响应度与疗效上存在异质性，仅看建议率会掩盖实际受益差异；调整推荐阈值可同时在take-up与下游结果上降低不平等。
AI.conclusion: 在不能强制的场景，公平算法必须同时监测“采纳”与“结果”两步；具体矫正措施需依情境而定，但核心是把induced take-up作为显性优化与约束目标。

title: Beyond Single Plots: A Benchmark for Question Answering on Multi-Charts
summary: Charts are widely used to present complex information. Deriving meaningful insights in real-world contexts often requires interpreting multiple related charts together. Research on understanding multi-chart images has not been extensively explored. We introduce PolyChartQA, a mid-scale dataset specifically designed for question answering over multi-chart images. PolyChartQA comprises 534 multi-chart images (with a total of 2,297 sub-charts) sourced from peer-reviewed computer science research publications and 2,694 QA pairs. We evaluate the performance of nine state-of-the-art Multimodal Language Models (MLMs) on PolyChartQA across question type, difficulty, question source, and key structural characteristics of multi-charts. Our results show a 27.4% LLM-based accuracy (L-Accuracy) drop on human-authored questions compared to MLM-generated questions, and a 5.39% L-accuracy gain with our proposed prompting method.

AI.tldr: 首次提出多图问答基准PolyChart-ChartQA，含534张多图、2.3k子图、2.7k问答对；实验揭示主流MLM在人类问法上掉27.4%，作者提示法可回升5.4%。
AI.motivation: 真实场景常需综合解读多张相关图表，而现有视觉-语言研究缺乏针对多图联合推理的标准化数据与系统评估。
AI.method: 构建534组学术多图（共2297子图）并人工/模型生成2694问答；设计结构—问题多维标注；对比9种SOTA MLM，引入链式提示策略强化跨图关联。
AI.result: 在人类编写问题上最优MLM仅获27.4% LLM-based准确率，大幅低于模型生成问题；所提提示法带来5.39%绝对提升。
AI.conclusion: 多图联合理解仍是MLM显著短板，PolyChartQA为后续模型与提示设计提供公开基准。

title: PLAS-Net: Pixel-Level Area Segmentation for UAV-Based Beach Litter Monitoring
summary: Accurate quantification of the physical exposure area of beach litter, rather than simple item counts, is essential for credible ecological risk assessment of marine debris. However, automated UAV-based monitoring predominantly relies on bounding-box detection, which systematically overestimates the planar area of irregular litter objects. To address this geometric limitation, we develop PLAS-Net (Pixel-level Litter Area Segmentor), an instance segmentation framework that extracts pixel-accurate physical footprints of coastal debris. Evaluated on UAV imagery from a monsoon-driven pocket beach in Koh Tao, Thailand, PLAS-Net achieves a mAP_50 of 58.7% with higher precision than eleven baseline models, demonstrating improved mask fidelity under complex coastal conditions. To illustrate how the accuracy of the masking affects the conclusions of environmental analysis, we conducted three downstream demonstrations: (i) power-law fitting of normalized plastic density (NPD) to characterize fragmentation dynamics; (ii) area-weighted ecological risk index (ERI) to map spatial pollution hotspots; and (iii) source composition analysis revealing the abundance-area paradox: fishing gear constitutes a small proportion of the total number of items, but has the largest physical area per unit item. Pixel-level area extraction can provide more valuable information for coastal monitoring compared to methods based solely on counting.

AI.tldr: 提出 PLAS-Net 像素级实例分割网络，用无人机影像精准度量海滩垃圾实际面积，克服传统框检测面积高估缺陷，并在下游生态风险分析中验证其必要性。
AI.motivation: 现有无人机监测仅用包围框估算垃圾面积，会系统性地高估不规则物体的平面占比，导致生态风险评估失真，亟需像素级精确面积数据。
AI.method: 设计 PLAS-Net 实例分割框架，实现海岸垃圾像素级 footprints 提取；在泰国 Koh Tao 季风口袋海滩无人机影像上训练验证，并与 11 种基线模型对比；随后开展三项下游任务：NPD 幂律拟合、面积加权 ERI 制图、来源组成解析。
AI.result: PLAS-Net mAP_50 达 58.7%，掩膜精度优于所有基线；发现“数量-面积悖论”：渔具件数少但单件面积最大；面积加权 pollution hotspots 与仅计数结果显著不同。
AI.conclusion: 像素级面积提取比单纯计数更能反映真实生态风险，应在海岸垃圾监测中作为标准指标推广。

title: TRAVELFRAUDBENCH: A Configurable Evaluation Framework for GNN Fraud Ring Detection in Travel Networks
summary: We introduce TravelFraudBench (TFG), a configurable benchmark for evaluating graph neural networks (GNNs) on fraud ring detection in travel platform graphs. Existing benchmarks--YelpChi, Amazon-Fraud, Elliptic, PaySim--cover single node types or domain-generic patterns with no mechanism to evaluate across structurally distinct fraud ring topologies. TFG simulates three travel-specific ring types--ticketing fraud (star topology with shared device/IP clusters), ghost hotel schemes (reviewer x hotel bipartite cliques), and account takeover rings (loyalty transfer chains)--in a heterogeneous graph with 9 node types and 12 edge types. Ring size, count, fraud rate, scale (500 to 200,000 nodes), and composition are fully configurable. We evaluate six methods--MLP, GraphSAGE, RGCN-proj, HAN, RGCN, and PC-GNN--under a ring-based split where each ring appears entirely in one partition, eliminating transductive label leakage. GraphSAGE achieves AUC=0.992 and RGCN-proj AUC=0.987, outperforming the MLP baseline (AUC=0.938) by 5.5 and 5.0 pp, confirming graph structure adds substantial discriminative power. HAN (AUC=0.935) is a negative result, matching the MLP baseline. On the ring recovery task (>=80% of ring members flagged simultaneously), GraphSAGE achieves 100% recovery across all ring types; MLP recovers only 17-88%. The edge-type ablation shows device and IP co-occurrence are the primary signals: removing uses_device drops AUC by 5.2 pp. TFG is released as an open-source Python package (MIT license) with PyG, DGL, and NetworkX exporters and pre-generated datasets at https://huggingface.co/datasets/bsajja7/travel-fraud-graphs, with Croissant metadata including Responsible AI fields.

AI.tldr: TravelFraudBench（TFG）是首个面向旅游场景、可配置的异构图欺诈环基准，证明图结构可显著提升检测精度并开源全套资源。
AI.motivation: 现有欺诈基准仅覆盖单节点类型或通用模式，缺乏对旅游平台中结构迥异欺诈环（票务环、幽灵酒店、账户盗用链）的系统评估手段。
AI.method: 构建含9 节点×12 边的可配置异构图生成器，模拟三种旅游专属欺诈环；提出“环级划分”消除标签泄漏，对比 MLP、GraphSAGE、RGCN-proj、HAN 等 6 种方法。
AI.result: GraphSAGE 与 RGCN-proj 分别达 AUC 0.992/0.987，较 MLP 提升 5.5/5.0 pp；GraphSAGE 在环恢复任务上 100% 找回全部环成员，而 MLP 仅 17–88%。边类型消融显示 device/IP 边是核心信号。
AI.conclusion: 图结构为旅游欺诈环检测带来显著增益；TFG 填补了领域基准空白，已开源数据集与生成工具以支持后续研究。

title: ReaGeo: Reasoning-Enhanced End-to-End Geocoding with LLMs
comment: 12 pages, 8 figures, submitted to ACM SIGSPATIAL 2024 (under review)
summary: This paper proposes ReaGeo, an end-to-end geocoding framework based on large language models, designed to overcome the limitations of traditional multi-stage approaches that rely on text or vector similarity retrieval over geographic databases, including workflow complexity, error propagation, and heavy dependence on structured geographic knowledge bases.
