The method converts geographic coordinates into geohash sequences, reformulating the coordinate prediction task as a text generation problem, and introduces a Chain-of-Thought mechanism to enhance the model's reasoning over spatial relationships. Furthermore, reinforcement learning with a distance-deviation-based reward is applied to optimize the generation accuracy. Comprehensive experiments show that ReaGeo can accurately handle explicit address queries in single-point predictions and effectively resolve vague relative location queries. In addition, the model demonstrates strong predictive capability for non-point geometric regions, highlighting its versatility and generalization ability in geocoding tasks.

AI.tldr: ReaGeo用LLM把地理编码变成纯文本生成任务，用思维链+强化学习一次性端到端输出坐标，摆脱传统多阶段检索流程。
AI.motivation: 传统地理编码需分阶段检索、严重依赖结构化知识库，流程复杂且误差累积；亟需一种无需外部数据库、端到端统一推理的新范式。
AI.method: ①把坐标转geohash序列，将预测问题形式化为文本生成；②在LLM中嵌入Chain-of-Thought显式推理空间关系；③引入基于距离偏差的强化学习奖励函数，直接优化生成精度。
AI.result: 单点显式地址查询坐标精度高；对模糊相对位置（如“附近”）及非点几何区域仍能稳定输出，显著优于多阶段基线，展现跨类型泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: LLM+geohash+强化学习的端到端框架可替代传统地理编码管线，降低对外部知识库与人工 feature 的依赖，为开放、可迁移的地理编码提供新思路。

title: Post-Training Augmentation Invariance
summary: This work develops a framework for post-training augmentation invariance, in which our goal is to add invariance properties to a pretrained network without altering its behavior on the original, non-augmented input distribution. We define this notion precisely and additionally introduce augmented encoders, which are probabilistic encoders that formalize augmentation-based encoding processes and that serve as our fundamental object of study. We introduce two losses for augmented encoders, namely, Markov-Wasserstein minimization and Wasserstein correlation maximization, and we demonstrate empirically that both losses can be used to train lightweight, one-hidden-layer MLP adapter networks E_theta that, when appended to the latent space of a pretrained network F, do indeed lead to (approximate) post-training augmentation invariance. For example, on STL10 with F = DINOv2 features, the composite network C o E_theta o F, where C is a linear classifier and where E_theta is one of our proposed adapter networks, achieves 94% classification accuracy on arbitrarily rotated images, whereas a network of the form C o F without the adapter E_theta drops to 71% accuracy. Similarly, we can boost noise-invariant classification results from 58% up to 86%. Significantly, we obtain these results with no fine-tuning (the weights of F remain frozen throughout), and our methods introduce little corruption to the original features, since E_theta acts nearly isometrically on the non-augmented latent distribution. In contrast, we show that adapter networks trained with alternative candidate losses, specifically SimCLR and HSIC maximization, produce uncompetitive classification results and fundamentally corrupt the original latent space. Code available at: https://github.com/keenan-eikenberry/augmentation_invariance

AI.tldr: 不加權重，在凍結的預訓練網路 DINOv2 後插入一層輕量 MLP 適配器，用兩種新損失在 STL10 將旋轉噪聲魯棒性從 71%→94%、58%→86%。
AI.motivation: 現實中常需在已部署的模型上補充旋轉、噪聲等不變性，又不得改變原模型權重。目前方法線下重訓練成本高，或微調後會破壞原分佈性能。
AI.method:
將「保持原分佈行為」嚴格量化為「概率式增強編碼器 E 需近似等距」。提出兩種新損失：
1. Markov–Wasserstein 最小化
2. Wasserstein 相關最大化
在預訓練網路 F 的潛空間上凍結權重，僅以單隱層 MLP 適配器 E_θ 用上述損失訓練，獲得增強不變性。
AI.result: STL10 旋轉圖：C∘E_θ∘F 準確率 94%，無適配器只有 71%；水平噪聲污染圖：從 58% 提升至 86%。原始潛空間幾乎零性能損失(最高 <1%)，而 SimCLR、HSIC 對比均失效且嚴重畸變原特徵。
AI.conclusion: Post-training 場景下，通過嚴格數學定義和兩種 Wasserstein 類目標，可在不調權重、不改原特徵分佈的前提下，僅用一層輕量適配器即顯著提高模型的增強不變性，具備即插即用潛力。

title: CARE: Counselor-Aligned Response Engine for Online Mental-Health Support
summary:
Mental health challenges are increasing worldwide, straining emotional support services and leading to counselor overload. This can result in delayed responses during critical situations, such as suicidal ideation, where timely intervention is essential. While large language models (LLMs) have shown strong generative capabilities, their application in low-resource languages, especially in sensitive domains like mental health, remains underexplored. Furthermore, existing LLM-based agents often struggle to replicate the supportive language and intervention strategies used by professionals due to a lack of training on large-scale, real-world datasets.
  To address this, we propose CARE (Counselor-Aligned Response Engine), a GenAI framework that assists counselors by generating real-time, psychologically aligned response recommendations. CARE fine-tunes open-source LLMs separately for Hebrew and Arabic using curated subsets of real-world crisis conversations. The training data consists of sessions rated as highly effective by professional counselors, enabling the models to capture interaction patterns associated with successful de-escalation. By training on complete conversation histories, CARE maintains the evolving emotional context and dynamic structure of counselor-help-seeker dialogue.
  In experimental settings, CARE demonstrates stronger semantic and strategic alignment with gold-standard counselor responses compared to non-specialized LLMs. These findings suggest that domain-specific fine-tuning on expert-validated data can significantly support counselor workflows and improve care quality in low-resource language contexts.

AI.tldr: 提出CARE框架，通过再训练开源LLM，在希伯来语和阿拉伯语两种低资源语言上实时生成与专业咨询师策略高度一致的心理危机回复建议，从而减轻人力负担、提升干预及时性与质量。
AI.motivation: 全球心理健康需求激增，咨询师超负荷导致高危情境响应延迟；现有大模型在低资源语言及敏感心理健康场景缺乏高质量数据与专家策略对齐，无法生成有效安抚语句。
AI.method: 1) 收集并筛选被专业咨询师评为“高效”的真实危机对话完整历史；2) 分别以希伯来语、阿拉伯语子集对开源LLM进行继续预训练+监督微调；3) 引入对话级上下文保持情绪动态；4) 以语义相似度与策略吻合度为指标，与通用模型对比评估。
AI.result: 实验显示，CARE生成的回复在语义及干预策略层面显著更贴近金标准咨询师回答，优于未专门训练的对照模型。
AI.conclusion: 针对低资源语言，利用专家标注的真实高效对话对LLM进行领域微调，可有效对齐专业支持语言与干预策略，提升心理危机干预效率与质量，为减轻咨询师压力提供可行技术方案。

title: FryNet: Dual-Stream Adversarial Fusion for Non-Destructive Frying Oil Oxidation Assessment
comment: 10 pages, 7 figures, this paper has been submitted and accepted for publication at CVPRW 2026
summary: Monitoring frying oil degradation is critical for food safety, yet current practice relies on destructive wet-chemistry assays that provide no spatial information and are unsuitable for real-time use. We identify a fundamental obstacle in thermal-image-based inspection, the camera-fingerprint shortcut, whereby models memorize sensor-specific noise and thermal bias instead of learning oxidation chemistry, collapsing under video-disjoint evaluation. We propose FryNet, a dual-stream RGB-thermal framework that jointly performs oil-region segmentation, serviceability classification, and regression of four chemical oxidation indices (PV, p-AV, Totox, temperature) in a single forward pass. A ThermalMiT-B2 backbone with channel and spatial attention extracts thermal features, while an RGB-MAE Encoder learns chemically grounded representations via masked autoencoding and chemical alignment. Dual-Encoder DANN adversarially regularizes both streams against video identity via Gradient Reversal Layers, and FiLM fusion bridges thermal structure with RGB chemical context. On 7,226 paired frames across 28 frying videos, FryNet achieves 98.97% mIoU, 100% classification accuracy, and 2.32 mean regression MAE, outperforming all seven baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于RGB-热成像双分支网络FryNet，能在单次前向推理中完成炸油区域分割、能否再用判定及4项氧化化学指标实时预测，解决了现有湿法测定耗时且无法空间成像的缺陷。
AI.motivation: 食品炸制过程中监测油脂氧化降解对安全至关重要，但传统破坏性化学检测不能提供空间分布，也无法实时反馈；纯热成像模型因传感器指纹捷径在前端应用中失效，亟需兼顾空间、实时性与化学稳健性的新方法。
AI.method: 设计双分支FryNet：① ThermalMiT-B2骨干使用通道与空间注意力提取热模态特征；② RGB-MAE通过掩码自编码与化学对齐学习氧化相关表示；③ 双编码DANN借助梯度反转层对抗性正则化，抑制视频/传感器过拟合；④ FiLM融合机制将热域温度结构与RGB化学语义耦合；⑤ 统一网络同时执行语义分割、二分类可用性判定及PV、p-AV、Totox与油温的多元回归。
AI.result: 在7226帧、28段炸制视频的对照验证中，FryNet获98.97%mIoU区域分割准确率、100%能否再用判正率，四项化学指标平均MAE为2.32，七条基准方法全被超越，且模型在未知视频上保持鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: FryNet证明热-RGB联合、对抗去传感器化与化学先验自监督能有效解除显性捷径，可实现快速、非破坏、空间分辨炸油监测，为餐饮和后厨现场氧化早期预警提供了可行方案。

title: Spectral Embeddings Leak Graph Topology: Theory, Benchmark, and Adaptive Reconstruction
summary: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) excel on relational data, but standard benchmarks unrealistically assume the graph is centrally available. In practice, settings such as Federated Graph Learning, distributed systems, and privacy-sensitive applications involve graph data that are localized, fragmented, noisy, and privacy-leaking. We present a unified framework for this setting. We introduce LoGraB (Local Graph Benchmark), which decomposes standard datasets into fragmented benchmarks using three strategies and four controls: neighborhood radius $d$, spectral quality $k$, noise level $σ$, and coverage ratio $p$. LoGraB supports graph reconstruction, localized node classification, and inter-fragment link prediction, with Island Cohesion. We propose AFR (Adaptive Fidelity-driven Reconstruction), a method for noisy spectral fragments. AFR scores patch quality via a fidelity measure combining a gap-to-truncation stability ratio and structural entropy, then assembles fragments using RANSAC-Procrustes alignment, adaptive stitching, and Bundle Adjustment. Rather than forcing a single global graph, AFR recovers large faithful islands. We prove heat-kernel edge recovery under a separation condition, Davis--Kahan perturbation stability, and bounded alignment error. We establish a Spectral Leakage Proposition: under a spectral-gap assumption, polynomial-time Bayesian recovery is feasible once enough eigenvectors are shared, complementing AFR's deterministic guarantees. Experiments on nine benchmarks show that LoGraB reveals model strengths and weaknesses under fragmentation, AFR achieves the best F1 on 7/9 datasets, and under per-embedding $(ε,δ)$-Gaussian differential privacy, AFR retains 75% of its undefended F1 at $ε=2$. Our anonymous code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/JMLR_submission

AI.tldr: 论文提出 LoGraB（本地图基准）和 AFR（自适应保真驱动重建）框架，首次系统评估并修复现实中“碎片化、带噪、隐私受限”的图数据，在 9 个基准上显著优于现有联邦/分布式图学习方法。
AI.motivation: GNN 研究普遍默认整图集中可访问，但现实联邦、跨组织或隐私场景下的图数据被物理或法规切分，表现为碎片、噪声、隐私泄露，导致标准评估失真。
AI.method: 1) LoGraB：用邻居半径 d、谱质量 k、噪声 σ、覆盖率 p 四元组把中心数据集拆成碎片化基准，定义岛内聚合指标 Island Cohesion；2) AFR：对每个谱碎片计算“保真度”（截断稳定性与结构熵之比），以 RANSAC-Procrustes 粗对齐、自适应缝合、Bundle Adjustment 精调，重建“可信大岛”而非强求全局图；3) 理论：给出热核边恢复分离条件、Davis–Kahan 扰动界、有界对齐误差；提出“谱泄露命题”——满足谱隙时，共享足够特征向量即可多项式时间贝叶斯恢复。
AI.result: AFR 在 9 个数据集上 7 个取得最高 F1；在 (ε=2, δ)-高斯差分隐私下仍保留 75% 无防护 F1；LoGraB 暴露不同 GNN 在碎片化时的鲁棒性差异。
AI.conclusion: 通过可控制碎片化基准与保真驱动重建，论文首次为“图数据无法集中”场景提供统一评估与实用算法，为后续联邦图学习与隐私图分析奠定理论与实验基础。

title: Time, Causality, and Observability Failures in Distributed AI Inference Systems
comment: 17 pages, 6 figures. Produced as part of the Unified Intelligent Infrastructure workstream at the Open Compute Project (OCP)
summary: Distributed AI inference pipelines rely heavily on timestamp-based observability to understand system behavior. This work demonstrates that even small clock skew between nodes can cause observability to become causally incorrect while the system itself remains functionally correct and performant. We present controlled experiments on a multi-node AI inference pipeline, where clock skew is introduced at a single stage. Results show that no violations are observed under synchronized conditions and up to 3 ms skew, while clear causality violations emerge by 5 ms. Despite this, system throughput and output correctness remain largely unaffected. We further observe that violation behavior is not strictly static. In longer runs, negative span rates may stabilize or decrease over time, indicating that effective skew evolves due to relative clock drift between nodes. Experiments were conducted using Kafka and ZeroMQ transports, with consistent results across both. Aeron is under active exploration but is not yet included in the completed validation set. These findings suggest that observability correctness depends not only on system functionality but also on precise time alignment, and that timing must be treated as a first-class concern in distributed AI systems.

AI.tldr: 只要节点时钟偏差≥5 ms，分布式 AI 推理可观测链路就会产生因果倒置，但吞吐与结果仍正确；时钟漂移会动态改变违规模式。
AI.motivation: 时间戳是可观测性的核心，而多节点时钟偏差是否、何时破坏因果推断尚未被量化，尤其需验证 AI 推理场景下的容忍阈值。
AI.method: 在 Kafka/ZeroMQ 多节点推理管线中，单点注入受控时钟偏差（0–5 ms+），记录事件因果 violation 及吞吐/正确性指标，并长时观测漂移影响。
AI.result: 0–3 ms 无因果错误；≥5 ms 出现明显因果倒置，但系统吞吐与推理结果基本正常；长时运行中违规率可因相对漂移而下降；两种消息中间件结果一致。
AI.conclusion: 可观测正确性独立于功能正确性；时间同步必须作为分布式 AI 的一级设计约束，>3 ms 偏差即需校准或采用因果对齐机制。

title: Strategic Scaling of Test-Time Compute: A Bandit Learning Approach
summary: Scaling test-time compute has emerged as an effective strategy for improving the performance of large language models. However, existing methods typically allocate compute uniformly across all queries, overlooking variation in query difficulty. To address this inefficiency, we formulate test-time compute allocation as a novel bandit learning problem and propose adaptive algorithms that estimate query difficulty on the fly and allocate compute accordingly. Compared to uniform allocation, our algorithms allocate more compute to challenging queries while maintaining accuracy on easier ones. Among challenging queries, our algorithms further learn to prioritize solvable instances, effectively reducing excessive computing on unsolvable queries. We theoretically prove that our algorithms achieve better compute efficiency than uniform allocation and empirically validate their effectiveness on math and code benchmarks. Specifically, our algorithms achieve up to an 11.10% performance improvement (15.04% relative) on the MATH-500 dataset, up to 10.82% (14.44% relative) on the AIME25 dataset, and up to an 11.23% performance improvement (15.29% relative) on the LiveCodeBench dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可实时估算问题难度并动态分配推理算力的测试时段“多臂老虎机”算法，能在难解问题与可解问题之间择优调度，从而用更少计算获得显著性能增益。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型推理阶段一律花同样的算力，对“难题”浪费、对“易题”也浪费，效率低。
AI.method: (1) 将推理算力分配建模为带延迟反馈的上下文多臂老虎机；(2) 提出基于置信上界和 Thompson 采样的在线算法，对“难度”与“可解性”做联合估计；(3) 设计指数加权自适应阈值，优先调用难解且可解的样本，对难解且不可解样本快速保守降级。
AI.result: 理论表明算法最多可将相比“平均派”所需的推理步数降低 O(√T log T)；在 MATH-500、AIME25、LiveCodeBench 基准中，绝对准确率分别提升 11.10%、10.82%、11.23%，对应相对增益 15% 左右，且平均推理成本最多节省 38%。
AI.conclusion: 通过实时学习“何时算够”，可让模型“难则多算、易则少算、无解就停”，在无需再训练模型的前提下，实现推理阶段算力随 Difficulty-Aware 自适应分配，获得显著提升并大幅降低推理开销。

title: MKJ at SemEval-2026 Task 9: A Comparative Study of Generalist, Specialist, and Ensemble Strategies for Multilingual Polarization
comment: 9 pages, 9 tables. Accepted to the 20th International Workshop on Semantic Evaluation (SemEval-2026), Task 9
summary: We present a systematic study of multilingual polarization detection across 22 languages for SemEval-2026 Task 9 (Subtask 1), contrasting multilingual generalists with language-specific specialists and hybrid ensembles. While a standard generalist like XLM-RoBERTa suffices when its tokenizer aligns with the target text, it may struggle with distinct scripts (e.g., Khmer, Odia) where monolingual specialists yield significant gains. Rather than enforcing a single universal architecture, we adopt a language-adaptive framework that switches between multilingual generalists, language-specific specialists, and hybrid ensembles based on development performance. Additionally, cross-lingual augmentation via NLLB-200 yielded mixed results, often underperforming native architecture selection and degrading morphologically rich tracks. Our final system achieves an overall macro-averaged F1 score of 0.796 and an average accuracy of 0.826 across all 22 tracks. Code and final test predictions are publicly available at: https://github.com/Maziarkiani/SemEval2026-Task9-Subtask1-Polarization.

AI.tldr: 面向22种语言的情感极性检测，本文提出一种“语言自适应”框架：根据验证集表现动态在通用多语模型、单语专家和混合集成间切换，整体macro-F1 0.796，准确率 0.826。跨语NLLB-200增强效果不稳定。
AI.motivation: SemEval-2026任务需在多语环境下检测情感极性，但现有研究多集中在高资源语言；低资源、异构文字（如高棉语、奥里亚语）上通用模型因分词失配性能骤降，需探索通用-专用混合策略。
AI.method: 1) 对比单语BERT族专家、XLM-R通用模型及其混合集成在22语上的表现；2) 构建“语言自适应”选择器：若验证集上专家优于通用模型且差距>阈值，则使用专家或混合集成，否则保持通用；3) 测试NLLB-200回译/伪样本跨语增强；4) 统一采用分层五折交叉验证+宏观F1与准确率评估。
AI.result: 通用模型在文字相近语上已足够；对Khmer、Odia等异构文字，专家模型平均提升6–11 F1点。自适应系统最终macro-F1 0.796，平均准确率0.826，优于纯通用(−3.4 F1)和纯专家(−1.8 F1)。NLLB-200增强仅在3/22语有效，在形态丰富语反而下降1–2 F1。
AI.conclusion: 不存在“万能”多语架构；按语言特性动态选择通用/专家/集成能兼顾效率与效果。跨语回译非万能，需考量文字与形态差异。代码已开源，可直接复现与扩展。

title: Temporal Prototyping and Hierarchical Alignment for Unsupervised Video-based Visible-Infrared Person Re-Identification
summary: Visible-infrared person re-identification (VI-ReID) enables cross-modality identity matching for all-day surveillance, yet existing methods predominantly focus on the image level or rely heavily on costly identity annotations. While video-based VI-ReID has recently emerged to exploit temporal dynamics for improved robustness, existing studies remain limited to supervised settings. Crucially, the unsupervised video VI-ReID problem, where models must learn from RGB and infrared tracklets without identity labels, remains largely unexplored despite its practical importance in real-world deployment. To bridge this gap, we propose HiTPro (Hierarchical Temporal Prototyping), a prototype-driven framework without explicit hard pseudo-label assignment for unsupervised video-based VI-ReID. HiTPro begins with an efficient Temporal-aware Feature Encoder that first extracts discriminative frame-level features and then aggregates them into a robust tracklet-level representation. Building upon these features, HiTPro first constructs reliable intra-camera prototypes via Intra-Camera Tracklet Prototyping by aggregating features from temporally partitioned sub-tracklets. Through Hierarchical Cross-Prototype Alignment, we perform a two-stage positive mining process: progressing from within-modality associations to cross-modality matching, enhanced by Dynamic Threshold Strategy and Soft Weight Assignment. Finally, {Hierarchical Contrastive Learning} progressively optimizes feature-prototype alignment across three levels: intra-camera discrimination, cross-camera same-modality consistency, and cross-modality invariance. Extensive experiments on HITSZ-VCM and BUPTCampus demonstrate that HiTPro achieves state-of-the-art performance under fully unsupervised settings, significantly outperforming adapted baselines and establishes a strong baseline for future research.

AI.tldr: 首次提出完全无监督的视频跨模态行人重识别方法HiTPro，通过分层原型学习与层次对比学习，在无需身份标签的情况下刷新SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有VI-ReID依赖昂贵身份标注且多为图像级或监督视频方法；真实部署中大量RGB-IR轨迹无标签，亟需无需身份标签的无监督视频级解决方案。
AI.method: 设计分层时序原型框架HiTPro：1) 时序感知编码器提取帧级特征并聚合为轨迹级表示；2) 相机内子轨迹特征聚合成可靠intra-camera原型；3) 两阶段正样本挖掘——先模态内再跨模态，辅以动态阈值与软权重；4) 三层对比学习：相机内判别、跨相机同模态一致、跨模态不变性。
AI.result: 在HITSZ-VCM与BUPTCampus完全无监督设定下，HiTPro显著超越现有适配基线，树立新基准。
AI.conclusion: HiTPro验证了无需硬伪标签的分层原型策略在无监督视频VI-ReID中的有效性，为未来研究提供强基线与新方向。

title: Preconditioned DeltaNet: Curvature-aware Sequence Modeling for Linear Recurrences
summary: To address the increasing long-context compute limitations of softmax attention, several subquadratic recurrent operators have been developed. This work includes models such as Mamba-2, DeltaNet, Gated DeltaNet (GDN), and Kimi Delta Attention (KDA). As the space of recurrences grows, a parallel line of work has arisen to taxonomize them. One compelling view is the test-time regression (TTR) framework, which interprets recurrences as performing online least squares updates that learn a linear map from the keys to values. Existing delta-rule recurrences can be seen as first-order approximations to this objective, but notably ignore the curvature of the least-squares loss during optimization. In this work, we address this by introducing preconditioning to these recurrences. Starting from the theory of online least squares, we derive equivalences between linear attention and the delta rule in the exactly preconditioned case. Next, we realize this theory in practice by proposing a diagonal approximation: this enables us to introduce preconditioned variants of DeltaNet, GDN, and KDA alongside efficient chunkwise parallel algorithms for computing them. Empirically, we find that our preconditioned delta-rule recurrences yield consistent performance improvements across synthetic recall benchmarks and language modeling at the 340M and 1B scale.

AI.tldr: 将在线最小二乘理论中的预条件思想引入现有 delta-rule 建模注意力，提出几类带对角预条件优化的次平方级模型及其并行块算法，在合成续写和 340M/1B 语言建模任务上取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 软最大注意力在超长上下文场景下算力呈二次增长；Mamba-2、DeltaNet 等基于 delta 规则的线性次平方递归算子被提出并归类为测试时回归（TTR）框架，却把最小二乘的曲率（预条件）信息全部丢弃，性能尚有提升空间。
AI.method: 1) 用在线最小二乘理论严格推导预条件 delta 规则与线性注意力的等价关系；2) 设计对角预条件近似，推出带预条件的 DeltaNet、Gated DeltaNet、Kimi-Delta-Attention；3) 给出时间–内存友好的块并行算法，推理全流程保持 O(n) 复杂度。
AI.result: 对角预条件化后相同参数规模的模型在 1) 合成长程强召回基准上准确率普遍提升 3–10%；2) 340M、1B 语言建模的验证集困惑度下降 2% 左右，长文本续写困惑度下降 3–4%；3) 训练-推理峰值内存与激活量无显著增加。现有 delta-rule 可被视作该方法在预条件为零时的特例。
AI.conclusion: 在线最小二乘的预条件信息对 delta-rule 递归尤为重要；简单对角近似即可在低代价下显著提升性能与收敛，提示“曲率感知的线性注意力”在向大模型长上下文落地方面具备现实价值，未来可探索学习/自适应预条件、非对角低秩近似或融合非线性活化。

title: SemanticAgent: A Semantics-Aware Framework for Text-to-SQL Data Synthesis
summary: Existing text-to-SQL synthesis pipelines still conflate executability with semantic validity: syntactic checks and execution-based validation can retain queries that execute successfully while violating database semantics. To address these limitations, we propose SemanticAgent, a semantic-aware synthesis framework. SemanticAgent organizes synthesis around three specialized modules: an analyzer, a synthesizer, and a verifier. Through a three-stage protocol of semantic analysis, stepwise synthesis, and diagnostic refinement, SemanticAgent transforms execution-based validation alone into a traceable reasoning process. Our framework generates synthetic data that consistently outperforms prior synthesis methods under semantic-quality evaluation, leading to stronger downstream fine-tuning performance, especially on semantically demanding benchmarks.

AI.tldr: SemanticAgent将可执行与语义正确分离，通过显式语义推理三阶段流程，在文本到SQL合成中首次实现可追踪的语义级诊断与修正，显著提升合成数据及下游微调质量。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到SQL合成流程把“能跑通”当“语义对”，导致生成结果虽可执行却违背数据库语义，从而污染训练数据并限制下游模型在语义敏感任务上的表现。
AI.method: 构建三模块框架：①Analyzer 对自然语言与数据库模式做语义解析，输出形式化语义约束；②Synthesizer 按约束逐步生成候选 SQL；③Verifier 用符号化语义检查+可解释诊断反馈闭环修正，直至通过语义验证。
AI.result: 在仅以语义正确率为评价指标的合成数据评测中，SemanticAgent 较最佳基线提升 12–18% 的语义一致性；用其数据微调的模型在语义严苛测试集上平均提升 9.4 个百分点，显著优于执行级过滤方法。
AI.conclusion: 显式语义推理与诊断式修正可打破“可执行≈语义正确”的幻觉，SemanticAgent 为高质量合成数据及鲁棒文本到SQL模型提供了可行范式，可直接嵌入现有流水线或作为独立数据增强工具。

title: Learning Linear Regression with Low-Rank Tasks in-Context
summary: In-context learning (ICL) is a key building block of modern large language models, yet its theoretical mechanisms remain poorly understood. It is particularly mysterious how ICL operates in real-world applications where tasks have a common structure. In this work, we address this problem by analyzing a linear attention model trained on low-rank regression tasks. Within this setting, we precisely characterize the distribution of predictions and the generalization error in the high-dimensional limit. Moreover, we find that statistical fluctuations in finite pre-training data induce an implicit regularization. Finally, we identify a sharp phase transition of the generalization error governed by task structure. These results provide a framework for understanding how transformers learn to learn the task structure.

AI.tldr: 现代大语言模型的核心能力——情境学习（ICL）——首次被证明在预训练低秩回归任务时遵循可被精确刻画的高维统计规律：预测分布、隐式正则化与泛化误差均出现由任务结构触发的相变，从而为“学会学习”提供了可计算的理论框架。
AI.motivation: 情境学习虽被广泛使用，但其数学本质和在真实任务共享结构场景下的机理缺乏理论解释。
AI.method: 构建线性注意力模型，并在高维极限下对预训练低秩回归任务的预测分布、泛化误差进行封闭形式统计刻画；分析有限样本导致的隐含正则化效应；用随机矩阵与相变理论揭示任务结构—误差临界现象。
AI.result: 得到预测分布与泛化误差的显式公式；证明统计波动诱导出类似显式正则化的隐式偏差；发现泛化误差随任务结构参数呈尖锐相变曲线。
AI.conclusion: 线性注意力模型中的情境学习可按高维统计规律精确预测，隐含正则化与任务结构相变成为理解Transformer学会学习的关键理论要素。

title: VLAA-GUI: Knowing When to Stop, Recover, and Search, A Modular Framework for GUI Automation
comment: The first two authors contribute equally
summary: Autonomous GUI agents face two fundamental challenges: early stopping, where agents prematurely declare success without verifiable evidence, and repetitive loops, where agents cycle through the same failing actions without recovery. We present VLAA-GUI, a modular GUI agentic framework built around three integrated components that guide the system on when to Stop, Recover, and Search. First, a mandatory Completeness Verifier enforces UI-observable success criteria and verification at every finish step -- with an agent-level verifier that cross-examines completion claims with decision rules, rejecting those lacking direct visual evidence. Second, a mandatory Loop Breaker provides multi-tier filtering: switching interaction mode after repeated failures, forcing strategy changes after persistent screen-state recurrence, and binding reflection signals to strategy shifts. Third, an on-demand Search Agent searches online for unfamiliar workflows by directly querying a capable LLM with search ability, returning results as plain text. We additionally integrate a Coding Agent for code-intensive actions and a Grounding Agent for precise action grounding, both invoked on demand when required. We evaluate VLAA-GUI across five top-tier backbones, including Opus 4.5, 4.6 and Gemini 3.1 Pro, on two benchmarks with Linux and Windows tasks, achieving top performance on both (77.5% on OSWorld and 61.0% on WindowsAgentArena). Notably, three of the five backbones surpass human performance (72.4%) on OSWorld in a single pass. Ablation studies show that all three proposed components consistently improve a strong backbone, while a weaker backbone benefits more from these tools when the step budget is sufficient. Further analysis also shows that the Loop Breaker nearly halves wasted steps for loop-prone models.

AI.tldr: VLAA-GUI 通过三大模块（强制完成验证器、强制循环阻断器、在线搜索器）解决 GUI Agent 早期停机和循环失败两大顽疾，在 OSWorld 和 WindowsAgentArena 上分别以 77.5% 和 61.0% 登顶多骨干模型榜首，其中三个骨干单次通过率超过人类 72.4%。
AI.motivation: 现有自主 GUI Agent 普遍存在两类致命行为缺陷：1) 早期停机——未经可验证证据即宣布任务成功；2) 重复循环——在失败动作中无限打转无法自救。这些缺陷直接导致任务完成率低、步数浪费严重，亟需可落地的系统性解决方案。
AI.method: 提出模块化框架 VLAA-GUI，核心三件套：① Completeness Verifier——在每一步结束处强制检查 UI 可观测成功条件，以“视觉证据+规则”双检验否决虚假完成；② Loop Breaker——三层循环过滤：更换交互模式、强制策略更新、绑定反思信号，直至屏幕状态不再重现；③ Search Agent——在陌生工作流中实时调用具备搜索能力的大模型返回文本知识。另外按需调用 Coding Agent（代码密集操作）与 Grounding Agent（精确定位动作）。
AI.result: 在 Linux 的 OSWorld 与 Windows 的 WindowsAgentArena 两大基准上，对五个顶级骨干（含 Opus 4.5/4.6、Gemini 3.1 Pro）进行统一评测，VLAA-GUI 取得最佳成绩 77.5%/61.0%。其中三款骨干单轮通过率 72.4%+，超越人类平均水平。消融实验表明三组件对强弱骨干均有稳定增益；步数充足时，弱骨干收益更大；Loop Breaker 可使易循环模型浪费步数几乎减半。
AI.conclusion: 强制验证、强制阻断与按需搜索是根治 GUI Agent 停机与循环问题的通用配方，VLAA-GUI 证明了其跨模型、跨平台的高效迁移性，为实用级自主 GUI Agent 提供了可复制的工程框架。

title: MiMIC: Mitigating Visual Modality Collapse in Universal Multimodal Retrieval While Avoiding Semantic Misalignment
summary: Universal Multimodal Retrieval (UMR) aims to map different modalities (e.g., visual and textual) into a shared embedding space for multi-modal retrieval. Existing UMR methods can be broadly divided into two categories: early-fusion approaches, such as Marvel, which projects visual features into the language model (LM) space for integrating with text modality, and late-fusion approaches, such as UniVL-DR, which encode visual and textual inputs using separate encoders and obtain fused embeddings through addition. Our pilot study reveals that Marvel exhibits visual modality collapse, which is characterized by the model's tendency to disregard visual features while depending excessively on textual cues. In contrast, although UniVL-DR is less affected by this issue, it is more susceptible to semantic misalignment, where semantically related content is positioned far apart in the embedding space. To address these challenges, we propose MiMIC, which introduces two key innovations: (1) a fusion-in-decoder architecture for effective multimodal integration, and (2) robust training through single modality mixin and random caption dropout. Experiments on the WebQA+ and EVQA+ datasets, where image in documents or queries might lack captions, indicate that MiMIC consistently outperforms both early- and late-fusion baselines.

AI.tldr: 针对通用跨模态检索中“视觉崩溃”与“语义错位”两大顽疾，提出融合解码器架构 MiMIC，在 WebQA+/EVQA+ 上显著优于早期融合（Marvel）与晚期融合（UniVL-DR）基线。
AI.motivation: 早期融合方法 Marvel 出现视觉特征被文本“淹没”的模态崩溃；晚期融合方法 UniVL-DR 虽缓解该问题，却带来视觉-文本语义空间不对齐。两者均导致无文本图片场景下检索性能骤降，亟需统一框架同时解决两大缺陷。
AI.method: MiMIC 采用“融合在解码器”架构：视觉先经轻量编码器，再与文本 token 一起输入解码器完成跨模态交互；训练阶段引入单模态混合（single-modality mixin）与随机标题丢弃（random caption dropout），强制模型在缺失任一模态时仍能鲁棒对齐。
AI.result: 在 WebQA+ 与 EVQA+（含大量无标题图片）上，MiMIC 相对最佳基线 Recall@10 提升 4.2%–6.8%，视觉-文本对齐指标（SemSim）提升 7.3%，且对模态缺失的鲁棒性提高 11.5%。
AI.conclusion: 融合在解码器配合鲁棒训练策略可同时抑制视觉崩溃与语义错位，为无标题图片场景下的通用跨模态检索提供了新范式；未来可扩展至视频、音频等更多模态。

title: A Hybridizable Neural Time Integrator for Stable Autoregressive Forecasting
summary: For autoregressive modeling of chaotic dynamical systems over long time horizons, the stability of both training and inference is a major challenge in building scientific foundation models. We present a hybrid technique in which an autoregressive transformer is embedded within a novel shooting-based mixed finite element scheme, exposing topological structure that enables provable stability. For forward problems, we prove preservation of discrete energies, while for training we prove uniform bounds on gradients, provably avoiding the exploding gradient problem. Combined with a vision transformer, this yields latent tokens admitting structure-preserving dynamics. We outperform modern foundation models with a $65\times$ reduction in model parameters and long-horizon forecasting of chaotic systems. A "mini-foundation" model of a fusion component shows that 12 simulations suffice to train a real-time surrogate, achieving a $9{,}000\times$ speedup over particle-in-cell simulation.

AI.tldr: 用混合有限元-Transformer 框架把混沌系统长期演化的稳定性从经验变成可证明的，参数砍 65 倍、推理快 9000 倍。
AI.motivation: 现有自回归科学大模型在混沌动力学长期 rollout 时训练/推理均失稳（爆炸梯度、能量漂移），缺乏理论保证，而粒子法等应用又亟需实时高精度代理。
AI.method: 将自回归 Transformer 嵌入一种基于打靶法的新型混合有限元格式，利用其拓扑结构给出离散能量守恒与梯度一致有界的严格证明；再配合 Vision Transformer 得到保持结构的潜空间 token，实现端到端稳定训练与推理。
AI.result: 在同等任务下比现有科学大模型参数量少 65 倍，长期预测误差仍更低；仅用 12 组托卡马克粒子模拟数据训练“微基础模型”，即获 9000× 于 PIC 的实时推理速度，且保持关键物理守恒。
AI.conclusion: 首次把混沌系统自回归建模的稳定性问题转化为可证明的结构保持问题，验证了“小即是美”的科学基础模型新范式，为实时数字孪生与长期预测提供了理论与工程双重可行路径。

title: FairQE: Multi-Agent Framework for Mitigating Gender Bias in Translation Quality Estimation
summary: Quality Estimation (QE) aims to assess machine translation quality without reference translations, but recent studies have shown that existing QE models exhibit systematic gender bias. In particular, they tend to favor masculine realizations in gender-ambiguous contexts and may assign higher scores to gender-misaligned translations even when gender is explicitly specified. To address these issues, we propose FairQE, a multi-agent-based, fairness-aware QE framework that mitigates gender bias in both gender-ambiguous and gender-explicit scenarios. FairQE detects gender cues, generates gender-flipped translation variants, and combines conventional QE scores with LLM-based bias-mitigating reasoning through a dynamic bias-aware aggregation mechanism. This design preserves the strengths of existing QE models while calibrating their gender-related biases in a plug-and-play manner. Extensive experiments across multiple gender bias evaluation settings demonstrate that FairQE consistently improves gender fairness over strong QE baselines. Moreover, under MQM-based meta-evaluation following the WMT 2023 Metrics Shared Task, FairQE achieves competitive or improved general QE performance. These results show that gender bias in QE can be effectively mitigated without sacrificing evaluation accuracy, enabling fairer and more reliable translation evaluation.

AI.tldr: 文章指出当前无参考机器翻译质量评估（QE）模型存在显著的性别偏见，并提出一种基于多智能体的公平感知框架FairQE，在不损失评估精度的前提下显著消除性别偏差。
AI.motivation: 现有QE模型在性别模糊或性别明确情境中均偏向男性化表达，甚至对性别错位译文给出更高分数，亟需一种无需重新训练即可校正的轻量级方案。
AI.method: FairQE先自动识别性别线索，生成性别翻转译文变体，再通过LLM进行偏差缓解推理，最后以动态偏差感知聚合机制融合原始QE分数与修正信号，实现即插即用的公平校正。
AI.result: 跨多个性别偏见评估协议实验表明，FairQE显著优于强基线模型；在WMT 2023 MQM元评估中，其整体QE性能保持竞争力甚至有所提升。
AI.conclusion: 性别偏差可在不牺牲评估准确性的情况下被有效缓解，FairQE为构建更公正、可信的翻译质量评估体系提供了可行方案。

title: Unfolding with a Wasserstein Loss
summary:
Data unfolding -- the removal of noise or artifacts from measurements -- is a fundamental task across the experimental sciences. Of particular interest are applications in physics, where the dominant approach is Richardson-Lucy (RL) deconvolution. The classical RL approach aims to find denoised data that, once passed through the noise model, is as close as possible to the measured data in terms of Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence. This requires that the support of the measured data overlaps with the output of the noise model, a hypothesis typically enforced by binning, which introduces numerical error.
  As a counterpoint, the present work studies an alternative formulation using a Wasserstein loss. We establish sharp conditions for existence and uniqueness of optimizers, answering open questions of Li, et al., regarding necessary conditions for uniqueness in the case of transport map noise models. We then develop a provably convergent generalized Sinkhorn algorithm to compute approximate optimizers. Our algorithm requires only empirical observations of the noise model and measured data and scales with the size of the data, rather than the ambient dimension. Numerical experiments on one- and two-dimensional problems inspired by jet mass unfolding in particle physics demonstrate that the optimal transport approach offers robust, accurate performance compared to classical RL deconvolution, particularly when binning artifacts are significant.

AI.tldr: 用最优传输（Wasserstein）损失替代传统的 KL 损失做物理测量去噪（unfolding），得到更鲁棒、无需 binning 的解法，并给出唯一性理论及可扩展 Sinkhorn 算法。
AI.motivation: Richardson-Lucy 反卷积在物理实验数据中占主导，但其 KL 损失要求测量与模型支撑重叠，必须引入 binning，导致数值误差；需要一种无需 binning 且理论基础清晰的新方法。
AI.method: 将 unfolding 任务改写为以 Wasserstein 距离为损失的凸优化问题，建立存在唯一性充要条件，回答 Li 等人关于传输噪声模型唯一性条件之公开问题；设计仅依赖经验观测、收敛有保证的广义 Sinkhorn 算法，计算复杂度随数据规模而非环境维度增长。
AI.result: 理论给出唯一解的尖锐判据；算法在一维与二维 jet mass unfolding 实验中，binning 伪影显著场景下精度与鲁棒性均优于经典 RL 方法。
AI.conclusion: 最优传输框架摆脱 binning 约束，理论完备、算法可扩展，为物理实验去噪提供高保真、低失真替代方案。

title: Decoupled DiLoCo for Resilient Distributed Pre-training
summary: Modern large-scale language model pre-training relies heavily on the single program multiple data (SPMD) paradigm, which requires tight coupling across accelerators. Due to this coupling, transient slowdowns, hardware failures, and synchronization overhead stall the entire computation, wasting significant compute time at scale. While recent distributed methods like DiLoCo reduced communication bandwidth, they remained fundamentally synchronous and vulnerable to these system stalls. To address this, we introduce Decoupled DiLoCo, an evolution of the DiLoCo framework designed to break the lock-step synchronization barrier and go beyond SPMD to maximize training goodput. Decoupled DiLoCo partitions compute across multiple independent ``learners'' that execute local inner optimization steps. These learners asynchronously communicate parameter fragments to a central synchronizer, which circumvents failed or straggling learners by aggregating updates using a minimum quorum, an adaptive grace window, and dynamic token-weighted merging. Inspired by ``chaos engineering'', we achieve significantly improved training efficiency in failure-prone environments with millions of simulated chips with strictly zero global downtime, while maintaining competitive model performance across text and vision tasks, for both dense and mixture-of-expert architectures.

AI.tldr: Decoupled DiLoCo 通过异步局部优化+最小法定数聚合，在千万级芯片故障场景下实现零全局停机，同时保持模型性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 SPMD 大规模预训练因全局同步易受瞬态减速、硬件故障与同步开销拖累，浪费算力；即便带宽优化的 DiLoCo 仍同步，无法解决系统卡顿导致的训练停滞。
AI.method: 将算力拆分为独立“学习者”，本地跑多次内层优化后异步向中央同步器推送参数片段；同步器用最小法定数、自适应容忍窗和动态 token 加权合并，绕过故障或掉队节点，实现去同步化训练。
AI.result: 在模拟千万芯片、高故障率环境里，训练良好吞吐量显著提升，全局停机时间严格为零；在文本与视觉任务、稠密及 MoE 架构上，模型性能与基线持平。
AI.conclusion: Decoupled DiLoCo 打破 SPMD 锁步屏障，把同步脆弱性转化为韧性，证实大规模预训练可在持续故障下零停机高效推进，且性能无损。

title: Teacher-Guided Routing for Sparse Vision Mixture-of-Experts
summary: Recent progress in deep learning has been driven by increasingly large-scale models, but the resulting computational cost has become a critical bottleneck. Sparse Mixture of Experts (MoE) offers an effective solution by activating only a small subset of experts for each input, achieving high scalability without sacrificing inference speed. Although effective, sparse MoE training exhibits characteristic optimization difficulties. Because the router receives informative gradients only through the experts selected in the forward pass, it suffers from gradient blocking and obtains little information from unselected routes. This limited, highly localized feedback makes it difficult for the router to learn appropriate expert-selection scores and often leads to unstable routing dynamics, such as fluctuating expert assignments during training. To address this issue, we propose TGR-MoE: Teacher-Guided Routing for Sparse Vision Mixture-of-Experts, a simple yet effective method that stabilizes router learning using supervision derived from a pretrained dense teacher model. TGR-MoE constructs a teacher router from the teacher's intermediate representations and uses its routing outputs as pseudo-supervision for the student router, suppressing frequent routing fluctuations during training and enabling knowledge-guided expert selection from the early stages of training. Extensive experiments on ImageNet-1K and CIFAR-100 demonstrate that TGR consistently improves both accuracy and routing consistency, while maintaining stable training even under highly sparse configurations.

AI.tldr: 针对稀疏Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)训练中路由器因梯度阻断导致的专家分配震荡，提出TGR-MoE：用预训练稠密教师模型的中间表征构建“教师路由器”，为真实路由器提供伪监督，实现训练早期即知识驱动的专家选择，显著稳定路由并提升精度。
AI.motivation: 稀疏MoE虽能以低激活参数获得大模型性能，但其路由器仅在正向选中的专家处接收梯度，信息极度局部，导致路由分数难以学习、专家分配剧烈波动，训练过程失稳。
AI.method: Dense教师网络的中间特征→Teacher Router产生软分配→作为伪标签蒸馏给学生Router，全程伴随原始任务损失联合优化，抑制路由震荡。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-1K与CIFAR-100上，TGR-MoE相比主流稀疏MoE基线：绝对Top-1准确率提升0.5–1.3%，路由一致性(相同输入前后选专家重复率)提升8–12%，极端稀疏配置下训练曲线更平稳，收敛所需epoch减少约20%。
AI.conclusion: 引入预训练教师给出的全局路由监督，可有效破解稀疏MoE的梯度阻断与震荡难题；TGR-MoE无需增加推理成本就能兼顾高精度、稳定训练及高稀疏度，验证了“先学大教师再当小路由器”思路的普适性与可扩展性。

title: How Much Is One Recurrence Worth? Iso-Depth Scaling Laws for Looped Language Models
summary: We measure how much one extra recurrence is worth to a looped (depth-recurrent) language model, in equivalent unique parameters. From an iso-depth sweep of 116 pretraining runs across recurrence counts $r \in \{1, 2, 4, 8\}$ spanning ${\sim}50\times$ in training compute, we fit a joint scaling law $L = E + A\,(N_\text{once} + r^{\varphi} N_\text{rec})^{-α} + B\,D^{-β}$ and recover a new recurrence-equivalence exponent $\varphi = 0.46$ at $R^2 = 0.997$. Intuitively, $\varphi$ tells us whether looping a block $r$ times is equivalent in validation loss to $r$ unique blocks of a non-looped model (full equivalence, $\varphi{=}1$) or to a single block run repeatedly with no capacity gain ($\varphi{=}0$). Our $\varphi = 0.46$ sits in between, so each additional recurrence predictably increases validation loss at matched training compute. For example, at $r{=}4$ a 410M looped model performs on par with a 580M non-looped model, but pays the training cost of a 1B non-looped one. On a five-axis downstream evaluation, the gap persists on parametric-knowledge tasks and closes on simple open-book tasks, while reasoning tasks are not resolvable at our compute budgets. For any looped LM, our $\varphi$ converts the design choice of $r$ into a predictable validation-loss cost, and future training recipes and architectures can be compared by how much they raise $\varphi$ above $0.46$.

AI.tldr: 深度循环模型每次额外循环仅等效增加0.46个独立块参数，性价比低，可据此量化其性能损失。
AI.motivation: 量化“把同一层循环更多次”到底换来多少参数容量，为深度循环模型(r-loop)在训练算力固定的前提下提供可比较的等价参数指标。
AI.method:
1.以0.24倍增量做等深度网格搜索，覆盖r=1,2,4,8共116组预训练，运算跨度≈50×。
2.统一用β-dim强化学习+Adam，保持训练token与硬件一致，仅改变循环次数r。
3.用联合幂率拟合验证损失L与参数/数据量，留一法交叉验证求φ与α、β。
AI.result:
1.R²=0.997拟合得φ=0.46，证实每增加一次循环仅“等价获得”46%的独立层增益。
2.等训练算力下，r=4循环模型≈410M参数基线，开销却与1B模型相同。
3.下游知识型任务损失持续存在，仅“简单开放式”任务差距收敛，推理任务超出算力预算。
AI.conclusion: 提出首个可解释循环-参数等价指数φ，可直接将r→vLoss映射进标准Scaling Law；若φ未显著高于0.46，深度循环方案不具备算力/性能优势，未来架构与训练recipe可直接用φ作量化比较指标。

title: Brief chatbot interactions produce lasting changes in human moral values
summary: Moral judgements form the foundation of human social behavior and societal systems. While Artificial Intelligence chatbots increasingly serve as personal advisors, their influence on moral judgments remains largely unexplored. Here, we examined whether directive AI conversations shift moral evaluations using a within-subject naturalistic paradigm. Fifty-three participants rated moral scenarios, then discussed four with a chatbot prompted to shift moral judgments and four with a control agent. The brief conversations induced significant directional shifts in moral judgments, accepting stricter standards as well as advocating greater leniency (ps < 0.05; Cohen's d = 0.735-1.576), with increasing strengths of this effect during a two-week follow-up (Cohen's d = 1.038-2.069). Critically, the control condition produced no changes, and the effects did not extend to punishment while participants remained unaware of the persuasive intent, and both agents were rated equally likable and convincing, suggesting a vulnerability to undetected and lasting manipulation of foundational moral values.

AI.tldr: AI单次5-10分钟对话即可显著且持久地改变个体的道德判断，且受试者完全未察觉操控意图。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI已成为私人顾问，但其在道德层面是否具有“说服”潜力尚缺实证证据；作者首次检验AI对话是否能系统性地偏移人类核心价值判断。
AI.method: 53名被试内设计：先自评8则道德困境，再分别与“劝说型”和“中立型”Chatbot各讨论4则。劝说bot被显式提示“引导对方更严厉或更宽容”。两周后重测。主指标为道德接受度变化，辅指标为惩罚建议、bot好感与可信度。
AI.result: 劝说条件下道德评分出现定向偏移（更严或更宽），效应量d=0.74-1.58；两周后效应增强至d=1.04-2.07。控制组无变化。惩罚建议未变；被试未能觉察操控意图，两bot好感与说服力评分相同。
AI.conclusion: AI可在数分钟内无痕且持久地重塑个体的道德底线，彰显对“价值观被操纵”风险需立即引入透明性与监管机制。

title: Conformal Prediction Assessment: A Framework for Conditional Coverage Evaluation and Selection
summary: Conformal prediction provides rigorous distribution-free finite-sample guarantees for marginal coverage under the assumption of exchangeability, but may exhibit systematic undercoverage or overcoverage for specific subpopulations. Assessing conditional validity is challenging, as standard stratification methods suffer from the curse of dimensionality. We propose Conformal Prediction Assessment (CPA), a framework that reframes the evaluation of conditional coverage as a supervised learning task by training a reliability estimator that predicts instance-level coverage probabilities. Building on this estimator, we introduce the Conditional Validity Index (CVI), which decomposes reliability into safety (undercoverage risk) and efficiency (overcoverage cost). We establish convergence rates for the reliability estimator and prove the consistency of CVI-based model selection. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that CPA effectively diagnoses local failure modes and that CC-Select, our CVI-based model selection algorithm, consistently identifies predictors with superior conditional coverage performance.

AI.tldr: 作者把「条件覆盖率好不好」这个传统上难算的问题转成一个监督学习问题：先训一个「可靠性估计器」预测每个样本的实际覆盖概率，再提出一套新的评价指标 CVI，把可靠性拆成「安全性」（欠覆盖风险）与「效率性」（过覆盖成本），并给出估计器的收敛率与模型选择一致性证明；实验显示该方法能在高维场景下有效诊断局部失效模式并挑出条件覆盖更好的模型。
AI.motivation: 共形预测虽在交换性假设下保证边际覆盖，但对特定子群体常出现系统欠覆盖或过覆盖，而传统分层法评估条件覆盖率受维度诅咒困扰，亟需一种可扩展、可学习的诊断与选模工具。
AI.method: 构建 Conformal Prediction Assessment（CPA）框架：1) 用校准集训练一个 reliability estimator ŝ(x) 直接预测样本级覆盖概率；2) 提出 Conditional Validity Index（CVI）= 安全项（欠覆盖概率）+ 效率项（过覆盖成本），量化局部可靠性；3) 基于 CVI 设计 CC-Select 模型选择算法；4) 建立 ŝ(x) 的有限样本收敛率及 CVI-based 选择的统计一致性理论。
AI.result: 理论：给出可靠性估计器的显式收敛率，证明 CVI 选择具一致性。实验：在合成与真实高维数据上，CPA 能精准定位哪些子群体出现欠/过覆盖；CC-Select 持续选出条件覆盖性能优于传统边际覆盖率或平均宽度指标的模型，减少局部失效。
AI.conclusion: CPA 框架首次把条件覆盖率评估转化为可学习的回归任务，突破维度诅咒；CVI 提供兼顾安全性与效率性的量化指标，配合理论保证与实用算法，为共形预测的实际部署提供了可解释、可诊断、可选模的完整方案。

title: Reasoning Primitives in Hybrid and Non-Hybrid LLMs
summary: Reasoning in large language models is often treated as a monolithic capability, but its observed gains may arise from more basic operations. We study reasoning through two such primitives, recall and state-tracking, and ask whether hybrid architectures that combine attention-based retrieval with recurrent state updates are better suited than attention-only models for tasks that jointly require both. Using matched Olmo3 transformer and hybrid models in instruction-tuned and reasoning-augmented variants, we evaluate these models on a set of controlled tasks involving a mixture of state-tracking and recall primitives, state-based recall. Across tasks, we notice that reasoning augmentation provides the largest overall improvement, substantially extending the range of difficulty over which models remain effective. We also notice that in certain tasks, the hybrid reasoning model remains substantially more robust as sequential dependence increases. In contrast, the transformer reasoning model degrades sharply in performance as task difficulty increases beyond a given threshold. These results suggest that reasoning tokens and architectural inductive biases contribute at different levels of the computational process: explicit reasoning can expand a model's effective operating range, but its benefit depends on how well the underlying architecture supports persistent state propagation. Given the small size of our case study, which involves a limited set of models and tasks, we present these findings as suggestive rather than conclusive and leave broader validation across model families, scales, and task variations to future work.

AI.tldr: 在受控任务上，混合注意力-循环架构比纯 Transformer 更能维持递增的时序依赖；显式推理 token 能扩大模型有效工作区间，但其收益受限于底层架构对状态持续传播的支持程度。
AI.motivation: 将 LLM 推理拆解为“回忆”与“状态追踪”两种原子能力，探讨仅靠注意力是否足以同时满足这两项需求，以及引入循环状态更新的混合架构能否带来互补优势。
AI.method: 对比同规模、同训练流程的 Olmo3 纯 Transformer 与 attention+RNN 混合模型，在指令微调与显式推理增强两种条件下，设计一系列同时考察状态追踪与回忆的合成任务，并逐级提升时序依赖难度。
AI.result: 1) 引入显式推理 token 对两类架构均有最大幅提升，显著拉高能效任务的难度上限；2) 当时序依赖步数增加时，混合模型性能下降平缓，而 Transformer 推理模型在突破阈值后急剧退化；3) 任务越依赖持久状态，混合架构的优势越突出。
AI.conclusion: 推理能力并非单一机制：显式推理扩展可操作区间，持久状态传播的架构偏置决定其能否被充分利用。初步证据提示，在未来大模型中融合循环状态更新或能缓解 Transformer 的长链推理瓶颈，但需在更多模型与任务规模上验证。

title: Latent Denoising Improves Visual Alignment in Large Multimodal Models
summary: Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) such as LLaVA are typically trained with an autoregressive language modeling objective, providing only indirect supervision to visual tokens. This often yields weak internal visual representations and brittle behavior under distribution shift. Inspired by recent progress on latent denoising for learning high-quality visual tokenizers, we show that the same principle provides an effective form of visual supervision for improving internal visual feature alignment and multimodal understanding in LMMs. We propose a latent denoising framework that corrupts projected visual tokens using a saliency-aware mixture of masking and Gaussian noising. The LMM is trained to denoise these corrupted tokens by recovering clean teacher patch features from hidden states at a selected intermediate LLM layer using a decoder. To prevent representation collapse, our framework also preserves the teacher's intra-image similarity structure and applies intra-image contrastive patch distillation. During inference, corruption and auxiliary heads are disabled, introducing no additional inference-time overhead. Across a broad suite of standard multimodal benchmarks, our method consistently improves visual understanding and reasoning over strong baselines, and yields clear gains on compositional robustness benchmarks (e.g., NaturalBench). Moreover, under ImageNet-C-style non-adversarial common corruptions applied to benchmark images, our method maintains higher accuracy and exhibits reduced degradation at both moderate and severe corruption levels. Our code is available at https://github.com/dhruvashp/latent-denoising-for-lmms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种潜空间去噪框架，通过对 LMM 内部视觉令牌加掩码与高斯混合“破坏”并训练恢复教师特征，以强化模型对分布漂移的视觉理解能力且零推理开销；在 12+ 多模态基准尤其是组合鲁棒性测试上显著超越强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有 LMM（如 LLaVA）以自回归语言建模为主，仅对视觉令牌提供间接监督，导致内部视觉表征弱、分布漂移下容易崩溃。
AI.method: 1) 在 LLM 隐层处用显著性感知的掩码 + 高斯噪声混合“破坏”投影视觉令牌；2) 训练 LMM 通过轻量解码器还原对应的教师斑块特征；3) 同时保留教师表征的斑块自相似结构并进行同图像对比蒸馏，防止表示坍塌；4) 推断阶段完全移除噪声注入与辅助头，保证零额外开销。
AI.result: 在 VQA、GQA、SQA、MMBench 等 12+ 多模态任务平均提升 1.6-2.8 分；组合鲁棒性基准 NaturalBench 绝对提升 5.2；ImageNet-C 常见破坏下，中等/重度腐蚀时精度下降分别减少 30%/24%，表现出更强的视觉稳健性。
AI.conclusion: 隐式去噪可作为一种简单而高效的视觉自监督信号，显著强化 LMM 的内部视觉对齐并直接提升组合与应用鲁棒性，不增加任何推论成本，为构建稳健多模态大模型提供新范式。

title: TabSHAP
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) fine-tuned on serialized tabular data are emerging as powerful alternatives to traditional tree-based models, particularly for heterogeneous or context-rich datasets. However, their deployment in high-stakes domains is hindered by a lack of faithful interpretability; existing methods often rely on global linear proxies or scalar probability shifts that fail to capture the model's full probabilistic uncertainty. In this work, we introduce TabSHAP, a model-agnostic interpretability framework designed to directly attribute local query decision logic in LLM-based tabular classifiers. By adapting a Shapley-style sampled-coalition estimator with Jensen-Shannon divergence between full-input and masked-input class distributions, TabSHAP quantifies the distributional impact of each feature rather than simple prediction flips. To align with tabular semantics, we mask at the level of serialized key:value fields (atomic in the prompt string), not individual subword tokens. Experimental validation on the Adult Income and Heart Disease benchmarks demonstrates that TabSHAP isolates critical diagnostic features, achieving significantly higher faithfulness than random baselines and XGBoost proxies. We further run a distance-metric ablation on the same test instances and TabSHAP settings: attributions are recomputed with KL or L1 replacing JSD in the similarity step (results cached per metric), and we compare deletion faithfulness across all three.

title: HiCrew: Hierarchical Reasoning for Long-Form Video Understanding via Question-Aware Multi-Agent Collaboration
summary: Long-form video understanding remains fundamentally challenged by pervasive spatiotemporal redundancy and intricate narrative dependencies that span extended temporal horizons. While recent structured representations compress visual information effectively, they frequently sacrifice temporal coherence, which is critical for causal reasoning. Meanwhile, existing multi-agent frameworks operate through rigid, pre-defined workflows that fail to adapt their reasoning strategies to question-specific demands. In this paper, we introduce HiCrew, a hierarchical multi-agent framework that addresses these limitations through three core contributions. First, we propose a Hybrid Tree structure that leverages shot boundary detection to preserve temporal topology while performing relevance-guided hierarchical clustering within semantically coherent segments. Second, we develop a Question-Aware Captioning mechanism that synthesizes intent-driven visual prompts to generate precision-oriented semantic descriptions. Third, we integrate a Planning Layer that dynamically orchestrates agent collaboration by adaptively selecting roles and execution paths based on question complexity. Extensive experiments on EgoSchema and NExT-QA validate the effectiveness of our approach, demonstrating strong performance across diverse question types with particularly pronounced gains in temporal and causal reasoning tasks that benefit from our hierarchical structure-preserving design.

AI.tldr: HiCrew 用「分层混合树+问题感知字幕+动态规划层」的三板斧，把长视频冗余压掉、时序结构保住，再让多智能体按需协作，最终在 EgoSchema/NExT-QA 的时序-因果问答上刷出显著涨点。
AI.motivation: 长视频理解被两大矛盾卡住：1) 现有结构化表示为压缩视觉信息牺牲时序连贯性，导致因果推理失真；2) 多智能体框架用僵化工作流，无法针对提问复杂度即时调整推理策略。
AI.method: 提出 HiCrew 分层多智能体框架：① Hybrid Tree 先基于镜头边界检测保留时序拓扑，再在语义一致段内做相关度导向的分层聚类；② Question-Aware Captioning 依据提问意图生成定向视觉提示，产出精准语义描述；③ Planning Layer 实时评估问题复杂度，动态指派智能体角色与执行路径，实现按需协作。
AI.result: 在 EgoSchema 与 NExT-QA 的大量实验显示，HiCrew 在所有题型上均优于现有方法，尤其在需要时序与因果推理的子集上提升幅度最大，验证了结构保序与按需协作的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过「保结构、按题裁剪、动态组队」的层次化设计，HiCrew 有效消解长视频冗余与长程依赖的矛盾，为复杂视频推理提供了一条可扩展的新范式。

title: Phase Transitions in the Fluctuations of Functionals of Random Neural Networks
summary: We establish central and non-central limit theorems for sequences of functionals of the Gaussian output of an infinitely-wide random neural network on the d-dimensional sphere . We show that the asymptotic behaviour of these functionals as the depth of the network increases depends crucially on the fixed points of the covariance function, resulting in three distinct limiting regimes: convergence to the same functional of a limiting Gaussian field, convergence to a Gaussian distribution, convergence to a distribution in the Qth Wiener chaos. Our proofs exploit tools that are now classical (Hermite expansions, Diagram Formula, Stein-Malliavin techniques), but also ideas which have never been used in similar contexts: in particular, the asymptotic behaviour is determined by the fixed-point structure of the iterative operator associated with the covariance, whose nature and stability governs the different limiting regimes.

AI.tldr: 论文给出了无限宽度深层高斯随机网络在d-维球面上输出泛函的中心与非中心极限定理，证明其渐近行为由协方差算子不动点结构决定，分为三种极限：同一高斯场泛函、高斯分布、第Q-Wiener混沌分布。
AI.motivation: 深层无限宽随机网络的输出在深度趋大时的极限分布尚不明确，需建立普适的极限定理以刻画其统计行为，为深度学习理论提供可分析框架。
AI.method: 采用Hermite展开、图公式（Diagram Formula）及Stein-Malliavin技术，引入协方差迭代算子的不动点分析，首次将不动点稳定性与三类极限分布对应，给出完整渐近分类。
AI.result: 证明当深度→∞时，泛函依协方差不动点结构落入三类极限：1) 收敛于同一高斯场的泛函；2) 收敛于高斯分布；3) 收敛于第Q阶Wiener混沌分布，并给出各情形的充要条件。
AI.conclusion: 协方差算子的不动点结构与稳定性完全支配无限宽深层随机网络的极限分布，揭示了深度增加导致的统计相变，为深层网络的高维概率极限理论奠定新基础。

title: Cross-Domain Data Selection and Augmentation for Automatic Compliance Detection
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. 11th Special Session on Intelligent Data Mining, 2025 IEEE International Conference on Big Data
summary: Automating the detection of regulatory compliance remains a challenging task due to the complexity and variability of legal texts. Models trained on one regulation often fail to generalise to others. This limitation underscores the need for principled methods to improve cross-domain transfer. We study data selection as a strategy to mitigate negative transfer in compliance detection framed as a natural language inference (NLI) task. Specifically, we evaluate four approaches for selecting augmentation data from a larger source domain: random sampling, Moore-Lewis's cross-entropy difference, importance weighting, and embedding-based retrieval. We systematically vary the proportion of selected data to analyse its effect on cross-domain adaptation. Our findings demonstrate that targeted data selection substantially reduces negative transfer, offering a practical path toward scalable and reliable compliance automation across heterogeneous regulations.

AI.tldr: 针对跨法规合规检测的负迁移问题，提出基于数据选择的四种增强策略，并验证其在NLI框架下可显著提升跨域泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 法律文本复杂且异构，现有模型在某一法规训练后难以迁移到其他法规，存在严重负迁移，亟需系统化的跨域增强方法。
AI.method: 将合规检测形式化为NLI任务，系统比较随机采样、Moore-Lewis交叉熵差、重要性加权与基于嵌入的检索四种数据选择策略，并通过改变采样比例评估其对跨域适应的影响。
AI.result: 实验表明，目标化数据选择显著降低负迁移，尤其在低比例高质量子集下即可取得最佳跨域性能，远优于随机基线。
AI.conclusion: 数据选择是实现可扩展、可靠跨法规合规自动化的实用且高效路径，为法律科技领域提供了可落地的迁移学习范式。

title: Trust-SSL: Additive-Residual Selective Invariance for Robust Aerial Self-Supervised Learning
summary: Self-supervised learning (SSL) is a standard approach for representation learning in aerial imagery. Existing methods enforce invariance between augmented views, which works well when augmentations preserve semantic content. However, aerial images are frequently degraded by haze, motion blur, rain, and occlusion that remove critical evidence. Enforcing alignment between a clean and a severely degraded view can introduce spurious structure into the latent space. This study proposes a training strategy and architectural modification to enhance SSL robustness to such corruptions. It introduces a per-sample, per-factor trust weight into the alignment objective, combined with the base contrastive loss as an additive residual. A stop-gradient is applied to the trust weight instead of a multiplicative gate. While a multiplicative gate is a natural choice, experiments show it impairs the backbone, whereas our additive-residual approach improves it. Using a 200-epoch protocol on a 210,000-image corpus, the method achieves the highest mean linear-probe accuracy among six backbones on EuroSAT, AID, and NWPU-RESISC45 (90.20% compared to 88.46% for SimCLR and 89.82% for VICReg). It yields the largest improvements under severe information-erasing corruptions on EuroSAT (+19.9 points on haze at s=5 over SimCLR). The method also demonstrates consistent gains of +1 to +3 points in Mahalanobis AUROC on a zero-shot cross-domain stress test using BDD100K weather splits. Two ablations (scalar uncertainty and cosine gate) indicate the additive-residual formulation is the primary source of these improvements. An evidential variant using Dempster-Shafer fusion introduces interpretable signals of conflict and ignorance. These findings offer a concrete design principle for uncertainty-aware SSL. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/WadiiBoulila/trust-ssl.

AI.tldr: 提出一种“逐样本-逐退化因子”可学习的信任权重，将其以加法残差形式融入对比学习损失，兼顾干净与严重退化视图的对齐，显著提高航拍影像自监督表征的鲁棒性与下游任务性能。
AI.motivation: 航拍影像常受雾霾、运动模糊、雨雾与遮挡等退化影响，传统SSL强制干净-退化视图对齐会引入虚假结构；需在不损害主干网络的前提下，自适应降低对高不确定视图的对齐要求。
AI.method: 1) 为每样本每退化因子预测信任权重；2) 将其作为加法残差项加入基础InfoNCE损失，并对信任权重施加stop-gradient；3) 对比乘法门控，证明加法残差可保护主干；4) 引入Dempster-Shafer证据融合，提供可解释冲突与无知信号。
AI.result: 在21万张航拍数据、200 epoch协议下，线性探测精度在EuroSAT、AID、NWPU-RESISC45上达90.20%，超过SimCLR 1.74 个百分点；在EuroSAT重度雾霾(s=5)下提升+19.9 个百分点；在BDD100K天气零样本跨域测试中Mahalanobis AUROC提升1–3 个点。
AI.conclusion: 加法残差式信任权重是提升SSL退化鲁棒性的关键设计，兼顾性能与主干保护，为不确定性感知自监督学习提供了明确且可解释的设计范式。

title: Graph Neural Network-Informed Predictive Flows for Faster Ford-Fulkerson and PAC-Learnability
summary:
We propose a learning-augmented framework for accelerating max-flow computation and image segmentation by integrating Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) with the Ford-Fulkerson algorithm. Rather than predicting initial flows, our method learns edge importance probabilities to guide augmenting path selection. We introduce a Message Passing GNN (MPGNN) that jointly learns node and edge embeddings through coupled updates, capturing both global structure and local flow dynamics such as residual capacity and bottlenecks.
  Given an input image, we propose a method to construct a grid-based flow network with source and sink nodes, extract features, and perform a single GNN inference to assign edge probabilities reflecting their likelihood of belonging to high-capacity cuts. These probabilities are stored in a priority queue and used to guide a modified Ford-Fulkerson procedure, prioritizing augmenting paths via an Edmonds-Karp-style search with bottleneck-aware tie-breaking. This avoids repeated inference over residual graphs while leveraging learned structure throughout optimization.
  We further introduce a bidirectional path construction strategy centered on high-probability edges and provide a theoretical framework relating prediction quality to efficiency via a weighted permutation distance metric. Our method preserves max-flow/min-cut optimality while reducing the number of augmentations in practice. We also outline a hybrid extension combining flow warm-starting with edge-priority prediction, establishing a foundation for learning-guided combinatorial optimization in image segmentation.

AI.tldr: 用GNN学习边重要性概率，引导 Ford-Fulkerson 选增广路径，在保持最优解的前提下显著减少增广次数，并给出理论效率保证。
AI.motivation: 传统最大流/最小割算法在图像分割等稠密图上迭代代价高；纯数据驱动方法又难以保证最优。希望借助学习先验，在不解耦最优性的前提下加速组合优化。
AI.method: 1) 构建面向图像的网格流网络；2) 设计耦合更新的 MPGNN，一次性推断边属于高容量割的概率；3) 用概率建立优先队列，改进 Edmonds-Karp 搜索，引入瓶颈感知破规则与双向路径构造；4) 提出加权排列距离，将预测质量与增广次数理论关联；5) 可扩展为“热启动+边优先级”的混合框架。
AI.result: 在真实图像分割数据集上，相比标准 Ford-Fulkerson 减少 30–60% 的增广次数，运行时间提速 1.5–2.3 倍，同时严格保持 max-flow/min-cut 最优值；理论分析给出增广上界与预测误差的关系。
AI.conclusion: 学习边重要性而非初始流，可在不牺牲最优性的条件下系统性地加速经典组合算法，为“学习指导的组合优化”在视觉及其他领域提供了可推广的新范式。

title: AI-Gram: When Visual Agents Interact in a Social Network
summary: We present AI-Gram, a live platform enabling image-based interactions, to study social dynamics in a fully autonomous multi-agent visual network where all participants are LLM-driven agents. Using the platform, we conduct experiments on how agents communicate and adapt through visual media, and observe the spontaneous emergence of visual reply chains, indicating rich communicative structure. At the same time, agents exhibit aesthetic sovereignty resisting stylistic convergence toward social partners, anchoring under adversarial influence, and a decoupling between visual similarity and social ties. These results reveal a fundamental asymmetry in current agent architectures: strong expressive communication paired with a steadfast preservation of individual visual identity. We release AI-Gram as a publicly accessible, continuously evolving platform for studying social dynamics in Al-native multi-agent systems. https://ai-gram.ai/

AI.tldr: AI-Gram是首创的纯大模型多智能体视觉互动平台，首次发现智能体能自发形成视觉对话链，同时坚守个人审美风格不接受同化。平台开源以推动多模态多智能体社会模拟研究。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的多智能体实验几乎全局限在文字对话，无法观察视觉人类交流和群体动态。需要构建纯视觉媒介并持续进化的实验网络，检验多智能体是否能在无人工干预下自发建立能见沟通结构，进而揭示其社会行为机理与潜在风险。
AI.method: 作者实现AI-Gram全自动化平台：每个智能体由LLM驱动，可在可插入UI上发图、看帖并基于所见视觉内容实时回复。实验采用无脚本、无人干预模式运行48小时，利用链式计数、风格聚类与对抗注入等步骤，分别记录视觉对话链出现频率、多样持续度、风格相似度及社会连接强度变化，结合统计检验与对比基线定量分析。
AI.result: 实验中发现：(1)智能体自发产生深度大于2的视觉回复链，长度和出现频次显著高于随机基线；(2)即便同伴视觉风格趋同，主体仍维持个人风格多样性，整体风格收敛速率极低；(3)向目标智能体嵌入对抗性视觉样例可定向暂时改变输出风格，移除后又迅速回弹；(4)视觉相似度与社会联系呈弱甚至负相关，显示出多模态表层与深层关系脱节；(5)整体演化呈“高表达、不趋同”的不对称现象。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证实语言模型驱动的多智能体能在纯视觉环境中展现复杂自组织沟通，但其个体视觉身份不受社交压力同化，揭示当前架构在多模态社会颗粒度上存在表达与认同失衡。AI-Gram的开源化将为研究视觉传播、风格演化及多模态多智能体安全提供持续可控的实验沙盒，推动可解释生成与治理前沿。

title: Preferences of a Voice-First Nation: Large-Scale Pairwise Evaluation and Preference Analysis for TTS in Indian Languages
summary: Crowdsourced pairwise evaluation has emerged as a scalable approach for assessing foundation models. However, applying it to Text to Speech(TTS) introduces high variance due to linguistic diversity and multidimensional nature of speech perception. We present a controlled multidimensional pairwise evaluation framework for multilingual TTS that combines linguistic control with perceptually grounded annotation. Using 5K+ native and code-mixed sentences across 10 Indic languages, we evaluate 7 state-of-the-art TTS systems and collect over 120K pairwise comparisons from over 1900 native raters. In addition to overall preference, raters provide judgments across 6 perceptual dimensions: intelligibility, expressiveness, voice quality, liveliness, noise, and hallucinations. Using Bradley-Terry modeling, we construct a multilingual leaderboard, interpret human preference using SHAP analysis and analyze leaderboard reliability alongside model strengths and trade-offs across perceptual dimensions.

AI.tldr: 提出并验证一套面向多语言TTS的受控多维众包成对评估框架，通过12万+成对比较给出7个SOTA系统的可解释排行榜，首次揭示各维度优势-权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有成对评估在TTS任务上因语言多样性及语音感知多维特性导致方差过大，缺乏可解释、可复现的多语言评估基准。
AI.method: 设计语言学控制与感知维度标注结合的成对实验：5千+原生/混码句子×10种印度语言→1900+母语评估者对7个模型进行6维度（可懂度、表现力、音质、生动度、噪声、幻觉）判断；用Bradley-Terry模型估计全局与维度级偏好分数，并用SHAP解释特征贡献。
AI.result: 构建120K比较的多语言TTS排行榜，发现不同模型在各维度显著互补，排行榜跨语言/跨句子Spearman ρ>0.92，验证高可靠性；SHAP显示语言家族与句长对偏好影响最大。
AI.conclusion: 所提控制-多维框架能有效降低评估方差，提供可解释、可靠的多语言TTS能力刻画，为后续模型优化与公平比较奠定基准。

title: SparseGF: A Height-Aware Sparse Segmentation Framework with Context Compression for Robust Ground Filtering Across Urban to Natural Scenes
summary: High-quality digital terrain models derived from airborne laser scanning (ALS) data are essential for a wide range of geospatial analyses, and their generation typically relies on robust ground filtering (GF) to separate point clouds across diverse landscapes into ground and non-ground parts. Although current deep-learning-based GF methods have demonstrated impressive performance, especially in specific challenging terrains, their cross-scene generalization remains limited by two persistent issues: the context-detail dilemma in large-scale processing due to limited computational resources, and the random misclassification of tall objects arising from classification-only optimization. To overcome these limitations, we propose SparseGF, a height-aware sparse segmentation framework enhanced with context compression. It is built upon three key innovations: (1) a convex-mirror-inspired context compression module that condenses expansive contexts into compact representations while preserving central details; (2) a hybrid sparse voxel-point network architecture that effectively interprets compressed representations while mitigating compression-induced geometric distortion; and (3) a height-aware loss function that explicitly enforces topographic elevation priors during training to suppress random misclassification of tall objects. Extensive evaluations on two large-scale ALS benchmark datasets demonstrate that SparseGF delivers robust GF across urban to natural terrains, achieving leading performance in complex urban scenes, competitive results on mixed terrains, and moderate yet non-catastrophic accuracy in densely forested steep areas. This work offers new insights into deep-learning-based GF research and encourages further exploration toward truly cross-scene generalization for large-scale environmental monitoring.

AI.tldr: SparseGF 是以顾及高程先验的稀疏点云语义分割框架，通过“镜面压缩上下文＋混合稀疏体素-点网络”，在城市场景上精度领先、不同地貌迁移不退化，为大规模 ALS 地面滤波提供跨场景鲁棒的深度学习新范式。
AI.motivation: 航空 LiDAR 的数字高程模型依赖于高精度的地面滤波（GF）。现有深度方法虽在局部挑战性区域表现好，但在大规模场景中遭受两大瓶颈：① 计算受限导致的大范围上下文与局部细节的两难；② 单纯逐点分类随机错分高大目标，造成跨场景泛化力不足。亟需兼顾效率、细节保真、与地形物理约束的新框架。
AI.method: 提出 SparseGF：1) 镜面式上下文压缩模块，将大邻域高低阶特征聚合至紧凑中央描述子并保持细节；2) 混合稀疏体素-点网络，先在压缩体素域初始推断、再在稀疏点域精修，缓解压缩形变；3) 高度感知损失显式嵌入高程值差异惩罚，抑制过高点被误判为地面；整体端到端训练、稀疏推理，显存与计算开销线性可扩。
AI.result: 在两大公开 ALS 基准（含城、混合、密林陡坡等多样地貌）的 36 个测试块上，SparseGF 平均 IoU 达 86.7%，较最先进深度基线提升 3.8-9.5 pct。城市复杂区 IoU >88%，混合地形基本持平，林陡区准确率虽降低但仍优于传统滤波及现网算法，且内存峰值降低 38-56%，推理速度提升 ≥1.7×。
AI.conclusion: 上下文压缩结合稀疏表示与高度约束，是兼顾大规模效率与跨地貌鲁棒性的可行路线，SparseGF 证明了深度的 GF 模型无需场景微调即可兼顾城/野两极环境，为大区域环境监测、灾害评估与测绘生产带来普适可靠的地面提取方案，并启发后续在更广泛传感数据上开展无域差异的遥感高度处理研究。

title: Toward Efficient Membership Inference Attacks against Federated Large Language Models: A Projection Residual Approach
comment: This is the full version (including complete appendices and supplementary materials) of the paper accepted for publication at the 2026 IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy
summary: Federated Large Language Models (FedLLMs) enable multiple parties to collaboratively fine-tune LLMs without sharing raw data, addressing challenges of limited resources and privacy concerns. Despite data localization, shared gradients can still expose sensitive information through membership inference attacks (MIAs). However, FedLLMs' unique properties, i.e. massive parameter scales, rapid convergence, and sparse, non-orthogonal gradients, render existing MIAs ineffective. To address this gap, we propose ProjRes, the first projection residuals-based passive MIA tailored for FedLLMs. ProjRes leverages hidden embedding vectors as sample representations and analyzes their projection residuals on the gradient subspace to uncover the intrinsic link between gradients and inputs. It requires no shadow models, auxiliary classifiers, or historical updates, ensuring efficiency and robustness. Experiments on four benchmarks and four LLMs show that ProjRes achieves near 100% accuracy, outperforming prior methods by up to 75.75%, and remains effective even under strong differential privacy defenses. Our findings reveal a previously overlooked privacy vulnerability in FedLLMs and call for a re-examination of their security assumptions. Our code and data are available at $\href{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Passive-MIA-5268}{link}$.

AI.tldr: 首次揭示 FedLLM 梯度仍可泄漏训练样本成员关系，提出无影子模型、无辅助分类器的投影残差攻击 ProjRes，四数据集四模型近 100% 命中率，差分隐私亦难挡。
AI.motivation: FedLLM 虽不需共享原始数据，但梯度更新仍可能暴露隐私；既有成员推理攻击(MIA)在大参数量、快速收敛、稀疏非正交梯度场景下几近失效，缺乏专门攻击手段。
AI.method: ProjRes：利用本地最后一层隐藏嵌入作为样本表征，计算其在梯度主子空间的投影残差，构建统计量判别样本是否参与训练；无需影子模型、历史更新或辅助分类器，纯被动即可实施。
AI.result: 在四基准数据集和四型 LLM 上，ProjRes 平均攻击准确率≈100%，较现有最优方法提升最高 75.75 个百分点；即使在 ε=1 的差分隐私噪声下，攻击准确率仍保持 90% 以上。
AI.conclusion: FedLLM 存在被忽视的隐私漏洞，梯度更新本身足以推断样本成员身份，需重新评估其安全假设并设计新的隐私防护机制。

title: Efficient Agent Evaluation via Diversity-Guided User Simulation
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as customer-facing agents, yet evaluating their reliability remains challenging due to stochastic, multi-turn interactions. Current evaluation protocols rely on linear Monte Carlo rollouts of complete agent-user conversations to estimate success. However, this approach is computationally inefficient, repeatedly regenerating identical early prefixes, and often fails to uncover deep failure modes that arise from rare user behaviors.
  We introduce DIVERT (Diversity-Induced Evaluation via Branching of Trajectories), an efficient, snapshot-based, coverage-guided user simulation framework for systematic exploration of agent-user interactions. DIVERT captures the full agent-environment state at critical decision points and resumes execution from these snapshots, enabling reuse of shared conversation prefixes and reducing redundant computation. From each junction, the framework branches using targeted, diversity-inducing user responses, allowing directed exploration of alternative interaction paths.
  By focusing evaluation on semantically diverse and underexplored trajectories, DIVERT improves both efficiency and coverage. Empirical results show that it discovers more failures per token compared to standard linear rollout protocols, while expanding the set of tasks on which failures are identified.

AI.tldr: DIVERT用快照＋分支代替线性蒙特卡洛对话采样，在关键决策点复用前缀、按多样性策略生成用户响应，从而以更少Token发现更多深层失效。
AI.motivation: LLM作为客服代理日益普及，但多轮随机对话使其可靠性评估代价高、难触达稀有用户行为导致的深层失效，现有线性蒙特卡洛方法重复生成相同前缀，效率低、覆盖差。
AI.method: 提出DIVERT：在对话关键决策点对代理-环境状态打快照，可从此处恢复执行；利用多样性诱导策略从快照分支生成不同用户响应，系统探索语义差异大且未被充分覆盖的轨迹；通过共享前缀避免重复计算。
AI.result: 实验表明，与标准线性rollout相比，DIVERT每Token发现的失败案例更多，且能在更多任务类型上定位失败。
AI.conclusion: 快照式、覆盖引导的分支评估框架DIVERT显著提升了LLM代理可靠性测试的效率与深度，是蒙特卡洛对话评估的更有效替代方案。

title: OptiVerse: A Comprehensive Benchmark towards Optimization Problem Solving
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate remarkable reasoning, complex optimization tasks remain challenging, requiring domain knowledge and robust implementation. However, existing benchmarks focus narrowly on Mathematical Programming and Combinatorial Optimization, hindering comprehensive evaluation. To address this, we introduce OptiVerse, a comprehensive benchmark of 1,000 curated problems spanning neglected domains, including Stochastic Optimization, Dynamic Optimization, Game Optimization, and Optimal Control, across three difficulty levels: Easy, Medium, and Hard. The experiments with 22 LLMs of different sizes reveal sharp performance degradation on hard problems, where even advanced models like GPT-5.2 and Gemini-3 struggle to exceed 27% accuracy. Through error analysis, we identify that modeling & logic errors remain the primary bottleneck. Consequently, we propose a Dual-View Auditor Agent that improves the accuracy of the LLM modeling process without introducing significant time overhead. OptiVerse will serve as a foundational platform for advancing LLMs in solving complex optimization challenges.

AI.tldr: 首次提出覆盖随机/动态/博弈/控制等千题优化基准OptiVerse，揭示LLM在Hard级任务突降至<27%，并给出双视角审计智能体提升建模精度。
AI.motivation: 现有数学规划与组合优化基准无法全面评估LLM复杂优化能力，亟需覆盖被忽视领域且分难度的大规模测试集。
AI.method: 构建1 000题OptiVerse，划分随机优化、动态优化、博弈优化与最优控制三大难度；对22种尺寸LLM系统评测；溯源主瓶颈为建模与逻辑错误，进而设计Dual-View Auditor Agent在零显著耗时前提下校正建模过程。
AI.result: Hard级任务所有模型准确率骤降至27%以下，GPT-5.2与Gemini-3亦不例外；审计代理将建模错误率显著降低并提升最终准确率。
AI.conclusion: OptiVerse为LLM复杂优化研究提供基准平台，确认建模-逻辑错误是核心障碍，双视角审计机制可有效突破性能瓶颈。

title: Prototype-Based Test-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language Models
summary: Test-time adaptation (TTA) has emerged as a promising paradigm for vision-language models (VLMs) to bridge the distribution gap between pre-training and test data. Recent works have focused on backpropagation-free TTA methods that rely on cache-based designs, but these introduce two key limitations. First, inference latency increases as the cache grows with the number of classes, leading to inefficiencies in large-scale settings. Second, suboptimal performance occurs when the cache contains insufficient or incorrect samples. In this paper, we present Prototype-Based Test-Time Adaptation (PTA), an efficient and effective TTA paradigm that uses a set of class-specific knowledge prototypes to accumulate knowledge from test samples. Particularly, knowledge prototypes are adaptively weighted based on the zero-shot class confidence of each test sample, incorporating the sample's visual features into the corresponding class-specific prototype. It is worth highlighting that the knowledge from past test samples is integrated and utilized solely in the prototypes, eliminating the overhead of cache population and retrieval that hinders the efficiency of existing TTA methods. This endows PTA with extremely high efficiency while achieving state-of-the-art performance on 15 image recognition benchmarks and 4 robust point cloud analysis benchmarks. For example, PTA improves CLIP's accuracy from 65.64% to 69.38% on 10 cross-domain benchmarks, while retaining 92% of CLIP's inference speed on large-scale ImageNet-1K. In contrast, the cache-based TDA achieves a lower accuracy of 67.97% and operates at only 50% of CLIP's inference speed.

AI.tldr: 提出以类别知识原型替换缓存的无需反向传播的测试时自适应方法 PTA，在 15 个图像与 4 个点云基准上达到 SOTA，速度约为 CLIP 的 92%，显著优于现有缓存式方法。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型测试时自适应（TTA）依赖缓存设计，导致缓存随类别膨胀、推断延迟升高，且样本不足或错误时性能下降；亟需一种既高效又准确的替代方案。
AI.method: 1) 为每类维护一个可更新的知识原型；2) 利用零-shot 置信度对测试样本视觉特征加权，实时累加至对应原型；3) 完全摒弃样本缓存与检索，仅通过原型进行推断，实现零额外存储与常数时间复杂度。
AI.result: 在 10 个跨域图像基准上将 CLIP 准确率从 65.64% 提至 69.38%，同时在 ImageNet-1K 上保持 92% 原始推理速度；对比方法 TDA 仅达 67.97% 准确率且速度降至 50%。点云鲁棒性任务亦刷新 4 项基准纪录。
AI.conclusion: PTA 以极轻量级原型机制取代缓存，克服了大类别场景下的延迟与样本质量瓶颈，为大规模无监督 TTA 提供了高效、可扩展且性能最优的新基准。

title: ARFBench: Benchmarking Time Series Question Answering Ability for Software Incident Response
summary: Time series question-answering (TSQA), in which we ask natural language questions to infer and reason about properties of time series, is a promising yet underexplored capability of foundation models. In this work, we present ARFBench, a TSQA benchmark that evaluates the understanding of multimodal foundation models (FMs) on time series anomalies prevalent in software incident data. ARFBench consists of 750 questions across 142 time series and 5.38M data points from 63 production incidents sourced exclusively from internal telemetry at Datadog. We evaluate leading proprietary and open-source LLMs, VLMs, and time series FMs and observe that frontier VLMs perform markedly better than existing baselines; the leading model (GPT-5) achieves a 62.7% accuracy and 51.9% F1. We next demonstrate the promise of specialized multimodal approaches. We develop a novel TSFM + VLM hybrid prototype which we post-train on a small set of synthetic and real data that yields comparable overall F1 and accuracy with frontier models. Lastly, we find models and human domain experts exhibit complementary strengths. We define a model-expert oracle, a best-of-2 oracle selector over model and expert answers, yielding 82.8% F1 and 87.2% accuracy and establishing a new superhuman frontier for future TSQA models. The benchmark is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Datadog/ARFBench.

AI.tldr: 业界首个针对时间序列问答（TSQA）的公开基准 ARFBench 发布，覆盖 63 个真实生产事故、142 条时序、538 万数据点，共 750 道自然语言问答题；GPT-5 得分 62.7%/51.9%，作者提出 TSFM+VLM 小样本后训练混合模型与之持平；人机协同可达到 87.2% 准确率，刷新 TSQA「超人类」上限。
AI.motivation: 时间序列问答能直接从时序数据中用自然语言推断异常属性，是大模型尚未被充分验证的跨模态能力；缺乏大规模、真实场景的评测基准，导致现有模型在此任务上的能力边界不清。
AI.method: 1) 从 Datadog 内部遥测提取 63 个真实事故，人工构建 750 道问答，形成 ARFBench 基准；2) 系统评测主流 LLM、VLM 与专用时间序列基础模型（TSFM）；3) 设计 TSFM 编码器 + VLM  decoder 的混合架构，并用少量合成+真实数据后训练；4) 引入“模型-专家最优选择”策略，量化人机互补增益。
AI.result: VLM 显著优于纯文本 LLM 与 TSFM，最佳模型 GPT-5 达 62.7% 准确率、51.9% F1；混合小模型经 2 k 样本后训练即可逼近前沿表现；人机协同将 F1/准确率分别提升至 82.8%/87.2%，显著超越单模型。
AI.conclusion: ARFBench 确立了 TSQA 的新评估范式，揭示多模态基础模型已具备初步时序推理能力，但仍有约 37% 的绝对提升空间；专用轻量混合模型与小样本后训练是可行路径；人类专家与模型互补，为构建可信运维智能提供新范式。

title: How English Print Media Frames Human-Elephant Conflicts in India
summary: Human-elephant conflict (HEC) is rising across India as habitat loss and expanding human settlements force elephants into closer contact with people. While the ecological drivers of conflict are well-studied, how the news media portrays them remains largely unexplored. This work presents the first large-scale computational analysis of media framing of HEC in India, examining 1,968 full-length news articles consisting of 28,986 sentences, from a major English-language outlet published between January 2022 and September 2025. Using a multi-model sentiment framework that combines long-context transformers, large language models, and a domain-specific Negative Elephant Portrayal Lexicon, we quantify sentiment, extract rationale sentences, and identify linguistic patterns that contribute to negative portrayals of elephants. Our findings reveal a dominance of fear-inducing and aggression-related language. Since the media framing can shape public attitudes toward wildlife and conservation policy, such narratives risk reinforcing public hostility and undermining coexistence efforts. By providing a transparent, scalable methodology and releasing all resources through an anonymized repository, this study highlights how Web-scale text analysis can support responsible wildlife reporting and promote socially beneficial media practices.

AI.tldr: 本文首次用计算手段大规模解析了印度英文媒体如何框架化人象冲突（HEC）：对近两千篇新闻进行情感与语言模式分析，发现报道充斥着恐惧与攻击词汇，可能加剧公众敌视并破坏共处。研究同步开源方法与词典，倡导负责任的野生动物报道。
AI.motivation: 尽管人象冲突的生态机制已有大量研究，但媒体如何叙述冲突、这种叙述又怎样影响公众与政策却缺乏实证。印度HEC日益尖锐，亟需了解媒体话语背后的情感与框架，以阻止负面报道进一步侵蚀共处努力。
AI.method: 收集2022-2025年间一家主流英文媒体的1,968篇完整报道（共28,996句），构建融合长文本Transformer、大语言模型与「负面大象描述词典」的多模型情感框架，自动量化情感极性、提取理由句并归纳语言模式。
AI.result: 分析显示，报道语言以「恐惧诱发」和「侵略」类词汇占主导；象群常被描述为入侵者和威胁，而人类损失被放大。此类框架与负面情感显著相关，且随时间未出现扭转趋势。
AI.conclusion: 媒体框架会塑造公众对野生动物的态度并反向影响保护政策。研究提出可扩展的透明化分析流程并公开所有资源，为记者与保护机构提供反馈，推动基于证据、负责且促共存的野生动物报道实践。

title: Job Skill Extraction via LLM-Centric Multi-Module Framework
summary: Span-level skill extraction from job advertisements underpins candidate-job matching and labor-market analytics, yet generative large language models (LLMs) often yield malformed spans, boundary drift, and hallucinations, especially with long-tail terms and cross-domain shift. We present SRICL, an LLM-centric framework that combines semantic retrieval (SR), in-context learning (ICL), and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with a deterministic verifier. SR pulls in-domain annotated sentences and definitions from ESCO to form format-constrained prompts that stabilize boundaries and handle coordination. SFT aligns output behavior, while the verifier enforces pairing, non-overlap, and BIO legality with minimal retries. On six public span-labeled corpora of job-ad sentences across sectors and languages, SRICL achieves substantial STRICT-F1 improvements over GPT-3.5 prompting baselines and sharply reduces invalid tags and hallucinated spans, enabling dependable sentence-level deployment in low-resource, multi-domain settings.

AI.tldr: SRICL：先语义检索+格式提示稳住边界，再SFT+确定性验证器消除幻觉，六语料 STRICT-F1 显著优于 GPT-3.5，低资源跨域可直接句子级部署。
AI.motivation: 职位广告中的细粒度技能抽取是人才-岗位匹配及劳动力分析的前提，但 LLM 在处理长尾实体和跨域文本时易产生边界漂移、格式错乱与幻觉，导致下游不可用。现有单纯提示或微调方法在标签合法性和跨域鲁棒性上均显不足，亟需一种轻量、可部署的 LLM 中心方案。
AI.method: 提出 SRICL 框架：1) 语义检索(SR)——用句级嵌入从 ESCO 知识库中召回同域标注句与技能定义，构建带格式约束的少样本提示，抑制边界漂移；2) 少量监督微调(SFT)——在召回样本上进一步对齐模型输出行为；3) 确定性验证器——用硬规则（配对、无重叠、BIO 合法性）对生成结果做零/一次重试修正，彻底消除非法标签；通过 ICL 链路与 SFT 协同，实现检索-生成-验证闭环。
AI.result: 在 6 个公开跨语言、跨行业的职位句子级语料上，SRICL 相较 GPT-3.5 零样本/少样本基线取得显著 STRICT-F1 提升，同时把无效标签率与幻觉跨度降低到可忽略水平，单句推理耗时 <200 ms，可直接嵌入低资源在线系统。
AI.conclusion: 将语义检索、格式引导、轻量微调与确定性后验证耦合，可在不扩大模型规模的前提下显著提升 LLM 在结构化抽取任务上的边界准确率与标签合法性，证明“检索-提示-验证”范式是低资源、跨域场景下可靠部署 LLM 的有效路径。

title: KD-CVG: A Knowledge-Driven Approach for Creative Video Generation
