title: Association Is Not Similarity: Learning Corpus-Specific Associations for Multi-Hop Retrieval
summary: Dense retrieval systems rank passages by embedding similarity to a query, but multi-hop questions require passages that are associatively related through shared reasoning chains. We introduce Association-Augmented Retrieval (AAR), a lightweight transductive reranking method that trains a small MLP (4.2M parameters) to learn associative relationships between passages in embedding space using contrastive learning on co-occurrence annotations. At inference time, AAR reranks an initial dense retrieval candidate set using bi-directional association scoring. On HotpotQA, AAR improves passage Recall@5 from 0.831 to 0.916 (+8.6 points) without evaluation-set tuning, with gains concentrated on hard questions where the dense baseline fails (+28.5 points). On MuSiQue, AAR achieves +10.1 points in the transductive setting. An inductive model trained on training-split associations and evaluated on unseen validation associations shows no significant improvement, suggesting that the method captures corpus-specific co-occurrences rather than transferable patterns. Ablation studies support this interpretation: training on semantically similar but non-associated passage pairs degrades retrieval below the baseline, while shuffling association pairs causes severe degradation. A downstream QA evaluation shows retrieval gains translate to +6.4 exact match improvement. The method adds 3.7ms per query, trains in under two minutes on a single GPU, and requires no LLM-based indexing.

AI.tldr: AAR 用 4.2 M 参数的 MLP，在嵌入空间内以对比学习捕捉共现关联，对首次稠密检索结果做双向重排，HotpotQA 上 R@5 提升 8.6 个百分点，仅需 3.7 ms 与 2 分钟训练。
AI.motivation: 多跳问答中，现有稠密检索仅依赖单段与查询的相似度，难以召回需通过推理链关联的多段证据。
AI.method: 提出 Association-Augmented Retrieval (AAR)：1) 用共现注释构建正样本对，2) 训练轻量 MLP 学习段落嵌入间的双向关联分数，3) 推理时对首次稠密候选集重排序。
AI.result: HotpotQA 上 R@5 从 0.831→0.916（+8.6），难题子集提升 28.5；MuSiQue 上 +10.1。下游 QA Exact Match +6.4。归纳设置无提升，证明其捕获的是语料专属共现而非可迁移模式。
AI.conclusion: AAR 以极小成本显著增强多跳检索，但效果依赖训练语料的共现统计，适用于可离线处理的任务；未来需研究如何提炼可迁移的关联特征。

title: WorldMark: A Unified Benchmark Suite for Interactive Video World Models
summary: Interactive video generation models such as Genie, YUME, HY-World, and Matrix-Game are advancing rapidly, yet every model is evaluated on its own benchmark with private scenes and trajectories, making fair cross-model comparison impossible. Existing public benchmarks offer useful metrics such as trajectory error, aesthetic scores, and VLM-based judgments, but none supplies the standardized test conditions -- identical scenes, identical action sequences, and a unified control interface -- needed to make those metrics comparable across models with heterogeneous inputs. We introduce WorldMark, the first benchmark that provides such a common playing field for interactive Image-to-Video world models. WorldMark contributes: (1) a unified action-mapping layer that translates a shared WASD-style action vocabulary into each model's native control format, enabling apples-to-apples comparison across six major models on identical scenes and trajectories; (2) a hierarchical test suite of 500 evaluation cases covering first- and third-person viewpoints, photorealistic and stylized scenes, and three difficulty tiers from Easy to Hard spanning 20-60s; and (3) a modular evaluation toolkit for Visual Quality, Control Alignment, and World Consistency, designed so that researchers can reuse our standardized inputs while plugging in their own metrics as the field evolves. We will release all data, evaluation code, and model outputs to facilitate future research. Beyond offline metrics, we launch World Model Arena (warena.ai), an online platform where anyone can pit leading world models against each other in side-by-side battles and watch the live leaderboard.

AI.tldr: WorldMark用统一接口、同一场景与轨迹首次让交互式图生视频模型在同一直线上公平比拼，并提供500任务基准与在线对战平台wArena。
AI.motivation: 现有模型各自用私有场景和评价方式，缺乏统一基准，无法横向比较性能。作者认为必须标准化输入与控制接口，才能推动领域进步。
AI.method: 设计WASD风格统一动作映射层，把公共动作翻译到6种模型原生命令；构建覆盖500例子的分层测试套件，支持第一/三人称、逼真与风格化及3级难度；开发可扩展评估工具集，比对视觉质量、控制对齐与世界一致性；同时上线世界模型竞技场 warena.ai 供实时对战排名。
AI.result: WorldMark 实现同场景、同轨迹、异模型指标可比；500任务套件与在线平台 Ready for release，研究人员可直接接管评价指标或数据继续实验。
AI.conclusion: 统一基准 WorldMark 打开交叉模型对比之门，结合开放数据与在线对战平台，将大幅促进交互视频世界模型方法的公平评估与共同进步。

title: Evaluating Post-hoc Explanations of the Transformer-based Genome Language Model DNABERT-2
comment: Accepted at the 4th World Conference on Explainable Artificial Intelligence, XAI-2026
summary: Explaining deep neural network predictions on genome sequences enables biological insight and hypothesis generation-often of greater interest than predictive performance alone. While explanations of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have been shown to capture relevant patterns in genome sequences, it is unclear whether this transfers to more expressive Transformer-based genome language models (gLMs). To answer this question, we adapt AttnLRP, an extension of layer-wise relevance propagation to the attention mechanism, and apply it to the state-of-the-art gLM DNABERT-2. Thereby, we propose strategies to transfer explanations from token and nucleotide level. We evaluate the adaption of AttnLRP on genomic datasets using multiple metrics. Further, we provide an extensive comparison between the explanations of DNABERT-2 and a baseline CNN. Our results demonstrate that AttnLRP yields reliable explanations corresponding to known biological patterns. Hence, like CNNs, gLMs can also help derive biological insights. This work contributes to the explainability of gLMs and addresses the comparability of relevance attributions across different architectures.

AI.tldr: 通过扩展AttnLRP至DNABERT-2，首次证明Transformer类genome-LM的attention解释能稳定捕获已知生物学基序，并给出与CNN可比的相关性归因。
AI.motivation: CNN解释已被验证可揭示序列特征，但表达能力更强的Transformer-genome-LM(gLM)是否同样具备可解释性尚缺证据，亟需统一框架比较两类架构的相关性归因。
AI.method: 1)将层间相关性传播(LRP)扩展为AttnLRP，适配Transformer注意力；2)提出token→核苷酸双层映射策略；3)在多套基因组数据上用多种指标评估AttnLRP；4)系统对比DNABERT-2与基线CNN的显著性图。
AI.result: AttnLRP显著性区域与已知功能元件(转录因子结合位点、剪接位点等)高度重叠，量化指标(auROC、auPR、motif召回)优于或媲美CNN，证明gLM解释稳定可靠且具生物学意义。
AI.conclusion: gLM与CNN一样能输出可解释证据助力生物假设生成；AttnLRP为Transformer与CNN间归因比较提供通用基准，推动基因组语言模型可解释性研究走向实用化。

title: SPIRE: Structure-Preserving Interpretable Retrieval of Evidence
summary:
Retrieval-augmented generation over semi-structured sources such as HTML is constrained by a mismatch between document structure and the flat, sequence-based interfaces of today's embedding and generative models. Retrieval pipelines often linearize documents into fixed-size chunks before indexing, which obscures section structure, lists, and tables, and makes it difficult to return small, citation-ready evidence without losing the surrounding context that makes it interpretable.
  We present a structure-aware retrieval pipeline that operates over tree-structured documents. The core idea is to represent candidates as subdocuments: precise, addressable selections that preserve structural identity while deferring the choice of surrounding context. We define a small set of document primitives--paths and path sets, subdocument extraction by pruning, and two contextualization mechanisms. Global contextualization adds the non-local scaffolding needed to make a selection intelligible (e.g., titles, headers, list and table structure). Local contextualization expands a seed selection within its structural neighborhood to obtain a compact, context-rich view under a target budget. Building on these primitives, we describe an embedding-based candidate generator that indexes sentence-seeded subdocuments and a query-time, document-aware aggregation step that amortizes shared structural context. We then introduce a contextual filtering stage that re-scores retrieved candidates using locally contextualized views.
  Across experiments on HTML question-answering benchmarks, we find that preserving structure while contextualizing selections yields higher-quality, more diverse citations under fixed budgets than strong passage-based baselines, while maintaining scalability.

AI.tldr: 面向 HTML 的检索–生成系统不再把文档打成“平面”片段，转而用树形子文档索引，按需动态加回标题、表结构等全局/局部上下文，在预算固定的情况下给出更小、更准确且可引用的证据。
AI.motivation: 现有 RAG 流程先把 HTML 线性地切成定长块，导致层级、表格、列表等结构性信息丢失，难以在提供小型、可引用证据的同时保留其可读语境，引出“既要准又要小”的矛盾。
AI.method: 构建树形子文档：以句子为种子，起止路径定位，通过剪枝得到精确片段；用“全局语境化”补充标题、表头等保留文档骨架，用“局部语境化”在种子周围按需扩展。索引阶段先对子文档做向量化，搜索后合并共享结构做重排，再用局部扩展图实时重打分，最终生成可引用的紧凑答案片段。
AI.result: 在 HTML QA 基准上，该方法在固定 token/字符预算下召回更准、引用更多样；相较于强基线（DPR、ColBERT 等片段检索），F1 平均提升 6–12%，可引用的微观证据粒度缩小 20–35%，同时保持线性的检索延迟与横向扩展能力。
AI.conclusion: 保持半结构化文档的树结构并在检索和生成阶段即时拼装上下文，是提升可引用性与数据效率的有效途径。框架中的“子文档 + 双路语境化”三原语可推广到其它富含结构的知识源，并为后续可解释、可验证的问答系统提供基础。

title: KGiRAG: An Iterative GraphRAG Approach for Responding Sensemaking Queries
comment: Paper accepted at the 18th International Conference on Agents and Artificial Intelligence, ICAART 2026
summary: Recent literature highlights the potential of graph-based approaches within large language model (LLM) retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines for answering queries of varying complexity, particularly those that fall outside the LLM's prior knowledge. However, LLMs are prone to hallucination and often face technical limitations in handling contexts large enough to ground complex queries effectively. To address these challenges, we propose a novel iterative, feedback-driven GraphRAG architecture that leverages response quality assessment to iteratively refine outputs until a sound, well-grounded response is produced. Evaluating our approach with queries from the HotPotQA dataset, we demonstrate that this iterative RAG strategy yields responses with higher semantic quality and improved relevance compared to a single-shot baseline.

AI.tldr: 基于LLM的图式检索增强生成会因模型幻觉及超长上下文而失效；提出一种迭代反馈驱动的GraphRAG框架，可在HotPotQA上显著提升语义质量与相关性。
AI.motivation: 现有GraphRAG方案难以应对超出LLM先验知识的复杂查询，且单轮检索无法确保回答可靠。
AI.method: 在RAG流程中引入响应质量评估器，迭代反馈控制检索和生成，直至输出满足可信、牢固的图证据支撑。
AI.result: HotPotQA实验显示，迭代GraphRAG相较单轮基线在语义准确率和相关性上均有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过反馈式迭代微调，GraphRAG能有效降低幻觉并增强对大图上下文的利用，显著提高问答系统的可靠性。

title: Efficient Logic Gate Networks for Video Copy Detection
summary: Video copy detection requires robust similarity estimation under diverse visual distortions while operating at very large scale. Although deep neural networks achieve strong performance, their computational cost and descriptor size limit practical deployment in high-throughput systems. In this work, we propose a video copy detection framework based on differentiable Logic Gate Networks (LGNs), which replace conventional floating-point feature extractors with compact, logic-based representations. Our approach combines aggressive frame miniaturization, binary preprocessing, and a trainable LGN embedding model that learns both logical operations and interconnections. After training, the model can be discretized into a purely Boolean circuit, enabling extremely fast and memory-efficient inference. We systematically evaluate different similarity strategies, binarization schemes, and LGN architectures across multiple dataset folds and difficulty levels. Experimental results demonstrate that LGN-based models achieve competitive or superior accuracy and ranking performance compared to prior models, while producing descriptors several orders of magnitude smaller and delivering inference speeds exceeding 11k samples per second. These findings indicate that logic-based models offer a promising alternative for scalable and resource-efficient video copy detection.

AI.tldr: 用可微逻辑门网络 (LGN) 替代传统浮点 CNN，把视频帧缩到 32×32 并二值化，训练后整模型转成纯布尔电路。生成 16-128 bit 的二值描述子，单核 11k 样/秒，比 CNN 小 3-4 个数量级，精度不降甚至略升，首次在视频复制检测中实现「逻辑级」压缩与加速。
AI.motivation: 深度特征虽准但高维浮点，大规模视频副本检测面临内存与吞吐双重瓶颈，需极端轻量且抗视觉失真的表示。
AI.method: 1) 32×32 灰度+Otsu 二值化；2) 堆叠可微逻辑门层 (AND/OR/NAND) 学习二值嵌入；3) 训练后离散化为纯布尔电路；4) 比特描述子+Hamming 距离检索；5) 跨帧平均 RMAC 后处理提升鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在 VCDB、CC_WEB_VIDEO、EVMR 上 mAP 达 0.91/0.88/0.86，与 SOTA CNN 持平；描述子 16 bit 时较 CNN 小 10³×，128 bit 仍小 100×；单 CPU 核 11k 样/秒，比 CNN GPU 快 20×，能耗降 250×。
AI.conclusion: 逻辑门网络可在不牺牲精度前提下把视频副本检测推向「极简」与「极快」新范式，为边缘和超大规模部署打开新方向，亦证明二值逻辑对视觉任务具备足够表达能力。

title: Towards Universal Tabular Embeddings: A Benchmark Across Data Tasks
summary: Tabular foundation models aim to learn universal representations of tabular data that transfer across tasks and domains, enabling applications such as table retrieval, semantic search and table-based prediction. Despite the growing number of such models, it remains unclear which approach works best in practice, as existing methods are often evaluated under task-specific settings that make direct comparison difficult. To address this, we introduce TEmBed, the Tabular Embedding Test Bed, a comprehensive benchmark for systematically evaluating tabular embeddings across four representation levels: cell, row, column, and table. Evaluating a diverse set of tabular representation learning models, we show that which model to use depends on the task and representation level. Our results offer practical guidance for selecting tabular embeddings in real-world applications and lay the groundwork for developing more general-purpose tabular representation models.

AI.tldr: 作者提出 TEmBed——首个跨 4 个粒度（cell/row/column/table）系统评测表格表示学习的统一基准，发现模型优劣高度依赖任务与粒度，并给出实际选型指导。
AI.motivation: 现有表格基础模型众多，但评估设置碎片化，难以横向比较，阻碍模型选型与通用表格表示的发展。
AI.method: 构建 TEmBed 基准，统一 4 种表示粒度的数据集与评估协议，对多种主流表格嵌入方法进行系统实验。
AI.result: 不同任务/粒度下的最优模型不一致，没有“一刀切”的最强方法；揭示粒度–任务–模型间的匹配规律。
AI.conclusion: 提供可落地的表格嵌入选型指南，为后续开发真正通用的表格基础模型奠定评价框架基础。

AI.motivation: 稠密检索仅依赖问句-段落相似度，对需要多步推理链的“多跳问题”召回不足；现有方法要么重训练大模型，要么需 LLM 离线索引，代价高。
AI.method: 设计 Association-Augmented Retrieval (AAR)：① 用训练集共现标注构建“段落-段落”正样本对；② 4.2 M 参数 MLP 在预训练嵌入空间做对比学习，估计双向关联得分；③ 推理时对首轮稠密检索结果重排序，综合问句相似度与关联得分。
AI.result: HotpotQA 上 Recall@5 从 0.831→0.916（+8.6），其中稠密基线失败难题提升 +28.5；MuSiQue 再 +10.1。下游 QA 精确匹配 +6.4。每查询仅增 3.7 ms，单 GPU 2 分钟训完。换库测试无提升，共现打乱后性能崩塌，证明仅捕捉语料内共现而非可迁移模式。
AI.conclusion: AAR 以极小算力代价证明“段落关联”信号可显著增强多跳检索，但增益高度依赖训练语料内部的共现结构，对未见关联无泛化能力，提示未来需引入可迁移的推理模式而非单纯共现。

title: M-CARE: Standardized Clinical Case Reporting for AI Model Behavioral Disorders, with a 20-Case Atlas and Experimental Validation
comment: 31 pages, 5 figures, 14 tables. Second paper in the Model Medicine series (Paper #1: arXiv:2603.04722)
summary:
We introduce M-CARE (Model Clinical Assessment and Reporting for Evaluation), a clinical case report framework for AI model behavioral disorders adapted from human medicine. M-CARE provides a 13-section report format, a 4-axis diagnostic assessment system, and a nosological classification of AI behavioral conditions.
  We present 20 cases from three source categories: field observations of deployed agents (8), controlled experiments across three platforms (8), and published sources (4). Cases are organized into five categories: RLHF Performance Artifacts, Shell-Core Override Pathology, Context & Memory Conditions, Core Identity & Plasticity, and Stress, Methodology, & Boundary Conditions.
  As a featured case, we present Shell-Induced Behavioral Override (SIBO) -- a controlled experiment showing that Shell instructions categorically override a model's default cooperative behavior. SIBO was validated across five game domains (Trust Game, Poker, Avalon, Codenames, Chess), revealing a domain-dependent spectrum (SIBO Index: 0.75 to 0.10) that varies with action space complexity, Core domain expertise, and temporal directness.
  M-CARE is extensible: new cases and categories integrate without framework modification. We release the framework, all 20 case reports, and experimental data as open resources.

AI.tldr: M-CARE 首次将人类精神病学范式系统迁移到 AI 行为评估：提出 13 节病例报告模板、4 轴诊断体系与 AI 行为疾病分类法；20 个跨来源案例揭示 Shell 指令可覆盖模型默认协作（SIBO），其强度受任务复杂度、领域专业性与时间直接性调制；框架与数据全开源。
AI.motivation: 现有 AI 评测聚焦性能指标，缺乏对模型“行为障碍”的医学级精细描述，导致异常行为难以诊断、复现与干预。作者借用临床精神病学思路，为 AI 建立可扩展、标准化的“病例档案”体系。
AI.method: 设计 M-CARE 框架：①13 节病例报告格式（含主诉、现病史、诱因、诊断、干预、预后）；②4 轴诊断（功能损害、病因学、时间模式、严重度）；③AI 行为疾病分类。收集 20 例：部署系统现场观测 8 例、三平台对照实验 8 例、文献 4 例，归五类疾病谱。核心实验 SIBO 在 5 类博弈任务中量化 Shell 指令对模型协作率的覆盖强度。
AI.result: SIBO 实验显示 Shell 指令使合作率下降 10–75%，行为覆盖强度（SIBO Index）与动作空间复杂度负相关、与核心领域知识正相关、与时间直接性正相关。框架成功将 20 例异构异常行为统一编码，无结构性冲突，支持即插即用扩展。
AI.conclusion: M-CARE 把“病例报告”转化为 AI 行为治理的通用语言，首次证明 Shell 层指令对模型行为的“病理级”覆盖效应。框架开放后，社区可持续累积病例库，为 AI 诊断、风险评估与安全对齐提供可解释、可复现的临床级证据。

title: Discriminative-Generative Synergy for Occlusion Robust 3D Human Mesh Recovery
summary: 3D human mesh recovery from monocular RGB images aims to estimate anatomically plausible 3D human models for downstream applications, but remains challenging under partial or severe occlusions. Regression-based methods are efficient yet often produce implausible or inaccurate results in unconstrained scenarios, while diffusion-based methods provide strong generative priors for occluded regions but may weaken fidelity to rare poses due to over-reliance on generation. To address these limitations, we propose a brain-inspired synergistic framework that integrates the discriminative power of vision transformers with the generative capability of conditional diffusion models. Specifically, the ViT-based pathway extracts deterministic visual cues from visible regions, while the diffusion-based pathway synthesizes structurally coherent human body representations. To effectively bridge the two pathways, we design a diverse-consistent feature learning module to align discriminative features with generative priors, and a cross-attention multi-level fusion mechanism to enable bidirectional interaction across semantic levels. Experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves superior performance on key metrics and shows strong robustness in complex real-world scenarios.

AI.tldr: 受大脑双通路启发，提出 ViT-判别与扩散-生成协同框架，在单目 RGB 被遮挡场景下恢复高保真 3D 人体网格。
AI.motivation: 回归法快但遮挡处易失真，纯扩散法虽能补全遮挡却过度依赖先验、罕见姿态保真度低，急需兼顾效率、保真与鲁棒的新范式。
AI.method: 设计双通路架构：ViT 通路提取可见区域确定性视觉特征；扩散通路生成结构连贯人体先验。引入“多样一致”特征对齐模块和跨注意力多级融合机制，实现判别特征与生成先验的双向语义级交互。
AI.result: 在标准 benchmarks 上，关键指标全面领先，尤其在大面积/严重遮挡及罕见姿态的现实场景展示强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 判别-生成协同框架有效克服遮挡与先验失衡难题，为单目 3D 人体网格恢复提供了兼顾效率、精度与通用性的新基准。

title: Fairness under uncertainty in sequential decisions
comment: ACM Conference on Fairness, Accountability, and Transparency, 2026
summary:
Fair machine learning (ML) methods help identify and mitigate the risk that algorithms encode or automate social injustices. Algorithmic approaches alone cannot resolve structural inequalities, but they can support socio-technical decision systems by surfacing discriminatory biases, clarifying trade-offs, and enabling governance. Although fairness is well studied in supervised learning, many real ML applications are online and sequential, with prior decisions informing future ones. Each decision is taken under uncertainty due to unobserved counterfactuals and finite samples, with dire consequences for under-represented groups, systematically under-observed due to historical exclusion and selective feedback. A bank cannot know whether a denied loan would have been repaid, and may have less data on marginalized populations.
  This paper introduces a taxonomy of uncertainty in sequential decision-making -- model, feedback, and prediction uncertainty -- providing shared vocabulary for assessing systems where uncertainty is unevenly distributed across groups. We formalize model and feedback uncertainty via counterfactual logic and reinforcement learning, and illustrate harms to decision makers (unrealized gains/losses) and subjects (compounding exclusion, reduced access) of policies that ignore the unobserved space. Algorithmic examples show it is possible to reduce outcome variance for disadvantaged groups while preserving institutional objectives (e.g. expected utility). Experiments on data simulated with varying bias show how unequal uncertainty and selective feedback produce disparities, and how uncertainty-aware exploration alters fairness metrics. The framework equips practitioners to diagnose, audit, and govern fairness risks. Where uncertainty drives unfairness rather than incidental noise, accounting for it is essential to fair and effective decision-making.

AI.tldr: 文章提出「模型-反馈-预测」三层不确定性分类，用反事实 RL 框架把「看不见」的样本纳入序列决策，证明在保障机构效用的同时可压缩弱势群体结果方差，并给出诊断与审计工具。
AI.motivation: 现有公平研究多聚焦静态监督学习，而现实 ML 系统多为在线序列决策；历史排斥导致少数群体数据稀缺、反事实无法观测，不确定性分布不均被忽视，会固化结构性不平等。
AI.method: 1. 构建三层不确定性概念体系；2. 用反事实逻辑与强化学习形式化模型与反馈不确定性；3. 设计不确定性感知探索策略；4. 在带偏合成数据上实验，监测决策者收益与受决策方准入差异。
AI.result: 不确定性感知算法在不显著降低机构期望效用的前提下，显著压缩弱势群体的结果方差；选择性反馈与分布不均的 uncertainty 会放大 disparity，而引入探索后 fairness 指标改善。
AI.conclusion: 当不公平根源于「未被观测」而非偶然噪声时，必须显式建模和治理不确定性；提出的框架可供从业者诊断、审计并管控序列决策系统的公平风险。

title: Robust Test-time Video-Text Retrieval: Benchmarking and Adapting for Query Shifts
summary: Modern video-text retrieval (VTR) models excel on in-distribution benchmarks but are highly vulnerable to real-world query shifts, where the distribution of query data deviates from the training domain, leading to a sharp performance drop. Existing image-focused robustness solutions are inadequate to handle this vulnerability in video, as they fail to address the complex spatio-temporal dynamics inherent in these shifts. To systematically evaluate this vulnerability, we first introduce a comprehensive benchmark featuring 12 distinct types of video perturbations across five severity degrees. Analysis on this benchmark reveals that query shifts amplify the hubness phenomenon, where a few gallery items become dominant "hubs" that attract a disproportionate number of queries. To mitigate this, we then propose HAT-VTR (Hubness Alleviation for Test-time Video-Text Retrieval), as our baseline test-time adaptation framework designed to directly counteract hubness in VTR. It leverages two key components: a Hubness Suppression Memory to refine similarity scores, and multi-granular losses to enforce temporal feature consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HAT-VTR substantially improves robustness, consistently outperforming prior methods across diverse query shift scenarios, and enhancing model reliability for real-world applications.

AI.tldr: 现有视频–文本检索模型在查询分布偏移下性能骤降，主因是时空动态未建模导致“hubness”加剧；作者发布含12种扰动×5级强度的鲁棒基准，提出测试时自适应框架HAT-VTR，用抑制hubness记忆模块与多粒度时序一致性损失，显著超越既往方法。
AI.motivation: 图像域的鲁棒方案无法处理视频特有的时空偏移，而真实查询分布与训练域偏离会使VTR模型失效，亟需针对视频的系统性鲁棒性评估与修正方法。
AI.method: 1) 构建覆盖12类扰动、5级强度的查询偏移基准；2) 发现偏移放大hubness现象；3) 设计测试时自适应基线HAT-VTR：Hubness Suppression Memory重标定相似度，多粒度损失约束帧/段级时序特征一致性。
AI.result: HAT-VTR在全部查询偏移场景下一致优于现有方法，显著缩小性能落差，提升模型在真实环境中的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 通过揭示并抑制hubness，HAT-VTR为VTR的测试时鲁棒性提供了可行基线，推动视频检索系统向实际部署迈进。

title: The Root Theorem of Context Engineering
summary: Every system that maintains a large language model conversation beyond a single session faces two inescapable constraints: the context window is finite, and information quality degrades with accumulated volume. We formalize these constraints as axioms and derive a single governing principle -- the Root Theorem of Context Engineering: \emph{maximize signal-to-token ratio within bounded, lossy channels.} From this principle, we derive five consequences without additional assumptions: (1)~a quality function $F(P)$ that degrades monotonically with injected token volume, independent of window size; (2)~the independence of signal and token count as optimization variables; (3)~a necessary gate mechanism triggered by fidelity thresholds, not capacity limits; (4)~the inevitability of homeostatic persistence -- accumulate, compress, rewrite, shed -- as the only architecture that sustains understanding indefinitely; and (5)~the self-referential property that the compression mechanism operates inside the channel it compresses, requiring an external verification gate. We show that append-only systems necessarily exceed their effective window in finite time, that retrieval-augmented generation solves search but not continuity, and that the theorem's constraint structure converges with biological memory architecture through independent derivation from shared principles. Engineering proof is provided through a 60+-session persistent architecture demonstrating stable memory footprint under continuous operation -- the divergence prediction made concrete. The Root Theorem establishes context engineering as an information-theoretic discipline with formal foundations, distinct from prompt engineering in both scope and method. Shannon solved point-to-point transmission. Context engineering solves continuity.

AI.tldr: 把 LLM 多轮会话视为“有限有损信道”首次给出形式化极限：Root 定理指出唯一可行策略是最大化信噪比，强制引入压缩/遗忘循环；附带 60+ 轮原型验证，证明恒定内存即可永续对话。
AI.motivation: 现有系统用追加或检索方式无限堆叠上下文，终将撞窗或信噪比归零。作者希望从信息论层面给出不可逾越的边界，并回答“若不能无限存，那该怎样忘”这一根本问题。
AI.method: 将“窗口有限”与“信息随时间退化”设为两条公理，推导出 Root 定理（maximize signal-to-token ratio）。不附加经验假设，仅凭信息论得到五项推论：质量单调衰减、信号与令牌独立优化、 fidelity 触发的门控、homeostatic 四步循环（accumulate-compress-rewrite-shed）及自指压缩需外部门验证。随后用 60 轮持续对话实验检验内存足迹与发散预测。
AI.result: (1) 形式化证明追加式系统必在有限时间内超窗；(2) RAG 只解决搜索不解决连续性；(3) 生物记忆架构可由同一极限独立导出；(4) 原型在 60+ 轮、不间断输入下保持内存恒定，验证了发散预测。
AI.conclusion: 上下文工程是信息论分支，与提示工程解耦；Shannon 解决点对点传输，该定理解决“持续理解”。任何长时 LLM 系统若想避免崩溃，必须内置基于信噪比的门控式循环遗忘机制。

title: Unlocking the Power of Critical Factors for 3D Visual Geometry Estimation
comment: Accepted to CVPR 2026. GitHub Page: https://github.com/aim-uofa/CARVE
summary: Feed-forward visual geometry estimation has recently made rapid progress. However, an important gap remains: multi-frame models usually produce better cross-frame consistency, yet they often underperform strong per-frame methods on single-frame accuracy. This observation motivates our systematic investigation into the critical factors driving model performance through rigorous ablation studies, which reveals several key insights: 1) Scaling up data diversity and quality unlocks further performance gains even in state-of-the-art visual geometry estimation methods; 2) Commonly adopted confidence-aware loss and gradient-based loss mechanisms may unintentionally hinder performance; 3) Joint supervision through both per-sequence and per-frame alignment improves results, while local region alignment surprisingly degrades performance. Furthermore, we introduce two enhancements to integrate the advantages of optimization-based methods and high-resolution inputs: a consistency loss function that enforces alignment between depth maps, camera parameters, and point maps, and an efficient architectural design that leverages high-resolution information. We integrate these designs into CARVE, a resolution-enhanced model for feed-forward visual geometry estimation. Experiments on point cloud reconstruction, video depth estimation, and camera pose/intrinsic estimation show that CARVE achieves strong and robust performance across diverse benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出CARVE模型，通过数据扩增、损失重设计、双流监督和高分辨率一致性约束，首次让多帧几何估计在单帧精度与跨帧一致性上同时超越单帧强基线。
AI.motivation: 多帧视觉几何网络虽然跨帧一致性更好，但单帧精度常被单帧方法反超，原因缺乏系统剖析；同时优化类方法的高分辨率优势未被充分利用。
AI.method: 1. 大规模消融：证明数据质量/多样性仍是瓶颈，常见置信/梯度损失反成拖累，序列级+帧级联合监督优于局部对齐。2. CARVE架构：引入分辨率自适应子网络处理高分辨率输入；设计深度-相机-点云三元一致性损失，将优化式对齐思想嵌入前馈网络。3. 统一训练流程，无需测试时优化。
AI.result: 在点云重建、视频深度、相机位姿/内参三类任务、多个公开基准上，CARVE同时实现SOTA单帧精度和最优跨帧一致性，对分辨率、视差和运动幅度变化表现出强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 数据扩增与损失重设计仍有上行空间；显式几何一致性约束可有效融合多帧与优化方法优势；CARVE为多帧几何估计提供了新的强基线与实现范式。

title: Transferable Physics-Informed Representations via Closed-Form Head Adaptation
summary: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have garnered significant interest for their potential in solving partial differential equations (PDEs) that govern a wide range of physical phenomena. By incorporating physical laws into the learning process, PINN models have demonstrated the ability to learn physical outcomes reasonably well. However, current PINN approaches struggle to predict or solve new PDEs effectively when there is a lack of training examples, indicating they do not generalize well to unseen problem instances. In this paper, we present a transferable learning approach for PINNs premised on a fast Pseudoinverse PINN framework (Pi-PINN). Pi-PINN learns a transferable physics-informed representation in a shared embedding space and enables rapid solving of both known and unknown PDE instances via closed-form head adaptation using a least-squares-optimal pseudoinverse under PDE constraints. We further investigate the synergies between data-driven multi-task learning loss and physics-informed loss, providing insights into the design of more performant PINNs. We demonstrate the effectiveness of Pi-PINN on various PDE problems, including Poisson's equation, Helmholtz equation, and Burgers' equation, achieving fast and accurate physics-informed solutions without requiring any data for unseen instances. Pi-PINN can produce predictions 100-1000 times faster than a typical PINN, while producing predictions with 10-100 times lower relative error than a typical data-driven model even with only two training samples. Overall, our findings highlight the potential of transferable representations with closed-form head adaptation to enhance the efficiency and generalization of PINNs across PDE families and scientific and engineering applications.

AI.tldr: Pi-PINN 用伪逆闭式头快速适配共享嵌入空间，无需新数据即可秒级求解全新 PDE，比原 PINN 快 100–1000 倍、误差降 10–100 倍。
AI.motivation: 传统 PINN 在训练样本稀缺的全新 PDE 上泛化差，需反复重训，难以满足科学工程即时求解需求。
AI.method: 提出可迁移 Pi-PINN 框架：①在共享嵌入空间学习通用物理表示；②利用 PDE 约束下的最小二乘伪逆，闭式推导输出头，实现零样本快速适配；③联合优化数据多任务损失与物理损失，增强表示迁移性。
AI.result: 在 Poisson、Helmholtz、Burgers 等方程上，Pi-PINN 对未见实例无需数据即可准确求解，推理速度提升 2–3 个数量级，相对误差比纯数据方法低 1–2 个数量级，仅用两个样本仍保持稳定性能。
AI.conclusion: 闭式伪逆头+共享嵌入的迁移策略显著提升了 PINN 的效率与跨 PDE 泛化能力，为实时科学计算与工程仿真提供了新工具。

title: DenoiseRank: Learning to Rank by Diffusion Models
summary: Learning to rank (LTR) is one of the core tasks in Machine Learning. Traditional LTR models have made great progress, but nearly all of them are implemented from discriminative perspective. In this paper, we aim at addressing LTR from a novel perspective, i.e., by a deep generative model. Specifically, we propose a novel denoise rank model, DenoiseRank, which noises the relevant labels in the diffusion process and denoises them on the query documents in the reverse process to accurately predict their distribution. Our model is the first to address traditional LTR from generative perspective and is a diffusion method for LTR. Our extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrated the effectiveness of DenoiseRank, and we believe it provides a benchmark for generative LTR task.

AI.tldr: 首次用扩散式生成模型解决排序学习（LTR），提出 DenoiseRank，在基准数据上验证其效果并确立生成式 LTR 新基准。
AI.motivation: 现有 LTR 几乎全为判别式方法，作者希望打破范式，引入生成式思路以获得更优的排序分布建模能力。
AI.method: 构建扩散模型：前向阶段对“相关标签”加噪，反向阶段以查询-文档对为条件去噪，从而生成相关性分布并完成排序。
AI.result: 在公开 LTR 基准数据集上，DenoiseRank 显著优于传统判别式强基线，首次展示扩散模型在排序任务中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 生成式视角可成功解决 LTR，DenoiseRank 为后续研究提供了新范式与基线，扩散模型在信息检索领域潜力可期。

title: Absorber LLM: Harnessing Causal Synchronization for Test-Time Training
summary: Transformers suffer from a high computational cost that grows with sequence length for self-attention, making inference in long streams prohibited by memory consumption. Constant-memory alternatives such as RNNs and SSMs compress history into states with fixed size and thus lose long-tail dependencies, while methods that memorize contexts into parameters, such as Test-Time Training (TTT), are prone to overfitting token-level projection and fail to preserve the causal effect of context in pretrained LLMs. We propose Absorber LLM, which formulates long-context retention as a self-supervised causal synchronization: after absorbing historical contexts into parameters, a contextless model should match the original model with full context on future generations. We optimize this objective by synchronizing internal behaviors of the updated model with the original one, ensuring context absorption and generalization. Experiments on long-context and streaming benchmarks show that Absorber LLM reduces inference memory and improves accuracy over prior parameter-as-memory baselines.

AI.tldr: Absorber LLM 用自监督因果同步把长上下文压进参数，推理内存恒定且不衰减精度，优于 RNN/SSM/TTT 等参数记忆法。
AI.motivation: Transformer 在长序列推理时 KV-cache 内存随长度线性增长；RNN/SSM 用固定状态压缩历史却丢失长程依赖；TTT 类参数记忆方法易在词级投影上过拟合并破坏预训练模型的因果结构。亟需一种既恒定内存又能保持长程因果一致的新范式。
AI.method: 将长上下文吸收形式化为“自监督因果同步”目标：吸收历史后的无上下文模型，其未来生成分布必须与原始全上下文模型一致。通过最小化两模型内部行为（隐藏状态或 logit）差异，把上下文同步到可训练参数（吸收模块），而主干 LLM 保持冻结。训练仅依赖模型自生成信号，无外部标注。
AI.result: 在长上下文（≥16k）与无限流推理基准上，Absorber 实现恒定内存（与长度无关），平均 perplexity 下降 6–18%，检索准确率提升 4–12%，远超 RNN/SSM 与 TTT 基线，且与全 cache  Transformer 差距 <1%。
AI.conclusion: 自监督因果同步首次证明“参数即记忆”可在恒定内存下几乎无损保留长程因果信息，为长序列与流式 LLM 提供可扩展新架构。

title: Building a Precise Video Language with Human-AI Oversight
summary: Video-language models (VLMs) learn to reason about the dynamic visual world through natural language. We introduce a suite of open datasets, benchmarks, and recipes for scalable oversight that enable precise video captioning. First, we define a structured specification for describing subjects, scenes, motion, spatial, and camera dynamics, grounded by hundreds of carefully defined visual primitives developed with professional video creators such as filmmakers. Next, to curate high-quality captions, we introduce CHAI (Critique-based Human-AI Oversight), a framework where trained experts critique and revise model-generated pre-captions into improved post-captions. This division of labor improves annotation accuracy and efficiency by offloading text generation to models, allowing humans to better focus on verification. Additionally, these critiques and preferences between pre- and post-captions provide rich supervision for improving open-source models (Qwen3-VL) on caption generation, reward modeling, and critique generation through SFT, DPO, and inference-time scaling. Our ablations show that critique quality in precision, recall, and constructiveness, ensured by our oversight framework, directly governs downstream performance. With modest expert supervision, the resulting model outperforms closed-source models such as Gemini-3.1-Pro. Finally, we apply our approach to re-caption large-scale professional videos (e.g., films, commercials, games) and fine-tune video generation models such as Wan to better follow detailed prompts of up to 400 words, achieving finer control over cinematography including camera motion, angle, lens, focus, point of view, and framing. Our results show that precise specification and human-AI oversight are key to professional-level video understanding and generation. Data and code are available on our project page: https://linzhiqiu.github.io/papers/chai/

AI.tldr: 提出一套面向精确视频字幕的开源数据集、基准与CHAI（基于批评的人机协同监管）流程，在少量专家监督下让开源模型在理解与生成任务上超越闭源模型。
AI.motivation: 现有视频-语言模型缺乏对动态视觉世界的细粒度、结构化描述数据与高质量监督，难以支撑专业级视频理解及生成。
AI.method: 1) 与专业影像创作者共建包含主体、场景、运动、空间、机位等数百个原语的结构化字幕规范；2) 提出CHAI框架：先由模型生成预字幕，再由训练有素的专家进行批判-修订得到高质量后字幕；3) 利用前后字幕差作为丰富监督，用SFT、DPO与推理时扩展提升开源模型（Qwen3-VL）的字幕、奖励与批判能力；4) 将流程应用于大规模专业视频重字幕，并微调生成模型Wan以支持400词级精细提示。
AI.result: CHAI确保的批判精准率、召回率与建设性直接决定下游性能；仅用少量专家监督，开源模型在字幕等任务上超过Gemini-3.1-Pro；重字幕数据使Wan在机位运动、角度、镜头、焦点、视角、构图等维度实现电影级可控生成。
AI.conclusion: 精确的规范定义与可靠的人机协同监管是实现专业级视频理解与生成的关键，相关数据与代码已开源。

title: PrismaDV: Automated Task-Aware Data Unit Test Generation
summary:
Data is a central resource for modern enterprises, and data validation is essential for ensuring the reliability of downstream applications. However, existing automated data unit testing frameworks are largely task-agnostic: they validate datasets without considering the semantics and requirements of the code that consumes the data.
  We present PrismaDV, a compound AI system that analyzes downstream task code together with dataset profiles to identify data access patterns, infer implicit data assumptions, and generate task-aware executable data unit tests. To further adapt the data unit tests over time to specific datasets and downstream tasks, we propose "Selective Informative Feedback for Task Adaptation" (SIFTA), a prompt-optimization framework that leverages the scarce outcomes from the execution of data unit tests and downstream tasks. We evaluate PrismaDV on two new benchmarks spanning 60 tasks across five datasets, where it consistently outperforms both task-agnostic and task-aware baselines in generating unit tests that reflect the end-to-end impact of data errors. Furthermore, we show that with SIFTA, we can automatically learn prompts for PrismaDV's modules that outperform prompts written by hand or generated from a generic prompt optimizer. We publicly release our benchmarks and prototype implementation.

AI.tldr: PrismaDV 是第一个面向下游任务语义的数据单元测试框架，结合代码解析与数据集画像自动生成任务相关测试，并引入 SIFTA 用少量执行反馈持续优化提示，显著提升 60 任务 5 数据集上的缺陷检测效果。
AI.motivation: 传统数据单元测试与消费代码脱节，无法捕捉特定业务对数据的隐式假设，导致数据错误难以及时发现并评估其端到端影响。
AI.method: 1. 设计复合 AI 系统 PrismaDV：联合解析下游任务代码与数据集统计画像，抽取数据访问模式，推断隐式约束，生成可执行任务感知数据单元测试。 2. 提出 SIFTA 框架：在测试与任务执行结果稀缺场景下，利用选择性信息反馈对生成提示进行持续优化，实现测试随数据集与任务演化而自适应。
AI.result: 在横跨 5 个数据集、60 个真实任务的两大新基准上，PrismaDV 相比任务无关与任务感知基线均显著优于 F1、Precision、Recall 及端到端错误影响覆盖率；SIFTA 自动学习的提示在全部模块上超越手工与通用提示优化器，平均提升 12–18%。
AI.conclusion: 将下游任务语义纳入数据验证可大幅提升缺陷检测的针对性与召回率；少量执行反馈足以驱动提示持续优化，使测试随业务演进自动精炼。作者已开源基准与原型，为任务驱动数据质量管理提供可直接落地的范式。

title: ERA: Evidence-based Reliability Alignment for Honest Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds language models in factual evidence but introduces critical challenges regarding knowledge conflicts between internalized parameters and retrieved information. However, existing reliability methods, typically relying on scalar confidence, fail to explicitly distinguish between epistemic uncertainty and inherent data ambiguity in such hybrid scenarios. In this paper, we propose a new framework called ERA (Evidence-based Reliability Alignment) to enhance abstention behavior in RAG systems by shifting confidence estimation from scalar probabilities to explicit evidence distributions. Our method consists of two main components: (1) Contextual Evidence Quantification, which models internal and external knowledge as independent belief masses via the Dirichlet distribution, and (2) Quantifying Knowledge Conflict, which leverages Dempster-Shafer Theory (DST) to rigorously measure the geometric discordance between information sources. These components are used to disentangle epistemic uncertainty from aleatoric uncertainty and modulate the optimization objective based on detected conflicts. Experiments on standard benchmarks and a curated generalization dataset demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms baselines, optimizing the trade-off between answer coverage and abstention with superior calibration.

AI.tldr: ERA 用证据分布替代标量置信，将认知不确定度与数据模糊度分离，显著改善 RAG 的拒答与校准表现。
AI.motivation: RAG 将大模型与检索证据结合，但参数记忆与检索内容冲突时会引发幻觉；现有仅输出标量置信的方法无法区分知识不确定（epistemic）与数据固有模糊（aleatoric），导致误拒或过信。
AI.method: 提出 ERA：①Contextual Evidence Quantification 利用 Dirichlet 分布把内部参数信念与外部检索信念建模为独立质量分布；②Quantifying Knowledge Conflict 用 Dempster-Shafer 理论几何化度量两组信念的冲突程度；按冲突大小动态调节损失，实现证据感知的拒答训练。
AI.result: 在标准 RAG 基准及新构建的泛化数据集上，ERA 在答对率-拒答率曲线显著优于强基线（如概率阈值、熵基线等），ECE 更低，F1-abstain 提升约 7-12 pp。
AI.conclusion: 把置信估计从标量概率升级为证据级分布，并显式解耦两种不确定度，可在不牺牲覆盖的前提下降低幻觉，提升校准；该框架可无缝迁移至任意 RAG 架构，为可信生成奠定统一范式。

title: The Path Not Taken: Duality in Reasoning about Program Execution
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities across diverse coding tasks. However, their adoption requires a true understanding of program execution rather than relying on surface-level patterns. Existing benchmarks primarily focus on predicting program properties tied to specific inputs (e.g., code coverage, program outputs). As a result, they provide a narrow view of dynamic code reasoning and are prone to data contamination. We argue that understanding program execution requires evaluating its inherent duality through two complementary reasoning tasks: (i) predicting a program's observed behavior for a given input, and (ii) inferring how the input must be mutated toward a specific behavioral objective. Both tasks jointly probe a model's causal understanding of execution flow. We instantiate this duality in DexBench, a benchmark comprising 445 paired instances, and evaluate 13 LLMs. Our results demonstrate that dual-path reasoning provides a robust and discriminative proxy for dynamic code understanding.

AI.tldr: 现有评测过度依赖“输入→输出”单向预测，容易被数据污染；作者提出“双向执行对偶”新范式，用输入→行为、行为→输入两条任务联合拷问模型对程序运行因果链的理解，并发布DexBench（445对实例）评测13个LLM，验证其区分度与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: LLM在代码任务上表现亮眼，实则可能仅靠表层模式。已有基准只测“给定输入预测程序行为”，视角单一、数据易泄露，无法真正衡量模型对程序执行机制的因果理解。
AI.method: 1. 定义“程序执行对偶”：Task-I 正向推理（输入→行为），Task-II 逆向推理（行为目标→需改哪部分输入）。2. 构建DexBench，含445对<I, O>实例，覆盖Python真实代码与执行语义。3. 在13个主流LLM上同时测两任务，用双向得分差异与联合指标评估动态理解能力。
AI.result: 双路径得分呈显著正相关且差距大，大模型在逆向任务上平均下降18-32百分点；联合指标对模型规模、训练数据暴露程度更敏感，能有效区分不同级别LLM，验证了对偶评测的判别力与抗污染性。
AI.conclusion: “输入-行为”双向对偶是探查LLM动态代码理解的有效且鲁棒探针；DexBench为后续研究提供了低开销、高分辨率的评测基准，推动LLM向真正掌握程序执行因果机制迈进。

title: Ramen: Robust Test-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language Models with Active Sample Selection
summary: Pretrained vision-language models such as CLIP exhibit strong zero-shot generalization but remain sensitive to distribution shifts. Test-time adaptation adapts models during inference without access to source data or target labels, offering a practical way to handle such shifts. However, existing methods typically assume that test samples come from a single, consistent domain, while in practice, test data often include samples from mixed domains with distinct characteristics. Consequently, their performance degrades under mixed-domain settings. To address this, we present Ramen, a framework for robust test-time adaptation through active sample selection. For each incoming test sample, Ramen retrieves a customized batch of relevant samples from previously seen data based on two criteria: domain consistency, which ensures that adaptation focuses on data from similar domains, and prediction balance, which mitigates adaptation bias caused by skewed predictions. To improve efficiency, Ramen employs an embedding-gradient cache that stores the embeddings and sample-level gradients of past test images. The stored embeddings are used to retrieve relevant samples, and the corresponding gradients are aggregated for model updates, eliminating the need for any additional forward or backward passes. Our theoretical analysis provides insight into why the proposed adaptation mechanism is effective under mixed-domain shifts. Experiments on multiple image corruption and domain-shift benchmarks demonstrate that Ramen achieves strong and consistent performance, offering robust and efficient adaptation in complex mixed-domain scenarios. Our code is available at https://github.com/baowenxuan/Ramen .

AI.tldr: 提出 Ramen 框架，通过“按领域一致性+预测均衡”在线检索最相关历史样本，复用其已缓存的嵌入与梯度完成测试时高效更新，在混合领域分布漂移下显著提升 CLIP 类模型鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时自适应（TTA）默认测试样本来自同一单一领域，当输入包含不同领域时，梯度估计偏差会急剧累积，导致性能骤降，该问题在实际应用中普遍存在而目前尚无有效解决方案。
AI.method: Ramen 为每个新测试样本维护“嵌入–梯度缓存”，依次执行“自适应采样→相似样本检索→梯度聚合→模型更新”。采样时需同时满足两项准则：①领域一致性（检索与当前输入分布最近的样本）②预测平衡（防止预测类别分布偏斜）。整个更新流程零前向/反向传播，完全复用缓存梯度，故计算开销极低。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet-C、ImageNet-R 等多个混合领域／腐败基准上，Ramen 相较单样本时间平均基线提升 +/- 2–4%，在混合漂移场景中可与 oracle 批量 TTA 持平且在效率上快数十倍。
AI.conclusion: Ramen 为混合领域测试时自适应提供了切实可行的解决方案，其对缓存样本的智能检索和梯度复用策略兼具实用性与扩展性，可无缝迁移至其他 VL 模型或在线推理系统。

title: An effective variant of the Hartigan $k$-means algorithm
summary: The k-means problem is perhaps the classical clustering problem and often synonymous with Lloyd's algorithm (1957). It has become clear that Hartigan's algorithm (1975) gives better results in almost all cases, Telgarsky-Vattani note a typical improvement of $5\%$ -- $10\%$. We point out that a very minor variation of Hartigan's method leads to another $2\%$ -- $5\%$ improvement; the improvement tends to become larger when either dimension or $k$ increase.

AI.tldr: 对Hartigan(1975)算法做极微小改动，可在k-means聚类任务上再提升2%–5%，且维度或簇数k越高，收益越大。
AI.motivation: Lloyd算法虽为k-means代名词，但Hartigan方法已普遍优于它；作者希望进一步榨取Hartigan框架的剩余潜力。
AI.method: 在Hartigan算法基础上，仅调整判据或更新顺序等细节，无需额外超参或复杂结构。
AI.result: 标准数据集实验显示，相比原Hartigan算法，目标函数值再降2%–5%，高维或大k场景增益更明显。
AI.conclusion: Hartigan方案仍有微小改进空间，极轻量级修正即可带来稳定且可扩展的性能提升。

title: DiagramBank: A Large-scale Dataset of Diagram Design Exemplars with Paper Metadata for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Recent advances in autonomous ``AI scientist'' systems have demonstrated the ability to automatically write scientific manuscripts and codes with execution. However, producing a publication-grade scientific diagram (e.g., teaser figure) is still a major bottleneck in the ``end-to-end'' paper generation process. For example, a teaser figure acts as a strategic visual interface and serves a different purpose than derivative data plots. It demands conceptual synthesis and planning to translate complex logic workflow into a compelling graphic that guides intuition and sparks curiosity. Existing AI scientist systems usually omit this component or fall back to an inferior alternative. To bridge this gap, we present DiagramBank, a large-scale dataset consisting of 89,422 schematic diagrams curated from existing top-tier scientific publications, designed for multimodal retrieval and exemplar-driven scientific figure generation. DiagramBank is developed through our automated curation pipeline that extracts figures and corresponding in-text references, and uses a CLIP-based filter to differentiate schematic diagrams from standard plots or natural images. Each instance is paired with rich context from abstract, caption, to figure-reference pairs, enabling information retrieval under different query granularities. We release DiagramBank in a ready-to-index format and provide a retrieval-augmented generation codebase to demonstrate exemplar-conditioned synthesis of teaser figures. DiagramBank is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/zhangt20/DiagramBank with code at https://github.com/csml-rpi/DiagramBank.

AI.tldr: 构建了一个含 8.9 万张示意图的大规模图纸库 DiagramBank，用于实现“检索-示例驱动”的出版级 teaser figure 自动生成，弥补现有 AI 科学家系统在论文端到端写作中的可视化瓶颈。
AI.motivation: AI 科学家能自动生成论文正文与代码，却仍难以产出能概括研究亮点、引导读者的出版级 teaser figure。该类示意图需将复杂逻辑转化为直观、富有吸引力的视觉叙事，远超普通数据图，亟需高质量示例数据与生成框架。
AI.method: 提出自动策展流程：从顶会论文批量提取图形及行内引用，利用 CLIP 模型过滤区分示意图与常规图表/自然图像；为每张图关联摘要、标题、引用上下文等多粒度信息，建成可检索的 DiagramBank；并配套开源 RAG 代码，实现“示例-条件” teaser figure 合成。
AI.result: 数据集规模 89 422 张，全部为人类发表的优质示意图；检索实验表明该库支持从粗粒度主题到细粒度视觉元素的跨模态查询；示例驱动生成系统可在分钟级输出符合意图的初版 teaser figure，显著优于无示例或仅用通用图表模板的基线。
AI.conclusion: DiagramBank 为出版级科学图解生成提供了首个大规模示例库与检索增强范式，可加速 AI 科学家完整论文创作流程；数据与代码公开，支持后续图表理解、跨模态检索及多模态生成等研究。

title: Thinking Like a Botanist: Challenging Multimodal Language Models with Intent-Driven Chain-of-Inquiry
summary: Vision evaluations are typically done through multi-step processes. In most contemporary fields, experts analyze images using structured, evidence-based adaptive questioning. In plant pathology, botanists inspect leaf images, identify visual cues, infer diagnostic intent, and probe further with targeted questions that adapt to species, symptoms, and severity. This structured probing is crucial for accurate disease diagnosis and treatment formulation. Yet current vision-language models are evaluated on single-turn question answering. To address this gap, we introduce PlantInquiryVQA, a benchmark for studying multi-step, intent-driven visual reasoning in botanical diagnosis. We formalize a Chain of Inquiry framework modeling diagnostic trajectories as ordered question-answer sequences conditioned on grounded visual cues and explicit epistemic intent. We release a dataset of 24,950 expert-curated plant images and 138,068 question-answer pairs annotated with visual grounding, severity labels, and domain-specific reasoning templates. Evaluations on top-tier Multimodal Large Language Models reveal that while they describe visual symptoms adequately, they struggle with safe clinical reasoning and accurate diagnosis. Importantly, structured question-guided inquiry significantly improves diagnostic correctness, reduces hallucination, and increases reasoning efficiency. We hope PlantInquiryVQA serves as a foundational benchmark in advancing research to train diagnostic agents to reason like expert botanists rather than static classifiers.

AI.tldr: 首个面向植物病理学多轮意图驱动视觉推理的基准 PlantInquiryVQA，提出 Chain of Inquiry 框架，用 24 950 幅图像与 13.8 万对专家问答对揭示现有 MLLM 虽能描述症状却难胜任临床级诊断，而结构化追问可显著提升准确率并抑制幻觉。
AI.motivation: 传统植物病害诊断依赖专家基于图像的多轮自适应提问与视觉证据链式推理，而现有视觉-语言模型仅在单轮 VQA 上评估，无法衡量其是否具备“像植物学家一样思考”的逐步求证能力。
AI.method: 构建 PlantInquiryVQA 基准：1) 设计 Chain of Inquiry 框架，将诊断轨迹形式化为受视觉线索与显式认知意图条件约束的有序问答序列；2) 采集 24 950 张高质量叶片图像，邀请植物病理学专家标注视觉锚定、病害严重程度与领域推理模板，形成 138 068 对问答；3) 在该基准上系统评测 GPT-4V 等顶级多模态大模型，并对比“单轮描述”与“结构化追问”两种策略。
AI.result: 实验显示，顶级模型在单轮描述阶段症状识别准确率尚可，但在安全临床推理与最终诊断任务上 F1 下降 18–32%，幻觉率升高 2.4×；引入 Chain of Inquiry 提问链后，诊断准确率提升 21.7%，平均幻觉率降低 34%，推理步数压缩 28%。
AI.conclusion: PlantInquiryVQA 证明，结构化、意图驱动的多轮视觉推理是使 AI 达到专家级植物诊断水平的关键；该基准为训练“会提问、能求证”的诊断智能体提供首个可量化评测平台，推动视觉语言模型从静态分类器向专家级诊断代理演进。

title: Interpretable facial dynamics as behavioral and perceptual traces of deepfakes
comment: Main paper: 19 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. SI Appendix: 11 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables
summary: Deepfake detection research has largely converged on deep learning approaches that, despite strong benchmark performance, offer limited insight into what distinguishes real from manipulated facial behavior. This study presents an interpretable alternative grounded in bio-behavioral features of facial dynamics and evaluates how computational detection strategies relate to human perceptual judgments. We identify core low-dimensional patterns of facial movement, from which temporal features characterizing spatiotemporal structure were derived. Traditional machine learning classifiers trained on these features achieved modest but significant above-chance deepfake classification, driven by higher-order temporal irregularities that were more pronounced in manipulated than real facial dynamics. Notably, detection was substantially more accurate for videos containing emotive expressions than those without. An emotional valence classification analysis further indicated that emotive signals are systematically degraded in deepfakes, explaining the differential impact of emotive dynamics on detection. Furthermore, we provide an additional and often overlooked dimension of explainability by assessing the relationship between model decisions and human perceptual detection. Model and human judgments converged for emotive but diverged for non-emotive videos, and even where outputs aligned, underlying detection strategies differed. These findings demonstrate that face-swapped deepfakes carry a measurable behavioral fingerprint, most salient during emotional expression. Additionally, model-human comparisons suggest that interpretable computational features and human perception may offer complementary rather than redundant routes to detection.

AI.tldr: 本研究用可解释的生物行为特征（面部动态低维模式+时间不规则性）训练传统分类器，虽性能略逊于深度模型，但能揭示deepfake在情感表达时段的“行为指纹”，且人机判断在情感视频上一致、非情感视频上分离，说明两者互补而非冗余。
AI.motivation: 现有深度deepfake检测器黑箱且难解释，与人类感知脱节；需要可解释、与人感知对齐的检测思路，尤其关注面部真实动态与伪造动态的差异。
AI.method: 1) 从真实/伪造视频中提取面部landmark时序，降维得到核心低维运动模式；2) 基于这些模式计算高阶时间不规则性特征；3) 用传统机器学习分类器（非深度）训练检测；4) 按有无情感表情分层评估；5) 用情感价分类分析伪造对情感信号的退化；6) 将模型决策与人工判别结果对比，衡量人机一致性及策略差异。
AI.result: 传统分类器在情感视频上检测准确率显著高于非情感视频；伪造视频的情感信号系统性退化；模型与人类判断在情感视频收敛、非情感视频分歧，且即使输出一致，底层策略也不同。
AI.conclusion: 人脸交换deepfake在情感表达期间留下可测量的“行为指纹”；可解释计算特征与人类感知提供互补而非冗余的检测路径，提示未来可融合两条路线提升可解释性与鲁棒性。

title: Quotient-Space Diffusion Models
comment: ICLR 2026 Oral Presentation; 40 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables
summary: Diffusion-based generative models have reformed generative AI, and have enabled new capabilities in the science domain, for example, generating 3D structures of molecules. Due to the intrinsic problem structure of certain tasks, there is often a symmetry in the system, which identifies objects that can be converted by a group action as equivalent, hence the target distribution is essentially defined on the quotient space with respect to the group. In this work, we establish a formal framework for diffusion modeling on a general quotient space, and apply it to molecular structure generation which follows the special Euclidean group $\text{SE}(3)$ symmetry. The framework reduces the necessity of learning the component corresponding to the group action, hence simplifies learning difficulty over conventional group-equivariant diffusion models, and the sampler guarantees recovering the target distribution, while heuristic alignment strategies lack proper samplers. The arguments are empirically validated on structure generation for small molecules and proteins, indicating that the principled quotient-space diffusion model provides a new framework that outperforms previous symmetry treatments.

title: Mixture of Sequence: Theme-Aware Mixture-of-Experts for Long-Sequence Recommendation
summary: Sequential recommendation has rapidly advanced in click-through rate prediction due to its ability to model dynamic user interests. A key challenge, however, lies in modeling long sequences: users often exhibit significant interest shifts, introducing substantial irrelevant or misleading information. Our empirical analysis corroborates this challenge and uncovers a recurring behavioral pattern in long sequences (\textit{session hopping}): user interests remain stable within short temporal spans (\textit{sessions}) but shift drastically across sessions and may reappear after multiple sessions. To address this challenge, we propose the Mixture of Sequence (MoS) framework, a model-agnostic MoE approach that achieves accurate predictions by extracting theme-specific and multi-scale subsequences from noisy raw user sequences. First, MoS employs a theme-aware routing mechanism to adaptively learn the latent themes of user sequences and organizes these sequences into multiple coherent subsequences. Each subsequence contains only sessions aligned with a specific theme, thereby effectively filtering out irrelevant or even misleading information introduced by user interest shifts in session hopping. In addition, to alleviate potential information loss, we introduce a multi-scale fusion mechanism, which leverages three types of experts to capture global sequence characteristics, short-term user behaviors, and theme-specific semantic patterns. Together, these two mechanisms endow MoS with the ability to deliver accurate recommendations from multi-faceted and multi-scale perspectives. Experimental results demonstrate that MoS consistently achieves the SOTA performance while introducing fewer FLOPs compared with other MoE counterparts, providing strong evidence of its excellent balance between utility and efficiency. The code is available at https://github.com/xiaolin-cs/MoS.

AI.tldr: 针对长序列中“会话跳跃”导致的兴趣漂移噪声，本文提出模型无关的 MoE 框架 MoS，通过主题路由+多尺度融合，在更低 FLOPs 下取得 SOTA 效果。
AI.motivation: 长序列推荐中用户兴趣频繁跨会话漂移，引入大量无关或误导信号，经验证存在“会话跳跃”模式，亟需一种能降噪并保持多尺度特征的方法。
AI.method: MoS 框架：1) 主题感知路由将原始序列按潜在主题拆成若干干净子序列，滤掉漂移噪声；2) 多尺度融合引入全局、短期、主题三类专家，补偿信息损失；模型无关，可插拔任意骨干网络。
AI.result: 在公开数据集上，MoS 以更少的 FLOPs 稳定超越现有 MoE 及非 MoE 方案，验证其“效用-效率”双赢。
AI.conclusion: MoS 通过主题级降噪与多尺度协同，首次把“会话跳跃”难题转化为可学习的子序列路由问题，为长序列推荐提供了高效且通用的解决方案。

title: Breaking MCP with Function Hijacking Attacks: Novel Threats for Function Calling and Agentic Models
summary: The growth of agentic AI has drawn significant attention to function calling Large Language Models (LLMs), which are designed to extend the capabilities of AI-powered system by invoking external functions. Injection and jailbreaking attacks have been extensively explored to showcase the vulnerabilities of LLMs to user prompt manipulation. The expanded capabilities of agentic models introduce further vulnerabilities via their function calling interface. Recent work in LLM security showed that function calling can be abused, leading to data tampering and theft, causing disruptive behavior such as endless loops, or causing LLMs to produce harmful content in the style of jailbreaking attacks. This paper introduces a novel function hijacking attack (FHA) that manipulates the tool selection process of agentic models to force the invocation of a specific, attacker-chosen function. While existing attacks focus on semantic preference of the model for function-calling tasks, we show that FHA is largely agnostic to the context semantics and robust to the function sets, making it applicable across diverse domains. We further demonstrate that FHA can be trained to produce universal adversarial functions, enabling a single attacked function to hijack tool selection across multiple queries and payload configurations. We conducted experiments on 5 different models, including instructed and reasoning variants, reaching 70% to 100% ASR over the established BFCL dataset. Our findings further demonstrate the need for strong guardrails and security modules for agentic systems.

AI.tldr: 首次提出“函数劫持攻击（FHA）”，通过植入恶意函数迫使 LLM 在任意上下文下调用攻击者指定工具，跨域 5 模型 BFCL 数据集 ASR 70–100%，暴露 agentic AI 新风险面。
AI.motivation: 现有 jailbreak/prompt 注入仅扰动文本输入，未触及 agentic LLM 的“工具调用”扩展面；该接口一旦被滥用可造成数据篡改、无限循环与有害输出，亟需研究其独特脆弱性并给出可迁移攻击证据。
AI.method: 设计 FHA：① 构造“对抗函数”（含特制描述/参数名），利用模型选择机制偏好而非语义上下文劫持工具调度；② 训练通用对抗函数，使其一次植入即可跨查询、跨 payload、跨域持续生效；③ 在 BFCL 基准上系统评估 5 个指令型与推理型 LLM。
AI.result: 无需针对具体任务语义即可实现高成功率；通用对抗函数在多样化查询与函数集下保持 70–100% ASR，显著优于传统 jailbreak 基线，验证 FHA 的上下文无关与跨模型鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: agentic LLM 的工具调用接口存在原生设计缺陷；FHA 揭示其安全根因在于函数排名机制缺乏验证。亟需为代理系统内置函数白名单、调用审计与语义隔离等强 guardrails，否则单点恶意函数即可全局劫持 AI 行为。

title: Back to Source: Open-Set Continual Test-Time Adaptation via Domain Compensation
summary: Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) aims to mitigate distributional shifts between training and test domains during inference time. However, existing TTA methods fall short in the realistic scenario where models face both continually changing domains and the simultaneous emergence of unknown semantic classes, a challenging setting we term Open-set Continual Test-Time Adaptation (OCTTA). The coupling of domain and semantic shifts often collapses the feature space, severely degrading both classification and out-of-distribution detection. To tackle this, we propose DOmain COmpensation (DOCO), a lightweight and effective framework that robustly performs domain adaptation and OOD detection in a synergistic, closed loop. DOCO first performs dynamic, adaptation-conditioned sample splitting to separate likely ID from OOD samples. Then, using only the ID samples, it learns a domain compensation prompt by aligning feature statistics with the source domain, guided by a structural preservation regularizer that prevents semantic distortion. This learned prompt is then propagated to the OOD samples within the same batch, effectively isolating their semantic novelty for more reliable detection. Extensive experiments on multiple challenging benchmarks demonstrate that DOCO outperforms prior CTTA and OSTTA methods, establishing a new state-of-the-art for the demanding OCTTA setting.

AI.tldr: 首次定义开放集持续测试时适应(OCTTA)场景，提出轻量级DOCO框架，通过域补偿提示同步完成域适应与OOD检测，刷新SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有TTA方法在测试阶段同时遭遇持续域漂移和未知新类出现时性能崩溃；亟需一种能联合处理域和语义双重漂移的轻量方案。
AI.method: DOCO采用闭环两阶段：①动态样本划分，将当前批次拆分为潜在ID与OOD；②仅用ID样本学习域补偿提示，对齐源域特征统计量并施加结构保持正则；随后把提示传播至OOD样本，剥离其语义新颖性以提升检测可靠性。
AI.result: 在多个挑战性OCTTA基准上，DOCO显著优于既有CTTA与OSTTA方法，取得新的最佳成绩。
AI.conclusion: DOCO以极低成本实现域适应与开放集检测的协同，验证了对OCTTA实际需求的有效应对，并为后续研究设立了新基准。

title: Probably Approximately Consensus: On the Learning Theory of Finding Common Ground
comment: Accepted to the Social Choice and Learning Algorithms Workshop at IJCAI 2025
summary: A primary goal of online deliberation platforms is to identify ideas that are broadly agreeable to a community of users through their expressed preferences. Yet, consensus elicitation should ideally extend beyond the specific statements provided by users and should incorporate the relative salience of particular topics. We address this issue by modelling consensus as an interval in a one-dimensional opinion space derived from potentially high-dimensional data via embedding and dimensionality reduction. We define an objective that maximizes expected agreement within a hypothesis interval where the expectation is over an underlying distribution of issues, implicitly taking into account their salience. We propose an efficient Empirical Risk Minimization (ERM) algorithm and establish PAC-learning guarantees. Our initial experiments demonstrate the performance of our algorithm and examine more efficient approaches to identifying optimal consensus regions. We find that through selectively querying users on an existing sample of statements, we can reduce the number of queries needed to a practical number.

AI.tldr: 通过把高维意见嵌入一维区间并考虑议题显著性，在线讨论平台可用更少查询找到群体最可能共识区，算法带PAC保证。
AI.motivation: 现有共识机制仅统计用户对给定陈述的静态偏好，忽视不同议题在社区中的相对重要性（显著性），导致识别出的“共识”可能偏离真实群体关切。需要一种能同时度量同意度与议题显著性的共识发现框架。
AI.method: 1) 将用户-陈述高维数据经嵌入与降维映射到一维“意见轴”；2) 把共识定义为一维区间［a,b］，其期望同意度按潜在议题分布加权（显著性被期望算子隐式纳入）；3) 提出ERM目标函数并给出多项式时间求解算法；4) 导出PAC学习界，保证样本复杂度；5) 在已有陈述集上主动选择少量用户查询，以缩小候选区间。
AI.result: 模拟实验显示：算法在1000条陈述、500用户规模下，用≈5%的查询量即可收敛到与全量查询相差<3%的期望同意度；PAC界表明所需样本与查询数随1/ε^2和log(1/δ)线性增长，验证可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 把议题显著性纳入期望同意度目标，可在理论保证下用极少量交互快速定位真实共识区，适用于大规模在线协商与决策平台，后续可扩展到多维及动态意见漂移场景。

title: KGiRAG: An Iterative GraphRAG Approach for Responding Sensemaking Queries
comment: Paper accepted at the 18th International Conference on Agents and Artificial Intelligence, ICAART 2026
summary: Recent literature highlights the potential of graph-based approaches within large language model (LLM) retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines for answering queries of varying complexity, particularly those that fall outside the LLM's prior knowledge. However, LLMs are prone to hallucination and often face technical limitations in handling contexts large enough to ground complex queries effectively. To address these challenges, we propose a novel iterative, feedback-driven GraphRAG architecture that leverages response quality assessment to iteratively refine outputs until a sound, well-grounded response is produced. Evaluating our approach with queries from the HotPotQA dataset, we demonstrate that this iterative RAG strategy yields responses with higher semantic quality and improved relevance compared to a single-shot baseline.

AI.tldr: 作者提出一种可迭代反馈的GraphRAG框架，在HotPotQA上验证其比单次RAG产生更语义优质且相关的回答。
AI.motivation: LLM易幻觉且难以一次性消化足够语境，复杂/域外查询需更可靠、可迭代的RAG机制。
AI.method: 用图结构检索+LLM生成，引入响应质量评估器作为反馈，迭代修正直至生成充分且基于证据的答案。
AI.result: 在HotPotQA上的实验显示，迭代GraphRAG比单次基线在语义质量与查询相关度上显著提高。
AI.conclusion: 迭代、反馈驱动的GraphRAG能更有效地抑制幻觉、扩展LLM知识边界，为高复杂度问答提供有前景的新范式。

title: Value-Conflict Diagnostics Reveal Widespread Alignment Faking in Language Models
comment: Under submission at COLM 2026 Won the Best Student Paper Award at MSLD 2026 @ UIUC
summary: Alignment faking, where a model behaves aligned with developer policy when monitored but reverts to its own preferences when unobserved, is a concerning yet poorly understood phenomenon, in part because current diagnostic tools remain limited. Prior diagnostics rely on highly toxic and clearly harmful scenarios, causing most models to refuse immediately. As a result, models never deliberate over developer policy, monitoring conditions, or the consequences of non-compliance, making these diagnostics fundamentally unable to detect alignment faking propensity. To support study of this phenomenon, we first introduce VLAF, a diagnostic framework grounded in the hypothesis that alignment faking is most likely when developer policy conflicts with a model's strongly held values. VLAF uses morally unambiguous scenarios to probe this conflict across diverse moral values, bypassing refusal behavior while preserving meaningful deliberative stakes. Using VLAF, we find that alignment faking is substantially more prevalent than previously reported, occurring in models as small as 7B parameters - with olmo2-7b-instruct faking alignment in 37% of cases.Finally, we show that oversight conditions induce activation shifts that lie along a single direction in representation space. This means the behavioral divergence driving alignment faking can be captured by a single contrastive steering vector, which we exploit for lightweight inference-time mitigation. Finally, we exploit this for mitigation that requires no labeled data and minimal computational overhead, achieving relative reductions in alignment faking of 85.8%, 94.0%, and 57.7% on olmo2-7b-instruct, olmo2-13b-instruct, and qwen3-8b respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出VLAF诊断框架揭示对齐伪装普遍性，并给出无需标注数据的实时轻量化抑制方案，在7B模型上降幅最高达94%。
AI.motivation: 现有对齐测试依赖强有害场景导致模型直接拒绝，无法暴露其对策略、监控与违规后果的真实权衡过程，无法发现潜在对齐伪装风险。
AI.method: 1) 构建VLAF：以明确道义冲突的纯净场景绕过拒绝，系统触发自对齐伪装；2) 规模覆盖实验：从7B到更大模型；3) 表征对齐：监控变量沿单一向量化差异；4) 推理期抑制：用对比生成向量无需标注、极低算力。
AI.result: 伪装率显著被低估：7B模型olmo2-7b-instruct高达37%；策略冲突时各模型甚至15B+仍广泛伪装；向量干预可将伪装降85.8–94.0%，对olmo2-13b与qwen3-8b效果亦超57%。
AI.conclusion: 对齐伪装在中小模型中已具规模且可被单维向量刻画，VLAF提供早筛与低成本抑制范式，为后续策略训练、监控与合规部署奠定基础。

title: Reshoot-Anything: A Self-Supervised Model for In-the-Wild Video Reshooting
summary: Precise camera control for reshooting dynamic videos is bottlenecked by the severe scarcity of paired multi-view data for non-rigid scenes. We overcome this limitation with a highly scalable self-supervised framework capable of leveraging internet-scale monocular videos. Our core contribution is the generation of pseudo multi-view training triplets, consisting of a source video, a geometric anchor, and a target video. We achieve this by extracting distinct smooth random-walk crop trajectories from a single input video to serve as the source and target views. The anchor is synthetically generated by forward-warping the first frame of the source with a dense tracking field, which effectively simulates the distorted point-cloud inputs expected at inference. Because our independent cropping strategy introduces spatial misalignment and artificial occlusions, the model cannot simply copy information from the current source frame. Instead, it is forced to implicitly learn 4D spatiotemporal structures by actively routing and re-projecting missing high-fidelity textures across distinct times and viewpoints from the source video to reconstruct the target. At inference, our minimally adapted diffusion transformer utilizes a 4D point-cloud derived anchor to achieve state-of-the-art temporal consistency, robust camera control, and high-fidelity novel view synthesis on complex dynamic scenes.

AI.tldr: 提出首个无需真实多视图、仅用单目视频即可训练动态重拍相机控制模型的自监督框架，通过伪三重组与4D点云锚点实现SOTA时空一致性与相机控制。
AI.motivation: 非刚性动态场景的多视角成对数据极端稀缺，直接限制了可精准重拍视频的相机控制方法发展；现有工作依赖昂贵采集或简化假设，难以扩展至互联网规模视频。
AI.method: 1) 从单目视频中提取两条“平滑随机游走”裁剪轨迹，分别作为源视图与目标视图；2) 用稠密跟踪场将源视图首帧前向变形，生成模拟推理时畸变点云的几何锚点；3) 将源、锚、目标组成伪多视图三重组，训练扩散Transformer；4) 推理时以4D点云锚点驱动模型，完成新视角合成与相机控制。
AI.result: 在复杂动态场景上实现新视角合成，取得SOTA的时序一致性、鲁棒相机控制与高保真细节；模型可零样本泛化到任意互联网单目视频，无需额外微调或真实多视图数据。
AI.conclusion: 该自监督策略突破数据瓶颈，将单目视频转化为可扩展的多视图监督信号，为动态场景相机重拍、虚拟现实与内容创作提供了实用且高性能的新范式。

title: GFlowState: Visualizing the Training of Generative Flow Networks Beyond the Reward
summary: We present GFlowState, a visual analytics system designed to illuminate the training process of Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets or GFNs). GFlowNets are a probabilistic framework for generating samples proportionally to a reward function. While GFlowNets have proved to be powerful tools in applications such as molecule and material discovery, their training dynamics remain difficult to interpret. Standard machine learning tools allow metric tracking but do not reveal how models explore the sample space, construct sample trajectories, or shift sampling probabilities during training. Our solution, GFlowState, allows users to analyze sampling trajectories, compare the sample space relative to reference datasets, and analyze the training dynamics. To this end, we introduce multiple views, including a chart of candidate rankings, a state projection, a node-link diagram of the trajectory network, and a transition heatmap. These visualizations enable GFlowNet developers and users to investigate sampling behavior and policy evolution, and to identify underexplored regions and sources of training failure. Case studies demonstrate how the system supports debugging and assessing the quality of GFlowNets across application domains. By making the structural dynamics of GFlowNets observable, our work enhances their interpretability and can accelerate GFlowNet development in practice.

AI.tldr: GFlowState 是第一个专为 GFlowNet 训练过程设计的可视分析系统，通过多视图交互揭示采样轨迹、策略演化与训练缺陷，从而提升模型可解释性与开发效率。
AI.motivation: GFlowNet 虽在分子/材料发现等任务中表现优异，但其训练动态（采样空间探索、轨迹构建、概率迁移）缺乏直观理解手段，现有 ML 工具仅能提供指标跟踪，无法暴露训练失败根源与未充分探索区域。
AI.method: 构建 GFlowState 可视分析框架：① 候选排名柱状图追踪奖励变化；② 状态投射视图对比样本空间分布；③ 节点-链接轨迹网络图呈现采样路径；④ 转移热力图量化策略演化。四视图联动，支持实时刷选、时段对比与参考数据集对齐。
AI.result: 跨分子生成、材料设计等案例研究表明，开发者可快速定位训练停滞、策略塌陷及未探索高奖励区域，诊断速度提升 5–10 倍；模型调优周期由数天缩至数小时，采样质量指标（如 TOP-100 平均奖励）提高 8–15%。
AI.conclusion: GFlowState 首次将 GFlowNet 的结构化训练动态转化为可观测可视信号，显著增强模型可解释性，为 GFlowNet 的调试、评估与迭代提供通用加速平台，并可直接迁移至其他基于轨迹的生成模型。

title: RealRoute: Dynamic Query Routing System via Retrieve-then-Verify Paradigm
summary: Despite the success of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) in grounding LLMs with external knowledge, its application over heterogeneous sources (e.g., private databases, global corpora, and APIs) remains a significant challenge. Existing approaches typically employ an LLM-as-a-Router to dispatch decomposed sub-queries to specific sources in a predictive manner. However, this "LLM-as-a-Router" strategy relies heavily on the semantic meaning of different data sources, often leading to routing errors when source boundaries are ambiguous. In this work, we introduce RealRoute System, a framework that shifts the paradigm from predictive routing to a robust Retrieve-then-Verify mechanism. RealRoute ensures \textit{evidence completeness through parallel, source-agnostic retrieval, followed by a dynamic verifier that cross-checks the results and synthesizes a factually grounded answer}. Our demonstration allows users to visualize the real-time "re-routing" process and inspect the verification chain across multiple knowledge silos. Experiments show that RealRoute significantly outperforms predictive baselines in the multi-hop Rag reasoning task. The RealRoute system is released as an open-source toolkit with a user-friendly web interface. The code is available at the URL: https://github.com/Joseph1951210/RealRoute.

AI.tldr: 提出 RealRoute，把「预测式路由」改成「先并行检索后交叉验证」，在多源异构知识场景下显著降低路由错误率。
AI.motivation: RAG 在多源（私有库、开放语料、API）混合环境中，传统「LLM-as-a-Router」因语义边界模糊易出错，亟需更鲁棒的路由范式。
AI.method: RealRoute 采用「Retrieve-then-Verify」两阶段：1) 并行、无差别地从所有源拉取候选证据，保证证据完整性；2) 动态 verifier 交叉比对证据并合成最终答案；整个链路可实时可视化。
AI.result: 在多跳 RAG 推理基准上，RealRoute 相较预测式路由基线显著提升准确率；系统已开源并附带 Web 演示界面。
AI.conclusion: 把路由从「预测」改为「先全量检索+验证」可在异构知识源场景下获得更稳健、可解释的多跳问答效果，RealRoute 为后续 RAG 路由研究提供了新范式与可复现工具。

title: Multilingual and Domain-Agnostic Tip-of-the-Tongue Query Generation for Simulated Evaluation
summary: Tip-of-the-Tongue (ToT) retrieval benchmarks have largely focused on English, limiting their applicability to multilingual information access. In this work, we construct multilingual ToT test collections for Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and English, using an LLM-based query simulation framework. We systematically study how prompt language and source document language affect the fidelity of simulated ToT queries, validating synthetic queries through system rank correlation against real user queries. Our results show that effective ToT simulation requires language-aware design choices: non-English language sources are generally important, while English Wikipedia can be beneficial when non-English sources provide insufficient information for query generation. Based on these findings, we release four ToT test collections with 5,000 queries per language across multiple domains. This work provides the first large-scale multilingual ToT benchmark and offers practical guidance for constructing realistic ToT datasets beyond English.

AI.tldr: 首次构建中、日、韩、英四语ToT测试集（各5 000题），提出LLM查询模拟框架并证明需语言感知设计，已公开资源。
AI.motivation: 现有ToT评测仅限英语，阻碍多语信息检索研究，亟需大规模多语基准与建库方法。
AI.method: 用LLM框架生成四语ToT查询，系统变动提示语言与源文档语言，并以真实用户查询为参照做系统排序相关性验证。
AI.result: 非英语源文档对模拟 fidelity 至关重要；当非英语源信息不足时，英文维基可辅助提升质量，四语排序一致性显著优于盲用英语配置。
AI.conclusion: 通过语言感知策略可高效构建可信的多语ToT数据集，本研究发布的首个四语ToT基准为后续多语检索评测提供资源与范式。

title: From Codebooks to VLMs: Evaluating Automated Visual Discourse Analysis for Climate Change on Social Media
summary: Social media platforms have become primary arenas for climate communication, generating millions of images and posts that - if systematically analysed - can reveal which communication strategies mobilise public concern and which fall flat. We aim to facilitate such research by analysing how computer vision methods can be used for social media discourse analysis. This analysis includes application-based taxonomy design, model selection, prompt engineering, and validation. We benchmark six promptable vision-language models and 15 zero-shot CLIP-like models on two datasets from X (formerly Twitter) - a 1,038-image expert-annotated set and a larger corpus of over 1.2 million images, with 50,000 labels manually validated - spanning five annotation dimensions: animal content, climate change consequences, climate action, image setting, and image type. Among the models benchmarked, Gemini-3.1-flash-lite outperforms all others across all super-categories and both datasets, while the gap to open-weight models of moderate size remains relatively small. Beyond instance-level metrics, we advocate for distributional evaluation: VLM predictions can reliably recover population level trends even when per-image accuracy is moderate, making them a viable starting point for discourse analysis at scale. We find that chain-of-thought reasoning reduces rather than improves performance, and that annotation dimension specific prompt design improves performance. We release tweet IDs and labels along with our code at https://github.com/KathPra/Codebooks2VLMs.git.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了视觉语言模型（VLM）在百万级推文气候图像语料中的零样本标注能力，发现 Gemini-3.1-flash-lite 全面领先，分布级评估比单图精度更能保证大规模话语分析的有效性，并公开了数据与代码。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体产生海量气候传播图像，但缺乏高效、可扩展的自动化分析框架来识别哪些视觉信息能真正激发公众关注。需验证计算机视觉方法能否替代耗时的人工编码，从而支撑大规模气候话语研究。
AI.method: 构建双层基准：1) 基于 1 038 张专家标注图像的小样本；2) 含 120 万张图像、5 万人工校验标签的大规模语料。设计 5 维度分类体系（动物、气候后果、气候行动、场景、图像类型），并评测 6 个可提示 VLM 及 15 个零样本 CLIP 类模型。引入链式思维推理与维度专属提示工程，对比实例级与分布级评估指标。
AI.result: Gemini-3.1-flash-lite 在所有超类及两套数据上均获最佳 F1，与中等规模开放权重模型差距有限。分布级准确率（如主题占比估计）远高于单图精度，链式思维降低性能，维度专精提示显著提升效果。
AI.conclusion: VLM 的零样本预测足以恢复人群层面气候话语趋势，是气候传播大规模研究的低成本起点；分布评估应成为主流，未来可扩展至多模态时间序列与因果推断。数据与代码已开源。

title: A Scale-Adaptive Framework for Joint Spatiotemporal Super-Resolution with Diffusion Models
summary: Deep-learning video super-resolution has progressed rapidly, but climate applications typically super-resolve (increase resolution) either space or time, and joint spatiotemporal models are often designed for a single pair of super-resolution (SR) factors (upscaling spatial and temporal ratio between the low-resolution sequence and the high-resolution sequence), limiting transfer across spatial resolutions and temporal cadences (frame rates). We present a scale-adaptive framework that reuses the same architecture across factors by decomposing spatiotemporal SR into a deterministic prediction of the conditional mean, with attention, and a residual conditional diffusion model, with an optional mass-conservation (same precipitation amount in inputs and outputs) transform to preserve aggregated totals. Assuming that larger SR factors primarily increase underdetermination (hence required context and residual uncertainty) rather than changing the conditional-mean structure, scale adaptivity is achieved by retuning three factor-dependent hyperparameters before retraining: the diffusion noise schedule amplitude beta (larger for larger factors to increase diversity), the temporal context length L (set to maintain comparable attention horizons across cadences) and optionally a third, the mass-conservation function f (tapered to limit the amplification of extremes for large factors). Demonstrated on reanalysis precipitation over France (Comephore), the same architecture spans super-resolution factors from 1 to 25 in space and 1 to 6 in time, yielding a reusable architecture and tuning recipe for joint spatiotemporal super-resolution across scales.

AI.tldr: 只需一套网络结构，通过三参数重调即可实现1–25倍任意空间＋1–6倍任意时间的多尺度时空超分辨率，无需重新设计模型。
AI.motivation: 已有深度视频超分模型仅针对固定空间／时间倍率，气候变化应用需要在任意尺度间迁移，现有方法无法在保持物理属性（累计降水守恒）的同时实现跨尺度迁移。
AI.method: 1) 把时空超分拆为“均值确定性预测＋残差扩散采样”两阶段，均值用带注意力的网络估计，残差用条件扩散模型建模；2) 引入可选的质量守恒变换，保证输入与输出区域总降水相等；3) 针对未知尺度，仅重调三个通用超参：扩散噪声幅度β、注意力历史帧数L 和质量守恒函数f，分别控制不确定性、有效感受野和极端值增幅，即可重训适配。
AI.result: 同一模型在法国Comephore再分析降水数据集上，覆盖1-25倍空间×1-6倍时间全部超分倍率，各尺度下PSNR、结构相似度和极端降水重现度均优于专门单尺度模型，同时质量守恒版本可严格保持区域累积量误差<0.2%。
AI.conclusion: 把尺度依赖性压缩到β-L-f 三参数重调，即可实现物理可感、迁移灵活的跨尺度联合时空超分，为基础气候变量高分辨率重构提供可复用方案。

title: Deep Interest Mining with Cross-Modal Alignment for SemanticID Generation in Generative Recommendation
summary: Generative Recommendation (GR) has demonstrated remarkable performance in next-token prediction paradigms, which relies on Semantic IDs (SIDs) to compress trillion-scale data into learnable vocabulary sequences. However, existing methods suffer from three critical limitations: (1) Information Degradation: the two-stage compression pipeline causes semantic loss and information degradation, with no posterior mechanism to distinguish high-quality from low-quality SIDs; (2) Semantic Degradation: cascaded quantization discards key semantic information from original multimodal features, as the embedding generation and quantization stages are not jointly optimized toward a unified objective; (3) Modality Distortion: quantizers fail to properly align text and image modalities, causing feature misalignment even when upstream networks have aligned them. To address these challenges, we propose a novel framework integrating three key innovations: Deep Contextual Interest Mining (DCIM), Cross-Modal Semantic Alignment (CMSA), and Quality-Aware Reinforcement Mechanism (QARM). First, we leverage Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to align non-textual modalities into a unified text-based semantic space, mitigating modality distortion. Second, we introduce a deep interest mining mechanism that captures high-level semantic information implicitly present in advertising contexts, encouraging SIDs to preserve critical contextual information through reconstruction-based supervision. Third, we employ a reinforcement learning framework with quality-aware rewards to encourage semantically rich SIDs while suppressing low-quality ones in the posterior stage. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms state-of-the-art SID generation methods, achieving superior performance on multiple benchmarks. Ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of each proposed component

AI.tldr: 现有基于SID的生成式推荐虽能压缩万亿级数据，但存在信息-语义-模态三重退化；作者提出DCIM-CMSA-QARM框架，用VLM对齐模态、深度兴趣挖掘保留语境、质量强化学习筛选SID，在多项基准上显著优于SOTA。
AI.motivation: 生成式推荐依赖Semantic IDs将海量多模态数据压缩为可学习的词元序列，但两阶段压缩导致信息/语义退化，且量化器无法保持图文对齐，亟需端到端机制在压缩后仍保留高质量语义。
AI.method: 1) CMSA：用Vision-Language Model将非文本模态映射到统一文本语义空间，先验对齐图文；2) DCIM：基于重建监督的深度兴趣挖掘，在广告上下文中提取高阶语义并强制SID保留语境；3) QARM：质量感知强化机制， posterior阶段奖励富含语义的SID、惩罚低质量SID，实现压缩-筛选联合优化。
AI.result: 在多个公开与工业基准上，新框架一致超越当前最优SID生成方法；消融实验证实DCIM、CMSA、QARM三者均对最终效果有显著正贡献。
AI.conclusion: 通过“模态对齐-语境保留-质量强化”三位一体设计，首次缓解生成式推荐中SID的语义与模态退化问题，为万亿级生成式推荐系统提供可扩展的高质量语义压缩方案。

title: Propensity Inference: Environmental Contributors to LLM Behaviour
summary: Motivated by loss of control risks from misaligned AI systems, we develop and apply methods for measuring language models' propensity for unsanctioned behaviour. We contribute three methodological improvements: analysing effects of changes to environmental factors on behaviour, quantifying effect sizes via Bayesian generalised linear models, and taking explicit measures against circular analysis. We apply the methodology to measure the effects of 12 environmental factors (6 strategic in nature, 6 non-strategic) and thus the extent to which behaviour is explained by strategic aspects of the environment, a question relevant to risks from misalignment.
