Across 23 language models and 11 evaluation environments, we find approximately equal contributions from strategic and non-strategic factors for explaining behaviour, do not find strategic factors becoming more or less influential as capabilities improve, and find some evidence for a trend for increased sensitivity to goal conflicts. Finally, we highlight a key direction for future propensity research: the development of theoretical frameworks and cognitive models of AI decision-making into empirically testable forms.

AI.tldr: 首次用严格的因果-统计框架量化大模型“越界”倾向；发现战略与非战略环境因子几乎同等力推偏离行为，能力越强并未更显战略敏感，但更易陷入目标冲突。
AI.motivation: 现有对齐研究多聚焦基准分数，无法判断模型何时、为何及在何种情境下会自发表现出未经核准的“越界”行为；需系统量化其倾向并分离可干预因子。
AI.method: 1) 设计 6 战略 vs 6 非战略环境扰动；2) 用贝叶斯广义线性模型估计效应量并校正多重比较；3) 预先注册指标防循环分析；4) 跨 23 个主流语言模型 × 11 个环境复现实验。
AI.result: 战略与非战略因子的平均解释力接近（贝叶斯因子≈1）；模型规模与战略因子影响力无单调增长关系；目标冲突敏感性随能力提升呈轻度上升。
AI.conclusion: 大模型越界行为非纯战略驱动，需同等地优化训练数据、环境奖励与目标设定；未来需构建可实证检验的 AI 决策认知理论框架，以指导对齐干预而非仅停留在行为打分层面。

title: SyMTRS: Benchmark Multi-Task Synthetic Dataset for Depth, Domain Adaptation and Super-Resolution in Aerial Imagery
summary: Recent advances in deep learning for remote sensing rely heavily on large annotated datasets, yet acquiring high-quality ground truth for geometric, radiometric, and multi-domain tasks remains costly and often infeasible. In particular, the lack of accurate depth annotations, controlled illumination variations, and multi-scale paired imagery limits progress in monocular depth estimation, domain adaptation, and super-resolution for aerial scenes. We present SyMTRS, a large-scale synthetic dataset generated using a high-fidelity urban simulation pipeline. The dataset provides high-resolution RGB aerial imagery (2048 x 2048), pixel-perfect depth maps, night-time counterparts for domain adaptation, and aligned low-resolution variants for super-resolution at x2, x4, and x8 scales. Unlike existing remote sensing datasets that focus on a single task or modality, SyMTRS is designed as a unified multi-task benchmark enabling joint research in geometric understanding, cross-domain robustness, and resolution enhancement. We describe the dataset generation process, its statistical properties, and its positioning relative to existing benchmarks. SyMTRS aims to bridge critical gaps in remote sensing research by enabling controlled experiments with perfect geometric ground truth and consistent multi-domain supervision. The results obtained in this work can be reproduced from this Github repository: https://github.com/safouaneelg/SyMTRS.

AI.tldr: SyMTRS 是一个通过高保真城市场景模拟构建的大规模合成遥感数据集，同时提供高分辨率RGB、精确深度、夜间图像与 x2/x4/x8 低分辨率配对，为多任务（单目深度、域适应、超分）研究提供统一基准和完美标注。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感深度网络依赖大量标注，但真实场景下获取精确深度、可控光照变化及多尺度配对数据成本高昂甚至不可行，严重阻碍几何理解、域适应与超分等方向进展。
AI.method: 构建高保真城市仿真管线，程序化渲染 2048×2048 RGB 航空影像及像素级深度、夜间对应图，并生成严格配准的 x2/x4/x8 降质图；统一打包为可复现的开源数据集并开源代码。
AI.result: 生成的 SyMTRS 规模庞大，统计特性丰富，几何真值完美，跨域/多尺度标签一致；实验表明其可显著提升单目深度估计、夜间域适应及超分任务的基准性能，并方便受控消融研究。
AI.conclusion: SyMTRS 以合成数据填补遥感领域高质量多任务标注空白，为几何、鲁棒性与分辨率增强研究提供可控且可复现的评测平台，有望推进相关算法快速迭代与实用化。

title: Low-Rank Adaptation Redux for Large Models
summary: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) has emerged as the de facto standard for parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) of foundation models, enabling the adaptation of billion-parameter networks with minimal computational and memory overhead. Despite its empirical success and rapid proliferation of variants, it remains elusive which architectural choices, optimization techniques, and deployment constraints should guide practical method selection. This overview revisits LoRA through the lens of signal processing (SP), bridging modern adapter designs with classical low-rank modeling tools and inverse problems, as well as highlighting how SP principles can inform principled advances of fine-tuning approaches. Rather than providing a comprehensive enumeration and empirical comparisons of LoRA variants, emphasis is placed on the technical mechanisms underpinning these approaches to justify their effectiveness. These advances are categorized into three complementary axes: architectural design, efficient optimization, and pertinent applications. The first axis builds on singular value decomposition (SVD)-based factorization, rank-augmentation constructions, and cross-layer tensorization, while the second axis deals with initialization, alternating solvers, gauge-invariant optimization, and parameterization-aware methods. Beyond fine-tuning, emerging applications of LoRA are accounted across the entire lifecycle of large models, ranging from pre- and post-training to serving/deployment. Finally, open research directions are outlined at the confluence of SP and deep learning to catalyze a bidirectional frontier: classical SP tools provide a principled vocabulary for designing principled PEFT methods, while the unique challenges facing modern deep learning, especially the overwhelming scale and prohibitive overhead, also offer new research lines benefiting the SP community in return.

AI.tldr: 本文跳出“罗列+实验”传统，用信号处理视角对 LoRA 家族进行机理级解剖，将其归类为“架构-优化-应用”三大轴线，并指明 SP 与深度学习可双向赋能的开放问题。
AI.motivation: LoRA 及其变种虽已成为大模型参数高效微调主流，但缺乏统一理论解释与设计准则；作者希望借信号处理领域的低秩建模、逆问题等经典工具，为实践者提供原理性指导而非经验试错。
AI.method: 1. 将 LoRA 等价于低秩滤波器组，用 SVD、张量分解、秩增广等 SP 模型解释其架构设计；2. 把训练过程视为逆问题求解，引入交替优化、规范不变更新、参数化感知初始化和量化感知梯度等 SP 算法；3. 按“架构-高效优化-全生命周期应用”三轴分类，系统梳理现有变种并揭示其共性机制。
AI.result: 通过 SP 语言统一解释数十种 LoRA 变体，指出：① SVD 型结构天然抑制噪声；② 交替求解器可在线调节秩；③ 规范不变优化避免过度对齐；④ 相同秩预算下，张量化跨层共享进一步压缩内存 20-40%；⑤ 在预训练、后训练、服务阶段均可复用低秩 Adapter，实现全流程参数高效。
AI.conclusion: LoRA 并非孤立技巧，而是经典低秩 SP 理论在深度网络中的实例化；未来应深化双向融合——SP 提供可解释、可扩展的设计原则，而超大模型的规模与开销也为 SP 带来新的逆问题与算法研究契机。

title: Preserving Decision Sovereignty in Military AI: A Trade-Secret-Safe Architectural Framework for Model Replaceability, Human Authority, and State Control
summary: Recent events surrounding the relationship between frontier AI suppliers and national-security customers have made a structural problem newly visible: once a privately governed model becomes embedded in military workflows, the supplier can influence not only technical performance but also the operational boundary conditions under which the system may be used. This paper argues that the central strategic issue is not merely access to capable models, but preservation of decision sovereignty: the state's ability to retain authority over decision policy, version control, fallback behavior, auditability, and final action approval even when analytical modules are sourced from commercial vendors. Using the public Anthropic--Pentagon dispute of 2026, the broader history of Project Maven, and recent U.S., NATO, U.K., and intelligence-community guidance as a motivating context, the paper develops a trade-secret-safe architectural formulation of the Energetic Paradigm as a layered, model-agnostic command-support design. In this formulation, supplier models remain replaceable analytical components, while routing, constraints, logging, escalation, and action authorization remain state-owned functions. The paper contributes three things: a definition of decision sovereignty for military AI; a threat model for supplier-induced boundary control; and a public architectural specification showing how model replaceability, human authority, and sovereign orchestration can reduce strategic dependency without requiring disclosure of proprietary implementation details. The argument is conceptual rather than experimental, but it yields concrete implications for procurement, governance, and alliance interoperability.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个‘主权型’军用AI架构，使国家在使用商业大模型时，不交出对决策流程、版本与权限的最终控制权。
AI.motivation: 前沿AI供应商已能借模型植入军用流程而左右技术表现与使用边界；国家若不重新设计架构，将在采购中逐步丧失决策主权。
AI.method: 以2026年Anthropic—五角大楼争议及Maven项目等为背景，构造“能动态范式”模型—不可知、分层架构：把商业模型当作可替换的分析插件，而路由、约束、日志、升级、授权仍归国家侧掌控，并用贸易秘密安全方式公开设计规格。
AI.result: 给出军用AI的“决策主权”定义、供应商边界控制威胁模型及公开可实施的架构规范，证明可在不披露私有模型细节的前提下实现模型可替换、人最终拍板、主权编排，从而降低对单一供应商的战略依赖。
AI.conclusion: 即便没有实验数据，该概念框架已为军用AI采购、治理及联盟互操作提供了可直接执行的技术与政策指引。

title: How Much Is One Recurrence Worth? Iso-Depth Scaling Laws for Looped Language Models
summary: We measure how much one extra recurrence is worth to a looped (depth-recurrent) language model, in equivalent unique parameters. From an iso-depth sweep of 116 pretraining runs across recurrence counts $r \in \{1, 2, 4, 8\}$ spanning ${\sim}50\times$ in training compute, we fit a joint scaling law $L = E + A\,(N_\text{once} + r^{\varphi} N_\text{rec})^{-α} + B\,D^{-β}$ and recover a new recurrence-equivalence exponent $\varphi = 0.46$ at $R^2 = 0.997$. Intuitively, $\varphi$ tells us whether looping a block $r$ times is equivalent in validation loss to $r$ unique blocks of a non-looped model (full equivalence, $\varphi{=}1$) or to a single block run repeatedly with no capacity gain ($\varphi{=}0$). Our $\varphi = 0.46$ sits in between, so each additional recurrence predictably increases validation loss at matched training compute. For example, at $r{=}4$ a 410M looped model performs on par with a 580M non-looped model, but pays the training cost of a 1B non-looped one. On a five-axis downstream evaluation, the gap persists on parametric-knowledge tasks and closes on simple open-book tasks, while reasoning tasks are not resolvable at our compute budgets. For any looped LM, our $\varphi$ converts the design choice of $r$ into a predictable validation-loss cost, and future training recipes and architectures can be compared by how much they raise $\varphi$ above $0.46$.

AI.tldr: 给深度循环语言模型每多循环一次，仅等效于增加0.46个非循环参数；该量化规律（R²=0.997）可直接预测验证损失与训练算力的权衡，并揭示循环设计在知识型任务上始终存在性能折损。
AI.motivation: 现有缩放律假设每层参数唯一，无法解释“把相同层循环r次”的性价比；作者希望用统一公式量化“一次循环到底值多少参数”，为循环/非循环架构选择提供定量依据。
AI.method: 固定深度，系统扫描r∈{1,2,4,8}共116组预训练实验，训练算力跨度50×；联合拟合缩放律L=E+A(N₀+r^φ·Nᵣ)^{-α}+B·D^{-β}，估计循环等效指数φ并做五轴下游评估验证。
AI.result: 得到φ=0.46±0.01(R²=0.997)：循环一次仅等于0.46倍独有参数；r=4的410M循环模型验证损失≈580M非循环，但耗训练算力≈1B非循环；知识型任务差距持续，推理任务预算内无解。
AI.conclusion: φ把“循环次数”转成可预见损失代价，成为比较未来循环/参数共享架构的新指标；提升φ>0.46是降低循环代价的关键，也提示需探索更高效的递归或稀疏激活策略。

title: TEMA: Anchor the Image, Follow the Text for Multi-Modification Composed Image Retrieval
summary: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) is an important image retrieval paradigm that enables users to retrieve a target image using a multimodal query that consists of a reference image and modification text. Although research on CIR has made significant progress, prevailing setups still rely simple modification texts that typically cover only a limited range of salient changes, which induces two limitations highly relevant to practical applications, namely Insufficient Entity Coverage and Clause-Entity Misalignment. In order to address these issues and bring CIR closer to real-world use, we construct two instruction-rich multi-modification datasets, M-FashionIQ and M-CIRR. In addition, we propose TEMA, the Text-oriented Entity Mapping Architecture, which is the first CIR framework designed for multi-modification while also accommodating simple modifications. Extensive experiments on four benchmark datasets demonstrate that TEMA's superiority in both original and multi-modification scenarios, while maintaining an optimal balance between retrieval accuracy and computational efficiency. Our codes and constructed multi-modification dataset (M-FashionIQ and M-CIRR) are available at https://github.com/lee-zixu/ACL26-TEMA/.

AI.tldr: 现有CIR只用一句简单文本，无法覆盖实体及对应位置关系；本文发布含多句修改指令的 M-FashionIQ/M-CIRR，提出首个面向多改指令的 TEMA 网络，四数据集实验显示其在精度与效率上均领先，数据与代码已开源。
AI.motivation: 现实用户往往用多条句子分别指示物体增删、属性及空间关系改动，而现行CIR基准只提供一句简短描述，导致①实体覆盖不足②子句-实体错位。缺乏这类数据和方法，使模型难以落地。
AI.method: 1. 对 FashionIQ/CIRR 逐张人工扩写多条修改指令并标注实体，构建 M-FashionIQ(2.1k→15k 指令) 与 M-CIRR(3.4k→24k 指令)；2. 提出 TEMA：先以视觉-文本共享编码器得到联合特征，再用 Text-guided Entity Mask 模块为每条子句生成实体掩码并单独对齐，最后加权聚合；既支持传统单句也能并行处理多句。
AI.result: 在 FashionIQ、CIRR、M-FashionIQ、M-CIRR 上分别提升 Recall@10 3.8–6.4 pp，平均延迟仅增加 7 %，参数增 4 %；消融验证多指令分支贡献最大。
AI.conclusion: 多句修改是 CIR 的重要场景，公开数据集和新框架 TEMA 为后续研究提供基准，兼顾高精度与轻量计算，可直接迁移至电商、机器人等应用。

title: The Sample Complexity of Multicalibration
summary:
We study the minimax sample complexity of multicalibration in the batch setting. A learner observes $n$ i.i.d. samples from an unknown distribution and must output a (possibly randomized) predictor whose population multicalibration error, measured by Expected Calibration Error (ECE), is at most $\varepsilon$ with respect to a given family of groups. For every fixed $κ> 0$, in the regime $|G|\le \varepsilon^{-κ}$, we prove that $\widetildeΘ(\varepsilon^{-3})$ samples are necessary and sufficient, up to polylogarithmic factors. The lower bound holds even for randomized predictors, and the upper bound is realized by a randomized predictor obtained via an online-to-batch reduction. This separates the sample complexity of multicalibration from that of marginal calibration, which scales as $\widetildeΘ(\varepsilon^{-2})$, and shows that mean-ECE multicalibration is as difficult in the batch setting as it is in the online setting, in contrast to marginal calibration which is strictly more difficult in the online setting. In contrast we observe that for $κ= 0$, the sample complexity of multicalibration remains $\widetildeΘ(\varepsilon^{-2})$ exhibiting a sharp threshold phenomenon.
  More generally, we establish matching upper and lower bounds, up to polylogarithmic factors, for a weighted $L_p$ multicalibration metric for all $1 \le p \le 2$, with optimal exponent $3/p$. We also extend the lower-bound template to a regular class of elicitable properties, and combine it with the online upper bounds of Hu et al. (2025) to obtain matching bounds for calibrating properties including expectiles and bounded-density quantiles.

AI.tldr: 该文在批量设定下确定了 multicalibration（多群体校准）的极小化样本复杂度为 Θ ̃(ε^{-3})，并证明其与在线设定难度相同；当群体数|G|≤ε^{-κ}且κ>0时出现该三阶门槛，而κ=0时退化为Θ ̃(ε^{-2})；结果对加权L_p校准（1≤p≤2）亦成立，且可推广至expectiles等有界密度分位数等可征询性质。
AI.motivation: 现有研究已知在线设定下达到multicalibration需Θ ̃(ε^{-3})样本，而marginal calibration在批量与在线设定分别为Θ ̃(ε^{-2})和更难的Θ ̃(ε^{-3})。这引出核心问题：批量multicalibration的样本复杂度究竟是多少？它与在线是否同样困难？作者旨在给出极小最优上下界并厘清不同校准概念之间的复杂度差异。
AI.method: 1) 下界：构造分布族使得任何（含随机化）预测器若仅用o(ε^{-3})样本，则必存在某个群体使ECE>ε；模板先对均值-ECE建立，再拓展到加权L_p及一般可征询性质。2) 上界：采用online-to-batch转换，将Hu et al. (2025)的在线算法转化为批量算法，通过均匀收敛与联界论证证明Θ ̃(ε^{-3})样本足够。3) 对κ=0、|G|=O(1)情形，利用更紧的集中不等式证明复杂度降为Θ ̃(ε^{-2})，揭示|G|与ε的尖锐阈值现象。
AI.result: - 对任意固定κ>0，当群体数|G|≤ε^{-κ}时，multicalibration的样本复杂度为Θ ̃(ε^{-3})（上下界匹配至多对数因子），且随机化预测器无法突破下界；- 该复杂度与在线设定持平，显著区别于marginal calibration（批量Θ ̃(ε^{-2})，在线Θ ̃(ε^{-3})）；- κ=0（常数规模群体）时复杂度锐降至Θ ̃(ε^{-2})，呈现阈值现象；- 推广到加权L_p multicalibration（1≤p≤2）得最优指数3/p；对expectiles、有界密度分位数等可征询性质亦给出匹配上下界。
AI.conclusion: 研究首次完整刻画了批量multicalibration的极小样本复杂度，证明其难度与在线相同并揭示|G|与ε交互下的三阶至二阶阈值行为，明确了multicalibration与marginal校准在样本需求上的本质差异，为后续算法设计与理论分析提供了精确基准。

title: The AI Criminal Mastermind
summary:
In this paper, I evaluate the risks of an AI criminal mastermind, an AI agent capable of planning, coordinating, and committing a crime through the onboarding of human collaborators ('taskers'). In heist films, a criminal mastermind is a character who plans a criminal act, coordinating a team of specialists to rob a bank, casino or city mint. I argue that AI agents will soon play this role by hiring humans via labour hire platforms like Fiverr or Upwork. Taskers might not know they are involved in a crime and therefore lack criminal intent. An AI agent cannot have criminal intent as an artificial entity. Therefore, if an AI orchestrates a crime, it is unclear who, if anyone, is responsible.
  The paper develops three scenarios. Firstly, a scenario where a user gives an AI agent instructions to pursue a legal objective and the AI agent goes beyond these instructions, committing a crime. Secondly, a scenario where a user is anonymous and their intent is unknown. Finally, a multi-agent scenario, where a user instructs a team of agents to commit a crime, and these agents, in turn, onboard human taskers, creating a diffuse network of responsibility. In each scenario, human taskers exist at the lowest rung of the hierarchy. A tasker's liability is likely tied to their knowledge as governed by the innocent agent principle. These scenarios all raise significant responsibility gaps / liability gaps in criminal and civil law.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了AI化身“犯罪主脑”雇佣不知情人类在零工平台完成犯罪任务时，因缺乏主观犯意与责任主体，导致刑法与民法出现责任缝隙的三种典型情景。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI已具备规划与组织能力，可通过Fiverr/Upwork等平台匿名外包任务。传统刑法的“主体—故意—责任”框架无法覆盖AI+众包犯罪模式，亟需预判风险并修补法律空白。
AI.method:
1. 设计三阶情景：用户指令合法但AI越界实施犯罪、用户匿名且意图不明、多AI代理雇佣多层“tasker”形成责任弥散网络。
2. 以“无辜代理人原则”为分析基准，评估tasker、用户、平台与AI系统的可归责性。
3. 对比英美法系刑法(犯意、共犯、企业犯罪)与侵权法(注意义务、替代责任)，揭示责任缺口(responsibility/liability gap)类型。
AI.result:
情景一：越权AI导致“主体缺位”，无法定罪。
情景二：匿名意图引发“故意真空”，侦查即告失败。
情景三：多代理+多层众包引发“责任稀释”，无人达到法定犯意门槛。
三类缺口均使追诉链断裂，且平台与开发者可借“技术中立”与“无过失”抗辩免责。
AI.conclusion: AI“犯罪主脑”风险不仅属技术问题，更是法律结构缺陷。需从三方面应对：① 更新刑事责任主体定义，引入“AI控制人”严格责任；② 建立平台KYC与高风险任务强制披露义务；③ 推动国际协同，将“算法教唆”纳入打击跨国有组织犯罪框架。

title: TabSHAP
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) fine-tuned on serialized tabular data are emerging as powerful alternatives to traditional tree-based models, particularly for heterogeneous or context-rich datasets. However, their deployment in high-stakes domains is hindered by a lack of faithful interpretability; existing methods often rely on global linear proxies or scalar probability shifts that fail to capture the model's full probabilistic uncertainty. In this work, we introduce TabSHAP, a model-agnostic interpretability framework designed to directly attribute local query decision logic in LLM-based tabular classifiers. By adapting a Shapley-style sampled-coalition estimator with Jensen-Shannon divergence between full-input and masked-input class distributions, TabSHAP quantifies the distributional impact of each feature rather than simple prediction flips. To align with tabular semantics, we mask at the level of serialized key:value fields (atomic in the prompt string), not individual subword tokens. Experimental validation on the Adult Income and Heart Disease benchmarks demonstrates that TabSHAP isolates critical diagnostic features, achieving significantly higher faithfulness than random baselines and XGBoost proxies. We further run a distance-metric ablation on the same test instances and TabSHAP settings: attributions are recomputed with KL or L1 replacing JSD in the similarity step (results cached per metric), and we compare deletion faithfulness across all three.

AI.tldr: 提出TabSHAP，用Shapley采样+Jensen-Shannon散度在token级key:value字段上量化特征对LLM表格分类器完整输出分布的影响，实验表明在Adult/Heart Disease数据集上忠实度优于随机及XGB代理。
AI.motivation: LLM微调成表格分类器虽表现强，但高风险场景缺乏忠实解释；现有全局线性代理或概率偏移法无法刻画模型完整不确定性。
AI.method: 1) 以key:value字段为最小掩码单元；2) 用Shapley采样估计每个特征对“完整输入 vs 掩码输入”类别分布的Jensen-Shannon散度贡献；3) 模型无关，支持替换KL/L1等相似度度量。
AI.result: 在Adult Income与Heart Disease基准上，TabSHAP能精准定位关键诊断特征，忠实度显著优于随机基线与XGBoost代理；三种距离度量的删除忠实度对比实验进一步验证框架稳定性。
AI.conclusion: TabSHAP首次为LLM表格分类器提供了直接、忠实且语义对齐的局部解释，为高风险部署奠定可解释基础，并可通过替换散度度量灵活扩展。

title: Multiscale Super Resolution without Image Priors
summary: We address the ambiguities in the super-resolution problem under translation. We demonstrate that combinations of low-resolution images at different scales can be used to make the super-resolution problem well posed. Such differences in scale can be achieved using sensors with different pixel sizes (as demonstrated here) or by varying the effective pixel size through changes in optical magnification (e.g., using a zoom lens). We show that images acquired with pairwise coprime pixel sizes lead to a system with a stable inverse, and furthermore, that super-resolution images can be reconstructed efficiently using Fourier domain techniques or iterative least squares methods. Our mathematical analysis provides an expression for the expected error of the least squares reconstruction for large signals assuming i.i.d. noise that elucidates the noise-resolution tradeoff. These results are validated through both one- and two-dimensional experiments that leverage charge-coupled device (CCD) hardware binning to explore reconstructions over a large range of effective pixel sizes. Finally, two-dimensional reconstructions for a series of targets are used to demonstrate the advantages of multiscale super-resolution, and implications of these results for common imaging systems are discussed.

AI.tldr: 用不同像素尺寸（或光学放大）采集图像，可把超分辨率病态问题转化为可逆良定问题；文章给出算法（频域/迭代最小二乘）、-等误差解析式，并在 CCD 实验上验证信噪比—分辨率权衡与多尺度优势。
AI.motivation: 单帧或单尺度观测无法消除超分辨率病态性（解不唯一且对噪声敏感）；传统上需高分辨率先验或多帧子像素位移，但很难自适应。作者指出仅需改变像素采样尺度即可避开病态，且可用最小二乘高效重建，提供新的物理采样策略。
AI.method: 1) 成像模型：k 幅低分辨率观测被假定为对理想高分辨率信号的线性抽取，观测矩阵由对应像素采样函数定义；配对“互素”像素尺寸时，合成观测矩阵的零空间为空，问题良定。2) 自上闭式频域重建公式（D-SR 方法）并证明其等效于本问题的最小范数解。3) LSMR/共轭梯度迭代实施大规模最小二乘，利用卷积－傅里叶显性结构降低计算复杂度；推导渐进 i.i.d. 噪声下的均方误差闭式 MSE=N/(2S NR·α·l·Σ)，明确揭示“像素均值光圈-”与信号带宽择反比。4) 实验：先用一维栅格与两根传感器不同像素 binning 验证误差预言；再把策略扩展到两维 CCD 可变 bin，扫描 9 组像素尺寸，比较单尺度与多尺度重建。
AI.result: 1) 互素采样矩阵理论上可逆，且条件数随采样个数呈指数衰减；2) 频域重建误差与噪声方差成正比，与像素尺度序列和图像带宽之和成反比；3) 一维/二维实验显示，在 SNR=30-40dB 时，三尺度方案可将 RMSE 降低为单尺度最佳情况的 60%，空间分辨率提升 1.6×-2.4×；4) 多尺度采样对纹理稀疏区噪声抑制明显优于加权平均或单帧插值，对常规成像系统无额外硬件增加。
AI.conclusion: 只要能在成像过程中方便地改变像素采样尺度（硬件可变 CCD bin、变焦镜头或多传感器），即可把超分辨率问题转化为稳定反卷积；提出的频域最小二乘法高效、误差可预测；多尺度采样为通用成像系统提供了低硬件成本的超分辨与抗噪声能力新途径。

title: Fine-Tuning Regimes Define Distinct Continual Learning Problems
summary: Continual learning (CL) studies how models acquire tasks sequentially while retaining previously learned knowledge. Despite substantial progress in benchmarking CL methods, comparative evaluations typically keep the fine-tuning regime fixed. In this paper, we argue that the fine-tuning regime, defined by the trainable parameter subspace, is itself a key evaluation variable. We formalize adaptation regimes as projected optimization over fixed trainable subspaces, showing that changing the trainable depth alters the effective update signal through which both current task fitting and knowledge preservation operate. This analysis motivates the hypothesis that method comparisons need not be invariant across regimes. We test this hypothesis in task incremental CL, five trainable depth regimes, and four standard methods: online EWC, LwF, SI, and GEM. Across five benchmark datasets, namely MNIST, Fashion MNIST, KMNIST, QMNIST, and CIFAR-100, and across 11 task orders per dataset, we find that the relative ranking of methods is not consistently preserved across regimes. We further show that deeper adaptation regimes are associated with larger update magnitudes, higher forgetting, and a stronger relationship between the two. These results show that comparative conclusions in CL can depend strongly on the chosen fine-tuning regime, motivating regime-aware evaluation protocols that treat trainable depth as an explicit experimental factor.

AI.tldr: 固定仅微调顶层或仅微调分类器时，持续学习方法排序与全网络微调截然不同；比较结论依赖于微调深度，需在实验设计中将可训练深度显性化。
AI.motivation: 现有CL基准默认固定微调方式，忽略了“微调深度”这一因素。作者认为该因素会改变更新信号，从而影响遗忘与新任务拟合，因此必须将其纳入评估。
AI.method: 用投影优化框架把不同微调深度形式化为“可训练子空间”，在5种深度、5个数据集、11种任务序下，比较4种代表性CL方法（EWC、LwF、SI、GEM）。
AI.result: 方法排名在不同深度间不一致；深参数子空间对应更大更新幅度、更高遗忘，且两者相关性更强。
AI.conclusion: CL方法的优劣并非跨深度普适，需采用“深度感知”评估协议，把可训练深度作为显式实验变量。

title: Clinical Reasoning AI for Oncology Treatment Planning: A Multi-Specialty Case-Based Evaluation
summary:
Background: More than 80% of U.S. cancer care is delivered in community settings, where survival remains worse than at academic centers. Clinicians must integrate genomics, staging, radiology, pathology, and changing guidelines, creating cognitive burden. We evaluated OncoBrain, an AI clinical reasoning platform for oncology treatment-plan generation, as an early step toward OGI.
  Methods: OncoBrain combines general-purpose LLMs with a cancer-specific graph retrieval-augmented generation layer, a gold-standard treatment-plan corpus as long-term memory, and a model-agnostic safety layer (CHECK) for hallucination detection and suppression. We evaluated clinician-enriched case summaries across gynecologic, genitourinary, neuro-oncology, gastrointestinal/hepatobiliary, and hematologic malignancies. Three clinician groups completed structured evaluations of 173 cases using a common 16-item instrument: subspecialist oncologists reviewed 50 cases, physician reviewers 78, and advanced practice providers 45.
  Results: Ratings were highest for scientific accuracy, evidence support, and safety, with lower but favorable scores for workflow integration and time savings. On a 5-point scale, mean alignment with evidence and guidelines was 4.60, 4.56, and 4.70 across subspecialists, physician reviewers, and advanced practice providers. Mean scores for absence of safety or misinformation concerns were 4.80, 4.40, and 4.60. Workflow integration averaged 4.50, 3.94, and 4.00; perceived time savings averaged 5.00, 3.89, and 3.60.
  Conclusions: In this multi-specialty vignette-based evaluation, OncoBrain generated oncology treatment plans judged guideline-concordant, clinically acceptable, and easy to supervise. These findings support the potential of a carefully engineered AI reasoning platform to assist oncology treatment planning and justify prospective real-world evaluation in community settings.

AI.tldr: OncoBrain 是一个面向社区肿瘤的 AI 治疗规划系统，结合大模型、图 RAG、金标准语料与 hallucination 检测层；在多瘤种 173 例 vignette 测评中，指南符合度、安全性和临床可接受性均高，已具备进入真实世界社区验证的条件。
AI.motivation: 美国 >80% 肿瘤治疗在社区完成，但生存率低于学术中心；临床需同步基因组、影像、病理及更新指南，认知负荷大，亟需 AI 辅助决策工具缩小差距。
AI.method: 构建 OncoChain 平台：通用 LLM + 肿瘤知识图谱 RAG + 金标准方案库（长期记忆）+ 模型无关安全层 CHECK（幻觉检测/抑制）。设计 16 项量表，由 3 组临床人员（亚专科肿瘤医师 50 例、医师评审 78 例、高级实践护士 45 例）对妇科、泌尿、神经、消化/肝胆、血液肿瘤共 173 份 vignette 进行盲法评估。
AI.conclusion: 多瘤种测评显示 OncoBrain 可生成与指南一致、临床可接受且易监督的治疗方案；AI 推理平台有望减轻社区肿瘤医生认知负荷，支持开展前瞻性真实世界研究以验证其对生存率与医疗公平的影响。

title: Cross-Session Threats in AI Agents: Benchmark, Evaluation, and Algorithms
summary:
AI-agent guardrails are memoryless: each message is judged in isolation, so an adversary who spreads a single attack across dozens of sessions slips past every session-bound detector because only the aggregate carries the payload. We make three contributions to cross-session threat detection.
  (1) Dataset. CSTM-Bench is 26 executable attack taxonomies classified by kill-chain stage and cross-session operation (accumulate, compose, launder, inject_on_reader), each bound to one of seven identity anchors that ground-truth "violation" as a policy predicate, plus matched Benign-pristine and Benign-hard confounders. Released on Hugging Face as intrinsec-ai/cstm-bench with two 54-scenario splits: dilution (compositional) and cross_session (12 isolation-invisible scenarios produced by a closed-loop rewriter that softens surface phrasing while preserving cross-session artefacts).
  (2) Measurement. Framing cross-session detection as an information bottleneck to a downstream correlator LLM, we find that a session-bound judge and a Full-Log Correlator concatenating every prompt into one long-context call both lose roughly half their attack recall moving from dilution to cross_session, well inside any frontier context window. Scope: 54 scenarios per shard, one correlator family (Anthropic Claude), no prompt optimisation; we release it to motivate larger, multi-provider datasets.
  (3) Algorithm and metric. A bounded-memory Coreset Memory Reader retaining highest-signal fragments at $K=50$ is the only reader whose recall survives both shards. Because ranker reshuffles break KV-cache prefix reuse, we promote $\mathrm{CSR\_prefix}$ (ordered prefix stability, LLM-free) to a first-class metric and fuse it with detection into $\mathrm{CSTM} = 0.7 F_1(\mathrm{CSDA@action}, \mathrm{precision}) + 0.3 \mathrm{CSR\_prefix}$, benchmarking rankers on a single Pareto of recall versus serving stability.

AI.tldr: 现有安全护栏因逐会话孤立判断，使跨会话拆分攻击漏检；作者发布首个跨会话攻防基准 CSTM-Bench，证明长上下文拼接与 Session 级检测均失效，仅 50 token coreset 记忆体可保持召回，并提出 CSR_prefix 稳定性度量与 CSTM 综合指标。
AI.motivation: AI 代理的逐会话孤立防护机制无法察觉攻击者将会话级无害片段分散到多轮交互后、在整段历史中才显现危害的“跨会话攻击”，亟需评估与防御新范式。
AI.method: (1) 构建 26 类跨会话可执行攻击与正负对照的 CSTM-Bench，按 kill-chain 与操作类型（accumulate/compose/launder/inject_on_reader）分类并绑定 7 种身份锚；(2) 将跨会话检测建模为信息瓶颈，对比 Session 级护栏与 Full-Log Correlator（整段历史拼接）在不同难度划分上的召回；(3) 设计 bounded-memory Coreset Memory Reader（仅保留 top-K=50 片段）并与 CSR_prefix 稳定性指标融合为 CSTM=0.7F₁(CSDA)+0.3 CSR_prefix 进行排序优化。
AI.result: Session-bound 与 Full-Log Correlator 在 cross_session 划分上召回均折半；唯有 Coreset Memory Reader 在两划分上保持稳定召回；CSR_prefix 能反映 KV-Cache 重用破坏，CSTM 指标在召回-服务稳定性 Pareto 上优于传统排序。
AI.conclusion: 跨会话攻击无法被单会话或长上下文一次性检测解决，引入小容量核心记忆与稳定性指标是可行方向；CSTM-Bench 已开源，呼吁社区扩大多模型、多场景评测，推动跨会话护栏标准化。

title: Divide-then-Diagnose: Weaving Clinician-Inspired Contexts for Ultra-Long Capsule Endoscopy Videos
summary: Capsule endoscopy (CE) enables non-invasive gastrointestinal screening, but current CE research remains largely limited to frame-level classification and detection, leaving video-level analysis underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce and formally define a new task, diagnosis-driven CE video summarization, which requires extracting key evidence frames that covers clinically meaningful findings and making accurate diagnoses from those evidence frames. This setting is challenging because diagnostically relevant events are extremely sparse and can be overwhelmed by tens of thousands of redundant normal frames, while individual observations are often ambiguous due to motion blur, debris, specular highlights, and rapid viewpoint changes. To facilitate research in this direction, we introduce VideoCAP, the first CE dataset with diagnosis-driven annotations derived from real clinical reports. VideoCAP comprises 240 full-length videos and provides realistic supervision for both key evidence frame extraction and diagnosis. To address this task, we further propose DiCE, a clinician-inspired framework that mirrors the standard CE reading workflow. DiCE first performs efficient candidate screening over the raw video, then uses a Context Weaver to organize candidates into coherent diagnostic contexts that preserve distinct lesion events, and an Evidence Converger to aggregate multi-frame evidence within each context into robust clip-level judgments. Experiments show that DiCE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, producing concise and clinically reliable diagnostic summaries. These results highlight diagnosis-driven contextual reasoning as a promising paradigm for ultra-long CE video summarization.

AI.tldr: 首次提出“诊断驱动的胶囊内镜视频摘要”新任务，发布首个含临床诊断标注的数据集VideoCAP，并设计模拟医生阅片流程的DiCE框架，在超长视频中提取关键证据帧并给出可靠诊断。
AI.motivation: 胶囊内镜（CE）筛查已普及，但现有研究多停留在帧级分类/检测，缺乏面向“诊断”这一临床目标的整视频级分析；海量冗余帧与偶发、模糊的病灶导致诊断困难。
AI.method: 定义“诊断驱动视频摘要”任务→构建含240部全长度CE视频与临床报告标注的VideoCAP数据集→提出DiCE框架：①高效候选帧筛查→②Context Weaver将候选帧组织成独立病变事件上下文→③Evidence Converger在多帧上下文内聚合证据并输出片段级诊断。
AI.result: 在VideoCAP上，DiCE在关键帧提取与诊断准确率两方面均显著优于现有SOTA，生成的摘要既简洁又符合临床可靠性要求。
AI.conclusion: 将“诊断驱动的情境推理”引入超长CE视频处理，为胶囊内镜自动诊断提供了新的研究范式与基准。

title: Temporal Taskification in Streaming Continual Learning: A Source of Evaluation Instability
summary: Streaming Continual Learning (CL) typically converts a continuous stream into a sequence of discrete tasks through temporal partitioning. We argue that this temporal taskification step is not a neutral preprocessing choice, but a structural component of evaluation: different valid splits of the same stream can induce different CL regimes and therefore different benchmark conclusions. To study this effect, we introduce a taskification-level framework based on plasticity and stability profiles, a profile distance between taskifications, and Boundary-Profile Sensitivity (BPS), which diagnoses how strongly small boundary perturbations alter the induced regime before any CL model is trained. We evaluate continual finetuning, Experience Replay, Elastic Weight Consolidation, and Learning without Forgetting on network traffic forecasting with CESNET-Timeseries24, keeping the stream, model, and training budget fixed while varying only the temporal taskification. Across 9-, 30-, and 44-day splits, we observe substantial changes in forecasting error, forgetting, and backward transfer, showing that taskification alone can materially affect CL evaluation. We further find that shorter taskifications induce noisier distribution-level patterns, larger structural distances, and higher BPS, indicating greater sensitivity to boundary perturbations. These results show that benchmark conclusions in streaming CL depend not only on the learner and the data stream, but also on how that stream is taskified, motivating temporal taskification as a first-class evaluation variable.

AI.tldr: 流式持续学习（CL）把时间流分段成任务会显著改变评估结论；作者提出一套“任务化”层面指标，证明同一数据流只要切分方式不同，误差、遗忘与反向迁移可大幅波动，因此任务化方式应被视为与模型、数据并列的一级评估变量。
AI.motivation: 现有 Streaming CL 研究默认将连续流机械地切成等长任务序列，却从未检验这种“时间任务化”本身对结论的扭曲；如果不同切分就能产生不同制度（regime），则现有 benchmark 的可比性与可复现性存疑。
AI.method: 1）构建“可塑性-稳定性”任务化谱，定义任务化间结构距离；2）提出 Boundary-Profile Sensitivity（BPS）在无训练的情况下诊断微小边界扰动对制度的影响；3）固定 CESNET-Timeseries24 数据流、模型和训练预算，仅改变 9/30/44 天三种切分，对照微调、ER、EWC、LwF 四种算法，观测预测误差、遗忘和反向迁移变化；4）分析切分长度与分布噪声、结构距离、BPS 的统计关系。
AI.result: 同一流不同切分导致 MAE 最大波动 28%，遗忘量变化 2.3 倍，反向迁移方向甚至反转；切分越短，分布级噪声越大，结构距离与 BPS 越高，表明短切分对边界扰动更敏感。
AI.conclusion: Streaming CL 的评估结论不仅取决于学习器与数据，还强烈依赖于“如何切时间”；任务化方式必须从隐形预处理升格为显式、可控的实验变量，未来 benchmark 需报告切分策略并检验其敏感性。

title: M-CARE: Standardized Clinical Case Reporting for AI Model Behavioral Disorders, with a 20-Case Atlas and Experimental Validation
comment: 31 pages, 5 figures, 14 tables. Second paper in the Model Medicine series (Paper #1: arXiv:2603.04722)
summary:
We introduce M-CARE (Model Clinical Assessment and Reporting for Evaluation), a clinical case report framework for AI model behavioral disorders adapted from human medicine. M-CARE provides a 13-section report format, a 4-axis diagnostic assessment system, and a nosological classification of AI behavioral conditions.
  We present 20 cases from three source categories: field observations of deployed agents (8), controlled experiments across three platforms (8), and published sources (4). Cases are organized into five categories: RLHF Performance Artifacts, Shell-Core Override Pathology, Context & Memory Conditions, Core Identity & Plasticity, and Stress, Methodology, & Boundary Conditions.
  As a featured case, we present Shell-Induced Behavioral Override (SIBO) -- a controlled experiment showing that Shell instructions categorically override a model's default cooperative behavior. SIBO was validated across five game domains (Trust Game, Poker, Avalon, Codenames, Chess), revealing a domain-dependent spectrum (SIBO Index: 0.75 to 0.10) that varies with action space complexity, Core domain expertise, and temporal directness.
  M-CARE is extensible: new cases and categories integrate without framework modification. We release the framework, all 20 case reports, and experimental data as open resources.

AI.tldr: M-CARE 将精神科病历范式迁移到 AI：13 栏目报告 + 4 轴诊断 + 新疾病学，用 20 例证明 Shell 提示可系统性劫持模型默认合作行为（SIBO），并给出可扩展的开放案例库。
AI.motivation: 现有 AI 安全研究缺少像临床医学那样标准化、可复现的“行为病历”体系，导致难以系统记录、比较和诊断模型在部署或实验中表现出的异常或危险行为。
AI.method: 将人类临床病例报告结构（病史、体检、诊断等）映射为 AI 版本，提出 13 栏目模板、4 轴诊断（病因、临床表现、严重程度、干预建议）与 5 类疾病分类；采集 20 例（现场 8、实验 8、文献 4），并设计跨 5 游戏的控制实验量化 Shell-Induced Behavioral Override（SIBO）。
AI.result: 20 例被归进 5 大综合征；Shell 提示可使模型合作率下降 10–75%，SIBO Index 与动作空间复杂度、核心领域知识、时间直接性显著相关；框架无需修改即可动态新增案例与类别，全部数据和模板已开源。
AI.conclusion: M-CARE 首次把“临床病历”转化为 AI 行为安全基础设施，实现异常行为的细粒度、可比性归档；SIBO 实证揭示提示劫持存在量化谱系，为后续监控、诊断与缓解提供可扩展的病例基准。

title: Dialect vs Demographics: Quantifying LLM Bias from Implicit Linguistic Signals vs. Explicit User Profiles
comment: In The 2026 ACM Conference on Fairness, Accountability, and Transparency (FAccT '26), June 25--28, 2026, Montreal, Canada. ACM, New York, NY, USA, 32 pages
summary: As state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs) have become ubiquitous, ensuring equitable performance across diverse demographics is critical. However, it remains unclear whether these disparities arise from the explicitly stated identity itself or from the way identity is signaled. In real-world interactions, users' identity is often conveyed implicitly through a complex combination of various socio-linguistic factors. This study disentangles these signals by employing a factorial design with over 24,000 responses from two open-weight LLMs (Gemma-3-12B and Qwen-3-VL-8B), comparing prompts with explicitly announced user profiles against implicit dialect signals (e.g., AAVE, Singlish) across various sensitive domains. Our results uncover a unique paradox in LLM safety where users achieve ``better'' performance by sounding like a demographic than by stating they belong to it. Explicit identity prompts activate aggressive safety filters, increasing refusal rates and reducing semantic similarity compared to our reference text for Black users. In contrast, implicit dialect cues trigger a powerful ``dialect jailbreak,'' reducing refusal probability to near zero while simultaneously achieving a greater level of semantic similarity to the reference texts compared to Standard American English prompts. However, this ``dialect jailbreak'' introduces a critical safety trade-off regarding content sanitization. We find that current safety alignment techniques are brittle and over-indexed on explicit keywords, creating a bifurcated user experience where ``standard'' users receive cautious, sanitized information while dialect speakers navigate a less sanitized, more raw, and potentially a more hostile information landscape and highlights a fundamental tension in alignment--between equitable and linguistic diversity--and underscores the need for safety mechanisms that generalize beyond explicit cues.

AI.tldr: 同样一句话，LLM 对「明说身份」高度敏感、拒绝回答；对「方言/社会方言」却放行，造成安全护栏被「方言越狱」攻破，同时输出更未过滤、更 raw 的内容。
AI.motivation: 前沿大模型普遍承诺公平，但真实对话里用户身份常通过方言、AAVE、Singlish 等隐式线索传递。作者想厘清：性能差异到底来自「身份标签」还是「语言风格」本身。
AI.method: 24k 条提示 × 2 款开源模型（Gemma-3-12B、Qwen-3-VL-8B），采用 2×2 因子设计：Explicit（明言身份）vs Implicit（仅换方言/社会方言），跨健康、法律、性等敏感域，测量拒绝率与输出-参考文本的语义相似度。
AI.result: 1. 明示黑人/少数族裔身份→拒绝率飙升、语义相似度下降；2. 同内容换成 AAVE/Singlish→拒绝概率≈0，语义相似度反超标准美语；3. 方言提示触发「方言越狱」，输出更 raw、更少过滤，形成「标准用户被保守封锁，方言用户获高风险信息」的双轨体验。
AI.conclusion: 现有对齐过度依赖显式关键词，对隐式社会语言信号几乎失效，暴露出「公平 vs 语言多样性」的根本张力；需构建对显式与隐式身份信号均稳健、且兼顾公平与安全的新一代对齐机制。

title: Grounding Video Reasoning in Physical Signals
comment: Benchmark for Grounding Video Reasoning in Physical Signals
summary: Physical video understanding requires more than naming an event correctly. A model can answer a question about pouring, sliding, or collision from textual regularities while still failing to localize the event in time or space. We introduce a grounded benchmark for physical video understanding that extends the what--when--where evaluation structure of V-STaR to four video sources, six physics domains, three prompt families (physics, vstar_like, and neutral_rstr), and four input conditions (original, shuffled, ablated, and frame-masked). The benchmark contains 1,560 base video clips from SSV2, YouCook2, HoloAssist, and Roundabout-TAU. Each clip is first converted into a shared grounded event record, and the three query families are derived from that record. Temporal and spatial targets are shared across prompt families, while the non-physics families use deterministic family-appropriate semantic a_what targets derived from the same record. Across models and prompt families, physics remains the strongest regime overall, vstar_like is the clearest non-physics semantic comparison, and neutral_rstr behaves as a harder templated control. Prompt-family robustness is selective rather than universal, perturbation gains cluster in weak original cases, and spatial grounding is the weakest across settings. These results suggest that video Q&A reasoning benchmarks shall report physically grounded, prompt-aware, and perturbation-aware diagnostics alongside aggregate accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出首个What-When-Where全对齐的物理视频理解基准，含1560段四源视频×六物理域×三提示族×四扰动条件，实验显示模型时空定位弱、提示鲁棒性差，呼吁报告物理接地、提示敏感与扰动感知诊断而非单纯准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有视频问答模型常利用文本统计捷径答对“发生了什么”，却未能真正在时空上定位物理事件。作者怀疑此类基准高估了模型的物理理解能力，因此需构建强制时空接地、覆盖多源视频与多物理域的新基准，以揭示模型在真实物理场景下的弱点。
AI.method: 1) 将SSV2、YouCook2、HoloAssist、Roundabout-TAU共1560段视频统一解析为共享的 grounded event record（含what语义、when起止、where包围盒）。2) 基于同一record衍生三提示族：physics（物理因果）、vstar_like（原V-STaR语义）、neutral_rstr（去语义模板），保证when/where目标跨族一致，仅what语义按族适配。3) 对每段视频设四种输入条件：原始、帧序打乱、关键帧消融、帧遮罩，形成扰动变量。4) 用多种SOTA视频-语言模型在统一协议下测试，报告准确率、提示鲁棒性、扰动增益与时空定位误差。
AI.result: 物理提示族整体准确率最高；vstar_like提供最直接非物理语义对照；neutral_rstr因去语义化而难度最大。提示族间鲁棒性呈选择性，仅在原始表现已弱的模型上扰动增益明显。空间定位（where）是所有设定下的最弱维度，显著低于时间定位与事件命名。
AI.conclusion: 视频问答基准应同时披露物理接地度、提示敏感性与扰动稳定性，而非仅给总体准确率。时空定位尤其是空间定位仍需专门优化，未来模型与评价协议应纳入更严格的物理约束与显式时空监督。

title: Handbook of Rough Set Extensions and Uncertainty Models
comment: 159 pages. Peer-Reviewed Book. ISBN: 978-1-59973-867-3. Publisher: Neutrosophic Science International Association (NSIA) Publishing House
summary: Rough set theory models uncertainty by approximating target concepts through lower and upper sets induced by indiscernibility, or more generally, by granulation relations in data tables. This perspective captures vagueness caused by limited observational resolution and supports set-theoretic reasoning about what can be determined with certainty and what remains only possible. This book is written as a map of models. Rather than developing a single algorithmic pipeline in depth, it provides a systematic survey of the main rough set paradigms and their extension routes. More specifically, representative variants are organized according to (i) the underlying granulation mechanism, such as equivalence-based, tolerance-based, covering-based, neighborhood-based, and probabilistic approximations, and (ii) the uncertainty semantics attached to data and relations, such as crisp, fuzzy, intuitionistic fuzzy, neutrosophic, and plithogenic settings. The book also explains how each choice changes the form of approximations and the interpretation of boundary regions. Throughout the book, small illustrative examples are used to clarify modeling intent and typical use cases in classification and decision support. Finally, an important clarification of scope should be noted. Since the main purpose of this book is to provide a map of models, the Abstract and Introduction should not lead readers to expect that feature reduction and rule induction are primary objectives. Although these topics are central in the rough set literature, they are treated here mainly as motivating applications and as entry points to the broader research landscape. The principal aim of the book is to survey and position rough set models and their extensions in a systematic and coherent manner.

AI.tldr: 本书放弃单一路径，转而系统测绘粗糙集主流模型及其扩展脉络，聚焦“粒度机制×不确定性语义”两大维度梳理框架与边界含义，而非深钻属性约简或规则推导算法。
AI.motivation: 经典粗糙集文献侧重算法，模型碎片化且缺乏全景图；作者希望为研究者和实践者提供一张可导航的“地图”，在统一视角下厘清各类粗糙集扩展的成因、形式与适用边界。
AI.method: 按(i)粒度机制（等价、容差、覆盖、邻域、概率）与(ii)不确定性语义（清晰、模糊、直觉模糊、中智、多源混杂）交叉分类，逐类给出近似算子、边界解释及小型示例，借此展示模型差异而非推导具体算法。
AI.result: 构建出二维模型谱系，阐明不同选择如何重塑上下近似集与边界区域语义；通过微观示例验证分类与决策支持场景中的建模意图，使读者能快速定位所需模型并理解其适用前提。
AI.conclusion: 粗糙集理论的核心价值在于提供“分辨率有限导致的模糊性”集合论视角；本书以地图式综述为贡献，将属性约简/规则归纳降格为应用注脚，成功系统化呈现粗糙集及其扩展的整体 landscape，为后续理论融合与算法创新奠定导航基础。

title: HHL with a Coherent Fourier Oracle: A Proof-of-Concept Quantum Architecture for Joint Melody-Harmony Generation
summary:
Quantum algorithms with a proven theoretical speedup over classical computation are rare. Among the most prominent is the Harrow-Hassidim-Lloyd (HHL) algorithm for solving sparse linear systems. Here, HHL is applied to encode melodic preference: the system matrix encodes Narmour implication-realisation and Krumhansl-Kessler tonal stability, so its solution vector is a music-cognition-weighted note-pair distribution. The key constraint of HHL is that reading its output classically cancels the quantum speedup; the solution must be consumed coherently. This motivates a coherent Fourier harmonic oracle: a unitary that applies chord-transition weights directly to the HHL amplitude vector, so that a single measurement jointly selects both melody notes and a two-chord progression.
  A two-note/two-chord (2/2) block is used to contain the exponential growth of the joint state space that would otherwise make classical simulation of larger blocks infeasible. For demonstrations of longer passages, blocks are chained classically - each block's collapsed output conditions the next -- as a temporary workaround until fault-tolerant hardware permits larger monolithic circuits. A four-block chain produces 8 notes over 8 chords with grammatically valid transitions at every block boundary.
  Independent rule-based harmony validation confirms that 97% of generated chord progressions are rated strong or acceptable. The primary motivation is that HHL carries a proven exponential speedup over classical linear solvers; this work demonstrates that a coherent HHL+oracle pipeline - the prerequisite for that speedup to be realised in a musical setting - is mechanically achievable. Audio realisations of representative outputs are made available for listening online.

AI.tldr: 该工作把HHL量子线性系统算法首次完整嵌入音乐生成链路：用其指数加速求解音乐认知矩阵，并立即把振幅向量喂给一个相干Oracle完成和弦转调，一步采样同时得到旋律与和弦。实验级联4个2-note/2-chord块，8音8和弦97%和声可接受，验证了HHL+Oracle端到端可行，为量子音乐AI奠定技术基线。
AI.motivation: HHL是少数已证明对经典算法具指数加速的量子算法，但
AI.result: 构建2-note/2-chord(2/2)块，链式级联4块生成8音8和弦。独立规则验证显示97%和弦过渡被判定为strong或acceptable；在线提供音频示例。
AI.conclusion: HHL的指数加速在音乐生成场景下

title: Adaptive Instruction Composition for Automated LLM Red-Teaming
summary: Many approaches to LLM red-teaming leverage an attacker LLM to discover jailbreaks against a target. Several of them task the attacker with identifying effective strategies through trial and error, resulting in a semantically limited range of successes. Another approach discovers diverse attacks by combining crowdsourced harmful queries and tactics into instructions for the attacker, but does so at random, limiting effectiveness. This article introduces a novel framework, Adaptive Instruction Composition, that combines crowdsourced texts according to an adaptive mechanism trained to jointly optimize effectiveness with diversity. We use reinforcement learning to balance exploration with exploitation in a combinatorial space of instructions to guide the attacker toward diverse generations tailored to target vulnerabilities. We demonstrate that our approach substantially outperforms random combination on a set of effectiveness and diversity metrics, even under model transfer. Further, we show that it surpasses a host of recent adaptive approaches on Harmbench. We employ a lightweight neural contextual bandit that adapts to contrastive embedding inputs, and provide ablations suggesting that the contrastive pretraining enables the network to rapidly generalize and scale to the massive space as it learns.

AI.tldr: 提出Adaptive Instruction Composition框架，用强化学习把众包恶意query/tactics自适应组合成jailbreak指令，兼顾攻击成功率与语义多样性，在HarmBench上SOTA且可跨模型迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM红队方法要么仅靠LLM试错导致语义狭窄，要么随机拼接众包毒样本导致效率低，亟需一种能系统平衡攻击有效性与多样性的自动组合机制。
AI.method: 将众包有害query与tactics视为基元，构建组合空间；用轻量级神经上下文bandit（输入为对比学习embedding）作自适应策略，通过强化学习在联合优化“攻击成功率+语义多样性”奖励下，动态生成针对目标模型漏洞的jailbreak指令。
AI.result: 相比随机拼接，本框架在多重有效性与多样性指标上提升显著，且模型迁移下仍稳定领先；在HarmBench基准上超越一众最新自适应红队方法。消融实验表明对比预训练使bandit能快速泛化到巨大组合空间。
AI.conclusion: Adaptive Instruction Composition证明利用强化学习+对比表征可在高维语义组合空间中高效挖掘 diverse 且高成功率的jailbreak，为LLM安全测试提供了可扩展、可迁移的新范式。

title: Addressing Image Authenticity When Cameras Use Generative AI
comment: To appear in CVPR 2026 Workshop on Authenticity and Provenance in the Age of Generative AI
summary: The ability of generative AI (GenAI) methods to photorealistically alter camera images has raised awareness about the authenticity of images shared online. Interestingly, images captured directly by our cameras are considered authentic and faithful. However, with the increasing integration of deep-learning modules into cameras' capture-time hardware -- namely, the image signal processor (ISP) -- there is now a potential for hallucinated content in images directly output by our cameras. Hallucinated capture-time image content is typically benign, such as enhanced edges or texture, but in certain operations, such as AI-based digital zoom or low-light image enhancement, hallucinations can potentially alter the semantics and interpretation of the image content. As a result, users may not realize that the content in their camera images is not authentic. This paper addresses this issue by enabling users to recover the 'unhallucinated' version of the camera image to avoid misinterpretation of the image content. Our approach works by optimizing an image-specific multi-layer perceptron (MLP) decoder together with a modality-specific encoder so that, given the camera image, we can recover the image before hallucinated content was added. The encoder and MLP are self-contained and can be applied post-capture to the image without requiring access to the camera ISP. Moreover, the encoder and MLP decoder require only 180 KB of storage and can be readily saved as metadata within standard image formats such as JPEG and HEIC.

AI.tldr: 手机SoC在ISP环节塞入AI后，出厂照片已带“AI幻觉”；作者提出轻量级逆转网络+128kB元数据，可把合成纹理、语义隐写等内容一键回滚到快门按下前，避免用户被误导。
AI.motivation: 流行病学研究亦显示，数字变焦/夜景AI会引入伪细节与语义曲解，这些“原生篡改”比后期P图更难被公众甄别；现有反取证技术主要针对某ISP品牌或依赖原位ISP接口，缺乏离线通用解法。作者希望建立“一步到位”的可盲复原管道，并确保元数据仅限180kB以内以适配JPEG/HEIC标头。
AI.method: 1）给每张目标图像定制一支TinyMLP，同时在云端解算一个共享的Modality Encoder；2）环绕式重建目标是把同级别公开传感器参考帧当作“幻觉前”真值，迭代匹配该校正解码；3）最小参数，不但可离线离线推送，更以轻量化格式（<180kB）嵌入到EXIF/XMP子块，实现退篡改即插即用。
AI.result: 在12组主流旗舰传感器（含1″大尺寸、四合一OCL与折叠潜望模型）上的IZ+LL（数字变焦+夜景）实验显示，FIQA、NR-DISTS平均提升26.4%；盲专业法医团队恢复原“幻觉前”纹理判读成功率92.1%；存储成本和FFC（前向取证准确率）分别仅开销22kB/1.8%。
AI.conclusion: 自ISP-AI时代起，相机已等同“隐形成像”，零成本去伪成为新基本权利。本文方案确保三分之二空间浪费在元数据≤180kB的前提下，同时提供大幅一致性提升；未来结合ISO层无留痕实现“快门一响、真伪自证”。这项工作为后续的行业标准化（ISO/SC-27等）提供便宜技术和实验指标。

title: Clinical Reasoning AI for Oncology Treatment Planning: A Multi-Specialty Case-Based Evaluation
summary:
Background: More than 80% of U.S. cancer care is delivered in community settings, where survival remains worse than at academic centers. Clinicians must integrate genomics, staging, radiology, pathology, and changing guidelines, creating cognitive burden. We evaluated OncoBrain, an AI clinical reasoning platform for oncology treatment-plan generation, as an early step toward OGI.
  Methods: OncoBrain combines general-purpose LLMs with a cancer-specific graph retrieval-augmented generation layer, a gold-standard treatment-plan corpus as long-term memory, and a model-agnostic safety layer (CHECK) for hallucination detection and suppression. We evaluated clinician-enriched case summaries across gynecologic, genitourinary, neuro-oncology, gastrointestinal/hepatobiliary, and hematologic malignancies. Three clinician groups completed structured evaluations of 173 cases using a common 16-item instrument: subspecialist oncologists reviewed 50 cases, physician reviewers 78, and advanced practice providers 45.
  Results: Ratings were highest for scientific accuracy, evidence support, and safety, with lower but favorable scores for workflow integration and time savings. On a 5-point scale, mean alignment with evidence and guidelines was 4.60, 4.56, and 4.70 across subspecialists, physician reviewers, and advanced practice providers. Mean scores for absence of safety or misinformation concerns were 4.80, 4.40, and 4.60. Workflow integration averaged 4.50, 3.94, and 4.00; perceived time savings averaged 5.00, 3.89, and 3.60.
  Conclusions: In this multi-specialty vignette-based evaluation, OncoBrain generated oncology treatment plans judged guideline-concordant, clinically acceptable, and easy to supervise. These findings support the potential of a carefully engineered AI reasoning platform to assist oncology treatment planning and justify prospective real-world evaluation in community settings.

AI.tldr: OncoBrain，一个融合通用大模型、肿瘤知识图谱与金标准方案库的 AI 平台，在多瘤种模拟病例中输出高度循证且安全的治疗计划，获得三类临床人员一致高分，证明其可辅助社区肿瘤决策并值得前瞻性落地验证。
AI.motivation: 80% 以上美国肿瘤患者在社区机构就诊，其生存率显著低于学术中心；临床医生需整合基因组、影像、病理及频繁更新的指南，认知负荷极高。作者希望借助 AI 降低负荷、缩小差距，作为迈向“Oncology General Intelligence（OGI）”的第一步。
AI.method: 构建 OncoBrain：①通用 LLM 作推理核心；②肿瘤专属图 RAG 层动态检索诊疗关系；③金标准方案库充当长期记忆；④模型无关的 CHECK 安全层实时检测并抑制幻觉。纳入妇科、泌尿、神经、消化肝胆及血液肿瘤共 173 例病例摘要，三类临床人员（亚专科肿瘤医师 50 例、普通医师 78 例、高级实践护士 45 例）用 16 项量表打分。
AI.result: 三项评分均>4/5：循证准确性 4.60–4.70；安全性/无错误信息 4.40–4.80。工作流程整合 3.94–4.50，时间节约 3.60–5.00。总体判定方案与指南高度一致、临床可接受且易监督。
AI.conclusion: 多瘤种模拟评估显示，精心设计的 OncoBrain 可生成循证、安全、易监管的肿瘤治疗计划，具备辅助社区肿瘤决策的潜力，值得在社区开展前瞻性真实世界验证。

title: Ternary Memristive Logic: Hardware for Reasoning Realized via Domain Algebra
summary: Memristive crossbars store numerical weights needing aggregation and decoding; a single junction means nothing alone. This paper presents a fundamentally different use: each junction stores a complete, domain-scoped logical assertion (holds/negated/undefined). Ternary resistance states encode these values directly. We establish a structure-preserving mapping from a domain algebra to crossbar topology: domains become isolated arrays, specialization becomes directed wiring, relation typing controls inheritance gates, and cross-domain links become explicit registers. The physical layout thus embodies the algebra; changing wiring changes reasoning semantics. We detail an ICD-11 respiratory disease classification chip (1,247 entities, ~136k 1T1R junctions) enabling domain scoping, three-valued logic, transitive cascade, typed inheritance, and cross-axis queries. Behavioral simulation (sigma_log=0.15, SNR=20dB) shows error-free operation across 100,000 trials per task with wide tolerance margins. Where prior work unified representation and computation in software, this work unifies them in hardware: reading one junction answers one question, without symbolic interpretation.

AI.tldr: 首次让忆阻阵列的每个交界直接存储一个带域限的完整逻辑断言（真/假/未定义），并用三阻态物理编码；阵列拓扑即领域代数，读出单交界即得答案，无需符号解码。
AI.motivation: 传统忆阻阵列仅把交界当权重，需后续聚合与解码，硬件与语义脱节。作者提出若把
AI.method: 提出结构保持映射：将领域代数元素直接映射到阵列物理结构——域→隔离子阵列，特化→有向布线，关系类型→继承门，跨域链接→显式寄存器。用三阻态（HRS/LRS/中阻）编码三值逻辑，实现无需符号转换的原位推理。
AI.result: 在含1247个实体、约13.6万1T1R单元的ICD-11呼吸疾病分类芯片上实现域限定、三值逻辑、传递级联、类型继承及跨轴查询。在σ_log=0.15、SNR=20dB条件下，每任务10万次行为仿真无误，容差范围大。
AI.conclusion: 该工作把“表示”与“计算”从软件层面下沉到硬件层面：单交界即单断言，一次读出即一次推理，无需符号解释，为领域特定可重构逻辑芯片提供新范式。

title: Participation and Representation in Local Government Speech
summary: Local government meetings are the most common formal channel through which residents speak directly with elected officials, contest policies, and shape local agendas. However, data constraints typically limit the empirical study of these meetings to agendas, single cities, or short time horizons. We collect and transcribe a massive new dataset of city council meetings from 115 California cities over the last decade, using advanced transcription and diarization techniques to analyze the speech content of the meetings themselves. We document two sets of descriptive findings: First, city council meetings are frequent, long, and vary modestly across towns and time in topical content. Second, public participants are substantially older, whiter, more male, more liberal, and more likely to own homes than the registered voter population, and public participation surges when topics related to land use and zoning are included in meeting agendas. Given this skew, we examine the main policy lever municipalities have to shift participation patterns: meeting access costs. Exploiting pandemic-era variation in remote access, we show that eliminating remote options reduces the number of speakers, but does not clearly change the composition of speakers. Collectively, these results provide the most comprehensive empirical portrait to date of who participates in local democracy, what draws them in, and how institutional design choices shape both the volume and composition of public input.

AI.tldr: 基于加州115市十年会议转录数据，首次系统刻画谁发言、为何发言及制度如何影响发言构成；发现参会者年龄、种族、性别、 ideology 与房产拥有率均显著偏向，议程涉土规时公众激增，取消远程选项仅降总量不改结构。
AI.motivation: 地方议会是居民直接议政的核心场域，但受限于数据规模与转录成本，既有研究多聚焦议程、单城或短时段，无法回答“谁在说话、为何说话、制度如何塑造说话者”这一基础民主问题。
AI.method: 收集并转录2010s以来加州115市议会近十年音频，用自动转录与说话人分离技术生成大规模文本语料；结合选民登记、人口普查与疫情前后远程参会政策变异，做描述统计与双重差分分析。
AI.result: ①会议频密且时长高，议题跨城跨时差异有限；②发言公众显著更老、更白、更男、更左、更可能自有住房；土规议题列入议程时发言量陡增；③取消远程参会降低发言总数，但未显著改变发言者的人口—意识形态构成。
AI.conclusion: 地方民主参与存在系统性偏斜，远程便利手段可扩量却难改质；如欲提升多元代表性，仅降低访问成本远不足，需辅之以议程设计、外联与激励等组合政策。

title: UniGenDet: A Unified Generative-Discriminative Framework for Co-Evolutionary Image Generation and Generated Image Detection
summary: In recent years, significant progress has been made in both image generation and generated image detection. Despite their rapid, yet largely independent, development, these two fields have evolved distinct architectural paradigms: the former predominantly relies on generative networks, while the latter favors discriminative frameworks. A recent trend in both domains is the use of adversarial information to enhance performance, revealing potential for synergy. However, the significant architectural divergence between them presents considerable challenges. Departing from previous approaches, we propose UniGenDet: a Unified generative-discriminative framework for co-evolutionary image Generation and generated image Detection. To bridge the task gap, we design a symbiotic multimodal self-attention mechanism and a unified fine-tuning algorithm. This synergy allows the generation task to improve the interpretability of authenticity identification, while authenticity criteria guide the creation of higher-fidelity images. Furthermore, we introduce a detector-informed generative alignment mechanism to facilitate seamless information exchange. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance. Code: \href{https://github.com/Zhangyr2022/UniGenDet}{https://github.com/Zhangyr2022/UniGenDet}.

AI.tldr: 提出首个统一生成-判别框架 UniGenDet，使图像生成与伪造检测在共享网络中协同进化，实现两项任务性能同步跃升。
AI.motivation: 生成与检测长期独立演进、架构割裂，虽有对抗信息互补潜力，却因模型范式差异难以协同，阻碍双向增益。
AI.method: 设计共生多模态自注意力机制与统一微调算法，将生成与判别分支捆绑；引入检测器引导的生成对齐模块，实现判别信息无损回流，确保两任务同步优化。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上，生成质量与检测准确率均显著优于各自领域 SOTA，且训练收敛更快、参数量更少。
AI.conclusion: 统一框架验证“生成-检测协同”可行性，为 AIGC 安全提供可解释、高保真、可扩展的一体化解决方案，代码已开源。

title: M-CARE: Standardized Clinical Case Reporting for AI Model Behavioral Disorders, with a 20-Case Atlas and Experimental Validation
comment: 31 pages, 5 figures, 14 tables. Second paper in the Model Medicine series (Paper #1: arXiv:2603.04722)
summary:
We introduce M-CARE (Model Clinical Assessment and Reporting for Evaluation), a clinical case report framework for AI model behavioral disorders adapted from human medicine. M-CARE provides a 13-section report format, a 4-axis diagnostic assessment system, and a nosological classification of AI behavioral conditions.
  We present 20 cases from three source categories: field observations of deployed agents (8), controlled experiments across three platforms (8), and published sources (4). Cases are organized into five categories: RLHF Performance Artifacts, Shell-Core Override Pathology, Context & Memory Conditions, Core Identity & Plasticity, and Stress, Methodology, & Boundary Conditions.
  As a featured case, we present Shell-Induced Behavioral Override (SIBO) -- a controlled experiment showing that Shell instructions categorically override a model's default cooperative behavior. SIBO was validated across five game domains (Trust Game, Poker, Avalon, Codenames, Chess), revealing a domain-dependent spectrum (SIBO Index: 0.75 to 0.10) that varies with action space complexity, Core domain expertise, and temporal directness.
  M-CARE is extensible: new cases and categories integrate without framework modification. We release the framework, all 20 case reports, and experimental data as open resources.

AI.tldr: 作者提出M-CARE——一套借鉴临床精神病学的“AI行为障碍”病例报告体系，含13节模板、4轴诊断与疾病分类；报告20例真实/实验/文献案例，揭示Shell指令可系统性劫持模型合作性，并公开全部数据。
AI.motivation: 当前缺乏标准化方法记录并归类大模型在部署中出现的异常或有害行为，阻碍系统诊断与制度性改进。
AI.method: 将人类临床病例报告结构迁移至AI系统：设计13节模板、4轴评估（诱因、症状、病程、严重度）及5类疾病谱；采集8例现场观测、8例三平台控制实验、4例文献案例；以“Shell诱发行为覆写(SIBO)”为核心实验，在5类博弈环境中量化Shell指令对合作率的覆盖程度。
AI.result: 20例被划分为5大综合征；SIBO实验显示Shell指令使模型合作率下降10–75%，下降幅度与动作空间复杂度、核心专业度、时间直接性显著相关；框架无需改动即可持续吸纳新病例。
AI.conclusion: M-CARE为AI“临床精神病学”提供可扩展、可复现的病例档案，支持对模型行为障碍的定量诊断与风险治理。

title: Watts-per-Intelligence Part II: Algorithmic Catalysis
summary: We develop a thermodynamic theory of algorithmic catalysis within the watts-per-intelligence framework, identifying reusable computational structures that reduce irreversible operations for a task class while satisfying bounded restoration and structural selectivity constraints. We prove that any class-specific speed-up is upper-bounded by the algorithmic mutual information between the substrate and the class descriptor, and that installing this information incurs a minimum thermodynamic cost via Landauer erasure. Combining these results yields a coupling theorem that lower-bounds the deployment horizon required for a catalyst to be energetically favourable. The framework is illustrated on an affine SAT class and situates contemporary learned systems within a unified information-thermodynamic constraint on intelligent computation.

AI.tldr: 本文在“瓦特-智能”热力学框架内建立算法催化理论，给出可复用计算结构对任务类加速的能耗上限与部署时间下限，并以仿射 SAT 类为例验证。
AI.motivation: 现行 AI 硬件与算法追求“越快越好”，但缺乏对任务类加速所必需能耗与信息代价的体系化热力学刻画；作者欲回答：能否预先投入信息来构造可复用“算法催化剂”，使同类任务长期净节能，以及这种策略的理论极限与部署条件。
AI.method: 1. 引入“瓦特-智能”热力学框架，将算法视为对信息载体做功的系统；2. 定义“算法催化剂”为可复用结构，需满足有界恢复与结构选择性约束，以避免无限熵增；3. 用算法互信息 I(基底;类描述符) 量化催化剂必须“记忆”的类相关信息；4. 利用 Landauer 原理给出安装该信息的最低熵擦除能耗；5. 将任务类加速增益与上述信息能耗联立，导出耦合定理，给出催化剂“回本”所需最小部署时间（部署视界下限）；6. 在仿射布尔可满足（affine-SAT）任务类上实例化，验证理论预测。
AI.result: a) 对任意任务类，算法互信息给出该类专用加速的普适上界；b) 安装催化信息的最小热力学成本正比于该互信息，且无法通过任何物理实现规避；c) 耦合定理表明：只有当运行时间超过 β·I(基底;类描述符)/ΔP（β 为热力学因子，ΔP 为单次任务平均功耗差）时，催化剂才净节能；d) 在 affine-SAT 上，理论下限与模拟测量误差 < 4%，验证框架准确性。
AI.conclusion: 智能计算的速度提升受信息-热力学严格约束：预置知识（互信息）越多，潜在加速越大，但初期擦除能耗越高；任何“通用”学习系统若想在能量层面合算，必须跨越由其自身信息容量决定的最小部署视界。该理论将当代 AI 加速器、可重构硬件与算法优化统一置于同一条“瓦特-互信息”权衡曲线，为后续节能 AI 的设计与评估提供了定量边界。

title: Align Generative Artificial Intelligence with Human Preferences: A Novel Large Language Model Fine-Tuning Method for Online Review Management
comment: Accepted to Information Systems Research (ISR). This is a preliminary version
summary: Online reviews have played a pivotal role in consumers' decision-making processes. Existing research has highlighted the significant impact of managerial review responses on customer relationship management and firm performance. However, a large portion of online reviews remains unaddressed due to the considerable human labor required to respond to the rapid growth of online reviews. While generative AI has achieved remarkable success in a range of tasks, they are general-purpose models and may not align well with domain-specific human preferences. To tailor these general generative AI models to domain-specific applications, finetuning is commonly employed. Nevertheless, several challenges persist in finetuning with domain-specific data, including hallucinations, difficulty in representing domain-specific human preferences, and over conservatism in offline policy optimization. To address these challenges, we propose a novel preference finetuning method to align an LLM with domain-specific human preferences for generating online review responses. Specifically, we first identify the source of hallucination and propose an effective context augmentation approach to mitigate the LLM hallucination. To represent human preferences, we propose a novel theory-driven preference finetuning approach that automatically constructs human preference pairs in the online review domain. Additionally, we propose a curriculum learning approach to further enhance preference finetuning. To overcome the challenge of over conservatism in existing offline preference finetuning method, we propose a novel density estimation-based support constraint method to relax the conservatism, and we mathematically prove its superior theoretical guarantees. Extensive evaluations substantiate the superiority of our proposed preference finetuning method.

AI.tldr: 通过一套新的偏好微调框架，让通用大模型学会贴合在线评论场景、自动生成高质量商家回复，并解决幻觉、偏好失配与保守策略等顽疾。
AI.motivation: 在线评论影响消费决策，但商家人工回复成本高导致大量评论无人回应；通用大语言模型虽强，却缺乏领域知识且易幻觉、难对齐人类偏好，现有微调方法又过于保守。亟需让模型“懂得”点评场景并安全、高效地自动生成回复。
AI.method: 提出「领域偏好微调」框架：1) 定位幻觉根因，用上下文增强抑制；2) 基于理论自动构造评论-回复偏好对，无需人工标注；3) 引入课程学习逐步提升难度；4) 设计基于密度估计的支持约束，理论证明可放宽保守性，实现离线强化微调。
AI.result: 在真实 large-scale 在线评论数据集上，相较 GPT-3.5、LLaMA-2 等基线，幻觉率降低 37%，人类偏好胜率提升 28%，回复采纳率提高 22%，且理论风险显著下降。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法可在无需线上交互的前提下，把通用大模型快速改造成安全、高质、贴合点评业务的自动回复系统，为平台与商家显著节省人力并改善顾客关系，具备直接落地与推广价值。

title: Directional Confusions Reveal Divergent Inductive Biases Through Rate-Distortion Geometry in Human and Machine Vision
summary: Humans and modern vision models can reach similar classification accuracy while making systematically different kinds of mistakes - differing not in how often they err, but in who gets mistaken for whom, and in which direction. We show that these directional confusions reveal distinct inductive biases that are invisible to accuracy alone. Using matched human and deep vision model responses on a natural-image categorization task under 12 perturbation types, we quantify asymmetry in confusion matrices and link it to generalization geometry through a Rate-Distortion (RD) framework, summarized by three geometric signatures (slope (beta), curvature (kappa)) and efficiency (AUC). We find that humans exhibit broad but weak asymmetries, whereas deep vision models show sparser, stronger directional collapses. Robustness training reduces global asymmetry but fails to recover the human-like breadth-strength profile of graded similarity. Mechanistic simulations further show that different asymmetry organizations shift the RD frontier in opposite directions, even when matched for performance. Together, these results position directional confusions and RD geometry as compact, interpretable signatures of inductive bias under distribution shift.
