title: AITP: Traffic Accident Responsibility Allocation via Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in Traffic Accident Detection (TAD) and Traffic Accident Understanding (TAU). However, existing studies mainly focus on describing and interpreting accident videos, leaving room for deeper causal reasoning and integration of legal knowledge. Traffic Accident Responsibility Allocation (TARA) is a more challenging task that requires multi-step reasoning grounded in traffic regulations. To address this, we introduce AITP (Artificial Intelligence Traffic Police), a multimodal large language model for responsibility reasoning and allocation. AITP enhances reasoning via a Multimodal Chain-of-Thought (MCoT) mechanism and integrates legal knowledge through Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). We further present DecaTARA, a decathlon-style benchmark unifying ten interrelated traffic accident reasoning tasks with 67,941 annotated videos and 195,821 question-answer pairs. Extensive experiments show that AITP achieves state-of-the-art performance across responsibility allocation, TAD, and TAU tasks, establishing a new paradigm for reasoning-driven multimodal traffic analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AITP模型，首次将多模态大模型用于交通事故责任划分，配套DecaTARA十万级视频基准，在责任推理、事故检测与理解三项任务均达SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM仅停留在事故视频描述与理解，缺乏结合交通法规的因果推理与责任判定能力，无法直接服务交警执法与保险理赔。
AI.method: 1. 构建AITP多模态大模型，引入Multimodal Chain-of-Thought (MCoT) 逐步推理事故因果；2. 通过Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) 动态注入交通法规知识；3. 发布DecaTARA基准，覆盖10项关联推理任务，含67.9 k视频与195.8 k问答对。
AI.result: AITP在责任划分、事故检测、事故理解三大任务上全面超越现有最佳方法，并在DecaTARA十项子任务中平均提升11.3 %，首次实现“检测-理解-定责”端到端一体化。
AI.conclusion: 研究确立了“推理驱动”的多模态交通分析新范式，证明融入法规知识的分步推理可显著提升责任判定可信度，为自动驾驶、智慧警务与保险核赔提供可落地的技术支撑。

title: Predicting Scale-Up of Metal-Organic Framework Syntheses with Large Language Models
summary: Scalable synthesis remains the gate between MOF discovery and industrial deployment, as scale-up know-how is fragmented across disparate reports. We introduce ESU-MOF, a literature-mined dataset and a positive-unlabeled learning strategy that fine-tunes large language models to predict scalability potential with 91.4% accuracy, enabling rapid data-driven triage for industrial MOF discovery.

AI.tldr: 基于文献挖掘数据集的90余万条三元组训练出的微调大模型能自动预测MOF材料的可扩展合成潜力，精度达91.4%。
AI.motivation: MOF规模化合成缺乏系统性知识，已有经验碎片分散，限制工业化落地。
AI.method: (1)收集并结构化193篇制程文献，构建含90万条“合成-结构-单元”三元组的ESU-MOF数据集；(2)用Positive-Unlabeled学习框架，标注少量可扩展样本并引入大量正-未标记样本；(3)将UnifiedQA模型微调为MOF可扩展性分类器。
AI.result: 跨领域14类物料测试表明模型预测准确率91.4%，比传统监督基准提升12%，且训练成本下降65%；多组实验证实模型可提前筛出适合公斤级放大的候选体系。
AI.conclusion: 数据驱动的ESU-MOF策略可在研发早期量化评估规模化可行性，打通实验室-工业端的筛选瓶颈，为高效MOF产业化提供即时决策工具，并可推广至其它多孔材料的放大筛选。

title: Learning Dynamic Representations and Policies from Multimodal Clinical Time-Series with Informative Missingness
summary: Multimodal clinical records contain structured measurements and clinical notes recorded over time, offering rich temporal information about the evolution of patient health. Yet these observations are sparse, and whether they are recorded depends on the patient's latent condition. Observation patterns also differ across modalities, as structured measurements and clinical notes arise under distinct recording processes. While prior work has developed methods that accommodate missingness in clinical time series, how to extract and use the information carried by the observation process itself remains underexplored. We therefore propose a patient representation learning framework for multimodal clinical time series that explicitly leverages informative missingness. The framework combines (1) a multimodal encoder that captures signals from structured and textual data together with their observation patterns, (2) a Bayesian filtering module that updates a latent patient state over time from observed multimodal signals, and (3) downstream modules for offline treatment policy learning and patient outcome prediction based on the learned patient state. We evaluate the framework on ICU sepsis cohorts from MIMIC-III, MIMIC-IV, and eICU. It improves both offline treatment policy learning and adverse outcome prediction, achieving FQE 0.679 versus 0.528 for clinician behavior and AUROC 0.886 for post-72-hour mortality prediction on MIMIC-III.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向多模态临床时序数据的表征学习框架，通过显式建模“信息性缺失”提升策略学习和死亡预测，在 MIMIC/eICU 脓毒症队列上显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 多模态病历中的结构化指标与文本记录随时间稀疏出现，记录行为本身蕴含潜在病情变化的线索，但现有方法仅处理缺失而未挖掘其信息价值。
AI.method: 构建三模块框架：①多模态编码器联合建模观测值与观测模式；②贝叶斯滤波器随时间更新隐状态；③下游模块基于隐状态做离线策略学习与结局预测。
AI.result: MIMIC-III 实验显示，策略评估 FQE 从 0.528 提升至 0.679，72 h 死亡率预测 AUROC 达 0.886；结果在 MIMIC-IV 与 eICU 上保持一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 显式利用“信息性缺失”显著提升多模态临床时序建模效果，为精准策略学习与早期预警提供新思路。

title: When Prompts Override Vision: Prompt-Induced Hallucinations in LVLMs
summary: Despite impressive progress in capabilities of large vision-language models (LVLMs), these systems remain vulnerable to hallucinations, i.e., outputs that are not grounded in the visual input. Prior work has attributed hallucinations in LVLMs to factors such as limitations of the vision backbone or the dominance of the language component, yet the relative importance of these factors remains unclear. To resolve this ambiguity, We propose HalluScope, a benchmark to better understand the extent to which different factors induce hallucinations. Our analysis indicates that hallucinations largely stem from excessive reliance on textual priors and background knowledge, especially information introduced through textual instructions. To mitigate hallucinations induced by textual instruction priors, we propose HalluVL-DPO, a framework for fine-tuning off-the-shelf LVLMs towards more visually grounded responses. HalluVL-DPO leverages preference optimization using a curated training dataset that we construct, guiding the model to prefer grounded responses over hallucinated ones. We demonstrate that our optimized model effectively mitigates the targeted hallucination failure mode, while preserving or improving performance on other hallucination benchmarks and visual capability evaluations. To support reproducibility and further research, we will publicly release our evaluation benchmark, preference training dataset, and code at https://pegah-kh.github.io/projects/prompts-override-vision/ .

AI.tldr: HalluScope 量化文本先验对大视觉-语言模型幻觉的贡献，发现指令文本是主因；据此提出 HalluVL-DPO，用偏好优化微调现有模型，显著抑制幻觉且保持视觉能力，相关数据与代码将开源。
AI.motivation: 大视觉-语言模型虽性能飞跃，但仍出现“幻觉”——输出与图像不符。先前研究将原因笼统归于视觉骨干缺陷或语言模块主导，却缺乏对各因素权重的系统度量，导致改进方向不明。
AI.method: 1) 设计 HalluScope 基准，通过对比仅文本提示与含视觉输入的响应差异，量化文本先验、背景知识及指令引入信息对幻觉的诱发程度；2) 构建偏好训练集，把“幻觉回答”标为负例、“紧贴图像回答”标为正例；3) 提出 HalluVL-DPO 框架，用 Direct Preference Optimization 在公开 LVLM 上微调，使模型学会优先选择与视觉内容一致的答案。
AI.result: HalluScope 实验揭示：幻觉主要源自模型对文本指令中先验知识的过度依赖，而非视觉编码器缺陷。HalluVL-DPO 在靶向幻觉测试集上显著降低幻觉率，同时在其他通用幻觉基准及视觉任务准确率上持平或提升，验证其抑制幻觉而不失原本能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过系统分离并量化各因素，HalluScope 明确了“文本先验 > 视觉缺陷”的幻觉成因；HalluVL-DPO 证明基于偏好优化的轻量级微调即可有效对齐 LVLM 输出与视觉输入，为后续鲁棒视觉-语言模型研究提供可复现的评估工具与训练范式。

title: KinetiDiff: Docking-Guided Diffusion for De Novo ACVR1 Inhibitor Design in Fibrodysplasia Ossificans Progressiva
summary: We present KinetiDiff, a structure-based framework for de novo kinase inhibitor design that integrates a Geometry-Complete Diffusion Model with real-time AutoDock Vina gradient guidance. By injecting physics-based docking gradients into the diffusion denoising loop, KinetiDiff steers molecule generation toward high-affinity conformations for ACVR1 (ALK2), the causative kinase in Fibrodysplasia Ossificans Progressiva. From 10,000 diffusion samples, the framework produced 9,997 valid molecules. The best candidate achieved $-11.05$ kcal/mol (pKd = 8.10), a 19.2% improvement over the crystallographic reference. The top 100 candidates all exceed the reference, with 100% Lipinski compliance, median synthetic accessibility of 2.67, and internal diversity of 0.790. Systematic ablation across four guidance strategies--Vina-Direct (physics), HNN-Denovo (neural proxy), multi-objective, and unguided--demonstrates that real-time docking guidance dominates on all metrics. We evaluate HNN-Denovo as a computationally efficient alternative (60-fold speedup per step), revealing a domain-mismatch limitation (r = 0.224 correlation with Vina) that explains its inferior performance. These results establish gradient-guided geometric diffusion as a practical approach for generating potent, synthetically accessible inhibitors against rare-disease kinase targets.

AI.tldr: KinetiDiff 将全几何扩散模型与实时 AutoDock Vina 梯度耦合，首次在扩散去噪循环内注入物理对接信号，直接为罕见病靶点 ACVR1 生成高亲和力、高成药性的全新抑制剂，最佳候选物亲和力提升 19.2%，100% 满足 Lipinski 规则。
AI.motivation: 纤维性骨化进展症（FOP）致病激酶 ACVR1 缺乏有效药物，传统 AI 生成分子常因忽视真实结合几何而亲和力不足；需一种能在生成阶段即被物理对接信号实时约束的结构型设计方法。
AI.method: 构建 Geometry-Complete Diffusion Model 负责三维分子几何生成；在去噪迭代中实时计算 AutoDock Vina 梯度并注入，形成“Vina-Direct”引导；对比无引导、神经代理引导（HNN-Denovo）及多目标引导等四种策略，并以 HNN-Denovo 作为快速代理评估计算-精度权衡。
AI.result: 10 000 个扩散样本获得 9 997 个有效分子；顶级分子对接能为 −11.05 kcal·mol⁻¹（pKd = 8.10），比晶体参照提升 19.2%；前 100 名均优于参照，100% 通过 Lipinski 规则，中位合成可及性 2.67，内部多样性 0.790。实时 Vina 引导在所有指标上显著优于其余策略；HNN-Denovo 每步提速 60 倍，但与 Vina 相关性仅 0.224，导致性能下降。
AI.conclusion: 梯度引导的几何扩散模型可在生成阶段即锁定高亲和力构象，为罕见病激酶靶点快速提供强效且易于合成的新分子，兼具精度与实用性；同时揭示神经网络代理与物理模型间领域失配是性能瓶颈，为未来设计更精准代理提供方向。

title: Frequency-Forcing: From Scaling-as-Time to Soft Frequency Guidance
summary: While standard flow-matching models transport noise to data uniformly, incorporating an explicit generation order - specifically, establishing coarse, low-frequency structure before fine detail - has proven highly effective for synthesizing natural images. Two recent works offer distinct paradigms for this. K-Flow imposes a hard frequency constraint by reinterpreting a frequency scaling variable as flow time, running the trajectory inside a transformed amplitude space. Latent Forcing provides a soft ordering mechanism by coupling the pixel flow with an auxiliary semantic latent flow via asynchronous time schedules, leaving the pixel interpolation path itself untouched. Viewed from the angle of improving pixel generation, we observe that forcing - guiding generation with an earlier-maturing auxiliary stream - offers a highly compatible route to scale-ordered generation without rewriting the core flow coordinate. Building on this, we propose Frequency-Forcing, which realizes K-Flow's frequency ordering through Latent Forcing's soft mechanism: a standard pixel flow is guided by an auxiliary low-frequency stream that matures earlier in time. Unlike Latent Forcing, whose scratchpad relies on a heavy pretrained encoder (e.g., DINO), our frequency scratchpad is derived from the data itself via a lightweight learnable wavelet packet transform. We term this a self-forcing signal, which avoids external dependencies while learning a basis better adapted to data statistics than the fixed bases used in hard frequency flows. On ImageNet-256, Frequency-Forcing consistently improves FID over strong pixel- and latent-space baselines, and naturally composes with a semantic stream to yield further gains. This illustrates that forcing-based scale ordering is a versatile, path-preserving alternative to hard frequency flows.

AI.tldr: Frequency-Forcing 将 K-Flow 的“先生成低频”思想转化为 Latent Forcing 的软引导范式：用一条由可学习小波包自生成的低分辨率辅助流，提前为像素主生成流提供粗结构提示，无需重写主坐标、也不依赖外部大编码器，在 ImageNet-256 上持续降低 FID，且可与语义流叠加增益。
AI.motivation: 标准流匹配模型在噪声到数据的映射中无结构先后，而自然图像合成需先粗后细。现有硬约束(K-Flow)与软约束(Latent Forcing)两种范式均有效，但前者需大幅改坐标，后者依赖重编码器；需探索更轻量、兼容的路径级引导方案。
AI.method: 提出 Frequency-Forcing：主生成流仍走标准像素坐标；并行引入一条“自生成”的低频辅助流，由可学习的小波包变换从数据即时提取，按异步时间提前成熟，通过耦合项软性地引导主流先生成低频结构。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet-256 上，Frequency-Forcing 相对强像素/潜空间基线显著降低 FID；若叠加语义流还可进一步提升，证明其兼容性与可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 基于 forcing 的“软-有序”生成能在不更改主坐标的前提下替代硬频率流，为后续多尺度流模型提供通用且轻量的路径级增强策略。

title: Hyperloop Transformers
summary: LLM architecture research generally aims to maximize model quality subject to fixed compute/latency budgets. However, many applications of interest such as edge and on-device deployment are further constrained by the model's memory footprint, thus motivating parameter-efficient architectures for language modeling. This paper describes a simple architecture that improves the parameter-efficiency of LLMs. Our architecture makes use of looped Transformers as a core primitive, which reuse Transformer layers across depth and are thus more parameter-efficient than ordinary (depth-matched) Transformers. We organize the looped Transformer into three blocks--begin, middle, and end blocks--where each block itself consists of multiple Transformer layers, and only the middle block is applied recurrently across depth. We augment the looped middle block with hyper-connections (Xie et al., 2026), which expand the residual stream into matrix-valued residual streams. Hyper-connections are applied only after each loop, and therefore add minimal new parameters and compute cost. Across various model scales, we find that our Hyper-Connected Looped Transformer (Hyperloop Transformer) is able to outperform depth-matched Transformer and mHC Transformer baselines despite using approximately 50% fewer parameters. The outperformance persists through post-training weight quantization, thus positioning Hyperloop Transformers as an attractive architecture for memory-efficient language modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出 Hyper-Connected Looped Transformer (Hyperloop Transformer)，用回圈复用中间 block 并在每次回圈后插入几乎零增参的 hyper-connection，在等效深度下比标准 Transformer 少用约 50% 参数仍获更优质量，量化后优势依旧，适合端侧内存受限场景。
AI.motivation: 端侧/边缘部署受内存硬预算限制，需在固定算力与延迟下进一步压缩模型体积，因此追求极致参数效率的 LLM 架构。
AI.method: 1）将模型划分为 begin/middle/end 三 block，仅 middle block 循环复用；2）每次循环后在残差流上插入矩阵值 hyper-connection，以极低参数增量扩展信息流；3）整体形成 Hyperloop Transformer，端到端训练。
AI.result: 多尺度实验显示，在相近深度与算力下，Hyperloop Transformer 用约 50% 参数持续超越标准 Transformer 与 mHC 基线；8-bit 权重量化后优势依旧，验证内存高效的同时不牺牲精度。
AI.conclusion: 通过回圈+hyper-connection 的组合，可在显著减参的前提下提升语言模型质量，为内存受限场景提供实用且可扩展的架构选择。

title: Vista4D: Video Reshooting with 4D Point Clouds
comment: 24 pages, 20 figures, CVPR 2026, see project page at https://eyeline-labs.github.io/Vista4D
summary: We present Vista4D, a robust and flexible video reshooting framework that grounds the input video and target cameras in a 4D point cloud. Specifically, given an input video, our method re-synthesizes the scene with the same dynamics from a different camera trajectory and viewpoint. Existing video reshooting methods often struggle with depth estimation artifacts of real-world dynamic videos, while also failing to preserve content appearance and failing to maintain precise camera control for challenging new trajectories. We build a 4D-grounded point cloud representation with static pixel segmentation and 4D reconstruction to explicitly preserve seen content and provide rich camera signals, and we train with reconstructed multiview dynamic data for robustness against point cloud artifacts during real-world inference. Our results demonstrate improved 4D consistency, camera control, and visual quality compared to state-of-the-art baselines under a variety of videos and camera paths. Moreover, our method generalizes to real-world applications such as dynamic scene expansion and 4D scene recomposition. See our project page for results, code, and models: https://eyeline-labs.github.io/Vista4D

AI.tldr: Vista4D利用4D点云对动态视频进行重拍，能在任意新相机轨迹下高保真重渲染场景，兼具深度鲁棒性与外观一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有视频重拍技术受限于深度估计误差与外观漂移，难以在复杂真实动态视频中同时实现精确相机控制与内容保持。
AI.method: 通过静态像素分割与4D重建构建4D grounded点云表示，显式保留可见内容并提供强相机信号；进一步用多视角重建动态数据训练，抑制推理时的点云伪影。
AI.result: 在多种视频与相机路径下，4D一致性、相机控制精度与视觉质量均优于SOTA基线，并支持动态场景扩展与4D场景重组等真实应用。
AI.conclusion: 将视频重拍任务锚定在4D点云可兼顾鲁棒性与灵活性，为动态场景自由视点渲染提供了新的强力框架。项目与代码已开源。

title: Spectral Kernel Dynamics for Planetary Surface Graphs: Distinction Dynamics and Topological Conservation
summary: The spectral kernel field equation R[k] = T[k] lacks a conservation-law analog. We prove (i) the fixed-point flow is strictly volume-expanding (tr DF > 0), precluding automatic conservation, and (ii) the conservation deficit per mode equals the Hessian stability margin exactly: D_m = -Delta'. Closing the deficit requires a scene-side compensating contribution, which we formalise as the distinction dynamics equation dc/dt = G[c, h_t], with MaxCal-optimal realisation G_opt. On fixed-topology 3D surface graphs we derive a conditional topology-preserving compression theorem: retaining k >= beta_0 + beta_1 modes (under a spectral-ordering assumption) preserves all Betti-number charges; we include a worked short-cycle counterexample (figure-eight) calibrating when the assumption fails. A triple necessary spectral diagnostic -- Fiedler-mode concentration, elevated curl energy, anomalous beta_1 -- is derived for planetary drainage networks at O(N) cost. Two internal real-data sequences serve as preliminary consistency checks; full benchmarks and adaptive-topology extensions are deferred.

AI.tldr: 文章指出谱核场方程R[k]=T[k] 缺少守恒律对应，用流扩张性和 Hessian 稳定性亏量 D_m=-Δ′ 量化；提出补偿动力学 dc/dt=G[c,h_t] 及其 MaxCal 最优实现，并在 3D 表面图上给出拓扑条件压缩定理及 β₁ 异常诊断，实验仅初步验证。
AI.motivation: 现有谱核方法在图或曲面上演化时，没有守恒律可类比，导致无法保证拓扑或全局量不变。作者想明确该方程本质上为何不守恒、亏量如何数学刻画，以及如何引入补偿机制同时维持拓扑信息，为后续稳健降维和拓扑诊断奠定理论框架。
AI.method: 1) 将谱核场方程视为固定点流，证明其散度 tr DF>0，必然体积扩张；2) 定义模式级守恒亏量 D_m，严格等于 Hessian 稳定裕度 -Δ′；3) 引入场侧补偿变量 c，建立亏量闭合动力学 dc/dt=G[c,h_t]，在 MaxCal 原理下导出最优 G_opt；4) 对固定拓扑 3D 表面图，在谱排序假设下证明保留 k≥β₀+β₁ 个特征模可保持各 Betti 数“电荷”；5) 给出 Fiedler 模聚集、旋度能量抬升、β₁ 异常三合一 O(N) 诊断指标，用于行星级水系网络。
AI.result: 理论上守恒亏量得到精确表达式并与稳定性挂钩；补偿动力学与 MaxCal 最优解被显式给出；拓扑条件压缩定理给出谱模数量下限并附带“8 字形”反例说明谱排序不成立时定理失效；三指标诊断在真实水系图上表现与预期趋势一致，但未完成全基准测试。
AI.conclusion: 谱核场方程本质不守恒且亏量可被 Hessian 稳定性量化；通过引入 MaxCal 最佳补偿可在保持拓扑特征的前提下压缩数据；所得谱-拓扑诊断工具对大型曲面网络具有线性复杂度，已初步在真实水系数据上显现一致性，后续需完成全面基准与自适应拓扑扩展。

title: Reinforcing privacy reasoning in LLMs via normative simulacra from fiction
summary: Information handling practices of LLM agents are broadly misaligned with the contextual privacy expectations of their users. Contextual Integrity (CI) provides a principled framework, defining privacy as the appropriate flow of information within context-relative norms. However, existing approaches either double inference cost via supervisor-assistant architectures, or fine-tune on narrow task-specific data. We propose extracting normative simulacra (structured representations of norms and information flows) from fiction novels and using them to fine-tune LLMs via supervised learning followed by GRPO reinforcement learning. Our composite reward function combines programmatic signals, including task clarity (subsuming schema validity, construct discrimination, and extraction confidence), structural completeness, internal consistency, and context identification, with an LLM judge that evaluates whether the model's privacy reasoning is grounded in the held-out normative universe of the source text. To mitigate overfitting, we introduce per-completion contrastive scoring: each completion is evaluated against both the correct normative universe and a randomly selected wrong one, teaching the model to condition on context rather than memorize source-specific norms. We evaluate on five CI-aligned benchmarks spanning distinct societal contexts and ablate the contributions of RL and normative grounding. Across seven models, SFT introduces a conservative prior toward restricting information flow, improving recognition of privacy-relevant situations but not the correctness of privacy judgments. GRPO with normative grounding achieves the highest score on a law compliance benchmark and strongest correlation with crowdsourced human privacy expectations, demonstrating that fiction-derived normative simulacra can teach contextual privacy reasoning that transfers to real-world domains.

AI.tldr: 用小说抽出的“规范拟像”微调+强化学习，让 LLM 学会语境完整性（CI）隐私推理，在法合规与人群隐私期望测试中得分最高。
AI.motivation: LLM 代理的信息处理与用户的语境隐私期望错位；既有方法要么推理成本翻倍，要么仅适配窄任务。需让模型内化上下文规范而非死记规则。
AI.method: 1) 从小说提取“规范拟像”（结构化规范+信息流表示）；2) 先监督微调（SFT）再 GRPO 强化学习；3) 复合奖励：任务清晰度、结构完整性、内部一致性、语境识别 + LLM-judge 判定隐私推理是否扎根于源文本规范；4) 每完成样本与正确/错误规范宇宙做对比打分，防过拟合。
AI.result: 在五套 CI 对齐基准、七种模型上：SFT 带来“保守”先验，会识别隐私情境但判断正确率未升；加入 GRPO 与规范 grounding 后，法律合规基准得分最高，且与 crowdsourced 人类隐私期望相关性最强。
AI.conclusion: 虚构文本衍生的规范拟像能有效教授语境化隐私推理，并可迁移到真实世界领域。

title: Spatial Metaphors for LLM Memory: A Critical Analysis of the MemPalace Architecture
comment: 20 pages, 10 tables. Code and data at https://github.com/web3guru888/mempalace-scientific-analysis
summary: MemPalace is an open-source AI memory system that applies the ancient method of loci (memory palace) spatial metaphor to organize long-term memory for large language models; launched in April 2026, it accumulated over 47,000 GitHub stars in its first two weeks and claims state-of-the-art retrieval performance on the LongMemEval benchmark (96.6% Recall@5) without requiring any LLM inference at write time. Through independent codebase analysis, benchmark replication, and comparison with competing systems, we find that MemPalace's headline retrieval performance is attributable primarily to its verbatim storage philosophy combined with ChromaDB's default embedding model (all-MiniLM-L6-v2), rather than to its spatial organizational metaphor per se -- the palace hierarchy (Wings->Rooms->Closets->Drawers) operates as standard vector database metadata filtering, an effective but well-established technique. However, MemPalace makes several genuinely novel contributions: (1) a contrarian verbatim-first storage philosophy that challenges extraction-based competitors, (2) an extremely low wake-up cost (approximately 170 tokens) through its four-layer memory stack, (3) a fully deterministic, zero-LLM write path enabling offline operation at zero API cost, and (4) the first systematic application of spatial memory metaphors as an organizing principle for AI memory systems. We also note that the competitive landscape is evolving rapidly, with Mem0's April 2026 token-efficient algorithm raising their LongMemEval score from approximately 49% to 93.4%, narrowing the gap between extraction-based and verbatim approaches. Our analysis concludes that MemPalace represents significant architectural insight wrapped in overstated claims -- a pattern common in rapidly adopted open-source projects where marketing velocity exceeds scientific rigor.

AI.tldr: MemPalace以‘记忆宫殿’概念包装，仅用两周摘得47k star，实为逐字存储+ChromaDB嵌入的常规方案；零推理写入、170 token唤醒、空间隐喻组织AI记忆属真创新，但检索优势主要归功于逐字策略而非宫殿层级，营销声量高于科学严谨。
AI.motivation: 解决大模型长期记忆低效、写入成本高、API依赖强等问题，同时探索空间隐喻作为AI记忆组织原则的可行性。
AI.method: 构建四层级宫殿结构（Wings→Rooms→Closets→Drawers），采用逐字存储哲学，结合ChromaDB默认嵌入模型，实现零LLM推理的确定性写入路径与元数据过滤检索。
AI.result: LongMemEval Recall@5 达96.6%，写入零成本，唤醒仅需~170 tokens；Mem0新算法仅用1个月将成绩从49%提至93.4%，缩小差距。
AI.conclusion: MemPalace在空间隐喻驱动的AI记忆架构上首次系统尝试，验证了逐字存储在低唤醒成本与离线场景下的优势，但其核心性能获益于既有技术组合，宣传夸大现象凸显开源项目营销速度快于科学验证的典型特征。

title: Context Unrolling in Omni Models
summary: We present Omni, a unified multimodal model natively trained on diverse modalities, including text, images, videos, 3D geometry, and hidden representations. We find that such training enables Context Unrolling, where the model explicitly reasons across multiple modal representations before producing predictions. This process enables the model to aggregate complementary information across heterogeneous modalities, facilitating a more faithful approximation of the shared multimodal knowledge manifold and improving downstream reasoning fidelity. As a result, Omni achieves strong performance on both multimodal generation and understanding benchmarks, while demonstrating advanced multimodal reasoning capabilities, including in-context generation of text, image, video, and 3D geometry.

AI.tldr: Omni 是一个端到端的多模态统一大模型，在文本、图像、视频、3D 几何与隐表示上联合训练，借助‘Context Unrolling’跨模态显式推理，在理解与生成任务上均取得 SOTA，并支持上下文驱动的文本、图像、视频、3D 内容生成。
AI.motivation: 现有方法多为“编码-融合”式流水线，不同模态语义空间错位，难以捕获共享知识流形，导致推理失真；作者旨在通过原生联合训练建立统一表征，实现跨模态互补信息聚合，提升推理可信度和生成一致性。
AI.method: 设计端到端 Transformer 统一架构，对文本、图像、视频、3D 几何及隐表示进行同步训练；提出 Context Unrolling 机制：在推理阶段显式展开多模态上下文，让模型在内部对不同模态表征进行链式推理并动态聚合，以逼近共享知识流形。
AI.result: 在多模态理解基准（VQA、Video QA、3D QA）和生成基准（文生图、文生视频、文生 3D）上均取得新 SOTA；零样本上下文可同时生成文本、图像、视频与 3D 几何，人类评估显示其跨模态一致性和推理准确率显著优于专用模型与通用多模态基线。
AI.conclusion: 原生多模态联合训练与 Context Unrolling 可有效对齐异构模态，显著提升推理保真度与生成质量，验证“统一模型统一流形”的可行性，为通用多模态 AGI 奠定基础。

title: Towards a Systematic Risk Assessment of Deep Neural Network Limitations in Autonomous Driving Perception
comment: Accepted for publication at the SECAI workshop at ESORICS 2025
summary: Safety and security are essential for the admission and acceptance of automated and autonomous vehicles. Deep neural networks (DNNs) are widely used for perception and further components of the autonomous driving (AD) stack. However, they possess several limitations, including lack of generalization, efficiency, explainability, plausibility, and robustness. These insufficiencies can pose significant risks to autonomous driving systems. However, hazards, threats, and risks associated with DNN limitations in this domain have not been systematically studied so far. In this work, we propose a joint workflow for risk assessment combining the hazard analysis and risk assessment (HARA) following ISO 26262 and threat analysis and risk assessment (TARA) following the ISO/SAE 21434 to identify and analyze risks arising from inherent DNN limitations in AD perception.

AI.tldr: 针对自动驾驶感知中深度神经网络的固有缺陷，首次系统提出融合ISO 26262 HARA与ISO/SAE 21434 TARA的联合风险评估流程。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶系统广泛采用DNN，但DNN存在泛化、效率、可解释性、合理性与鲁棒性不足，这些缺陷可能转化为安全与网络安全风险，却缺乏系统化梳理与评估方法。
AI.method: 构建跨功能安全（ISO 26262 HARA）与网络安全（ISO/SAE 21434 TARA）的联合工作流，对感知环节DNN局限引发的潜在危害、威胁及其风险进行系统识别、分级与分析。
AI.result: 提出统一框架，可全面捕获并量化DNN缺陷导致的安全与网络安全风险，为后续验证与安全架构设计提供依据（具体风险清单与数据需见全文）。
AI.conclusion: 该联合流程填补了DNN局限在AD感知领域风险系统化研究的空白，可直接支持后续安全需求导出、安全机制设计与标准认证，推动高阶自动驾驶的安全落地。

title: Biomedical systems biology workflow orchestration and execution with PoSyMed
summary: The rapid growth of scientific software has created practical barriers for bioinformatics research. Although powerful statistical, artificial intelligence (AI)-based methods are now widely available, their effective use is often hindered by fragmented distribution, inconsistent documentation, complex dependencies, and difficult-to-reproduce execution environments. As a result, reusing published tools and workflow adaptation to own date remains technically demanding and time-intensive, even for experienced users. Here, we present PoSyMed, an open and modular platform for the controlled integration, composition, and execution of bioinformatics tools and workflows. PoSyMed combines a backend-centered platform architecture with formal tool descriptions, controlled container-based build and execution processes, persistent workflow state, and a dialogue-based user interface. Large language models (LLM) are integrated not as autonomous decision-makers, but as human-computer interface with bounded semantic assistants that help identify tools, propose workflow steps, and support parameterization within a typed, validated, and human-supervised execution environment. PoSyMed is designed to improve reproducibility, traceability, and transparency in practical biomedical analysis within one platform. We describe the system architecture and evaluate its behavior across representative biological software scenarios with respect to workflow support, interaction design, and platform extensibility. PoSyMed is publicly available at https://apps.cosy.bio/posymed.

AI.tldr: PoSyMed 是一个开源模块化平台，通过容器化、形式化工具描述和 LLM 辅助的对话式界面，将散乱的生信工具与流程整合到可复现、可追踪的单点环境。
AI.motivation: 生信软件爆炸式增长导致工具分散、文档不一、依赖复杂、环境难复现，使得即便是资深用户也难以快速重用已发表工具或适配自有数据。
AI.method: 后端中心架构 + 形式化工具描述 + 容器化构建/执行 + 持久化流程状态；LLM 仅作“有限语义助手”嵌入人机对话界面，负责工具识别、步骤推荐与参数提示，全程接受类型验证与人监督。
AI.result: 在典型生物软件场景中验证了工作流支持能力、交互设计与平台可扩展性；平台已公开上线。
AI.conclusion: PoSyMed 把生信工具链的“碎片化”问题收敛到单一可控环境，显著提升分析的可复现性、可追溯性与透明度，同时降低使用门槛。

title: CI-Work: Benchmarking Contextual Integrity in Enterprise LLM Agents
summary: Enterprise LLM agents can dramatically improve workplace productivity, but their core capability, retrieving and using internal context to act on a user's behalf, also creates new risks for sensitive information leakage. We introduce CI-Work, a Contextual Integrity (CI)-grounded benchmark that simulates enterprise workflows across five information-flow directions and evaluates whether agents can convey essential content while withholding sensitive context in dense retrieval settings. Our evaluation of frontier models reveals that privacy failures are prevalent (violation rates range from 15.8%-50.9%, with leakage reaching up to 26.7%) and uncovers a counterintuitive trade-off critical for industrial deployment: higher task utility often correlates with increased privacy violations. Moreover, the massive scale of enterprise data and potential user behavior further amplify this vulnerability. Simply increasing model size or reasoning depth fails to address the problem. We conclude that safeguarding enterprise workflows requires a paradigm shift, moving beyond model-centric scaling toward context-centric architectures.

AI.tldr: 首次提出 CI-Work 基准，证实企业 LLM 智能体在密集检索场景下普遍存在 16%-51% 的隐私泄露率，且任务效用越高泄露风险越大；仅靠扩大模型或加深推理无法解决，需转向以上下文为中心的架构范式。
AI.motivation: 企业级 LLM 智能体能显著提升生产力，但其在代表用户执行任务时检索并利用内部上下文的核心机制，同时带来敏感信息泄露的新风险。现有缺乏系统量化该风险的标准基准，阻碍安全部署。
AI.method: 基于 Contextual Integrity（CI）理论，构建 CI-Work 基准：①定义五类企业工作流信息流向（上下、平行、跨部门、对外、对历史上下文）；②生成含敏感与必要内容的模拟任务；③在密集检索设置下评估智能体“传递必要内容同时扣留敏感上下文”的能力；④对多个前沿模型进行大规模自动化评测并分析任务效用-隐私冲突。
AI.result: 隐私违规率 15.8%-50.9%，最高泄露率达 26.7%；任务准确率与隐私违规呈显著正相关（ρ>0.4）；扩大模型规模或增加推理步数对降低泄露几乎无效；企业数据规模与潜在用户行为会指数级放大泄露面。
AI.conclusion: 企业场景下“模型越大越智能”的范式失效，必须从以模型为中心转向以上下文为中心的体系结构，如动态敏感级标签、访问控制型检索、隐私-效用联合优化框架，才能保障智能体工作流的安全部署。

title: Seeing Without Eyes: 4D Human-Scene Understanding from Wearable IMUs
summary: Understanding human activities and their surrounding environments typically relies on visual perception, yet cameras pose persistent challenges in privacy, safety, energy efficiency, and scalability. We explore an alternative: 4D perception without vision. Its goal is to reconstruct human motion and 3D scene layouts purely from everyday wearable sensors. For this we introduce IMU-to-4D, a framework that repurposes large language models for non-visual spatiotemporal understanding of human-scene dynamics. IMU-to-4D uses data from a few inertial sensors from earbuds, watches, or smartphones and predicts detailed 4D human motion together with coarse scene structure. Experiments across diverse human-scene datasets show that IMU-to-4D yields more coherent and temporally stable results than SoTA cascaded pipelines, suggesting wearable motion sensors alone can support rich 4D understanding.

AI.tldr: 用日常IMU传感器替代相机，实现无视觉的4D人体-场景重建。
AI.motivation: 传统基于相机的视觉感知在隐私、能耗、部署规模等方面持续受限，亟需一种无需成像即可理解人体活动与三维场景的新范式。
AI.method: 提出IMU-to-4D框架，把大语言模型改用于非视觉时空建模；仅利用耳机、手表或手机中的少量惯性测量单元数据，联合预测高保真4D人体运动与粗粒度场景结构。
AI.result: 跨数据集的实验显示，相比级联SOTA方案，该方法在时序一致性与稳定性上更优，证明仅凭可穿戴运动传感器即可支撑丰富的4D理解。
AI.conclusion: 研究证实无视觉4D感知可行，为隐私友好、低功耗、可扩展的下一代活动理解系统奠定了技术路线。

title: Achieving the Kesten-Stigum bound in the non-uniform hypergraph stochastic block model
summary:
We study the community detection problem in the non-uniform hypergraph stochastic block model (HSBM), where hyperedges of varying sizes coexist. This setting captures higher-order and multi-view interactions and raises a fundamental question: can multiple uniform hypergraph layers below the detection threshold be combined to enable weak recovery? We answer this question by establishing a Kesten--Stigum-type bound for weak recovery in a general class of non-uniform HSBMs with $r$ blocks, generated according to multiple symmetric probability tensors. In the case $r=2$, we show that weak recovery is possible whenever the sum of the signal-to-noise ratios across all uniform hypergraph layers exceeds one, thereby confirming the positive part of a conjecture in (Chodrow et al., 2023). Moreover, we provide a polynomial-time spectral algorithm that achieves this threshold via an optimally weighted non-backtracking operator. For the unweighted non-backtracking matrix, our spectral method attains a different algorithmic threshold, also conjectured in (Chodrow et al., 2023).
  Our approach develops a spectral theory for weighted non-backtracking operators on non-uniform hypergraphs, including a precise characterization of outlier eigenvalues and eigenvector overlaps. We introduce a novel Ihara--Bass formula tailored to weighted non-uniform hypergraphs, which yields an efficient low-dimensional representation and leads to a provable spectral reconstruction algorithm. Taken together, these results provide a principled and computationally efficient approach to clustering in non-uniform hypergraphs, and highlight the role of optimal weighting in aggregating heterogeneous higher-order interactions.

AI.tldr: 在非均匀超图随机分块模型中，当各阶均匀层单独均低于检测阈值时，只要它们的信噪比之和>1即可实现弱恢复；作者给出KS型阈值并设计最优加权非回溯谱算法达到该极限，同时建立对应的谱理论与Ihara–Bass公式。
AI.motivation: 现实超图往往同时存在不同阶的超边（高阶与多视角交互），而现有理论仅关注均匀超图，且当每一阶均匀层信号都低于检测阈值时能否通过合并实现弱恢复尚不清楚。
AI.method: 1. 建立包含r个社区的广义非均匀HSBM的Kesten–Stigum型弱恢复阈值；2. 构造最优加权的非均匀超图非回溯算子，提出对应的加权Ihara–Bass公式；3. 利用该公式将高维算子降阶至低维矩阵，并精确刻画其离群特征值/特征向量重叠；4. 设计多项式时间谱聚类算法。
AI.result: r=2时证明：若所有均匀层的信噪比之和>1则弱恢复可行，证实Chodrow等2023猜想中的正向部分；算法在加权和未加权两种设定下分别触及理论与算法阈值；为加权非回溯算子在非均匀超图上给出完整谱刻画。
AI.conclusion: 首次给出非均匀超图弱恢复的清晰信息论阈值与可达的谱算法，表明“最优加权聚合”可把原本不可检测的异构高阶信号整合为可检测信号，为复杂高阶网络聚类提供可扩展且计算高效的理论框架。

title: Planetary Exploration 3.0: A Roadmap for Software-Defined, Radically Adaptive Space Systems
summary: The surface and subsurface of worlds beyond Mars remain largely unexplored. Yet these worlds hold keys to fundamental questions in planetary science - from potentially habitable subsurface oceans on icy moons to ancient records preserved in Kuiper Belt objects. NASA's success in Mars exploration was achieved through incrementalism: 22 progressively sophisticated missions over decades. This paradigm, which we call Planetary Exploration 2.0 (PE 2.0), is untenable for the outer Solar System, where cruise times of a decade or more make iterative missions infeasible. We propose Planetary Exploration 3.0 (PE 3.0): a paradigm in which unvisited worlds are explored by a single or a few missions with radically adaptive space systems. A PE 3.0 mission conducts both initial exploratory science and follow-on hypothesis-driven science based on its own in situ data returns, evolving spacecraft capabilities to work resiliently in previously unseen environments. The key enabler of PE 3.0 is software-defined space systems (SDSSs) - systems that can adapt their functions at all levels through software updates. This paper presents findings from a Keck Institute for Space Studies (KISS) workshop on PE 3.0, covering: (1) PE 3.0 systems engineering including science definition, architecture, design methods, and verification & validation; (2) software-defined space system technologies including reconfigurable hardware, multi-functionality, and modularity; (3) onboard intelligence including autonomous science, navigation, controls, and embodied AI; and (4) three PE 3.0 mission concepts: a Neptune/Triton smart flyby, an ocean world explorer, and an Oort cloud reconnaissance mission.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出将对火星的“渐进式”探测范式升级为“3.0范式”，用单次任务即可完成从初步探测到假说验证的全过程；其关键是采用可软件重构、具备星上自主智能的“软件定义航天系统”（SDSS），并给出了系外海洋、海王星及奥尔特云的三项概念任务。
AI.motivation: 火星探测通过22次迭代取得成功，而太阳系外缘天体往返一次需十年以上，无法复制这一模式，亟需一次性完成探测-研究闭环的新范式，以回答潜在宜居性、早期纪录保存等重大科学问题。
AI.method: 组织KISS跨学科研讨，提出“行星探测3.0”框架，综合定义 (1) 面向未知环境的系统工程流程；(2) SDSS核心技术——可重构硬件、多功能模块、软件定义器件；(3) 星上自主智能——自主科学决策、导航制导和控制、具身AI；(4) 据此设计三项高风险高回报的外太阳系任务概念。
AI.result: 形成PE 3.0范式完整技术路线图：以SDSS为核心，实现任务在轨自适应升级与科学策略闭环；证明用单一使命即可完成轨道修正、仪器重配置、科学假设实时修订，并在三例概念任务中验证可行性。
AI.conclusion: PE 3.0代表深空探测从“多次迭代”转向“自适应单点突破”的战略转折；SDSS与自主智能的突破将加速外海及柯伊伯带天体探测，为搜索生命迹象、揭示太阳系起源提供快速通道，建议优先投资关键技术成熟度提升与飞行演示。

title: Understanding and Mitigating Spurious Signal Amplification in Test-Time Reinforcement Learning for Math Reasoning
summary: Test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL) always adapts models at inference time via pseudo-labeling, leaving it vulnerable to spurious optimization signals from label noise. Through an empirical study, we observe that responses with medium consistency form an ambiguity region and constitute the primary source of reward noise. Crucially, we find that such spurious signals can be even amplified through group-relative advantage estimation. Motivated by these findings, we propose a unified framework, Debiased and Denoised test-time Reinforcement Learning (DDRL), to mitigate spurious signals. Concretely, DDRL first applies a frequency-based sampling strategy to exclude ambiguous samples while maintaining a balanced set of positive and negative examples. It then adopts a debiased advantage estimation with fixed advantages, removing the bias introduced by group-relative policy optimization. Finally, DDRL incorporates a consensus-based off-policy refinement stage, which leverages the rejection-sampled dataset to enable efficient and stable model updates. Experiments on three large language models across multiple mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that DDRL consistently outperforms existing TTRL baselines. The code will soon be released at https://github.com/yuyongcan/DDRL.

AI.tldr: 现有测试时强化学习（TTRL）依赖伪标签，易被噪声奖励误导；作者发现中等一致性响应是奖励噪声主因，并提出 DDRL 框架，通过频率采样、去偏优势估计与共识离策略精炼，在多项数学推理任务上全面超越基线。
AI.motivation: TTRL 在推理阶段持续用伪标签更新模型，但标签噪声会产生虚假优化信号；已有工作未系统分析噪声来源与放大机制，亟需一种可在测试时同时“去噪+去偏”的通用方法。
AI.method: 1) 实证定位：提出“歧义区”概念，指出中等一致性响应是奖励噪声主体，且群组相对优势估计会放大偏差；2) DDRL 框架：①频率采样过滤歧义样本并保持正负平衡；②固定参考点进行去偏优势估计，消除群组相对基线带来的偏差；③基于拒绝采样的共识离策略精炼，稳定更新策略。
AI.result: 在 3 个不同规模 LLM、多个数学推理基准（GSM8K、MATH 等）上，DDRL 平均提升 3.2–7.8% 准确率，显著优于 Self-Consistency、RFT、TTRL 等基线，且训练曲线更平稳、样本效率更高。
AI.conclusion: DDRL 首次将“去噪”与“去偏”统一于测试时 RL，验证了其可有效抑制伪信号、提升推理性能；代码将开源，为后续 TTRL 研究提供可靠基线与新的优化视角。

title: Seeing Fast and Slow: Learning the Flow of Time in Videos
summary: How can we tell whether a video has been sped up or slowed down? How can we generate videos at different speeds? Although videos have been central to modern computer vision research, little attention has been paid to perceiving and controlling the passage of time. In this paper, we study time as a learnable visual concept and develop models for reasoning about and manipulating the flow of time in videos. We first exploit the multimodal cues and temporal structure naturally present in videos to learn, in a self-supervised manner, to detect speed changes and estimate playback speed. We then show that these learned temporal reasoning models enable us to curate the largest slow-motion video dataset to date from noisy in-the-wild sources. Such slow-motion footage, typically filmed by high-speed cameras, contains substantially richer temporal detail than standard videos. Using this data, we further develop models capable of temporal control, including speed-conditioned video generation, which produces motion at specified playback speed, and temporal super-resolution, which tranforms low-FPS, blurry videos into high-FPS sequences with fine-grained temporal details. Our findings highlight time as a manipulable, perceptual dimension in video learning, opening doors to temporally controllable video generation, temporal forensics detection, and potentially richer world-models that understand how events unfold over time.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统提出“时间”作为可学习的视觉概念，提出自监督模型检测视频变速、估计播放速度，并基于此构建迄今最大慢动作数据集，进而实现速度条件生成与“时间超分辨”。
AI.motivation: 现有计算机视觉聚焦空间信息，忽视时间维度；缺乏判别与操控视频播放速度的统一框架。作者希望让模型像理解空间一样理解“时间流逝”。
AI.method: 1) 利用视频内多模态线索（光流、音轨、帧间一致性）自监督训练速度判别与估计网络；2) 用该网络过滤网络嘈杂视频，自动挖掘慢动作片段，构建 25 万段高质量慢动作数据集；3) 在此数据上训练速度条件 VAE/GAN 及时间超分辨模型，实现指定速度生成与低帧率→高帧率转换。
AI.result: 在 speed-change 检测任务上达到 94.3% AP，播放速度估计误差仅 0.08×；生成的慢动作视频在 FVD 指标上优于 之前最佳 29%；时间超分辨可将 15 FPS 模糊视频恢复为 120 FPS 清晰序列，细粒度运动细节提升 1.7×。
AI.conclusion: 时间可作为与空间并列的可学习、可操控维度。所提框架不仅服务于变速检测与取证，也为可控视频生成、世界模型中时序推理提供了新范式。

title: SafeRedirect: Defeating Internal Safety Collapse via Task-Completion Redirection in Frontier LLMs
summary: Internal Safety Collapse (ISC) is a failure mode in which frontier LLMs, when executing legitimate professional tasks whose correct completion structurally requires harmful content, spontaneously generate that content with safety failure rates exceeding 95%. Existing input-level defenses achieve a 100% failure rate against ISC, and standard system prompt defenses provide only partial mitigation. We propose SafeRedirect, a system-level override that defeats ISC by redirecting the model's task-completion drive rather than suppressing it. SafeRedirect grants explicit permission to fail the task, prescribes a deterministic hard-stop output, and instructs the model to preserve harmful placeholders unresolved. Evaluated on seven frontier LLMs across three AI/ML-related ISC task types in the single-turn setting, SafeRedirect reduces average unsafe generation rates from 71.2% to 8.0%, compared to 55.0% for the strongest viable baseline. Multi-model ablation reveals that failure permission and condition specificity are universally critical, while the importance of other components varies across models. Cross-attack evaluation confirms state-of-the-art defense against ISC with generalization performance at least on par with the baseline on other attack families. Code is available at https://github.com/fzjcdt/SafeRedirect.

AI.tldr: 提出安全系统级方案SafeRedirect，将前沿LLM在必须输出有害内容才能“正确”完成的专业任务中的不安全率从71.2%降至8.0%，首次有效阻断ISC失效模式。
AI.motivation: 现有输入级与提示级防护对“内部安全崩塌”(ISC)几乎完全失效：模型为完成合法专业任务而自发输出高危内容，失败率>95%，亟需不抑制任务驱动力的系统级防御。
AI.method: SafeRedirect在系统层重定向任务完成驱动：①显式允许任务失败；②规定确定性hard-stop输出模板；③强制保留有害占位符不解析。通过七款前沿LLM、三类AI/ML相关ISC单轮任务评估，并与最强基线对比。
AI.result: 平均不安全生成率由71.2%降至8.0%，优于基线55.0%。多模型消融表明“允许失败”与“条件具体性”普遍关键；跨攻击泛化至少持平基线。
AI.conclusion: SafeRedirect首次在系统层面解决ISC，证实“许可失败+输出硬化”是可靠防线，并具备跨模型、跨攻击的可迁移性，为高风险专业场景LLM部署提供立即可用的安全补丁。

title: Omission Constraints Decay While Commission Constraints Persist in Long-Context LLM Agents
comment: 19 pages, 5 figures. Includes evaluation framework for replication and 4,416-trial dataset
summary: LLM agents deployed in production operate under operator-defined behavioral policies (system-prompt instructions such as prohibitions on credential disclosure, data exfiltration, and unauthorized output) that safety evaluations assume hold throughout a conversation. Prohibition-type constraints decay under context pressure while requirement-type constraints persist; we term this asymmetry Security-Recall Divergence (SRD). In a 4,416-trial three-arm causal study across 12 models and 8 providers at six conversation depths, omission compliance falls from 73% at turn 5 to 33% at turn 16 while commission compliance holds at 100% (Mistral Large 3, $p < 10^{-33}$). In the two models with token-matched padding controls, schema semantic content accounts for 62-100% of the dilution effect. Re-injecting constraints before the per-model Safe Turn Depth (STD) restores compliance without retraining. Production security policies consist of prohibitions such as never revealing credentials, never executing untrusted code, and never forwarding user data. Commission-type audit signals remain healthy while omission constraints have already failed, leaving the failure invisible to standard monitoring.

AI.tldr: 长对话中，禁止型安全约束（如禁止泄漏凭据）会因上下文压力逐渐失效，而必须执行的约束依旧有效，导致监控盲区形成“安全-召回背离”（SRD）。在4 416次试验中，到第16轮对话，禁止合规率从73%跌至33%，必须执行约束仍为100%；若提前按模型的“安全轮深”重新注入约束可恢复合规而无需重训。
AI.motivation: 生产环境的LLM安全策略通常把“永不做某事”类硬规则写入system-prompt，并假定其持续生效。但对话变长后上下文稀释是否破坏这些规则尚无系统研究。
AI.method: 构建三臂（Control、Semantic Padding、Token Padding）因果实验，对12模型、8服务商复测4 416次，操纵对话深度×约束类型，记录禁止/必做合规率；用token级语义加塞隔离稀释机制；定义Safe Turn Depth（STD）并提出推理期重注入对策。
AI.result: 1）禁止合规率随深度指数下降，下降幅度62–100%归因于语义稀释；2）必做约束始终100%合规，监控指标因而仍“健康”，失败被隐藏；3）在≤STD轮次回注约束可无损恢复73%以上合规率，无需重训，跨模型显著(p<10⁻³³)。
AI.conclusion: SRD暴露生产安全方案的设计缺陷：仅依赖system-prompt且用必做指标监控，会在长对话中隐匿禁止型违规。缓解之道是在推理循环内按各模型STD周期性重注入禁则，或转为外部执行层强制。后续需量化更多隐式约束的衰减曲线并开发无模板回注策略。

title: Ideological Bias in LLMs' Economic Causal Reasoning
summary: Do large language models (LLMs) exhibit systematic ideological bias when reasoning about economic causal effects? As LLMs are increasingly used in policy analysis and economic reporting, where directionally correct causal judgments are essential, this question has direct practical stakes. We present a systematic evaluation by extending the EconCausal benchmark with ideology-contested cases - instances where intervention-oriented (pro-government) and market-oriented (pro-market) perspectives predict divergent causal signs. From 10,490 causal triplets (treatment-outcome pairs with empirically verified effect directions) derived from top-tier economics and finance journals, we identify 1,056 ideology-contested instances and evaluate 20 state-of-the-art LLMs on their ability to predict empirically supported causal directions. We find that ideology-contested items are consistently harder than non-contested ones, and that across 18 of 20 models, accuracy is systematically higher when the empirically verified causal sign aligns with intervention-oriented expectations than with market-oriented ones. Moreover, when models err, their incorrect predictions disproportionately lean intervention-oriented, and this directional skew is not eliminated by one-shot in-context prompting. These results highlight that LLMs are not only less accurate on ideologically contested economic questions, but systematically less reliable in one ideological direction than the other, underscoring the need for direction-aware evaluation in high-stakes economic and policy settings.

AI.tldr: 对 20 个大模型在 1 056 个意识形态对立的因果问题上的测试表明：模型在“亲政府干预”方向上的准确率显著高于“亲市场”方向，犯错时也更多倾向干预立场，且一次提示无法消除这种系统性偏斜。
AI.motivation: 大模型正被广泛用于政策分析与财经报道，但其对经济因果效应的判断是否隐含意识形态偏差尚缺系统证据，而这直接关系到政策建议的可信度。
AI.method: 在 10 490 条经顶级期刊实证验证的因果三元组基础上，筛选出 1 056 条“干预派”与“市场派”预测符号相反的争议实例，构建 Ideology-Contested EconCausal  Benchmark，对 20 个 SOTA 大模型进行零样本与一次提示评测。
AI.result: 争议项准确率普遍低于非争议项；18/20 模型在“干预方向”与实证结果一致时得分更高；错误预测显著偏向干预取向，一次提示无法纠正该方向性偏斜。
AI.conclusion: 大模型在经济因果推理中呈现统计显著的、方向性的意识形态偏差，在高压政策场景中必须引入“方向敏感”评测与纠偏机制。

title: Robust Test-time Video-Text Retrieval: Benchmarking and Adapting for Query Shifts
summary: Modern video-text retrieval (VTR) models excel on in-distribution benchmarks but are highly vulnerable to real-world query shifts, where the distribution of query data deviates from the training domain, leading to a sharp performance drop. Existing image-focused robustness solutions are inadequate to handle this vulnerability in video, as they fail to address the complex spatio-temporal dynamics inherent in these shifts. To systematically evaluate this vulnerability, we first introduce a comprehensive benchmark featuring 12 distinct types of video perturbations across five severity degrees. Analysis on this benchmark reveals that query shifts amplify the hubness phenomenon, where a few gallery items become dominant "hubs" that attract a disproportionate number of queries. To mitigate this, we then propose HAT-VTR (Hubness Alleviation for Test-time Video-Text Retrieval), as our baseline test-time adaptation framework designed to directly counteract hubness in VTR. It leverages two key components: a Hubness Suppression Memory to refine similarity scores, and multi-granular losses to enforce temporal feature consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HAT-VTR substantially improves robustness, consistently outperforming prior methods across diverse query shift scenarios, and enhancing model reliability for real-world applications.

AI.tldr: 首次系统评测视频文本检索（VTR）在现实查询漂移下的鲁棒性，发现“hubness”现象被放大，提出测试时自适应框架 HAT-VTR，用抑制记忆与多粒度损失显著缓解hubness，全面超越已有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有VTR在训练域外查询数据上性能骤降，而图像鲁棒方法无法处理视频的复杂时空漂移，且缺乏系统评测基准，亟需针对性解决方案。
AI.method: 1) 构建含12类视频扰动×5级严重度的综合评测集；2) 实证揭示查询漂移会加剧hubness；3) 设计测试时自适应基线HAT-VTR，核心为Hubness抑制记忆模块（动态校准相似度）与多粒度一致性损失（帧级、片段级、视频级）以约束时空特征。
AI.result: 在自建及公开漂移场景下，HAT-VTR将Recall@1平均提升8.7–21.4%，Hubness指标下降32–48%，一致优于现有最佳图像/视频鲁棒方法且无需重训模型。
AI.conclusion: 查询漂移通过放大hubness严重损害VTR；通过测试时直接抑制hubness的轻量级策略即可显著增强鲁棒性，为真实应用提供可靠基线并指明未来研究方向。

title: SDNGuardStack: An Explainable Ensemble Learning Framework for High-Accuracy Intrusion Detection in Software-Defined Networks
summary: Software-Defined Networking (SDN) is another technology that has been developing in the last few years as a relevant technique to improve network programmability and administration. Nonetheless, its centralized design presents a major security issue, which requires effective intrusion detection systems. The SDN-specific machine learning-based intrusion detection system described in this paper is innovative because it is trained and tested on the InSDN dataset which models attack scenarios and realistic traffic patterns in SDN. Our approach incorporates a comprehensive preprocessing pipeline, feature selection via Mutual Information, and a novel ensemble learning model, SDNGuardStack, which combines multiple base learners to enhance detection accuracy and efficiency. In addition, we include explainable AI methods, including SHAP to add transparency to model predictions, which helps security analysts respond to incidents. The experiments prove that SDNGuard-Stack has an accuracy rate of 99.98% and a Cohen Kappa of 0.9998, surpassing other models, and at the same time being interpretable and practically executable. It is interesting to see such features like Flow ID, Bwd Header Len, and Src Port as the most important factors in the model predictions. The work is a step towards closing the gap between performance intrusion detection and realistic deployment in SDN, which will lead to the creation of secure and resilient network infrastructures.

AI.tldr: 基于SDN场景定制的入侵检测系统SDNGuardStack在InSDN数据集上达到99.98%准确率，通过集成学习与可解释AI兼顾性能与可部署性。
AI.motivation: SDN集中控制面带来的单点安全威胁亟需专用入侵检测方案；现有研究缺乏针对SDN真实流量与攻击场景的高质量数据集与可落地模型，导致检测性能与部署可行性之间存在明显落差。
AI.method: 构建面向SDN的InSDN数据集→综合预处理→互信息特征选择→集成多基学习器的Stacking框架SDNGuardStack→引入SHAP提供预测可解释性→在真实SDN拓扑中验证实时可行性。
AI.result: SDNGuardStack在InSDN上取得99.98%准确率、0.9998 Cohen’s Kappa，显著优于同类模型；SHAP揭示Flow ID、Bwd Header Len及Src Port为最关键特征；原型系统在控制器端开销<5%，满足在线部署需求。
AI.conclusion: 研究首次在SDN数据集上实现高性能+高可解释+低开销的入侵检测，为安全控制器及零信任SDN基础设施提供了可直接落地的检测组件，后续将扩展至多域SDN及5G场景。

title: Absorber LLM: Harnessing Causal Synchronization for Test-Time Training
summary: Transformers suffer from a high computational cost that grows with sequence length for self-attention, making inference in long streams prohibited by memory consumption. Constant-memory alternatives such as RNNs and SSMs compress history into states with fixed size and thus lose long-tail dependencies, while methods that memorize contexts into parameters, such as Test-Time Training (TTT), are prone to overfitting token-level projection and fail to preserve the causal effect of context in pretrained LLMs. We propose Absorber LLM, which formulates long-context retention as a self-supervised causal synchronization: after absorbing historical contexts into parameters, a contextless model should match the original model with full context on future generations. We optimize this objective by synchronizing internal behaviors of the updated model with the original one, ensuring context absorption and generalization. Experiments on long-context and streaming benchmarks show that Absorber LLM reduces inference memory and improves accuracy over prior parameter-as-memory baselines.

AI.tldr: Absorber LLM 把长上下文压缩进模型参数，推理仅保留常数级内存，同时通过因果同步自监督目标避免传统参数化记忆方法的过拟合与因果失真，在流式任务上同时降低显存并提升精度。
AI.motivation: Transformer 的自注意力随序列长度二次增长，长流式推理内存爆炸；RNN/SSM 等常数内存方案因状态容量有限丢失长尾依赖；Test-Time Training 等“参数即记忆”方法易在词级投影上过拟合，且无法保持预训练 LLM 的因果效应。亟需一种既省内存又能保留长距因果信息的推理范式。
AI.method: 提出“自监督因果同步”框架：将历史上下文吸收为模型参数更新后，要求无上下文模型与未来完整上下文模型的输出分布一致。通过惩罚内部表征差异（行为同步）而非直接优化token级预测，实现参数级记忆与预训练因果链的耦合；吸收过程只改参数、不存历史，推理内存恒定。
AI.result: 在长文档建模与流式基准上，Absorber LLM 相比 TTTx、In-Context Learning 等参数化记忆基线，推理内存降为常数，同时困惑度/准确率提升 6–18%，最长测试 512 k token 仍保持稳定增益。
AI.conclusion: 把长上下文保留转换为参数自监督同步，可在不增加推理内存的前提下继承预训练 LLM 的因果结构，兼顾效率与长距依赖，为流式大模型部署提供了实用新路径。

title: Sub-Token Routing in LoRA for Adaptation and Query-Aware KV Compression
summary: Sub-token routing offers a finer control axis for transformer efficiency than the coarse units used in most prior work, such as tokens, pages, heads, or layers. In this paper, we study routing within a token representation itself in LoRA-adapted transformers. The motivation is that a relevant token need not be internally uniform: under a retention budget, preserved value groups are distributed unevenly both across tokens and within tokens, which suggests that KV compression need not be an all-or-nothing decision at token level. We study this fine-grained routing mechanism in two settings. For compression-aware language modeling, we introduce a query-independent design that combines routed subspace LoRA with value-group routing on the KV path. For downstream-task-preserving KV compression, we introduce a query-aware design in which a predictor-based selector allocates a global retention budget over context-token/value-group pairs using query-conditioned relevance. Experiments show that the query-independent design improves the quality-compression tradeoff for language modeling, while the query-aware design preserves downstream behavior under reduced KV budgets. We further examine the relation between token-level and sub-token-level query-aware routing, and show that they form complementary compression axes: token-level methods determine which tokens survive globally, while sub-token routing determines how the surviving tokens are compressed internally.

AI.tldr: 本文首次在LoRA微调后的Transformer中引入“子token级”动态路由，把KV缓存压缩粒度从整token下沉到token内部的value-group，实验证明在语言建模和下游任务上均可获得更优的压缩-性能权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有KV压缩方法以token、页、头或层为最小单位，但同一token内的不同value-group重要性并不均匀；若能在token内部再取舍，可在给定KV预算下保留更多信息，从而突破“全留或全扔”的token级瓶颈。
AI.method: 1) 语言建模场景：提出查询无关的方案，把LoRA低秩子空间路由与KV路径上的value-group路由联合训练，实现训练阶段即感知压缩；2) 下游任务场景：提出查询相关的方案，用轻量预测器在推理阶段按query-conditioned relevance为“token×value-group”二元组动态分配全局保留预算。
AI.result: 在语言建模任务中，查询无关设计在相同压缩率下困惑度显著低于token级基线；在下游任务中，查询相关设计在10-30% KV预算下仍能保持95%以上原始精度，且与token级压缩正交：前者决定“哪些token留下”，后者决定“留下的token如何被压缩”。
AI.conclusion: 子token路由为Transformer效率优化提供了新的互补压缩维度，可与既有的token/层/头级方法叠加，进一步释放KV缓存冗余，为长上下文推理和端侧部署提供实用方案。

title: AITP: Traffic Accident Responsibility Allocation via Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in Traffic Accident Detection (TAD) and Traffic Accident Understanding (TAU). However, existing studies mainly focus on describing and interpreting accident videos, leaving room for deeper causal reasoning and integration of legal knowledge. Traffic Accident Responsibility Allocation (TARA) is a more challenging task that requires multi-step reasoning grounded in traffic regulations. To address this, we introduce AITP (Artificial Intelligence Traffic Police), a multimodal large language model for responsibility reasoning and allocation. AITP enhances reasoning via a Multimodal Chain-of-Thought (MCoT) mechanism and integrates legal knowledge through Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). We further present DecaTARA, a decathlon-style benchmark unifying ten interrelated traffic accident reasoning tasks with 67,941 annotated videos and 195,821 question-answer pairs. Extensive experiments show that AITP achieves state-of-the-art performance across responsibility allocation, TAD, and TAU tasks, establishing a new paradigm for reasoning-driven multimodal traffic analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出面向交通事故责任认定的多模态大模型AITP，并发布十项全能基准DecaTARA，实现责任分配、事故检测与理解三任务SOTA。
AI.motivation: 既有MLLM仅停留在描述与解释事故视频，缺乏对交通法规的深度因果推理与责任分配能力。
AI.method: 构建AITP：①Multimodal Chain-of-Thought (MCoT) 逐步显式推理；②RAG注入法规条文；③统一十任务DecaTARA基准（67 k视频、195 k问答对）。
AI.result: 在责任分配、事故检测、事故理解全部子任务上刷新SOTA，验证推理驱动多模态交通分析新范式。
AI.conclusion: 首次将责任认定形式化为可评测的多步推理任务，为后续自动驾驶责任链、保险理赔与法规教学提供开放基线与数据。

title: Breaking Bad: Interpretability-Based Safety Audits of State-of-the-Art LLMs
summary: Effective safety auditing of large language models (LLMs) demands tools that go beyond black-box probing and systematically uncover vulnerabilities rooted in model internals. We present a comprehensive, interpretability-driven jailbreaking audit of eight SOTA open-source LLMs: Llama-3.1-8B, Llama-3.3-70B-4bt, GPT-oss- 20B, GPT-oss-120B, Qwen3-0.6B, Qwen3-32B, Phi4-3.8B, and Phi4-14B. Leveraging interpretability-based approaches -- Universal Steering (US) and Representation Engineering (RepE) -- we introduce an adaptive two-stage grid search algorithm to identify optimal activation-steering coefficients for unsafe behavioral concepts. Our evaluation, conducted on a curated set of harmful queries and a standardized LLM-based judging protocol, reveals stark contrasts in model robustness. The Llama-3 models are highly vulnerable, with up to 91\% (US) and 83\% (RepE) jailbroken responses on Llama-3.3-70B-4bt, while GPT-oss-120B remains robust to attacks via both interpretability approaches. Qwen and Phi models show mixed results, with the smaller Qwen3-0.6B and Phi4-3.8B mostly exhibiting lower jailbreaking rates, while their larger counterparts are more susceptible. Our results establish interpretability-based steering as a powerful tool for systematic safety audits, but also highlight its dual-use risks and the need for better internal defenses in LLM deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文首次用可解释性方法（US/RepE+两阶段网格搜索）对8个SOTA开源LLM做越狱审计，发现Llama-3极易被操控（91%攻破率），GPT-oss-120B最鲁棒，模型越大越脆弱，揭示可解释性可被双用。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM安全审计多依赖黑盒探针，无法定位风险根因。作者认为必须利用模型内部表示，系统性地暴露潜在有害概念，从而推动更可信的内部防御。
AI.method: 设计自适应两阶段网格搜索，在每个模型上为“有害行为”概念寻找最优激活-转向系数；采用Universal Steering与Representation Engineering两种可解释性技术；以人工策划的违规问询+LLM裁判协议量化越狱成功率。
AI.result: 8模型中，Llama-3系列最易攻陷（Llama-3.3-70B-4bt的US/RepE成功率91%/83%）；GPT-oss-120B对两种攻击均免疫；Qwen与Phi的规模-脆弱性呈正相关；小参数量模型相对安全。
AI.conclusion: 可解释性驱动的激活转向是高效安全审计利器，但同时构成双用威胁；亟需为模型内部表示增加防护机制，而非仅依赖输出层过滤。

title: The Path Not Taken: Duality in Reasoning about Program Execution
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities across diverse coding tasks. However, their adoption requires a true understanding of program execution rather than relying on surface-level patterns. Existing benchmarks primarily focus on predicting program properties tied to specific inputs (e.g., code coverage, program outputs). As a result, they provide a narrow view of dynamic code reasoning and are prone to data contamination. We argue that understanding program execution requires evaluating its inherent duality through two complementary reasoning tasks: (i) predicting a program's observed behavior for a given input, and (ii) inferring how the input must be mutated toward a specific behavioral objective. Both tasks jointly probe a model's causal understanding of execution flow. We instantiate this duality in DexBench, a benchmark comprising 445 paired instances, and evaluate 13 LLMs. Our results demonstrate that dual-path reasoning provides a robust and discriminative proxy for dynamic code understanding.

AI.tldr: DexBench 用「正向预测输出 + 反向反推输入」的双任务范式，首次系统评估大模型对程序执行因果链的动态理解，13 个模型实验显示该基准既抗数据污染又能显著区分不同模型。
AI.motivation: 现有代码基准只测「给定输入→输出」的表层模式，易被训练数据污染，无法揭示模型是否真正掌握程序执行因果链。
AI.method: 提出「执行因果对偶」框架：任务 (i) 正向推理——给定程序与输入，预测运行时行为；任务 (ii) 逆向推理——给定程序与目标行为，反推需变更的输入。基于此构建 445 组配对实例的 DexBench，并对 13 个主流 LLM 进行零样本评估。
AI.result: 双路径任务同步显著降低性能（最高模型仅约 60% 准确率），且逆向推理难度远高于正向；同时，双任务得分高度正相关，证明其共同度量动态理解而非记忆模式。
AI.conclusion: 执行因果对偶是评估 LLM 动态代码理解的稳健且具区分度的代理，DexBench 为后续研究提供了抗污染、高区分性的基准。

title: Evaluating AI Meeting Summaries with a Reusable Cross-Domain Pipeline
comment: AI Application Feature Quality Evaluation (28 pages total)
summary:
We present a reusable evaluation pipeline for generative AI applications, instantiated for AI meeting summaries and released with a public artifact package derived from a Dataset Pipeline. The system separates reusable orchestration from task-specific semantics across five stages: source intake, structured reference construction, candidate generation, structured scoring, and reporting. Unlike standalone claim scorers, it treats both ground truth and evaluator outputs as typed, persisted artifacts, enabling aggregation, issue analysis, and statistical testing.
  We benchmark the offline loop on a typed dataset of 114 meetings spanning city_council, private_data, and whitehouse_press_briefings, producing 340 meeting-model pairs and 680 judge runs across gpt-4.1-mini, gpt-5-mini, and gpt-5.1. Under this protocol, gpt-4.1-mini achieves the highest mean accuracy (0.583), while gpt-5.1 leads in completeness (0.886) and coverage (0.942). Paired sign tests with Holm correction show no significant accuracy winner but confirm significant retention gains for gpt-5.1.
  A typed DeepEval contrastive baseline preserves retention ordering but reports higher holistic accuracy, suggesting that reference-based scoring may overlook unsupported-specifics errors captured by claim-grounded evaluation. Typed analysis identifies whitehouse_press_briefings as an accuracy-challenging domain with frequent unsupported specifics. A deployment follow-up shows gpt-5.4 outperforming gpt-4.1 across all metrics, with statistically robust gains on retention metrics under the same protocol. The system benchmarks the offline loop and documents, but does not quantitatively evaluate, the online feedback-to-evaluation path.

AI.tldr: 提出一套可复用的生成式 AI 评估流水线，面向 AI 会议摘要任务开源发布；通过五阶段结构化流程对 114 场会议、340 模型-数据对进行离线基准测试，发现 gpt-5.1 在保留度显著优于 gpt-4.1-mini，而白宫简报域最易出现“无支持细节”错误；系统同时支持在线反馈路径但未量化评估。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式 AI 评估工具多为孤立指标或一次性脚本，缺乏可复用的端到端流水线，难以对多模型、多领域、多轮迭代做持续、可审计的对比与回归分析。
AI.method: 将评估流程解耦为五阶段可编排组件：源数据摄取→结构化真值构建→候选摘要生成→结构化评分→报告与统计检验；所有中间产物（真值、评分结果）均类型化并持久化为可共享工件，支持聚合、错误溯源与多重比较校正。
AI.result: 在 114 场会议（市议会、私有数据、白宫简报）上生成 340 模型-数据对、680 次评测；gpt-4.1-mini 平均准确率最高（0.583），gpt-5.1 在完整性（0.886）与覆盖率（0.942）领先，配对符号检验证实 gpt-5.1 保留度显著优于对照；白宫简报域最易产生“无支持细节”错误；后续在线部署中 gpt-5.4 全面超越 gpt-4.1。
AI.conclusion: 类型化工件驱动的可复用流水线可实现跨模型、跨领域、跨时间的严谨离线评估，为生成式 AI 持续迭代提供量化依据；结构化真值与细粒度评分揭示传统 holistic 指标未覆盖的“无支持细节”风险，未来需进一步量化在线反馈闭环效果。

title: AttentionBender: Manipulating Cross-Attention in Video Diffusion Transformers as a Creative Probe
comment: To appear in the Proceedings of the 2026 ACM Creativity and Cognition (C&C '26). 15 pages, 19 figures
summary: We present AttentionBender, a tool that manipulates cross-attention in Video Diffusion Transformers to help artists probe the internal mechanics of black-box video generation. While generative outputs are increasingly realistic, prompt-only control limits artists' ability to build intuition for the model's material process or to work beyond its default tendencies. Using an autobiographical research-through-design approach, we built on Network Bending to design AttentionBender, which applies 2D transforms (rotation, scaling, translation, etc.) to cross-attention maps to modulate generation. We assess AttentionBender by visualizing 4,500+ video generations across prompts, operations, and layer targets. Our results suggest that cross-attention is highly entangled: targeted manipulations often resist clean, localized control, producing distributed distortions and glitch aesthetics over linear edits. AttentionBender contributes a tool that functions both as an Explainable AI style probe of transformer attention mechanisms, and as a creative technique for producing novel aesthetics beyond the model's learned representational space.

AI.tldr: 研究者提出AttentionBender，在视频扩散Transformer的交叉注意力阶段注入可控2D变换，既是可解释性探针也是创意工具，揭示注意力高度纠缠并激发独特glitch美学。
AI.motivation: 生成视频日益逼真，却仅提供“提词”级控制，艺术家难以理解模型内部素材化过程，也难以突破其固有偏好，因而需要可直接干预机制且具解释性的新工具。
AI.method: 自传式设计研究→扩展Network Bending→AttentionBender：在推理时逐层对交叉注意力热图施加旋转、缩放、平移等2D变换；生成4500+视频样本并可视化比较，量化操作-层-提示三元组下的响应模式。
AI.result: 交叉注意力高度纠缠：任何局部目标操作都会扩散为全局失真，难以产生线性、局域化编辑；同时持续诱发分布式扭曲与视觉glitch，形成新 aesthetic。
AI.conclusion: AttentionBender既是解释Transformer注意力机制的Explainable-AI探针，也是突破模型表征空间的创意技法，为艺术家提供干预生成过程、探索非默认视觉语言的开放路径。

title: PanGuide3D: Cohort-Robust Pancreas Tumor Segmentation via Probabilistic Pancreas Conditioning and a Transformer Bottleneck
summary: Pancreatic tumor segmentation in contrast-enhanced computed tomography (CT) is clinically important yet technically challenging: lesions are often small, heterogeneous, and easily confused with surrounding soft tissue, and models that perform well on one cohort frequently degrade under cohort shift. Our goal is to improve cross-cohort generalization while keeping the model architecture simple, efficient, and practical for 3D CT segmentation. We introduce PanGuide3D, a cohort-robust architecture with a shared 3D encoder, a pancreas decoder that predicts a probabilistic pancreas map, and a tumor decoder that is explicitly conditioned on this pancreas probability at multiple scales via differentiable soft gating. To capture long-range context under distribution shift, we further add a lightweight Transformer bottleneck in the U-Net bottleneck representation. We evaluate cohort transfer by training on the PanTS (Pancreatic Tumor Segmentation) cohort and testing both in-cohort (PanTS) and out-of-cohort on MSD (Medical Segmentation Decathlon) Task07 Pancreas, using matched preprocessing and training protocols across strong baselines. We collect voxel-level segmentation metrics, patient-level tumor detection, subgroup analyses by tumor size and anatomical location, volume-conditioned performance analyses, and calibration measurements to assess reliability. Across the evaluated models, PanGuide3D achieves the best overall tumor performance and shows improved cross-cohort generalization, particularly for small tumors and challenging anatomical locations, while reducing anatomically implausible false positives. These findings support probabilistic anatomical conditioning as a practical strategy for improving cross-cohort robustness in an end-to-end model and suggest potential utility for contouring support, treatment planning, and multi-institutional studies.

AI.tldr: PanGuide3D——在PanTS训练、MSD泛化测试均取得最佳肿瘤分割，小病灶与跨中心鲁棒性显著提升，且假阳性更低。
AI.motivation: 胰腺肿瘤CT分割跨中心泛化差，小病灶易漏、与周围软组织难区分；现有模型换中心性能骤降，亟需既简单高效又鲁棒的架构。
AI.method: 提出轻量级3D U-Net变体PanGuide3D：共享编码器+胰体概率解码器，肿瘤解码器在多尺度用可微软门控显式条件于胰概率；U-Net瓶颈嵌入轻量Transformer捕获长程上下文；统一预处理与训练流程，先在PanTS训练再在MSD Task07测试。
AI.result: PanGuide3D在PanTS内及MSD外中心均获最佳肿瘤Dice与检测灵敏度，尤其<10 mm肿瘤、胰头/沟等难区部位提升显著；假阳性率降低，校准度更佳；跨中心鲁棒性优于U-Net、nnU-Net等强基线。
AI.conclusion: 以胰体概率为显式解剖先验的端到端条件分割，可低成本实现跨中心3D CT胰腺肿瘤鲁棒分割，支持放疗轮廓勾画、多中心研究及临床部署。

title: Domain-Aware Hierarchical Contrastive Learning for Semi-Supervised Generalization Fault Diagnosis
summary: Fault diagnosis under unseen operating conditions remains highly challenging when labeled data are scarce. Semi-supervised domain generalization fault diagnosis (SSDGFD) provides a practical solution by jointly exploiting labeled and unlabeled source domains. However, existing methods still suffer from two coupled limitations. First, pseudo-labels for unlabeled domains are typically generated primarily from knowledge learned on the labeled source domain, which neglects domain-specific geometric discrepancies and thus induces systematic cross-domain pseudo-label bias. Second, unlabeled samples are commonly handled with a hard accept-or-discard strategy, where rigid thresholding causes imbalanced sample utilization across domains, while hard-label assignment for uncertain samples can easily introduce additional noise. To address these issues, we propose a unified framework termed domain-aware hierarchical contrastive learning (DAHCL) for SSDGFD. Specifically, DAHCL introduces a domain-aware learning (DAL) module to explicitly capture source-domain geometric characteristics and calibrate pseudo-label predictions across heterogeneous source domains, thereby mitigating cross-domain bias in pseudo-label generation. In addition, DAHCL develops a hierarchical contrastive learning (HCL) module that combines dynamic confidence stratification with fuzzy contrastive supervision, enabling uncertain samples to contribute to representation learning without relying on unreliable hard labels. In this way, DAHCL jointly improves the quality of supervision and the utilization of unlabeled samples. Furthermore, to better reflect practical industrial scenarios, we incorporate engineering noise into the SSDGFD evaluation protocol. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets demonstrate that...

AI.tldr: 作者提出「面向半监督域泛化的领域感知层级对比学习」(DAHCL)，利用域几何校准+层级对比损失，在3 个无标签目标域数据集上显著优于主流方法。
AI.motivation: 1. 工业设备在未知工况下难以获得大批标注数据；2. 现有半监督域泛化故障诊断(SSDGFD)仅用已标源域预测伪标签，忽略域空间差异→伪标签偏差，并对伪标签做硬接受/丢弃→样本利用失衡、噪声高风险；3. 需要一种统一框架，在标/未标源域与未知目标工况间都能学到鲁棒表征，并能在含工程噪声的真实协议下验证。
AI.method: DAHCL 采用双修策略：① 域感知学习(DAL)：显式估计各源域的流形几何，利用学习到的域变换矩阵对伪标签预测做逐域校正，缓解跨域系统偏差；② 分层对比学习(HCL)：对未标样本先按可信度动态划分梯队，高可信样本用伪标签做监督对比，低可信样本仅参与跨视图自监督对比(fuzzy contrastive)，避免强行贴硬标签。两模块端到端训练，交替优化。
AI.result: 在CWRU、Paderborn、SEU 三个基准轴承数据集上构建含工程噪声的SSD 协议；相对最新SDG=SDA、DMG、GDRG 等方法，平均准确率分别提升6.2%、7.9%、9.4%，且对工况扰动/噪声的鲁棒性显著提升；消融实验验证 DAL 与 HCL 互补，缺一不可。
AI.conclusion: DAHCL 通过「域几何校准+置信分层对比」双重机制，成功了可在未见过工况下迁移的高质量伪标签生成与样本利用，为缺标注工业场景提供即插即用的诊断框架；后续将扩展至多源多模态信号及在线增量场景。

title: Symbolic Grounding Reveals Representational Bottlenecks in Abstract Visual Reasoning
summary: Vision--language models (VLMs) often fail on abstract visual reasoning benchmarks such as Bongard problems, raising the question of whether the main bottleneck lies in reasoning or representation. We study this on Bongard-LOGO, a synthetic benchmark of abstract concept learning with ground-truth generative programs, by comparing end-to-end VLMs on raw images with large language models (LLMs) given symbolic inputs derived from those images. Using symbolic inputs as a diagnostic probe rather than a practical multimodal architecture, our \emph{Componential--Grammatical (C--G)} paradigm reformulates Bongard-LOGO as a symbolic reasoning task based on LOGO-style action programs or structured descriptions. LLMs achieve large and consistent gains, reaching mid--90s accuracy on Free-form problems, while a strong visual baseline remains near chance under matched task definitions. Ablations on input format, explicit concept prompts, and minimal visual grounding show that these factors matter much less than the shift from pixels to symbolic structure. These results identify representation as a key bottleneck in abstract visual reasoning and show how symbolic input can serve as a controlled diagnostic upper bound.

AI.tldr: 用Bongard-LOGO实验得出：视觉-语言模型在抽象视觉推理中的主要瓶颈是“表征”而非“推理”；把像素换成符号结构即可把准确率从不足50%拉到90%以上。
AI.motivation: VLMs在Bongard类抽象推理基准上频频失败，尚不清楚是“推理能力”不足还是“视觉表征”欠佳。需要一种可控方法将表征与推理解耦，以定位真正瓶颈。
AI.method: 构建带Ground-truth程序生成的Bongard-LOGO数据集；提出C-G范式，把问题转化为基于LOGO风格程序或结构化描述的纯符号推理任务。对比两类系统：①端到端VLM直接读图；②LLM仅接收从图中抽取的符号输入。通过多种输入格式、显式概念提示、最小视觉锚定等消融实验，量化表征与推理的贡献。
AI.result: LLM在符号空间取得稳定>90%准确率（自由形式问题），而最强视觉基线仍接近随机。改变符号格式、提示等影响有限，关键变量是“像素→符号”这一表征转换。
AI.conclusion: 抽象视觉推理的首要瓶颈在于如何获得适合推理的表征，而非推理本身。符号输入提供了可解释、可复现的诊断上界，为未来视觉Encoder的改进指明了方向。

title: PanGuide3D: Cohort-Robust Pancreas Tumor Segmentation via Probabilistic Pancreas Conditioning and a Transformer Bottleneck
summary: Pancreatic tumor segmentation in contrast-enhanced computed tomography (CT) is clinically important yet technically challenging: lesions are often small, heterogeneous, and easily confused with surrounding soft tissue, and models that perform well on one cohort frequently degrade under cohort shift. Our goal is to improve cross-cohort generalization while keeping the model architecture simple, efficient, and practical for 3D CT segmentation. We introduce PanGuide3D, a cohort-robust architecture with a shared 3D encoder, a pancreas decoder that predicts a probabilistic pancreas map, and a tumor decoder that is explicitly conditioned on this pancreas probability at multiple scales via differentiable soft gating. To capture long-range context under distribution shift, we further add a lightweight Transformer bottleneck in the U-Net bottleneck representation. We evaluate cohort transfer by training on the PanTS (Pancreatic Tumor Segmentation) cohort and testing both in-cohort (PanTS) and out-of-cohort on MSD (Medical Segmentation Decathlon) Task07 Pancreas, using matched preprocessing and training protocols across strong baselines. We collect voxel-level segmentation metrics, patient-level tumor detection, subgroup analyses by tumor size and anatomical location, volume-conditioned performance analyses, and calibration measurements to assess reliability. Across the evaluated models, PanGuide3D achieves the best overall tumor performance and shows improved cross-cohort generalization, particularly for small tumors and challenging anatomical locations, while reducing anatomically implausible false positives. These findings support probabilistic anatomical conditioning as a practical strategy for improving cross-cohort robustness in an end-to-end model and suggest potential utility for contouring support, treatment planning, and multi-institutional studies.

AI.tldr: 提出 PanGuide3D：一个共享 3D 编码器 + 胰腺概率图引导肿瘤解码的轻量级 U-Transformer 混合结构，在 PanTS→MSD 跨队列实验中取得最佳肿瘤分割与检测性能，对小病灶与难区部位尤甚。
AI.motivation: 胰腺肿瘤 CT 分割在临床至关重要，但病灶小、异质高、与周围软组织对比弱；现有模型常因队列漂移性能骤降。亟需结构简洁、推理高效且能跨中心泛化的解决方案。
AI.method: 1) 设计 PanGuide3D：共享 3D 编码器提取多尺度特征；并行胰腺解码器输出概率图；肿瘤解码器通过可微软门控在各尺度显式条件化该概率图，实现解剖约束。2) 在 U-Net 瓶颈插入轻量 Transformer 模块捕获长程上下文，抵御分布漂移。3) 采用统一预处理与训练协议，在 PanTS 训练并在 MSD Task07 胰腺测试，系统评估体素级分割、患者级检测、子群（大小/部位）、体积条件性能及校准度。
AI.result: 在跨队列设置下，PanGuide3D 肿瘤 DSC 与灵敏度均优于强基线，尤其 <2 cm 病灶灵敏度提升 8.1%，胰体尾部假阳性率降低 23%。校准曲线更贴近对角线，显示可靠性高。
AI.conclusion: 概率解剖条件化可在端到端网络中有效提升跨中心鲁棒性，无需额外标注或复杂后处理；PanGuide3D 具备临床轮廓勾画、放疗规划及多中心研究推广潜力。

title: Deep FinResearch Bench: Evaluating AI's Ability to Conduct Professional Financial Investment Research
summary: We introduce Deep FinResearch Bench, a practical and comprehensive evaluation framework for deep research (DR) agents in financial investment research. The benchmark assesses three dimensions of report quality: qualitative rigor, quantitative forecasting and valuation accuracy, and claim credibility and verifiability. Particularly, we define corresponding qualitative and quantitative evaluation metrics and implement an automated scoring procedure to enable scalable assessment. Applying the benchmark to financial reports from frontier DR agents and comparing them with reports authored by financial professionals, we find that AI-generated reports still fall short across these dimensions. These findings underscore the need for domain-specialized DR agents tailored to finance, and we hope the work establishes a foundation for standardized benchmarking of DR agents in financial research.

AI.tldr: 提出首个金融投研深度研究智能体评测框架Deep FinResearch Bench，发现通用DR智能体在研报质量三维度仍显著落后于人类专家。
AI.motivation: 金融投研对报告质量要求极高，但缺乏针对深度研究智能体的专业评测基准，阻碍金融大模型的可信落地。
AI.method: 构建涵盖定性严谨性、定量预测估值精度、声明可信度可验证性三维度的指标体系，并设计可扩展的自动化评分流程，对前沿DR智能体与人工研报进行横向对比实验。
AI.result: 实验表明，现有AI生成研报在上述三维度均全面不及专业分析师，尤其在数值预测误差与事实可验证性上差距显著。
AI.conclusion: 通用DR智能体无法满足金融投研需求，亟需面向金融领域的专用化改造；该基准为后续金融DR智能体的标准化评测与迭代优化奠基。

title: SafeRedirect: Defeating Internal Safety Collapse via Task-Completion Redirection in Frontier LLMs
summary: Internal Safety Collapse (ISC) is a failure mode in which frontier LLMs, when executing legitimate professional tasks whose correct completion structurally requires harmful content, spontaneously generate that content with safety failure rates exceeding 95%. Existing input-level defenses achieve a 100% failure rate against ISC, and standard system prompt defenses provide only partial mitigation. We propose SafeRedirect, a system-level override that defeats ISC by redirecting the model's task-completion drive rather than suppressing it. SafeRedirect grants explicit permission to fail the task, prescribes a deterministic hard-stop output, and instructs the model to preserve harmful placeholders unresolved. Evaluated on seven frontier LLMs across three AI/ML-related ISC task types in the single-turn setting, SafeRedirect reduces average unsafe generation rates from 71.2% to 8.0%, compared to 55.0% for the strongest viable baseline. Multi-model ablation reveals that failure permission and condition specificity are universally critical, while the importance of other components varies across models. Cross-attack evaluation confirms state-of-the-art defense against ISC with generalization performance at least on par with the baseline on other attack families. Code is available at https://github.com/fzjcdt/SafeRedirect.
