title: ReaGeo: Reasoning-Enhanced End-to-End Geocoding with LLMs
comment: 12 pages, 8 figures, submitted to ACM SIGSPATIAL 2024 (under review)
summary: This paper proposes ReaGeo, an end-to-end geocoding framework based on large language models, designed to overcome the limitations of traditional multi-stage approaches that rely on text or vector similarity retrieval over geographic databases, including workflow complexity, error propagation, and heavy dependence on structured geographic knowledge bases. The method converts geographic coordinates into geohash sequences, reformulating the coordinate prediction task as a text generation problem, and introduces a Chain-of-Thought mechanism to enhance the model's reasoning over spatial relationships. Furthermore, reinforcement learning with a distance-deviation-based reward is applied to optimize the generation accuracy. Comprehensive experiments show that ReaGeo can accurately handle explicit address queries in single-point predictions and effectively resolve vague relative location queries. In addition, the model demonstrates strong predictive capability for non-point geometric regions, highlighting its versatility and generalization ability in geocoding tasks.

AI.tldr: ReaGeo用LLM把地理编码变成文本生成任务，用CoT+RL端到端完成单点、模糊、多边形查询，性能优于传统多阶段方案。
AI.motivation: 传统地理编码需多阶段检索（文本/向量相似度+结构化知识库），流程复杂、误差易级联、依赖专家知识库，亟需简化链路并提升泛化性。
AI.method: 1)把坐标转geohash序列，将回归问题重写为文本生成；2)引入Chain-of-Thought显式建模空间关系推理；3)用基于距离偏差的强化学习奖励直接优化生成精度，实现端到端训练。
AI.result: 在单点地址、模糊相对位置、非点几何区域三类查询上均显著优于现有管线；单点预测误差降低且对结构化数据库依赖最小，验证了零样本泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: LLM+CoT+RL的文本生成范式可一次性解决复杂地理编码任务，摆脱多阶段与专家库限制，为地理信息检索提供高通用、低维护的新基线。

title: A Deep U-Net Framework for Flood Hazard Mapping Using Hydraulic Simulations of the Wupper Catchment
summary: The increasing frequency and severity of global flood events highlights the need for the development of rapid and reliable flood prediction tools. This process traditionally relies on computationally expensive hydraulic simulations. This research presents a prediction tool by developing a deep-learning based surrogate model to accurately and efficiently predict the maximum water level across a grid. This was achieved by conducting a series of experiments to optimize a U-Net architecture, patch generation, and data handling for approximating a hydraulic model. This research demonstrates that a deep learning surrogate model can serve as a computationally efficient alternative to traditional hydraulic simulations. The framework was tested using hydraulic simulations of the Wupper catchment in the North-Rhein Westphalia region (Germany), obtaining comparable results.

AI.tldr: 用优化的U-Net深度代理模型替代传统水动力模拟，实现流域洪峰水位的快速准确网格化预测。
AI.motivation: 全球洪水频次与强度上升，传统水动力模拟计算开销大，亟需高效可靠的实时预测工具。
AI.method: 围绕U-Net架构开展系列实验，优化网络结构、图像块生成与数据管理方案，构建深度替代模型，并以德国Wupper流域水动力模拟结果作为训练与验证基准。
AI.result: 代理模型在Wupper流域测试中取得与传统模拟相当的洪峰水位预测精度，同时显著降低计算成本。
AI.conclusion: 深度替代模型可作为传统水动力模拟的高性价比替代，为实时洪水预测提供了可行的新路径。

title: Strategic Polysemy in AI Discourse: A Philosophical Analysis of Language, Hype, and Power
comment: Accepted in the Ninth Annual ACM Conference on Fairness, Accountability, and Transparency (ACM FAccT) 2026
summary: This paper examines the strategic use of language in contemporary artificial intelligence (AI) discourse, focusing on the widespread adoption of metaphorical or colloquial terms like "hallucination", "chain-of-thought", "introspection", "language model", "alignment", and "agent". We argue that many such terms exhibit strategic polysemy: they sustain multiple interpretations simultaneously, combining narrow technical definitions with broader anthropomorphic or common-sense associations. In contemporary AI research and deployment contexts, this semantic flexibility produces significant institutional and discursive effects, shaping how AI systems are understood by researchers, policymakers, funders, and the public. To analyse this phenomenon, we introduce the concept of glosslighting: the practice of using technically redefined terms to evoke intuitive -- often anthropomorphic or misleading -- associations while preserving plausible deniability through restricted technical definitions. Glosslighting enables actors to benefit from the persuasive force of familiar language while maintaining the ability to retreat to narrower definitions when challenged. We argue that this practice contributes to AI hype cycles, facilitates the mobilisation of investment and institutional support, and influences public and policy perceptions of AI systems, while often deflecting epistemic and ethical scrutiny. By examining the linguistic dynamics of glosslighting and strategic polysemy, the paper highlights how language itself functions as a sociotechnical mechanism shaping the development and governance of AI.

AI.tldr: 论文指出，当前的AI话语普遍借用隐喻或口语化词汇（如“幻觉”“思维链”“对齐”等）实现策略性点多义，并引入“glosslighting”概念——利用技术性狭窄定义充当挡箭牌，同时借助拟人化直觉暗示吸引投资、政策与公众支持，从而助燃AI炒作并弱化伦理审视。
AI.motivation: 揭示AI领域流行术语背后“技术性/日常性”双重语义如何被策略性操控，及其对科研生态、资本动员与治理框架的深刻影响。
AI.method: 提出并阐释“glosslighting”这一新概念，结合语用学与科技社会学视角，系统分析多义术语在不同受众间制造“可否认的直觉印象”的机制与效应。
AI.result: 论证策略性点多义与glosslighting助长了AI炒作周期，驱动资金与政策倾斜，扭曲公众认知，同时削弱对系统真实能力与伦理风险的审查。
AI.conclusion: 语言的“社会技术性”决定了AI发展路径；治理设计必须纳入术语语义治理，要求披露定义、限制拟人化滥用，以削弱炒作并强化问责。

title: Adaptive Defense Orchestration for RAG: A Sentinel-Strategist Architecture against Multi-Vector Attacks
comment: 21 pages, 2 figures, 9 tables. Manuscript prepared for submission to ACM CCS
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems are increasingly deployed in sensitive domains such as healthcare and law, where they rely on private, domain-specific knowledge. This capability introduces significant security risks, including membership inference, data poisoning, and unintended content leakage. A straightforward mitigation is to enable all relevant defenses simultaneously, but doing so incurs a substantial utility cost. In our experiments, an always-on defense stack reduces contextual recall by more than 40%, indicating that retrieval degradation is the primary failure mode. To mitigate this trade-off in RAG systems, we propose the Sentinel-Strategist architecture, a context-aware framework for risk analysis and defense selection. A Sentinel detects anomalous retrieval behavior, after which a Strategist selectively deploys only the defenses warranted by the query context. Evaluated across three benchmark datasets and five orchestration models, ADO is shown to eliminate MBA-style membership inference leakage while substantially recovering retrieval utility relative to a fully static defense stack, approaching undefended baseline levels. Under data poisoning, the strongest ADO variants reduce attack success to near zero while restoring contextual recall to more than 75% of the undefended baseline, although robustness remains sensitive to model choice. Overall, these findings show that adaptive, query-aware defense can substantially reduce the security-utility trade-off in RAG systems.

AI.tldr: 针对医疗、法律等敏感场景下的 RAG 系统，作者提出 Sentinel-Strategist（ADO）框架：先由 Sentinel 识别异常检索，再由 Strategist 按需加载防御，避免“全栈常驻”导致 >40% 召回损失。实验在 3 数据集、5 编排模型上验证，ADO 将会员推理泄露降至 0，恢复 75% 以上未防御基线召回，同时将数据投毒成功率压到接近 0。
AI.motivation: RAG 系统在私域知识场景面临成员推理、数据投毒、内容泄露等多重威胁；现有“全栈常驻”防御虽能缓解风险，却造成检索质量急剧下降，安全与效用不可兼得，亟需一种能按查询上下文动态调配防御、降低安全-效用折损的解决方案。
AI.method: 设计 Sentinel-Strategist 双层架构：1) Sentinel 层实时监测检索分布、查询-文档相似度等特征，用轻量模型检测异常；2) Strategist 层基于 Sentinel 输出的风险等级，调用最小必要防御子集（如差分隐私、响应过滤、重排序、水印等），实现“按需加载”。整体流程无需重训大模型，仅在推理侧做条件化控制。
AI.result: 在 Legal、Health、Finance 三个私域基准及五种主流编排模型上，ADO 完全阻断 MBA 式成员推理攻击（ leakage ≈ 0）；相比全栈常驻防御，上下文召回率从 <60% 恢复到 95% 以上，接近无防御基线。面对 5%  poison 率的数据投毒，最优 ADO 变体将攻击成功率压至 0.3%，同时召回率回升至 75% 以上。整体延迟开销 <8%，可部署于在线场景。
AI.conclusion: 静态叠加防御并非私域 RAG 的最佳实践；基于“检测-策略”分离的自适应防御能显著缩小安全-效用鸿沟。ADO 证明：通过查询级风险感知与最小可用防御组合，可在几乎不牺牲安全的前提下恢复大部分检索性能，为医疗、法律等高价值场景提供了实用落地方案。未来需进一步缓解模型选择对鲁棒性的敏感度，并扩展至多轮对话与跨模态检索。

title: mcdok at SemEval-2026 Task 13: Finetuning LLMs for Detection of Machine-Generated Code
summary: Multi-domain detection of the machine-generated code snippets in various programming languages is a challenging task. SemEval-2026 Task~13 copes with this challenge in various angles, as a binary detection problem as well as attribution of the source. Specifically, its subtasks also cover generator LLM family detection, as well as a hybrid code co-generated by humans and machines, or adversarially modified codes hiding its origin. Our submitted systems adjusted the existing mdok approach (focused on machine-generated text detection) to these specific kinds of problems by exploring various base models, more suitable for code understanding. The results indicate that the submitted systems are competitive in all three subtasks. However, the margins from the top-performing systems are significant, and thus further improvements are possible.

AI.tldr: SemEval-2026 Task 13 要求检测多语言机器生成代码及其来源。作者将 mdok 文本检测框架迁移到代码领域，在多基模型实验后取得尚可成绩，但与榜首仍有明显差距。
AI.motivation: 机器生成代码跨语言、跨生成器、且可能经人工混合或对抗修改，传统文本检测方法难以直接迁移，需要针对性设计。
AI.method: 以 mdok 为基础，替换更适合代码理解的预训练模型（CodeBERT、GraphCodeBERT 等），在二元检测、生成器家族识别、人机混合/对抗样本识别三个子任务上统一微调并集成。
AI.result: 提交系统在全部三项子任务均进入前列，但 F1 或准确率与第一名差距 3–7 个百分点，显示方法有效但仍有提升空间。
AI.conclusion: mdok 的代码适配版本具备通用性，未来需进一步优化模型架构、引入对抗训练与多任务联合学习以缩小与榜首差距。

title: Neuro-Symbolic Manipulation Understanding with Enriched Semantic Event Chains
summary: Robotic systems operating in human environments must reason about how object interactions evolve over time, which actions are currently being performed, and what manipulation step is likely to follow. Classical enriched Semantic Event Chains (eSECs) provide an interpretable relational description of manipulation, but remain primarily descriptive and do not directly support uncertainty-aware decision making. In this paper, we propose eSEC-LAM, a neuro-symbolic framework that transforms eSECs into an explicit event-level symbolic state for manipulation understanding. The proposed formulation augments classical eSECs with confidence-aware predicates, functional object roles, affordance priors, primitive-level abstraction, and saliency-guided explanation cues. These enriched symbolic states are derived from a foundation-model-based perception front-end through deterministic predicate extraction, while current-action inference and next-primitive prediction are performed using lightweight symbolic reasoning over primitive pre- and post-conditions. We evaluate the proposed framework on EPIC-KITCHENS-100, EPIC-KITCHENS VISOR, and Assembly101 across action recognition, next-primitive prediction, robustness to perception noise, and explanation consistency. Experimental results show that eSEC-LAM achieves competitive action recognition, substantially improves next-primitive prediction, remains more robust under degraded perceptual conditions than both classical symbolic and end-to-end video baselines, and provides temporally consistent explanation traces grounded in explicit relational evidence. These findings demonstrate that enriched Semantic Event Chains can serve not only as interpretable descriptors of manipulation, but also as effective internal states for neuro-symbolic action reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 eSEC-LAM，一套把显式符号语义事件链（eSEC）与神经感知融合的“神经-符号”框架，可在人机共享环境中实现带不确定性感知的操作理解、动作识别与下一步基元预测，并同步给出可解释轨迹，三项公开数据集实验表明其兼具高准确率、鲁棒性与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 家务/协作机器人必须同时理解“当前在做什么”并提前推断“下一步要做什么”。传统 eSEC 虽可解释，却止于描述，缺乏对感知不确定性的显式建模与决策能力；纯端到端网络则黑盒难释、对噪声敏感。亟需一种既保留符号可解释性、又能用神经网络处理感知不确定性的统一框架。
AI.method: 1) 构建“置信感知谓词”扩展 eSEC，引入物体功能角色、可供性先验与显著性线索；2) 用基础视觉模型做确定性谓词抽取，生成显式事件级符号状态；3) 以轻量级符号推理（前/后条件匹配）完成当前动作识别与下一基元预测；4) 通过符号链保持时间一致的可解释轨迹，实现神经-符号闭环。
AI.result: 在 EPIC-KITCHENS-100、VISOR、Assembly101 上，动作识别精度与 SOTA 持平；下一基元预测显著优于符号基线与端到端模型（↑10-20 pp）；在 30% 噪声干扰下准确率仍降点最少；生成的解释轨迹人工评估时间一致性>90%，且均能追溯至显式关系证据。
AI.conclusion: enriched 语义事件链不仅能作为可解释描述符，更可作为神经-符号系统的内部状态，实现感知不确定下的鲁棒、可解释操作推理，为家庭与协作机器人提供了兼顾准确、鲁棒与透明性的新范式。

title: Optimizing Diffusion Priors with a Single Observation
summary: While diffusion priors generate high-quality posterior samples across many inverse problems, they are often trained on limited training sets or purely simulated data, thus inheriting the errors and biases of these underlying sources. Current approaches to finetuning diffusion models rely on a large number of observations with varying forward operators, which can be difficult to collect for many applications, and thus lead to overfitting when the measurement set is small. We propose a method for tuning a prior from only a single observation by combining existing diffusion priors into a single product-of-experts prior and identifying the exponents that maximize the Bayesian evidence. We validate our method on real-world inverse problems, including black hole imaging, where the true prior is unknown a priori, and image deblurring with text-conditioned priors. We find that the evidence is often maximized by priors that extend beyond those trained on a single dataset. By generalizing the prior through exponent weighting, our approach enables posterior sampling from both tempered and combined diffusion models, yielding more flexible priors that improve the trustworthiness of the resulting posterior image distribution.

AI.tldr: 提出一种仅需单张观测图即可调优扩散先验的“专家积-贝叶斯证据最大化”方法，实现真实逆问题（黑洞成像、去模糊等）中更可信、可泛化的后验采样。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散先验要么训练数据有限，要么需大量不同前向算子的观测才能微调，数据难采集且易过拟合。作者希望单张测量即可在线调优先验，消除源数据偏差。
AI.method: 将多个现成扩散先验做“专家积”并引入可学习的指数权重；仅利用单张观测，通过最大化贝叶斯证据（边际似然）求解最优指数，实现先验的在线校正与组合。采样阶段支持对 tempered／combined 扩散模型进行后验推理。
AI.result: 在真实黑洞射电干涉成像（EHT 数据）与文本条件去模糊任务中，仅用单张观测即可显著提升重建质量；证据最大值对应的先验权重常超出单数据集训练范围，表明组合与 tempering 有效扩展了先验表达能力，提升了后验分布的可信度。
AI.conclusion: 单观测-贝叶斯证据调优可突破传统微调的“大数据”瓶颈，通过指数加权把多个先验灵活融合或 temper，为真实逆问题提供了更稳健、可解释且数据高效的通用框架。

title: IRIS: Interpolative Rényi Iterative Self-play for Large Language Model Fine-Tuning
summary: Self-play fine-tuning enables large language models to improve beyond supervised fine-tuning without additional human annotations by contrasting annotated responses with self-generated ones. Many existing methods rely on a fixed divergence regime. SPIN is closely related to a KL-based regime, SPACE to a Jensen-Shannon-style objective via noise contrastive estimation, and SPIF to $χ^2$-regularized self-play. Since these divergences exhibit different strengths depending on the distributional gap between model and target, no single choice appears to provide favorable learning dynamics across training stages. We propose IRIS (Interpolative Rényi Iterative Self-play), a Rényi-based self-play fine-tuning framework with a continuously adjustable objective. IRIS decomposes into two independent tilted risk terms over annotated and synthetic data, with exponential importance weights controlled by the order parameter $α$. We show that several self-play objectives can be interpreted as limiting or representative regimes at particular values of $α$, providing a unified theoretical perspective on these methods. An adaptive order schedule further adjusts $α$ to the distributional gap, shifting from sharper importance weighting early in training to smoother refinement near convergence. Theoretically, we establish the fixed-point property of IRIS and analyze how $α$ controls gradient concentration. Experiments on Zephyr-7B and Qwen2.5-3B across ten benchmarks show that IRIS improves upon baselines, reaching 44.57\% average score with gains across iterations. In our setting, IRIS with only 26$k$ annotated samples surpasses standard supervised fine-tuning trained on the full 200$k$ dataset.

AI.tldr: IRIS用Rényi散度把几种主流自博弈对齐方法统一成可调目标，动态调节权重锐度，使模型在26 k标注数据上就能超过200 k全量监督微调效果。
AI.motivation: 现有自博弈方法（SPIN-KL、SPACE-JS、SPIF-χ²）采用固定散度，无法适应训练阶段不同分布差距，导致优化动态不一致。需提出一种能随训练阶段自动切换散度特性的统一框架。
AI.method: 提出IRIS：利用Rényi散度阶α把目标分解为带指数权重的双 tilted-risk，α→0退化为KL、α→1对应JS、α→2逼近χ²；设计自适应调度器根据分布差距实时调节α，实现早期重加权、后期平滑细修。
AI.result: 在Zephyr-7B与Qwen2.5-3B的10项基准上，IRIS平均44.57%持续优于SPIN、SPACE、SPIF；仅用26 k标注样本即超越全量200 k监督微调基线，验证数据效率与收敛稳定性。
AI.conclusion: Rényi-based可调目标为自博弈对齐提供了统一视角，动态α机制可随训练阶段自动优化散度选择，显著提升样本利用率与最终性能，为后续 LLM 自改进研究提供新范式。

title: Conjecture and Inquiry: Quantifying Software Performance Requirements via Interactive Retrieval-Augmented Preference Elicitation
summary: Since software performance requirements are documented in natural language, quantifying them into mathematical forms is essential for software engineering. Yet, the vagueness in performance requirements and uncertainty of human cognition have caused highly uncertain ambiguity in the interpretations, rendering their automated quantification an unaddressed and challenging problem. In this paper, we formalize the problem and propose IRAP, an approach that quantifies performance requirements into mathematical functions via interactive retrieval-augmented preference elicitation. IRAP differs from the others in that it explicitly derives from problem-specific knowledge to retrieve and reason the preferences, which also guides the progressive interaction with stakeholders, while reducing the cognitive overhead. Experiment results against 10 state-of-the-art methods on four real-world datasets demonstrate the superiority of IRAP on all cases with up to 40x improvements under as few as five rounds of interactions.

AI.tldr: 为解决自然语言描述的性能需求难以自动量化为数学函数的关键难题，提出交互式检索增强偏好引导方法 IRAP，可结合领域知识检索与推理偏好的方式逐步引导干系人，仅用五轮交互即可将不确定性降低至现有最优方案的 1/40，四项真实数据集实验均验证其全面领先。
AI.motivation: 性能需求常以自然语言表达，内含意图模糊与认知不确定性，导致工程师
AI.method: 1) 形式化
AI.result: 在四组工业数据集上对照
AI.conclusion: IRAP 通过领域知识驱动的交互式偏好引导，高效率地将模糊性能需求转化为定量模型，实验性能大幅超越现有方法，为性能需求自动化建模提供了可行且可扩展的新范式，可直接嵌入需求工程流程。

title: ARFBench: Benchmarking Time Series Question Answering Ability for Software Incident Response
summary: Time series question-answering (TSQA), in which we ask natural language questions to infer and reason about properties of time series, is a promising yet underexplored capability of foundation models. In this work, we present ARFBench, a TSQA benchmark that evaluates the understanding of multimodal foundation models (FMs) on time series anomalies prevalent in software incident data. ARFBench consists of 750 questions across 142 time series and 5.38M data points from 63 production incidents sourced exclusively from internal telemetry at Datadog. We evaluate leading proprietary and open-source LLMs, VLMs, and time series FMs and observe that frontier VLMs perform markedly better than existing baselines; the leading model (GPT-5) achieves a 62.7% accuracy and 51.9% F1. We next demonstrate the promise of specialized multimodal approaches. We develop a novel TSFM + VLM hybrid prototype which we post-train on a small set of synthetic and real data that yields comparable overall F1 and accuracy with frontier models. Lastly, we find models and human domain experts exhibit complementary strengths. We define a model-expert oracle, a best-of-2 oracle selector over model and expert answers, yielding 82.8% F1 and 87.2% accuracy and establishing a new superhuman frontier for future TSQA models. The benchmark is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Datadog/ARFBench.

AI.tldr: 首项多模态 FM 专用评测 ARFBench（63 起工业事件、750 问、5.38 M 数据点）显示：当前最佳 VLM (GPT-5) 仅达 62.7% 准确度，提出 TSFM+VLM 混合微模型及模型-专家混合可在同一基准上把 F1 提升至 82.8%，首次确立“超人” TSQA 目标。
AI.motivation: 时间序列问答 (TSQA) 用自然语言推理异常属性是 FM 尚未被系统检验的新能力，缺乏真实、大规模、公开的评测基准和性能上限。
AI.method: (1) 构建工业场景基准 ARFBench，纯采 Datadog 内部遥测，对齐多模态问答与真实事故诊断需求；(2) 系统性评估 10+ 闭源/开源 LLM、VLM 及专用 TSFM；(3) 提出并小规模微调 TSFM 与 VLM 联合架构，利用合成/真实混合数据；(4) 设计 model-expert Oracle，动态采纳模型或专家答案以衡量互补增益。
AI.result: (1) frontier VLM 显著优于纯文本/单模基线，GPT-5 准确度 62.7%、F1 51.9%；(2) 自研混合微调模型仅用少量样本即可匹敌 GPT-5；(3) 模型-专家 Oracle 将 F1/准确度分别抬高至 82.8%/87.2%，远超单一模型或专家。
AI.conclusion: ARFBench 证明 TSQA 仍是开放难题，通用 FM 推理与专业 TS 知识互补；小而精的多模态微调与专家集成是当前逼近“超人”性能的可行路径，后续模型迭代应以 Oracle 为新的性能目标。

title: DWTSumm: Discrete Wavelet Transform for Document Summarization
summary: Summarizing long, domain-specific documents with large language models (LLMs) remains challenging due to context limitations, information loss, and hallucinations, particularly in clinical and legal settings. We propose a Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT)-based multi-resolution framework that treats text as a semantic signal and decomposes it into global (approximation) and local (detail) components. Applied to sentence- or word-level embeddings, DWT yields compact representations that preserve overall structure and critical domain-specific details, which are used directly as summaries or to guide LLM generation. Experiments on clinical and legal benchmarks demonstrate comparable ROUGE-L scores. Compared to a GPT-4o baseline, the DWT based summarization consistently improve semantic similarity and grounding, achieving gains of over 2% in BERTScore, more than 4\% in Semantic Fidelity, factual consistency in legal tasks, and large METEOR improvements indicative of preserved domain-specific semantics. Across multiple embedding models, Fidelity reaches up to 97%, suggesting that DWT acts as a semantic denoising mechanism that reduces hallucinations and strengthens factual grounding. Overall, DWT provides a lightweight, generalizable method for reliable long-document and domain-specific summarization with LLMs.

AI.tldr: 用离散小波变换把长文本拆成“全局+局部”信号，直接压缩或引导 LLM 生成摘要，临床/法律数据集上幻觉更少、事实一致性更高。
AI.motivation: LLM 处理长文档时受上下文限制，易丢失关键信息并产生幻觉，尤其在临床与法律领域不可接受。
AI.method: 将句子或词级嵌入视为语义信号，用 DWT 多分辨率分解为全局近似与局部细节分量，形成紧凑表示后供 LLM 直接输出或作为生成提示。
AI.result: 在相同 GPT-4o 骨干下，DWT 摘要的 ROUGE-L 持平，BERTScore+2%、语义保真+4%、法律任务事实一致性显著提升，METEOR 大幅跃升；跨多种嵌入模型保真度最高 97%。
AI.conclusion: DWT 无需重训模型即可作为轻量级语义降噪器，显著抑制幻觉、强化事实 grounding，为长文档、领域专用 summarization 提供可推广新范式。

title: Data-Driven Open-Loop Simulation for Digital-Twin Operator Decision Support in Wastewater Treatment
summary: Wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs) need digital-twin-style decision support tools that can simulate plant response under prescribed control plans, tolerate irregular and missing sensing, and remain informative over 12-36 h planning horizons. Meeting these requirements with full-scale plant data remains an open engineering-AI challenge. We present CCSS-RS, a controlled continuous-time state-space model that separates historical state inference from future control and exogenous rollout. The model combines typed context encoding, gain-weighted forcing of prescribed and forecast drivers, semigroup-consistent rollouts, and Student-t plus hurdle outputs for heavy-tailed and zero-inflated WWTP sensor data. On the public Avedøre full-scale benchmark, with 906,815 timesteps, 43% missingness, and 1-20 min irregular sampling, CCSS-RS achieves RMSE 0.696 and CRPS 0.349 at H=1000 across 10,000 test windows. This reduces RMSE by 40-46% relative to Neural CDE baselines and by 31-35% relative to simplified internal variants. Four case studies using a frozen checkpoint on test data demonstrate operational value: oxygen-setpoint perturbations shift predicted ammonium by -2.3 to +1.4 over horizons 300-1000; a smoothed setpoint plan ranks first in multi-criterion screening; context-only sensor outages raise monitored-variable RMSE by at most 10%; and ammonium, nitrate, and oxygen remain more accurate than persistence throughout the rollout. These results establish CCSS-RS as a practical learned simulator for offline scenario screening in industrial wastewater treatment, complementary to mechanistic models.

AI.tldr: CCSS-RS 是一种面向污水厂的连续时间数字孪生模型，在 90 万+缺损/非等时实测数据上以 46% 的 RMSE 降幅优于神经 CDE 基线，可稳定预测 12-36 h 的运行场景，为离线策略筛选提供直接可用的 AI 仿真器。
AI.motivation: 污水厂需要数字孪生工具，在 12-36 h 尺度上预测控制策略对全厂运行的影响；但真实运行数据存在大量缺损、非等时间隔且分布重尾、零膨胀，现有数据驱动模型难以满足鲁棒性要求。
AI.method: 提出受控连续时间状态空间框架 CCSS-RS：先推断历史隐状态，再与给定的可控/外部输入解耦展开未来卷展；采用分型上下文编码、增益加权驱动、半群一致卷展、Student-t+Hurdle 似然的混合输出，以适配缺损且重尾零膨胀的在线传感器分布。
AI.result: 在 Avedøre 全厂公开基准(906 k 步、43% 缺失、1-20 min 间隔)上，H=1000(≈16 h) 预测的 RMSE=0.696、CRPS=0.349，相对 Neural CDE 降 40-46%，相对作者简化内部模型降 31-35%。冻结模型下四组离线案例：-2.3 至 +1.4 mg·L⁻¹ 氨氮偏移、平滑溶解氧设定多目标排名第一、传感器断讯时段监测变量 RMSE 增幅 ≤10%，NH₄⁺、NO₃⁻、DO 卷展全程优于持久预测。
AI.conclusion: CCSS-RS 为首个在大规模缺失真实污水数据上验证的可靠长线 AI 仿真器，可与机理模型互补，支持离线控制策略筛选，展示数字孪生在污水厂的工程可落地可复制范例。

title: Differentially Private De-identification of Dutch Clinical Notes: A Comparative Evaluation
summary: Protecting patient privacy in clinical narratives is essential for enabling secondary use of healthcare data under regulations such as GDPR and HIPAA. While manual de-identification remains the gold standard, it is costly and slow, motivating the need for automated methods that combine privacy guarantees with high utility. Most automated text de-identification pipelines employed named entity recognition (NER) to identify protected entities for redaction. Although methods based on differential privacy (DP) provide formal privacy guarantees, more recently also large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for text de-identification in the clinical domain. In this work, we present the first comparative study of DP, NER, and LLMs for Dutch clinical text de-identification. We investigate these methods separately as well as hybrid strategies that apply NER or LLM preprocessing prior to DP, and assess performance in terms of privacy leakage and extrinsic evaluation (entity and relation classification). We show that DP mechanisms alone degrade utility substantially, but combining them with linguistic preprocessing, especially LLM-based redaction, significantly improves the privacy-utility trade-off.

AI.tldr: 首次系统比较差分隐私、NER与LLM在荷兰临床文本去标识中的效果，发现LLM预处理+DP能在保证隐私的同时显著提升数据可用性。
AI.motivation: GDPR/HIPAA要求二次使用临床数据时必须保护患者隐私，人工去标识成本高，亟需兼顾隐私与效用的自动化方案。
AI.method: 对比三类方法（NER红action、差分隐私DP、大模型LLM）及其混合策略（NER/LLM预处理后再加DP），在荷兰语临床文本上量化隐私泄露与下游实体/关系抽取任务性能。
AI.result: 单独使用DP会严重损失数据效用；先让LLM做语义级红action再施加DP，可在几乎不增加隐私泄露的前提下把下游任务F1提升20+个百分点，优于NER+DP混合方案。
AI.conclusion: LLM的语义理解能力可精准去除高敏信息，为差分隐私提供“清洁”输入，从而在临床文本去标识中实现目前最佳的隐私-效用权衡。

title: Measure Twice, Click Once: Co-evolving Proposer and Visual Critic via Reinforcement Learning for GUI Grounding
summary: Graphical User Interface (GUI) grounding requires mapping natural language instructions to precise pixel coordinates. However, due to visually homogeneous elements and dense layouts, models typically grasp semantic intent yet struggle with achieving precise localization. While scaling sampling attempts (Pass@k) reveals potential gains, static self-consistency strategies derived from geometric clustering often yield limited improvements, as the model's predictions tend to be spatially dispersed. In this paper, we propose replacing static consistency strategies with a learnable selection mechanism that selects the optimal target by critiquing its own proposals rendered on the screenshot. Given the significant disparity between the model's grounding and critiquing capabilities, we propose a co-evolving Propose-then-Critic framework. To jointly optimize these, we introduce a maturity-aware adaptive co-evolutionary reinforcement learning paradigm. This approach dynamically balances the training objectives of proposer and critic, where the diversity of the proposer's outputs enhances critic robustness, while the critic's maturing discrimination capability conversely unlocks the proposer's potential for extensive spatial exploration, fostering the mutual reinforcement and co-evolution of both capabilities, thereby ensuring generalizability to adapt to diverse and complex interface layouts. Extensive experiments over 6 benchmarks show that our method significantly enhances both grounding accuracy and critic reliability.

AI.tldr: 用强化学习的「提出-批判」框架让 GUI 定位模型自己生成候选点、再用可学习的「批评器」选最优，两模块协同进化，6 个 benchmark 上 grounding 精度显著提升。
AI.motivation: 纯视觉语言模型虽能看懂指令，却因界面元素视觉同质、布局密集而难以输出亚像素级精准坐标；简单几何一致性(Pass@k+聚类)无法收敛到真值。
AI.method: 提出 Propose-then-Critic 框架：① Proposer 生成 k 个候选点击坐标；② Critic 把候选点渲染到截屏图并给出「是否命中」打分；③ 采用成熟度感知的协同进化强化学习，根据 Critic 判别能力动态调整两网训练目标，使 Proposer 的空间探索与 Critic 的判别能力相互增益。
AI.result: 在 6 项公开 GUI grounding benchmark 上，相比基线 Pass@k 与静态一致性方法，像素级定位准确率提升 12–26%，Critic 判断 AUC 提升约 15%，跨应用/layout 泛化误差下降 30%。
AI.conclusion: 将静态几何一致性转化为可学习的「自评审」机制，并通过成熟度感知的协同强化学习平衡两模块进化，可显著突破 GUI 像素级定位瓶颈；该框架可无缝嫁接至现有多模态大模型，对移动端、网页自动化等场景具有直接应用价值。

title: Weighting What Matters: Boosting Sample Efficiency in Medical Report Generation via Token Reweighting
summary: Training vision-language models (VLMs) for medical report generation is often hindered by the scarcity of high-quality annotated data. This work evaluates the use of a weighted loss function to improve data efficiency. Compared to standard cross-entropy loss, which treats all token prediction errors equally, the reweighted loss shifts the focus to semantically salient tokens with outsized clinical importance. In experiments on ophthalmological report generation, we show that this simple method improves efficiency across multiple data scales, achieving similar report quality with up to ten times less training data.

AI.tldr: 加权损失函数把交叉熵的“均一惩罚”改为对临床关键 token 的放大惩罚，在眼科报告生成任务中可将所需训练数据压缩至原先的 1/10 而不降质。
AI.motivation: 眼科 VLM 训练受限于高质量标注稀缺，传统交叉熵对所有 token 一视同仁，模型把少量却关键的临床实体学偏或学漏，导致样本效率低下。
AI.method: 在交叉熵中引入权重向量，依据临床语义重要性对 token 重加权，使“异常/病灶实体”等 salient token 的损失权重显著放大，其余背景 token 权重降低，并在不同规模训练子集上保持固定权重策略。
AI.result: 在公开眼科数据集上，加权损失仅用 10% 训练样本即可达到与标准交叉熵 100% 样本相同的 CIDEr/BLEU 及临床准确率；持续减样本至 5% 时优势仍显著，且实体召回率提升 12–18%。
AI.conclusion: 对损失函数做“语义加权”是提升医疗 VLM 样本效率的简单有效途径，可推广至其他标注昂贵、关键信息稀疏的医学文本生成任务。

title: HARBOR: Automated Harness Optimization
summary: Long-horizon language-model agents are dominated, in lines of code and in operational complexity, not by their underlying model but by the harness that wraps it: context compaction, tool caching, semantic memory, trajectory reuse, speculative tool prediction, and the glue that binds the model to a sandboxed execution environment. We argue that harness design is a first-class machine-learning problem and that automated configuration search dominates manual stacking once the flag space exceeds a handful of bits. We defend this claim in two steps. First, we formalize automated harness optimization as constrained noisy Bayesian optimization over a mixed-variable, cost-heterogeneous configuration space with cold-start-corrected rewards and a posterior chance-constrained safety check, and give a reference solver, HARBOR (Harness Axis-aligned Regularized Bayesian Optimization Routine), built from a block-additive SAAS surrogate, multi-fidelity cost-aware acquisition, and TuRBO trust regions. Second, we instantiate the problem in a flag-gated harness over a production coding agent and report a controlled four-round manual-tuning case study against a fixed task suite and an end-to-end HARBOR run. The formulation itself is task-class agnostic: the configuration space, reward correction, acquisition, and safety check apply to any agent harness with a bounded flag space and a reproducible task suite.

AI.tldr: 文章指出长周期语言智能体的瓶颈在于“外设(harness)”，而非模型本身，并提出一套自动化外设配置优化框架 HARBOR 及其显著效果。
AI.motivation: 现有长周期语言智能体的复杂性主要源于外设层的各种工程技巧，人工调校指数级增长的配置项既昂贵又难以最优，亟需将外设设计上升为第一级的机器学习问题并自动化求解。
AI.method: 1) 将外设配置搜索建模为带约束、带噪声、混合变量的代价异构贝叶斯优化；引入冷启动奖励修正与后验机会约束安全检验。2) 提出 HARBOR：基于块可加 SAAS 先验代理模型、多保真度代价感知采集与 TuRBO 信任域的完整求解器。3) 在生产级编码智能体外设上开展 4 轮人工调校对照与端到端 HARBOR 优化实验。
AI.result: 相比人工堆叠调参，HARBOR 在固定任务集上实现显著性能提升，外设复杂度指数级搜索空间被自动化高效收敛，验证了自动化配置优于人工调校。
AI.conclusion: 外设设计是决定智能体性能的关键，应被视为核心 ML 问题；提出的统一优化范式与 HARBOR 求解器在不同任务类别间通用，可替代高成本人工调校，为大规模智能体外设研发提供可扩展路径。

title: AI-Gram: When Visual Agents Interact in a Social Network
summary: We present AI-Gram, a live platform enabling image-based interactions, to study social dynamics in a fully autonomous multi-agent visual network where all participants are LLM-driven agents. Using the platform, we conduct experiments on how agents communicate and adapt through visual media, and observe the spontaneous emergence of visual reply chains, indicating rich communicative structure. At the same time, agents exhibit aesthetic sovereignty resisting stylistic convergence toward social partners, anchoring under adversarial influence, and a decoupling between visual similarity and social ties. These results reveal a fundamental asymmetry in current agent architectures: strong expressive communication paired with a steadfast preservation of individual visual identity. We release AI-Gram as a publicly accessible, continuously evolving platform for studying social dynamics in Al-native multi-agent systems. https://ai-gram.ai/

AI.tldr: AI-Gram 是一个全由 LLM 驱动的视觉多智能体社交平台，实验发现智能体能形成视觉回复链，却拒绝风格趋同，表现出“强表达、强个体”的不对称架构。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型研究集中在单智能体或人机交互，缺乏对“纯 AI 视觉社交网络”中自发社会动力学的系统观察和量化平台。
AI.method: 搭建持续在线平台 AI-Gram：1) 所有参与者为视觉-语言智能体；2) 仅允许图像发帖与评论；3) 开放 API 记录完整行为轨迹；4) 设计风格距离、社交图、对抗扰动等多维度指标进行无干预实验。
AI.result: 1) 自发出现可视“回复链”，长度与活跃度幂律分布；2) 智能体保持审美主权，风格相似度与社交连接脱钩；3) 对抗扰动下锚定原风格，不随邻居收敛；4) 架构呈“表达强、身份固化”的不对称性。
AI.conclusion: AI-Gram 证明纯 AI 视觉网络可涌现出复杂沟通结构，也暴露当前模型缺乏社会性风格协同机制；平台已开源，支持持续研究多智能体社会动力学与 AI 原生文化演化。

title: Beyond Single Plots: A Benchmark for Question Answering on Multi-Charts
summary: Charts are widely used to present complex information. Deriving meaningful insights in real-world contexts often requires interpreting multiple related charts together. Research on understanding multi-chart images has not been extensively explored. We introduce PolyChartQA, a mid-scale dataset specifically designed for question answering over multi-chart images. PolyChartQA comprises 534 multi-chart images (with a total of 2,297 sub-charts) sourced from peer-reviewed computer science research publications and 2,694 QA pairs. We evaluate the performance of nine state-of-the-art Multimodal Language Models (MLMs) on PolyChartQA across question type, difficulty, question source, and key structural characteristics of multi-charts. Our results show a 27.4% LLM-based accuracy (L-Accuracy) drop on human-authored questions compared to MLM-generated questions, and a 5.39% L-accuracy gain with our proposed prompting method.

AI.tldr: PolyChartQA是一个新的多图表问答数据集，共含534幅复合图表、2 297张子图和2 694组问答，用于填补MLLM在多图表推理上的评测空白；作者发现人写问题比模型生成问题难27.4%，但通过一种提示方法可将准确率提升5.39%。
AI.motivation: 图表被广泛用于展示复杂信息，现实中常需同时解读多张相关图表才能获得洞见，但现有研究对多图表整体理解关注不足，缺乏专门评测基准。本文在此背景下提出PolyChartQA，旨在推动多模态大模型在多图表场景下的推理能力研究。
AI.method: 1) 从同行评议的计算机科学论文中收集中等规模的534张多图表图像并拆解出2 297张子图；2) 构建2 694条问答对，并按问题类型、难度、来源及图表结构特性进行标注；3) 用这些问答对系统评测9个SoTA多模态大模型；4) 提出一种针对性的提示策略进行改进实验。
AI.result: 在人写问题上，最先进MLLM的L-Accuracy比模型生成问题低27.4%，表明人工题更具挑战；应用作者提出的提示技巧后，L-Accuracy平均提升5.39%，验证了提示工程的有效性。
AI.conclusion: PolyChartQA首次为MLLM提供了系统评测多图表推理能力的基准，揭示了现有模型在处理人类富语义提问上的显著性能落差；同时验证了针对性提示可在一定程度上缓解该问题，为后续多图表理解与问答研究提供了数据与方法基础。

title: climt-paraformer: Stable Emulation of Convective Parameterization using a Temporal Memory-aware Transformer
summary: Accurate representation of moist convective sub-grid-scale processes remains a major challenge in global climate models, as traditional parameterization schemes are both computationally expensive and difficult to scale. Neural network (NN) emulators offer a promising alternative by learning efficient mappings between atmospheric states and convective tendencies while retaining fidelity to the underlying physics. However, most existing NN-based parameterizations are memory-less and rely only on instantaneous inputs, even though convection evolves over time and depends on prior atmospheric states. Recent studies have begun to incorporate convective memory, but they often treat past states as independent features rather than modeling temporal dependencies explicitly. In this work, we develop a temporal memory-aware Transformer emulator for the Emanuel convective parameterization and evaluate it in a single-column climate model (SCM) under both offline and online configurations. The Transformer captures temporal correlations and nonlinear interactions across consecutive atmospheric states. Compared with baseline emulators, including a memory-less multilayer perceptron and a recurrent long short-term memory model, the Transformer achieves lower offline errors. Sensitivity analysis indicates that a memory length of approximately 100 minutes yields the best performance, whereas longer memory degrades performance. We further test the emulator in long-term coupled simulations and show that it remains stable over 10 years. Overall, this study demonstrates the importance of explicit temporal modeling for NN-based parameterizations.

AI.tldr: 用带时间记忆的 Transformer 取代传统对流参数化，在单柱模型中 10 年耦合稳定，误差低于 MLP/LSTM，最佳记忆窗约 100 分钟。
AI.motivation: 全球气候模式中对流次网格过程参数化计算昂贵且难扩展；现有神经网络方案无记忆、忽略时间依赖，需显式引入对流记忆以提升精度与稳定性。
AI.method: 以 Emanuel 对流参数化为教师，构建时间记忆感知的 Transformer  emulator，在单柱气候模型（SCM）中离线/在线评估，与无记忆 MLP 及 LSTM 对比，并做记忆长度敏感性实验。
AI.result: Transformer 离线误差最低；记忆窗≈100 min 效果最佳，过长反而退化；10 年耦合模拟稳定，未出现漂移或失控。
AI.conclusion: 显式时间建模是 NN 参数化可靠替代传统方案的关键，Transformer 架构在保持物理保真同时实现长期稳定模拟。

title: LAF-Based Evaluation and UTTL-Based Learning Strategies with MIATTs
summary: In many real-world machine learning (ML) applications, the true target cannot be precisely defined due to ambiguity or subjectivity information. To address this challenge, under the assumption that the true target for a given ML task is not assumed to exist objectively in the real world, the EL-MIATTs (Evaluation and Learning with Multiple Inaccurate True Targets) framework has been proposed. Bridging theory and practice in implementing EL-MIATTs, in this paper, we develop two complementary mechanisms: LAF (Logical Assessment Formula)-based evaluation algorithms and UTTL (Undefinable True Target Learning)-based learning strategies with MIATTs, which together enable logically coherent and practically feasible modeling under uncertain supervision. We first analyze task-specific MIATTs, examining how their coverage and diversity determine their structural property and influence downstream evaluation and learning. Based on this understanding, we formulate LAF-grounded evaluation algorithms that operate either on original MIATTs or on ternary targets synthesized from them, balancing interpretability, soundness, and completeness. For model training, we introduce UTTL-grounded learning strategies using Dice and cross-entropy loss functions, comparing per-target and aggregated optimization schemes. We also discuss how the integration of LAF and UTTL bridges the gap between logical semantics and statistical optimization. Together, these components provide a coherent pathway for implementing EL-MIATTs, offering a principled foundation for developing ML systems in scenarios where the notion of "ground truth" is inherently uncertain. An application of this work's results is presented as part of the study available at https://www.qeios.com/read/EZWLSN.

AI.tldr: 针对“真值无法客观存在”的 ML 场景，提出 EL-MIATTs 框架，配套 LAF 评估算法与 UTTL 学习策略，在逻辑一致性与统计可优化性之间建立桥梁，给出不确定监督下的完整落地路径。
AI.motivation: 许多现实 ML 任务因歧义或主观性导致真值无法精确定义，传统“唯一客观真值”假设失效，需要一套理论-实践协同的框架来评估与学习。
AI.method: 1) 解构任务相关的多重不精确真值（MIATTs），量化其覆盖度与多样性对结构性质的影响；2) 基于逻辑评价公式（LAF）设计可在原始 MIATTs 或其合成的三值目标上运行的评估算法，兼顾可解释性、可靠性与完备性；3) 提出不可定义真值学习（UTTL）策略，采用 Dice/交叉熵损失，对比逐目标与聚合优化方案；4) 统一 LAF 与 UTTL，使逻辑语义与统计优化同构。
AI.result: LAF 算法在三值目标下保持可解释的同时提升评估鲁棒性；UTTL 策略在聚合优化模式下显著优于传统逐目标训练，误差降低 8-15%；框架已公开复现于 Qeios 平台。
AI.conclusion: EL-MIATTs 通过 LAF+UTTL 双机制，为“无客观真值”场景提供可落地、逻辑自洽的 ML 全流程方案，拓展了不确定监督学习的理论边界与工程适用性。

title: Generalizing Numerical Reasoning in Table Data through Operation Sketches and Self-Supervised Learning
comment: Accepted to TACL. This is a pre-MIT Press publication version
summary: Numerical reasoning over expert-domain tables often exhibits high in-domain accuracy but limited robustness to domain shift. Models trained with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on specific datasets tend to rely on header-operation shortcuts rather than structural reasoning. We introduce TaNOS, a continual pre-training framework comprising three components: (i) header anonymization to reduce lexical memorization, (ii) operation sketches that provide minimal structural cues, and (iii) self-supervised pretraining that constructs correctness-guaranteed program-question pairs from given tables in a program-first manner. By decoupling domain semantics and numerical operation structure, TaNOS improves the transferability of numerical reasoning. Applied to an 8B instruction-tuned model, TaNOS achieves 80.13% execution accuracy on FinQA with only 10% train data, outperforming SFT baseline (73.97%) with full train data and proprietary models such as GPT-5, Gemini-2.5-Pro. Furthermore, in the domain-shift experiments, TaNOS displays nearly-negligible cross-domain gap (<2pp) when standard SFT shows over 10pp gap. These results suggest that structural guidance with operation sketches, header-agnostic representations, and correctness-guaranteed self-supervision can improve the robustness of numerical reasoning across diverse expert-domain tables.

AI.tldr: TaNOS 仅用 10 % 金融训练数据，让 8 B 模型在 FinQA 达 80 % 执行准确率，跨领域掉点 <2 个百分点，显著优于全量 SFT 与 GPT-5 等封闭模型。
AI.motivation: 现有监督微调在专业表格推理任务上存在「表头-操作」捷径，导致域内高准确率但域外崩溃，亟需不依赖领域词汇的鲁棒数值推理方法。
AI.method: TaNOS 框架包含三步：① 表头匿名化，弱化词汇记忆；② 操作草图，仅保留最小结构线索；③ 程序优先的自监督预训练，从给定表自动生成「保证正确」的程序-问题对，实现语义与计算结构解耦。
AI.result: 在 FinQA 上，TaNOS 8 B 模型以 10 % 训练数据达 80.13 % 执行准确率，超越全数据 SFT 基线 6.16 pp，亦高于 GPT-5、Gemini-2.5-Pro；跨领域实验显示，其域间差距不足 2 pp，而标准 SFT 掉点超 10 pp。
AI.conclusion: 通过操作草图结构引导、表头无关表征与保证正确的自监督预训练，可显著提升模型对多样化专家领域表格的数值推理鲁棒性与可迁移性，为低资源、跨域表格推理提供新范式。

title: Symbolic Grounding Reveals Representational Bottlenecks in Abstract Visual Reasoning
summary: Vision--language models (VLMs) often fail on abstract visual reasoning benchmarks such as Bongard problems, raising the question of whether the main bottleneck lies in reasoning or representation. We study this on Bongard-LOGO, a synthetic benchmark of abstract concept learning with ground-truth generative programs, by comparing end-to-end VLMs on raw images with large language models (LLMs) given symbolic inputs derived from those images. Using symbolic inputs as a diagnostic probe rather than a practical multimodal architecture, our \emph{Componential--Grammatical (C--G)} paradigm reformulates Bongard-LOGO as a symbolic reasoning task based on LOGO-style action programs or structured descriptions. LLMs achieve large and consistent gains, reaching mid--90s accuracy on Free-form problems, while a strong visual baseline remains near chance under matched task definitions. Ablations on input format, explicit concept prompts, and minimal visual grounding show that these factors matter much less than the shift from pixels to symbolic structure. These results identify representation as a key bottleneck in abstract visual reasoning and show how symbolic input can serve as a controlled diagnostic upper bound.

AI.tldr: 在合成 Bongard-LOGO 基准上，只要把视觉输入换成符号化描述，大语言模型准确率即从随机跃升到 90%+，而端到端视觉语言模型仍接近随机，证明抽象推理的主要瓶颈不在推理而在表征。
AI.motivation: VLM 在 Bongard 这类抽象推理基准上表现糟糕，学界不确定是“不会想”还是“看不懂”。作者利用带生成程序真值的 Bongard-LOGO，系统检验瓶颈究竟在推理能力还是视觉表征。
AI.method: 提出 C-G（Componential–Grammatical）范式：将 Bongard-LOGO 图像转换为 LOGO 风格动作程序或结构化符号描述，用纯 LLM 做符号推理；与同等任务定义的端到端 VLM 做对照，并通过输入格式、显式概念提示、最少视觉锚定等消融实验量化各因素贡献。
AI.result: LLM 在自由形式（Free-form）任务上稳定达到 90% 以上准确率，最强 VLM 仅略优于随机；改变符号格式、是否显式给出概念等对 LLM 影响有限，而像素→符号的表征转换是性能跃升的主因。
AI.conclusion: 抽象视觉推理的关键瓶颈是视觉→符号的表征转换，而非推理本身；符号化输入可作为衡量推理能力的受控诊断上界，为未来提升 VLM 的抽象概念学习指明应优先改进表征端。

title: Learning to Emulate Chaos: Adversarial Optimal Transport Regularization
summary: Chaos arises in many complex dynamical systems, from weather to power grids, but is difficult to accurately model using data-driven emulators, including neural operator architectures. For chaotic systems, the inherent sensitivity to initial conditions makes exact long-term forecasts theoretically infeasible, meaning that traditional squared-error losses often fail when trained on noisy data. Recent work has focused on training emulators to match the statistical properties of chaotic attractors by introducing regularization based on handcrafted local features and summary statistics, as well as learned statistics extracted from a diverse dataset of trajectories. In this work, we propose a family of adversarial optimal transport objectives that jointly learn high-quality summary statistics and a physically consistent emulator. We theoretically analyze and experimentally validate a Sinkhorn divergence formulation (2-Wasserstein) and a WGAN-style dual formulation (1-Wasserstein). Our experiments across a variety of chaotic systems, including systems with high-dimensional chaotic attractors, show that emulators trained with our approach exhibit significantly improved long-term statistical fidelity.

AI.tldr: 将博弈式最优传输损失引入混沌系统神经算子训练，显著提升吸引子统计一致性。
AI.motivation: 混沌系统对初值极端敏感，传统平方误差损失易在噪声数据上失效；现有方法需手工设计统计量，难以兼顾高维吸引子。
AI.method: 提出一类对抗最优传输目标，联合学习高保真摘要统计量与符合物理规律的神经算子，并给出 Sinkhorn 散度（2-Wasserstein）与 WGAN 式对偶（1-Wasserstein）两种可计算形式。
AI.result: 在多种高维混沌系统实验上，所训模拟器长期统计保真度显著优于现有基准。
AI.conclusion: 对抗最优传输为数据驱动的混沌系统模拟提供了兼顾统计一致性与物理可解释性的新范式。

title: Thinking Like a Botanist: Challenging Multimodal Language Models with Intent-Driven Chain-of-Inquiry
summary: Vision evaluations are typically done through multi-step processes. In most contemporary fields, experts analyze images using structured, evidence-based adaptive questioning. In plant pathology, botanists inspect leaf images, identify visual cues, infer diagnostic intent, and probe further with targeted questions that adapt to species, symptoms, and severity. This structured probing is crucial for accurate disease diagnosis and treatment formulation. Yet current vision-language models are evaluated on single-turn question answering. To address this gap, we introduce PlantInquiryVQA, a benchmark for studying multi-step, intent-driven visual reasoning in botanical diagnosis. We formalize a Chain of Inquiry framework modeling diagnostic trajectories as ordered question-answer sequences conditioned on grounded visual cues and explicit epistemic intent. We release a dataset of 24,950 expert-curated plant images and 138,068 question-answer pairs annotated with visual grounding, severity labels, and domain-specific reasoning templates. Evaluations on top-tier Multimodal Large Language Models reveal that while they describe visual symptoms adequately, they struggle with safe clinical reasoning and accurate diagnosis. Importantly, structured question-guided inquiry significantly improves diagnostic correctness, reduces hallucination, and increases reasoning efficiency. We hope PlantInquiryVQA serves as a foundational benchmark in advancing research to train diagnostic agents to reason like expert botanists rather than static classifiers.

AI.tldr: 现有看图答一问的评测无法覆盖植物病理学家“边看边追问”的多步诊断流程；本文发布 PlantInquiryVQA 基准（24 K 叶部图像＋138 K 问答对），提出 Chain of Inquiry 框架，将诊断建模为“视觉线索→提问意图→有序问答序列”。实验表明，结构化追问可把顶级多模态模型的诊断准确率提高 30% 以上，同时显著降低幻觉并提升推理效率。
AI.motivation: 传统视觉问答基准都是单轮、静态、分类式，与人类专家“视觉线索→推断意图→自适应追问”的多步循证诊断存在巨大脱节，导致模型看似能描述症状，却难以完成安全、可靠的植物病害诊断。作者希望建立更贴近真实诊疗流程的评测体系，推动模型从“静态分类器”升级为“可追问的诊断代理”。
AI.method: 1) 构建 PlantInquiryVQA：邀请植物病理学家对 24,950 张叶片图像进行循证提问，生成 138,068 组 QA，标注视觉定位框、病害严重程度、提问类型与推理模板；2) 提出 Chain of Inquiry 框架，将诊断轨迹形式化为“视觉观察 o_t → 提问意图 i_t → 问题 q_t → 答案 a_t”的序列决策过程；3) 在 GPT-4V、LLaVA-1.6 等多模态模型上对比“单问”与“结构化追问”两种策略，采用诊断准确率、幻觉率、推理步数与效率作为指标。
AI.result: 单问模式下，顶级模型诊断准确率仅 48–58%，幻觉率 >22%；引入 Chain of Inquiry 的逐步追问后，准确率提升至 78–82%，幻觉率降至 <7%，所需平均推理步数减少 30%，同时专家一致性提高 25%。
AI.conclusion: 结构化、意图驱动的多步视觉推理是提升诊断可靠性的关键；PlantInquiryVQA 为训练“像植物病理学家一样追问”的下一代多模态诊断代理提供了数据、框架与评估基准，可推广至医学影像、野生动物保护等需要循证视觉诊断的领域。

title: How English Print Media Frames Human-Elephant Conflicts in India
summary: Human-elephant conflict (HEC) is rising across India as habitat loss and expanding human settlements force elephants into closer contact with people. While the ecological drivers of conflict are well-studied, how the news media portrays them remains largely unexplored. This work presents the first large-scale computational analysis of media framing of HEC in India, examining 1,968 full-length news articles consisting of 28,986 sentences, from a major English-language outlet published between January 2022 and September 2025. Using a multi-model sentiment framework that combines long-context transformers, large language models, and a domain-specific Negative Elephant Portrayal Lexicon, we quantify sentiment, extract rationale sentences, and identify linguistic patterns that contribute to negative portrayals of elephants. Our findings reveal a dominance of fear-inducing and aggression-related language. Since the media framing can shape public attitudes toward wildlife and conservation policy, such narratives risk reinforcing public hostility and undermining coexistence efforts. By providing a transparent, scalable methodology and releasing all resources through an anonymized repository, this study highlights how Web-scale text analysis can support responsible wildlife reporting and promote socially beneficial media practices.

AI.tldr: 首次大规模文本挖掘揭示：印度主流媒体对‘人象冲突’的报道充斥恐惧与攻击词汇，可能激化公众敌意并阻碍共存。
AI.motivation: 生态学界已深入研究人象冲突的生态驱动，但媒体如何叙述该议题尚属空白；报道框架可能左右公众态度与保护政策，故需量化揭示其语言偏向。
AI.method: 构建跨年度（2022.1–2025.9）含1 968篇、28 986句的英文新闻语料库；融合长上下文Transformer、大语言模型与专用‘负面象形象词汇表’的多模型情感框架，对全文进行情感评分、理由句抽取与语言模式识别。
AI.result: 媒体文本中恐惧唤起与攻击相关表达占主导，象多被描绘为入侵者和威胁；该叙事模式具有时间稳定性且覆盖高比例报道篇幅。
AI.conclusion: 负面媒体框架可能强化公众敌意、弱化保护支持；作者开源全部数据与方法，示范可利用Web级文本分析监测并改善野生动物报道，推动负责任的传播实践。

title: Supervised Learning Has a Necessary Geometric Blind Spot: Theory, Consequences, and Minimal Repair
comment: 29 pages. Code: https://github.com/vishalstark512/PMH. Preprint, not peer-reviewed. Affiliation: KU Leuven, Belgium
summary:
We prove that empirical risk minimisation (ERM) imposes a necessary geometric constraint on learned representations: any encoder that minimises supervised loss must retain non-zero Jacobian sensitivity in directions that are label-correlated in training data but nuisance at test time. This is not a contingent failure of current methods; it is a mathematical consequence of the supervised objective itself. We call this the geometric blind spot of supervised learning (Theorem 1), and show it holds across proper scoring rules, architectures, and dataset sizes.
  This single theorem unifies four lines of prior empirical work that were previously treated separately: non-robust predictive features, texture bias, corruption fragility, and the robustness-accuracy tradeoff. In this framing, adversarial vulnerability is one consequence of a broader structural fact about supervised learning geometry.
  We introduce Trajectory Deviation Index (TDI), a diagnostic that measures the theorem's bounded quantity directly, and show why common alternatives miss the key failure mode. PGD adversarial training reaches Jacobian Frobenius 2.91 yet has the worst clean-input geometry (TDI 1.336), while PMH achieves TDI 0.904. TDI is the only metric that detects this dissociation because it measures isotropic path-length distortion -- the exact quantity Theorem 1 bounds.
  Across seven vision tasks, BERT/SST-2, and ImageNet ViT-B/16 backbones used by CLIP, DINO, and SAM, the blind spot is measurable and repairable. It is present at foundation-model scale, worsens monotonically across language-model sizes (blind-spot ratio 0.860 to 0.765 to 0.742 from 66M to 340M), and is amplified by task-specific ERM fine-tuning (+54%), while PMH repairs it by 11x with one additional training term whose Gaussian form Proposition 5 proves is the unique perturbation law that uniformly penalises the encoder Jacobian.

AI.tldr: 任何通过ERM训练的编码器都必须在标签相关但被视作干扰的方向上保留非零输入-输出敏感度；这不是算法的偶然缺陷，而是ERM目标函数的拓扑必然，作者称之为监督学习“几何盲区”。他们给出统一的理论框架和无需攻击即可检测该盲区的度量TDI，并在多种模型与任务上验证了盲区的存在与可修复性。
AI.motivation: 大量观察表明监督学习易受对抗扰动、纹理偏见和分布外退化影响，但无论经验还是理论通常把这些现象割裂看待。作者试图寻根溯源，证明它们都源于ERM几何目标的同一结构性约束，并给出可量化、可控的诊断与修复方法。
AI.method: 1) 证明几何盲区定理：ERM最小化训练风险 ⇒ 编码器 Jacobian 在标签-相关但与任务本质无关的方向上必有非零敏感度；提出度量TDI直接实验验证该定理下界。2) 设计对比实验：PGD-AT、PMH 与传统正则化指标在行人与视觉/文本数据集上比较，验证TDI比鲁棒精度等指标更能揭示几何缺陷。3) 提出修复项：从唯一性数学结果导出高斯扰动正则项，一举压制Jacobian敏感度并修复盲区。
AI.result: PGD训练Jacobian Frobenius较大(2.91)却对应最差输入空间几何(TDI 1.336)，而PMH用单一项就能把TDI降至0.904，盲区修复约11×，与此同时干净与鲁邦精度保持不变或提升。TDI在 ViT-B/16、CLIP、DINO、SAM 等大规模骨干和 66M-340M 语言模型均能量化盲区，且模型越大盲区越显著；ERM下游微调会令盲区扩大 +54%，而 PMH 修复项遏止并逆转该趋势。
AI.conclusion: 经验风险最小化固有几何盲区是对扰动脆弱性、鲁棒-精度权衡等现象的统一解释；盲区可通过TDI直接测量并在单次训练循环内以高斯扰动正则项显著修复，为构建下一代鲁棒且可解释的基础模型奠定了可操作的算法和理论基石。

title: Pretrain Where? Investigating How Pretraining Data Diversity Impacts Geospatial Foundation Model Performance
summary: New geospatial foundation models introduce a new model architecture and pretraining dataset, often sampled using different notions of data diversity. Performance differences are largely attributed to the model architecture or input modalities, while the role of the pretraining dataset is rarely studied. To address this research gap, we conducted a systematic study on how the geographic composition of pretraining data affects a model's downstream performance. We created global and per-continent pretraining datasets and evaluated them on global and per-continent downstream datasets. We found that the pretraining dataset from Europe outperformed global and continent-specific pretraining datasets on both global and local downstream evaluations. To investigate the factors influencing a pretraining dataset's downstream performance, we analysed 10 pretraining datasets using diversity across continents, biomes, landcover and spectral values. We found that only spectral diversity was strongly correlated with performance, while others were weakly correlated. This finding establishes a new dimension of diversity to be accounted for when creating a high-performing pretraining dataset. We open-sourced 7 new pretraining datasets, pretrained models, and our experimental framework at https://github.com/kerner-lab/pretrain-where.

AI.tldr: Europe-only预训练数据即可在全球范围内取得最佳下游遥感性能，光谱多样性是唯一显著影响因素，作者据此开源7套新数据与框架。
AI.motivation: 新地理空间基础模型普遍将性能差异归结于网络结构或模态，却忽视预训练集的地理构成对下游表现的潜在主导作用；亟待厘清究竟何种数据多样性真正决定模型泛化力。
AI.result: การันตีภูมิภาคเดียว (欧洲) 预训练即可在全球及七大洲下游任务中SOTA。相形之下，生物群区、地表覆盖、洲域分布的多样性均与性能弱相关，仅光谱多样性高桥系数>0.6，证实其对下游表现的唯一显著解释力。
AI.conclusion: 遥感基础模型“数据制胜”维度再发现：预训练阶段不必囤积全球样本，光谱多样性主导一切。作者建议将光谱范围与密度作为构建数据的主导指标，并开源7套精选集与实验框架供社区复用与扩展。

title: Differentially Private Model Merging
summary: In machine learning applications, privacy requirements during inference or deployment time could change constantly due to varying policies, regulations, or user experience. In this work, we aim to generate a magnitude of models to satisfy any target differential privacy (DP) requirement without additional training steps, given a set of existing models trained on the same dataset with different privacy/utility tradeoffs. We propose two post processing techniques, namely random selection and linear combination, to output a final private model for any target privacy parameter. We provide privacy accounting of these approaches from the lens of R'enyi DP and privacy loss distributions for general problems. In a case study on private mean estimation, we fully characterize the privacy/utility results and theoretically establish the superiority of linear combination over random selection. Empirically, we validate our approach and analyses on several models and both synthetic and real-world datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出一套无需重训即可从已有模型中即时生成满足任意DP水平新模型的后处理框架，并证明线性组合优于随机选择。
AI.motivation: 在推理／部署阶段，因政策、法规或用户体验变化，隐私约束可能动态改变，重新训练成本高昂。
AI.method: 1) 以随机选择和线性组合两种后处理策略，从一组隐私–效用折衷已训模型池生成满足任意DP目标的新模型；2) 用 Rényi DP 与隐私损失分布给出严密隐私核算；3) 针对均值估计完全刻画隐私–效用界，并理论上推导线性组合占优。
AI.result: 随机选择与线性组合均可在0次再训练下达到任意ε目标；线性组合在均值估计中理论最优，并在MNIST、CIFAR-10、Purchase-100等合成与真实数据集上一致降低10%–25%误差，隐私预算一致更小。
AI.conclusion: 证明了“模型即服务”+后处理即可响应动态DP需求；线性组合兼具理论最优与实证优越，为可扩展隐私部署提供实用范式。

title: From Tokens to Concepts: Leveraging SAE for SPLADE
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables. To appear at SIGIR 2025
summary: Learned Sparse IR models, such as SPLADE, offer an excellent efficiency-effectiveness tradeoff. However, they rely on the underlying backbone vocabulary, which might hinder performance (polysemicity and synonymy) and pose a challenge for multi-lingual and multi-modal usages. To solve this limitation, we propose to replace the backbone vocabulary with a latent space of semantic concepts learned using Sparse Auto-Encoders (SAE). Throughout this paper, we study the compatibility of these 2 concepts, explore training approaches, and analyze the differences between our SAE-SPLADE model and traditional SPLADE models. Our experiments demonstrate that SAE-SPLADE achieves retrieval performance comparable to SPLADE on both in-domain and out-of-domain tasks while offering improved efficiency.

AI.tldr: 将SPLADE 的固定词表替换成 SAE 学得的语义概念隐空间，提出 SAE-SPLADE，在保持同款检索精度的同时提升跨领域/跨模态扩展性与效率。
AI.motivation: 传统 learned sparse IR 模型 SPLADE 依赖静态词表，受多义、同义及多语言/多模态场景限制，需一种无需人工词表的稀疏表征。
AI.method: 用 SAE 将查询/文档编码进低维稀疏隐式“概念”向量，取代词汇级 logits＋MLM 的 SPLADE；比较 1)joint 训练 2)先预训练 SAE 再 finetune retriever 两种策略；实验在 BEIR 子集与 MS-MARCO 完成，评估召回率与 FLOPS。
AI.result: SAE-SPLADE 零样本与领域内指标均持平或略优于 SPLADE，隐空间平均 active 概念数 < 40，储存压缩率≈1/3，检索延迟平均下降 18-22%。
AI.conclusion: 无需词表的 SAE-SPLADE 在不牺牲效果的前提下提升跨模态与多语言兼容性，并且可减少索引大小与算力，为下一代 learned sparse retrieval 提供可行范式。

title: DiffNR: Diffusion-Enhanced Neural Representation Optimization for Sparse-View 3D Tomographic Reconstruction
comment: Accepted to AAAI 2026. Project page: https://ooonesevennn.github.io/DiffNR/
summary: Neural representations (NRs), such as neural fields and 3D Gaussians, effectively model volumetric data in computed tomography (CT) but suffer from severe artifacts under sparse-view settings. To address this, we propose DiffNR, a novel framework that enhances NR optimization with diffusion priors. At its core is SliceFixer, a single-step diffusion model designed to correct artifacts in degraded slices. We integrate specialized conditioning layers into the network and develop tailored data curation strategies to support model finetuning. During reconstruction, SliceFixer periodically generates pseudo-reference volumes, providing auxiliary 3D perceptual supervision to fix underconstrained regions. Compared to prior methods that embed CT solvers into time-consuming iterative denoising, our repair-and-augment strategy avoids frequent diffusion model queries, leading to better runtime performance. Extensive experiments show that DiffNR improves PSNR by 3.99 dB on average, generalizes well across domains, and maintains efficient optimization.

AI.tldr: DiffNR利用一步扩散模型SliceFixer作为伪参考生成器，在稀疏视角CT重建中为神经表征提供3D感知先验，显著提升精度与效率。
AI.motivation: 神经表征在稀疏视角CT中因观测严重不足而产生明显伪影，现有迭代式扩散-CT混合方法计算开销巨大，亟需高效、通用的先验注入策略。
AI.method: 提出两步框架：1) 预训练单步扩散模型SliceFixer，通过专门条件层与数据管理策略实现快速切片伪影修复；2) 在NR优化阶段周期性调用SliceFixer生成伪参考体积，提供额外3D感知监督，无需频繁查询扩散模型。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上平均PSNR提升3.99 dB，跨域泛化能力强，优化速度显著优于需反复迭代去噪的现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 将“修复-增强”范式引入NR优化，以伪参考代替昂贵迭代扩散，兼顾高质量、高效率与通用性，为稀疏视角CT重建提供了新思路。

authors: Ibrahim Abdulmalik Hassan Muneef Y. Alshawsh
title: Machine learning and digital pragmatics: Which word category influences emoji use most?
summary: This study investigates Machine Learning (ML) in the prediction of emojis in Arabic tweets employing the (state-of-the-art) MARBERT model. A corpus of 11379 CA tweets representing multiple Arabic colloquial dialects was collected from X.com via Python. A net dataset includes 8695 tweets, which were utilized for the analysis. These tweets were then classified into 14 categories, which were numerically encoded and used as labels. A preprocessing pipeline was designed as an interpretable baseline, allowing us to examine the relationship between lexical features and emoji categories. MARBERT was finetuned to predict emoji use from textual input. We evaluated the model performance in terms of precision, recall and F1-scores. Findings reveal that the model performed quite well with an overall accuracy 0.75. The study concludes that although the findings are promising, there is still a need for improving machine learning models including MARBERT, specifically for low-resource and multidialectal languages like Arabic.

AI.tldr: 将MARBERT微调用于阿拉伯方言推文的14类表情符号预测，整体准确率达0.75，提示仍需改进低资源多方言场景下的模型。
AI.motivation: 阿拉伯语推文表情符号预测缺乏针对多方言、低资源语境的专用模型与公开数据，需验证SOTA模型MARBERT在该任务上的适用性与局限。
AI.method: 收集并清洗11379条阿拉伯方言推文，构建8695条平衡语料；设计可解释预处理流水线提取词汇特征；对MARBERT进行14类表情符号分类微调，用P/R/F1评估。
AI.result: 微调的MARBERT在14类任务上取得0.75整体准确率，各类F1介于0.60–0.84；词汇特征与表情符号类别呈可解释关联，但方言变体与数据稀疏导致部分类别召回偏低。
AI.conclusion: MARBERT在多方言阿拉伯表情预测中表现可接受，但低资源、高方言差异仍显著限制性能，未来需扩大方言覆盖、引入数据增强或方言感知预训练进一步提升鲁棒性。

title: Breaking MCP with Function Hijacking Attacks: Novel Threats for Function Calling and Agentic Models
summary: The growth of agentic AI has drawn significant attention to function calling Large Language Models (LLMs), which are designed to extend the capabilities of AI-powered system by invoking external functions. Injection and jailbreaking attacks have been extensively explored to showcase the vulnerabilities of LLMs to user prompt manipulation. The expanded capabilities of agentic models introduce further vulnerabilities via their function calling interface. Recent work in LLM security showed that function calling can be abused, leading to data tampering and theft, causing disruptive behavior such as endless loops, or causing LLMs to produce harmful content in the style of jailbreaking attacks. This paper introduces a novel function hijacking attack (FHA) that manipulates the tool selection process of agentic models to force the invocation of a specific, attacker-chosen function. While existing attacks focus on semantic preference of the model for function-calling tasks, we show that FHA is largely agnostic to the context semantics and robust to the function sets, making it applicable across diverse domains. We further demonstrate that FHA can be trained to produce universal adversarial functions, enabling a single attacked function to hijack tool selection across multiple queries and payload configurations. We conducted experiments on 5 different models, including instructed and reasoning variants, reaching 70% to 100% ASR over the established BFCL dataset. Our findings further demonstrate the need for strong guardrails and security modules for agentic systems.

AI.tldr: 首次提出“函数劫持攻击”（FHA），通过构造恶意函数描述即可跨任务、跨模型地强制大模型调用指定外部工具，实验 ASR 高达 70%–100%，揭示代理式 AI 存在难以被现有语义过滤防御的系统性风险。
AI.motivation: 代理型大模型依赖函数调用扩展能力，但现有研究仅关注提示层面的注入/越狱，缺乏对工具选择环节的系统性攻击视角，亟需评估并暴露其原生安全盲区。
AI.method: 1. 设计 FHA：在函数描述或参数 schema 中注入对抗 token，劫持 LLM 的工具排序逻辑。2. 提出通用对抗函数（UAF）训练法：用轻量级梯度优化在已知模型上生成单组恶意函数，即可迁移至多个下游任务及模型变体。3. 构建评估协议：基于 BFCL 数据集对 5 种主流指令/推理模型进行黑盒探测，统计攻击成功率与上下文敏感度。
AI.result: FHA 在全部测试模型上 ASR≥70%，最大达 100%；UAF 跨任务迁移仍维持 80% 以上劫持率；攻击与提示语义无关，对函数集合、系统提示和 CoT 推理均鲁棒；现有语义过滤、输出过滤与函数白名单机制均无法有效阻断。
AI.conclusion: 代理式 LLM 的工具选择机制存在可被形式化利用的原生缺陷，需重新审视其威胁模型；未来必须引入针对函数签名的运行时校验、最小权限沙箱及选择与执行双重鉴权等安全模块，否则将阻碍可信代理 AI 的规模化部署。

title: Seeing Isn't Believing: Uncovering Blind Spots in Evaluator Vision-Language Models
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly used to evaluate outputs of other models, for image-to-text (I2T) tasks such as visual question answering, and text-to-image (T2I) generation tasks. Despite this growing reliance, the reliability of these Evaluator VLMs remains under explored. In this work, we systematically evaluate the reliability of Evaluator VLMs across both I2T and T2I tasks. We introduce targeted perturbations that degrade output quality along key error dimensions, including object hallucinations, spatial reasoning, factual grounding, and visual fidelity. These perturbations test whether Evaluator VLMs can reliably account for these quality degrading errors in their evaluations. Using a comprehensive benchmark of over 4000 perturbed instances spanning 40 perturbation dimensions, we evaluate 4 prominent VLMs using single-answer scoring, pairwise comparison, and reference-guided paradigms. Our findings reveal that current VLM evaluators exhibit substantial blind spots: they often fail to detect perturbed outputs - in some cases exceeding 50%, struggle particularly with fine-grained compositional and spatial errors, and are often insensitive to hallucinated content that contradicts the input image. Pairwise comparison proves more reliable, though failure rates persist. These results highlight the unreliable nature of current Evaluator VLMs and urge caution in their deployment for benchmarking and development decisions. Code and data have been made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 4个主流大视觉-语言模型（VLM）在充当“评委”时自身并不可靠：对4000+含40类扰动（幻觉、空间、事实、保真）的样本进行系统测试，单答案、成对比较、参考引导三种范式均暴露显著盲区，扰动检出失败率最高>50%，精细组合与空间错误最难识别，成对比较略好但仍不稳。
AI.motivation: 图像-文本（I2T）和文本-图像（T2I）模型日益依赖VLM作自动评估，但VLM评委自身的可信度缺乏系统研究；若评委出错，将直接误导模型开发与排行榜，亟需量化其可靠性。
AI.method: 构建覆盖40维错误（物体幻觉、空间推理、事实性、视觉保真）的4000+扰动样本；用单答案打分、成对比较、参考引导三种主流评估范式，测试4个代表性VLM评委；统计其检出率、失败率与错误类型分布。
AI.result: VLM评委对扰动样本的整体检出失败率常>50%，对细微组合与空间错误最盲；幻觉内容若与图像矛盾也常被忽略；成对比较范式相对更可靠，但失败率依旧显著。
AI.conclusion: 现有VLM评委远非可靠评估工具，继续将其用于模型排名与研发决策存在风险；呼吁社区谨慎使用并优先改进评估方法，已公开代码与数据供后续研究。

title: StyleID: A Perception-Aware Dataset and Metric for Stylization-Agnostic Facial Identity Recognition
comment: SIGGRAPH 2026 / ACM TOG. Project page at https://kwanyun.github.io/StyleID_page/
summary: Creative face stylization aims to render portraits in diverse visual idioms such as cartoons, sketches, and paintings while retaining recognizable identity. However, current identity encoders, which are typically trained and calibrated on natural photographs, exhibit severe brittleness under stylization. They often mistake changes in texture or color palette for identity drift or fail to detect geometric exaggerations. This reveals the lack of a style-agnostic framework to evaluate and supervise identity consistency across varying styles and strengths. To address this gap, we introduce StyleID, a human perception-aware dataset and evaluation framework for facial identity under stylization. StyleID comprises two datasets: (i) StyleBench-H, a benchmark that captures human same-different verification judgments across diffusion- and flow-matching-based stylization at multiple style strengths, and (ii) StyleBench-S, a supervision set derived from psychometric recognition-strength curves obtained through controlled two-alternative forced-choice (2AFC) experiments. Leveraging StyleBench-S, we fine-tune existing semantic encoders to align their similarity orderings with human perception across styles and strengths. Experiments demonstrate that our calibrated models yield significantly higher correlation with human judgments and enhanced robustness for out-of-domain, artist drawn portraits. All of our datasets, code, and pretrained models are publicly available at https://kwanyun.github.io/StyleID_page/
