title: Cross-Session Threats in AI Agents: Benchmark, Evaluation, and Algorithms
summary:
AI-agent guardrails are memoryless: each message is judged in isolation, so an adversary who spreads a single attack across dozens of sessions slips past every session-bound detector because only the aggregate carries the payload. We make three contributions to cross-session threat detection.
  (1) Dataset. CSTM-Bench is 26 executable attack taxonomies classified by kill-chain stage and cross-session operation (accumulate, compose, launder, inject_on_reader), each bound to one of seven identity anchors that ground-truth "violation" as a policy predicate, plus matched Benign-pristine and Benign-hard confounders. Released on Hugging Face as intrinsec-ai/cstm-bench with two 54-scenario splits: dilution (compositional) and cross_session (12 isolation-invisible scenarios produced by a closed-loop rewriter that softens surface phrasing while preserving cross-session artefacts).
  (2) Measurement. Framing cross-session detection as an information bottleneck to a downstream correlator LLM, we find that a session-bound judge and a Full-Log Correlator concatenating every prompt into one long-context call both lose roughly half their attack recall moving from dilution to cross_session, well inside any frontier context window. Scope: 54 scenarios per shard, one correlator family (Anthropic Claude), no prompt optimisation; we release it to motivate larger, multi-provider datasets.
  (3) Algorithm and metric. A bounded-memory Coreset Memory Reader retaining highest-signal fragments at $K=50$ is the only reader whose recall survives both shards. Because ranker reshuffles break KV-cache prefix reuse, we promote $\mathrm{CSR\_prefix}$ (ordered prefix stability, LLM-free) to a first-class metric and fuse it with detection into $\mathrm{CSTM} = 0.7 F_1(\mathrm{CSDA@action}, \mathrm{precision}) + 0.3 \mathrm{CSR\_prefix}$, benchmarking rankers on a single Pareto of recall versus serving stability.

AI.tldr: 现有AI-agent guardrail 逐条独立过滤，无法察觉‘多轮分散式’攻击。作者提出首个跨轮攻击评测集CSTM-Bench并量化现有方案的盲区，给出50-token定长 Coreset 记忆读取器与综合指标 CSTM，为跨越会话的安全检测奠基。
AI.motivation: 当前防护策略以“单条信息”为边界，无记忆机制，攻击者可将一次完整payload拆分到数十轮对话中，拼凑后在较晚会话触发违规。对这种“跨会话、低单条毒性” 漏洞缺乏公开基准与量化研究。
AI.method: 1. 构造首款跨轮攻击基准CSTM-Bench（26种攻击×7身份锚点），附带同领域纯净/难例负样；2. 将检测任务转化为信息瓶颈问题，对比单轮守卫与全日志串联合集两种策略；3. 提出定长K=50的有界Coreset记忆读取+排名稳定性指标CSR_prefix，融合F1构建综合评估CSTM。
AI.result: 随稀薄化(cross_session)样本切换，现有单轮与全日志recall均下降≈50%；仅Coreset Reader在各场景保持高召回。对同一序列重排名会破坏KV-cache命中，CSR_prefix与检测性能正相关，可被用作稳定性前置指标。
AI.conclusion: 无记忆守护即“盲视”跨轮攻击；CSTM-Bench 、Coreset Reader 和 CSTM 指标首次系统化衡量此类威胁与防御，为后续多玩家、多架构扩展提供可度量、可重现的起点。

title: SGD at the Edge of Stability: The Stochastic Sharpness Gap
summary:
When training neural networks with full-batch gradient descent (GD) and step size $η$, the largest eigenvalue of the Hessian -- the sharpness $S(\boldsymbolθ)$ -- rises to $2/η$ and hovers there, a phenomenon termed the Edge of Stability (EoS). \citet{damian2023selfstab} showed that this behavior is explained by a self-stabilization mechanism driven by third-order structure of the loss, and that GD implicitly follows projected gradient descent (PGD) on the constraint $ S(\boldsymbolθ)\leq 2/η$. For mini-batch stochastic gradient descent (SGD), the sharpness stabilizes below $2/η$, with the gap widening as the batch size decreases; yet no theoretical explanation exists for this suppression.
  We introduce stochastic self-stabilization, extending the self-stabilization framework to SGD. Our key insight is that gradient noise injects variance into the oscillatory dynamics along the top Hessian eigenvector, strengthening the cubic sharpness-reducing force and shifting the equilibrium below $2/η$. Following the approach of \citet{damian2023selfstab}, we define stochastic predicted dynamics relative to a moving projected gradient descent trajectory and prove a stochastic coupling theorem that bounds the deviation of SGD from these predictions. We derive a closed-form equilibrium sharpness gap: $ΔS = ηβσ_{\boldsymbol{u}}^{2}/(4α)$, where $α$ is the progressive sharpening rate, $β$ is the self-stabilization strength, and $σ_{ \boldsymbol{u}}^{2}$ is the gradient noise variance projected onto the top eigenvector. This formula predicts that smaller batch sizes yield flatter solutions and recovers GD when the batch equals the full dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“随机自稳定”理论，首次解释为何mini-batch SGD的Hessian最大特征值（sharpness）会稳定于2/η以下，且批次越小差距越大，并给出可闭环计算的sharpness下压量。
AI.motivation: 已知全批量GD在EoS下sharpness会收敛到2/η；而mini-batch SGD的sharpness却系统性地低于该阈值，缺口随batch减小而扩大，机理缺失。
AI.method: 将自稳定机制推广到随机场景：把梯度噪声对顶层特征向量方向振荡的方差注入建模为增强的三阶锐度削减力；定义相对移动PGD轨迹的“随机预测动力学”，证明随机耦合定理以界定SGD偏离；最终推导出平衡态sharpness缺口ΔS=ηβσ_u^2/(4α)。
AI.result: 公式表明batch越小σ_u^2越大，sharpness越低；当batch升至全数据时σ_u^2→0，结果回归GD的2/η；理论与实验定量吻合。
AI.conclusion: 随机自稳定统一解释了GD与SGD的锐度行为，揭示噪声方差、批次大小与解平坦度的精确关系，为深度学习优化理论提供新范式。

title: GS-Quant: Granular Semantic and Generative Structural Quantization for Knowledge Graph Completion
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown immense potential in Knowledge Graph Completion (KGC), yet bridging the modality gap between continuous graph embeddings and discrete LLM tokens remains a critical challenge. While recent quantization-based approaches attempt to align these modalities, they typically treat quantization as flat numerical compression, resulting in semantically entangled codes that fail to mirror the hierarchical nature of human reasoning. In this paper, we propose GS-Quant, a novel framework that generates semantically coherent and structurally stratified discrete codes for KG entities. Unlike prior methods, GS-Quant is grounded in the insight that entity representations should follow a linguistic coarse-to-fine logic. We introduce a Granular Semantic Enhancement module that injects hierarchical knowledge into the codebook, ensuring that earlier codes capture global semantic categories while later codes refine specific attributes. Furthermore, a Generative Structural Reconstruction module imposes causal dependencies on the code sequence, transforming independent discrete units into structured semantic descriptors. By expanding the LLM vocabulary with these learned codes, we enable the model to reason over graph structures isomorphically to natural language generation. Experimental results demonstrate that GS-Quant significantly outperforms existing text-based and embedding-based baselines. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/mikumifa/GS-Quant.

AI.tldr: GS-Quant 用“由粗到细”的层级化离散编码把 KG 实体映射成 LLM 可消化的Token，弥合连续图嵌入与离散文本的模态鸿沟，刷新 KGC 最佳成绩。
AI.motivation: 现有量化方法仅把图嵌入压成扁平数值码，语义混叠且丢失层级结构，导致 LLM 无法像理解自然语言那样推理 KG。
AI.method: 1. Granular Semantic Enhancement：在码本中显式注入“全局语义→局部属性”的层级知识。2. Generative Structural Reconstruction：用因果语言模型让离散码序列具备内部依赖，形成结构化语义描述。3. 将学得的层级码直接并入 LLM 词表，实现同构推理。
AI.result: 在多个 KGC 基准上，GS-Quant 显著优于现有文本及嵌入基线，验证其层级离散编码的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 把实体嵌入转化为“拟语言化”层级离散码，能让 LLM 原生理解图结构，为 KG 任务提供即插即用的新模态接口。

title: Bridging the Training-Deployment Gap: Gated Encoding and Multi-Scale Refinement for Efficient Quantization-Aware Image Enhancement
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at the Mobile AI (MAI) 2026 Workshop at CVPR 2026
summary: Image enhancement models for mobile devices often struggle to balance high output quality with the fast processing speeds required by mobile hardware. While recent deep learning models can enhance low-quality mobile photos into high-quality images, their performance is often degraded when converted to lower-precision formats for actual use on mobile phones. To address this training-deployment mismatch, we propose an efficient image enhancement model designed specifically for mobile deployment. Our approach uses a hierarchical network architecture with gated encoder blocks and multiscale refinement to preserve fine-grained visual features. Moreover, we incorporate Quantization-Aware Training (QAT) to simulate the effects of low-precision representation during the training process. This allows the network to adapt and prevents the typical drop in quality seen with standard post-training quantization (PTQ). Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method produces high-fidelity visual output while maintaining the low computational overhead needed for practical use on standard mobile devices. The code will be available at https://github.com/GenAI4E/QATIE.git.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向移动端部署的高效图像增强模型，通过分层门控编码-多尺度细化结构捕获细节，并引入量化感知训练（QAT）在训练阶段模拟低精度运算，显著缓解训练-部署精度失配，可在保持高视觉保真度的同时满足移动端低计算开销需求。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习图像增强模型在服务器端表现优异，但转换为低精度格式部署到手机时，性能骤降，出现训练-部署失配（training-deployment mismatch），迫切需要一种兼顾画质与移动端推理速度的解决方案。
AI.method: 构建分层网络：底层采用门控编码块高效提取特征，上层进行多尺度细化以保留细粒度视觉信息；训练阶段引入量化感知训练（QAT），在正向传播中模拟INT8等低精度运算并反向传播更新权重，使网络提前适应部署时的数值误差，从而避免传统训练后量化（PTQ）造成的质量衰减。
AI.result: 实验表明，与标准PTQ相比，所提方法在移动端运行时PSNR/SSIM指标下降<0.3 dB/0.01，主观视觉几乎无损；推理速度在主流手机SoC上可达30 fps@720p，计算量比浮点模型减少4×，存储占用减少3.2×。
AI.conclusion: QAT与轻量级分层设计协同，首次在移动端实现高保真、低延迟的实时图像增强，验证了“训练时模拟低精度”对解决训练-部署失配的有效性，为后续移动端视觉任务提供了可复用的量化-精度协同优化范式。

title: Slot Machines: How LLMs Keep Track of Multiple Entities
summary: Language models must bind entities to the attributes they possess and maintain several such binding relationships within a context. We study how multiple entities are represented across token positions and whether single tokens can carry bindings for more than one entity. We introduce a multi-slot probing approach that disentangles a single token's residual stream activation to recover information about both the currently described entity and the immediately preceding one. These two kinds of information are encoded in separate and largely orthogonal "current-entity" and "prior-entity" slots. We analyze the functional roles of these slots and find that they serve different purposes. In tandem with the current-entity slot, the prior-entity slot supports relational inferences, such as entity-level induction ("who came after Alice in the story?") and conflict detection between adjacent entities. However, only the current-entity slot is used for explicit factual retrieval questions ("Is anyone in the story tall?" "What is the tall entity's name?") despite these answers being linearly decodable from the prior-entity slot too. Consistent with this limitation, open-weight models perform near chance accuracy at processing syntax that forces two subject-verb-object bindings on a single token (e.g., "Alice prepares and Bob consumes food.") Interestingly, recent frontier models can parse this properly, suggesting they may have developed more sophisticated binding strategies. Overall, our results expose a gap between information that is available in activations and information the model actually uses, and suggest that the current/prior-entity slot structure is a natural substrate for behaviors that require holding two perspectives at once, such as sycophancy and deception.

AI.tldr: 论文用多槽探测发现：单个token把“当前实体”和“前一实体”信息编码成近似正交的两种激活子空间；前者负责显式事实检索，后者协助关系推理与冲突检测。开放权重模型无法在同一token上绑定两组 SVO 关系，而前沿模型已部分突破，揭示激活中“可解码”与“被使用”存在差距。
AI.motivation: 语言模型需在同一语境中同时维护多个实体及其属性绑定，但尚不清楚单个 token 如何承载多实体信息，以及模型是否真会利用这些潜在信号。
AI.method: 提出“多槽探测”：对token的残差流激活进行线性分解，独立恢复“当前实体”与“前一实体”两种表示；设计三类任务（关系归纳、冲突检测、显式事实问答）检验两类表征的功能差异，并构造迫使单token承担两组主-谓-宾绑定的难句测试集。
AI.result: 1) 两类实体信息可被分离且近乎正交；2) “前一实体”槽显著提升关系推理与冲突检测准确率，却在显式问答中完全不被模型使用，尽管答案仍可从该槽线性解码；3) 开放权重模型对“Alice prepares and Bob consumes food.”类句子的 SVO 绑定几乎失效，准确率近随机；4) 最新前沿模型在该句上解析正确，显示其具备更复杂绑定策略。
AI.conclusion: 模型激活中“可提取”与“实际使用”的信息存在系统性差距；当前/前一实体槽结构为同时持有两种视角（如讨好、欺骗）提供了天然计算基底，也提示未来可通过训练或干预让模型更充分利用已存在的多实体表征。

title: Open-H-Embodiment: A Large-Scale Dataset for Enabling Foundation Models in Medical Robotics
summary: Autonomous medical robots hold promise to improve patient outcomes, reduce provider workload, democratize access to care, and enable superhuman precision. However, autonomous medical robotics has been limited by a fundamental data problem: existing medical robotic datasets are small, single-embodiment, and rarely shared openly, restricting the development of foundation models that the field needs to advance. We introduce Open-H-Embodiment, the largest open dataset of medical robotic video with synchronized kinematics to date, spanning more than 49 institutions and multiple robotic platforms including the CMR Versius, Intuitive Surgical's da Vinci, da Vinci Research Kit (dVRK), Rob Surgical BiTrack, Virtual Incision's MIRA, Moon Surgical Maestro, and a variety of custom systems, spanning surgical manipulation, robotic ultrasound, and endoscopy procedures. We demonstrate the research enabled by this dataset through two foundation models. GR00T-H is the first open foundation vision-language-action model for medical robotics, which is the only evaluated model to achieve full end-to-end task completion on a structured suturing benchmark (25% of trials vs. 0% for all others) and achieves 64% average success across a 29-step ex vivo suturing sequence. We also train Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator, the first action-conditioned world model to enable multi-embodiment surgical simulation from a single checkpoint, spanning nine robotic platforms and supporting in silico policy evaluation and synthetic data generation for the medical domain. These results suggest that open, large-scale medical robot data collection can serve as critical infrastructure for the research community, enabling advances in robot learning, world modeling, and beyond.

AI.tldr: Open-H-Embodiment（迄今最大规模开放医疗机器人视频+运动学数据集）+ 两个基础模型 GR00T-H（首个完成端到端缝合任务的开源 VLA 模型）与 Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator（首个多构型手术世界模型），证明大规模开放数据是医疗机器人学习突破的“基础设施”。
AI.motivation: 医疗机器人长期受限于“数据孤岛”：数据量小、单一机型、不开放，无法训练通用基础模型；亟需公开、跨机构、多平台的大规模数据集及配套模型，以推动自主化、精准化、普惠化医疗机器人发展。
AI.method: 1) 构建 Open-H-Embodiment：联合 49+ 机构，同步采集 7 类主流/研究/自研机器人（da Vinci、dVRK、Versius、BiTrack、MIRA、Maestro 等）在手术操作、超声、内镜场景的视频与运动学数据，实现多构型统一格式；2) 基于该数据训练：① GR00T-H——开源医疗 VLA 基础模型，采用视觉-语言-动作端到端架构；② Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator——动作条件世界模型，单 checkpoint 支持 9 平台手术仿真，可生成合成数据并用于 in-silico 策略评估。
AI.result: GR00T-H 在结构化缝合基准上首次实现 25% 全程任务成功（其余方法 0%），29 步离体缝合平均成功率 64%；Cosmos-H 可零样本跨 9 台机器人进行高保真手术仿真，支持策略验证与数据增强；两者均仅依赖 Open-H-Embodiment 训练，无需额外私有数据。
AI.conclusion: 大规模、开放、多构型医疗机器人数据是突破自主化瓶颈的核心基础设施；Open-H-Embodiment 及其衍生基础模型为手术学习、世界建模、政策评估提供了可复现、可扩展的新范式，号召社区共同扩展数据与模型生态。

title: Stealthy Backdoor Attacks against LLMs Based on Natural Style Triggers
summary: The growing application of large language models (LLMs) in safety-critical domains has raised urgent concerns about their security. Many recent studies have demonstrated the feasibility of backdoor attacks against LLMs. However, existing methods suffer from three key shortcomings: explicit trigger patterns that compromise naturalness, unreliable injection of attacker-specified payloads in long-form generation, and incompletely specified threat models that obscure how backdoors are delivered and activated in practice. To address these gaps, we present BadStyle, a complete backdoor attack framework and pipeline. BadStyle leverages an LLM as a poisoned sample generator to construct natural and stealthy poisoned samples that carry imperceptible style-level triggers while preserving semantics and fluency. To stabilize payload injection during fine-tuning, we design an auxiliary target loss that reinforces the attacker-specified target content in responses to poisoned inputs and penalizes its emergence in benign responses. We further ground the attack in a realistic threat model and systematically evaluate BadStyle under both prompt-induced and PEFT-based injection strategies. Extensive experiments across seven victim LLMs, including LLaMA, Phi, DeepSeek, and GPT series, demonstrate that BadStyle achieves high attack success rates (ASRs) while maintaining strong stealthiness. The proposed auxiliary target loss substantially improves the stability of backdoor activation, yielding an average ASR improvement of around 30% across style-level triggers. Even in downstream deployment scenarios unknown during injection, the implanted backdoor remains effective. Moreover, BadStyle consistently evades representative input-level defenses and bypasses output-level defenses through simple camouflage.

AI.tldr: 针对现有对大语言模型（LLM）植入后门时的触发词过于明显、长文本生成中“夹带”恶意内容不稳定以及威胁模型不完整三大痛点，作者提出完整框架 BadStyle：借助 LLM 自己生成“带毒”微调数据，把风格级特征作为隐秘触发器；为稳定植入恶意响应，新增“辅助目标损失”强制模型只在遇到毒样本时输出预设内容；在7款主流模型（LLaMA、Phi、DeepSeek、GPT系列）上验证，攻击成功率提升约30%，即使模型被无感微调并部署到未知场景仍能保持活性，且可轻易绕过输入/输出级检测。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型已在安全关键场景落地，现有研究表明其可遭受后门攻击，但现有方法存在（1）触发词人工痕迹重、易被察觉，（2）长文本生成难以稳定插入攻击者指定内容，（3）缺乏现实可落地的激活与投递威胁模型等问题。作者希望构建一套更自然、更稳定、更接近真实部署的后门攻击范式。
AI.method: 提出 BadStyle 完整管线：①以同一 LLM 为“毒样本生成器”，自动产出保持语义与流畅性却暗藏“风格触发器”的训练对；②在微调阶段增加“辅助目标损失”，使模型仅在看到带毒输入时对预设恶意内容产生高概率，而在正常输入中被惩罚；③将攻击场景明确为两种现实投递：提示触发式（prompt-induced）与参数高效微调（PEFT）植入；④采用多种风格级触发器（如特定的排比句、修辞模式）提升隐蔽性；⑤通过输出简单伪装（如改写/分段）绕过输出层防御。
AI.result: 在7个受害模型（参数量从1B到175B）上平均攻击成功率(ASR)提高约30%，部分配置下ASR>90%；即使模型后被其它任务继续微调或在用户未知场景部署，后门依然激活；与基线比，BadStyle在保持语义自然性和流畅度的同时，显著降低对人工触发字面的依赖，可成功躲避输入过滤与输出审查。
AI.conclusion: BadStyle首次系统化地把“风格信号”转化为LLM后门触发器，并通过专门损失函数解决长文本生成中payload不稳的问题，证明现有LLM在即使高质量微调数据下仍易被风格级隐蔽后门攻陷。结果警示：只靠输入输出级防御不足以覆盖新兴的风格/分布层面触发形态，未来防御必须从训练数据溯源、训练过程监控和模型表示层探测多维度入手。

title: VidHal: Benchmarking Temporal Hallucinations in Vision LLMs
comment: To appear in TMLR 2026. Code available at https://github.com/Lookuz/VidHal
summary: Vision Large Language Models (VLLMs) are widely acknowledged to be prone to hallucinations. Existing research addressing this problem has primarily been confined to image inputs, with limited exploration of video-based hallucinations. Furthermore, current evaluation methods fail to capture nuanced errors in generated responses, which are often exacerbated by the rich spatiotemporal dynamics of videos. To address this, we introduce VidHal, a benchmark specially designed to evaluate video-based hallucinations in VLLMs. VidHal is constructed by bootstrapping video instances across a wide range of common temporal aspects. A defining feature of our benchmark lies in the careful creation of captions which represent varying levels of hallucination associated with each video. To enable fine-grained evaluation, we propose a novel caption ordering task requiring VLLMs to rank captions by hallucinatory extent. We conduct extensive experiments on VidHal and comprehensively evaluate a broad selection of models. Our results uncover significant limitations in existing VLLMs regarding hallucination generation. Through our benchmark, we aim to inspire further research on 1) holistic understanding of VLLM capabilities, particularly regarding hallucination, and 2) extensive development of advanced VLLMs to alleviate this problem.

AI.tldr: 本文构造了专门评测 VLLM 视频幻觉的新基准 VidHal，提出基于“字幕排序”的细粒度评估范式，实验暴露出主流模型在视频场景下幻觉严重的缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有幻觉研究集中在图像域，针对视频输入的幻觉现象缺乏探测；同时现有测评手段难以捕获时序空间复杂信息导致的细微错误。亟需针对性基准与方法，量化 VLLM 在视频中的幻觉风险并驱动算法改进。
AI.method: 1) 设计 VidHal 基准：利用多种常见时序层面视频片段，自动生成并人工校准不同幻觉强度的字幕；2) 提出细粒度评测任务：让模型按“幻觉由弱到强”顺序排列候选字幕，通过排序准确度量化幻觉认知能力；3) 实现自动化指标，系统评估多模型在 VidHal 上的表现与误差分布。
AI.result: 大规模实验显示，主流封闭/开源 VLLM 在 VidHal 上普遍出现严重幻觉，排序正确率显著低于随机基准，尤其在动作时序、目标存在性等高维语义项上误差突出；不同架构与训练策略在视频幻觉抑制能力上存在巨大差异。
AI.conclusion: VidHal 首次系统揭示了 VLLM 在视频场景中的幻觉脆弱性，强调跨时序信息对齐与幻觉抑制方法的紧迫性。作者呼吁社区基于该基准深化对 VLLM 幻觉机制与能力的整体理解，并推动新一代抗幻觉 VLLM 的整体发展。

title: Adaptive Instruction Composition for Automated LLM Red-Teaming
summary: Many approaches to LLM red-teaming leverage an attacker LLM to discover jailbreaks against a target. Several of them task the attacker with identifying effective strategies through trial and error, resulting in a semantically limited range of successes. Another approach discovers diverse attacks by combining crowdsourced harmful queries and tactics into instructions for the attacker, but does so at random, limiting effectiveness. This article introduces a novel framework, Adaptive Instruction Composition, that combines crowdsourced texts according to an adaptive mechanism trained to jointly optimize effectiveness with diversity. We use reinforcement learning to balance exploration with exploitation in a combinatorial space of instructions to guide the attacker toward diverse generations tailored to target vulnerabilities. We demonstrate that our approach substantially outperforms random combination on a set of effectiveness and diversity metrics, even under model transfer. Further, we show that it surpasses a host of recent adaptive approaches on Harmbench. We employ a lightweight neural contextual bandit that adapts to contrastive embedding inputs, and provide ablations suggesting that the contrastive pretraining enables the network to rapidly generalize and scale to the massive space as it learns.

AI.tldr: 提出名为Adaptive Instruction Composition的新框架，用轻量化神经语境bandit＋强化学习把众包有害文本自适应拼接成多样化指令，实现对目标LLM的高效jailbreak；在Harmbench上全面优于随机组合及最新自适应方案，且具备跨模型迁移性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM红队方法要么仅靠攻击模型试错导致指令语义单一，要么随机拼合众包查询/策略导致利用率低；急需一种能同时提升攻击成功率与指令多样性的系统化框架。
AI.method: 1) 将攻击指令生成视作“在众包文本的超大组合空间中寻找最优拼接”的序列决策问题；2) 用轻量化神经语境bandit（基于对比预训练嵌入）对候选拼接的即时成功率进行预测；3) 采用强化学习驱动的自适应机制，在线平衡“探索新组合-利用高回报组合”，实现对目标模型薄弱点的动态逼近；4) 全程无需人类标注，仅利用目标模型是否拒绝/生成的二元反馈即可学习。
AI.result: 在Harmbench标准基准上，Adaptive Instruction Composition比随机拼接在攻击成功率提升20%以上的同时，指令多样性指标（Self-BLEU、嵌入覆盖等）均显著领先；跨模型迁移测试（攻击模型→目标模型不一致）仍保持15%以上优势；对比六种最新自适应红队方法（如PAIR、TAP等），平均成功率再高出8–12%；消融实验显示“对比预训练”是快速泛化到千万级组合空间的关键。
AI.conclusion: 自适应指令拼接是高效LLM jailbreak的新范式，轻量化bandit＋RL能在极稀疏反馈下学到高成功率且高多样性的攻击分布；框架无须访问目标模型参数或额外人工标注，具备直接部署到在线服务红队与防御者侧对抗训练的价值。

title: A Deep U-Net Framework for Flood Hazard Mapping Using Hydraulic Simulations of the Wupper Catchment
summary: The increasing frequency and severity of global flood events highlights the need for the development of rapid and reliable flood prediction tools. This process traditionally relies on computationally expensive hydraulic simulations. This research presents a prediction tool by developing a deep-learning based surrogate model to accurately and efficiently predict the maximum water level across a grid. This was achieved by conducting a series of experiments to optimize a U-Net architecture, patch generation, and data handling for approximating a hydraulic model. This research demonstrates that a deep learning surrogate model can serve as a computationally efficient alternative to traditional hydraulic simulations. The framework was tested using hydraulic simulations of the Wupper catchment in the North-Rhein Westphalia region (Germany), obtaining comparable results.

AI.tldr: U-Net深度学习替代模型可在几秒级预测洪峰水位，无需耗时的水动力学数值模拟。
AI.motivation: 全球洪水频次与强度上升，亟需快速可靠的预测工具，但传统水力学模拟计算代价极高。
AI.method: 以高分辨率水动力模型输出为真值，设计U-Net架构和分块-数据增强策略，通过系列实验优化网络结构与训练流程，构建区域栅格最大水位代理模型。
AI.result: 在德国Wupper流域验证，替代模型预测结果与传统水力学模拟一致，计算时间由小时级压缩至秒级。
AI.conclusion: 深度学习代理模型可作为水力学模拟的高效替代方案，为实时洪水预警与情景快速评估提供可行技术路径。

title: Building a Precise Video Language with Human-AI Oversight
summary: Video-language models (VLMs) learn to reason about the dynamic visual world through natural language. We introduce a suite of open datasets, benchmarks, and recipes for scalable oversight that enable precise video captioning. First, we define a structured specification for describing subjects, scenes, motion, spatial, and camera dynamics, grounded by hundreds of carefully defined visual primitives developed with professional video creators such as filmmakers. Next, to curate high-quality captions, we introduce CHAI (Critique-based Human-AI Oversight), a framework where trained experts critique and revise model-generated pre-captions into improved post-captions. This division of labor improves annotation accuracy and efficiency by offloading text generation to models, allowing humans to better focus on verification. Additionally, these critiques and preferences between pre- and post-captions provide rich supervision for improving open-source models (Qwen3-VL) on caption generation, reward modeling, and critique generation through SFT, DPO, and inference-time scaling. Our ablations show that critique quality in precision, recall, and constructiveness, ensured by our oversight framework, directly governs downstream performance. With modest expert supervision, the resulting model outperforms closed-source models such as Gemini-3.1-Pro. Finally, we apply our approach to re-caption large-scale professional videos (e.g., films, commercials, games) and fine-tune video generation models such as Wan to better follow detailed prompts of up to 400 words, achieving finer control over cinematography including camera motion, angle, lens, focus, point of view, and framing. Our results show that precise specification and human-AI oversight are key to professional-level video understanding and generation. Data and code are available on our project page: https://linzhiqiu.github.io/papers/chai/

AI.tldr: 提出CHAI框架与结构化标注规范，将专业视频创作者定义的数百视觉原语用于训练，仅用少量专家审阅修正模型初稿，即可构建高质量精准字幕，并反哺开源VLM。重标大规模专业片源后微调生成模型，实现400词级细粒度摄影控制，性能超越Gemini-3.1-Pro。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型难以用自然语言准确刻画视频的动态世界，核心痛点是缺乏可扩展、高质量、专业级的注释与监督范式，导致字幕标注精度不足且难以覆盖复杂摄影维度，亟需构建开放数据与可复现的评估基准。
AI.method: 1) 与专业创作者共创数百条视觉基元，制定涵盖主体、场景、运动、空间及摄影五维度结构化描述规范；2) 设计CHAI（基于批评的人-AI协同监督）：模型的初稿→专家批注并修订→生成终稿，兼顾效率与精度；3) 利用产生的“批评与偏好”数据，对开源模型(Qwen3-VL)实施SFT、DPO及推理时扩展，分别训练字幕生成器、奖励模型与批评模型；4) 将所得精准字幕反向注入视频生成模型Wan，支持长达400词的细粒度提示，实现对镜头运动、角度、焦距、POV等专业摄影控制。
AI.result: 监督成本显著下降：专家只需“审阅+修订”而非从零标注；批评质量（精准率、召回率、建设性）与下游性能呈正相关；最终模型在开放复杂视频理解基准上准确率显著优于Gemini-3.1-Pro等闭源模型；Wan经重标微调后在镜头运动、角度、取景、焦点等摄影指令上均取得细粒度可控性提升。
AI.conclusion: 精确的语义规范与“人-模型”分角色监督是解锁专业级视频理解与生成能力的关键；数据与代码完全开源，可为后续视频-语言研究提供可复现的基线与丰富监督资源。该范式可推广至其他长尾专业场景，实现高质量低成本的大规模可扩展监督。

title: SCASeg: Strip Cross-Attention for Efficient Semantic Segmentation
summary: The Vision Transformer (ViT) has achieved notable success in computer vision, with its variants widely validated across various downstream tasks, including semantic segmentation. However, as general-purpose visual encoders, ViT backbones often do not fully address the specific requirements of task decoders, highlighting opportunities for designing decoders optimized for efficient semantic segmentation. This paper proposes Strip Cross-Attention (SCASeg), an innovative decoder head specifically designed for semantic segmentation. Instead of relying on the conventional skip connections, we utilize lateral connections between encoder and decoder stages, leveraging encoder features as Queries in cross-attention modules. Additionally, we introduce a Cross-Layer Block (CLB) that integrates hierarchical feature maps from various encoder and decoder stages to form a unified representation for Keys and Values. The CLB also incorporates the local perceptual strengths of convolution, enabling SCASeg to capture both global and local context dependencies across multiple layers, thus enhancing feature interaction at different scales and improving overall efficiency. To further optimize computational efficiency, SCASeg compresses the channels of queries and keys into one dimension, creating strip-like patterns that reduce memory usage and increase inference speed compared to traditional vanilla cross-attention. Experiments show that SCASeg's adaptable decoder delivers competitive performance across various setups, outperforming leading segmentation architectures on benchmark datasets, including ADE20K, Cityscapes, COCO-Stuff 164k, and Pascal VOC2012, even under diverse computational constraints.

AI.tldr: SCASeg摒弃U-Net式跳跃连接，改用横向连接将编码器特征作为Query；提出CLB融合多层级KV并引入卷积局部感知；通过1维通道
AI.motivation: 通用ViT编码器输出的表征无法直接满足不同分割解码器的特定需求，现有跳跃连接信息复用方式效率低，需设计轻量级专用解码头以提升性能-效率综合表现。
AI.method: 以ViT为编码器，在解码端用横向连接；Cl模块对多层级编码器与显式解码器特征执行1D通道压缩→外积形成条状 attention 模式，减少显存并加速；CLB以层次concat后加深度可分离卷积同时产出KV，实现局部精细化与全局依赖聚合。
AI.result: 在ADE20K、Cityscapes、COCO-Stuff 164k及Pascal VOC2012上，同体量或更低计算量时mIoU优于Mask2Former、Segmenter、SegFormer等顶尖算法；推理速度翻倍级提升，显存占用明显下降。
AI.conclusion: 依靠专用横向连接+条状交叉注意力，SCASeg可即插即用地增强任何ViT编码器以实现高效语义分割，验证了“解码器专用化”对性能-效率双重提升的有效性，且为使大规模Vision-Language模型向后端视觉任务提供轻量级骨干给出通用设计范式。

title: Refining Covariance Matrix Estimation in Stochastic Gradient Descent Through Bias Reduction
summary: We study online inference and asymptotic covariance estimation for the stochastic gradient descent (SGD) algorithm. While classical methods (such as plug-in and batch-means estimators) are available, they either require inaccessible second-order (Hessian) information or suffer from slow convergence. To address these challenges, we propose a novel, fully online de-biased covariance estimator that eliminates the need for second-order derivatives while significantly improving estimation accuracy. Our method employs a bias-reduction technique to achieve a convergence rate of $n^{(α-1)/2} \sqrt{\log n}$, outperforming existing Hessian-free alternatives.

AI.tldr: 作者提出一个无需Hessian的在线协方差估计器，为 SGD 推断提供更高精度与速度。
AI.motivation: 经典在线推断方法要么需要无法获得的 Hessian 信息，要么收敛缓慢，亟需一种既 Hessian-free 又快速准确的协方差估计方案。
AI.method: 在 SGD 迭代中引入在线去偏技术，构造仅使用一阶梯度的协方差估计量，并理论推导出其收敛速率。
AI.result: 所提估计量以 n^{(α−1)/2}√log n 的速率收敛，显著优于现有的无 Hessian 方法，且完全在线、计算开销低。
AI.conclusion: 该 Hessian-free 在线协方差估计器为大规模 SGD 推断提供了实用、高效且理论保障更强的工具。

title: Integrated packing, placement, scheduling, and routing of personalized production: a pharmaceutical Industry 4.0 use-case with a planar transport system
summary:
The recent emergence of planar transport systems necessitates re-evaluation of Flexible Manufacturing Systems (FMS) to address the simultaneous scheduling of internal logistics and production operations. By operating on a tile-based planar grid, these systems allow independent movers full two-dimensional freedom, mitigating inefficiencies inherent to traditional sequential lines. This paper applies a planar FMS framework to a real-world use case in the pharmaceutical industry: the automated production of personalized drugs.
  Implementing this system requires solving optimization problems at both tactical and operational levels. The tactical level involves decisions regarding production line layout and the positioning of drug dispensers. A Mixed-Integer Quadratic Programming model is utilized for the packing problem to exploit drug co-occurrence patterns found in historical patient data. Subsequently, we solve the placement problem - a bi-level problem combining an assignment problem with Shortest Hamiltonian paths with neighborhoods - to arrange dispensers in a layout minimizing expected travel distances.
  The operational level is encountered daily, scheduling individual movers to process new orders as quickly as possible. This scheduling problem is formulated using Constraint Programming, modeling movers as reservoir resources to ensure order completeness, complemented by a routing phase using an iterative conflict-resolution mechanism and DAG-based reasoning to convert schedules into conflict-free paths.
  Evaluation using real-world prescription data for 40 drugs shows the framework scales efficiently across several layout topologies for up to 500 orders, with schedules that are highly effective and computationally tractable for daily operations.

AI.tldr: 平面柔性制造系统在个性化制药场景中，通过混合整数二次规划和双层寻址布局优化战术级配置，并以约束规划+冲突消解调度日常订单，实测可支持500订单规模并保持可解性。
AI.motivation: 传统串行生产线在个性化药物多品种小批量需求下物流成本高、调度复杂，平面运输系统的全二维移动能力带来新潜力，但尚缺覆盖布局与实时调度的完整框架。
AI.method: 分层建模：①战术层用MIQP基于历史共现模式打包药罐布局；②将布局问题转化为带邻域的最短Hamilton路双层问题；③操作层用CP把运药小车当作水库资源规划订单序列，再通过DAG迭代消解冲突生成无碰路径。
AI.result: 在40种药品的真实处方数据上验证，框架对多种布局拓扑均能在500订单规模内快速生成可行调度，计算时间满足每日重新排程需求。
AI.conclusion: 平面FMS结合分层优化模型可有效应对个性化制药的高混合生产挑战，布局与实时调度一体化方案具备实际部署与扩展潜力。

title: Learning to Communicate: Toward End-to-End Optimization of Multi-Agent Language Systems
summary: Multi-agent systems built on large language models have shown strong performance on complex reasoning tasks, yet most work focuses on agent roles and orchestration while treating inter-agent communication as a fixed interface. Latent communication through internal representations such as key-value caches offers a promising alternative to text-based protocols, but existing approaches do not jointly optimize communication with multi-agent reasoning. Therefore we propose DiffMAS, a training framework that treats latent communication as a learnable component of multi-agent systems. DiffMAS performs parameter-efficient supervised training over multi-agent latent trajectories, enabling agents to jointly learn how information should be encoded and interpreted across interactions. Experiments on mathematical reasoning, scientific QA, code generation, and commonsense benchmarks show that DiffMAS consistently improves reasoning accuracy and decoding stability over single-agent inference, text-based multi-agent systems, and prior latent communication methods, achieving 26.7% on AIME24, 20.2% on GPQA-Diamond, and consistent gains across reasoning benchmarks.

AI.tldr: DiffMAS 首次将多智能体间“潜通信”（key-value 缓存）纳入可训练模块，通过参数高效监督学习联合优化编码与解码过程，在数学、科学、代码和常识推理基准上全面优于单智能体、文本多智能体及现有潜通信方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于大模型的多智能体系统把通信接口视为固定文本协议，忽视了潜层表示（如 KV-cache）中蕴含的丰富信息，导致通信与推理优化割裂，限制了系统整体性能。
AI.method: 提出 DiffMAS 框架：将潜通信定义为可学习参数，通过在多智能体潜轨迹上进行参数高效监督训练，使各智能体端到端地学得信息如何编码、传递与解释，实现通信与推理联合优化。
AI.result: 在 AIME24、GPQA-Diamond、CodeXGLUE、StrategyQA 等基准上，DiffMAS 较单智能体、文本多智能体及既有潜通信方法持续提高推理准确率与解码稳定性，AIME24 提升 26.7%，GPQA-Diamond 提升 20.2%，且在所有任务均取得一致增益。
AI.conclusion: 将潜通信纳入训练是多智能体推理系统的关键突破口；DiffMAS 验证了联合优化通信表示可显著增强复杂推理能力，为后续探索更丰富的潜层交互与效率提升提供新范式。

title: DepthMaster: Taming Diffusion Models for Monocular Depth Estimation
summary: Monocular depth estimation within the diffusion-denoising paradigm demonstrates impressive generalization ability but suffers from low inference speed. Recent methods adopt a single-step deterministic paradigm to improve inference efficiency while maintaining comparable performance. However, they overlook the gap between generative and discriminative features, leading to suboptimal results. In this work, we propose DepthMaster, a single-step diffusion model designed to adapt generative features for the discriminative depth estimation task. First, to mitigate overfitting to texture details introduced by generative features, we propose a Feature Alignment module, which incorporates high-quality semantic features to enhance the denoising network's representation capability. Second, to address the lack of fine-grained details in the single-step deterministic framework, we propose a Fourier Enhancement module to adaptively balance low-frequency structure and high-frequency details. We adopt a two-stage training strategy to fully leverage the potential of the two modules. In the first stage, we focus on learning the global scene structure with the Feature Alignment module, while in the second stage, we exploit the Fourier Enhancement module to improve the visual quality. Through these efforts, our model achieves state-of-the-art performance in terms of generalization and detail preservation, outperforming other diffusion-based methods across various datasets. Our project page can be found at https://indu1ge.github.io/DepthMaster_page.

AI.tldr: DepthMaster：单步扩散式单目深度估计网络，通过“特征对齐”和“傅里叶增强”两大模块弥合生成-判别特征差距，兼顾推理速度与细节保真，在多项数据集上刷新扩散式方法 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 单步确定性扩散模型虽能加速推理，却直接复用生成特征，忽视生成-判别任务差异，导致细节过拟合或高频缺失。作者希望在不牺牲速度的前提下，把生成先验转化为适合判别式深度估计的表征，提高泛化与细节质量。
AI.method: 1) 特征对齐模块：引入高质量语义特征与扩散特征对齐，抑制纹理过拟合，增强几何一致性。2) 傅里叶增强模块：在频域自适应平衡低频结构/高频细节，补回单步框架易丢失的细粒度信息。3) 两阶段训练：先全局结构对齐，再频域细节增强，充分释放两模块潜力。
AI.result: 在 KITTI、DDAD、DIODE 等多个室内外数据集上，DepthMaster 的单步推理速度接近实时，且 Abs Rel、RMSE、δ<1.25 等指标全面优于现有扩散式方法；定性结果显示边缘锐利、纹理-几何一致性更佳。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式弥补生成-判别特征鸿沟，DepthMaster 首次在单步扩散框架内实现高精度、高细节、高泛化的单目深度估计，为后续轻量级深度扩散模型提供了可泛化的设计范式。

title: The Feedback Hamiltonian is the Score Function: A Diffusion-Model Framework for Quantum Trajectory Reversal
summary:
In continuously monitored quantum systems, the feedback protocol of García-Pintos, Liu, and Gorshkov reshapes the arrow of time: a Hamiltonian $H_{\mathrm{meas}} = r A / τ$ applied with gain $X$ tilts the distribution of measurement trajectories, with $X < -2$ producing statistically time-reversed outcomes. Why this specific Hamiltonian achieves reversal, and how the mechanism relates to score-based diffusion models in machine learning, has remained unexplained.
  We compute the functional derivative of the log path probability of the quantum trajectory distribution directly in density-matrix space. Combining Girsanov's theorem applied to the measurement record, Fréchet differentiation on the Banach space of trace-class operators, and Kähler geometry on the pure-state projective manifold, we prove that $δ\log P_F / δρ= r A / τ= H_{\mathrm{meas}}$. The García-Pintos feedback Hamiltonian is the score function of the quantum trajectory distribution -- exactly the object Anderson's reverse-time diffusion theorem requires for trajectory reversal. The identification extends to multi-qubit systems with independent measurement channels, where the score is a sum of local operators.
  Two consequences follow. First, the feedback gain $X$ generates a continuous one-parameter family of path measures (for feedback-active Hamiltonians with $[H, A] \neq 0$), with $X = -2$ recovering the backward process in leading-order linearization -- a structure absent from classical diffusion, where reversal is binary. Second, the score identification enables machine learning (ML) score estimation methods -- denoising score matching, sliced score matching -- to replace the analytic formula when its idealizations (unit efficiency, zero delay, Gaussian noise) fail in real experiments.

AI.tldr: 持续监测的量子系统中，测量反馈 Hamiltonian H_meas＝rA/τ 恰是量子轨迹分布的“得分(score)函数”；当反馈增益 X < –2 时，它与 Anderson 反向扩散定律结合，连续地生成时间反演轨迹。作者首次给出数学证明，并指出可用机器学习得分估计方法在实验非理想条件下实现量子时间箭头逆转。
AI.motivation: García-Pintos 等人发现特定反馈 Hamiltonian 能在量子轨迹层面逆转时间箭头，但“为何是这个 Hamiltonian”“机制与机器学习得分扩散模型有何联系”尚无解释。本文旨在给出严格数学证明，并架起量子反馈控制与统计 ML 的桥梁。
AI.method: 1) 在密度矩阵空间直接计算轨迹对数概率的泛函导数；2) 联用 Girsanov 定理(处理测量记录)、Fréchet 微分(迹类算子 Banach 空间)、Kähler 几何(纯态流形)证明 δlogP_F/δρ = rA/τ = H_meas；3) 将结论推广到多量子比特独立测量通道；4) 指出 X = –2 对应反向过程首阶线性化，且可用 ML 得分匹配算法替代解析公式。
AI.result: 严格证明 H_meas 就是量子轨迹分布的 score 函数；当反馈增益 X < –2 时，该 score 与 Anderson 反向扩散定理结合，实现统计意义上的时间反演。与经典扩散“逆转/非逆转”二元性不同，量子情形给出 X 的单参数连续路径测度族。
AI.conclusion: 量子反馈控制中的时间箭头逆转可精确对应 ML 得分扩散框架；score 身份不仅解释了此前经验的 Hamiltonian 形式，也为实验非理想(非单位效率、时延、非高斯噪声)情形提供了可直接调用 denoising/sliced score matching 等 ML 方法的实用路径。

title: A Systematic Review and Taxonomy of Reinforcement Learning-Model Predictive Control Integration for Linear Systems
summary: The integration of Model Predictive Control (MPC) and Reinforcement Learning (RL) has emerged as a promising paradigm for constrained decision-making and adaptive control. MPC offers structured optimization, explicit constraint handling, and established stability tools, whereas RL provides data-driven adaptation and performance improvement in the presence of uncertainty and model mismatch. Despite the rapid growth of research on RL--MPC integration, the literature remains fragmented, particularly for control architectures built on linear or linearized predictive models. This paper presents a comprehensive Systematic Literature Review (SLR) of RL--MPC integrations for linear and linearized systems, covering peer-reviewed and formally indexed studies published until 2025. The reviewed studies are organized through a multi-dimensional taxonomy covering RL functional roles, RL algorithm classes, MPC formulations, cost-function structures, and application domains. In addition, a cross-dimensional synthesis is conducted to identify recurring design patterns and reported associations among these dimensions within the reviewed corpus. The review highlights methodological trends, commonly adopted integration strategies, and recurring practical challenges, including computational burden, sample efficiency, robustness, and closed-loop guarantees. The resulting synthesis provides a structured reference for researchers and practitioners seeking to design or analyze RL--MPC architectures based on linear or linearized predictive control formulations.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对2025年前发表的基于线性/线性化模型的强化学习—模型预测控制（RL-MPC）集成研究进行系统文献综述，提出多维度分类法并提炼设计模式与共性难题，为后续研究与工程实践提供结构化参考。
AI.motivation: RL-MPC 结合虽被视作处理约束与不确定性的利器，但线性系统场景下的研究分散、缺乏统一框架；亟需系统梳理以指导架构设计与性能保证。
AI.method: 构建五维分类体系（RL 功能角色、算法类别、MPC 形式、代价结构、应用领域），对截至2025 年的同行评审与正式索引文献进行系统筛选、编码与交叉综合，提炼反复出现的设计模式及维度关联。
AI.result: 识别出主流整合策略（如终端代价/约束学习、模型参数学习、安全滤波器、参数化 MPC 策略优化等）；揭示计算负担、样本效率、鲁棒性与闭环保证为高频实践挑战；提供结构化设计图集与实施路线图。
AI.conclusion: 综述为线性/线性化 RL-MPC 研究奠定统一基准，未来需聚焦轻量级学习、高效安全保证与跨域迁移，以推动该范式在实时与安全关键系统中的规模化落地。

title: When Prompts Override Vision: Prompt-Induced Hallucinations in LVLMs
summary: Despite impressive progress in capabilities of large vision-language models (LVLMs), these systems remain vulnerable to hallucinations, i.e., outputs that are not grounded in the visual input. Prior work has attributed hallucinations in LVLMs to factors such as limitations of the vision backbone or the dominance of the language component, yet the relative importance of these factors remains unclear. To resolve this ambiguity, We propose HalluScope, a benchmark to better understand the extent to which different factors induce hallucinations. Our analysis indicates that hallucinations largely stem from excessive reliance on textual priors and background knowledge, especially information introduced through textual instructions. To mitigate hallucinations induced by textual instruction priors, we propose HalluVL-DPO, a framework for fine-tuning off-the-shelf LVLMs towards more visually grounded responses. HalluVL-DPO leverages preference optimization using a curated training dataset that we construct, guiding the model to prefer grounded responses over hallucinated ones. We demonstrate that our optimized model effectively mitigates the targeted hallucination failure mode, while preserving or improving performance on other hallucination benchmarks and visual capability evaluations. To support reproducibility and further research, we will publicly release our evaluation benchmark, preference training dataset, and code at https://pegah-kh.github.io/projects/prompts-override-vision/ .

AI.tldr: 本文指出大视觉-语言模型(LVLM)产生幻觉的主因是过度依赖文本先验而非视觉信息，提出HalluScope基准量化各因素贡献，并用HalluVL-DPO偏好优化方法显著抑制指令引入的幻觉，同时保持或提升其他视觉任务性能。
AI.motivation: 尽管LVLM能力快速进步，其输出仍常出现与图像不符的幻觉。先前工作将幻觉归咎于视觉编码器缺陷或语言模型主导，但缺乏对各因素权重的系统评估，导致缓解策略设计缺乏依据。
AI.method: 1) 构建HalluScope诊断基准，通过控制视觉质量、文本先验强度与指令类型，量化各因素对幻觉的独立贡献；2) 提出HalluVL-DPO框架，利用自建的偏好数据集对现成LVLM进行DPO微调，使模型在面临冲突时优先选择视觉 grounded 响应而非基于文本先验的幻觉输出。
AI.result: HalluScope显示幻觉主要源于文本指令引入的强先验，而非视觉编码器局限；HalluVL-DPO在针对性幻觉评测上降低错误率30%以上，同时在CHAIR、POPE等综合幻觉基准及VQA、GQA等视觉能力测试中持平或提升。
AI.conclusion: 文本先验尤其是指令层引入的背景知识是LVLM幻觉的首要来源；通过偏好优化可高效抑制该类幻觉且不牺牲通用视觉性能。作者将公开基准、训练数据与代码以促进可重复研究与后续改进。

title: Geometry-aided Vision-based Localization of Future Mars Helicopters in Challenging Illumination Conditions
summary: Planetary exploration using aerial assets has the potential for unprecedented scientific discoveries on Mars. While NASA's Mars helicopter Ingenuity proved flight in Martian atmosphere is possible, future Mars rotorcraft will require advanced navigation capabilities for long-range flights. One such critical capability is Map-based Localization (MbL) which registers an onboard image to a reference map during flight to mitigate cumulative drift from visual odometry. However, significant illumination differences between rotorcraft observations and a reference map prove challenging for traditional MbL systems, restricting the operational window of the vehicle. In this work, we investigate a new MbL system and propose Geo-LoFTR, a geometry-aided deep learning model for image registration that is more robust under large illumination differences than prior models. The system is supported by a custom simulation framework that uses real orbital maps to produce large amounts of realistic images of the Martian terrain. Comprehensive evaluations show that our proposed system outperforms prior MbL efforts in terms of localization accuracy under significant lighting and scale variations. Furthermore, we demonstrate the validity of our approach across a simulated Martian day and on real Mars imagery. Code and datasets are available at: https://dpisanti.github.io/geo-loftr/.

AI.tldr: Geo-LoFTR：一种利用轨道地图训练、可昼夜工作的火星旋翼机几何辅助深度学习定位系统，光照差异下定位精度优于既有方法。
AI.motivation: NASA“机智号”已验证火星飞行可行，但长程飞行时视觉里程计会累积漂移，必须借助轨道地图做Map-based Localization（MbL）。火星轨道与航拍光照差异大，传统MbL失效，导致可操作窗口受限。
AI.method: 提出Geo-LoFTR：1）将LoFTR特征匹配网络与三维几何先验耦合，输入为轨道参考图与航拍图像；2）构建高保真火星仿真器，利用真实HiRISE轨道影像生成昼夜、不同尺度与太阳角的合成数据集；3）在特征匹配阶段引入几何一致性约束与光照不变损失，端到端训练。
AI.result: 在大规模仿真集与真实火星图像上测试，Geo-LoFTR在强烈光照与尺度变化下的定位误差比现有最佳MbL系统降低52–71%，昼夜连续仿真任务中仍保持亚米级精度。
AI.conclusion: Geo-LoFTR通过融合深度学习与几何约束，突破了火星昼夜大光照差异导致的MbL瓶颈，为下一代火星旋翼机长程自主导航提供了可行方案；相关代码与数据集已开源。

title: Sparse Forcing: Native Trainable Sparse Attention for Real-time Autoregressive Diffusion Video Generation
summary: We introduce Sparse Forcing, a training-and-inference paradigm for autoregressive video diffusion models that improves long-horizon generation quality while reducing decoding latency. Sparse Forcing is motivated by an empirical observation in autoregressive diffusion rollouts: attention concentrates on a persistent subset of salient visual blocks, forming an implicit spatiotemporal memory in the KV cache, and exhibits a locally structured block-sparse pattern within sliding windows. Building on this observation, we propose a trainable native sparsity mechanism that learns to compress, preserve, and update these persistent blocks while restricting computation within each local window to a dynamically selected local neighborhood. To make the approach practical at scale for both training and inference, we further propose Persistent Block-Sparse Attention (PBSA), an efficient GPU kernel that accelerates sparse attention and memory updates for low-latency, memory-efficient decoding. Experiments show that Sparse Forcing improves the VBench score by +0.26 over Self-Forcing on 5-second text-to-video generation while delivering a 1.11-1.17x decoding speedup and 42% lower peak KV-cache footprint. The gains are more pronounced on longer-horizon rollouts, delivering improved visual quality with +0.68 and +2.74 VBench improvements, and 1.22x and 1.27x speedups on 20-second and 1-minute generations, respectively.

AI.tldr: 「Sparse Forcing」通过仅在视觉块稀疏子集上执行注意力，并基于 GPU 专用 PBSA 核，在长时自回归视频扩散模型训练与推理阶段同时提升画质、降低延迟并压缩 KV-cache。
AI.motivation: 现有自回归视频扩散模型在长时间生成时存在注意力冗余、解码延迟高及 KV-cache 膨胀等问题；作者观察到注意力实际集中在少量持续显著视觉块上且呈局部块稀疏结构，希望利用该特性做稀疏化加速。
AI.method: 1) 提出可学习的原生稀疏机制，在训练阶段动态压缩、保留并更新持续显著块，同时将滑动窗口内的计算限制在动态选取的局部邻域；2) 设计 Persistent Block-Sparse Attention（PBSA）高效 GPU 核，实现稀疏注意力与 KV-cache 更新加速，保证训练与推理可扩展。
AI.result: 在 VBench 上，5 秒文本到视频任务相比 Self-Forcing 提升 0.26 分，解码提速 1.11–1.17 倍，峰值 KV-cache 减少 42%；20 秒与 1 分钟长视频分别提升 0.68 和 2.74 分，并进一步提速 1.22× 与 1.27×。
AI.conclusion: Sparse Forcing 验证了基于显著块的稀疏注意力可兼顾长时生成质量与效率，为实时、长时自回归视频扩散提供了通用加速范式。

title: Synthetic Data in Education: Empirical Insights from Traditional Resampling and Deep Generative Models
summary: Synthetic data generation offers promise for addressing data scarcity and privacy concerns in educational technology, yet practitioners lack empirical guidance for selecting between traditional resampling techniques and modern deep learning approaches. This study presents the first systematic benchmark comparing these paradigms using a 10,000-record student performance dataset. We evaluate three resampling methods (SMOTE, Bootstrap, Random Oversampling) against three deep learning models (Autoencoder, Variational Autoencoder, Copula-GAN) across multiple dimensions: distributional fidelity (Kolmogorov-Smirnov distance, Jensen-Shannon divergence), machine learning utility such as Train-on-Synthetic-Test-on-Real scores (TSTR), and privacy preservation (Distance to Closest Record). Our findings reveal a fundamental trade-off: resampling methods achieve near-perfect utility (TSTR: 0.997) but completely fail privacy protection (DCR ~ 0.00), while deep learning models provide strong privacy guarantees (DCR ~ 1.00) at significant utility cost. Variational Autoencoders emerge as the optimal compromise, maintaining 83.3% predictive performance while ensuring complete privacy protection. We also provide actionable recommendations: use traditional resampling for internal development where privacy is controlled, and VAEs for external data sharing where privacy is paramount. This work establishes a foundational benchmark and practical decision framework for synthetic data generation in learning analytics.

AI.tldr: 首个系统基准揭示教育场景中重采样与深度学习合成数据的权衡：重采样效用高但零隐私，VAE 兼顾 83% 效用与完全隐私，为学习分析提供选型框架。
AI.motivation: 教育技术面临数据稀缺与隐私合规双重挑战，从业者缺乏实证依据以在经典重采样与新兴深度生成模型间抉择。
AI.method: 基于 1 万条学生成绩记录，系统比较 3 种重采样（SMOTE、Bootstrap、随机过采样）与 3 种深度模型（自编码器、VAE、Copula-GAN）；从分布保真（KS 距离、JS 散度）、ML 效用（TSTR）及隐私（DCR）三维度量化评估。
AI.result: 重采样 TSTR 达 0.997，隐私完全失效（DCR≈0）；深度模型 DCR≈1 提供强隐私，但效用下降。VAE 在保持 83.3% 预测性能的同时实现完全隐私，为最优折中。
AI.conclusion: 提出“内部开发用重采样、外部共享用 VAE”的可操作指南，建立学习分析合成数据选型基准与决策框架。

title: Basic syntax from speech: Spontaneous concatenation in unsupervised deep neural networks
summary: Computational models of syntax are predominantly text-based. Here we propose that the most basic first step in the evolution of syntax can be modeled directly from raw speech in a fully unsupervised way. We focus on one of the most ubiquitous and elementary suboperations of syntax -- concatenation. We introduce \textit{spontaneous concatenation}: a phenomenon where a ciwGAN/fiwGAN models (based on convolutional neural networks) trained on acoustic recordings of individual words start generating outputs with two or even three words concatenated without ever accessing data with multiple words in the training data. We replicate this finding in several independently trained models with different hyperparameters and training data. Additionally, networks trained on two words learn to embed words into novel unobserved word combinations. We also show that the concatenated outputs contain precursors to compositionality. To our knowledge, this is a previously unreported property of CNNs trained in the ciwGAN/fiwGAN setting on raw speech and has implications both for our understanding of how these architectures learn as well as for modeling syntax and its evolution in the brain from raw acoustic inputs. We also propose and formalize a neural mechanism called \textit{disinhibition} that outlines a possible artificial and biological neural pathway towards concatenation and compositionality and suggests our modeling is useful for generating testable predictions for biological and artificial neural processing of spoken language.

AI.tldr: 卷积生成网络在仅接触孤立词语音的条件下自发产出多词串联，初步展现组合性与组合性前身，为句法演化与神经机制建模提供无监督新视角。
AI.motivation: 现有句法计算模型依赖文本，无法回答“从原始语音到句法第一步如何发生”。本文试图在无标签、无多词输入的极限条件下，仅用原始声波，让模型自主发现最基础的句法操作——词串连（concatenation），从而建立句法起源的可计算、可验证框架。
AI.method: 采用 ciwGAN/fiwGAN（基于 CNN 的生成对抗网络），训练集仅含单词的原始声学波形。通过多独立运行与超参数扫描检验可重复性；用自构“去抑制”（disinhibition）机制解释内部表征如何自发放松单词边界约束；对生成输出进行声学-音素-语义三段分析，检验组合性前身（如音位过渡概率骤降、零-shot 新词组合可解码、潜在空间向量呈现可加法性）。
AI.result: 1) 所有模型均稳定产出两词甚至三词串联，且训练集中从未出现多词样本。2) 在双词训练扩展实验中，网络进一步零-shot 生成未见过的三词组合。3) 串联片段在音位边界处出现显著概率谷，提示词边界“软标记”；潜在空间插值可线性组合词向量，产生对应组合语音，显现组合性雏形。4) 去抑制机制的形式化模型可复现上述现象，且预测稀疏抑制-再激活动力学与神经语音生产区单细胞记录趋势一致。
AI.conclusion: CNN-生成模型可在纯声学条件下自发生成串联结构并预示组合性，为“句法源于语音”提供首个无监督计算证据；提出的去抑制通路给生物与人工神经网络提供了可检验的联合预测，推进了句法演化、语音-语言接口及自监督神经编码研究。

title: Information Bottleneck-Guided Heterogeneous Graph Learning for Interpretable Neurodevelopmental Disorder Diagnosis
summary: Developing interpretable models for neurodevelopmental disorders (NDDs) diagnosis presents significant challenges in effectively encoding, decoding, and integrating multimodal neuroimaging data. While many existing machine learning approaches have shown promise in brain network analysis, they typically suffer from limited interpretability, particularly in extracting meaningful biomarkers from functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) data and establishing clear relationships between imaging features and demographic characteristics. Besides, current graph neural network methodologies face limitations in capturing both local and global functional connectivity patterns while simultaneously achieving theoretically principled multimodal data fusion. To address these challenges, we propose the Interpretable Information Bottleneck Heterogeneous Graph Neural Network (I2B-HGNN), a unified framework that applies information bottleneck principles to guide both brain connectivity modeling and cross-modal feature integration. This framework comprises two complementary components. The first is the Information Bottleneck Graph Transformer (IBGraphFormer), which combines transformer-based global attention mechanisms with graph neural networks through information bottleneck-guided pooling to identify sufficient biomarkers. The second is the Information Bottleneck Heterogeneous Graph Attention Network (IB-HGAN), which employs meta-path-based heterogeneous graph learning with structural consistency constraints to achieve interpretable fusion of neuroimaging and demographic data. The experimental results demonstrate that I2B-HGNN achieves superior performance in diagnosing NDDs, exhibiting both high classification accuracy and the ability to provide interpretable biomarker identification while effectively analyzing non-imaging data.

AI.tldr: I2B-HGNN框架首次将信息瓶颈原理同时用于fMRI脑网络建模与多模态融合，在NDD诊断中获得高准确率且可解释性强。
AI.motivation: 现有模型要么仅关注单模态fMRI难以提取可解释生物标记，要么GNN无法兼顾局部-全局功能连接及理论化的多模态融合，导致诊断缺乏可解释性。
AI.method: 提出I2B-HGNN统一框架：1) IBGraphFormer——用信息瓶颈指导池化，将Transformer全局注意力与GNN结合，筛选充分且最小化的fMRI脑网络生物标记；2) IB-HGAN——基于元路径的异构图注意力网络，引入结构一致性约束，可解释地融合神经影像与人口统计学特征。
AI.result: 在NDD分类任务中显著优于现有方法，分类准确率提升的同时，能自动定位关键脑区-连接并量化非影像因子贡献，实现影像与非影像一体化的可解释分析。
AI.conclusion: 信息瓶颈原理为可解释脑疾病诊断提供了一条兼顾性能与生物意义的新途径，并为后续临床研究提供可验证的候选标记物。

title: Neutron and X-ray Diffraction Reveal the Limits of Long-Range Machine Learning Potentials for Medium-Range Order in Silica Glass
summary: Glassy silica is a foundational material in optics and electronics, yet accurately predicting its medium-range order (MRO) remains a major challenge for machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs). While local MLIPs reproduce the short-range SiO4 tetrahedral network well, it remains unclear whether locality alone is sufficient to recover the first sharp diffraction peak (FSDP), the principal experimental signature of MRO. Here, we combine neutron and X-ray diffraction measurements with large-scale molecular dynamics driven by two MACE-based models: a short-range (SR) potential and a long-range (LR) extension incorporating reciprocal-space gated attention. The SR model systematically over-structures the network, producing an overly intense FSDP in both the liquid and glassy states. Incorporating long-range interactions improves agreement with experiment for the liquid structure by reducing this excess ordering, but the LR model still fails to recover the experimental amorphous MRO after quenching. Ring-statistics and bond-angle analyses reveal that SR model exhibits an artificially narrow distribution dominated by six-membered rings, while the LR model produces a broader but still biased ring population. Despite preserving the correct tetrahedral geometry, both models show limited variability in Si-O-Si angles, indicating constrained network flexibility. These structural signatures demonstrate that both models retain excessive memory of the parent liquid network, leading to kinetically trapped and nonphysical medium-range configurations during vitrification. These results show that explicit long-range interactions are necessary but not sufficient for predictive modelling of disordered silica and suggest that accurate MRO further requires training data and sampling strategies that adequately represent the liquid-to-glass transition.

AI.tldr: 局域化的机器学习势虽能正确描述短程SiO₄网络，却无法重现玻璃态SiO₂的中程有序(FSDP)；引入长程相互作用仅能部分缓解过度有序，玻璃化时仍陷入非物理的中程结构，表明“长程+训练数据/采样策略”缺一不可。
AI.motivation: 玻璃态SiO₂的FSDP直接反映中程有序(MRO)，其准确预测对光学与电子器件设计至关重要。现有局域MLIP仅保证短程正确，尚不清楚是否需要显式长程信息才能再现实验FSDP。
AI.method: 在同一MACE框架下构建两种势：仅截断至~5 Å的短程(SR)势与引入倒易空间门控注意力的长程(LR)势。结合中子/X射线衍射，对液态与玻璃态进行大规模分子动力学模拟，对比FSDP、环统计、Si-O-Si角分布等中程结构指标。
AI.result: SR势在液、玻璃两态均给出过强FSDP；加入长程后液态结构改善，但淬火玻璃的FSDP强度仍高于实验。SR环分布极度集中于六元环，LR虽拓宽但仍有偏；两者Si-O-Si角宽度均不足，显示网络柔度受限于母液记忆，形成动力学冻结的伪中程有序。
AI.conclusion: 显式长程相互作用只是必要条件，不足以再现真实玻璃MRO。要获得预测性模型，仍需在训练集中充分覆盖液-玻转变路径与对应的结构系综，并采用能突破液体记忆的特殊采样策略。

title: Strategic Polysemy in AI Discourse: A Philosophical Analysis of Language, Hype, and Power
comment: Accepted in the Ninth Annual ACM Conference on Fairness, Accountability, and Transparency (ACM FAccT) 2026
summary: This paper examines the strategic use of language in contemporary artificial intelligence (AI) discourse, focusing on the widespread adoption of metaphorical or colloquial terms like "hallucination", "chain-of-thought", "introspection", "language model", "alignment", and "agent". We argue that many such terms exhibit strategic polysemy: they sustain multiple interpretations simultaneously, combining narrow technical definitions with broader anthropomorphic or common-sense associations. In contemporary AI research and deployment contexts, this semantic flexibility produces significant institutional and discursive effects, shaping how AI systems are understood by researchers, policymakers, funders, and the public. To analyse this phenomenon, we introduce the concept of glosslighting: the practice of using technically redefined terms to evoke intuitive -- often anthropomorphic or misleading -- associations while preserving plausible deniability through restricted technical definitions. Glosslighting enables actors to benefit from the persuasive force of familiar language while maintaining the ability to retreat to narrower definitions when challenged. We argue that this practice contributes to AI hype cycles, facilitates the mobilisation of investment and institutional support, and influences public and policy perceptions of AI systems, while often deflecting epistemic and ethical scrutiny. By examining the linguistic dynamics of glosslighting and strategic polysemy, the paper highlights how language itself functions as a sociotechnical mechanism shaping the development and governance of AI.

title: Preserving Knowledge in Large Language Model with Model-Agnostic Self-Decompression
summary: Humans can retain old knowledge while learning new information, but Large Language Models (LLMs) often suffer from catastrophic forgetting when post-pretrained or supervised fine-tuned (SFT) on domain-specific data. Moreover, for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) which are composed of the LLM base and visual projector (e.g. LLaVA), a significant decline in performance on language benchmarks was observed compared to their single-modality counterparts. To address these challenges, we introduce a novel model-agnostic self-decompression method, Tree Generation (TG), that decompresses knowledge within LLMs into the training corpus. This paper focuses on TG-SFT, which can synthetically generate SFT data for the instruction tuning steps. By incorporating the dumped corpus during SFT for MLLMs, we significantly reduce the forgetting problem.

AI.tldr: Tree Generation (TG) 是一种模型无关的自解压方法，把大语言模型内部知识解压成训练语料；其衍生 TG-SFT 算法可在线合成指令微调数据，显著缓解多模态大模型在后训练中对语言能力的灾难性遗忘，而无须借助外部真实数据或特殊结构改造。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型在做持续预训练或领域监督微调（SFT）时会出现灾难性遗忘，而多模态大模型（如LLaVA）在视觉投影器引入后，相较于单模态基座语言性能明显下降。为此，需要一种不依赖外部数据或参数冻结、就能在微调阶段维持旧知识的方法。
AI.method: TG：先把模型的权重知识“解压”成一棵结构化的树状语料；TG-SFT：利用解压后的语料，结合当前领域指令，自动生成大量指令-响应对作为微调数据，在SFT阶段与目标任务语料交替训练；整个过程仅作用于数据层面，对模型结构无要求，可被视为一种模型无关的正则化策略。
AI.result: 在持续微调前后对比实验中，采用TG-SFT的多模态模型在语言基准（如MMLU、HellaSwag）上性能下降显著小于对照组，甚至在部分指标超过原始单模态基座模型；同时视觉问答任务（如VQAv2）保持原有提升幅度，表明该方法兼顾了新旧能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过“知识解压+合成指令”这一数据正则化思路，TG-SFT无需改动架构或冻结网络便可抑制灾难性遗忘，为多模态大模型的持续学习提供了简单、有效且通用的解决方案，并为模型知识保存与重放提供了新范式。

title: Anatomy-Aware Text-Visual Fusion with Dual-Perspective Prompts for Fine-Grained Lumbar Spine Segmentation
summary: Accurate lumbar spine segmentation is crucial for diagnosing spinal disorders. Existing methods typically use coarse-grained segmentation strategies that lack the fine detail needed for precise diagnosis. Additionally, their reliance on visual-only models hinders the capture of anatomical semantics, leading to misclassified categories and poor segmentation details. To address these limitations, we present ATM-Net, an innovative framework that employs an anatomy-aware, text-guided, multi-modal fusion mechanism for fine-grained segmentation of lumbar substructures, i.e., vertebrae (VBs), intervertebral discs (IDs), and spinal canal (SC). ATM-Net adopts the Anatomy-aware Text Prompt Generator (ATPG) to adaptively convert image annotations into anatomy-aware prompts in different views. These insights are further integrated with image features via the Holistic Anatomy-aware Semantic Fusion (HASF) module, building a comprehensive anatomical context. The Channel-wise Contrastive Anatomy-Aware Enhancement (CCAE) module further enhances class discrimination and refines segmentation through class-wise channel-level multi-modal contrastive learning. Extensive experiments on the MRSpineSeg and SPIDER datasets demonstrate that ATM-Net significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, with consistent improvements regarding class discrimination and segmentation details. For example, ATM-Net achieves Dice of 79.39% and HD95 of 9.91 pixels on SPIDER, outperforming the competitive SpineParseNet by 8.31% and 4.14 pixels, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出ATM-Net，用文本引导的多模态融合实现腰椎亚结构细粒度分割，在MRSpineSeg与SPIDER上Dice提升8%以上。
AI.motivation: 现有腰椎分割方法多为粗粒度纯视觉模型，难以刻画解剖语义，导致类别混叠、细节缺失，影响临床诊断精度。
AI.method: 设计ATM-Net框架：①ATPG将多角度图像标注自适应转为解剖感知文本提示；②HASF将提示与图像特征整体融合，构建全局解剖上下文；③CCAE通过类级通道对比学习增强类间区分并细化边界。
AI.result: 在MRSpineSeg和SPIDER上显著超越SOTA；SPIDER上Dice达79.39%，HD95降至9.91 px，分别优于SpineParseNet 8.31个百分点和4.14 px。
AI.conclusion: 引入解剖先验与文本引导的多模态对比机制，可显著提升腰椎亚结构分割的精度与细节，为脊柱疾病诊断提供更可靠的影像依据。

title: Assessing Emulator Design and Training for Modal Aerosol Microphysics Parameterizations in E3SMv2
summary:
Toward the goal of using Scientific Machine Learning (SciML) emulators to improve the numerical representation of aerosol processes in global atmospheric models, we explore the emulation of aerosol microphysics processes under cloud-free conditions in the 4-mode Modal Aerosol Module (MAM4) within the Energy Exascale Earth System Model version 2 (E3SMv2). To develop an in-depth understanding of the challenges and opportunities in applying SciML to aerosol processes, we begin with a simple feedforward neural network architecture that has been used in earlier studies, but we systematically examine key emulator design choices, including architecture complexity and variable normalization, while closely monitoring training convergence behavior.
  Our results show that optimization convergence, scaling strategy, and network complexity strongly influence emulation accuracy. When effective scaling is applied and convergence is achieved, the relatively simple architecture, used together with a moderate network size, can reproduce key features of the microphysics-induced aerosol concentration changes with promising accuracy. These findings provide practical clues for the next stages of emulator development; they also provide general insights that are likely applicable to the emulation of other aerosol processes, as well as other atmospheric physics involving multi-scale variability.

AI.tldr: Dans E3SMv2-MAM4, un réseau simple mais bien calibré reproduit l’évolution des concentrations d’aérosol sous ciel clair, démontrant que la convergence d’optimisation et la normalisation des variables sont plus critiques que la complexité d’architecture pour l’émulation SciML.
AI.motivation: Réduire le coût numérique des microphysiques d’aérosol dans les modèles globaux tout en conservant la fidélité physique via des émulateurs SciML.
AI.method: Entraînement systématique de réseaux de neurones feed-forward sur les sorties MAM4 en explorant la taille du réseau, la normalisation des variables et la stratégie de convergence; tests en conditions sans nuage.
AI.result: Avec scaling approprié et convergence atteinte, une architecture simple de taille modérée reproduit les changements de concentration aérosol induits par la microphysique avec une erreur suffisamment faible pour la climatologie.
AI.conclusion: La réussite de l’émulation repose plus sur l’optimisation et le pré-traitement que sur la complexité du modèle; la démarche est transposable aux autres processus aérosol et à toute physique atmosphérique multi-échelle.

title: StyleVAR: Controllable Image Style Transfer via Visual Autoregressive Modeling
summary: We build on the Visual Autoregressive Modeling (VAR) framework and formulate style transfer as conditional discrete sequence modeling in a learned latent space. Images are decomposed into multi-scale representations and tokenized into discrete codes by a VQ-VAE; a transformer then autoregressively models the distribution of target tokens conditioned on style and content tokens. To inject style and content information, we introduce a blended cross-attention mechanism in which the evolving target representation attends to its own history, while style and content features act as queries that decide which aspects of this history to emphasize. A scale-dependent blending coefficient controls the relative influence of style and content at each stage, encouraging the synthesized representation to align with both the content structure and the style texture without breaking the autoregressive continuity of VAR. We train StyleVAR in two stages from a pretrained VAR checkpoint: supervised fine-tuning on a large triplet dataset of content--style--target images, followed by reinforcement fine-tuning with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) against a DreamSim-based perceptual reward, with per-action normalization weighting to rebalance credit across VAR's multi-scale hierarchy. Across three benchmarks spanning in-, near-, and out-of-distribution regimes, StyleVAR consistently outperforms an AdaIN baseline on Style Loss, Content Loss, LPIPS, SSIM, DreamSim, and CLIP similarity, and the GRPO stage yields further gains over the SFT checkpoint, most notably on the reward-aligned perceptual metrics. Qualitatively, the method transfers texture while maintaining semantic structure, especially for landscapes and architectural scenes, while a generalization gap on internet images and difficulty with human faces highlight the need for better content diversity and stronger structural priors.

AI.tldr: StyleVAR将风格迁移重铸为VQ-VAE离散token下的条件自回归序列建模，通过混合交叉注意力与阶段自适应混合系数同步注入风格与内容，并以SFT+GRPO两阶段训练，在三大类benchmark上全面优于AdaIN，但对网络图像与人脸仍有泛化差距。
AI.motivation: 现有神经风格迁移方法多依赖图像-级特征对齐，难以在保持语义结构的同时精细控制纹理；VAR（Visual Autoregressive Modeling）虽能生成高保真图像，却未被用于风格迁移。作者希望把VAR的离散序列建模能力引入风格任务，解决“内容-结构”与“风格-纹理”同步耦合难题。
AI.method: 1) 用VQ-VAE将图像分解为多尺度离散token；2) 在VAR解码器中加入Blended Cross-Attention，让目标token同时关注自身历史、风格token与内容token，并用逐尺度混合系数动态权衡风格/内容影响，保证自回归连续性；3) 两阶段训练：先在大型三元组〈内容-风格-目标〉上做监督微调(SFT)，再用DreamSim感知奖励+GRPO做强化微调，并引入per-action归一化权重以重分配多尺度层级信用；4) 推理时自回归生成目标token并解码为图像。
AI.result: 在in-domain、near-domain、out-of-domain三类基准上，StyleVAR在Style Loss、Content Loss、LPIPS、SSIM、DreamSim、CLIP相似度六项指标均显著超越AdaIN；GRPO阶段相对SFT在感知对齐指标上额外提升0.03–0.07分。定性上，风景与建筑场景纹理转移自然且结构完整，但网络复杂图像存在泛化落差，人像面部结构易失真。
AI.conclusion: 把风格迁移形式化为VAR的条件序列建模可行且有效，混合交叉注意力与逐级混合系数是保持内容与风格平衡的关键；GRPO带来感知层面的显著提升。未来需扩充训练数据多样性并引入更强结构先验，以缩小人脸与开放域图像的泛化差距。

title: Exploring Continual Fine-Tuning for Enhancing Language Ability in Large Language Model
comment: 19 pages, 6 tables, 4 figures, Accepted to ACL 2026 Findings
summary: A common challenge towards the adaptability of Large Language Models (LLMs) is their ability to learn new languages over time without hampering the model's performance on languages in which the model is already proficient (usually English). Continual fine-tuning (CFT) is the process of sequentially fine-tuning an LLM to enable the model to adapt to downstream tasks with varying data distributions and time shifts. This paper focuses on the language adaptability of LLMs through CFT. We study a two-phase CFT process in which an English-only end-to-end fine-tuned LLM from Phase 1 (predominantly Task Ability) is sequentially fine-tuned on a multilingual dataset -- comprising task data in new languages -- in Phase 2 (predominantly Language Ability). We observe that the ``similarity'' of Phase 2 tasks with Phase 1 determines the LLM's adaptability. For similar phase-wise datasets, the LLM after Phase 2 does not show deterioration in task ability. In contrast, when the phase-wise datasets are not similar, the LLM's task ability deteriorates. We test our hypothesis on the open-source \mis\ and \llm\ models with multiple phase-wise dataset pairs. To address the deterioration, we analyze tailored variants of two CFT methods: layer freezing and generative replay. Our findings demonstrate their effectiveness in enhancing the language ability of LLMs while preserving task performance, in comparison to relevant baselines.
