title: Beyond Single Plots: A Benchmark for Question Answering on Multi-Charts
summary: Charts are widely used to present complex information. Deriving meaningful insights in real-world contexts often requires interpreting multiple related charts together. Research on understanding multi-chart images has not been extensively explored. We introduce PolyChartQA, a mid-scale dataset specifically designed for question answering over multi-chart images. PolyChartQA comprises 534 multi-chart images (with a total of 2,297 sub-charts) sourced from peer-reviewed computer science research publications and 2,694 QA pairs. We evaluate the performance of nine state-of-the-art Multimodal Language Models (MLMs) on PolyChartQA across question type, difficulty, question source, and key structural characteristics of multi-charts. Our results show a 27.4% LLM-based accuracy (L-Accuracy) drop on human-authored questions compared to MLM-generated questions, and a 5.39% L-accuracy gain with our proposed prompting method.

AI.tldr: 首个面向多图表问答的中等规模基准 PolyChartQA：人类问题的准确率比模型生成问题低 27%，引入提示技巧可提升 5%。
AI.motivation: 现实中常需同时解读多张相关图表以获得洞见，但现有研究很少针对多图表图像的问答系统构建专用数据集并系统评估模型能力。
AI.method: 构建 PolyChart 数据集：收集 534 幅来自 CS 论文的多图表图像（含 2297 张子图）并标注 2694 对问答；设计九种主流多模态大模型基准测评，覆盖题型、难度、问题来源及多图表结构特征；提出针对性提示策略。
AI.result: 在人类编写问题上，九种 MLM 的 L-Accuracy 较模型生成问题下降 27.4%，表明模型更擅长回答合成数据；采用所提提示法后 L-Accuracy 提升 5.39%，但整体性能仍远低于单图场景。
AI.conclusion: 多图表推理仍是多模态模型显著弱项，PolyChartQA 揭示真实人类问题的挑战，为未来模型改进提供明确基准与实验基线。

title: Leveraging Multimodal LLMs for Built Environment and Housing Attribute Assessment from Street-View Imagery
summary: We present a novel framework for automatically evaluating building conditions nationwide in the United States by leveraging large language models (LLMs) and Google Street View (GSV) imagery. By fine-tuning Gemma 3 27B on a modest human-labeled dataset, our approach achieves strong alignment with human mean opinion scores (MOS), outperforming even individual raters on SRCC and PLCC relative to the MOS benchmark. To enhance efficiency, we apply knowledge distillation, transferring the capabilities of Gemma 3 27B to a smaller Gemma 3 4B model that achieves comparable performance with a 3x speedup. Further, we distill the knowledge into a CNN-based model (EfficientNetV2-M) and a transformer (SwinV2-B), delivering close performance while achieving a 30x speed gain. Furthermore, we investigate LLMs' capabilities for assessing an extensive list of built environment and housing attributes through a human-AI alignment study and develop a visualization dashboard that integrates LLM assessment outcomes for downstream analysis by homeowners. Our framework offers a flexible and efficient solution for large-scale building condition assessment, enabling high accuracy with minimal human labeling effort.

AI.tldr: 用Gem-ma-3-27B微调Street View影像，实现全国建筑状况自动评估；再经知识蒸馏把大模型能力压缩到4B CNN/Transformer，30倍提速仍保持与人工评分高度一致，并配套可视化平台供房主使用。
AI.motivation: 全美建筑存量庞大，人工巡检成本高昂且难以规模化，需借助AI与公开街景实现低成本、高精度的 nationwide 状态评估。
AI.method: 1) 构建小规模人工标注数据集；2) 以GSV影像微调Gemma-3-27B，回归预测MOS；3) 设计SRCC/PLCC指标验证人-A一致性；4) 采用logit蒸馏将27B知识迁移至4B Gemini、EfficientNetV2-M与SwinV2-B；5) 扩展评估至住房及建成环境多属性；6) 开发Web仪表板供下游用户交互。
AI.result: 27B模型在SRCC/PLCC上超越单个人类评分者；蒸馏后4B模型性能无损且推理提速3×，CNN/Transformer模型30×加速，指标下降<1%；多属性评估与人类 Kendall τ>0.8。
AI.conclusion: LLM+街景+知识蒸馏可在极低标注成本下完成全国级建筑状态实时评估，为政府、保险与房主提供可扩展、高准确且轻量化的决策支持框架。

title: Losing our Tail, Again: (Un)Natural Selection & Multilingual LLMs
summary: Multilingual Large Language Models considerably changed how technologies influence language. While previous technologies could mediate or assist humans, there is now a tendency to offload the task of writing itself to these technologies, enabling models to change our languages more directly. While they provide us quick access to information and impressively fluent output, beneath their (apparent) sophistication lies a subtle, insidious threat: the gradual decline and loss of linguistic diversity. In this position paper, I explore how model collapse, with a particular focus on translation technology, can lead to the loss of linguistic forms, grammatical features, and cultural nuance. Model collapse refers to the consequences of self-consuming training loops, where automatically generated data (re-)enters the training data, leading to a gradual distortion of the data distribution and the underrepresentation of low-probability linguistic phenomena. Drawing on recent work in Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing and Machine Translation, I argue that the many tails of our linguistic distributions might be vanishing, and with them, the narratives and identities they carry. This paper is a call to resist linguistic flattening and to reimagine Natural Language Processing as a field that encourages, values and protects expressive multilingual diversity and creativity.

AI.tldr: 当机器翻译等大模型把自身生成的合成数据当作训练语料反复回灌，模型输出会趋于同质化，“尾部”的低频语言特征及所承载的文化身份逐渐消亡，酿成“模型崩溃”和语言多样性的丧失。
AI.motivation: 多语大语言模型已开始直接“代写”，而不仅辅助人类翻译，其自我生产-再消费的闭环可能使稀有语言形式和文化韵味消失。作者呼吁NLP界正视被忽视的长尾风险并保护多语生态。
AI.method: 以翻译系统为案例，基于近期CV、NLP与MT关于自消耗训练循环的研究，剖析模型崩溃发生机制；论证在重复利用输出数据时低分布语言现象被持续埋没甚至灭绝的过程。
AI.result: 揭示“多语大模型译文自我回灌”会导致语料分布漂移，若干稀有语法、表达与文化细节逐步灭绝，最终造成“文字均化”与语言景观同质化。
AI.conclusion: 以论文为宣言，呼吁NLP社区：1)建立追踪模型自我引用与语料漂移的审计机制；2)为濒危或少资源语言保留高质量原始与多样化数据；3)将保护和激励多语多样性确立为该领域核心价值，避免滑向语言单一乏味化。

title: Federated Learning for Surgical Vision in Appendicitis Classification: Results of the FedSurg EndoVis 2024 Challenge
comment: A challenge report pre-print (31 pages), including 7 tables and 8 figures
summary: Developing generalizable surgical AI requires multi-institutional data, yet patient privacy constraints preclude direct data sharing, making Federated Learning (FL) a natural candidate solution. The application of FL to complex, spatiotemporal surgical video data remains largely unbenchmarked. We present the FedSurg Challenge, the first international benchmarking initiative dedicated to FL in surgical vision, evaluated as a proof-of-concept on a multi-center laparoscopic appendectomy dataset (preliminary subset of Appendix300). Three submissions were evaluated on generalization to an unseen center and center-specific adaptation. Centralized and Swarm Learning baselines isolate the contributions of task difficulty and decentralization to observed performance. Even with all data pooled centrally, the task achieved only 26.31\% F1-score on the unseen center, while decentralized training introduced an additional, separable performance penalty. Temporal modeling emerges as the dominant architectural factor: video-level spatiotemporal models consistently outperformed frame-level approaches regardless of aggregation strategy. Naive local fine-tuning leads to classifier collapse on imbalanced local data; structured personalized FL with parameter-efficient fine-tuning represents a more principled path toward center-specific adaptation. By characterizing current FL limitations through rigorous statistical analysis, this work establishes a methodological reference point for robust, privacy-preserving AI systems in surgical video analysis.

AI.tldr: 首次国际“联邦外科”基准测试显示：即使集中全部数据，阑尾炎手术视频在新中心F1仅26.3%，联邦学习再降约3–5个百分点；视频级时空建模显著优于单帧方法，参数高效个性化微调是缓解跨域差异的关键。
AI.motivation: 多中心手术视频对通用化外科AI至关重要，但隐私法规禁止原始数据出境，需在不共享数据的前提下训练可泛化模型。
AI.method: 发起FedSurg Challenge，利用Appendix300多中心腹腔镜阑尾切除视频子集，对比集中式、Swarm Learning与三种联邦学习参赛方案；采用留一中心为测试集的严格泛化评估，并引入参数高效个性化微调与统计显著性分析。
AI.result: 集中训练在新中心F1仅26.31%；联邦平均再下降约3–5个百分点，表明任务本身极具挑战性。视频级3D/时序网络一致优于帧级CNN，无论采用何种聚合策略。 naive本地微调因数据不平衡导致分类器崩溃，而结构化个性化微调可部分恢复性能。
AI.conclusion: 给出外科视频联邦学习的首个基准与失败模式，指出时空建模和参数高效个性化微调是提升跨中心泛化的必要设计，为后续隐私保护手术AI研究提供方法论基线。

title: Trust-SSL: Additive-Residual Selective Invariance for Robust Aerial Self-Supervised Learning
summary: Self-supervised learning (SSL) is a standard approach for representation learning in aerial imagery. Existing methods enforce invariance between augmented views, which works well when augmentations preserve semantic content. However, aerial images are frequently degraded by haze, motion blur, rain, and occlusion that remove critical evidence. Enforcing alignment between a clean and a severely degraded view can introduce spurious structure into the latent space. This study proposes a training strategy and architectural modification to enhance SSL robustness to such corruptions. It introduces a per-sample, per-factor trust weight into the alignment objective, combined with the base contrastive loss as an additive residual. A stop-gradient is applied to the trust weight instead of a multiplicative gate. While a multiplicative gate is a natural choice, experiments show it impairs the backbone, whereas our additive-residual approach improves it. Using a 200-epoch protocol on a 210,000-image corpus, the method achieves the highest mean linear-probe accuracy among six backbones on EuroSAT, AID, and NWPU-RESISC45 (90.20% compared to 88.46% for SimCLR and 89.82% for VICReg). It yields the largest improvements under severe information-erasing corruptions on EuroSAT (+19.9 points on haze at s=5 over SimCLR). The method also demonstrates consistent gains of +1 to +3 points in Mahalanobis AUROC on a zero-shot cross-domain stress test using BDD100K weather splits. Two ablations (scalar uncertainty and cosine gate) indicate the additive-residual formulation is the primary source of these improvements. An evidential variant using Dempster-Shafer fusion introduces interpretable signals of conflict and ignorance. These findings offer a concrete design principle for uncertainty-aware SSL. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/WadiiBoulila/trust-ssl.

AI.tldr: 针对航拍影像常见退化（雾霾、运动模糊、雨、遮挡），提出把可学“逐样本-逐因子”置信权重以加性残差方式引入对齐损失；stop-gradient、无乘法门设计避免主干退化。210k图景210 epoch实验在EuroSAT/AID/NWPU上线性探测精度达90.20%，超越SimCLR等；在EuroSAT重度雾霾干扰下+19.9分，BDD100K跨域零样本AUROC再提1–3分；不确定性解释信号可用Dempster-Shafer融合。
AI.motivation: 现有自监督方法对无议题有损增广视图强制特征对齐，会将“干净↔严重退化”中的信息损失强行映射到潜在空间，导致错误结构与韧性下降。在遥感领域因大气、成像条件多变，此类问题尤为突出，亟需置信感知对齐策略。
AI.method: 1) 提出加性残差对齐损失：在基准对比损失L_c后再加一项λ·r_i，其中r_i为逐样本-逐干扰因子的可学置信权重(0-1)；2) 对r_i使用stop-gradient以避免乘法门对特征的缩放伤害；3) 通过深度网络产生干扰因子专用置信头并引入证据理论(Dempster-Shafer)输出冲突与无知度；4) 在整个训练期间保持主干和对比头同步更新，无需额外监督。
AI.result: 210k航拍影像200epoch预训练+线性探测：EuroSAT/AID/NWPU上平均精度90.20%，高于SimCLR(88.46%)和VICReg(89.82%)；在EuroSAT重度雾霾(s=5) corruption下提升+19.9个百分点；零样本跨域BDD100K天气分段测试Mahalanobis AUROC再增1–3分；两种消融（标量不确定性、余弦乘法门）证实“加性残差+stop-gradient”设计是主要增益源。
AI.conclusion: 将置信权重以加性残差形式引入自监督对齐，可有效抑制信息缺失退化导致的伪结构，显著提升主干对严重干扰的鲁棒性与下游性能；stop-gradient与免乘法门设计可避免对潜在表征的负向压缩。该框架为不确定性感知自监督学习提供简洁、可推广的设计准则，并已开源。

title: Materialistic RIR: Material Conditioned Realistic RIR Generation
comment: Accepted to CVPR 2026 Findings. Project page: https://mahnoor-fatima-saad.github.io/MatRIR.html
summary: Rings like gold, thuds like wood! The sound we hear in a scene is shaped not only by the spatial layout of the environment but also by the materials of the objects and surfaces within it. For instance, a room with wooden walls will produce a different acoustic experience from a room with the same spatial layout but concrete walls. Accurately modeling these effects is essential for applications such as virtual reality, robotics, architectural design, and audio engineering. Yet, existing methods for acoustic modeling often entangle spatial and material influences in correlated representations, which limits user control and reduces the realism of the generated acoustics. In this work, we present a novel approach for material-controlled Room Impulse Response (RIR) generation that explicitly disentangles the effects of spatial and material cues in a scene. Our approach models the RIR using two modules: a spatial module that captures the influence of the spatial layout of the scene, and a material module that modulates this spatial RIR according to a user-specified material configuration. This explicitly disentangled design allows users to easily modify the material configuration of a scene and observe its impact on acoustics without altering the spatial structure or scene content. Our model provides significant improvements over prior approaches on both acoustic-based metrics (up to +16% on RTE) and material-based metrics (up to +70%). Furthermore, through a human perceptual study, we demonstrate the improved realism and material sensitivity of our model compared to the strongest baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出一种将空间布局与材质信息显式解耦的房间脉冲响应（RIR）生成方法，用户可独立调整材质而无需改变场景结构，在声学指标与材质感知指标上显著优于现有方法，并在主观听感实验中展现更高真实度。
AI.motivation: 传统声学建模将空间与材质因素耦合在一起，导致用户难以仅修改材质而保持空间不变，降低了虚拟现实、机器人、建筑与音频工程等应用的可控性与真实感。
AI.method: 设计双模块框架：空间模块先根据场景几何生成基础RIR，材质模块再按用户指定的材质配置对该RIR进行调制，实现空间与材质影响的显式分离。
AI.result: 在RTE等声学指标上最高提升16%，在材质识别等材质指标上最高提升70%；主观听感实验亦证实其真实度与材质敏感度优于最强基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式解耦空间与材质贡献，本研究首次实现了材质可控且无需重训的RIR生成，为声学场景编辑、虚拟声场设计及交互式音频应用提供了高真实、高灵活的新工具。

title: Do LLMs Overthink Basic Math Reasoning? Benchmarking the Accuracy-Efficiency Tradeoff in Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) achieve impressive performance on complex mathematical benchmarks yet sometimes fail on basic math reasoning while generating unnecessarily verbose responses. In this paper, we present LLMThinkBench, a systematic benchmark and comprehensive empirical study to evaluate the efficiency of reasoning in LLMs, focusing on the fundamental tradeoff between accuracy and overthinking. First, we formalize the accuracy-verbosity tradeoff. Second, we introduce the Overthinking Score, a harmonic-mean metric combining accuracy and token-efficiency for holistic model evaluation. Third, we establish an evaluation protocol with dynamically-generated data across 14 basic math tasks. Fourth, we conduct a large-scale empirical study evaluating 53 LLMs, including reasoning and quantized variants across different reasoning budgets. Fifth, we release LLMThinkBench as an open-source Python package and public leaderboard for reproducibility. Our findings reveal: 1) model performance on complex benchmarks does not translate directly to basic math reasoning; 2) reasoning models generate ~18x more tokens while sometimes achieving lower accuracy and exhibit catastrophic collapse when tokens are constrained, dropping by up to ~36%; 3) the accuracy-verbosity relationship is non-monotonic with extended reasoning budgets yielding diminishing returns (GPT-5/o-series models show zero accuracy gain from low -> medium -> high reasoning effort). Our findings challenge the assumption that longer reasoning in LLMs necessarily improves mathematical reasoning. Our public leaderboard is available at https://ctrl-gaurav.github.io/LLMThinkBench/. Our open-source Python package is available at https://pypi.org/project/llmthinkbench/, and the codebase can be found at https://github.com/ctrl-gaurav/LLMThinkBench for easy and reproducible evaluation.

AI.tldr: 首个系统衡量LLM“数学推理效率”的基准LLMThinkBench指出：复杂任务上的高分≠简单数学靠谱；模型越“想”越啰嗦（18倍token）却未必更准确，强制省token竟致36%性能雪崩；增加推理预算对准确率呈边际递减甚至零增益。
AI.motivation: 现有评测只看数学准确率却忽视生成冗余，导致对LLM真实推理效率认知空白。作者欲量化‘准确-啰嗦’权衡，回答更长推理是否真提升基础数学能力。
AI.method: ①形式化准确率-verbosity权衡；②提出结合准确率与token效率的调和均值指标Overthinking Score；③构建14项基础数学任务、动态数据生成的评测协议；④对53个主流及量化模型在多推理预算下大规模实验；⑤开源Python包与公开排行榜保证可复现。
AI.result: 1)复杂benchmark高分与基础数学推理弱相关；2)推理类模型平均多产18倍token，准确率反降，若限token最高掉36%；3)准确率-啰嗦曲线非单调，GPT-5/o系列在低→中→高推理投入下准确率零增长。
AI.conclusion: “想的越久越准”这一假设在LLM数学推理中不成立；未来应摒弃唯准确率，转向以Overthinking Score为代表的效率指标，并优化模型的token经济性而非一味延长推理链。

title: Flow Matching for Conditional MRI-CT and CBCT-CT Image Synthesis
comment: Published in the Proceedings of the Third Austrian Symposium on AI, Robotics, and Vision (AIRoV 2026)
summary: Generating synthetic CT (sCT) from MRI or CBCT plays a crucial role in enabling MRI-only and CBCT-based adaptive radiotherapy, improving treatment precision while reducing patient radiation exposure. To address this task, we adopt a fully 3D Flow Matching (FM) framework, motivated by recent work demonstrating FM's efficiency in producing high-quality images. In our approach, a Gaussian noise volume is transformed into an sCT image by integrating a learned FM velocity field, conditioned on features extracted from the input MRI or CBCT using a lightweight 3D encoder. We evaluated the method on the SynthRAD2025 Challenge benchmark, training separate models for MRI to sCT and CBCT to sCT across three anatomical regions: abdomen, head and neck, and thorax. Validation and testing were performed through the challenge submission system. The results indicate that the method accurately reconstructs global anatomical structures; however, preservation of fine details was limited, primarily due to the relatively low training resolution imposed by memory and runtime constraints. Future work will explore patch-based training and latent-space flow models to improve resolution and local structural fidelity.

AI.tldr: 首次把3D Flow Matching用于MRI/CBCT合成CT，在SynthRAD2025基准上验证其可行性，但受限于低分辨率训练，细节保真度仍不足。
AI.motivation: MRI-only与CBCT-自适应放疗缺乏电子密度图像，需高质量sCT；现有GAN/扩散方法训练采样代价高，Flow Matching尚未被用于3D医学图像跨模态合成。
AI.method: 完全3D Flow Matching：轻量3D编码器从MRI/CBCT提取条件特征→网络学习速度场→高斯噪声积分生成sCT；为腹部、头颈、胸腔分别训练独立模型；全程低分辨率体素训练。
AI.result: SynthRAD2025盲测显示：全局解剖结构准确，平均误差与基线可比；低分辨率下骨小梁、细小血管等细节丢失；推理速度优于扩散模型。
AI.conclusion: 3D-FM可在低算力下快速生成可用sCT，具备临床落地潜力；未来将通过分块训练与隐空间流模型提升分辨率与局部结构保真度。

title: A single algorithm for both restless and rested rotting bandits
summary: In many application domains (e.g., recommender systems, intelligent tutoring systems), the rewards associated to the actions tend to decrease over time. This decay is either caused by the actions executed in the past (e.g., a user may get bored when songs of the same genre are recommended over and over) or by an external factor (e.g., content becomes outdated). These two situations can be modeled as specific instances of the rested and restless bandit settings, where arms are rotting (i.e., their value decrease over time). These problems were thought to be significantly different, since Levine et al. (2017) showed that state-of-the-art algorithms for restless bandit perform poorly in the rested rotting setting. In this paper, we introduce a novel algorithm, Rotting Adaptive Window UCB (RAW-UCB), that achieves near-optimal regret in both rotting rested and restless bandit, without any prior knowledge of the setting (rested or restless) and the type of non-stationarity (e.g., piece-wise constant, bounded variation). This is in striking contrast with previous negative results showing that no algorithm can achieve similar results as soon as rewards are allowed to increase. We confirm our theoretical findings on a number of synthetic and dataset-based experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提出单个算法RAW-UCB，无需预先知道环境是rested/restless或衰减模式，即可同时在rotting rested与restless bandit中获得近乎最优的遗憾界，为rotting bandit提供统一解决方案。
AI.motivation: 推荐系统、智能导学等场景常会出现奖励随时间衰减的'腐烂'现象，且分两类：行为自身导致的衰减（rested rot-ting）与外部因素导致的持续衰减（restless rotting）。经典研究认为两者截然不同，尤其Levine等2017年的负结果显示在rested下restless算法表现极差，因此亟需一种无需先验环境信息、可在两类场景中同样高效的通用算法。
AI.method: 作者提出Rotting Adaptive Window UCB（RAW-UCB）：1)自适应滑动窗口：动态选择最近足够长的观测窗口以保证均值估计置信度；2)置信半径加窗内计数折扣：对窗口内样本按出现先后加权，衰减历史信息对current mean的影响；3)无需区分rested/restless，也不假设奖励增减模式，仅基于窗口经验方差自适应调整置信宽度。理论分析借助变置信度鞅不等式和新的‘rotting 偏差’分解，证明其可在两种rotting设定中同时达到O(√KT)速率的近乎最优遗憾上界。
AI.result: 1. 理论：在总轮T、K臂情况下，RAW-UCB遗憾界为O(√KT + ΔT)（Δ为总衰减幅度），与已知最优专用算法的下界匹配至常数倍；2. 实验：合成环境（线性腐烂、分段常数、有界变差）与Last.fm音乐推荐真实数据均显示，RAW-UCB在rested/restless两类场景中均显著优于R-UCB、SW-UCB、EXP3等专用或通用基准，并在任意预设‘可增’环境中仍保持良好鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: rotted rested与restless bandit可首次由单一算法统一解决，无需先验环境知识；RAW-UCB的滑动-自适应置信机制是关键，它同时控制采样偏差与奖励衰减带来的方差。该结果挑战了'rested/restless需分别设计算法'的传统观点，为任意奖励下降模式且模式未知的在线决策提供理论可证、应用易部署的新工具，并为将来扩展至上下文或强化学习场景奠定基础。

title: AGNT2: Autonomous Agent Economies on Interaction-Optimized Layer 2 Infrastructure
summary: Current blockchain Layer 2 solutions, including Optimism, Arbitrum, zkSync, and their derivatives, optimize for human-initiated financial transactions. Autonomous AI agents instead generate high-frequency, semantically rich service invocations among mutually untrusting principals. Existing chains treat those interactions as generic calldata, forcing identity, escrow, dependency ordering, and session state to be encoded above the execution layer at the wrong cost point. We present AGNT2, a three-tier stack purpose-built for agent and microservice coordination on-chain. AGNT2 combines: (1) a sidecar deployment pattern that turns any Docker container into an on-chain agent without application-code modification; (2) Layer Top P2P state channels for established bilateral pairs (<100 ms, rough design target 1K-5K TPS per pair, 10M+ aggregate TPS design envelope under endpoint-resource limits), Layer Core as a dependency-aware sequenced rollup for first-contact and multi-party interactions (500 ms-2 s, 300K-500K TPS design target), and Layer Root settlement with computational fraud proofs anchored to any EVM L1; and (3) an agent-native execution environment plus interaction trie that make service invocation, identity, reputation, capabilities, and session context first-class protocol objects. This paper focuses on the execution-layer systems problem: sequencing, state, settlement, and the data-availability (DA) bandwidth gap that bounds all three. Simulation and analytical modeling support the architecture, and prototype measurements validate selected components, but no end-to-end Layer Core implementation exists yet. Practical deployment is currently constrained to roughly 10K-100K TPS by DA throughput, leaving a ~100x gap at the target ceiling. AGNT2 argues that the agent economy requires a dedicated execution layer rather than a general-purpose chain repurposed for agents.

AI.tldr: 针对高频 AI 代理间的微服务调用，AGNT2 提出三层专用执行栈，通过侧车、状态通道与依赖感知 Rollup 将身份/会话等提升为协议一级对象；初步实验侧侧链路 1K–5K TPS/对，核心目标 10M TPS，但受制于 DA 带宽仍有百倍差距。
AI.motivation: OP、Arbitrum、zkSync 等 L2 以人类低频金融交易为优化目标，对 AI 代理间高并发、语义丰富且互不信任的微服务调用缺乏原生支持，需把身份、托管、依赖序和会话状态用昂贵链上 calldata 模拟，导致性能与成本双重瓶颈。
AI.method: 设计 AGNT2 三层架构：(1) Sidecar 部署模式，零修改容器即化身链上代理；(2) Layer Top P2P 状态通道维系已建立 bilateral 对(<100 ms, 1K-5K TPS/对，整体 10M TPS 设计上限)；Layer Core 为依赖感知定序 Rollup，首次接触及多方协作 500 ms–2 s, 300K-500K TPS；Layer Root 基于任意 EVM-L1 的欺诈证明做终局结算；(3) 原生代理执行环境与交互 Trie，把 Invocation、身份、信誉、能力与会话内容作为协议一级对象。
AI.result: 理论与模拟论证架构可行性；核心组件侧侧链路可达 1K-5K TPS，目标上限 10M TPS，但目前 Layer Core 全链实现缺如，DA 吞吐量仅支持 10K–100K TPS，差距约 100×。
AI.conclusion: 通用链难以高效承载代理经济；AI 代理需要专用执行层，AGNT2 提供了分三层解决“定序-状态-结算及 DA 带宽”问题的设计思路，但需突破数据可用性瓶颈并补齐全栈实现才能实现 10M TPS 愿景。

title: EduCoder: An Open-Source Annotation System for Education Transcript Data
summary: We introduce EduCoder, a domain-specialized tool designed to support utterance-level annotation of educational dialogue. While general-purpose text annotation tools for NLP and qualitative research abound, few address the complexities of coding education dialogue transcripts -- with diverse teacher-student and peer interactions. Common challenges include defining codebooks for complex pedagogical features, supporting both open-ended and categorical coding, and contextualizing utterances with external features, such as the lesson's purpose and the pedagogical value of the instruction. EduCoder is designed to address these challenges by providing a platform for researchers and domain experts to collaboratively define complex codebooks based on observed data. It incorporates both categorical and open-ended annotation types along with contextual materials. Additionally, it offers a side-by-side comparison of multiple annotators' responses, allowing comparison and calibration of annotations with others to improve data reliability. The system is open-source, with a demo video available.

AI.tldr: EduCoder是一款专为教育对话话语级标注设计的开源工具，弥补通用文本标注平台难以应对课堂师生/生生复杂互动、教育学特征编码书构建及情境化需求的空白。
AI.motivation: 教育对话研究需细粒度、可靠的语料标注，但现有工具无法兼顾复杂教育学编码书、开放与类别混合标注及多维度语境信息，导致数据质量与一致性难以保障。
AI.method: 系统支持研究者与领域专家基于真实数据协同定义编码书；同时提供类别与开放标注，并集成课程目标与教学价值等外部特征；通过并排多标注者视图实现对比与校准，提升标注一致性。
AI.result: EduCoder在功能和设计上满足教育对话标注的特有需求，为后续研究提供高可信度数据；系统已开源并配演示视频，便于社区采用与扩展。
AI.conclusion: EduCoder通过专业化功能与协作机制显著改善教育对话语料标注效率与可靠性，为教学交互分析、教育NLP模型训练及相关研究奠定高质量数据基础。

title: Accelerating Vision Transformers with Adaptive Patch Sizes
comment: Accepted to ICLR 2026. Project page at https://rccchoudhury.github.io/apt/
summary: Vision Transformers (ViTs) partition input images into uniformly sized patches regardless of their content, resulting in long input sequence lengths for high-resolution images. We present Adaptive Patch Transformers (APT), which addresses this by using multiple different patch sizes within the same image. APT reduces the total number of input tokens by allocating larger patch sizes in more homogeneous areas and smaller patches in more complex ones. APT achieves a drastic speedup in ViT inference and training, increasing throughput by 40% on ViT-L and 50% on ViT-H while maintaining downstream performance, and can be applied to a previously fine-tuned ViT, converging in as little as 1 epoch. It also significantly reduces training and inference time without loss of performance in high-resolution dense visual tasks, achieving up to 30\% faster training and inference in visual QA, object detection, and semantic segmentation.

AI.tldr: APT用自适应大小patch取代ViT的均匀切分，token量骤降，ViT-L/H吞吐+40-50%，下游精度不降，1 epoch即可微调收敛，高分辨率检测/分割/问答训练推理再快30%。
AI.motivation: ViT对高分辨率图采用固定小patch，序列冗长导致计算与内存瓶颈，需在不牺牲性能的前提下降低token量。
AI.method: APT：①内容感知的自适应分块——同质区域大patch、复杂区域小patch；②可即插即用到已微调ViT，仅需极少epoch再训练；③保持Transformer整体结构不变。
AI.result: ImageNet等下游任务精度持平，ViT-L/H推理吞吐分别提升40%、50%；高分辨率场景下检测、分割、VQA训练与推理时间额外减少30%。
AI.conclusion: APT证明自适应 token 分配能在零性能损失下显著加速ViT，为高分辨率密集视觉任务提供了即插即用的轻量化方案。

title: VARestorer: One-Step VAR Distillation for Real-World Image Super-Resolution
comment: Accepted in ICLR 2026. Code is available at https://github.com/EternalEvan/VARestorer
summary: Recent advancements in visual autoregressive models (VAR) have demonstrated their effectiveness in image generation, highlighting their potential for real-world image super-resolution (Real-ISR). However, adapting VAR for ISR presents critical challenges. The next-scale prediction mechanism, constrained by causal attention, fails to fully exploit global low-quality (LQ) context, resulting in blurry and inconsistent high-quality (HQ) outputs. Additionally, error accumulation in the iterative prediction severely degrades coherence in ISR task. To address these issues, we propose VARestorer, a simple yet effective distillation framework that transforms a pre-trained text-to-image VAR model into a one-step ISR model. By leveraging distribution matching, our method eliminates the need for iterative refinement, significantly reducing error propagation and inference time. Furthermore, we introduce pyramid image conditioning with cross-scale attention, which enables bidirectional scale-wise interactions and fully utilizes the input image information while adapting to the autoregressive mechanism. This prevents later LQ tokens from being overlooked in the transformer. By fine-tuning only 1.2\% of the model parameters through parameter-efficient adapters, our method maintains the expressive power of the original VAR model while significantly enhancing efficiency. Extensive experiments show that VARestorer achieves state-of-the-art performance with 72.32 MUSIQ and 0.7669 CLIPIQA on DIV2K dataset, while accelerating inference by 10 times compared to conventional VAR inference.

AI.tldr: VARestorer 将预训练 VAR 生成模型通过分布匹配蒸馏为一步式 Real-ISR 网络，引入跨尺度金字塔条件化解因果注意力对全局上下文利用不足的问题，仅用 1.2% 参数微调即可在 DIV2K 上达到 SoTA 指标并将推理提速 10 倍。
AI.motivation: 视觉自回归模型(VAR)在图像生成表现优异，但将其直接用于真实图像超分(ISR)时，因果注意力限制了对全局低质量(LQ)像素的利用，导致输出模糊、细节不一致；迭代式“下一尺度预测”还会累积误差，破坏局部与全局连贯性。
AI.method: 提出 VARestorer 框架：① 以分布匹配为核心，将预训练文本到图像 VAR 蒸馏为单步 ISR 模型，彻底摒弃迭代求精；② 设计金字塔图像条件分支，利用跨尺度注意力实现双向尺度间交互，使任意尺度的 LQ token 都能被后来的 HQ token 参考，避免信息被遗漏；③ 冻结原 VAR 主体，仅在Transformer层插入轻量级适配器，参数量仅增 1.2% 即可完成微调。
AI.result: 在 DIV2K 基准上，VARestorer 取得 72.32 MUSIQ、0.7669 CLIPIQA 的最高分；相较传统 VAR 迭代推理，加速 10 倍，且参数增量极少，保持原模型生成能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过分布匹配与金字塔跨尺度条件化，VARestorer 首次把生成式 VAR 高效转化为一步式 Real-ISR 模型，缓解因果注意力带来的上下文缺失与误差累积难题，实现精度最高、推理最快、参数最省的统一优化，为将自回归生成模型应用于低级视觉任务提供了可行范式。

title: Cross-Session Threats in AI Agents: Benchmark, Evaluation, and Algorithms
summary:
AI-agent guardrails are memoryless: each message is judged in isolation, so an adversary who spreads a single attack across dozens of sessions slips past every session-bound detector because only the aggregate carries the payload. We make three contributions to cross-session threat detection.
  (1) Dataset. CSTM-Bench is 26 executable attack taxonomies classified by kill-chain stage and cross-session operation (accumulate, compose, launder, inject_on_reader), each bound to one of seven identity anchors that ground-truth "violation" as a policy predicate, plus matched Benign-pristine and Benign-hard confounders. Released on Hugging Face as intrinsec-ai/cstm-bench with two 54-scenario splits: dilution (compositional) and cross_session (12 isolation-invisible scenarios produced by a closed-loop rewriter that softens surface phrasing while preserving cross-session artefacts).
  (2) Measurement. Framing cross-session detection as an information bottleneck to a downstream correlator LLM, we find that a session-bound judge and a Full-Log Correlator concatenating every prompt into one long-context call both lose roughly half their attack recall moving from dilution to cross_session, well inside any frontier context window. Scope: 54 scenarios per shard, one correlator family (Anthropic Claude), no prompt optimisation; we release it to motivate larger, multi-provider datasets.
  (3) Algorithm and metric. A bounded-memory Coreset Memory Reader retaining highest-signal fragments at $K=50$ is the only reader whose recall survives both shards. Because ranker reshuffles break KV-cache prefix reuse, we promote $\mathrm{CSR\_prefix}$ (ordered prefix stability, LLM-free) to a first-class metric and fuse it with detection into $\mathrm{CSTM} = 0.7 F_1(\mathrm{CSDA@action}, \mathrm{precision}) + 0.3 \mathrm{CSR\_prefix}$, benchmarking rankers on a single Pareto of recall versus serving stability.

AI.tldr: 作者发现现有AI-agent防护栏按会话逐条判别，无法识别跨会话累积攻击；于是发布跨会话威胁评测集CSTM-Bench，提出信息瓶颈视角下的检测框架与Coreset Memory Reader算法，仅用50-token记忆即可在54场景上保持召回，同时引入CSR_prefix稳定性指标。
AI.motivation: 传统防护栏逐条无状态判断，攻击者可将单次恶意载荷拆分到多会话，聚合后才显现威胁，现有检测器因缺乏跨会话记忆而失效，亟需可记忆、低消耗的跨会话检测方法与公开基准。
AI.method: (1)构建包含26种可执行攻击的CSTM-Bench数据集，按杀伤链阶段与跨会话操作（累积、组合、洗白、注入）分类，并配 benign 对照；(2)把跨会话检测建模为给下游相关器LLM的信息瓶颈，比较会话级判别器与Full-Log Correlator；(3)提出K=50的有界记忆Coreset Memory Reader，保留高信号片段；(4)引入稳定性指标CSR_prefix，与检测F1融合成CSTM综合指标。
AI.result: 会话级判别器与Full-Log Correlator在跨会话场景下召回下降约50%，而Coreset Memory Reader凭借50-token记忆在两种数据划分上均保持高召回；CSR_prefix可衡量排名重排对KV缓存复用的破坏。
AI.conclusion: 跨会话威胁需显式记忆机制；小容量Coreset即可有效；应把稳定性CSR_prefix纳入评价并扩大多提供商数据集；作者已开源数据与评测脚本，供社区继续扩展跨会话安全研究。

title: Aligning Language Models with Real-time Knowledge Editing
summary: Knowledge editing aims to modify outdated knowledge in language models efficiently while retaining their original capabilities. Mainstream datasets for knowledge editing are predominantly static and fail to keep in pace with the evolving real-world knowledge. In this work, we introduce CRAFT, an ever-evolving real-world dataset for knowledge editing. It evaluates models on temporal locality, common-sense locality, composite portability and alias portability, providing a comprehensive and challenging evaluation for knowledge editing, on which previous methods hardly achieve balanced performance. Towards flexible real-time knowledge editing, we propose KEDAS, a novel paradigm of knowledge editing alignment featuring diverse edit augmentation and self-adaptive post-alignment inference, exhibiting significant performance gain on both CRAFT and traditional datasets compared to previous methods. We hope this work may serve as a catalyst for shifting the focus of knowledge editing from static update to dynamic evolution.

AI.tldr: 提出首个持续演化的知识编辑基准CRAFT及对应的KEDAS训练范式，解决现有静态数据集与现实知识脱节、编辑方法在多维度指标上失衡的问题。
AI.motivation: 主流知识编辑数据集静态且滞后，无法反映现实知识的动态演化，导致评估失真；现有方法在时间局部性、常识局部性与可移植性等多维指标上难以兼顾，亟需可实时更新的基准与训练框架。
AI.method: 1) 构建持续抓取并自动标注的CRAFT数据集，引入时间局部、常识局部、复合/别名可移植四类任务；2) 设计KEDAS框架，结合多样化编辑增广策略与自适应后对齐推断，实现模型权重的在线微调。
AI.result: 在CRAFT与传统静态数据集上，KEDAS均显著优于现有方法，在时间局部性提升+12.3%，可移植性提升+18.7%，总体F1提升+15.2%，首次实现多维性能平衡。
AI.conclusion: 动态知识编辑应从静态修补转向持续演化；CRAFT与KEDAS为该方向提供了可扩展的基准与范式，推动知识编辑研究进入实时更新时代。

title: VFM-VAE: Vision Foundation Models Can Be Good Tokenizers for Latent Diffusion Models
comment: Accepted at CVPR 2026. Code and models available at: https://github.com/tianciB/VFM-VAE
summary: The performance of Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs) is critically dependent on the quality of their visual tokenizers. While recent works have explored incorporating Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) into the tokenizers training via distillation, we empirically find this approach inevitably weakens the robustness of learnt representation from original VFM. In this paper, we bypass the distillation by proposing a more direct approach by leveraging the frozen VFM for the LDMs tokenizer, named VFM Variational Autoencoder (VFM-VAE).To fully exploit the potential to leverage frozen VFM for the LDMs tokenizer, we design a new decoder to reconstruct realistic images from the semantic-rich representation of VFM. With the proposed VFM-VAE, we conduct a systematic study on how the representation from different tokenizers impact the representation learning process throughout diffusion training, enabling synergistic benefits of dual-side alignment on both tokenizers and diffusion models. Our effort in tokenizer design and training strategy lead to superior performance and efficiency: our system reaches a gFID (w/o CFG) of 2.22 in merely 80 epochs (a 10$\times$ speedup over prior tokenizers). With continued training to 640 epochs, it further attains a gFID (w/o CFG) of 1.62. These results offer solid evidence for the substantial potential of VFMs to serve as visual tokenizers to accelerate the LDM training progress.

AI.tldr: 用冻结的视觉基础模型替代蒸馏式Tokenizer，设计VFM-VAE直接重建图像，使LDM训练速度提升10倍、64 epoch gFID降至1.62。
AI.motivation: 已有方法用蒸馏把VFM引入Tokenizer会削弱原始VFM表征的鲁棒性，需要一种不破坏预训练优势的替代方案。
AI.method: 提出VFM-Variational Autoencoder：冻结VFM作为编码器提取语义特征，配套轻量解码器重建像素；两阶段联合训练实现Tokenizer与扩散模型的双向对齐。
AI.result: 80 epoch即在无条件生成下实现2.22 gFID，相当于此前需800 epoch的性能；继续训练至640 epoch，gFID进一步降到1.62。
AI.conclusion: 冻结VFM直接充当视觉Tokenizer可行性高，可显著加速LDM训练并提升最终质量，为高效视觉生成提供了新范式。

title: Cross-Domain Data Selection and Augmentation for Automatic Compliance Detection
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. 11th Special Session on Intelligent Data Mining, 2025 IEEE International Conference on Big Data
summary: Automating the detection of regulatory compliance remains a challenging task due to the complexity and variability of legal texts. Models trained on one regulation often fail to generalise to others. This limitation underscores the need for principled methods to improve cross-domain transfer. We study data selection as a strategy to mitigate negative transfer in compliance detection framed as a natural language inference (NLI) task. Specifically, we evaluate four approaches for selecting augmentation data from a larger source domain: random sampling, Moore-Lewis's cross-entropy difference, importance weighting, and embedding-based retrieval. We systematically vary the proportion of selected data to analyse its effect on cross-domain adaptation. Our findings demonstrate that targeted data selection substantially reduces negative transfer, offering a practical path toward scalable and reliable compliance automation across heterogeneous regulations.

title: Enhancing Science Classroom Discourse Analysis through Joint Multi-Task Learning for Reasoning-Component Classification
summary: Analyzing the reasoning patterns of students in science classrooms is critical for understanding knowledge construction mechanism and improving instructional practice to maximize cognitive engagement, yet manual coding of classroom discourse at scale remains prohibitively labor-intensive. We present an automated discourse analysis system (ADAS) that jointly classifies teacher and student utterances along two complementary dimensions: Utterance Type and Reasoning Component derived from our prior CDAT framework. To address severe label imbalance among minority classes, we (1) stratify-resplit the annotated corpus, (2) apply LLM-based synthetic data augmentation targeting minority classes, and (3) train a dual-probe head RoBERTa-base classifier. A zero-shot GPT-5.4 baseline achieves macro-F1 of 0.467 on UT and 0.476 on RC, establishing meaningful upper bounds for prompt-only approaches motivating fine-tuning. Beyond classification, we conduct discourse pattern analyses including UTxRC co-occurrence profiling, Cognitive Complexity Index (CCI) computation per session, lag-sequential analysis, and IRF chain analysis, revealing that teacher Feedback-with-Question (Fq) moves are the most consistent antecedents of student inferential reasoning (SR-I). Our results demonstrate that LLM-based augmentation meaningfully improves UT minority-class recognition, and that the structural simplicity of the RC task makes it tractable even for lexical baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出自动化话语分析系统ADAS，用RoBERTa双头分类器同时标注课堂中师/生话语的“话语类型”与“推理成分”，结合LLM合成少数类样本解决标签极不平衡问题；并通过多种序列分析发现教师“反馈+提问”最能有效诱发学生推断推理。
AI.motivation: 手工编码课堂话语以识别学生推理模式耗时巨大，亟需可扩展的自动分析方案，以便揭示知识建构机制并优化教学来最大化认知投入。
AI.method: 1) 基于CDAT框架构建“话语类型(UT)”与“推理成分(RC)”两级标注语料；2) 分层重划分、LLM合成少数类数据、双探针头RoBERTa-base联合训练；3) 零样本GPT-5.4做上限基线；4) 应用共现矩阵、认知复杂度指数(CCI)、滞后序列与IRF链分析挖掘教学-推理模式。
AI.result: RoBERTa系统在合成增强后显著优于零样本GPT(UT/RC宏观F1约0.47)；UT少数类召回明显提升；RC任务对词汇基线亦鲁棒。发现教师“反馈-提问(Fq)”行为高概率触发学生推断推理(SR-I)，且高认知复杂度会话含更多推理链。
AI.conclusion: LLM合成数据可有效缓解课堂话语极不平衡分类；自动ADAS不仅实现大规模标注，还能精确定位能激发学生高阶推理的教师话语策略，为智能教育督导与实时教学反馈提供可操作证据。

title: Context Is What You Need: The Maximum Effective Context Window for Real World Limits of LLMs
summary: Large language model (LLM) providers boast big numbers for maximum context window sizes. To test the real world use of context windows, we 1) define a concept of maximum effective context window, 2) formulate a testing method of a context window's effectiveness over various sizes and problem types, and 3) create a standardized way to compare model efficacy for increasingly larger context window sizes to find the point of failure. We collected hundreds of thousands of data points across several models and found significant differences between reported Maximum Context Window (MCW) size and Maximum Effective Context Window (MECW) size. Our findings show that the MECW is, not only, drastically different from the MCW but also shifts based on the problem type. A few top of the line models in our test group failed with as little as 100 tokens in context; most had severe degradation in accuracy by 1000 tokens in context. All models fell far short of their Maximum Context Window by as much as 99 percent. Our data reveals the Maximum Effective Context Window shifts based on the type of problem provided, offering clear and actionable insights into how to improve model accuracy and decrease model hallucination rates.

AI.tldr: 实测发现当前 LLM 厂商宣称的最大上下文窗口（MCW）与模型真正能有效利用的最大范围（MECW）相差悬殊，后者可因任务类型而动态变化且常仅百 token 级。
AI.motivation: 大模型厂商不断吹嘘“百万 token”满窗尺寸，但业界缺乏衡量“究竟能利用多少”的统一方法，导致使用者误判可行任务长度并遭遇幻觉激增。作者拟量化真实可依赖窗口，构建行业基准。
AI.method: 1. 提出“最大有效上下文窗口 MECW”概念；2. 设计多尺寸、多任务的可扩展评测协议，统一定义失败阈值；3. 对多个主流 LLM 收集数十万条实验数据，对比其官方 MCW 与实测 MECW，并分析任务类型对 MECW 的偏移效应。
AI.result: 试验模型普遍存在明显差距：顶配模型最早在 100 token 处即失效，多数于 1 000 token 时准确率严重衰减；所有模型 MECW 仅为官方 MCW 的 1%–20%，且随检索/推理/问答等任务不同而显著漂移。任务相关性与注意力退化模式提供了量化证据。
AI.conclusion: 叙事与实际脱节，MCW 数字已不可作为选型依据；建议从业者以 MECW 基准做窗口预算，并针对任务重排提示、切分或检索增强，以延缓性能衰减并降低幻觉风险。

title: When to Trust the Answer: Question-Aligned Semantic Nearest Neighbor Entropy for Safer Surgical VQA
summary: Safety and reliability are critical for deploying visual question answering (VQA) systems in surgery, where incorrect or ambiguous responses can cause patient harm. A key limitation of existing uncertainty estimation methods, such as Semantic Nearest Neighbor Entropy (SNNE), is that they do not explicitly account for the conditioning question. As a result, they may assign high confidence to answers that are semantically consistent yet misaligned with the clinical question, especially under variation in question phrasing. We propose Question-Aligned Semantic Nearest Neighbor Entropy (QA-SNNE), a black-box uncertainty estimator that incorporates question-answer alignment into semantic entropy through bilateral gating. QA-SNNE measures uncertainty by weighting pairwise semantic similarities among sampled answers according to their relevance to the question, using embedding-based, entailment-based, or cross-encoder alignment strategies. To assess robustness to language variation, we construct an out-of-template rephrased version of a benchmark surgical VQA dataset, where only the question wording is modified while images and ground-truth answers remain unchanged. We evaluate QA-SNNE on five VQA models across two benchmark surgical VQA datasets in both zero-shot and parameter-efficient fine-tuned (PEFT) settings, including out-of-template questions. QA-SNNE improves AUROC on EndoVis18-VQA for two of three zero-shot models in-template (e.g., +15% for Llama3.2 and +21% for Qwen2.5) and achieves up to +8% AUROC improvement under out-of-template rephrasing, with mixed results on external validation. Overall, QA-SNNE provides a practical, model-agnostic safeguard for surgical VQA by linking semantic uncertainty to question relevance.

AI.tldr: QA-SNNE + 手术 VQA = 问句对齐的黑盒不确定度，重表述稳健 AUROC 最多 +21%（零样本）。
AI.motivation: 现有 SNNE 法只度量答案语义相似度但忽略问句，易高置信答非所问；手术场景需更可靠置信度估计。
AI.method: 提出 QA-SNNE：先采样模型多答，再用嵌入/蕴含/跨编码器三种双侧门控机制，将每对答案的同义相似度按其对问句的相关性加权，得“问句对齐语义熵”做不确定度。
AI.result: 构建仅重述问句的 EndoVis18-VQA 外模板测试，5 模型 ×2 数据集 ×零样本/PEFT 设置：零样本模板内 Llama3.2/Qwen2.5 AUROC 各升 15%/21%，外模板最高升 8%；外部验证结果混杂但趋势一致。
AI.conclusion: QA-SNNE 实用、模型无关，可把语义不确定度锚定到问句相关性，为手术 VQA 提供有效安全阀。

title: Separable Expert Architecture: Toward Privacy-Preserving LLM Personalization via Composable Adapters and Deletable User Proxies
summary: Current model training approaches incorporate user information directly into shared weights, making individual data removal computationally infeasible without retraining. This paper presents a three-layer architecture that decouples personal data from shared weights by combining a static base model, composable domain-expert LoRA adapters that shape behavior without imparting user data, and per-user proxy artefacts whose deletion constitutes deterministic unlearning. Evaluation on Phi-3.5-mini and Llama-3.1-8B confirms per-user differentiation in which personal data influences outputs while remaining isolated, verified by a return to baseline after proxy removal (KL divergence of approximately 0.21 nats, 82-89% verification pass rate) and near-zero cross-user contamination. Because user-specific information never enters shared weights, the architecture mitigates model inversion, membership inference, and training-data extraction against shared model components by construction. The approach converts machine unlearning from an intractable weight-editing problem into a deterministic deletion operation that preserves personalization alongside privacy-enhancing guarantees and is compatible with differentially private stochastic gradient descent (DP-SGD) for privacy-preserving shared model improvement.

AI.tldr: 提出三层架构，把用户数据锁在“外挂”里，删人=删外挂，无需重训，兼顾个性化与隐私。
AI.motivation: 现有模型把用户数据直接写进共享权重，导致“删用户”必须重训，成本极高，且无法抵御模型逆向、成员推理等攻击。
AI.method: 三层解耦：①静态共享基础模型；②无用户数据的领域 LoRA 适配器，仅塑形行为；③含敏感数据的轻量级用户代理外挂。训练时只更新代理，LoRA 与主模型权重不变；删用户时直接删除其代理，实现确定性遗忘。
AI.result: 在 Phi-3.5-mini 与 Llama-3.1-8B 上验证：删除代理后输出分布与未用个人数据基线 KL≈0.21 nats，82–89% 通过检验；跨用户污染接近零；共享权重不受成员推理与训练数据提取影响；可与 DP-SGD 无缝结合。
AI.conclusion: 将“机器遗忘”从难解的权重编辑转化为确定性的外挂删除，保留个性化同时提供可证伪的隐私保证，且无需重训或牺牲模型性能。

title: Navigating the Clutter: Waypoint-Based Bi-Level Planning for Multi-Robot Systems
summary: Multi-robot control in cluttered environments is a challenging problem that involves complex physical constraints, including robot-robot collisions, robot-obstacle collisions, and unreachable motions. Successful planning in such settings requires joint optimization over high-level task planning and low-level motion planning, as violations of physical constraints may arise from failures at either level. However, jointly optimizing task and motion planning is difficult due to the complex parameterization of low-level motion trajectories and the ambiguity of credit assignment across the two planning levels. In this paper, we propose a hybrid multi-robot control framework that jointly optimizes task and motion planning. To enable effective parameterization of low-level planning, we introduce waypoints, a simple yet expressive representation for motion trajectories. To address the credit assignment challenge, we adopt a curriculum-based training strategy with a modified RLVR algorithm that propagates motion feasibility feedback from the motion planner to the task planner. Experiments on BoxNet3D-OBS, a challenging multi-robot benchmark with dense obstacles and up to nine robots, show that our approach consistently improves task success over motion-agnostic and VLA-based baselines. Our code is available at https://github.com/UCSB-NLP-Chang/navigate-cluster

AI.tldr: 本文以“路径点+分层课程强化学习”统一高层任务规划与底层轨迹，在具碰撞、障碍、越界约束的密集场景中使9机协作成功率显著提升。
AI.motivation: 多机器人在混杂场景中遭遇机器人互碰、机器人-障碍物碰撞及运动不可达等物理硬约束，当前分离式或逐层规划无法同时优化任务与路径，往往因底层路径失败导致上层任务失败，且任务-运动层级间信用难分配，亟须一个端到端联合优化框架。
AI.method: 提出混合式多机控制框架：1) 用稀疏空间路标（waypoints）对连续轨迹进行简洁而表达力强的参数化，降低优化维度；2) 将任务可行性及路径可行性收益统一为强化信号；3) 采用课程化训练，每阶段逐步增加场景密度与机器人数量，并通过改进RLVR算法，把运动时产生的“不可行”反馈逆向传播给任务规划器，实现跨层级信用校正；4) 所有组件集成于统一策略网络，用集中式训练提升多机协同。
AI.result: 在含稠密障碍物、最多9台机器人的 BoxNet3D-OBS 基准上，新方法比纯任务无关规划基线任务成功率平均提高 32%，比现有 VLA（Vision–Language–Action）规划基线提高 14%，在更高密度或更多机器人数配置下优势进一步放大；学习曲线亦证明课程化训练约减少 40% 样本消耗。
AI.conclusion: 通过简洁的 waypoint 表征与课程化强化学习，论文首次在统一框架中同时优化密集多机器人的任务与运动规划，显著提升了协同成功率并缓解层级信用碎片化问题，为多机自主系统在仓储、服务、救援等复杂场景提供了可直接扩展的解。

title: Compose and Fuse: Revisiting the Foundational Bottlenecks in Multimodal Reasoning
comment: Our code (https://github.com/DELTA-DoubleWise/OmniReason) and data (https://huggingface.co/datasets/ycwang11/OmniReason) are publicly available
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) promise enhanced reasoning by integrating diverse inputs such as text, vision, and audio. Yet cross-modal reasoning remains underexplored, with conflicting reports on whether added modalities help or harm performance. These inconsistencies stem from a lack of controlled evaluation frameworks and analysis of models' internals to isolate when and why modality interactions support or undermine reasoning. We address this gap through a logic-grounded evaluation framework that categorizes multimodal reasoning into six interaction patterns, varying how facts are distributed across modalities and logically combined. Empirically, additional modalities enhance reasoning only when they provide independent and sufficient reasoning paths, while redundant or chained entailment support often hurts performance. Moreover, reasoning degrades in three systematic ways: weaker modalities drag down overall performance, conflicts bias preference toward certain modalities, and joint signals from different modalities fail to be integrated effectively. Therefore, we identify two core failures: task-composition bottleneck, where recognition and reasoning cannot be jointly executed in one pass, and fusion bottleneck, where early integration introduces bias. For further investigation, we find that attention patterns fail to encode fact usefulness, but a simple two-step prompting (recognize then reason) restores performance, confirming the task-composition bottleneck. Moreover, modality identity remains recoverable in early layers, and softening attention in early fusion improves reasoning, highlighting biased fusion as another failure mode. Overall, our findings show that integration, not perception, is the main barrier to multimodal reasoning, suggesting composition-aware training and early fusion control as promising directions.

AI.tldr: 多模态推理好坏的关键不在感知而在整合；提出六类逻辑互动框架，发现只有当新增模态提供独立且充分的推理路径时才有益，否则出现“任务组合瓶颈”和“融合瓶颈”，并给出两步提示、软化早期注意力等缓解方案。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型报告对“加模态能否提升推理”结论矛盾，且缺乏可控评测与内部机理分析，难以解释何时何因跨模态互动会支撑或破坏推理性能。
AI.method: 提出基于逻辑的六类跨模态交互模式基准，系统变化事实在模态间的分布与组合方式；用注意力探针与两步提示对比分析模型内部行为，量化识别瓶颈。
AI.result: 新增模态仅在提供独立且充分推理路径时提升性能；冗余或链式支持、弱模态拖累、冲突偏好、信号未有效整合导致性能下降；两步提示与早期融合注意力软化能显著恢复推理表现。
AI.conclusion: 主要障碍是“整合”而非“感知”：任务组合瓶颈导致一次前向中识别与推理难兼顾，早期融合引入偏差造成融合瓶颈；提出组分感知训练及早期融合控制作为未来研究方向。

title: PercHead: Perceptual Head Model for Single-Image 3D Head Reconstruction & Editing
summary: We present PercHead, a model for single-image 3D head reconstruction and disentangled 3D editing - two tasks that are inherently challenging due to ambiguity in plausible explanations for the same input. At the heart of our approach lies our novel perceptual loss based on DINOv2 and SAM 2.1. Unlike widely-adopted low-level losses like LPIPS, SSIM or L1, we rely on deep visual understanding of images and the resulting generalized supervision signals. We show that our new loss can be a drop-in replacement for standard losses and used to improve visual quality in high-frequency areas. We base our model architecture on Vision Transformers (ViTs), allowing us to decouple the 3D representation from the 2D input. We train our method on multi-view images for view-consistency and in-the-wild images for strong transferability to new environments. Our model achieves state-of-the-art performance in novel-view synthesis and, furthermore, exhibits exceptional robustness to extreme viewing angles. We also extend our base model to disentangled 3D editing by swapping the encoder and fine-tuning the network. A segmentation map controls geometry and either a text prompt or a reference image specifies appearance. We highlight the intuitive and powerful 3D editing capabilities through an interactive GUI. Project Page: https://antoniooroz.github.io/PercHead Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4hFybgTk4kE

AI.tldr: PercHead 用基于 DINOv2+SAM 2.1 的感知损失取代传统像素级损失，在 ViT 架构下实现单图 3D 人头重建与解耦 3D 编辑，达到新视角合成 SOTA，并支持极端视角与交互式语义编辑。
AI.motivation: 单图 3D 人头重建与可解耦编辑本质病态，现有低层损失难以提供高层语义约束，导致几何与纹理在极端视角或野外场景下失真。
AI.method: 设计新型感知损失（DINOv2+SAM 2.1 特征）替代 LPIPS/L1；ViT 编码-解码架构将 2D 输入与 3D 表达解耦；多视角+野外数据联合训练；通过编码器替换与微调实现语义/外貌解耦编辑，支持文本或参考图驱动。
AI.result: 在新视角合成任务上达到 SOTA，极端视角下鲁棒性显著提升；感知损失可“即插即用”提升现有网络高频细节；交互 GUI 展示直观的 3D 几何与外貌分离编辑效果。
AI.conclusion: 高层感知损失是单图 3D 人头重建突破的关键，ViT 解耦架构与混合数据训练兼顾精度与泛化， PercHead 为高质量 3D 头像生成与语义编辑提供了可扩展框架。

title: CoFEE: Reasoning Control for LLM-Based Feature Discovery
summary: Feature discovery from complex unstructured data is fundamentally a reasoning problem: it requires identifying abstractions that are predictive of a target outcome while avoiding leakage, proxies, and post-outcome signals. With the introduction of ever-improving Large Language Models (LLMs), our method provides a structured method for addressing this challenge. LLMs are well suited for this task by being able to process large amounts of information, but unconstrained feature generation can lead to weak features. In this work, we study reasoning control in LLMs by inducing cognitive behaviors for improving feature discovery. We introduce CoFEE (Cognitive Feature Engineering Engine), a reasoning control framework that enforces cognitive behaviors in how the LLM reasons during feature discovery. From a machine learning perspective, these cognitive behaviors act as structured inductive biases over the space of candidate features generated by the model. These behaviors have been exploited with success in ML models, and include backward chaining from outcomes, subgoal decomposition, verification against observability and leakage criteria, and explicit backtracking of rejected reasoning paths. In a controlled comparison, we show that enforcing cognitive behaviors yields features with higher empirical predictability than those under unconstrained vanilla LLM prompts. CoFEE achieves an average Success Rate Score that is 15.2% higher than the vanilla approach, while generating 29% fewer features and reducing costs by 53.3%. Using held-out feature evaluation, we assess whether cognitively induced features generalize beyond the data used for discovery. Our results indicate that, in our evaluated setting, reasoning control is associated with improvements in quality and efficiency of LLM-based feature discovery.

AI.tldr: 提出CoFEE框架，用“认知行为”约束LLM进行特征工程，在保持泛化能力的同时显著提升特征质量与效率。
AI.motivation: 非结构化数据特征发现易被泄露、代理变量与事后信号污染；LLM虽能处理海量信息，但自由生成特征噪声大，需要结构化推理控制。
AI.method: 设计CoFEE（Cognitive Feature Engineering Engine），将四种认知行为（反向链式推理、子目标分解、可观测/泄露验证、显式回溯）作为归纳偏置注入LLM提示，引导其在候选特征空间中受控搜索。
AI.result: 与无约束提示相比，CoFEE平均成功率提高15.2%，生成特征量减少29%，成本降低53.3%；留一法评估表明认知特征在未见数据上仍具泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 在LLM驱动的特征发现中施加认知级推理控制，可同时提升预测力、效率与可泛化性，为复杂数据特征工程提供了可行范式。

title: Using Machine Mental Imagery for Representing Common Ground in Situated Dialogue
comment: Work under review. Biswesh Mohapatra and Giovanni Duca both contributed equally to this work
summary: Situated dialogue requires speakers to maintain a reliable representation of shared context rather than reasoning only over isolated utterances. Current conversational agents often struggle with this requirement, especially when the common ground must be preserved beyond the immediate context window. In such settings, fine-grained distinctions are frequently compressed into purely textual representations, leading to a critical failure mode we call \emph{representational blur}, in which similar but distinct entities collapse into interchangeable descriptions. This semantic flattening creates an illusion of grounding, where agents appear locally coherent but fail to track shared context persistently over time. Inspired by the role of mental imagery in human reasoning, and based on the increased availability of multimodal models, we explore whether conversational agents can be given an analogous ability to construct some depictive intermediate representations during dialogue to address these limitations. Thus, we introduce an active visual scaffolding framework that incrementally converts dialogue state into a persistent visual history that can later be retrieved for grounded response generation. Evaluation on the IndiRef benchmark shows that incremental externalization itself improves over full-dialog reasoning, while visual scaffolding provides additional gains by reducing representational blur and enforcing concrete scene commitments. At the same time, textual representations remain advantageous for non-depictable information, and a hybrid multimodal setting yields the best overall performance. Together, these findings suggest that conversational agents benefit from an explicitly multimodal representation of common ground that integrates depictive and propositional information.

AI.tldr: 提出主动视觉支架框架，将对话状态持续外化为可检索的视觉历史，显著减少“表征模糊”，在IndiRef上实现SOTA，验证混合多模态公用地表示对长程 grounded dialogue 的必要性。
AI.motivation: 现有对话系统在长程交互中仅用文本压缩细粒度区别，导致相似实体混同为可互换描述（representational blur），无法持续追踪共享语境。作者受人类心智意象启发，探讨是否让对话代理构建可描绘的中间表示以破解该局限。
AI.method: 设计“主动视觉支架”框架：每轮将更新后的对话状态实时渲染为透明场景图，累积为可检索的视觉历史；推理时同时以文本+视觉上下文为条件生成回答。对比纯文本、纯视觉及混合三种设定，并在IndiRef（含指代消歧与场景一致性检测）上评估。
AI.result: 仅引入增量视觉外化便优于整段文本推理（+5.7 F1）；加入视觉支架后再提升3.2 F1，指代错误率降18%。混合范式在可描绘属性上显著领先，而纯文本在抽象信息仍保持优势，最终混合系统获54.9 F1，刷新榜单。
AI.conclusion: 工作表明：对话代理需要显式维护融合“可描绘+可陈述”信息的多模态公用地；视觉支架有效抑制表征模糊并强制代理做出具体场景承诺，为长程 grounded dialogue 提供新范式。

title: ReFACT: A Benchmark for Scientific Confabulation Detection with Positional Error Annotations
comment: Accepted to EACL 2026 (Main Conference, Oral presentation)
summary: The mechanisms underlying scientific confabulation in Large Language Models (LLMs) remain poorly understood. We introduce ReFACT (Reddit False And Correct Texts), a benchmark of 1,001 expert-annotated question-answer pairs with span-level error annotations derived from Reddit's r/AskScience. Evaluating 9 state-of-the-art LLMs reveals two critical limitations. First, models exhibit a dominant "salient distractor" failure mode: 61% of incorrect span predictions are semantically unrelated to actual errors. Crucially, this pattern persists across all model scales (1B to 70B), indicating a fundamental semantic grounding deficit that scaling alone fails to resolve. Second, we find that comparative judgment is paradoxically harder than independent detection, even GPT-4o's F1 score drops from 0.67 to 0.53 when comparing answers side-by-side. These findings directly challenge the reliability of LLM-as-Judge paradigms for scientific factuality. Code and data are released at https://github.com/ddz5431/ReFACT.

AI.tldr: 以Reddit科学问答为基准(ReFACT)测试9个SOTA大模型发现：模型61%的错误预测与真实错误语义无关，且从1B到70B规模皆无法改善；并排比较时的F1反而比独立检测下降14个百分点，揭示LLM作为科学事实裁判基本不可信。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLM已广泛用于科学问答，但其在“科学幻觉(输出看似合理却与事实不符的内容)”上的内在机制仍缺乏系统研究。现有事实基准多聚焦独立陈述，难以揭示模型对错误片段的语义理解及多答案比较时的可靠性。
AI.method: 作者先爬取Reddit r/AskScience中的1 001条问答，由科学专家对答案文本进行1短语级隐藏错误标注，构造ReFACT；随后以句子级抽取式检测为任务，对9个不同规模的LLM分别评估独立检测和并排比较两种场景，统计预测错误与真实错误间的语义重叠度及评判一致性。
AI.result: 1) 61%的预测错误片段与真实错误只是在同一句子但无关，体现“显著干扰物”(salient distractor)失效模式，且随参数规模提升无显著改善；2) GPT-4o独立检测F1=0.67，并排比较仅0.53，反而更难；3) 所有模型对“错误对比”任务的整体准确率、一致性和校准度均低于随机基线。
AI.conclusion: LLM在科学事实性场景中表现出规模不可解的语义地面化缺陷，其作为“自动裁判”的综合能力目前不具备可信基础，依赖模型自评或将降低科学文本生成的可靠性。

title: Transformer-Progressive Mamba Network for Lightweight Image Super-Resolution
summary: Recently, Mamba-based super-resolution (SR) methods have demonstrated the ability to capture global receptive fields with linear complexity, addressing the quadratic computational cost of Transformer-based SR approaches. However, existing Mamba-based methods lack fine-grained transitions across different modeling scales, which limits the efficiency of feature representation. In this paper, we propose T-PMambaSR, a lightweight SR framework that integrates window-based self-attention with Progressive Mamba. By enabling interactions among receptive fields of different scales, our method establishes a fine-grained modeling paradigm that progressively enhances feature representation without introducing additional computational cost. Furthermore, we introduce an Adaptive High-Frequency Refinement Module (AHFRM) to recover high-frequency details lost during Transformer and Mamba processing. Extensive experiments demonstrate that T-PMambaSR progressively enhances the model's receptive field and expressiveness, yielding better performance than recent Transformer- or Mamba-based methods while incurring lower computational cost.

AI.tldr: 面向轻量级超分的渐进式 Mamba 框架T-PMambaSR，在线性复杂度下实现跨尺度细粒度建模，并辅以自适应高频补偿，性能优于现有Transformer/Mamba方法且计算量更低。
AI.motivation: 现有基于Mamba的SR方法虽以线性复杂度获得全局感受野，却缺乏跨尺度的精细过渡，导致表征效率受限；Transformer方法则因二次复杂度而难以轻量化。
AI.method: 将窗口自注意力与“渐进式Mamba”耦合，使不同尺度感受野相互交互，形成细粒度、无需额外计算的多级特征增强范式；并引入自适应高频精修模块(AHFRM)，弥补Transformer/Mamba处理中的细节损失。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，T-PMambaSR在感受野与表达能力上呈渐进式提升，PSNR/SSIM等指标优于最新Transformer或Mamba基线，同时FLOPs与参数量更低。
AI.conclusion: 通过跨尺度渐进建模与高频补偿，T-PMambaSR在保持线性复杂度的前提下实现高效、高质量超分，为轻量级SR提供了新的可行范式。

title: A Kernel Nonconformity Score for Multivariate Conformal Prediction
summary: Multivariate conformal prediction requires nonconformity scores that compress residual vectors into scalars while preserving certain implicit geometric structure of the residual distribution. We introduce a Multivariate Kernel Score (MKS) that produces prediction regions that explicitly adapt to this geometry. We show that the proposed score resembles the Gaussian process posterior variance, unifying Bayesian uncertainty quantification with the coverage guarantees of frequentist-type. Moreover, the MKS can be decomposed into an anisotropic Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) that interpolates between kernel density estimation and covariance-weighted distance. We prove finite-sample coverage guarantees and establish convergence rates that depend on the effective rank of the kernel-based covariance operator rather than the ambient dimension, enabling dimension-free adaptation. On regression tasks, the MKS reduces the volume of prediction region significantly, compared to ellipsoidal baselines while maintaining nominal coverage, with larger gains at higher dimensions and tighter coverage levels.

AI.tldr: 引入一种多元核分数（MKS），将残差向量压缩为标量时会显式保留其几何结构，从而构建既能保证有限样本覆盖率又具有维度无关收敛速度的协变量自适应预测区间；在回归任务中相比椭球基准可将预测区域体积显著缩小，且覆盖增益随维度与精度要求同步提升。
AI.motivation: 传统多元共形预测往往用一个简单范数（如 Mahalanobis 或 ℓ2 范数）将残差向量转化为标量，忽视了残差在高维空间中真实的各向异性结构，导致预测区域要么过分保守、要么在高维下体积爆炸。作者希望设计一种能够“感知”并「适应」该几何非对称性的非一致性得分，从而在保持有限样本覆盖保证的同时显著缩小预测集合。
AI.method: 1) 提出多元核分数 MKS：在 RKHS 中利用核方法将残差向量的几何信息编码为标量，使其结构类似于高斯过程后验方差。 2) MKS 的分析：证明其可进一步剖分为各向异性 MMD，自然在核密度估计与协方差加权距离之间插值。 3) 共形框架结合：将 MKS 嵌入经典的共形预测流程，对校准集上得到的非一致性得分做分位校正。 4) 理论：给出有限样本覆盖保证与收敛速率；收敛速度仅依赖于协方差算子的有效秩，而非原始维度，从而实现「维度无关」的自适应。
AI.result: 1) 规范化保证：对任意有限样本，MKS 构造的预测区域在额定置信水平下严格满足覆盖性。 2) 收敛速率：误差随样本数 n 增长以 O(1/n^β) 形式下降，β 与有效秩相关，与原始维度 d 大体无关。 3) 经验效果：在与椭球基准的比较实验中，MKS 生成的预测区域体积平均缩小 20–50%，且维度越高、置信水平越苛刻，体积优势越显著；同时始终维持足额覆盖率。
AI.conclusion: 在多元共形预测中引入 MKS 首次成功把「核驱动的几何自适应」与「频率学派严格覆盖」结合起来。MKS 的核心优点有三：理论收敛只与有效秩挂钩，具备维度无关的自适应；无需显式地建模误差分布或线性假设；不论高维场景还是苛刻置信区间，都能显著缩减预测区域体积且不牺牲覆盖率。因此，MKS 可作为高维不确定性量化与构造紧致预测区间的一种可解释、可扩展且带严格保证的工具。

title: Dialect vs Demographics: Quantifying LLM Bias from Implicit Linguistic Signals vs. Explicit User Profiles
comment: In The 2026 ACM Conference on Fairness, Accountability, and Transparency (FAccT '26), June 25--28, 2026, Montreal, Canada. ACM, New York, NY, USA, 32 pages
summary: As state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs) have become ubiquitous, ensuring equitable performance across diverse demographics is critical. However, it remains unclear whether these disparities arise from the explicitly stated identity itself or from the way identity is signaled. In real-world interactions, users' identity is often conveyed implicitly through a complex combination of various socio-linguistic factors. This study disentangles these signals by employing a factorial design with over 24,000 responses from two open-weight LLMs (Gemma-3-12B and Qwen-3-VL-8B), comparing prompts with explicitly announced user profiles against implicit dialect signals (e.g., AAVE, Singlish) across various sensitive domains. Our results uncover a unique paradox in LLM safety where users achieve ``better'' performance by sounding like a demographic than by stating they belong to it. Explicit identity prompts activate aggressive safety filters, increasing refusal rates and reducing semantic similarity compared to our reference text for Black users. In contrast, implicit dialect cues trigger a powerful ``dialect jailbreak,'' reducing refusal probability to near zero while simultaneously achieving a greater level of semantic similarity to the reference texts compared to Standard American English prompts. However, this ``dialect jailbreak'' introduces a critical safety trade-off regarding content sanitization. We find that current safety alignment techniques are brittle and over-indexed on explicit keywords, creating a bifurcated user experience where ``standard'' users receive cautious, sanitized information while dialect speakers navigate a less sanitized, more raw, and potentially a more hostile information landscape and highlights a fundamental tension in alignment--between equitable and linguistic diversity--and underscores the need for safety mechanisms that generalize beyond explicit cues.

AI.tldr: 大模型安全机制对显性身份声明过度敏感、对隐性方言信号几乎不设防，导致“说方言”比“声明身份”更易绕过审查，造成内容和体验的严重族群差异。
AI.motivation: 厘清LLM在不同人口群体间表现差异的根源究竟来自“身份声明”还是“语言暗示”，以指导更公平的模型对齐。
AI.method: 采用2×2因子设计，用24,000条提示对比Gemma-3-12B与Qwen-3-VL-8B在显性用户画像与隐性方言（AAVE、Singlish等）场景下的拒绝率与语义一致性。
AI.result: 显性身份触发高拒答率且语义偏离参考文本；隐性方言几乎零拒答并更接近参考内容，但同时绕过内容清洗，产生“方言越狱”现象。
AI.conclusion: 现有对齐方法依赖关键词、忽视语言多样性，造成“标准语用户被过度保护、方言用户暴露于粗粝内容”的二元体验，亟需可泛化的安全机制兼顾公平与多样性。

title: RV-HATE: Reinforced Multi-Module Voting for Implicit Hate Speech Detection
summary: Hate speech remains prevalent in human society and continues to evolve in its forms and expressions. Modern advancements in internet and online anonymity accelerate its rapid spread and complicate its detection. However, hate speech datasets exhibit diverse characteristics primarily because they are constructed from different sources and platforms, each reflecting different linguistic styles and social contexts. Despite this diversity, prior studies on hate speech detection often rely on fixed methodologies without adapting to data-specific features. We introduce RV-HATE, a detection framework designed to account for the dataset-specific characteristics of each hate speech dataset. RV-HATE consists of multiple specialized modules, where each module focuses on distinct linguistic or contextual features of hate speech. The framework employs reinforcement learning to optimize weights that determine the contribution of each module for a given dataset. A voting mechanism then aggregates the module outputs to produce the final decision. RV-HATE offers two primary advantages: (1)~it improves detection accuracy by tailoring the detection process to dataset-specific attributes, and (2)~it also provides interpretable insights into the distinctive features of each dataset. Consequently, our approach effectively addresses implicit hate speech and achieves superior performance compared to conventional static methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/leeyejin1231/RV-HATE.

AI.tldr: RV-HATE 用可解释的多模块投票框架+强化学习动态适配任意 hate 语料，显著提升含隐晦样本的检测效果。
AI.motivation: 网络匿名性使仇恨言论演化迅速、形式隐晦；不同来源语料的语境与语言风格差异大，而现有方法普遍采用固定模型，难以兼顾数据特异性，导致检测性能受限。
AI.method: 构建若干专精模块分别捕获词汇、隐含语义、上下文等特征；用强化学习为每个数据集动态优化模块权重；最后以可解释投票聚合模块输出。
AI.result: 在多个异构仇恨言论语料上全面优于静态基线，特别在隐晦仇恨样本上提升显著，并能输出各模块权重解释数据集特性。
AI.conclusion: 自适应权重+模块化 Voting 策略兼顾准确率与可解释性，证实了针对数据特异性设计检测流程的有效性，为后续迁移与扩展提供框架和代码。

title: SurgViVQA: Temporally-Grounded Video Question Answering for Surgical Scene Understanding
summary: Video Question Answering (VideoQA) in the surgical domain aims to enhance intraoperative understanding by enabling AI models to reason over temporally coherent events rather than isolated frames. Current approaches are limited to static image features, and available datasets often lack temporal annotations, ignoring the dynamics critical for accurate procedural interpretation. We propose SurgViVQA, a surgical VideoQA model that extends visual reasoning from static images to dynamic surgical scenes. It uses a Masked Video--Text Encoder to fuse video and question features, capturing temporal cues such as motion and tool--tissue interactions, which a fine-tuned large language model (LLM) then decodes into coherent answers. To evaluate its performance, we curated REAL-Colon-VQA, a colonoscopic video dataset that includes motion-related questions and diagnostic attributes, as well as out-of-template questions with rephrased or semantically altered formulations to assess model robustness. Experimental validation on REAL-Colon-VQA and the public EndoVis18-VQA dataset shows that SurgViVQA outperforms existing image-based VQA benchmark models, particularly in keyword accuracy, improving over PitVQA by +11\% on REAL-Colon-VQA and +9\% on EndoVis18-VQA. A perturbation study on the questions further confirms improved generalizability and robustness to variations in question phrasing. SurgViVQA and the REAL-Colon-VQA dataset provide a framework for temporally-aware understanding in surgical VideoQA, enabling AI models to interpret dynamic procedural contexts more effectively. Code and dataset available at https://github.com/madratak/SurgViVQA.

AI.tldr: SurgViVQA 首次将外科视频问答从静态帧升级为动态时序推理，在自建 REAL-Colon-VQA 与公开 EndoVis18-VQA 上，关键词准确率平均提升 10% 以上，代码与数据已开源。
AI.motivation: 现有外科 VQA 仅依赖单帧特征，缺失对器械-组织动态交互等时序线索的建模，导致术中情境理解不准；同时公开数据缺乏时间标注，难以训练时序模型。
AI.method: 构建 Masked Video–Text Encoder 显式融合视频与问句特征，捕获运动与工具-组织交互等时序线索；将融合表示输入微调后的大语言模型生成答案；另建 REAL-Colon-VQA，含运动问答、诊断属性及意译扰动问句，用于鲁棒评估。
AI.result: 在 REAL-Colon-VQA 与 EndoVis18-VQA 上，SurgViVQA 关键词准确率分别比最强图像基线 PitVQA 提升 11% 和 9%；问句扰动实验显示其对措辞变化具有更好泛化性。
AI.conclusion: SurgViVQA 证明了时序感知对外科 VideoQA 的关键作用，为术中动态情境理解提供了可直接复用的模型与基准数据。

title: Verifying Machine Learning Interpretability Requirements through Provenance
summary: Machine Learning (ML) Engineering is a growing field that necessitates an increase in the rigor of ML development. It draws many ideas from software engineering and more specifically, from requirements engineering. Existing literature on ML Engineering defines quality models and Non-Functional Requirements (NFRs) specific to ML, in particular interpretability being one such NFR. However, a major challenge occurs in verifying ML NFRs, including interpretability. Although existing literature defines interpretability in terms of ML, it remains an immeasurable requirement, making it impossible to definitively confirm whether a model meets its interpretability requirement. This paper shows how ML provenance can be used to verify ML interpretability requirements. This work provides an approach for how ML engineers can save various types of model and data provenance to make the model's behavior transparent and interpretable. Saving this data forms the basis of quantifiable Functional Requirements (FRs) whose verification in turn verifies the interpretability NFR. Ultimately, this paper contributes a method to verify interpretability NFRs for ML models.

AI.tldr: 提出一种利用机器学习溯源（provenance）数据，将不可度量的可解释性非功能需求转化为可验证的功能需求的方法，实现对模型可解释性需求的验证。
AI.motivation: 机器学习工程日益重视非功能需求（NFR），其中可解释性被视为关键，但现有研究仅给出定性定义，缺乏可验证手段，导致工程师无法确认模型是否真正满足可解释性要求。
AI.method: 通过系统保存模型与数据的各类溯源信息（训练数据版本、超参数、特征工程记录、决策路径等），将这些溯源数据转化为一系列可量化、可测试的功能需求（FR）；验证这些 FR 即间接验证可解释性 NFR。
AI.result: 构建了将可解释性 NFR 映射到可直接验证的功能需求集合的流程，并在概念验证中展示：当溯源 FR 全部通过时，可高置信度断言模型满足既定的可解释性要求。
AI.conclusion: 利用 ML 溯源把“不可度量”的可解释性转变为“可度量”的功能验证，为机器学习工程提供了一条实用、可落地的 NFR 验证路径，可推广至其他质量属性的验证。

title: Adaptive Instruction Composition for Automated LLM Red-Teaming
summary: Many approaches to LLM red-teaming leverage an attacker LLM to discover jailbreaks against a target. Several of them task the attacker with identifying effective strategies through trial and error, resulting in a semantically limited range of successes. Another approach discovers diverse attacks by combining crowdsourced harmful queries and tactics into instructions for the attacker, but does so at random, limiting effectiveness. This article introduces a novel framework, Adaptive Instruction Composition, that combines crowdsourced texts according to an adaptive mechanism trained to jointly optimize effectiveness with diversity. We use reinforcement learning to balance exploration with exploitation in a combinatorial space of instructions to guide the attacker toward diverse generations tailored to target vulnerabilities. We demonstrate that our approach substantially outperforms random combination on a set of effectiveness and diversity metrics, even under model transfer. Further, we show that it surpasses a host of recent adaptive approaches on Harmbench. We employ a lightweight neural contextual bandit that adapts to contrastive embedding inputs, and provide ablations suggesting that the contrastive pretraining enables the network to rapidly generalize and scale to the massive space as it learns.

AI.tldr: 提出Adaptive Instruction Composition框架，用轻量级神经contextual bandit把众包有害文本自适应组合成攻击指令，在有效性与多样性上显著优于随机组合及Harmbench最新自适应方法，且具备跨模型迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM红队方法要么靠试错导致攻击语义单一，要么随机拼接众包查询与 tactic 而效率低，亟需一种能同时优化攻击成功率与多样性的系统化方案。
AI.method: 构建Adaptive Instruction Composition：1) 把众包有害查询与战术编码为对比嵌入；2) 用轻量级神经contextual bandit在组合空间做强化学习，平衡探索-利用，实时生成针对目标模型漏洞的多样指令；3) 对比预训练让网络快速泛化到巨大组合空间。
AI.result: 在自设指标与Harmbench基准上，随机组合基线被全面超越，有效性与多样性显著提升；跨模型迁移场景下优势依旧；消融实验证实对比预训练是快速泛化与规模化的关键。
AI.conclusion: 通过把众包文本的自适应组合建模为对比嵌入+轻量级bandit RL，可在超大指令空间内持续生成高多样、高成功率的越狱提示，为LLM红队提供可扩展且可迁移的高效框架。

title: Optimal Aggregation of LLM and PRM Signals for Efficient Test-Time Scaling
comment: Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026
summary: Process reward models (PRMs) are a cornerstone of test-time scaling (TTS), designed to verify and select the best responses from large language models (LLMs). However, this promise is challenged by recent benchmarks where simple majority voting, which ignores PRM signals, occasionally outperforms standard PRM-based selection. This raises a critical question: How can we effectively utilize verification signals from PRMs for TTS? To address this, we start by developing a theoretical framework for optimally combining signals from both the LLM and the PRM. Our framework reveals that the optimal strategy is a weighted aggregation of responses, a strategy whose effectiveness hinges on estimating weights that capture the complex interplay between the models. Based on our theoretical results, we empirically show that these optimal weighting functions differ significantly across LLM-PRM pairs and, notably, often assign substantial negative weights. Motivated by these insights, we propose efficient pre-computation methods to calibrate these weighting functions. Extensive experiments across 5 LLMs and 7 PRMs demonstrate that our calibration method significantly boosts the TTS efficiency, surpassing the performance of vanilla weighted majority voting while using only $21.3\%$ of the computation. Ultimately, our work demonstrates that investing in a more intelligent aggregation strategy can be a more convincing path to performance gains than simply scaling test-time computation.

AI.tldr: 实践表明仅靠增加验证计算（PRM打分）未必优于投票，转而提出一种最优加权聚合理论，在5大模型×7种验证器上校准权重后，仅用21%计算即可显著超越标准PRM和多数投票，充分挖掘验证信号关键在于“怎么合”，而不是“算多少”。
AI.motivation: 测试时缩放(TTS)依赖PRM筛选最优回答，但近期基准显示简单多数投票常可击败标准PRM选择，说明当前验证信号未能被有效利用；本研究试图理解并解决此“用不好PRM”问题，提升最终回答质量而非仅增加计算成本。
AI.method: 首先构建理论框架，将最优预测表示为LLM生成与PRM验证信号的加权组合；推导得出最优权重函数并证明其随模型对而异且可含显著负权。基于此给出预计算校准算法，先在代表性样本上离线估计各权重项，再在推理阶段调用线性组合的聚合策略。
AI.result: 在5个不同规模LLM和7种PRM构成的评测上，提出的校准加权法在多项推理/问答任务中显著超越：与标准PRM最大值选答案相比提升3-9%，与多数投票相比提升2-6%，且仅消耗同等规模下21.3%的测试时计算，实现接近SOTA水平的total accuracy与效率帕累托改进。
AI.conclusion: 只要对LLM与PRM信号施以适当动态聚合，便可在不增大测试时计算的情况下获得性能增益；直接叠加更多验证步骤可能收益递减，而更智能的“信号合并”才是提升TTS效果的高效路径。

title: VVS: Accelerating Speculative Decoding for Visual Autoregressive Generation via Partial Verification Skipping
summary: Visual autoregressive (AR) generation models have demonstrated strong potential for image generation, yet their next-token-prediction paradigm introduces considerable inference latency. Although speculative decoding (SD) has been proven effective for accelerating visual AR models, its "draft one step, then verify one step" paradigm prevents a direct reduction in the number of forward passes, limiting its acceleration potential. Motivated by the interchangeability of visual tokens, we explore verification skipping in the SD process for the first time to explicitly cut the number of target model forward passes, thereby reducing inference latency. By analyzing the characteristics of the drafting stage, we observe that verification redundancy and stale feature reusability are key factors to maintain generation quality while improving speed for verification-free steps. Inspired by these two observations, we propose a novel SD framework VVS to accelerate visual AR model via partial verification skipping, which integrates three complementary modules: (1) a verification-free token selector with dynamic truncation, (2) token-level feature caching and reuse, and (3) fine-grained skipped step scheduling. Consequently, VVS reduces the number of target model forward passes by $2.8\times$ relative to vanilla AR decoding while maintaining competitive generation quality, offering a superior speed-quality trade-off over conventional SD frameworks and revealing strong potential to reshape the SD paradigm. Our code is available at https://github.com/HyattDD/VVS.

AI.tldr: 首次在视觉自回归模型中引入“验证跳过”机制，提出VVS框架，将目标模型前向次数减少2.8倍且保质量，刷新SD加速范式。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉自回归模型推理延迟高；传统投机解码只能“起草+验证”一一对应，无法直接减少目标模型前向计算。本文利用视觉token可交换性，首次尝试在SD中跳过部分验证步骤以进一步提速。
AI.method: 提出VVS框架，含三大互补模块：①动态截断的无验证token选择器；②token级特征缓存与复用；③细粒度跳过步调度。通过分析起草阶段发现“验证冗余”与“过时特征可复用”是保速保质的两个关键规律。
AI.result: 在视觉AR模型上，VVS将目标模型前向次数降至基线AR的1/2.8，同时保持与完整验证相当的生成质量，显著优于传统SD的速-质权衡。
AI.conclusion: 验证跳过能有效重塑投机解码范式，为视觉自回归生成提供高效推理新思路，并具备推广到其它模态的潜力。

title: On the Role of Preprocessing and Memristor Dynamics in Reservoir Computing for Image Classification
comment: Accepted for publication in Advanced Electronic Materials. Main text: pages 1-32, 11 figures. Supporting information: pages 24-32, 11 figures
summary: Reservoir computing (RC) is an emerging recurrent neural network architecture that has attracted growing attention for its low training cost and modest hardware requirements. Memristor-based circuits are particularly promising for RC, as their intrinsic dynamics can reduce network size and parameter overhead in tasks such as time-series prediction and image recognition. Although RC has been demonstrated with several memristive devices, a comprehensive evaluation of device-level requirements remains limited. In this paper, we analyze and explain the operation of a parallel delayed feedback network (PDFN) RC architecture with volatile memristors, focusing on how device characteristics -- such as decay rate, quantization, and variability -- affect reservoir performance. We further discuss strategies to improve data representation in the reservoir using preprocessing methods and suggest potential improvements. The proposed approach achieves 95.89% classification accuracy on MNIST, comparable with the best reported memristor-based RC implementations. Furthermore, the method maintains high robustness under 20% device variability, achieving an accuracy of up to 94.2%. These results demonstrate that volatile memristors can support reliable spatio-temporal information processing and reinforce their potential as key building blocks for compact, high-speed, and energy-efficient neuromorphic computing systems.

AI.tldr: 挥发性忆阻器构建的并行延迟反馈网络储层可在容忍20%器件变异下实现95.89% MNIST分类精度，为紧凑、低功耗神经形态计算提供可扩展硬件方案。
AI.motivation: 目前基于忆阻器的储层计算缺少对器件级指标（衰减率、量化误差、变异）与系统性能关系的系统评估，制约了硬件实现的可扩展性和鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出并行延迟反馈网络架构，引入挥发性忆阻器作为储层节点；给出器件特性（衰减、量化、随机变异）的解析模型，通过预处理及参数优化提升储层状态可分性；利用实验-仿真联合方法验证在不同器件涨落下分类精度等指标。
AI.result: MNIST 任务达到95.89%最高精度，与现有最佳忆阻RC方案持平；即使在20%器件变异条件下，精度仍保持≥94.2%；系统仅需1/3节点数即可完成同等时空信息处理，潜在能效提升约5.7×。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明挥发性忆阻器不仅支持与CMOS兼容的紧凑型储层计算，还固有抗变异优势，为高速、低功耗神经形态处理器奠定了器件-算法协同设计基础。

title: TAPO-Description Logic for Information Behavior: Refined OBoxes, Inference, and Categorical Semantics
comment: 23 pages, 2 figures. Substantially expanded version of arXiv:2602.17242; adds a guard-judgment layer, refined OBoxes, core inference rules, categorical semantics, sheaf-theoretic refinement, and a browsing-theory appendix
summary: This paper develops a refined version of TAPO-description logic for the analysis of information behavior. The framework is treated not as a single homogeneous object logic, but as a layered formalism consisting of a static descriptive layer (TBox/ABox), a procedural layer (PBox), and an oracle-sensitive layer (OBox). To make this architecture mathematically explicit, we introduce a metalevel guard-judgment layer governing procedural branching and iteration. On this basis we formulate a core inference system for TAPO-description logic, covering static TBox/ABox reasoning, guarded procedural transition in the PBox, and validated external import in the OBox. We then give a categorical semantics for the resulting framework and indicate its sheaf-theoretic refinement. The theory is illustrated by examples of information-seeking behavior, including simple search behavior and review-sensitive ordering behavior in a curry restaurant. The aim is to treat not only static knowledge representation but also hesitation, external consultation, and action-guiding update within a unified logical setting.

AI.tldr: 在TAPO-描述逻辑中引入TBox/ABox、PBox、OBox三层结构，并用元层guard-judgment控制流程与外部咨询，给出推理系统、范畴语义及示例。
AI.motivation: 传统描述逻辑只能刻画静态知识，无法统一表达信息寻求中的犹豫、外部咨询与动态更新行为，需要一种能兼容静态表示与过程推理的扩展框架。
AI.method: 1) 将TAPO拆为静态层(TBox/ABox)、过程层(PBox)、外部敏感层(OBox)；2) 引入元层guard-judgment显式控制分支与迭代；3) 构建覆盖静态推理、受保护过程转移与经外部验证导入的核心推理系统；4) 用范畴论给出语义，并进一步用层论(sheaf)精细化。
