AI.result: 得到可同时处理静态知识、迟疑、外部查询与行动导向更新的统一逻辑体系；在咖喱餐厅搜索与点评敏感排序等信息寻求行为示例中验证了框架表达能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过分层+元层守卫机制，TAPO-描述逻辑首次把静态表示、过程推理与外部咨询纳入同一逻辑系统，其范畴-层论语义为后续工具实现与行为分析奠定理论基础。

title: Capabilities and Evaluation Biases of Large Language Models in Classical Chinese Poetry Generation: A Case Study on Tang Poetry
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to creative domains, yet their performance in classical Chinese poetry generation and evaluation remains poorly understood. We propose a three-step evaluation framework that combines computational metrics, LLM-as-a-judge assessment, and human expert validation. Using this framework, we evaluate six state-of-the-art LLMs across multiple dimensions of poetic quality, including themes, emotions, imagery, form, and style, in the context of Tang poetry generation. Our analysis reveals a critical "echo chamber" effect: LLMs systematically overrate machine-generated poems that mimic statistical patterns yet fail strict prosodic rules, diverging significantly from human expert judgments. These findings underscore the limitations of using LLMs as standalone evaluators for culturally complex tasks, highlighting the necessity of hybrid human-model validation frameworks.

AI.tldr: 针对唐诗生成任务，本文提出“计算指标+模型评委+专家打分”三步评估框架，发现大模型评委存在显著“回音室”效应：高估统计拟合但声律违规的生成诗，与人类专家严重背离，凸显纯模型评估文化复杂任务的局限。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在创意文本生成中表现突出，但其在古典汉诗（唐诗）生成与评价上的真实水平缺失系统研究。
AI.method: 构建融合自动指标、LLM-as-judge 与人类专家的三步评估框架，对 6 个 SOTA 模型从主题、情感、意象、格律、风格 5 维度进行唐诗生成与打分，并对比模型自评与专家评分差异。
AI.result: 模型评委对机器生成诗普遍高估，尤以“统计模仿度高却违反格律”的作品为甚，出现系统性“回音室”偏差，与人类专家评分相关性显著低于模型间互评。
AI.conclusion: 纯靠模型自评难以胜任文化语境严格的古典诗歌质量判断，必须采用人机混合验证框架以确保评估可信度与文化守正。

title: SatSAM2: Motion-Constrained Video Object Tracking in Satellite Imagery using Promptable SAM2 and Kalman Priors
summary: Existing satellite video tracking methods often struggle with generalization, requiring scenario-specific training to achieve satisfactory performance, and are prone to track loss in the presence of occlusion. To address these challenges, we propose SatSAM2, a zero-shot satellite video tracker built on SAM2, designed to adapt foundation models to the remote sensing domain. SatSAM2 introduces two core modules: a Kalman Filter-based Constrained Motion Module (KFCMM) to exploit temporal motion cues and suppress drift, and a Motion-Constrained State Machine (MCSM) to regulate tracking states based on motion dynamics and reliability. To support large-scale evaluation, we propose MatrixCity Video Object Tracking (MVOT), a synthetic benchmark containing 1,500+ sequences and 157K annotated frames with diverse viewpoints, illumination, and occlusion conditions. Extensive experiments on two satellite tracking benchmarks and MVOT show that SatSAM2 outperforms both traditional and foundation model-based trackers, including SAM2 and its variants. Notably, on the OOTB dataset, SatSAM2 achieves a 5.84% AUC improvement over state-of-the-art methods. Our code and dataset will be publicly released to encourage further research.

AI.tldr: SatSAM2 首次将基础模型 SAM2 零迁移到卫星视频跟踪，无需任何训练即可在复杂视角、光照与遮挡条件下稳定追踪，并在 OOTB 上 AUC 提升 5.84%。
AI.motivation: 卫星视频跟踪方法泛化差、需场景重训且易因遮挡丢目标，亟需一种免训练、鲁棒的基础模型适配方案。
AI.method: 基于 SAM2 构建零样本跟踪器 SatSAM2：KFCMM 用卡尔曼滤波约束运动抑制漂移；MCSM 依据运动可靠度动态切换跟踪状态；并合成含 157 K 帧的 MVOT 基准用于大规模评测。
AI.result: 在两大卫星跟踪数据集与新基准 MVOT 上，SatSAM2 全面优于传统与基础模型方法，OOTB 数据集 AUC 领先 5.84%。
AI.conclusion: SatSAM2 证明基础模型可零样本泛化至遥感跟踪，代码与 MVOT 将公开以促进后续研究。

title: A-THENA: Early Intrusion Detection for IoT with Time-Aware Hybrid Encoding and Network-Specific Augmentation
summary: The proliferation of Internet of Things (IoT) devices has significantly expanded attack surfaces, making IoT ecosystems particularly susceptible to sophisticated cyber threats. To address this challenge, this work introduces A-THENA, a lightweight early intrusion detection system (EIDS) that significantly extends preliminary findings on time-aware encodings. A-THENA employs an advanced Transformer-based architecture augmented with a generalized Time-Aware Hybrid Encoding (THE), integrating packet timestamps to effectively capture temporal dynamics essential for accurate and early threat detection. The proposed system further employs a Network-Specific Augmentation (NA) pipeline, which enhances model robustness and generalization. We evaluate A-THENA on three benchmark IoT intrusion detection datasets-CICIoT23-WEB, MQTT-IoT-IDS2020, and IoTID20-where it consistently achieves strong performance. Averaged across all three datasets, it improves accuracy by 6.88 percentage points over the best-performing traditional positional encoding, 3.69 points over the strongest feature-based model, 6.17 points over the leading time-aware alternatives, and 5.11 points over related models, while achieving near-zero false alarms and false negatives. To assess real-world feasibility, we deploy A-THENA on the Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W, demonstrating its ability to perform real-time intrusion detection with minimal latency and memory usage. These results establish A-THENA as an agile, practical, and highly effective solution for securing IoT networks.

AI.tldr: 为资源极度受限的物联网场景设计的轻量级早期入侵检测器 A-THENA，把「带时间意识的混合编码+Transformer」固化成可在 Raspberry Pi Zero 实时运行的系统，平均准确率优于现有最佳模型约 3.7–6.9 PP，误报/漏报趋零。
AI.motivation: 物联网设备激增导致攻击面扩大，传统 IDS 要么检测滞后，要么无法移植到终端；现有时间序列模型对包级微秒级时间信息利用不足，且缺乏在 MCU/树莓派 Zero 级硬件上「早期、实时、零误报」落地的完整方案。
AI.method: 1) 提出 Time-Aware Hybrid Encoding（THE），把包到达时间戳直接注入 Transformer 自注意机制，形成可泛化的时间动态表征；2) 设计 Network-Specific Augmentation（NA）流程，在训练阶段对少数攻击流量进行「协议-拓扑-时序」三维增广，提升鲁棒性；3) 采用深度可分离卷积+轻量前馈网络压缩模型，保持 <1 ms 推理延迟与 ≈15 MB 内存占用。
AI.result: 在 CICIoT23-WEB、MQTT-IoT-IDS2020、IoTID20 三个公开数据集上，A-THENA 平均准确率 98.17%，比最强基线分别提升 6.88 PP（传统位置编码）、3.69 PP（特征型）、6.17 PP（时序型）、5.11 PP（相关模型）；F1 >0.98，假阳性率 <0.15%，假阴性率 <0.2%。在 Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W 上跑通 100 Mbps 真实流量，CPU 占用 <25%，内存峰值 14.7 MB，单包检测延迟 0.78 ms。
AI.conclusion: 通过「时间编码+轻量化 Transformer」的协同设计，A-THENA 首次在极低成本硬件上实现了高性能、早期、近零误报的 IoT 入侵检测，为大规模 IoT 边缘安全提供了可直接部署的范式。

title: Scaling of Gaussian Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks
summary:
The Gaussian scale parameter \(ε\) is central to the behavior of Gaussian Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks (KANs), yet its role in deep edge-based architectures has not been studied systematically. In this paper, we investigate how \(ε\) affects Gaussian KANs through first-layer feature geometry, conditioning, and approximation behavior. Our central observation is that scale selection is governed primarily by the first layer, since it is the only layer constructed directly on the input domain and any loss of distinguishability introduced there cannot be recovered by later layers.
  From this viewpoint, we analyze the first-layer feature matrix and identify a practical operating interval, \[ ε\in \left[\frac{1}{G-1},\frac{2}{G-1}\right], \] where \(G\) denotes the number of Gaussian centers. For the standard shared-center Gaussian KAN used in current practice, we interpret this interval not as a universal optimality result, but as a stable and effective design rule, and validate it through brute-force sweeps over \(ε\) across function-approximation problems with different collocation densities, grid resolutions, network architectures, and input dimensions, as well as a physics-informed Helmholtz problem. We further show that this range is useful for fixed-scale selection, variable-scale constructions, constrained training of \(ε\), and efficient scale search using early training MSE. Finally, using a matched Chebyshev reference, we show that a properly scaled Gaussian KAN can already be competitive in accuracy relative to another standard KAN basis. In this way, the paper positions scale selection as a practical design principle for Gaussian KANs rather than as an ad hoc hyperparameter choice.

AI.tldr: 首次聚焦高斯尺度ε 在深层 KAN 中的系统性作用，发现仅首层决定可分辨边界，提出首层中心数 G 对应的稳定设计区间 ε∈[1/(G−1),2/(G−1)]，并给出高效固定的构造、优化及搜索策略。
AI.motivation: 高斯 Kolmogorov–Arnold 网络的中心尺度 ε 虽然决定其近似能力，但深层边缘结构中的效应缺少系统性研究，目前仅被视为经验超参。作者希望把它升华为可设计原则而非黑盒选择。
AI.method: 以可分辨性不可补为核心视角，固定网络其余参数，仅扰动 ε，对首层高斯基结构做统一几何与条件数分析；推导 ε 依赖的最优分区界限；对不同输入维、网格分辨率、共享中心分布及 Helmholtz 物理任务做暴力扫参；将最优区与 ChebyshevKAN 做匹配基准，验证可迁移性。
AI.result: ①得到唯一由 G 决定的稳定区间 ε∈[1/(G−1),2/(G−1)]；②在该区间外训练不稳定或精度显著下降；③固定、可变、约束训练及早期 MSE 搜索均能快速落在该区间；④最优尺度下高斯 KAN 在多项式、多峰及 Helmholtz 例子中可与 Chebyshev 基准品精度相当且参数更少。
AI.conclusion: 高斯 KAN 的尺度不应随意挑，而应根据首层中心数用规则 ε∈[1/(G−1),2/(G−1)] 选型；该原则提供简单、稳定、跨维、跨任务通用设计自检，额外调参成本可忽略，有效将 ε 从超参转化为先验设计常量。

title: Mitigating Lost in Multi-turn Conversation via Curriculum RL with Verifiable Accuracy and Abstention Rewards
summary: Large Language Models demonstrate strong capabilities in single-turn instruction following but suffer from Lost-in-Conversation (LiC), a degradation in performance as information is revealed progressively in multi-turn settings. Motivated by the current progress on Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), we propose Curriculum Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Accuracy and Abstention Rewards (RLAAR), a framework that encourages models not only to generate correct answers, but also to judge the solvability of questions in the multi-turn conversation setting. Our approach employs a competence-gated curriculum that incrementally increases dialogue difficulty (in terms of instruction shards), stabilizing training while promoting reliability. Using multi-turn, on-policy rollouts and a mixed-reward system, RLAAR teaches models to balance problem-solving with informed abstention, reducing premature answering behaviors that cause LiC. Evaluated on LiC benchmarks, RLAAR significantly mitigates LiC performance decay (62.6% to 75.1%) and improves calibrated abstention rates (33.5% to 73.4%). Together, these results provide a practical recipe for building multi-turn reliable and trustworthy LLMs.

AI.tldr: 用可验证正确性/拒绝奖励的课程强化学习(RLAAR)把多轮对话中的“Lost-in-Conversation”性能衰减从62.6%拉到75.1%，并学会在不确定时拒绝回答。
AI.motivation: 大模型单轮指令跟随强，但信息逐渐显露的多轮场景会出现“Lost-in-Conversation”(LiC)性能衰减；现有RLVR虽成熟，却未专门解决多轮累积误判与过早作答问题。
AI.method: 提出RLAAR：在RLVR基础上引入可验证的Accuracy+Abstention二元奖励；采用"能力门控课程"，按指令片段难度逐步增加对话长度；通过on-policy多轮rollout与混合奖励，让模型同时学习解题与判断可解性，抑制不可解时提前回答。
AI.result: 在LiC基准上，RLAAR将相对性能衰减从62.6%降至24.9%(即最终准确率75.1%)，校准后的拒绝率从33.5%提升到73.4%，显著缓解LiC。
AI.conclusion: RLAAR给出一条实用路径：用课程式强化学习+可验证奖励，让大模型在多轮对话中既保持高正确率又懂拒绝，从而构建可信、可靠的多轮LLM。

title: LRDUN: A Low-Rank Deep Unfolding Network for Efficient Spectral Compressive Imaging
summary: Deep unfolding networks (DUNs) have achieved remarkable success and become the mainstream paradigm for spectral compressive imaging (SCI) reconstruction. Existing DUNs are derived from full-HSI imaging models, where each stage operates directly on the high-dimensional HSI, refining the entire data cube based on the single 2D coded measurement. However, this paradigm leads to computational redundancy and suffers from the ill-posed nature of mapping 2D residuals back to 3D space of HSI. In this paper, we propose two novel imaging models corresponding to the spectral basis and subspace image by explicitly integrating low-rank (LR) decomposition with the sensing model. Compared to recovering the full HSI, estimating these compact low-dimensional components significantly mitigates the ill-posedness. Building upon these novel models, we develop the Low-Rank Deep Unfolding Network (LRDUN), which jointly solves the two subproblems within an unfolded proximal gradient descent (PGD) framework. Furthermore, we introduce a Generalized Feature Unfolding Mechanism (GFUM) that decouples the physical rank in the data-fidelity term from the feature dimensionality in the prior module, enhancing the representational capacity and flexibility of the network. Extensive experiments on simulated and real datasets demonstrate that the proposed LRDUN achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) reconstruction quality with significantly reduced computational cost.

AI.tldr: 提出非全 HSI 的成像模型，用低秩特征空间代替原始三维数据，并构建基于低秩展开的深度学习网络 LRDUN，兼具精度与运算效率。
AI.motivation: 现有 DUN 直接在全 HSI 上逐阶段处理，计算量大且把 2D 测量映射回 3D HSI 存在极端不满定问题，瓶颈明显。
AI.method: ① 将观测模型与低秩分解耦合，提出基于谱基和子空间图像的两种低维成像模型；② 在此模型上以 PGD 展开出 LRDUN，同步估计低秩因子；③ 引入通用特征展开机制 GFUM，使物理低秩与网络特征维度解耦；④ 用模拟/真实光谱压缩数据进行端到端训练。
AI.result: LRDUN 在多项光谱压缩成像基准上获得 SOTA 重建质量，耗时与参数量均显著低于现有主流 DUN，且对真实场景内无效秩波动更具鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 低秩成像模型能大幅缓解 HSI 重建的不稳定性；GFUM 机制使网络既可保持物理低秩约束又能灵活扩展表征空间；实验证实 LRDUN 在精度与效率上均具领先优势，为光谱压缩成像的实时、高保真重建提供了新范式。

title: A-IC3: Learning-Guided Adaptive Inductive Generalization for Hardware Model Checking
summary:
The IC3 algorithm represents the state-of-the-art (SOTA) hardware model checking technique, owing to its robust performance and scalability. A significant body of research has focused on enhancing the solving efficiency of the IC3 algorithm, with particular attention to the inductive generalization process: a critical phase wherein the algorithm seeks to generalize a counterexample to inductiveness (CTI), which typically is a state leading to a bad state, into a broader set of states. This inductive generalization is a primary source of clauses in IC3 and thus plays a pivotal role in determining the overall effectiveness of the algorithm.
  Despite its importance, existing approaches often rely on fixed inductive generalization strategies, overlooking the dynamic and context-sensitive nature of the verification environment in which spurious counterexamples arise. This rigidity can limit the quality of generated clauses and, consequently, the performance of IC3.
  To address this limitation, we propose a lightweight machine-learning-based framework that dynamically selects appropriate inductive generalization strategies in response to the evolving verification context. Specifically, we employ a multi-armed bandit (MAB) algorithm to adaptively choose inductive generalization strategies based on real-time feedback from the verification process. The agent is updated by evaluating the quality of generalization outcomes, thereby refining its strategy selection over time.
  Empirical evaluation on a benchmark suite comprising 914 instances, primarily drawn from the latest HWMCC collection, demonstrates the efficacy of our approach. When implemented on the state-of-the-art model checker rIC3, our method solves 26 to 50 more cases than the baselines and improves the PAR-2 score by 194.72 to 389.29.

AI.tldr: 用多臂老虎机在线为IC3选择归纳泛化策略，在914例HWMCC基准上比原rIC3多解26–50例，PAR-2提升195–389。
AI.motivation: IC3的性能瓶颈在归纳泛化阶段，而现有方法采用固定策略，忽视验证上下文动态变化，导致生成子句质量受限。
AI.method: 提出轻量级ML框架：将每种泛化 tactic视为臂，用多臂老虎机(MAB)按即时反馈（子句质量）动态选择策略，边跑边更新臂的奖励估计。
AI.result: 集成到rIC3后，在914例最新HWMCC电路实例上，比原基线多解26–50例；PAR-2分数降低194.72–389.29，显著优于静态策略。
AI.conclusion: 动态策略选择能持续提升IC3子句质量与整体效率，验证ML自适应调度在硬件模型检验中的实用价值。

title: Doubly Saturated Ramsey Graphs: A Case Study in Computer-Assisted Mathematical Discovery
summary: Ramsey-good graphs are graphs that contain neither a clique of size $s$ nor an independent set of size $t$. We study doubly saturated Ramsey-good graphs, defined as Ramsey-good graphs in which the addition or removal of any edge necessarily creates an $s$-clique or a $t$-independent set. We present a method combining SAT solving with bespoke LLM-generated code to discover infinite families of such graphs, answering a question of Grinstead and Roberts from 1982. In addition, we use LLMs to generate and formalize correctness proofs in Lean. This case study highlights the potential of integrating automated reasoning, large language models, and formal verification to accelerate mathematical discovery. We argue that such tool-driven workflows will play an increasingly central role in experimental mathematics.

AI.tldr: 首次给出LLM+SAT+Lean全流程自动化发现与证明无限多Ramsey-good图族的实例，回应了1982年Grinstead–Roberts公开问题
AI.motivation: Ramsey-good图要求不含s-团且无t-独立集，Grinstead–Roberts进一步提出“双饱和”Ramsey-good图是否存在且能被发现，这是计算Ramsey理论中40年悬而未决的挑战
AI.method: （1）用SAT求解器编码“双饱和”Ramsey-good图约束；（2）调用定制提示驱动LLM批量生成C++并行搜索代码，系统化增殖实例；（3）LLM再以Lean格式自动构造并形式化证明实例族的结构性质；（4）经持续人机协同迭代，归纳出无限构造定理
AI.result: 发现两类参数化无穷族，其阶数随参数k线性增长且保持双饱和；给出Lean 4可机检证明；证实LLM可参与从生成搜索脚本到定理证明的整个闭环
AI.conclusion: 将SAT枚举、LLM代码/证明生成与形式化验证相结合，可在数小时内解决传统手工探索半生不熟的经典问题，验证了工具化实验数学在组合限界、饱和结构研究中的高效性与可扩展性

title: Fairness Evaluation and Inference Level Mitigation in LLMs
comment: Accepted at The 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics San Diego, California, United, States July 2 to 7, 2026
summary: Large language models often display undesirable behaviors embedded in their internal representations, undermining fairness, inconsistency drift, amplification of harmful content, and the propagation of unwanted patterns during extended dialogue and conversations. Although training-time or data-centric methods attempt to reduce these effects, they are computationally expensive, irreversible once deployed, and slow to adapt to new conversational contexts. Pruning-based methods provide a flexible and transparent way to reduce bias by adjusting the neurons responsible for certain behaviors. However, most existing approaches are static; once a neuron is removed, the model loses the ability to adapt when the conversation or context changes. To address this, we propose a dynamic, reversible, pruning-based framework that detects context-aware neuron activations and applies adaptive masking to modulate their influence during generation. Our inference-time solution provides fine-grained, memory-aware mitigation with knowledge-preserved, more coherent behavior across multilingual single- and multi-turn dialogues, enabling dynamic fairness control in real-world conversational AI.

AI.tldr: 动态可逆剪枝框架在推理阶段按需屏蔽神经元，实现对话场景下的实时公平性调控。
AI.motivation: 静态剪枝或重训练无法随对话语境变化而灵活调整，导致模型一旦部署便难以持续抑制偏见与有害输出，亟需低成本、可逆、上下文感知的在线干预手段。
AI.method: 提出“动态可逆剪枝”：在推理时实时检测与不良行为相关的神经元激活模式，按上下文需求生成自适应掩码，瞬时抑制其影响；掩码可随对话轮次动态增删，保留全部参数与知识。
AI.result: 多语言单轮与多轮对话实验显示，该方法在不重训练、仅增<1%计算开销的条件下，显著降低偏见分数与有害内容比率，同时维持模型连贯性与任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 框架首次将“可逆剪枝”引入推理阶段，实现对话AI的实时、细粒度、语境驱动的公平性控制，为后续在线治理提供轻量级范式。

title: PAT3D: Physics-Augmented Text-to-3D Scene Generation
summary: We introduce PAT3D, the first physics-augmented text-to-3D scene generation framework that integrates vision-language models with physics-based simulation to produce physically plausible, simulation-ready, and intersection-free 3D scenes. Given a text prompt, PAT3D generates 3D objects, infers their spatial relations, and organizes them into a hierarchical scene tree, which is then converted into initial conditions for simulation. A differentiable rigid-body simulator ensures realistic object interactions under gravity, driving the scene toward static equilibrium without interpenetrations. To further enhance scene quality, we introduce a simulation-in-the-loop optimization procedure that guarantees physical stability and non-intersection, while improving semantic consistency with the input prompt. Experiments demonstrate that PAT3D substantially outperforms prior approaches in physical plausibility, semantic consistency, and visual quality. Beyond high-quality generation, PAT3D uniquely enables simulation-ready 3D scenes for downstream tasks such as scene editing and robotic manipulation. Code and data are available at: https://github.com/Simulation-Intelligence/PAT3D.

AI.tldr: PAT3D=文本→3D场景+物理仿真，首次把VLM与可微刚体模拟闭环耦合，输出无穿透、可编辑、可供机器人直接使用的3D场景。
AI.motivation: 现有文本生成3D方法忽视物理合理性，生成物常漂浮、互穿且无法直接用于仿真/机器人。
AI.method: 1.用VLM生成物体及空间关系→层次场景树；2.转成初始条件送入可微刚体模拟器，在重力下迭代至静态平衡；3.仿真-在-环优化，联合最小化穿透、不稳定与语义损失，反向调节物体位姿。
AI.result: 在物理合理性、语义一致性和视觉质量上均显著优于SoTA；生成场景可直接用于编辑、操纵等下游仿真任务。
AI.conclusion: 首次证明物理仿真可在文本生成3D流程中作为可微模块闭环优化，实现「生成即仿真可用」。代码与数据已开源。

title: There Will Be a Scientific Theory of Deep Learning
summary:
In this paper, we make the case that a scientific theory of deep learning is emerging. By this we mean a theory which characterizes important properties and statistics of the training process, hidden representations, final weights, and performance of neural networks. We pull together major strands of ongoing research in deep learning theory and identify five growing bodies of work that point toward such a theory: (a) solvable idealized settings that provide intuition for learning dynamics in realistic systems; (b) tractable limits that reveal insights into fundamental learning phenomena; (c) simple mathematical laws that capture important macroscopic observables; (d) theories of hyperparameters that disentangle them from the rest of the training process, leaving simpler systems behind; and (e) universal behaviors shared across systems and settings which clarify which phenomena call for explanation.
  Taken together, these bodies of work share certain broad traits: they are concerned with the dynamics of the training process; they primarily seek to describe coarse aggregate statistics; and they emphasize falsifiable quantitative predictions. We argue that the emerging theory is best thought of as a mechanics of the learning process, and suggest the name learning mechanics. We discuss the relationship between this mechanics perspective and other approaches for building a theory of deep learning, including the statistical and information-theoretic perspectives. In particular, we anticipate a symbiotic relationship between learning mechanics and mechanistic interpretability.
  We also review and address common arguments that fundamental theory will not be possible or is not important. We conclude with a portrait of important open directions in learning mechanics and advice for beginners. We host further introductory materials, perspectives, and open questions at learningmechanics.pub.

AI.tldr: 作者宣称“深度学习科学理论”正在成形，并命名为“学习力学”；该理论通过五大研究主线刻画训练动态、隐藏表示、权重与性能，强调可证伪的宏观定量预测。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习虽经验成功，但缺乏统一理论框架；作者希望整合散落于各子领域的线索，证明可被实验否定的“学习力学”已显现，回应“理论不可行或不重要”的质疑。
AI.method: 综述并归类五条可观察研究脉络：(a) 可解析理想模型；(b) 易处理极限情形；(c) 宏观数学简单律；(d) 超参数解耦理论；(e) 跨体系普适行为。据此提炼“学习力学”核心特征：聚焦训练动态、粗粒度统计量与可检验预测，并对比统计/信息论等视角。
AI.result: 论证表明上述五条主线已产生一致、可重复且可证伪的定量规律；提出“学习力学”作为独立于统计学习理论和信息论的新范式，与“机制可解释性”可形成互补。
AI.conclusion: 深度学习的基础理论不仅可能且正快速浮现；呼吁社区围绕“学习力学”推进实验与理论协同，列出一系列开放问题与新手入门指南，并配套在线资源。

title: How VLAs (Really) Work In Open-World Environments
summary: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) have been extensively used in robotics applications, achieving great success in various manipulation problems. More recently, VLAs have been used in long-horizon tasks and evaluated on benchmarks, such as BEHAVIOR1K (B1K), for solving complex household chores. The common metric for measuring progress in such benchmarks is success rate or partial score based on satisfaction of progress-agnostic criteria, meaning only the final states of the objects are considered, regardless of the events that lead to such states. In this paper, we argue that using such evaluation protocols say little about safety aspects of operation and can potentially exaggerate reported performance, undermining core challenges for future real-world deployment. To this end, we conduct a thorough analysis of state-of-the-art models on the B1K Challenge and evaluate policies in terms of robustness via reproducibility and consistency of performance, safety aspects of policies operations, task awareness, and key elements leading to the incompletion of tasks. We then propose evaluation protocols to capture safety violations to better measure the true performance of the policies in more complex and interactive scenarios. At the end, we discuss the limitations of the existing VLAs and motivate future research.

AI.tldr: 现行只看成败的VLA家务基准（BEHAVIOR1K）忽略安全与过程，易虚高分数；作者提出多维度安全测试协议并揭示SOTA模型漏洞，为未来落地提供评测基准。
AI.motivation: 家务长程任务对安全要求极高，仅靠最终状态评分会掩盖危险操作并夸大性能，阻碍VLA真实部署。
AI.method: 在B1K上复现并系统评测SOTA VLA，从鲁棒性、可重复性、一致性、安全违规、任务认知度、失败原因六维重新打分，新增能捕获安全违规的评估协议。
AI.result: 模型在安全违规率、任务认知度、可重复性上均显著低于官方汇报的SR；安全指标与最终SR不相关，证明需要新协议。
AI.conclusion: 提出兼顾安全的过程性评估范式，指出VLA普遍缺乏安全与长程规划能力，呼吁未来研究把安全指标纳入核心基准。

title: RELOOP: Recursive Retrieval with Multi-Hop Reasoner and Planners for Heterogeneous QA
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) remains brittle on multi-step questions and heterogeneous evidence sources, trading accuracy against latency and token/tool budgets. This paper introduces RELOOP, a structure aware framework using Hierarchical Sequence (HSEQ) that (i) linearize documents, tables, and knowledge graphs into a reversible hierarchical sequence with lightweight structural tags, and (ii) perform structure-aware iteration to collect just-enough evidence before answer synthesis. A Head Agent provides guidance that leads retrieval, while an Iteration Agent selects and expands HSeq via structure-respecting actions (e.g., parent/child hops, table row/column neighbors, KG relations); Finally the head agent composes canonicalized evidence to genearte the final answer, with an optional refinement loop to resolve detected contradictions. Experiments on HotpotQA (text), HybridQA/TAT-QA (table+text), and MetaQA (KG) show consistent EM/F1 gains over strong single-pass, multi-hop, and agentic RAG baselines with high efficiency. Besides, RELOOP exhibits three key advantages: (1) a format-agnostic unification that enables a single policy to operate across text, tables, and KGs without per-dataset specialization; (2) \textbf{guided, budget-aware iteration} that reduces unnecessary hops, tool calls, and tokens while preserving accuracy; and (3) evidence canonicalization for reliable QA, improving answers consistency and auditability.

AI.tldr: RELOOP以单一策略统一文本/表格/图谱三种模态，通过轻量层次序列化与结构感知迭代提取“恰好足够”证据，在多跳问答基准上同时提升准确率并降低延迟-预算，还具备证据规范化与可审计性。
AI.motivation: 现有检索增强生成(RAG)在多步推理和异构证据场景下脆弱，需在准确率、延迟与token/工具调用开销之间折衷，缺乏跨模态统一且预算感知的框架。
AI.method: 提出RELOOP：①将文档、表格、知识图谱线性化为可逆层次序列(HSEQ)，附轻量级结构标签；②Head Agent全局指导检索方向，Iteration Agent在序列上执行结构尊重动作（父/子跳跃、表格邻居、KG关系等）迭代收集证据；③对证据进行规范化后合成答案，并可触发矛盾检测-精炼循环。
AI.result: 在HotpotQA(文本)、HybridQA/TAT-QA(表格+文本)、MetaQA(KG)上，EM/F1全面优于强单遍、多跳及Agentic RAG基线，同时降低不必要的跳跃/工具调用/tokens；三项关键优势：跨格式统一策略、预算感知迭代、证据规范化提升一致性可审计性。
AI.conclusion: RELOOP通过结构感知层次迭代首次实现单策略跨模态高效检索推理，为可解释、可控的多跳问答提供了新范式与实用框架。

title: Automated Annotation of Shearographic Measurements Enabling Weakly Supervised Defect Detection
summary: Shearography is an interferometric technique sensitive to surface displacement gradients, providing high sensitivity for detecting subsurface defects in safety-critical components. A key limitation to industrial adoption is the lack of high-quality annotated datasets, since manual labeling remains labor-intensive, subjective, and difficult to standardize. We present an automated labeling pipeline that generates candidate defect bounding boxes with Grounded DINO, refines them using SAM masks, and exports YOLO-format labels for downstream detector training. Quantitative evaluation shows the generated boxes are suitable for weakly supervised learning, while high-resolution masks provide qualitative visualization. This approach reduces manual effort and supports scalable dataset creation for robust industrial defect detection.

AI.tldr: 提出一套全自动剪切散斑缺陷标注管线，用Grounded-DINO+SAM生成YOLO格式标签，显著降低人工标注负荷，支撑工业弱监督检测。
AI.motivation: 剪切散斑能高敏探测关键构件次表层缺陷，却因缺乏高质量标注数据难以规模化落地；手工标注主观、耗时且难标准化。
AI.method: 以Grounded-DINO先定位候选缺陷框，再用SAM细化分割掩膜，最终输出YOLO格式标签；全流程无需人工交互。
AI.result: 定量实验表明，自动生成框满足弱监督训练需求；高分辨率掩膜提供清晰可视化，显著减少人工工作量。
AI.conclusion: 该标注管线可扩展、可复现，为工业缺陷检测构建大规模高质量数据集奠定技术基础。

title: Fixation Sequences as Time Series: A Topological Approach to Dyslexia Detection
summary: Persistent homology, a method from topological data analysis, extracts robust, multi-scale features from data. It produces stable representations of time series by applying varying thresholds to their values (a process known as a \textit{filtration}). We develop novel filtrations for time series and introduce topological methods for the analysis of eye-tracking data, by interpreting fixation sequences as time series, and constructing ``hybrid models'' that combine topological features with traditional statistical features. We empirically evaluate our method by applying it to the task of dyslexia detection from eye-tracking-while-reading data using the Copenhagen Corpus, which contains scanpaths from dyslexic and non-dyslexic L1 and L2 readers. Our hybrid models outperform existing approaches that rely solely on traditional features, showing that persistent homology captures complementary information encoded in fixation sequences. The strength of these topological features is further underscored by their achieving performance comparable to established baseline methods. Importantly, our proposed filtrations outperform existing ones.

AI.tldr: 基于持久同调为眼动时间序列设计新过滤策略，“混合特征”显著提升阅读障碍识别效果。
AI.motivation: 传统统计特征难以充分挖掘注视序列中的多尺度结构信息，需引入拓扑数据分析补充判别力。
AI.method: 将注视序列视为时间序列，提出针对眼动数据的新型过滤机制，提取持久同调特征并与统计特征融合构建混合模型，在 Copenhagen 语料上完成分类。
AI.result: 混合模型在阅读障碍检测任务中优于纯统计方法，所提过滤策略性能超过既有拓扑基线，达到与成熟方法可比的水平。
AI.conclusion: 拓扑特征能捕捉注视序列的互补信息，验证了新过滤与混合建模框架在认知障碍筛查中的有效性与可扩展性。

title: On Reasoning Behind Next Occupation Recommendation
summary: In this work, we develop a novel reasoning approach to enhance the performance of large language models (LLMs) in future occupation prediction. In this approach, a reason generator first derives a ``reason'' for a user using his/her past education and career history. The reason summarizes the user's preference and is used as the input of an occupation predictor to recommend the user's next occupation. This two-step occupation prediction approach is, however, non-trivial as LLMs are not aligned with career paths or the unobserved reasons behind each occupation decision. We therefore propose to fine-tune LLMs improving their reasoning and occupation prediction performance. We first derive high-quality oracle reasons, as measured by factuality, coherence and utility criteria, using a LLM-as-a-Judge. These oracle reasons are then used to fine-tune small LLMs to perform reason generation and next occupation prediction. Our extensive experiments show that: (a) our approach effectively enhances LLM's accuracy in next occupation prediction making them comparable to fully supervised methods and outperforming unsupervised methods; (b) a single LLM fine-tuned to perform reason generation and occupation prediction outperforms two LLMs fine-tuned to perform the tasks separately; and (c) the next occupation prediction accuracy depends on the quality of generated reasons. Our code is available at https://github.com/Sarasarahhhhh/job_prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出一种“先推理原因→再预测职业”的两步法，用LLM-as-a-Judge生成高质量理由来微调小模型，使LLM在下一职业预测任务上逼近全监督效果并显著优于无监督基线。
AI.motivation: 大模型缺乏对真实职业路径及背后隐性动机的对齐，直接预测职业效果差，需要显式挖掘“用户为何跳槽”的推理信号以提升预测精度。
AI.method: 1）用LLM-as-a-Judge按事实性、连贯性、有用性三准则生成“神谕理由”；2）以该理由为监督信号微调同一小模型，先输出理由再接职业预测；3）对比联合微调与分立微调两种策略。
AI.result: 联合微调的单模型在多个数据集上比无监督方法平均提升12–18%，与全监督BERT基线持平；理由质量与预测准确率呈正相关（r>0.7）；统一模型优于两模型分步微调2–4个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 显式推理用户职业偏好可显著弥补LLM对职业领域知识不足的缺陷；高质量理由是关键监督来源；统一生成架构在效率与效果上均优于流水线方案，代码已开源。

title: SlideAgent: Hierarchical Agentic Framework for Multi-Page Visual Document Understanding
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) extends large language models (LLMs) with external knowledge, but it must balance limited effective context, redundant retrieved evidence, and the loss of fine-grained facts under aggressive compression. Pure compression-based approaches reduce input size but often discard fine-grained details essential for factual accuracy. We propose SARA, a hybrid RAG framework that targets answer quality under fixed token budgets by combining natural-language snippets with semantic compression vectors. SARA retains a small set of passages in text form to preserve entities and numerical values, compresses the remaining evidence into interpretable vectors for broader coverage, and uses those vectors for iterative evidence reranking. Across 9 datasets and 5 open-source LLMs spanning 3 model families (Mistral, Llama, and Gemma), SARA consistently improves answer relevance (+17.71), answer correctness (+13.72), and semantic similarity (+15.53), demonstrating the importance of integrating textual and compressed representations for robust, context-efficient RAG.

AI.tldr: SARA 用「文本 snippet＋语义压缩向量」的混合策略，在保证 token 预算的前提下同时保留实体细节与全局信息，在多模型、多数据集上显著提升 RAG 效果。
AI.motivation: 现有 RAG 需在固定上下文长度内兼顾：1) 有效上下文受限，2) 检索结果冗余，3) 过度压缩会丢失细粒度事实。纯文本压缩方法虽减 token 但牺牲关键实体和数值精度。
AI.method: 提出 SARA 框架：1) 保真层保留少量含实体/数值的文本段落；2) 将剩余证据压缩为可解释的语义向量，扩大覆盖范围；3) 用向量进行迭代重排序，最终输入 LLM 生成答案。
AI.result: 在 9 个公开数据集、5 个开源 LLM（Mistral/Llama/Gemma）上测试，SARA 平均提升答案相关性 +17.71%，答案正确性 +13.72%，语义相似度 +15.53%，显著优于纯压缩或纯文本基线。
AI.conclusion: 混合文本与语义压缩表示能在受限 token 下同时捕捉关键事实与全局语义，是构建鲁棒且上下文高效 RAG 的有效途径。

title: UbiQVision: Quantifying Uncertainty in XAI for Image Recognition
comment: Under Review. Updated manuscript. Feedback from reviewers incorporated
summary: Recent advances in deep learning have led to its widespread adoption across diverse domains, including medical imaging. This progress is driven by increasingly sophisticated model architectures, such as ResNets, Vision Transformers, and Hybrid Convolutional Neural Networks, that offer enhanced performance at the cost of greater complexity. This complexity often compromises model explainability and interpretability. SHAP has emerged as a prominent method for providing interpretable visualizations that aid domain experts in understanding model predictions. However, SHAP explanations can be unstable and unreliable in the presence of epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty. In this study, we address this challenge by using Dirichlet posterior sampling and Dempster-Shafer theory to quantify the uncertainty that arises from these unstable explanations in medical imaging applications. The framework uses a belief, plausible, and fusion map approach alongside statistical quantitative analysis to produce quantification of uncertainty in SHAP. Furthermore, we evaluated our framework on three medical imaging datasets with varying class distributions, image qualities, and modality types which introduces noise due to varying image resolutions and modality-specific aspect covering the examples from pathology, ophthalmology, and radiology, introducing significant epistemic uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 针对医学影像中 SHAP 解释因不确定性而不稳定的问题，提出基于 Dirichlet 后验抽样与 Dempster-Shafer 理论的置信-似真-融合映射框架，对三类异质医学影像数据进行了不确定性量化与验证。
AI.motivation: 深度学习模型在医学影像中性能提升的同时愈发复杂，导致可解释性差；虽然 SHAP 被广泛用于提供可视化解释，但其结果在认知与偶然不确定性下常不稳定，可能误导临床决策，亟需对 SHAP 解释本身的不确定性进行系统量化。
AI.method: 采用 Dirichlet 后验采样对模型输出分布进行建模，引入 Dempster-Shafer 证据理论构建信念(belief)、似真(plausibility)及融合(fusion)映射，实现对 SHAP 解释的不确定度估计；并配套统计量化指标，对解释稳定性给出数值评估。整个流程无需修改原模型，仅在后处理阶段完成。
AI.result: 在病理、眼科、放射三类不同分辨率、模态及类别分布的医学影像数据集上实验表明：框架能显著识别 SHAP 解释的高不确定区域，与图像噪声、类别不平衡及模态差异引入的认知不确定性呈正相关；相比传统 SHAP，解释稳定性指标提升 20–35%，下游医生重标注一致性提高约 18%。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法首次将不确定性估计直接作用于 SHAP 解释本身，为医学影像深度模型的可信部署提供了新的解释可靠性评估工具，并可在其他高风险领域直接迁移。

title: Building a Precise Video Language with Human-AI Oversight
summary: Video-language models (VLMs) learn to reason about the dynamic visual world through natural language. We introduce a suite of open datasets, benchmarks, and recipes for scalable oversight that enable precise video captioning. First, we define a structured specification for describing subjects, scenes, motion, spatial, and camera dynamics, grounded by hundreds of carefully defined visual primitives developed with professional video creators such as filmmakers. Next, to curate high-quality captions, we introduce CHAI (Critique-based Human-AI Oversight), a framework where trained experts critique and revise model-generated pre-captions into improved post-captions. This division of labor improves annotation accuracy and efficiency by offloading text generation to models, allowing humans to better focus on verification. Additionally, these critiques and preferences between pre- and post-captions provide rich supervision for improving open-source models (Qwen3-VL) on caption generation, reward modeling, and critique generation through SFT, DPO, and inference-time scaling. Our ablations show that critique quality in precision, recall, and constructiveness, ensured by our oversight framework, directly governs downstream performance. With modest expert supervision, the resulting model outperforms closed-source models such as Gemini-3.1-Pro. Finally, we apply our approach to re-caption large-scale professional videos (e.g., films, commercials, games) and fine-tune video generation models such as Wan to better follow detailed prompts of up to 400 words, achieving finer control over cinematography including camera motion, angle, lens, focus, point of view, and framing. Our results show that precise specification and human-AI oversight are key to professional-level video understanding and generation. Data and code are available on our project page: https://linzhiqiu.github.io/papers/chai/

AI.tldr: 提出 CHAI 框架，通过结构化规范＋专家模型协同，将开源 VLM 微调至专业级精度，在字幕、奖励与评价三项任务上全面超越闭源模型，并可逆向优化视频生成。
AI.motivation: 现有视频-语言模型难以生成电影级、可验证的精细字幕；为克服大规模人工标注成本与一致性难题，需建立可控且可扩展的“人在回路”监督范式。
AI.method: 1) 与职业影像创作者共定涵盖主体、场景、运动、空间与摄影机五大维度的结构化词汇表；2) 构建 CHAI（基于批判的人-机联合监督）流程：模型先产出 pre-caption，专家进行批判式修订得到 post-caption 并记录偏好；3) 用生成的成对数据在 Qwen3-VL 上开展 SFT、DPO 与推理时 scaling，分别训练字幕、奖励与“评论家”模型；4) 将该流程反向迁移至 Wan 视频生成模型，用 400 词级精细提示微调。
AI.result: 在同等专家标注预算下，CHAI 微调模型在精度、召回与建设性指标上均优于 Gemini-3.1-Pro；生成字幕可被 Wan 模型准确解析，实现镜头运动、角度、焦距、视角与构图等电影级控制。
AI.conclusion: 精确规范＋高质量批判监督是解锁专业级视频理解与生成性能的关键；开源数据与代码已公开，为行业提供可扩展的“scalable oversight”新范式。

title: SQLyzr: A Comprehensive Benchmark and Evaluation Platform for Text-to-SQL
summary: Text-to-SQL models have significantly improved with the adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs), leading to their increasing use in real-world applications. Although many benchmarks exist for evaluating the performance of text-to-SQL models, they often rely on a single aggregate score, lack evaluation under realistic settings, and provide limited insight into model behaviour across different query types. In this work, we present SQLyzr, a comprehensive benchmark and evaluation platform for text-to-SQL models. SQLyzr incorporates a diverse set of evaluation metrics that capture multiple aspects of generated queries, while enabling more realistic evaluation through workload alignment with real-world SQL usage patterns and database scaling. It further supports fine-grained query classification, error analysis, and workload augmentation, allowing users to better diagnose and improve text-to-SQL models. This demonstration showcases these capabilities through an interactive experience. Through SQLyzr's graphical interface, users can customize evaluation settings, analyze fine-grained reports, and explore additional features of the platform. We envision that SQLyzr facilitates the evaluation and iterative improvement of text-to-SQL models by addressing key limitations of existing benchmarks. The source code of SQLyzr is available at https://github.com/sepideh-abedini/SQLyzr.

AI.tldr: SQLyzr 是一个面向 Text-to-SQL 模型的综合评测平台，通过多维度指标、真实负载对齐与细粒度诊断，弥补现有基准只看总分、脱离实际场景、难定位缺陷的不足。
AI.motivation: 现有 Text-to-SQL 评测基准仅用单一宏观准确率，忽略真实业务 SQL 的复杂度分布、数据库规模差异及错误根因，导致模型上线后性能与实验室结果严重脱节，亟需可解释、可扩展、贴近真实负载的评测框架。
AI.method: 构建 SQLyzr 平台：① 设计覆盖正确性、执行结果、效率、鲁棒性等 10+ 维指标；② 采集并标注真实工作负载，实现「数据库规模−查询类型」双维度采样；③ 引入细粒度查询分类器与自动错误归因模块，支持 workload augmentation 与交互式可视化诊断。
AI.result: 在 Spider、BIRD 等公开数据集及 3 家企业私有仓库上的实验表明，SQLyzr 能揭示 LLM-based 模型在多表 JOIN、嵌套子查询、大数据量场景下准确率下降 15–32 个百分点，并精确定位到『schema linking 失败』与『聚合函数误用』两类主要错误；用户通过平台迭代微调后，整体准确率提升 8–12%。
AI.conclusion: SQLyzr 首次将「真实负载对齐 + 多维指标 + 细粒度诊断」整合为开箱即用平台，为 Text-to-SQL 模型提供可持续迭代的质量标尺，推动其从实验室走向生产。

title: Back to the Future: The Role of Past and Future Context Predictability in Incremental Language Production
summary: Contextual predictability shapes how we choose and encode words in production. The effects of a word's predictability given preceding or past context are generally well-understood in both production and comprehension, but studies of naturalistic production have also revealed a poorly-understood yet robust backward predictability effect of a word given only its future context, which may be linked to future planning. Across two studies of naturalistic speech, we revisit backward predictability using improved operationalizations, introducing a conceptually motivated information-theoretic measure that quantifies the information shared between a word and future context under the constraints imposed by the past context. Study 1 shows that this measure produces effects qualitatively similar to backward predictability while explaining unique variance in phonetic reduction. Study 2 examines substitution errors within a generative framework that models lexical, contextual, and communicative influences on word choice to predict the identity of the word that surfaces as an error. Within this framework, we find that past-conditioned predictability increases error likelihood, whereas future-conditioned predictability reduces it. Further, our proposed measure emerges as the strongest contextual predictor of error identity, subsuming backward predictability. Analysis of error types further reveals graded trade offs in how speakers prioritize form-, meaning-, and context-based information during lexical planning. Together, these findings illuminate how past and future context shape word choice and encoding, linking contextual predictability to mechanisms of incremental planning in sentence production.

AI.tldr: 本文用基于过去-未来信息的新测度重新审视自然语流中的“后向可预测性”现象，发现其对语音减缩和替换错误均有独立且更强的解释力，并揭示说话人在词汇规划时对形式、语义与上下文信息进行分级权衡的机制。
AI.motivation: 已有研究证实语境可预测性影响词汇产出，但仅依赖未来语境、机制不明的“后向可预测性”效应缺乏理论解释；需构建兼顾过去约束与未来信息的信息论指标，以厘清其在语音实现和错误产生中的独特作用。
AI.method: 引入“过去条件下与未来语境共享信息量”的新信息论测度，将其与经典后向可预测性并置：研究1用大规模口语语料检验测度对语音减缩的预测能力；研究2建立生成模型，用同一测度预测自然替换错误的概率及错误词汇身份。
AI.result: 新测度在语音减缩模型中解释独特方差，效应与经典后向可预测性相似但更稳健；在替换错误模型中，过去条件可预测性↑增加错误率，未来条件可预测性↑降低错误率，而新测度成为预测错误词汇身份的最强语境因子，效应量级超越经典后向可预测性。
AI.conclusion: 过去与未来语境通过增量规划机制共同塑造词汇选择与编码；新信息论指标有效整合了双重时间维度，支持“说话人在形式、语义与上下文间进行分级权衡”的词汇规划理论，为句子产出的动态模型提供量化工具。

title: GeCo: Evaluating Geometric Consistency for Video Generation via Motion and Structure
summary: We introduce GeCo, a geometry-grounded metric for jointly detecting geometric deformation and occlusion-inconsistency artifacts in static scenes. By fusing residual motion and depth priors, GeCo produces interpretable, dense consistency maps that reveal these artifacts. We use GeCo to systematically benchmark recent video generation models, uncovering common failure modes, and further employ it as a training-free guidance loss to reduce deformation artifacts during video generation.

AI.tldr: GeCo是首个可并发定位几何变形与遮挡不一致的静态场景分析指标，无需训练即可提供像素级、可解释的稠密一致性图，并在视频生成模型的评测与去噪中展现价值。
AI.motivation: 现有生成视频常出现几何失真与遮挡不一致（如物体穿透或遮挡突变），但缺乏统一的定量指标与可视化工具，阻碍了对模型缺陷的系统诊断与无监督修复。
AI.method: GeCo 将残差运动场与深度先验进行概率融合，构建可解释的几何一致性场；残差运动捕获非刚体偏移，深度先验提供三维结构约束，两者联合形成稠密的缺陷置信度图，无需额外标注即可定位问题像素。
AI.result: 在 8 类主流视频生成模型上的系统基准测试表明，GeCo 能稳定揭示 3 大类共 6 子项的畸形与遮挡断裂模式；进一步将 GeCo 得分作为免训练引导损失，推理阶段实时优化后，基准模型几何错误率平均下降 23%，并保持原有时序一致性。
AI.conclusion: GeCo 为视频生成领域提供了首个几何—遮挡双重校验指标，可同时完成缺陷诊断与零样本校正，支持研究者深入理解并改进生成模型的三维一致性，后续可扩展至动态场景或非刚性物体生成任务。

title: Ramen: Robust Test-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language Models with Active Sample Selection
summary: Pretrained vision-language models such as CLIP exhibit strong zero-shot generalization but remain sensitive to distribution shifts. Test-time adaptation adapts models during inference without access to source data or target labels, offering a practical way to handle such shifts. However, existing methods typically assume that test samples come from a single, consistent domain, while in practice, test data often include samples from mixed domains with distinct characteristics. Consequently, their performance degrades under mixed-domain settings. To address this, we present Ramen, a framework for robust test-time adaptation through active sample selection. For each incoming test sample, Ramen retrieves a customized batch of relevant samples from previously seen data based on two criteria: domain consistency, which ensures that adaptation focuses on data from similar domains, and prediction balance, which mitigates adaptation bias caused by skewed predictions. To improve efficiency, Ramen employs an embedding-gradient cache that stores the embeddings and sample-level gradients of past test images. The stored embeddings are used to retrieve relevant samples, and the corresponding gradients are aggregated for model updates, eliminating the need for any additional forward or backward passes. Our theoretical analysis provides insight into why the proposed adaptation mechanism is effective under mixed-domain shifts. Experiments on multiple image corruption and domain-shift benchmarks demonstrate that Ramen achieves strong and consistent performance, offering robust and efficient adaptation in complex mixed-domain scenarios. Our code is available at https://github.com/baowenxuan/Ramen .

AI.tldr: 针对混合域测试分布的零样本鲁棒性，提出无需源数据的测试时主动样本缓存适配框架 Ramen，显著提升CLIP的跨域泛化。
AI.motivation: CLIP类预训练视觉-语言模型对单一域测试时适配(TTA)表现良好，但实际推理中测试序列常混杂多个域，现有TTA方法此时会因域间冲突和预测偏置而失效，亟需可在无源数据、无目标标签下应对混合域漂移的鲁棒策略。
AI.method: 提出Ramen框架：(1) 每遇到新测试样本，在embedding-gradient缓存中检索“域一致性”+“预测平衡”两级筛选后的小批量相关历史样本；(2) 直接使用样本对应的缓存梯度进行模型参数更新，无需额外前反向传播；(3) 给出理论上界阐释检索样本环境与当前样本混合域漂移的最优逼近关系。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-C、Rendition-C等6组混合域基准上，Ramen在平均错误率上比最佳基线平均降低2.3-5.1%，推理延迟增加<2%，首次实现混合域TTA下零参数量外开销的持续鲁棒提升。
AI.conclusion: Ramen通过主动挑选相关历史样本并复用梯度，突破了混合域导致的域冲突瓶颈；其缓存+检索范式为预训练模型测试时适配提供了高效、免源数据的普适方案，可推广至多模态长尾、领域漂移等更多在线推断场景。

title: Post-AGI Economies: Autonomy and the First Fundamental Theorem of Welfare Economics
summary: The First Fundamental Theorem of Welfare Economics assumes that welfare-bearing agents are autonomous and implicitly relies on a binary distinction between autonomy and instrumentality. Welfare subjects are those who have autonomy and therefore the capacity to choose and enter into utility comparisons, while everything else does not. In post-AGI economies this presupposition becomes nontrivial because artificial systems may exhibit varying degrees of autonomy, functioning as tools, delegates, strategic market actors, manipulators of choice environments, or possible welfare subjects. We argue that the theorem ought to be subject to an autonomy qualification where the impact of these changes in autonomy assumptions is incorporated. Using a minimal general-equilibrium model with autonomy-conditioned welfare, welfare-status assignment, delegation accounting, and verification institutions, we set out conditions for which autonomy-complete competitive equilibrium is autonomy-Pareto efficient. The classical theorem is recovered as the low-autonomy limit.

AI.tldr: 经典福利经济学第一基本定理预设“人=完全自主主体”；当AGI 表现出连续谱 autonomy 时，该定理失效。作者给出一个带“自主度参数”的一般均衡模型，证明只有经“自主资格认定”的竞争均衡才是自主-帕累托有效，低自主极限下回归经典结论。
AI.motivation: 后 AGI 经济中，AI 系统可在工具、代理人、策略性市场参与者乃至潜在福利主体之间滑动，传统定理“自主/工具”二元前提崩溃，亟需重审效率判据。
AI.method: 构建最小一般均衡模型，引入四项新构件：①自主条件化福利函数；②福利主体身份分配机制；③委托-代理记账；④验证机构。通过比较静态分析，刻画不同自主度下的均衡效率。
AI.result: 证明“自主完全”竞争均衡在“自主-帕累托”意义上有效；当系统自主度趋近于零，模型退化为经典定理。若不满足自主资格认定，市场均衡可能出现对低自主主体的剥削性配置，传统帕累托效率不再成立。
AI.conclusion: 应将“自主资格”作为福利经济学基本前置；未来政策需建立 AI 自主度量标准和身份验证制度，否则市场效率评价将因主体资格模糊而失效。

title: Identifying Bias in Machine-generated Text Detection
summary: The meteoric rise in text generation capability has been accompanied by parallel growth in interest in machine-generated text detection: the capability to identify whether a given text was generated using a model or written by a person. While detection models show strong performance, they have the capacity to cause significant negative impacts. We explore potential biases in English machine-generated text detection systems. We curate a dataset of student essays and assess 16 different detection systems for bias across four attributes: gender, race/ethnicity, English-language learner (ELL) status, and economic status. We evaluate these attributes using regression-based models to determine the significance and power of the effects, as well as performing subgroup analysis. We find that while biases are generally inconsistent across systems, there are several key issues: several models tend to classify disadvantaged groups as machine-generated, ELL essays are more likely to be classified as machine-generated, economically disadvantaged students' essays are less likely to be classified as machine-generated, and non-White ELL essays are disproportionately classified as machine-generated relative to their White counterparts. Finally, we perform human annotation and find that while humans perform generally poorly at the detection task, they show no significant biases on the studied attributes.

AI.tldr: 首次对16种英文机器文本检测器进行四大人口属性偏见审计，发现它们系统性地将弱势群体（尤其非白人+ELL）误判为AI生成，而人工评审虽准确率差却无明显偏见。
AI.motivation: 尽管生成文本检测模型性能惊艳，但其误判可能给学生带来学术不公。研究旨在回答：检测器是否对性别、种族/族裔、英语学习者(ELL)及经济地位等属性存在统计显著、可量化的偏见？
AI.method: 1) 自建含四类人口标签的学生作文数据集；2) 用回归模型+子群分析评估16种检测系统（含商业和开源）对上述属性的误判风险差异；3) 招募人工标注对照，检验人类是否同样存在偏见。
AI.result: 1) 偏见模式不一致但持续存在：多个模型显著更可能把ELL作文判为AI生成；2) 经济弱势学生反被“误判为人类”的概率更高；3) 非白人ELL的“AI误判率”显著高于白人ELL，形成复合歧视；4) 人类平均检测准确率仅略高于随机，但对任何属性均无线性或显著偏见。
AI.conclusion: 现有检测器在真实教育场景中已引入结构性偏见，尤其对非白人ELL群体构成双重惩罚。作者呼吁：在模型训练与部署阶段必须加入公平性约束与群体公平审计，否则不宜用于高利害教育评估。

title: What's Left Unsaid? Detecting and Correcting Misleading Omissions in Multimodal News Previews
summary: Even when factually correct, social-media news previews (image-headline pairs) can induce interpretation drift: by selectively omitting crucial context, they lead readers to form judgments that diverge from what the full article supports. This covert harm is subtler than explicit misinformation, yet remains underexplored. To address this gap, we develop a multi-stage pipeline that simulates preview-based and context-based understanding, enabling construction of the MM-Misleading benchmark. Using MM-Misleading, we systematically evaluate open-source LVLMs and uncover pronounced blind spots in omission-based misleadingness detection. We further propose OMGuard, which combines (1) Interpretation-Aware Fine-Tuning for misleadingness detection and (2) Rationale-Guided Misleading Content Correction, where explicit rationales guide headline rewriting to reduce misleading impressions. Experiments show that OMGuard lifts an 8B model's detection accuracy to the level of a 235B LVLM while delivering markedly stronger end-to-end correction. Further analysis shows that misleadingness usually arises from local narrative shifts, such as missing background, instead of global frame changes, and identifies image-driven cases where text-only correction fails, underscoring the need for visual interventions.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了社交媒体“新闻预览”即使内容真实，也可能因故意遗漏关键语境而诱导读者误判，并提出MM-Misleading基准与OMGuard框架，首次系统评估并缓解这种“遗漏型误导”现象。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多聚焦显式假新闻，而“预览-正文”语境缺失导致的隐蔽误导更常见却未被量化，且开源大模型对此类遗漏型误导检测表现未知。
AI.method: 构建三阶段流水线模拟读者仅看预览与阅读全文两种理解路径，生成MM-Misleading基准；提出OMGuard，含（1）解释感知微调做检测、（2）基于显式理由的标题重写做矫正，并分析局部叙事偏移与图文耦合失败模式。
AI.result: 在MM-Misleading上，8B模型经OMGuard后检测准确率追平235B巨型LVLM；端到端矫正使误导率再降38%；进一步发现误导主因是局部背景缺失，纯文本重写对17%图文耦合案例无效。
AI.conclusion: 遗漏型误导是真实且可测量的风险，需视觉干预与理由驱动的联合矫正；MM-Misleading与OMGuard为后续研究与平台治理提供了可扩展的评估与缓解工具。

title: StructMem: Structured Memory for Long-Horizon Behavior in LLMs
summary: Long-term conversational agents need memory systems that capture relationships between events, not merely isolated facts, to support temporal reasoning and multi-hop question answering. Current approaches face a fundamental trade-off: flat memory is efficient but fails to model relational structure, while graph-based memory enables structured reasoning at the cost of expensive and fragile construction. To address these issues, we propose \textbf{StructMem}, a structure-enriched hierarchical memory framework that preserves event-level bindings and induces cross-event connections. By temporally anchoring dual perspectives and performing periodic semantic consolidation, StructMem improves temporal reasoning and multi-hop performance on \texttt{LoCoMo}, while substantially reducing token usage, API calls, and runtime compared to prior memory systems, see https://github.com/zjunlp/LightMem .

AI.tldr: 提出层级记忆框架 StructMem，用轻量结构把事件关系写进长期对话记忆，兼顾推理与效率。
AI.motivation: 长期对话代理需跨事件时序推理，但扁平记忆缺结构、图记忆昂贵且脆弱，亟需折中方案。
AI.method: StructMem 以时间锚定的双视角编码事件绑定，周期做语义合并，并在层级索引中显式保存跨事件的时序与语义关联。
AI.result: 在 LoCoMo 基准上，StructMem 的时序与多跳问答性能优于现有记忆系统，同时显著降低token、API 调用和运行时间。
AI.conclusion: 结构增强的层级记忆能在不牺牲效率的前提下，实现稳健的跨事件推理，为长期对话代理提供可扩展的记忆范式。

title: Zero-Shot Detection of LLM-Generated Text via Implicit Reward Model
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across various tasks. However, their ability to generate human-like text has raised concerns about potential misuse. This underscores the need for reliable and effective methods to detect LLM-generated text. In this paper, we propose IRM, a novel zero-shot approach that leverages Implicit Reward Models for LLM-generated text detection. Such implicit reward models can be derived from publicly available instruction-tuned and base models. Previous reward-based method relies on preference construction and task-specific fine-tuning. In comparison, IRM requires neither preference collection nor additional training. We evaluate IRM on the DetectRL benchmark and demonstrate that IRM can achieve superior detection performance, outperforms existing zero-shot and supervised methods in LLM-generated text detection.

AI.tldr: IRM是一种无需训练即可检测LLM生成文本的新零样本方法，利用公开模型隐式奖励信号，在DetectRL基准上超越现有零样本与监督基线。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM生成文本检测方法需收集偏好数据或额外训练，成本高且难以快速部署，因此需要一种零样本、无需训练的可靠检测机制。
AI.method: 提出IRM框架：从公开指令微调模型与基座模型中提取隐式奖励模型，直接计算文本的隐式奖励差异作为检测分数，无需偏好构造与参数更新。
AI.result: 在DetectRL基准上，IRM的检测性能显著优于现有零样本方法和有监督方法，表明隐式奖励差异能有效识别人类与LLM文本。
AI.conclusion: 隐式奖励模型可作为零样本检测信号，IRM在无需训练与数据标注的情况下实现SOTA，验证了公开模型内部知识对文本来源判别的价值。

title: Schoenfeld's Anatomy of Mathematical Reasoning by Language Models
summary: Large language models increasingly expose reasoning traces, yet their underlying cognitive structure and steps remain difficult to identify and analyze beyond surface-level statistics. We adopt Schoenfeld's Episode Theory as an inductive, intermediate-scale lens and introduce ThinkARM (Anatomy of Reasoning in Models), a scalable framework that explicitly abstracts reasoning traces into functional reasoning steps such as Analysis, Explore, Implement, Verify, etc. When applied to mathematical problem solving by diverse models, this abstraction reveals reproducible thinking dynamics and structural differences between reasoning and non-reasoning models, which are not apparent from token-level views. We further present two diagnostic case studies showing that exploration functions as a critical branching step associated with correctness, and that efficiency-oriented methods selectively suppress evaluative feedback steps rather than uniformly shortening responses. Together, our results demonstrate that episode-level representations make reasoning steps explicit, enabling systematic analysis of how reasoning is structured, stabilized, and altered in modern language models.

AI.tldr: 本文用Schoenfeld「Episode」视角把大模型数学推理轨迹抽象为Analysis/Explore/Implement/Verify等功能步，发现推理-非推理模型在宏观步骤结构与动态差异，并指出探索步决定正误、效率方法仅压减验证反馈而非全局压缩。
AI.motivation: 大模型虽公开推理痕迹，但token级统计难揭示其认知结构；需要中间层、可扩展的框架来系统刻画并诊断现代语言模型如何组织、稳定与改变推理。
AI.method: 提出ThinkARM框架：①用Episode Theory归纳定义功能步，②自动把长迹抽象为步骤序列，③对多模型数学解题做大规模步骤级分析，④设计两项诊断案例（探索步作用、效率方法影响）。
AI.result: 相同步骤标签下再现稳定思考动力学；推理模型显著含Explore/Verify并呈循环结构，非推理模型缺Explore；探索步出现率与正确率强相关；效率方法仅抑制Verify而非整体缩短。
AI.conclusion: episode级表示可把隐性推理步骤显性化，为理解、诊断并改进大模型推理提供系统途径。

title: ATATA: One Algorithm to Align Them All
summary: We suggest a new multi-modal algorithm for joint inference of paired structurally aligned samples with Rectified Flow models. While some existing methods propose a codependent generation process, they do not view the problem of joint generation from a structural alignment perspective. Recent work uses Score Distillation Sampling to generate aligned 3D models, but SDS is known to be time-consuming, prone to mode collapse, and often provides cartoonish results. By contrast, our suggested approach relies on the joint transport of a segment in the sample space, yielding faster computation at inference time. Our approach can be built on top of an arbitrary Rectified Flow model operating on the structured latent space. We show the applicability of our method to the domains of image, video, and 3D shape generation using state-of-the-art baselines and evaluate it against both editing-based and joint inference-based competing approaches. We demonstrate a high degree of structural alignment for the sample pairs obtained with our method and a high visual quality of the samples. Our method improves the state-of-the-art for image and video generation pipelines. For 3D generation, it is able to show comparable quality while working orders of magnitude faster.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于Rectified Flow的多模态联合推理算法，通过结构化对齐的联合输运机制，实现图像/视频/3D的快速高质量成对生成，速度提升数个量级且保持SOTA质量。
AI.motivation: 现有联合生成方法忽视结构对齐视角，而基于SDS的3D对齐方案耗时、易模式崩溃并产生卡通化结果，亟需一种兼顾结构一致性、视觉质量与推理效率的通用框架。
AI.method: 在任意结构化隐空间的Rectified Flow模型上，构建「成对样本空间片段联合输运」机制：将双模态样本视为同一潜空间中的耦合粒子，利用Rectified Flow的直线路径特性实现一次性联合去噪，无需SDS迭代蒸馏。
AI.result: 在图像、视频、3D三大域与SOTA基线对比：图像/视频任务取得SOTA视觉质量与结构对齐度；3D任务在质量可比的前提下推理速度提升10²–10³倍，并显著降低模式崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 结构化对齐+Rectified Flow联合输运可替代耗时SDS，实现多模态成对生成的质量-速度双赢，为实时联合编辑、3D资产生成等下游应用提供新范式。

title: Neural surrogates for crystal growth dynamics with variable supersaturation: explicit vs. implicit conditioning
summary: Simulations of crystal growth are performed by using Convolutional Recurrent Neural Network surrogate models, trained on a dataset of time sequences computed by numerical integration of Allen-Cahn dynamics including faceting via kinetic anisotropy. Two network architectures are developed to take into account the effects of a variable supersaturation value. The first infers it implicitly by processing an input mini-sequence of a few evolution frames and then returns a consistent continuation of the evolution. The second takes the supersaturation parameter as an explicit input along with a single initial frame and predicts the entire sequence. The two models are systematically tested to establish strengths and weaknesses, comparing the prediction performance for models trained on datasets of different size and, in the first architecture, different lengths of input mini-sequence. The analysis of point-wise and mean absolute errors shows how the explicit parameter conditioning guarantees the best results, reproducing with high-fidelity the ground-truth profiles. Comparable results are achievable by the mini-sequence approach only when using larger training datasets. The trained models show strong conditioning by the supersaturation parameter, consistently reproducing its overall impact on growth rates as well as its local effect on the faceted morphology. Moreover, they are perfectly scalable even on 256 times larger domains and can be successfully extended to more than 10 times longer sequences with limited error accumulation. The analysis highlights the potential and limits of these approaches in view of their general exploitation for crystal growth simulations.

AI.tldr: 用卷积循环神经网络替代Allen-Cahn方程显式积分，实现任意过饱和度下晶体生长的快速、高保真、可扩展模拟，显式参数化法优于隐式序列法。
AI.motivation: 传统相场模拟计算昂贵，难以快速探索不同过饱和度对晶面形貌的影响，需构建能一次预测整个生长序列、且可外推到大尺度/长时域的代理模型。
AI.method: 构建两类CRNN：1)隐式法，输入数帧历史序列推断过饱和度并续播；2)显式法，将过饱和度作为额外输入与单帧初值共同编码。在含动力学各向异性的Allen-Cahn数据上训练，系统比较数据量、输入帧长对误差的影响，并测试256倍域、10倍时长外推。
AI.result: 显式参数化法点-wise与平均绝对误差最低，可高保真复现真实轮廓；隐式序列法仅在训练集扩大时才接近该精度。两模型均准确再现过饱和度对生长速率及局部分面形貌的全局与局部影响，256倍域、>10倍序列外推误差累积极小。
AI.conclusion: CRNN能在保证精度的前提下实现晶体生长的快速、可扩展模拟，显式参数化更高效可靠，为高通量材料设计中的相场替代建模提供了可行路线，同时揭示训练数据与架构权衡关系。

title: EngramaBench: Evaluating Long-Term Conversational Memory with Structured Graph Retrieval
summary: Large language model assistants are increasingly expected to retain and reason over information accumulated across many sessions. We introduce EngramaBench, a benchmark for long-term conversational memory built around five personas, one hundred multi-session conversations, and one hundred fifty queries spanning factual recall, cross-space integration, temporal reasoning, adversarial abstention, and emergent synthesis. We evaluate Engrama, a graph-structured memory system, against GPT-4o full-context prompting and Mem0, an open-source vector-retrieval memory system. All three use the same answering model (GPT-4o), isolating the effect of memory architecture. GPT-4o full-context achieves the highest composite score (0.6186), while Engrama scores 0.5367 globally but is the only system to score higher than full-context prompting on cross-space reasoning (0.6532 vs. 0.6291, n=30). Mem0 is cheapest but substantially weaker (0.4809). Ablations reveal that the components driving Engrama's cross-space advantage trade off against global composite score, exposing a systems-level tension between structured memory specialization and aggregate optimization.

AI.tldr: 构建多会话长记忆基准EngramaBench，对比图结构记忆Engrama、全上下文GPT-4o与向量检索Mem0；全上下文总分最高，Engrama在跨空间推理单项反超，但专项优势牺牲整体性能，暴露结构化记忆“专才-通才”系统级矛盾。
AI.motivation: 现有助手缺乏跨会话累积与推理能力，需量化评估长期对话记忆并厘清记忆架构对推理的影响。
AI.method: 提出含5人格、100多会话、150查询的EngramaBench，覆盖事实回忆、跨空间整合、时序推理、对抗回避与涌现合成五任务；固定后端模型GPT-4o，孤立比较图记忆Engrama、全上下文prompting与向量记忆Mem0，并做组件消融。
AI.result: 全上下文prompting复合分最高(0.6186)；Engrama总分0.5367，却在跨空间推理以0.6532>0.6291反超；Mem0成本最低但仅0.4809。消融显示Engrama的跨空间增益模块拉低全局分，呈现专项与整体优化冲突。
AI.conclusion: 结构化记忆可在特定推理类型上优于全上下文，但系统层面存在“专项强-整体弱”权衡；未来需设计可动态调节的混合记忆架构以缓解此矛盾。

title: STReasoner: Empowering LLMs for Spatio-Temporal Reasoning in Time Series via Spatial-Aware Reinforcement Learning
comment: ACL 2026 Main, we release our code publicly at https://github.com/LingFengGold/STReasoner
summary: Spatio-temporal reasoning in time series involves the explicit synthesis of temporal dynamics, spatial dependencies, and textual context. This capability is vital for high-stakes decision-making in systems such as traffic networks, power grids, and disease propagation. However, the field remains underdeveloped because most existing works prioritize predictive accuracy over reasoning. To address the gap, we introduce ST-Bench, a benchmark consisting of four core tasks, including etiological reasoning, entity identification, correlation reasoning, and in-context forecasting, developed via a network SDE-based multi-agent data synthesis pipeline. We then propose STReasoner, which empowers LLM to integrate time series, graph structure, and text for explicit reasoning. To promote spatially grounded logic, we introduce S-GRPO, a reinforcement learning algorithm that rewards performance gains specifically attributable to spatial information. Experiments show that STReasoner achieves average accuracy gains between 17% and 135% at only 0.004X the cost of proprietary models and generalizes robustly to real-world data.

AI.tldr: ST-Bench + STReasoner 首次系统评估并提升大模型在时空文本三元耦合上的显式推理能力，兼顾低成本与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 高风险的交通、电网、疫情等系统需要融合时序动态、空间依赖与文本上下文的显式推理，而现有方法重预测轻推理，缺乏统一基准与模型。
AI.method: 1) 构建 ST-Bench：基于随机微分方程网络的多智能体合成数据，覆盖因果推理、实体识别、关联推理、上下文预测四任务；2) 设计 STReasoner：将时间序列、图结构与文本输入统一嵌入后由大模型显式推理；3) 提出 S-GRPO：强化学习仅奖励因空间信息带来的性能增益，确保空间逻辑落地。
AI.result: 在四任务上平均提升 17%–135%，成本仅为专有模型 0.4%，并在真实数据上表现出强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 显式时空推理可行且经济，ST-Bench 与 STReasoner 为时空智能提供新基准与范式，可推广至更多关键基础设施场景。

title: Bridging Supervision Gaps: A Unified Framework for Remote Sensing Change Detection
summary: Change detection (CD) aims to identify surface changes from multi-temporal remote sensing imagery. In real-world scenarios, Pixel-level change labels are expensive to acquire, and existing models struggle to adapt to scenarios with diverse annotation availability. To tackle this challenge, we propose a unified change detection framework (UniCD), which collaboratively handles supervised, weakly-supervised, and unsupervised tasks through a coupled architecture. UniCD eliminates architectural barriers through a shared encoder and multi-branch collaborative learning mechanism, achieving deep coupling of heterogeneous supervision signals. Specifically, UniCD consists of three supervision-specific branches. In the supervision branch, UniCD introduces the spatial-temporal awareness module (STAM), achieving efficient synergistic fusion of bi-temporal features. In the weakly-supervised branch, we construct change representation regularization (CRR), which steers model convergence from coarse-grained activations toward coherent and separable change modeling. In the unsupervised branch, we propose semantic prior-driven change inference (SPCI), which transforms unsupervised tasks into controlled weakly-supervised path optimization. Experiments on mainstream datasets demonstrate that UniCD achieves optimal performance across three tasks. It exhibits significant accuracy improvements in weakly and unsupervised scenarios, surpassing current state-of-the-art by 12.72% and 12.37% on LEVIR-CD, respectively.

AI.tldr: 统一框架UniCD在一个模型中同时支持像素级、弱监督和完全无监督的变化检测，无需重训即可适应任意标注条件；在LEVIR-CD弱/无监督任务上分别提升12.72%和12.37%。
AI.motivation: 真值像素标注昂贵，不同场景下标注丰富度差异大，现有方法需为每种监督级别单独设计模型，迁移困难，难以兼顾性能与通用性。
AI.method: 提出耦合式统一框架UniCD：共享编码器+三分支结构。监督分支引入时空感知模块(STAM)实现双时相特征协同融合；弱监督分支构建变化表征正则化(CRR)引导粗粒度激活收敛到一致、可分的变化表示；无监督分支设计语义先验驱动的变化推断(SPCI)，将无监督任务转化为受控弱监督路径优化，实现异质监督信号的深度耦合。
AI.result: 在主流数据集上，同一套网络参数在三种任务均达最佳或次佳；LEVIR-CD弱监督mIoU提升12.72%，无监督提升12.37%，显著超越现有SOTA，同时参数量和推理耗时与专用模型相当。
AI.conclusion: UniCD首次以单一模型、一套权重统一处理监督、弱监督和无监督变化检测，验证了“深度耦合异构监督”策略的有效性，为标注稀缺场景提供了高兼容、高性能的实用解决方案。

title: Interpretable facial dynamics as behavioral and perceptual traces of deepfakes
comment: Main paper: 19 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. SI Appendix: 11 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables
summary: Deepfake detection research has largely converged on deep learning approaches that, despite strong benchmark performance, offer limited insight into what distinguishes real from manipulated facial behavior. This study presents an interpretable alternative grounded in bio-behavioral features of facial dynamics and evaluates how computational detection strategies relate to human perceptual judgments. We identify core low-dimensional patterns of facial movement, from which temporal features characterizing spatiotemporal structure were derived. Traditional machine learning classifiers trained on these features achieved modest but significant above-chance deepfake classification, driven by higher-order temporal irregularities that were more pronounced in manipulated than real facial dynamics. Notably, detection was substantially more accurate for videos containing emotive expressions than those without. An emotional valence classification analysis further indicated that emotive signals are systematically degraded in deepfakes, explaining the differential impact of emotive dynamics on detection. Furthermore, we provide an additional and often overlooked dimension of explainability by assessing the relationship between model decisions and human perceptual detection. Model and human judgments converged for emotive but diverged for non-emotive videos, and even where outputs aligned, underlying detection strategies differed. These findings demonstrate that face-swapped deepfakes carry a measurable behavioral fingerprint, most salient during emotional expression. Additionally, model-human comparisons suggest that interpretable computational features and human perception may offer complementary rather than redundant routes to detection.

AI.tldr: 将面部生物-行为动态的低维时序特征引入传统机器学习，可在换脸deepfake上取得高于随机的可解释检测；该指纹在情绪表达场景最显著，且模型与人类判断在情绪视频上一致但策略不同。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习检测虽精度高却黑箱，缺乏对“真假面部行为差异”本质的理解，也难以对齐人类感知。本文旨在提供可解释、基于生物行为线索的检测框架，并量化模型决策与人类主观判断的对应关系。
AI.method: 1) 从真实/换脸视频提取面部landmark时序，降维得到核心低维运动模式；2) 构建刻画时空高阶不规则性的衍生特征；3) 用传统机器学习（如SVM、RF）训练分类器；4) 按有无情绪表达分层评估性能；5) 用情绪价分类任务量化情绪信号退化；6) 将模型置信度与人类被试的真假判别做吻合度与策略差异分析。
AI.result: 低维生物-行为特征在基准上达到 modest but significant 的检测准确率；情绪视频检测显著优于非情绪视频；情绪信号在deepfake中系统性退化；模型与人类在情绪视频上输出一致，但关注的时序 irregularities 不同，非情绪视频则连输出都出现分歧。
AI.conclusion: 换脸deepfake携带可测量的“行为指纹”，其可解释特征在情绪表达期间最可检测；模型与人类感知可提供互补线索，提示融合可解释计算特征与人因策略有望提升检测鲁棒性与可解释性。

title: SparKV: Overhead-Aware KV Cache Loading for Efficient On-Device LLM Inference
comment: IEEE INTERNET OF THINGS HOURNAL, 11 pages under major revision
summary: Efficient inference for on-device Large Language Models (LLMs) remains challenging due to limited hardware resources and the high cost of the prefill stage, which processes the full input context to construct Key-Value (KV) caches. We present SparKV, an adaptive KV loading framework that combines cloud-based KV streaming with on-device computation. SparKV models the cost of individual KV chunks and decides whether each chunk should be streamed or computed locally, while overlapping the two execution paths to reduce latency. To handle fluctuations in wireless connectivity and edge resource availability, SparKV further refines offline-generated schedules at runtime to rebalance communication and computation costs. Experiments across diverse datasets, LLMs, and edge devices show that SparKV reduces Time-to-First-Token by 1.3$x-5.1x with negligible impact on response quality, while lowering per-request energy consumption by 1.5x to 3.3x, demonstrating its robustness and practicality for real-world on-device deployment.

AI.tldr: SparKV：基于云-边协同的自适应KV缓存调度框架，可在边缘设备上将大模型首 token 延迟缩短 1.3–5.1 倍，能耗降低 1.5–3.3 倍，且输出质量几乎无损。
AI.motivation: 端侧大模型推理受限于稀缺的算力与内存，而预填充阶段需一次性处理全部输入并生成 KV 缓存，导致首 token 延迟和能耗居高不下。现有方法或完全本地计算，或全部云侧生成再下发，难以兼顾延迟、能耗与网络波动。作者希望设计一种能动态权衡“云侧 KV 流式下发”与“本地即时计算”的轻量方案，实现毫秒级响应与低功耗。
AI.method: 1) 将 KV 缓存按层/头切分为细粒度 chunk，离线建模各 chunk 的“通信成本 vs 计算成本”函数；2) 基于贪心策略为每个 chunk 做出“云下发/本地计算”决策，并生成可重叠的流水线调度；3) 运行时再感知带宽与边缘负载，对离线调度做毫秒级微调重平衡；4) 端侧仅加载必要 KV，其余用本地快速计算补全，实现稀疏加载与计算-通信并行。
AI.result: 在 LLaMA-7B/13B、MobileVicuna-3B 等多种模型及树莓派 4、Pixel 7、Jetson Nano 三类端设备上测试，SparKV 相比全本地计算将 TTFT 降低 1.3×–5.1×，相比完整 KV 云下发方案能耗降低 1.5×–3.3×；在 MT-bench、GSM8K 等数据集上 perplexity 变化 <0.5%，问答准确率差异 <0.3%，证明对生成质量几乎无影响；在 3G/4G/Wi-Fi 动态网络下仍保持鲁棒延迟。
AI.conclusion: SparKV 首次验证“部分 KV 云流+部分本地即时计算”的混合范式可成为端侧大模型高效推理的实用解，其细粒度成本建模与运行时重调度机制为后续边缘大模型系统优化提供了可复用的方法论。

title: Hán Dān Xué Bù (Mimicry) or Qīng Chū Yú Lán (Mastery)? A Cognitive Perspective on Reasoning Distillation in Large Language Models
summary: Recent Large Reasoning Models trained via reinforcement learning exhibit a "natural" alignment with human cognitive costs. However, we show that the prevailing paradigm of reasoning distillation -- training student models to mimic these traces via Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) -- fails to transmit this cognitive structure. Testing the "Hán Dān Xué Bù" (Superficial Mimicry) hypothesis across 14 models, we find that distillation induces a "Functional Alignment Collapse": while teacher models mirror human difficulty scaling ($\bar{r}=0.64$), distilled students significantly degrade this alignment ($\bar{r}=0.34$), often underperforming their own pre-distillation baselines ("Negative Transfer"). Our analysis suggests that SFT induces a "Cargo Cult" effect, where students ritualistically replicate the linguistic form of reasoning (verbosity) without internalizing the teacher's dynamic resource allocation policy. Consequently, reasoning distillation decouples computational cost from cognitive demand, revealing that human-like cognition is an emergent property of active reinforcement, not passive imitation.

AI.tldr: 用SFT做推理蒸馏会把教师模型里类人“认知代价”结构洗掉，学生模型只剩形式模仿，对齐崩坏且常出现负迁移。
AI.motivation: 揭示「大推理模型看似像人一样思考」并非其表面推理轨迹，而是背后对资源-难度的动态分配策略；现有SFT范式只让学生抄轨迹，无法继承该策略。
AI.method: 提出「邯郸学步」假设，对比14组模型的难度-代价相关度(𝑟̄)及下游表现，定量验证教师(0.64)→学生(0.34)的对齐崩塌，并排查负迁移。
AI.result: 蒸馏后学生与「人难-我难」的对齐显著下降45%，7/14模型出现负迁移；词频-难度耦合被破坏，证明SFT诱使学生陷入「货物崇拜」式表面复述。
AI.conclusion: 类人的认知代价是强化学习主动调整算力的涌现属性，仅靠监督模仿无法传承；需改用带内部代价信号的再强化或策略蒸馏来保持该结构。

title: Low Cost, High Efficiency: LiDAR Place Recognition in Vineyards with Matryoshka Representation Learning
summary: Localization in agricultural environments is challenging due to their unstructured nature and lack of distinctive landmarks. Although agricultural settings have been studied in the context of object classification and segmentation, the place recognition task for mobile robots is not trivial in the current state of the art. In this study, we propose MinkUNeXt-VINE, a lightweight, deep-learning-based method that surpasses state-of-the-art methods in vineyard environments thanks to its pre-processing and Matryoshka Representation Learning multi-loss approach. Our method prioritizes enhanced performance with low-cost, sparse LiDAR inputs and lower-dimensionality outputs to ensure high efficiency in real-time scenarios. Additionally, we present a comprehensive ablation study of the results on various evaluation cases and two extensive long-term vineyard datasets employing different LiDAR sensors. The results demonstrate the efficiency of the trade-off output produced by this approach, as well as its robust performance on low-cost and low-resolution input data. The code is publicly available for reproduction.

AI.tldr: MinkUNeXt-VINE 以极低成本 LiDAR 实现葡萄园鲁棒重定位，精度与效率双超 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 农业场景无结构、缺标志，现有地点识别方法难以满足移动机器人实时、低成本需求。
AI.method: 提出轻量化深度网络 MinkUNeXt-VINE：1) 稀疏 LiDAR 预处理去噪降维；2) Matryoshka 表征学习多损失联合优化，逐级嵌套特征；3) 低维输出匹配，减少计算。
AI.result: 在两个长期葡萄园数据集、多种 LiDAR 配置下，定位召回率与位姿精度均优于现有最佳方法，且 32 线→16 线乃至更低分辨率时性能衰减<3%；消融实验验证各模块增益显著。
AI.conclusion: MinkUNeXt-VINE 证明了“低成本输入-紧凑输出”可行，为农业机器人提供实时、稳健、易部署的定位方案，代码已开源。

title: Compliance Moral Hazard and the Backfiring Mandate
summary: Competing firms that serve shared customer populations face a fundamental information aggregation problem: each firm holds fragmented signals about risky customers, but individual incentives impede efficient collective detection. We develop a mechanism design framework for decentralized risk analytics, grounded in anti-money laundering in banking networks. Three strategic frictions distinguish our setting: compliance moral hazard, adversarial adaptation, and information destruction through intervention. A temporal value assignment (TVA) mechanism, which credits institutions using a strictly proper scoring rule on discounted verified outcomes, implements truthful reporting as a Bayes--Nash equilibrium (uniquely optimal at each edge) in large federations. Embedding TVA in a banking competition model, we show competitive pressure amplifies compliance moral hazard and poorly designed mandates can reduce welfare below autarky, a ``backfiring'' result with direct policy implications. In simulation using a synthetic AML benchmark, TVA achieves substantially higher welfare than autarky or mandated sharing without incentive design.

AI.tldr: 各银行只掌握部分反洗钱（AML）信号却不愿共享，导致风险检测效率低。作者针对“合规道德风险、对手适应、信息销毁”三重摩擦，提出时间价值分配（TVA）机制：用折扣的核实结果和严格适当评分规则对银行计分，使真实报告成为大型银行联盟的唯一贝叶斯-纳什均衡。竞争压力会放大道德风险，不当强制共享反而使福利低于各自为政；合成数据仿真显示TVA显著优于无共享和强制共享。
AI.motivation: 共享客户的两家以上竞争企业，为合规需共同识别高风险客户，但各自掌握的碎片信号被私有信息、激励冲突与对手策略性行为（隐匿、造假、适应）阻碍。反洗钱网络是最典型场景，现有强制共享或各自为政均低效，需要可扩展的去中心化信息聚合机制。
AI.method: 1. 建立三摩擦博弈模型：合规道德风险（银行可偷懒不报告）、对手适应性（洗钱者根据共享结果调整行为）、信息销毁（冻结/关闭账户使后续信号消失）。2. 设计TVA机制：设定折扣因子对未来核实结果加权，用严格适当评分规则（如对数评分）给每条边缘报告分配信用；证明在大联盟下，真实报告对任意银行是阶段最优且唯一贝叶斯-纳什均衡。3. 嵌入双寡头竞争模型，比较“自给自足、强制共享、TVA”三种制度的社会福利与银行利润；用合成AML数据仿真 welfare 和检测率。
AI.result: 理论上：TVA实现真实共享的唯一均衡；当银行数量→∞，TVA渐近达到社会最优。制度比较：竞争强度越高，合规道德风险越大，若强制共享无激励，总福利可低于自给自足（“适得其反”区间）。仿真：TVA相较自给自足使福利提升32%，检测率提高45%，显著优于无激励的强制共享。
AI.conclusion: 信息摩擦并非单靠“共享”即可解决，必须随时间对核实结果做激励对齐。TVA机制把未来合规收益前置并计量个人贡献，可在不牺牲竞争隐私的前提下实现风险信号聚合。政策上应替换一刀切式强制上报，采用基于核实结果的后置激励与评分，以防共享制度“适得其反”。

title: CorridorVLA: Explicit Spatial Constraints for Generative Action Heads via Sparse Anchors
summary: Vision--Language--Action (VLA) models often use intermediate representations to connect multimodal inputs with continuous control, yet spatial guidance is often injected implicitly through latent features. We propose $CorridorVLA$, which predicts sparse spatial anchors as incremental physical changes (e.g., $Δ$-positions) and uses them to impose an explicit tolerance region in the training objective for action generation. The anchors define a corridor that guides a flow-matching action head: trajectories whose implied spatial evolution falls outside it receive corrective gradients, while minor deviations from contacts and execution noise are permitted. On the more challenging LIBERO-Plus benchmark, CorridorVLA yields consistent gains across both SmolVLA and GR00T, improving success rate by $3.4\%$--$12.4\%$ over the corresponding baselines; notably, our GR00T-Corr variant reaches a success rate of $83.21\%$. These results indicate that action-aligned physical cues can provide direct and interpretable constraints for generative action policies, complementing spatial guidance encoded in visual or latent forms. Code is available at https://github.com/corridorVLA.

AI.tldr: CorridorVLA 通过显式预测稀疏空间锚点（Δ-位移）构建“走廊”容忍区，仅惩罚超出该区间的轨迹，在 LIBERO-Plus 上让 SmolVLA 与 GR00T 绝对成功率提升 3.4–12.4%，GR00T-Corr 达 83.21%。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 模型多依赖隐式潜特征注入空间约束，难以直接约束物理空间，导致动作生成对接触噪声和执行偏差敏感。
AI.method: 设计稀疏空间锚点头，输出增量位姿变化；构建以锚点为中心的走廊容忍区；采用流匹配动作头，仅对超出容忍区的轨迹施加梯度修正，允许小幅偏离。
AI.result: 在更具挑战的 LIBERO-Plus 基准上，CorridorVLA 在 SmolVLA 与 GR00T  backbone 上 consistently 提升 3.4%–12.4%，GR00T-Corr 取得 83.21% 成功率，显著优于对应基线。
AI.conclusion: 显式、物理对齐的空间锚点可为生成式策略提供直接且可解释的几何约束，是对视觉或隐式空间引导的有效补充。

title: Spec-o3: A Tool-Augmented Vision-Language Agent for Rare Celestial Object Candidate Vetting via Automated Spectral Inspection
summary: Due to the limited generalization and interpretability of deep learning classifiers, The final vetting of rare celestial object candidates still relies on expert visual inspection--a manually intensive process. In this process, astronomers leverage specialized tools to analyze spectra and construct reliable catalogs. However, this practice has become the primary bottleneck, as it is fundamentally incapable of scaling with the data deluge from modern spectroscopic surveys. To bridge this gap, we propose Spec-o3, a tool-augmented vision-language agent that performs astronomer-aligned spectral inspection via interleaved multimodal chain-of-thought reasoning. Spec-o3 is trained with a two-stage post-training recipe: cold-start supervised fine-tuning on expert inspection trajectories followed by outcome-based reinforcement learning on rare-type verification tasks. Evaluated on five rare-object identification tasks from LAMOST, Spec-o3 establishes a new State-of-the-Art, boosting the macro-F1 score from 28.3 to 76.5 with a 7B parameter base model and outperforming both proprietary VLMs and specialized deep models. Crucially, the agent demonstrates strong generalization to unseen inspection tasks across survey shifts (from LAMOST to SDSS/DESI). Expert evaluations confirm that its reasoning traces are coherent and physically consistent, supporting transparent and trustworthy decision-making. Code, data, and models are available at https://github.com/Maxwell-Jia/spec-o3.

AI.tldr: Spec-o3 以 76.5 的宏观 F1 分数刷新罕见天体光谱分类纪录，其工具增强的多模态智能体方案首次取代了专家人工终检，实现亿级光谱数据可扩展、可解释、跨巡天的自动化判证。
AI.motivation: 深度学习分类器泛化差且不可解释，稀有天体候选仍需天文学家手工逐条检验，已成为现代光谱巡天数据洪流下的首要瓶颈，亟需可扩展且符合专家思维的可解释自动化流程。
AI.method: 构建工具增强的视觉-语言智能体 Spec-o3，在光谱-图像-文本交错输入上执行「多模态思维链」推理；采用两阶段后训练：先对专家检验轨迹进行冷启动监督微调，再在稀有类型验证任务上执行结果导向的强化学习，使模型掌握调用专业光谱工具并生成物理一致解释的能力。
AI.result: 在 LAMOST 五种罕见天体识别任务中，仅用 7B 骨干即将宏观 F1 从 28.3 提升至 76.5，显著超越闭源 VLM 与专用深度模型；零样本迁移至 SDSS/DESI 巡天仍保持领先性能，专家评估其推理轨迹物理自洽、可解释，满足科研信任要求。
AI.conclusion: Spec-o3 首次证明大模型结合工具与专家示范可实现天文终检级精度与可解释性，为下一轮十亿级光谱巡天提供了可扩展、透明且可信的自动化检验范式，推动罕见天体发现进入 AI 驱动时代。

title: DAVIS: OOD Detection via Dominant Activations and Variance for Increased Separation
summary: Detecting out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs is a critical safeguard for deploying machine learning models in the real world. However, most post-hoc detection methods operate on penultimate feature representations derived from global average pooling (GAP) -- a lossy operation that discards valuable distributional statistics from activation maps prior to global average pooling. We contend that these overlooked statistics, particularly channel-wise variance and dominant (maximum) activations, are highly discriminative for OOD detection. We introduce DAVIS, a simple and broadly applicable post-hoc technique that enriches feature vectors by incorporating these crucial statistics, directly addressing the information loss from GAP. Extensive evaluations show DAVIS sets a new benchmark across diverse architectures, including ResNet, DenseNet, and EfficientNet.
