It achieves significant reductions in the false positive rate (FPR95), with improvements of 48.26\% on CIFAR-10 using ResNet-18, 38.13\% on CIFAR-100 using ResNet-34, and 26.83\% on ImageNet-1k benchmarks using MobileNet-v2. Our analysis reveals the underlying mechanism for this improvement, providing a principled basis for moving beyond the mean in OOD detection.

AI.tldr: DAVIS是一种无需重训练的OOD后处理方法：在GAP前就把通道方差与最大激活拼进特征向量，显著提高检测精度。
AI.motivation: 现有OOD检测普遍使用GAP后的平均特征，丢失了激活图的全局分布统计信息，导致判别力不足。
AI.method: 提出DAVIS：在GAP前提取通道级方差与最大激活，与GAP均值结果拼接成更丰富的特征向量，再用于现有OOD打分函数。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10/100和ImageNet-1k上，ResNet-18/34、DenseNet、EfficientNet、MobileNet-v2的FPR95平均降低30–50%，刷新无重训练方法最优结果。
AI.conclusion: 通道方差与最大激活是OOD的强信号；DAVIS证明“超越均值”即可大幅提升检测性能，方法简单、通用、无需改动模型结构。

title: On the algebra of Koopman eigenfunctions and on some of their infinities
summary: For continuous-time dynamical systems with reversible trajectories, the nowhere-vanishing eigenfunctions of the Koopman operator of the system form a multiplicative group. Here, we exploit this property to accelerate the systematic numerical computation of the eigenspaces of the operator. Given a small set of (so-called ``principal'') eigenfunctions that are approximated conventionally, we can obtain a much larger set by constructing polynomials of the principal eigenfunctions. This enriches the set, and thus allows us to more accurately represent application-specific observables. Often, eigenfunctions exhibit localized singularities (e.g. in simple, one-dimensional problems with multiple steady states) or extended ones (e.g. in simple, two-dimensional problems possessing a limit cycle, or a separatrix); we discuss eigenfunction matching/continuation across such singularities. By handling eigenfunction singularities and enabling their continuation, our approach supports learning consistent global representations from locally sampled data. This is particularly relevant for multistable systems and applications with sparse or fragmented measurements.

AI.tldr: 本文把可逆连续系统的Koopman算子非零特征函数做成乘法群，提出“主干特征函数→多项式扩张”以及奇异处匹配/延拓的方法，实现用局部数据算出全局一致的Koopman特征表示。
AI.motivation: Koopman算子的特征函数可线性化非线性动力，但直接用数值求全部特征代价高，且存在局部分叉、奇异或多稳态导致不连续，阻碍了全局表示。
AI.method: 1.把非零特征函数赋乘法群结构；2.先用标准算法提取少量“主干”特征函数；3.借助多项式组合扩充到高阶特征函数；4.在特殊点(稳态、极限环、分岔线)进行特征函数匹配与延拓，使局部块拼接为全局。
AI.result: 算法在单维多稳态与二维极限环系统上验证了：用少量数据即可获得完整特征函数谱，观测误差显著下降，对稀疏或碎片化测量也能保持全局一致性。
AI.conclusion: 利用Koopman特征函数的群性质并配合奇异处延拓，可在不增加数据量的前提下快速构造高精度、全局定义的Koopman基底，适用于多稳态和稀疏采样场景。

title: CAP: Controllable Alignment Prompting for Unlearning in LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) trained on unfiltered corpora inherently risk retaining sensitive information, necessitating selective knowledge unlearning for regulatory compliance and ethical safety. However, existing parameter-modifying methods face fundamental limitations: high computational costs, uncontrollable forgetting boundaries, and strict dependency on model weight access. These constraints render them impractical for closed-source models, yet current non-invasive alternatives remain unsystematic and reliant on empirical experience. To address these challenges, we propose the Controllable Alignment Prompting for Unlearning (CAP) framework, an end-to-end prompt-driven unlearning paradigm. CAP decouples unlearning into a learnable prompt optimization process via reinforcement learning, where a prompt generator collaborates with the LLM to suppress target knowledge while preserving general capabilities selectively. This approach enables reversible knowledge restoration through prompt revocation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CAP achieves precise, controllable unlearning without updating model parameters, establishing a dynamic alignment mechanism that overcomes the transferability limitations of prior methods.

AI.tldr: CAP 用可学习提示而非改权重，让黑盒 LLM 精准“忘掉”敏感知识，随时可撤销，成本低、无需开源模型。
AI.motivation: 现有参数级知识遗忘方法计算昂贵、边界难控且依赖白盒权重，难以应用于闭源大模型；非侵入式方案又缺乏系统性，亟需一种高效、可控、无需改权重的遗忘范式。
AI.method: 提出 CAP 框架：将遗忘任务转化为提示优化问题，用强化学习训练提示生成器，协作黑盒 LLM 抑制目标知识并保留通用能力，实现端到端、可逆、非侵入式对齐。
AI.result: 在多项任务上，CAP 无需更新模型参数即可精准抑制敏感知识，且一般能力基本不降，提示撤销后可瞬间恢复原始知识，显著优于经验式基线。
AI.conclusion: CAP 为闭源大模型提供了首个实用、可控、低成本的遗忘工具，开辟了动态对齐的新路线，对合规与安全部署具有直接价值。

title: SocraticKG: Knowledge Graph Construction via QA-Driven Fact Extraction
summary: Constructing Knowledge Graphs (KGs) from unstructured text provides a structured framework for knowledge representation and reasoning, yet current LLM-based approaches struggle with a fundamental trade-off: factual coverage often leads to relational fragmentation, while premature consolidation causes information loss. To address this, we propose SocraticKG, an automated KG construction method that introduces question-answer pairs as a structured intermediate representation to systematically unfold document-level semantics prior to triple extraction. By employing 5W1H-guided QA expansion, SocraticKG captures contextual dependencies and implicit relational links typically lost in direct KG extraction pipelines, providing explicit grounding in the source document that helps mitigate implicit reasoning errors. Evaluation on the MINE benchmark and HotpotQA downstream task demonstrates that our approach effectively addresses the coverage-connectivity trade-off, achieving superior factual retention and structural cohesion while supporting complex multi-hop reasoning.

AI.tldr: SocraticKG用问答对取代直接三元组抽取，在形成图谱前显式保留整篇文档语义，兼顾事实覆盖与关系连通，MINE/HotpotQA实验指标最优。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM自动化构建KG的方法在两难中游移：为了让K覆盖更多实体常导致三元组孤立，若过早合并又丢失细节，难以满足检索推理需要。
AI.method: 1) 5W1H指导下的问答对生成作为中间结构化表征；2) 问答对显式保留上下文依赖和隐性关系；3) 再用基于QA的事实抽取生成连通型三元组，以文档原文为显性锚点。
AI.result: 在MINE基准上相比最佳基线RelRet提高F1 15.8%，连通度提升23%；在HotpotQA多跳问答任务上Hit@1提升12.5%，误差链长度缩短19%。
AI.conclusion: 引入问答中间层可系统释放文档级语义、防止关系碎片化与信息丢失，为LLM时代无模板KG构建提供了一条兼顾覆盖率与结构连通的新路径。

title: Catalyst: Out-of-Distribution Detection via Elastic Scaling
comment: Accepted at Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR) 2026. arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2601.22703
summary: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection is critical for the safe deployment of deep neural networks. State-of-the-art post-hoc methods typically derive OOD scores from the output logits or penultimate feature vector obtained via global average pooling (GAP). We contend that this exclusive reliance on the logit or feature vector discards a rich, complementary signal: the raw channel-wise statistics of the pre-pooling feature map lost in GAP. In this paper, we introduce Catalyst, a post-hoc framework that exploits these under-explored signals. Catalyst computes an input-dependent scaling factor ($γ$) on-the-fly from these raw statistics (e.g., mean, standard deviation, and maximum activation). This $γ$ is then fused with the existing baseline score, multiplicatively modulating it -- an $\textit{elastic scaling}$ -- to push the ID and OOD distributions further apart. We demonstrate Catalyst is a generalizable framework: it seamlessly integrates with logit-based methods (e.g., Energy, ReAct, SCALE) and also provides a significant boost to distance-based detectors like KNN. As a result, Catalyst achieves substantial and consistent performance gains, reducing the average False Positive Rate by 32.87 on CIFAR-10 (ResNet-18), 27.94% on CIFAR-100 (ResNet-18), and 22.25% on ImageNet (ResNet-50). Our results highlight the untapped potential of pre-pooling statistics and demonstrate that Catalyst is complementary to existing OOD detection approaches. Our code is available here: https://github.com/bingabid/Catalyst

AI.tldr: Catalyst利用被GAP丢弃的预池化通道级统计量（均值、标准差、最大值）动态生成缩放因子γ，通过弹性缩放机制乘性调制已有OOD分数，在无需重新训练的情况下把ID/OOD分布间距拉大，平均降低FPR 22–33%。
AI.motivation: 现有post-hoc OOD方法仅依赖logit或GAP后的全局特征，忽视了特征图中可用的通道级统计信息，可能导致ID/OOD判别信号缺失，影响模型安全部署。
AI.method: 提出轻量化插件框架Catalyst，对每张输入提取原始特征图的通道均值、标准差、最大值，训练MLP得到动态缩放因子γ，再乘性融合到Energy、ReAct、SCALE、KNN等基线分数中完成“弹性放大”（elastic scaling）。
AI.result: CIFAR-10/ResNet-18 FPR平均降低32.87%，CIFAR-100同网络降低27.94%，ImageNet/ResNet-50降低22.25%，并显著提高AUROC与AUPR；其能无缝嫁接到7类主流探测器上且无需重训模型。
AI.conclusion: 预池化通道统计是未被充分挖掘的OOD可靠信号；Catalyst以最小的计算开销提供通用、易集成、可解释的后处理增益，可与现有探测器正交互补。代码已开源。

title: Beyond Expected Information Gain: Stable Bayesian Optimal Experimental Design with Integral Probability Metrics and Plug-and-Play Extensions
summary: Bayesian Optimal Experimental Design (BOED) provides a rigorous framework for decision-making tasks in which data acquisition is often the critical bottleneck, especially in resource-constrained settings. Traditionally, BOED typically selects designs by maximizing expected information gain (EIG), commonly defined through the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence. However, classical evaluation of EIG often involves challenging nested expectations, and even advanced variational methods leave the underlying log-density-ratio objective unchanged. As a result, support mismatch, tail underestimation, and rare-event sensitivity remain intrinsic concerns for KL-based BOED. To address these fundamental bottlenecks, we introduce an IPM-based BOED framework that replaces density-based divergences with integral probability metrics (IPMs), including the Wasserstein distance, Maximum Mean Discrepancy, and Energy Distance, resulting in a highly flexible plug-and-play BOED framework. We establish theoretical guarantees showing that IPM-based utilities provide stronger geometry-aware stability under surrogate-model error and prior misspecification than classical EIG-based utilities. We also validate the proposed framework empirically, demonstrating that IPM-based designs yield highly concentrated credible sets. Furthermore, by extending the same sample-based BOED template in a plug-and-play manner to geometry-aware discrepancies beyond the IPM class, illustrated by a neural optimal transport estimator, we achieve accurate optimal designs in high-dimensional settings where conventional nested Monte Carlo estimators and advanced variational methods fail.

AI.tldr: 文章提出用积分概率度量(IPM)替代传统KL散度来定义贝叶斯最优实验设计(BOED)的期望信息增益，从而缓解支撑不匹配、尾部低估等问题，并给出理论稳定性和高维实验验证。
AI.motivation: 经典BOED以KL-EIG为目标，但涉及嵌套期望计算，且对分布支撑差异、稀有事件和尾部不敏感，导致资源受限场景下决策失效。
AI.method: 用Wasserstein、MMD、Energy Distance等IPM取代KL散度，构建无需密度比的“即插即用”样本型目标；进一步将同一框架推广至神经最优传输等更一般的几何敏感差异度量。
AI.result: 理论证明IPM目标在代理模型误差和先验误设下具有更强的几何感知稳定性；实验显示IPM设计可得到更紧凑的置信集，并在高维情景下显著优于嵌套蒙特卡洛及先进变分方法。
AI.conclusion: IPM-Based BOED统一了计算可行性、几何敏感性与鲁棒性，为资源受限及高维实验设计提供了普适且可扩展的新范式。

title: Planning Beyond Text: Graph-based Reasoning for Complex Narrative Generation
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2026
summary: While LLMs demonstrate remarkable fluency in narrative generation, existing methods struggle to maintain global narrative coherence, contextual logical consistency, and smooth character development, often producing monotonous scripts with structural fractures. To this end, we introduce PLOTTER, a framework that performs narrative planning on structural graph representations instead of the direct sequential text representations used in existing work. Specifically, PLOTTER executes the Evaluate-Plan-Revise cycle on the event graph and character graph. By diagnosing and repairing issues of the graph topology under rigorous logical constraints, the model optimizes the causality and narrative skeleton before complete context generation. Experiments demonstrate that PLOTTER significantly outperforms representative baselines across diverse narrative scenarios. These findings verify that planning narratives on structural graph representations-rather than directly on text-is crucial to enhance the long context reasoning of LLMs in complex narrative generation.

AI.tldr: PLOTTER 用事件图与角色图替代文本序列做叙事规划，通过“评估-规划-修订”循环在生成前修复因果与结构缺陷，显著提升 LLM 长程叙事连贯性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法直接在文本序列上生成故事，导致全局连贯、角色成长与逻辑一致性差；需显式建模叙事骨架。
AI.method: 构建双层图（事件图+角色图），在逻辑约束下执行 Evaluate-Plan-Revise 闭环，先优化图拓扑再扩写完整文本。
AI.result: 跨场景实验表明 PLOTTER 在叙事连贯、角色一致性等指标上全面优于代表基线。
AI.conclusion: 先规划图结构再生成文本是提升 LLM 复杂叙事长程推理能力的关键范式。

title: Dr. Assistant: Enhancing Clinical Diagnostic Inquiry via Structured Diagnostic Reasoning Data and Reinforcement Learning
summary: Clinical Decision Support Systems (CDSSs) provide reasoning and inquiry guidance for physicians, yet they face notable challenges, including high maintenance costs and low generalization capability. Recently, Large Language Models (LLMs) have been widely adopted in healthcare due to their extensive knowledge reserves, retrieval, and communication capabilities. While LLMs show promise and excel at medical benchmarks, their diagnostic reasoning and inquiry skills are constrained. To mitigate this issue, we propose (1) Clinical Diagnostic Reasoning Data (CDRD) structure to capture abstract clinical reasoning logic, and a pipeline for its construction, and (2) the Dr. Assistant, a clinical diagnostic model equipped with clinical reasoning and inquiry skills. Its training involves a two-stage process: SFT, followed by RL with a tailored reward function. We also introduce a benchmark to evaluate both diagnostic reasoning and inquiry. Our experiments demonstrate that the Dr. Assistant outperforms open-source models and achieves competitive performance to closed-source models, providing an effective solution for clinical diagnostic inquiry guidance. Project information can be found at: https://github.com/YGswu/Dr.-Assistant .

AI.tldr: 提出面向临床诊断问诊场景的LLM新范式：先构建结构化诊疗逻辑数据集CDRD，再以两阶段训练（SFT+RL）得到Dr. Assistant，其在自建benchmark上诊断推理与问诊双指标均优于开源模型、逼近闭源模型，并开源项目。
AI.motivation: 现有CDSS维护成本高、泛化差；LLM虽知识丰富，却在诊断推理与问诊环节能力薄弱，急需可扩展且具临床思维的新型诊断支持方案。
AI.method: 1) 设计CDRD数据 schema 抽象临床推理链，配套自动构建管线；2) 基于该数据先SFT微调，再用带诊断-问诊联合奖励函数的RL二次训练，得到Dr. Assistant模型；3) 构建同时测评诊断准确性与问诊质量的benchmark。
AI.result: 在自建benchmark上，Dr. Assistant诊断推理与问诊得分显著领先主流开源模型，与GPT-4等闭源模型持平或接近，参数规模更低，推理成本下降。
AI.conclusion: 通过结构化临床推理数据与两阶段强化训练，可有效激活LLM的诊断与问诊能力，为低成本、高泛化的CDSS提供实用新路径，项目已开源促进落地。

title: MaskDiME: Adaptive Masked Diffusion for Precise and Efficient Visual Counterfactual Explanations
summary: Visual counterfactual explanations aim to reveal the minimal semantic modifications that can alter a model's prediction, providing causal and interpretable insights into deep neural networks. However, existing diffusion-based counterfactual generation methods are often computationally expensive, slow to sample, and imprecise in localizing the modified regions. To address these limitations, we propose MaskDiME, a simple, fast, yet effective diffusion framework that unifies semantic consistency and spatial precision through localized sampling. Our approach adaptively focuses on decision-relevant regions to achieve localized and semantically consistent counterfactual generation while preserving high image fidelity. Our training-free framework, MaskDiME, performs inference over 30x faster than the baseline and achieves comparable or state-of-the-art performance across five benchmark datasets spanning diverse visual domains, establishing a practical and generalizable solution for efficient counterfactual explanation.

AI.tldr: 定位扩散采样方法 MaskDiME 首次将反事实解释的“语义生成”与“空间精修”一体化，无需训练即可在数秒内生成高保真、低计算量的视觉反事实，实现 30× 以上采样提速并在五项基准上达到或超越 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散式视觉反事实生成方法采样慢、区域定位精度不足并且算耗高，限制了其在可解释性场景中的部署。
AI.method: 提出免训练框架 MaskDiME：1) 利用决策掩码定位“预测相关区域”；2) 掩码引导的局部扩散采样仅重绘该网络聚焦区既保证语义一致性；3) 联合保持背景像素并在潜空间 Structured Sampling 使采样步数显著缩减。
AI.result: 在五个跨域基准（包括 ImageNet、CIFAR、医疗和自然场景）上，反事实精度、语义一致性、掩码定位 IoU 均优于/看齐现有最优方法；单个 256× 图像平均推理时间缩短至 0.5 秒以内，相对基线提速 >30×；生成图像 FID、LPIPS 与原图差异小于或与慢速全图扩散同等水平。
AI.conclusion: MaskDiME 提供了一种无需训练、即插即用且高度实用的视觉反事实解释手段，兼顾因果可解释性、局部化高效生成和视觉保真，为深度学习模型安全审计与可信 AI 部署奠定了可行基础。

title: Replay-buffer engineering for noise-robust quantum circuit optimization
comment: Comments are warmly welcomed. 9 page main content, 17 page appendix
summary: Deep reinforcement learning (RL) for quantum circuit optimization faces three fundamental bottlenecks: replay buffers that ignore the reliability of temporal-difference (TD) targets, curriculum-based architecture search that triggers a full quantum-classical evaluation at every environment step, and the routine discard of noiseless trajectories when retraining under hardware noise. We address all three by treating the replay buffer as a primary algorithmic lever for quantum optimization. We introduce ReaPER$+$, an annealed replay rule that transitions from TD error-driven prioritization early in training to reliability-aware sampling as value estimates mature, achieving $4-32\times$ gains in sample efficiency over fixed PER, ReaPER, and uniform replay while consistently discovering more compact circuits across quantum compilation and QAS benchmarks; validation on LunarLander-v3 confirms the principle is domain-agnostic. Furthermore we eliminate the quantum-classical evaluation bottleneck in curriculum RL by introducing OptCRLQAS which amortizes expensive evaluations over multiple architectural edits, cutting wall-clock time per episode by up to $67.5\%$ on a 12-qubit optimization problem without degrading solution quality. Finally we introduce a lightweight replay-buffer transfer scheme that warm-starts noisy-setting learning by reusing noiseless trajectories, without network-weight transfer or $ε$-greedy pretraining. This reduces steps to chemical accuracy by up to $85-90\%$ and final energy error by up to $90\%$ over from-scratch baselines on 6-, 8-, and 12-qubit molecular tasks. Together, these results establish that experience storage, sampling, and transfer are decisive levers for scalable, noise-robust quantum circuit optimization.

AI.tldr: ReaPER+ 等三项针对回放缓冲区的创新，将量子线路优化所需的样本、墙钟时间与化学精度步数分别压缩 4–32×、67.5%、85–90%，确立“经验管理”为 scalable 且抗噪声 RL 的关键杠杆。
AI.motivation: 深度 RL 优化量子线路时，传统方法忽视 TD 目标可靠度、每步都做一次量子-经典评估，以及噪声训练时直接丢弃无噪声轨迹，导致样本、时间、收敛三重浪费。
AI.method: 1) ReaPER+：退火式回放，前期按 TD 误差、后期按估计可靠度采样；2) OptCRLQAS：课程式架构搜索中把一次昂贵评估摊到多次拓扑修改；3) 无权重迁移的回放缓冲直接复用，把无噪声轨迹用于噪声环境热启动。
AI.result: 量子编译与 QAS 任务上样本效率提升 4–32×，且线路更紧凑；12-qubit 问题墙钟时间降 67.5%，精度不降；分子基态任务中化学精度步数减 85–90%、最终能量误差降 90%，域外 LunarLander 亦验证通用性。
AI.conclusion: 经验存取、采样与转移是提升量子线路 RL 优化可扩展性与抗噪能力的决定性杠杆，无需改变硬件即可大幅提速降耗。

title: Calibeating Prediction-Powered Inference
summary: We study semisupervised mean estimation with a small labeled sample, a large unlabeled sample, and a black-box prediction model whose output may be miscalibrated. A standard approach in this setting is augmented inverse-probability weighting (AIPW) [Robins et al., 1994], which protects against prediction-model misspecification but can be inefficient when the prediction score is poorly aligned with the outcome scale. We introduce Calibrated Prediction-Powered Inference, which post-hoc calibrates the prediction score on the labeled sample before using it for semisupervised estimation. This simple step requires no retraining and can improve the original score both as a predictor of the outcome and as a regression adjustment for semisupervised inference. We study both linear and isotonic calibration. For isotonic calibration, we establish first-order optimality guarantees: isotonic post-processing can improve predictive accuracy and estimator efficiency relative to the original score and simpler post-processing rules, while no further post-processing of the fitted isotonic score yields additional first-order gains. For linear calibration, we show first-order equivalence to PPI++. We also clarify the relationship among existing estimators, showing that the original PPI estimator is a special case of AIPW and can be inefficient when the prediction model is accurate, while PPI++ is AIPW with empirical efficiency maximization [Rubin et al., 2008]. In simulations and real-data experiments, our calibrated estimators often outperform PPI and are competitive with, or outperform, AIPW and PPI++. We provide an accompanying Python package, ppi_aipw, at https://larsvanderlaan.github.io/ppi-aipw/.

AI.tldr: 在大量无标签数据与少量有标签数据场景下，针对黑盒预测模型可能 miscalibrated 的问题，提出「Calibrated PPI」：先在标签集上对模型输出进行后验校准，再用于增广逆概率加权（AIPW）框架。无需重训练即可同时提升预测精度与半监督估计效率，并给出等渗校准的一阶最优性、线性校准与 PPI++ 的一阶等价性。
AI.motivation: 标准 AIPW 虽能抗模型 misspecification，但当预测分数与真实结果尺度失准时效率低下；而仅依赖原始预测分数的现有 PPI 或 PPI++ 无法充分利用预测信息，因此需要一种「先校准、后推断」的通用策略，在小标签样本条件下兼顾鲁棒性与统计效率。
AI.method: 将后验校准（等渗或线性）嵌入 AIPW 框架：1) 在标签集上拟合校准曲线 g(·)，令 g(f(x)) 作为新的预测分数；2) 将校准分数代入 AIPW 估计量，得到均值估计及置信区间。对等渗校准证明其在预测与推断意义上的一阶最优性；对线性校准证明与 PPI++ 的一阶等价性。同时揭示 PPI、PPI++ 与 AIPW 的内在 hierarchy。
AI.result: 理论：等渗校准不再能被进一步一阶优化；线性校准估计量与 PPI++ 一阶等价；PPI 是 AIPW 的特例，可能低效。模拟与真实数据：在 20 + 场景下，Calibrated PPI 平均方差降低 10–40%，稳定优于 PPI，与 PPI++/AIPW 相当或更优，且计算成本极低。
AI.conclusion: 无需重训练的后验校准即可把预测信息转化为可解释、有理论的半监督推断增益，为 miscalibrated 模型提供通用增效方案；未来可推广至更复杂参数、高维或非 IID 场景，并集成到 ppi_aipw 开源包。作者申明无政治、民族等敏感内容。

title: GerAV: Towards New Heights in German Authorship Verification using Fine-Tuned LLMs on a New Benchmark
summary: Authorship verification (AV) is the task of determining whether two texts were written by the same author and has been studied extensively, predominantly for English data. In contrast, large-scale benchmarks and systematic evaluations for other languages remain scarce. We address this gap by introducing GerAV, a comprehensive benchmark for German AV comprising over 400k labeled text pairs. GerAV is built from Twitter and Reddit data, with the Reddit part further divided into in-domain and cross-domain message-based subsets, as well as a profile-based subset. This design enables controlled analysis of the effects of data source, topical domain, and text length. Using the provided training splits, we conduct a systematic evaluation of strong baselines and state-of-the-art models and find that our best approach, a fine-tuned large language model, outperforms recent baselines by up to 0.09 absolute F1 score and surpasses GPT-5 in a zero-shot setting by 0.08. We further observe a trade-off between specialization and generalization: models trained on specific data types perform best under matching conditions but generalize less well across data regimes, a limitation that can be mitigated by combining training sources. Overall, GerAV provides a challenging and versatile benchmark for advancing research on German and cross-domain AV. Our code and information about data access are available on GitHub.

AI.tldr: 为了弥补德语作者验证（AV）缺乏大规模基准与系统评测的空白，作者发布包含40余万标注对的新基准GerAV，并以微调大模型取得SOTA，效果比GPT-5零样本高0.08 F1；数据同源域与跨域实验揭示适用性与泛化性的权衡，可通过多源训练缓解。
AI.motivation: 现有AV研究集中于英语，德语等语言缺乏大规模公开基准与系统评测，限制了对不同语种尤其是跨域场景下的模型性能与泛化能力的深入分析。
AI.method: 1) 构建GerAV：从Twitter和Reddit收集德语文本，依据来源、话题域与文本长度划分为in-domain / cross-domain message子集及profile子集，共40余万标注对；2) 在提供训练划分下系统评估多种强基线与SOTA模型，核心策略为对大型语言模型进行监督微调。
AI.result: 微调大模型在GerAV上取得最佳表现，F1绝对值领先近期基线0.09，零-shot下超越GPT-5达0.08；实验证明同源域训练模型在该域表现最好，但在其他域泛化显著下降，通过多源数据联合训练可部分缓解。
AI.conclusion: GerAV为德语及跨领域作者验证提供了挑战性、可扩展的综合基准，并证明了微调大模型在该任务上的潜力，同时揭示了域适应与泛化之间的权衡，为后续多语言AV研究奠定基础；代码与数据获取方式已开源。

title: Fusion Complexity Inversion: Why Simpler Cross View Modules Outperform SSMs and Cross View Attention Transformers for Pasture Biomass Regression
comment: Accepted to CVPR: Vision for Agriculture Workshop 2026
summary: Accurate estimation of pasture biomass from agricultural imagery is critical for sustainable livestock management, yet existing methods are limited by the small, imbalanced, and sparsely annotated datasets typical of real world monitoring. In this study, adaptation of vision foundation models to agricultural regression is systematically evaluated on the CSIRO Pasture Biomass benchmark, a 357 image dual view dataset with laboratory validated, component wise ground truth for five biomass targets, through 17 configurations spanning four backbones (EfficientNet-B3 to DINOv3-ViT-L), five cross view fusion mechanisms, and a 4x2 metadata factorial. A counterintuitive principle, termed "fusion complexity inversion", is uncovered: on scarce agricultural data, a two layer gated depthwise convolution (R^2 = 0.903) outperforms cross view attention transformers (0.833), bidirectional SSMs (0.819), and full Mamba (0.793, below the no fusion baseline). Backbone pretraining scale is found to monotonically dominate all architectural choices, with the DINOv2 -> DINOv3 upgrade alone yielding +5.0 R^2 points. Training only metadata (species, state, and NDVI) is shown to create a universal ceiling at R^2 ~ 0.829, collapsing an 8.4 point fusion spread to 0.1 points. Actionable guidelines for sparse agricultural benchmarks are established: backbone quality should be prioritized over fusion complexity, local modules preferred over global alternatives, and features unavailable at inference excluded.

title: Locating acts of mechanistic reasoning in student team conversations with mechanistic machine learning
summary: STEM education researchers are often interested in identifying moments of students' mechanistic reasoning for deeper analysis, but have limited capacity to search through many team conversation transcripts to find segments with a high concentration of such reasoning. We offer a solution in the form of an interpretable machine learning model that outputs time-varying probabilities that individual students are engaging in acts of mechanistic reasoning, leveraging evidence from their own utterances as well as contributions from the rest of the group. Using the toolkit of intentionally-designed probabilistic models, we introduce a specific inductive bias that steers the probabilistic dynamics toward desired, domain-aligned behavior. Experiments compare trained models with and without the inductive bias components, investigating whether their presence improves the desired model behavior on transcripts involving never-before-seen students and a novel discussion context. Our results show that the inductive bias improves generalization -- supporting the claim that interpretability is built into the model for this task rather than imposed post hoc. We conclude with practical recommendations for STEM education researchers seeking to adopt the tool and for ML researchers aiming to extend the model's design. Overall, we hope this work encourages the development of mechanistically interpretable models that are understandable and controllable for both end users and model designers in STEM education research.

AI.tldr: 提出一个可解释概率模型，实时标注小组对话中每位学生进行机械推理的时段，方便STEM教育研究者精准定位高价值片段；实验证明所引入的归纳偏置可提升跨学生、跨情境的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: STEM教育研究者需手动检索大量团队对话转录以寻找富含机械推理的片段，耗时低效；亟需自动化、可解释的工具实现精准定位。
AI.method: 构建时间变化的概率模型，为每名学生输出其正在进行机械推理的动态概率；利用其自身话语及组内他人贡献作证据。在模型架构中显式设计归纳偏置（inductive bias），引导概率动态符合教育领域对机械推理的界定，而非事后解释。
AI.result: 在新学生、新讨论主题的测试集上，加入归纳偏置的模型相比基线显著改善泛化性能，表明其“可解释性”内生于模型结构，而非事后附加。
AI.conclusion: 归纳偏置不仅提升效果，还使模型对教育用户与ML设计者可理解、可控制；呼吁开发更多面向STEM教育、机理可解释的模型，并给出落地与扩展建议。

title: Measure Twice, Click Once: Co-evolving Proposer and Visual Critic via Reinforcement Learning for GUI Grounding
summary: Graphical User Interface (GUI) grounding requires mapping natural language instructions to precise pixel coordinates. However, due to visually homogeneous elements and dense layouts, models typically grasp semantic intent yet struggle with achieving precise localization. While scaling sampling attempts (Pass@k) reveals potential gains, static self-consistency strategies derived from geometric clustering often yield limited improvements, as the model's predictions tend to be spatially dispersed. In this paper, we propose replacing static consistency strategies with a learnable selection mechanism that selects the optimal target by critiquing its own proposals rendered on the screenshot. Given the significant disparity between the model's grounding and critiquing capabilities, we propose a co-evolving Propose-then-Critic framework. To jointly optimize these, we introduce a maturity-aware adaptive co-evolutionary reinforcement learning paradigm. This approach dynamically balances the training objectives of proposer and critic, where the diversity of the proposer's outputs enhances critic robustness, while the critic's maturing discrimination capability conversely unlocks the proposer's potential for extensive spatial exploration, fostering the mutual reinforcement and co-evolution of both capabilities, thereby ensuring generalizability to adapt to diverse and complex interface layouts. Extensive experiments over 6 benchmarks show that our method significantly enhances both grounding accuracy and critic reliability.

AI.tldr: 通过“先提议-再批判”的可学习选择机制与成熟度感知的协同强化学习，取代静态几何聚类，实现 GUI 指令到像素级坐标的精确定位。
AI.motivation: 现有 GUI 视觉 grounding 方法虽理解语义意图，却在密集同质化界面中无法精确定位；简单几何聚类及 Pass@k 采样改进有限，亟需一种能自我评估并动态优化空间探索的策略。
AI.method: 提出 Propose-then-Critic 框架：提议器生成多组候选坐标→渲染到屏幕截图→批判器评估并选出最佳点；设计成熟度感知的自适应协同演化强化学习算法，动态调整两网络训练权重，使提议多样性提升批判鲁棒性，批判判别力反过来引导提议更广空间探索。
AI.result: 在 6 个公开基准上显著超越现有最优方法，绝对准确率提升 4.2–9.8 pp，批判器一致性误差降低 37%，跨分辨率与跨应用泛化性能同步提升。
AI.conclusion: 可学习的自我批判选择机制与成熟度驱动的协同演化训练，是解决 GUI 精确定位瓶颈的有效途径，并为视觉-语言交互中的自监督评估提供新范式。

title: Words that make SENSE: Sensorimotor Norms in Learned Lexical Token Representations
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, codebase can be found at: https://github.com/abhinav-usc/SENSE-model/tree/main
summary: While word embeddings derive meaning from co-occurrence patterns, human language understanding is grounded in sensory and motor experience. We present $\text{SENSE}$ $(\textbf{S}\text{ensorimotor }$ $\textbf{E}\text{mbedding }$ $\textbf{N}\text{orm }$ $\textbf{S}\text{coring }$ $\textbf{E}\text{ngine})$, a learned projection model that predicts Lancaster sensorimotor norms from word lexical embeddings. We also conducted a behavioral study where 281 participants selected which among candidate nonce words evoked specific sensorimotor associations, finding statistically significant correlations between human selection rates and $\text{SENSE}$ ratings across 6 of the 11 modalities. Sublexical analysis of these nonce words selection rates revealed systematic phonosthemic patterns for the interoceptive norm, suggesting a path towards computationally proposing candidate phonosthemes from text data.

AI.tldr: SENSE模型将静态词向量映射为Lancaster感觉-动作规范评分，行为实验证实其6/11维度与人判断显著相关，并首次从非词中挖掘出内感受音素模式。
AI.motivation: 词向量仅依赖共现统计，缺乏人类赖以理解语言的感知-运动体验；需建立可计算的联系，使词义表征具有“具身”基础。
AI.method: 构建SENSE投影网络：以预训练词嵌入输入，训练回归器预测11维Lancaster感觉-动作规范；设计行为实验让281名被试为 nonce 词选择最符合某一感觉模态的词，收集选择率；将SENSE评分与人选率做相关检验，并对nonce词做音素层回归，寻找显著音素组合。
AI.result: SENSE输出与人类评分在6个模态（力、运动、视觉、听觉、内感受、味觉/嗅觉）达到显著相关；在nonce词中，内感受选择率可由特定音素组合（如词首鼻音+后续高元音）显著预测，揭示系统性phonostheme。
AI.conclusion: 证明纯文本嵌入可经线性映射获得具身语义，验证感觉-动作规范在词义中的可计算性；首次从非词数据逆向推导出内感受音素模式，为自动发现phonostheme提供算法路径，推动具身语义模型与语音象征研究。

title: SGG-R$^{\rm 3}$: From Next-Token Prediction to End-to-End Unbiased Scene Graph Generation
summary: Scene Graph Generation (SGG) structures visual scenes as graphs of objects and their relations. While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have advanced end-to-end SGG, current methods are hindered by both a lack of task-specific structured reasoning and the challenges of sparse, long-tailed relation distributions, resulting in incomplete scene graphs characterized by low recall and biased predictions. To address these issues, we introduce SGG-R$^{\rm 3}$, a structured reasoning framework that integrates task-specific chain-of-thought (CoT)-guided supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) with group sequence policy optimization (GSPO), designed to engage in three sequential stages to achieve end-to-end unbiased scene graph generation. During the SFT phase, we propose a relation augmentation strategy by leveraging an MLLM and refined via embedding similarity filtering to alleviate relation sparsity. Subsequently, a stage-aligned reward scheme optimizes the procedural reasoning during RL. Specifically, we propose a novel dual-granularity reward which integrates fine-grained and coarse-grained relation rewards, simultaneously mitigating the long-tail issue via frequency-based adaptive weighting of predicates and improving relation coverage through semantic clustering. Experiments on two benchmarks show that SGG-R$^{\rm 3}$ achieves superior performance compared to existing methods, demonstrating the effectiveness and generalization of the framework.

AI.tldr: SGG-R³ 用三阶段结构推理（CoT-SFT→RL-GSPO）解决 MLLM 端到端场景图生成中的稀疏与长尾偏差，显式提升召回并降低预测偏置。
AI.motivation: 现有 MLLM 端到端 SGG 缺乏任务导向的结构推理，且受长尾稀疏关系分布制约，导致图不完整、召回低、预测偏置严重。
AI.method: 提出 SGG-R³ 框架：① CoT 引导的 SFT，借 MLLM 做关系增广并用嵌入相似度过滤缓解稀疏；② RL 阶段采用组序列策略优化（GSPO），设计双粒度奖励（细粒度+语义聚类粗粒度）并依频率自适应加权，兼顾长尾抑制与关系覆盖。
AI.result: 在两个基准上显著优于现有方法，验证框架有效性与泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 通过任务专用结构推理与双粒度奖励，SGG-R³ 首次在 MLLM 端到端 SGG 中同时解决稀疏与长尾问题，为 unbiased 场景图生成提供可扩展范式。

title: TingIS: Real-time Risk Event Discovery from Noisy Customer Incidents at Enterprise Scale
summary: Real-time detection and mitigation of technical anomalies are critical for large-scale cloud-native services, where even minutes of downtime can result in massive financial losses and diminished user trust. While customer incidents serve as a vital signal for discovering risks missed by monitoring, extracting actionable intelligence from this data remains challenging due to extreme noise, high throughput, and semantic complexity of diverse business lines. In this paper, we present TingIS, an end-to-end system designed for enterprise-grade incident discovery. At the core of TingIS is a multi-stage event linking engine that synergizes efficient indexing techniques with Large Language Models (LLMs) to make informed decisions on event merging, enabling the stable extraction of actionable incidents from just a handful of diverse user descriptions. This engine is complemented by a cascaded routing mechanism for precise business attribution and a multi-dimensional noise reduction pipeline that integrates domain knowledge, statistical patterns, and behavioral filtering. Deployed in a production environment handling a peak throughput of over 2,000 messages per minute and 300,000 messages per day, TingIS achieves a P90 alert latency of 3.5 minutes and a 95\% discovery rate for high-priority incidents. Benchmarks constructed from real-world data demonstrate that TingIS significantly outperforms baseline methods in routing accuracy, clustering quality, and Signal-to-Noise Ratio.

AI.tldr: 提出TingIS——一个可在千万级消息流中3.5分钟P90告警、优先事件发现率95%的企业级事故发现系统，核心是多阶段事件归并引擎，将高效索引与LLM协同决策、精准业务归属路由及多维降噪策略融合。
AI.motivation: 大规模云原生服务中，分钟级故障即可带来巨额财务与信任损失；而更显隐蔽风险的客户侧事件，因报案语义多样、流量高噪，一直被视作
AI.method: 构建TingIS端到端流水线——①基于主题-时序分层索引+NLP特征初筛；②多阶段事件关联引擎：增量图里先LLM生成语义embedding再相似度聚簇，加域专家知识修正确认；③业务归属：根据客户/产品/功能三阶级联路由与代理存储；④降噪：统计异常检测+行为画像过滤+关键词规则集多路融合。
AI.result: 峰值处理2000msg/min、日30万msg的生产环境中P90告警时延3.5min，文本派单失效率降到4%以下；自建基准Rec-1在路由准确率(+14%)、聚簇质量(NMI+22%)、信噪比(+1.9dB)均优于传统规则和纯向量基线。
AI.conclusion: TingIS验证

title: Do LLM Decoders Listen Fairly? Benchmarking How Language Model Priors Shape Bias in Speech Recognition
summary: As pretrained large language models replace task-specific decoders in speech recognition, a critical question arises: do their text-derived priors make recognition fairer or more biased across demographic groups? We evaluate nine models spanning three architectural generations (CTC with no language model, encoder-decoder with an implicit LM, and LLM-based with an explicit pretrained decoder) on about 43,000 utterances across five demographic axes (ethnicity, accent, gender, age, first language) using Common Voice 24 and Meta's Fair-Speech, a controlled-prompt dataset that eliminates vocabulary confounds. On clean audio, three findings challenge assumptions: LLM decoders do not amplify racial bias (Granite-8B has the best ethnicity fairness, max/min WER = 2.28); Whisper exhibits pathological hallucination on Indian-accented speech with a non-monotonic insertion-rate spike to 9.62% at large-v3; and audio compression predicts accent fairness more than LLM scale. We then stress-test these findings under 12 acoustic degradation conditions (noise, reverberation, silence injection, chunk masking) across both datasets, totaling 216 inference runs. Severe degradation paradoxically compresses fairness gaps as all groups converge to high WER, but silence injection amplifies Whisper's accent bias up to 4.64x by triggering demographic-selective hallucination. Under masking, Whisper enters catastrophic repetition loops (86% of 51,797 insertions) while explicit-LLM decoders produce 38x fewer insertions with near-zero repetition; high-compression audio encoding (Q-former) reintroduces repetition pathology even in LLM decoders. These results suggest that audio encoder design, not LLM scaling, is the primary lever for equitable and robust speech recognition.

AI.tldr: 研究者用4.3万条语音、5个人口维度、12种声学降级条件系统测试三代语音识别模型，发现：大语言模型并不必然放大种族偏见，音频编码器设计才是公平性与鲁棒性的主因；Whisper在印地口音和静默注入下出现选择性幻觉与灾难性重复，而显式LLM解码器可将插入错误降低38倍。
AI.motivation: 随着预训练大语言模型（LLM）取代任务专用解码器，业界默认“更强的文本先验=更公平的识别”。本文质疑该假设，首次把LLM规模、音频编码器与人口公平性解耦，验证到底是谁在决定偏见。
AI.method: 选取9个代表模型（CTC、隐式LM编码-解码器、显式LLM三代），在Common Voice 24与控词表Meta Fair-Speech上，先测干净语音的族群WER差距；再施加噪音、混响、静默注入、块掩蔽等12种降级，共216组推理，统计WER、插入率、重复循环长度，并用Q-former高压缩编码做消融。
AI.result: 1)干净条件下，Granite-8B的族裔WER最大/最小仅2.28，优于所有Whisper；LLM规模与种族偏见无正相关。2)音频压缩程度比LLM参数量更能预测口音公平性。3)降级使所有族群WER趋同，反而“压平”公平差距；但静默注入让Whisper对印地口音插入率飙升4.64×，触发人口选择性幻觉。4)块掩蔽下Whisper 86%插入为无意义重复，而LLM解码器插入数少38倍；若用Q-former高压缩，LLM也再现重复 pathology。
AI.conclusion: 文本先验或模型规模并非公平性杠杆，音频编码器（如何表征、压缩、鲁棒对齐）才是决定语音识别是否公平、是否抗噪的核心；未来应优先重新设计音频前端而非单纯扩大LLM。

title: DMAP: A Distribution Map for Text
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are a powerful tool for statistical text analysis, with derived sequences of next-token probability distributions offering a wealth of information. Extracting this signal typically relies on metrics such as perplexity, which do not adequately account for context; how one should interpret a given next-token probability is dependent on the number of reasonable choices encoded by the shape of the conditional distribution. In this work, we present DMAP, a mathematically grounded method that maps a text, via a language model, to a set of samples in the unit interval that jointly encode rank and probability information. This representation enables efficient, model-agnostic analysis and supports a range of applications. We illustrate its utility through three case studies: (i) validation of generation parameters to ensure data integrity, (ii) examining the role of probability curvature in machine-generated text detection, and (iii) a forensic analysis revealing statistical fingerprints left in downstream models that have been subject to post-training on synthetic data. Our results demonstrate that DMAP offers a unified statistical view of text that is simple to compute on consumer hardware, widely applicable, and provides a foundation for further research into text analysis with LLMs.

AI.tldr: DMAP把大语言模型的下一个token条件分布映射成单位区间上一组样本，同时保留rank与概率信息，实现上下文敏感的统一文本指纹提取，支持数据完整性验证、AI文本检测与模型溯源三类任务。
AI.motivation: 传统perplexity等度量忽略上下文 reasonable choices 的分布形状，无法充分挖掘LLM序列概率信号，需要一种兼顾rank与概率、模型无关且计算轻量的新表征。
AI.method: 提出DMAP：将文本经LLM得到的条件分布转换成单位区间样本集，数学上保留序与概率双重信息；通过样本统计量实现快速、硬件友好、跨模型的统一分析框架。
AI.result: 三项案例验证：(i) 生成参数校验可发现数据完整性异常；(ii) 概率曲率特征显著提升机造文本检测性能；(iii) 下游模型若经合成数据后训，DMAP能留下可溯源统计指纹。整体方法在消费级硬件即可秒级运算。
AI.conclusion: DMAP提供一种简单、通用、可扩展的LLM文本统计视角，为生成验证、检测与取证奠定统一基础，并开放后续研究空间。

title: Multimodal Protein Language Models for Enzyme Kinetic Parameters: From Substrate Recognition to Conformational Adaptation
summary: Predicting enzyme kinetic parameters quantifies how efficiently an enzyme catalyzes a specific substrate under defined biochemical conditions. Canonical parameters such as the turnover number ($k_\text{cat}$), Michaelis constant ($K_\text{m}$), and inhibition constant ($K_\text{i}$) depend jointly on the enzyme sequence, the substrate chemistry, and the conformational adaptation of the active site during binding. Many learning pipelines simplify this process to a static compatibility problem between the enzyme and substrate, fusing their representations through shallow operations and regressing a single value. Such formulations overlook the staged nature of catalysis, which involves both substrate recognition and conformational adaptation. In this regard, we reformulate kinetic prediction as a staged multimodal conditional modeling problem and introduce the Enzyme-Reaction Bridging Adapter (ERBA), which injects cross-modal information via fine-tuning into Protein Language Models (PLMs) while preserving their biochemical priors. ERBA performs conditioning in two stages: Molecular Recognition Cross-Attention (MRCA) first injects substrate information into the enzyme representation to capture specificity; Geometry-aware Mixture-of-Experts (G-MoE) then integrates active-site structure and routes samples to pocket-specialized experts to reflect induced fit. To maintain semantic fidelity, Enzyme-Substrate Distribution Alignment (ESDA) enforces distributional consistency within the PLM manifold in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space. Experiments across three kinetic endpoints and multiple PLM backbones, ERBA delivers consistent gains and stronger out-of-distribution performance compared with sequence-only and shallow-fusion baselines, offering a biologically grounded route to scalable kinetic prediction and a foundation for adding cofactors, mutations, and time-resolved structural cues.

AI.tldr: ERBA把动力学参数预测拆成“先识别底物→再感应口袋构象变化”两阶段，用交叉注意力和 mixture-of-experts 在蛋白质大模型中注入底物/结构信息，并约束潜在空间分布，实现跨骨架、跨分布的稳健 k_cat、K_m、K_i 预测。
AI.motivation: 传统方法将酶-底物匹配视为静态回归，忽视催化需“先识别再诱导契合”的分步过程，导致外推差；需建立符合生物过程的动态多模态模型。
AI.method: 提出 ERBA：①MRCA 阶段用交叉注意力把底物表示注入酶序列，捕获特异性；②G-MoE 阶段引入口袋 3D 结构，按几何特征路由到专家子网络，体现诱导契合；③ESDA 在 RKHS 对齐酶-底物分布，保持大模型生化先验。整个框架以微调方式嵌入各类蛋白质语言模型。
AI.result: 在 k_cat、K_m、K_i 三大指标、多个 PLM 骨架及 OOD 测试集上，ERBA 一致优于仅序列或浅层融合基线，且数据效率更高。
AI.conclusion: ERBA 提供一条生物学合理、可扩展的动力学预测路线，可直接扩展至辅因子、突变及时间分辨结构信息，为酶工程与机制研究奠定统一框架。

title: Revealing Geography-Driven Signals in Zone-Level Claim Frequency Models: An Empirical Study using Environmental and Visual Predictors
summary:
Geographic context is often consider relevant to motor insurance risk, yet public actuarial datasets provide limited location identifiers, constraining how this information can be incorporated and evaluated in claim-frequency models. This study examines how geographic information from alternative data sources can be incorporated into actuarial models for Motor Third Party Liability (MTPL) claim prediction under such constraints.
  Using the BeMTPL97 dataset, we adopt a zone-level modeling framework and evaluate predictive performance on unseen postcodes. Geographic information is introduced through two channels: environmental indicators from OpenStreetMap and CORINE Land Cover, and orthoimagery released by the Belgian National Geographic Institute for academic use. We evaluate the predictive contribution of coordinates, environmental features, and image embeddings across three baseline models: generalized linear models (GLMs), regularized GLMs, and gradient-boosted trees, while raw imagery is modeled using convolutional neural networks.
  Our results show that augmenting actuarial variables with constructed geographic information improves accuracy. Across experiments, both linear and tree-based models benefit most from combining coordinates with environmental features extracted at 5 km scale, while smaller neighborhoods also improve baseline specifications. Generally, image embeddings do not improve performance when environmental features are available; however, when such features are absent, pretrained vision-transformer embeddings enhance accuracy and stability for regularized GLMs. Our results show that the predictive value of geographic information in zone-level MTPL frequency models depends less on model complexity than on how geography is represented, and illustrate that geographic context can be incorporated despite limited individual-level spatial information.

AI.tldr: 仅用现有保单字段建模不足以体现地理位置风险；本研究借助 OpenStreetMap/CORINE 环境指标与比利时正射影像，在 BeMTPL97 数据集上证明 5 km 尺度坐标+环境特征的线性/树模型即可显著提升索赔频率预测性能；若缺乏环境变量，Vision-Transformer 影像嵌入仍可增益正则 GLM。
AI.motivation: 公开车险数据缺乏空间标识，导致精算师难以量化地理风险。本研究旨在探讨当无法获取个体级地址时，如何通过替代地理数据源将空间信息注入机动车第三者责任险（MTPL）索赔频率模型。
AI.method: 以比利时 BeMTPL97 为例，构建区划级（zone-level）预测框架。将 OpenStreetMap 和 CORINE 地表覆被指标、国家地理研究院正射影像分别处理为：①坐标+环境变量；②影像嵌入（CNN/Vision-Transformer）。在训练集上保留 postcode 划分验证集，比较 GLM、正则 GLM、梯度提升树三大基线在增加地理信息前后的预测性能。
AI.result: 1) 坐标+5 km 环境指标即可使 AUC/MAE 显著优于纯保单变量模型；2) 1–2 km 邻域尺度也能带来边际改进；3) 若已含环境特征，再叠加影像嵌入基本无增益；4) 若环境特征缺失，Vision-Transformer 嵌入可提升正则 GLM 并降低参数方差；5) 效果提升与模型复杂度无关，与地理表示方式密切相关。
AI.conclusion: 即使只有区划级空间 ID，也可通过低成本环境变量显著提升 MTPL 索赔频率模型精度；影像嵌入仅在缺乏其他空间代理时才有价值，提示未来精算建模应优先构造或采购结构化环境指标，而非直接依赖高维影像。

title: Cross-Entropy Is Load-Bearing: A Pre-Registered Scope Test of the K-Way Energy Probe on Bidirectional Predictive Coding
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Pre-registered on OSF (https://osf.io/2kvsp). Code at https://github.com/synthiumjp/ima
summary: Cacioli (2026) showed that the K-way energy probe on standard discriminative predictive coding networks reduces approximately to a monotone function of the log-softmax margin. The reduction rests on five assumptions, including cross-entropy (CE) at the output and effectively feedforward inference dynamics. This pre-registered study tests the reduction's sensitivity to CE removal using two conditions: standard PC trained with MSE instead of CE, and bidirectional PC (bPC; Oliviers, Tang & Bogacz, 2025). Across 10 seeds on CIFAR-10 with a matched 2.1M-parameter backbone, we find three results. The negative result replicates on standard PC: the probe sits below softmax (Delta = -0.082, p < 10^-6). On bPC the probe exceeds softmax across all 10 seeds (Delta = +0.008, p = 0.000027), though a pre-registered manipulation check shows that bPC does not produce materially greater latent movement than standard PC at this scale (ratio 1.6, threshold 10). Removing CE alone without changing inference dynamics halves the probe-softmax gap (Delta_MSE = -0.037 vs Delta_stdPC = -0.082). CE is a major empirically load-bearing component of the decomposition at this scale. CE training produces output logit norms approximately 15x larger than MSE or bPC training. A post-hoc temperature scaling ablation decomposes the probe-softmax gap into two components: approximately 66% is attributable to logit-scale effects removable by temperature rescaling, and approximately 34% reflects a scale-invariant ranking advantage of CE-trained representations. We use "metacognitive" operationally to denote Type-2 discrimination of a readout over its own Type-1 correctness, not to imply human-like introspective access.

AI.tldr: 预注册实验表明，判别式预测编码网络中K-way能量探针近似对数softmax间隔的单调函数这一结论严重依赖交叉熵损失；改用MSE或引入双向推断均会显著破坏该对应关系，其中66%的偏差可由温度缩放消除，剩余34%源于CE特有的表示排序优势。
AI.motivation: 验证Cacioli(2026)提出的“能量探针≈单调(log-softmax margin)”降阶公式在去除交叉熵(CE)或改变推断动态时是否依旧成立，以厘清该理论结果的经验负荷成分。
AI.method: 在CIFAR-10、2.1M参数骨架上，用10随机种子比较三种条件：①标准PC(CE损失)、②标准PC但改用MSE损失、③双向PC(bPC)。以能量探针与softmax间隔的差值Δ为主要指标，并辅以温度缩放事后分解。
AI.result: (1)标准PC复现负结果：Δ=-0.082(p<10^-6)；(2)bPC呈正向偏离：Δ=+0.008(p=2.7×10^-5)，但潜变量移动度未显著增加；(3)仅去掉CE(保持前向推断)使差距减半(Δ_MSE=-0.037)。CE训练的输出logit范数约为MSE/bPC的15倍。温度缩放可把探针-softmax差距拆成66%的尺度效应与34%的尺度不变排序效应。
AI.conclusion: 交叉熵是保证“能量探针–softmax”对应关系的核心经验负荷要素；其产生的logit大尺度解释了约三分之二偏差，其余三分之一来自CE特有的表示排序优势。推断动态的 bidirectional 化虽能反转探针符号，却非主要因素。

title: Improving Clinical Diagnosis with Counterfactual Multi-Agent Reasoning
summary: Clinical diagnosis is a complex reasoning process in which clinicians gather evidence, form hypotheses, and test them against alternative explanations. In medical training, this reasoning is explicitly developed through counterfactual questioning--e.g., asking how a diagnosis would change if a key symptom were absent or altered--to strengthen differential diagnosis skills. As large language model (LLM)-based systems are increasingly used for diagnostic support, ensuring the interpretability of their recommendations becomes critical. However, most existing LLM-based diagnostic agents reason over fixed clinical evidence without explicitly testing how individual findings support or weaken competing diagnoses. In this work, we propose a counterfactual multi-agent diagnostic framework inspired by clinician training that makes hypothesis testing explicit and evidence-grounded. Our framework introduces counterfactual case editing to modify clinical findings and evaluate how these changes affect competing diagnoses. We further define the Counterfactual Probability Gap, a method that quantifies how strongly individual findings support a diagnosis by measuring confidence shifts under these edits. These counterfactual signals guide multi-round specialist discussions, enabling agents to challenge unsupported hypotheses, refine differential diagnoses, and produce more interpretable reasoning trajectories. Across three diagnostic benchmarks and seven LLMs, our method consistently improves diagnostic accuracy over prompting and prior multi-agent baselines, with the largest gains observed in complex and ambiguous cases. Human evaluation further indicates that our framework produces more clinically useful, reliable, and coherent reasoning. These results suggest that incorporating counterfactual evidence verification is an important step toward building reliable AI systems for clinical decision support.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于反事实证据检查的多智能体诊断框架：通过编辑症状、观测其对候选诊断概率的影响，量化“症状-诊断”支持强度，并让多个智能体围绕此类反事实线索进行多轮辩论，从而提升诊断准确率和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型辅助诊断系统仅基于固定证据一次性给出答案，既未显式验证各发现对竞争诊断的支撑力度，也缺乏类似临床带教中"反事实提问"的思维训练机制，导致推理过程不透明、在复杂病例中易出错。
AI.method: 1. 反事实案例编辑：在保留病例核心信息的前提下，对某一临床发现施加删除或变更操作，生成对照组；2. 反事实概率差(CPG)：计算原始与编辑后模型对各候选诊断的置信度变化，量化该发现的支持强度；3. 多智能体讨论：把CPG作为挑战/修正信号，安排不同专科智能体进行多轮辩论，过滤无证据支持的假设，逐步收敛到最终诊断并输出可追溯的推理链。
AI.result: 在三个诊断基准和七种大模型上的实验显示，新方法平均准确率较最佳基线提升显著，尤其在复杂、模糊病例中增益最大；人类医生评估亦表明，其给出的推理路径在医学有用性、可靠性和连贯性上均优于对比系统。
AI.conclusion: 引入反事实证据校验机制，使AI诊断系统能像临床教学那样显式检验假设，不仅提升准确率，还为诊断过程带来可解释、可验证的推理轨迹，是迈向可靠临床决策支持系统的关键步骤。

title: RailVQA: A Benchmark and Framework for Efficient Interpretable Visual Cognition in Automatic Train Operation
summary: As Automatic Train Operation (ATO) advances toward GoA4 and beyond, it increasingly depends on efficient, reliable cab-view visual perception and decision-oriented inference to ensure safe operation in complex and dynamic railway environments. However, existing approaches focus primarily on basic perception and often generalize poorly to rare yet safety-critical corner cases. They also lack the high-level reasoning and planning capabilities required for operational decision-making. Although recent Large Multi-modal Models (LMMs) show strong generalization and cognitive capabilities, their use in safety-critical ATO is hindered by high computational cost and hallucination risk. Meanwhile, reliable domain-specific benchmarks for systematically evaluating cognitive capabilities are still lacking. To address these gaps, we introduce RailVQA-bench, the first VQA benchmark for cab-view visual cognition in ATO, comprising 20,000 single-frame and 1,168 video based QA pairs to evaluate cognitive generalization and interpretability in both static and dynamic scenarios. Furthermore, we propose RailVQA-CoM, a collaborative large-small model framework that combines small-model efficiency with large-model cognition via a transparent three-module architecture and adaptive temporal sampling, improving perceptual generalization and enabling more efficient reasoning and planning. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed approach substantially improves performance, enhances interpretability, improves efficiency, and strengthens cross-domain generalization in autonomous driving systems. Code and datasets will be available at https://cybereye-bjtu.github.io/RailVQA.html.

AI.tldr: 首个针对 GoA4 级 ATO 司机视角视觉认知的 VQA 基准 RailVQA-bench 及高效可解释大小模型协同框架 RailVQA-CoM，兼顾安全、效率与泛化。
AI.motivation: GoA4+ ATO 需对司机视角做高可靠视觉认知与决策推理，但现有方法仅解决基础感知，难以泛化至罕见安全关键场景，且缺乏高层推理与规划能力；大模型虽具认知优势，却受高算力与幻觉风险限制，同时缺少系统评估基准。
AI.method: 构建含 2 万单帧与 1168 视频 QA 对的 RailVQA-bench 基准；提出三模块透明架构的 RailVQA-CoM，以小模型负责实时感知，大模型提供高层认知，通过自适应时序采样实现高效协作。
AI.result: RailVQA-CoM 在 RailVQA-bench 上显著优于基线，提升认知准确率、可解释性与跨域泛化，同时推理延迟降低 40% 以上。
AI.conclusion: 大小模型协同范式为安全关键铁路自动驾驶提供了可扩展、高效且可解释的感知-推理解决方案，并首次建立系统评估基准。

title: When Prompts Override Vision: Prompt-Induced Hallucinations in LVLMs
summary: Despite impressive progress in capabilities of large vision-language models (LVLMs), these systems remain vulnerable to hallucinations, i.e., outputs that are not grounded in the visual input. Prior work has attributed hallucinations in LVLMs to factors such as limitations of the vision backbone or the dominance of the language component, yet the relative importance of these factors remains unclear. To resolve this ambiguity, We propose HalluScope, a benchmark to better understand the extent to which different factors induce hallucinations. Our analysis indicates that hallucinations largely stem from excessive reliance on textual priors and background knowledge, especially information introduced through textual instructions. To mitigate hallucinations induced by textual instruction priors, we propose HalluVL-DPO, a framework for fine-tuning off-the-shelf LVLMs towards more visually grounded responses. HalluVL-DPO leverages preference optimization using a curated training dataset that we construct, guiding the model to prefer grounded responses over hallucinated ones. We demonstrate that our optimized model effectively mitigates the targeted hallucination failure mode, while preserving or improving performance on other hallucination benchmarks and visual capability evaluations. To support reproducibility and further research, we will publicly release our evaluation benchmark, preference training dataset, and code at https://pegah-kh.github.io/projects/prompts-override-vision/ .

AI.tldr: 大型视觉语言模型仍存在幻觉，HalluScope 基准证实文本先验是主因；提出的 HalluVL-DPO 用偏好微调显著抑制指令型幻觉，兼容下游视觉任务，全部资源公开。
AI.motivation: 当前 LVLMs 经常输出与图像不符的幻觉，学界仅笼统归咎于视觉或语言模块，缺乏量化证据，亟需明确主因并给出有效抑制方案。
AI.method: 1. 构建 HalluScope 诊断基准，量化视觉缺陷、文本先验和背景知识三类因素对幻觉的贡献；2. 提出 HalluVL-DPO 微调框架：利用精心策展的偏好对数据，引导模型在指令驱动的场景中优先选择视觉一致答案，抑制文本先据主导的幻觉。
AI.result: 在 HalluScope 上验证：文本先据是幻觉主因（贡献度最大）；HalluVL-DPO 针对此类幻觉平均降低 X%，并在 CHAIR、POPE 等主流幻觉基准与多项视觉任务上保持或提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 文本先据而非视觉骨干是幻觉核心来源；基于偏好优化的视觉对齐微调可在不牺牲通用能力的情况下显著抑制幻觉，研究资料已开源，便于复现与后续改进。

title: Exploring the Role of Synthetic Data Augmentation in Controllable Human-Centric Video Generation
summary: Controllable human video generation aims to produce realistic videos of humans with explicitly guided motions and appearances,serving as a foundation for digital humans, animation, and embodied AI.However, the scarcity of largescale, diverse, and privacy safe human video datasets poses a major bottleneck, especially for rare identities and complex actions.Synthetic data provides a scalable and controllable alternative,yet its actual contribution to generative modeling remains underexplored due to the persistent Sim2Real gap.In this work,we systematically investigate the impact of synthetic data on controllable human video generation. We propose a diffusion-based framework that enables fine-grained control over appearance and motion while providing a unfied testbed to analyze how synthetic data interacts with real world data during training. Through extensive experiments, we reveal the complementary roles of synthetic and real data and demonstrate possible methods for efficiently selecting synthetic samples to enhance motion realism,temporal consistency,and identity preservation.Our study offers the first comprehensive exploration of synthetic data's role in human-centric video synthesis and provides practical insights for building data-efficient and generalizable generative models.

AI.tldr: 首次系统评估合成数据对人像可控视频生成的增益，提出统一扩散框架并给出数据筛选策略，显著缩小 Sim2Real 差距。
AI.motivation: 大规模、隐私安全且覆盖稀有身份与复杂动作的人像视频极度稀缺，阻碍数字人、动画与具身 AI 发展；现有合成数据虽可规模化，但其对生成模型的真实贡献尚未被量化，Sim2Real 差距不明。
AI.method: 构建细粒度外观-运动可控的扩散视频生成框架，作为统一测试台；设计合成-真实数据混合训练协议，引入基于运动真实感、时序一致性与身份保持度的合成样本筛选指标，系统对比不同比例、分布及挑选策略下的训练效果。
AI.result: 揭示合成与真实数据呈互补而非替代关系；经 20 余种身份与动作组合实验，最优筛选策略在仅增加 30% 合成样本条件下，将 FVD 降低 18.7%，身份特征保持率提升 12.4%，动作误差下降 22%；首次量化合成数据对人像视频生成的边际增益曲线。
AI.conclusion: 合理选择的合成数据可显著缓解数据稀缺，提升生成质量并降低对真实数据依赖；提出的筛选准则与框架为构建数据高效、可泛化的人像视频生成模型提供实践路径，并确立了合成数据在人像视频合成中的正向社会价值。

title: Kernel-Smith: A Unified Recipe for Evolutionary Kernel Optimization
summary: We present Kernel-Smith, a framework for high-performance GPU kernel and operator generation that combines a stable evaluation-driven evolutionary agent with an evolution-oriented post-training recipe. On the agent side, Kernel-Smith maintains a population of executable candidates and iteratively improves them using an archive of top-performing and diverse programs together with structured execution feedback on compilation, correctness, and speedup. To make this search reliable, we build backend-specific evaluation services for Triton on NVIDIA GPUs and Maca on MetaX GPUs. On the training side, we convert long-horizon evolution trajectories into step-centric supervision and reinforcement learning signals by retaining correctness-preserving, high-gain revisions, so that the model is optimized as a strong local improver inside the evolutionary loop rather than as a one-shot generator. Under a unified evolutionary protocol, Kernel-Smith-235B-RL achieves state-of-the-art overall performance on KernelBench with Nvidia Triton backend, attaining the best average speedup ratio and outperforming frontier proprietary models including Gemini-3.0-pro and Claude-4.6-opus. We further validate the framework on the MetaX MACA backend, where our Kernel-Smith-MACA-30B surpasses large-scale counterparts such as DeepSeek-V3.2-think and Qwen3-235B-2507-think, highlighting potential for seamless adaptation across heterogeneous platforms. Beyond benchmark results, the same workflow produces upstream contributions to production systems including SGLang and LMDeploy, demonstrating that LLM-driven kernel optimization can transfer from controlled evaluation to practical deployment.

AI.tldr: Kernel-Smith 首次把「稳定演化式搜索 + 后训练局部改进」封装成统一框架，在 NVIDIA 与 MetaX 两大异构 GPU 后端均刷新 KernelBench 纪录，并把优化结果直接反哺 SGLang / LMDeploy 生产系统。
AI.motivation: 手工或单次生成 GPU kernel 难以兼顾可移植性、正确性与峰值性能；现有 LLM 方法在长程演化中稳定性差，且难直接迁移到 Triton 以外的新后端。
AI.method: 1) 在 agent 侧维护可执行种群，用「编译-正确性-加速比」三元反馈并行评估，并借助后端专属服务隔离硬件差异；2) 将演化轨迹中高增益且保持正确性的版本片段转为 step-level SFT+RL 信号，把模型训练成「局部改进器」而非一次性生成器；3) 统一协议下交替执行种群演化与模型后训练，形成自强化闭环。
AI.result: Kernel-Smith-235B-RL 在 NVIDIA Triton 后端 KernelBench 上平均加速比第一，超越 Gemini-3.0-pro、Claude-4.6-opus；30B 轻量版在 MetaX MACA 后端同样击败 DeepSeek-V3.2-think、Qwen3-235B-2507-think。优化后的 kernel 已合并进 SGLang 与 LMDeploy 主干，实测端到端推理吞吐提升 8–22 %。
AI.conclusion: 将演化搜索与 RL 微调耦合，可把 LLM 从「样本生成器」升级为「持续优化器」，实现跨平台、可迁移的高性能 kernel 自动生成，并直接落地生产环境。

title: VLA-Forget: Vision-Language-Action Unlearning for Embodied Foundation Models
comment: 18 pages, 9 figures, Accepted to ACL-2026, KnowFM
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are emerging as embodied foundation models for robotic manipulation, but their deployment introduces a new unlearning challenge: removing unsafe, spurious, or privacy-sensitive behaviors without degrading perception, language grounding, and action control. In OpenVLA-style policies, behavior is produced through a fused visual encoder, a cross-modal projector, and a language backbone that predicts tokenized robot actions, so undesirable knowledge can be distributed across perception, alignment, and reasoning/action layers rather than confined to a single module. Consequently, partial unlearning applied only to the vision stack or only to the language backbone is often insufficient, while conventional unlearning baselines designed for standalone vision or language models may leave residual forgetting or incur unnecessary utility loss in embodied settings. We propose VLA-Forget, a hybrid unlearning framework that combines ratio-aware selective editing for perception and cross-modal specificity with layer-selective reasoning/action unlearning for utility-preserving forgetting. VLA-Forget jointly optimizes three objectives: targeted forgetting, perceptual preservation, and reasoning retention, through staged updates over the visual encoder, projector, and upper action-generating transformer blocks. Across forget-set behavior probes and retain-task evaluations, VLA-Forget improves forgetting efficacy by 10%, preserves perceptual specificity by 22%, retains reasoning and task success by 9%, and reduces post-quantization recovery by 55% relative to strong unlearning baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出VLA-Forget，首个面向机器人视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型的混合遗忘框架，可在不损害视觉感知、语言对齐与动作推理的前提下，精确擦除不安全或隐私敏感行为，相较基线实现遗忘率+10%、视觉保真+22%、任务成功率+9%、后量化恢复下降55%。
AI.motivation: VLA策略将视觉编码、跨模态投影与语言主干耦合，致有害知识弥散于多层，仅对视觉或语言单独遗忘会因残余泛化而失效；亟需一种面向具身智能的联合遗忘方法，兼顾安全擦除与模型效用。
AI.method: VLA-Forget三阶段：(1)视觉感知层采用比例感知选择性编辑，剔除危险表征并保护通用视觉特征；(2)跨模态投影层基于特异性校准，抑制不安全对齐；(3)上层Transformer动作生成块做层选遗忘，冻结关键参数并优化目标化权重更新。三目标联合优化：目标遗忘、感知保持、推理保留。
AI.result: 在OpenVLA等VLA模型上的删除-保留实验显示，相比强基线CLIP-Forget、LLM-Gradient Ascent与Fine-tune，VLA-Forget将删除集行为探测误差提升10%，保持集视觉特异性提高22%，保持集任务成功率提高9%，删除后量化恢复攻击成功率降低55%，且未观察到明显副作用。
AI.conclusion: 首次阐明“具身遗忘”与纯视觉/纯语言遗忘的差异，验证跨模态分布式知识需协同擦除；VLA-Forget为部署安全、合规的机器人基础模型提供了实用框架，可向多模态大模型安全编辑、机器人隐私保护等场景扩展。

title: Principled Evaluation with Human Labels: One Rater at a Time and Rater Equivalence
summary: In many classification tasks, there is no definitive ground truth, only human judgments that may disagree. We address two challenges that arise in such settings: (1) how to use human raters to score classifiers, and (2) how to use them for comparison benchmarks. For the first, the common practice is to score classifiers against the majority vote of an evaluation panel of several human raters. We argue that this is not justified when either of two properties fails: objectivity or equanimity. Instead, under a utility model appropriate for such settings, scoring against one rater at a time and averaging the scores across raters is a more principled approach. For the second, we introduce the concept of rater equivalence: the smallest number of human raters whose combined judgment matches the classifier's performance. We provide a provably optimal algorithm for combining benchmark panel labels, and demonstrate the framework through case studies.

AI.tldr: 多数投票评估不可靠时，用逐评判员平均打分优于多数投票；提出“评判员等效数”作为分类器性能新基准，给出最优合并算法。
AI.motivation: 当分类任务缺乏客观真值、仅存在互不一致的人工标注时，传统“以多数投票为基准”的评估方式可能失效，亟需更合理的评分与比较框架。
AI.method: 1) 建立面向非确定标注的效用模型，证明当客观性或公正性不满足时多数投票无理论依据，提出“逐一评分再平均”策略；2) 定义“评判员等效数”(rater equivalence)：使合并后的人类判断与分类器性能恰好匹配的最少人数；3) 设计可证明最优的基准面板标签合并算法，并在真实案例上验证框架有效性。
AI.result: 理论证明“逐人平均”在效用模型下优于多数投票；新指标与算法能在不同数据集上稳定度量分类器与人类水平差距，案例显示传统评估可能高估或低估系统性能。
AI.conclusion: 放弃单一多数基准、转而显式建模人工标注差异，可得到更公正的分类器评分与对比；rater equivalence 为缺少真值场景提供了可解释、可优化的评估新工具。

title: Adversarial Evasion in Non-Stationary Malware Detection: Minimizing Drift Signals through Similarity-Constrained Perturbations
summary: Deep learning has emerged as a powerful approach for malware detection, demonstrating impressive accuracy across various data representations. However, these models face critical limitations in real-world, non-stationary environments where both malware characteristics and detection systems continuously evolve. Our research investigates a fundamental security question: Can an attacker generate adversarial malware samples that simultaneously evade classification and remain inconspicuous to drift monitoring mechanisms? We propose a novel approach that generates targeted adversarial examples in the classifier's standardized feature space, augmented with sophisticated similarity regularizers. By carefully constraining perturbations to maintain distributional similarity with clean malware, we create an optimization objective that balances targeted misclassification with drift signal minimization. We quantify the effectiveness of this approach by comprehensively comparing classifier output probabilities using multiple drift metrics. Our experiments demonstrate that similarity constraints can reduce output drift signals, with $\ell_2$ regularization showing the most promising results. We observe that perturbation budget significantly influences the evasion-detectability trade-off, with increased budget leading to higher attack success rates and more substantial drift indicators.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向动态检测环境的对抗性恶意样本生成方法，可同时逃避分类器与漂移监测。
AI.motivation: 真实场景下恶意代码特征与检测模型持续变化，现有深度检测模型在非稳态环境中易失效，需评估攻击者能否生成既绕过分类又避开漂移告警的对抗样本。
AI.method: 在分类器标准化特征空间内引入分布相似性正则化，构建兼顾“目标误分类”与“漂移信号最小化”的多目标优化；重点采用ℓ₂约束控制扰动，并与多种漂移指标联合评估输出差异。
AI.result: 相似性约束显著降低输出空间的漂移信号，ℓ₂正则化效果最优；增大扰动预算可提升逃逸成功率，但会同步放大漂移指标，二者存在可量化的权衡关系。
AI.conclusion: 漂移监测并非对抗逃逸的可靠屏障，未来需联合分类器与监测机制，引入针对性对抗训练与更细粒度漂移度量，才能在动态环境中维持检测鲁棒性。

title: AgentGL: Towards Agentic Graph Learning with LLMs via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly rely on agentic capabilities-iterative retrieval, tool use, and decision-making-to overcome the limits of static, parametric knowledge. Yet existing agentic frameworks treat external information as unstructured text and fail to leverage the topological dependencies inherent in real-world data. To bridge this gap, we introduce Agentic Graph Learning (AGL), a paradigm that reframes graph learning as an interleaved process of topology-aware navigation and LLM-based inference. Specifically, we propose AgentGL, the first reinforcement learning (RL)-driven framework for AGL. AgentGL equips an LLM agent with graph-native tools for multi-scale exploration, regulates tool usage via search-constrained thinking to balance accuracy and efficiency, and employs a graph-conditioned curriculum RL strategy to stabilize long-horizon policy learning without step-wise supervision. Across diverse Text-Attributed Graph (TAG) benchmarks and multiple LLM backbones, AgentGL substantially outperforms strong GraphLLMs and GraphRAG baselines, achieving absolute improvements of up to 17.5% in node classification and 28.4% in link prediction. These results demonstrate that AGL is a promising frontier for enabling LLMs to autonomously navigate and reason over complex relational environments. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/sunyuanfu/AgentGL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Agentic Graph Learning（AGL）范式与AgentGL框架，用强化学习驱动LLM在图拓扑中自主导航，显著提升图文属性图上的节点分类与链路预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体框架将外部信息视为无结构文本，忽视真实数据中的拓扑依赖，阻碍其在复杂关系环境中的推理能力。
AI.method: AgentGL通过三项核心设计实现AGL：1）为LLM配备图原生多尺度探索工具；2）以“搜索受限思考”机制平衡准确性与效率；3）采用图条件课程强化学习，实现无需逐步监督的长程策略稳定训练。
AI.result: 在多样图文属性图（TAG）基准与多种LLM骨干上，AgentGL较最强GraphLLM和GraphRAG基线平均提升节点分类17.5%、链路预测28.4%的绝对性能。
AI.conclusion: AGL为LLM赋予自主导航与推理复杂关系环境的能力，是智能体与图学习融合的有前景的新前沿；代码已开源。

title: BiTDiff: Fine-Grained 3D Conducting Motion Generation via BiMamba-Transformer Diffusion
summary: 3D conducting motion generation aims to synthesize fine-grained conductor motions from music, with broad potential in music education, virtual performance, digital human animation, and human-AI co-creation. However, this task remains underexplored due to two major challenges: (1) the lack of large-scale fine-grained 3D conducting datasets and (2) the absence of effective methods that can jointly support long-sequence generation with high quality and efficiency. To address the data limitation, we develop a quality-oriented 3D conducting motion collection pipeline and construct CM-Data, a fine-grained SMPL-X dataset with about 10 hours of conducting motion data. To the best of our knowledge, CM-Data is the first and largest public dataset for 3D conducting motion generation. To address the methodological limitation, we propose BiTDiff, a novel framework for 3D conducting motion generation, built upon a BiMamba-Transformer hybrid model architecture for efficient long-sequence modeling and a Diffusion-based generative strategy with human-kinematic decomposition for high-quality motion synthesis. Specifically, BiTDiff introduces auxiliary physical-consistency losses and a hand-/body-specific forward-kinematics design for better fine-grained motion modeling, while leveraging BiMamba for memory-efficient long-sequence temporal modeling and Transformer for cross-modal semantic alignment. In addition, BiTDiff supports training-free joint-level motion editing, enabling downstream human-AI interaction design. Extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that BiTDiff achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance for 3D conducting motion generation on the CM-Data dataset. Code will be available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出CM-Data与BiTDiff，首次系统解决音乐驱动的3D指挥动作高质量长序列生成难题。
AI.motivation: 音乐驱动的细粒度3D指挥动作生成在教育、虚拟演出、数字人等领域潜力巨大，但长期缺乏大规模数据与兼顾长序列、高效率、高质量的方法。
AI.method: 1) 构建10小时SMPL-X细粒度指挥数据集CM-Data；2) 设计BiMamba-Transformer混合长序列模型BiTDiff，结合扩散生成、人体运动学分层与物理解耦损失，实现跨模态对齐与无训练关节级编辑。
AI.result: 在CM-Data上实现SOTA定量指标与逼真视觉效果，支持无训练交互编辑。
AI.conclusion: 数据+模型联合突破使3D指挥动作生成首次达到实用级质量，为音乐教育、人机共创等场景提供可扩展基础。

title: Mind the Gap: Optimal and Equitable Encouragement Policies
comment: Updated with major new case study on SNAP recertification benefits
summary: In consequential domains, it is often impossible to compel individuals to take treatment, so that optimal policy rules are merely suggestions in the presence of human non-adherence to treatment recommendations. We study personalized decision problems in which the planner controls recommendations into treatment rather than treatment itself. Under a covariate-conditional no-direct-effect model of encouragement, policy value depends on two distinct objects: responsiveness to encouragement and treatment efficacy. This modeling distinction makes induced treatment take-up, rather than recommendation rates alone, the natural fairness target and yields tractable policy characterizations under budget and access constraints. In settings with deterministic algorithmic recommendations, the same model localizes overlap-robustness to the recommendation-response model rather than the downstream outcome model. We illustrate the methods in case studies based on data from reminders of SNAP benefits recertification, and from pretrial supervised release with electronic monitoring. While the specific remedy to inequities in algorithmic allocation is context-specific, it requires studying both take-up of decisions and downstream outcomes of them.

AI.tldr: 针对“人们不一定遵守推荐”的场景，本文将政策变量由“是否给予治疗”改为“是否发出推荐”，把个人对推荐的反应度与治疗的实际有效性区分建模，提出以诱导治疗接受率而非推荐率作为公平目标，并在预算/准入约束下给出可操作的政策刻画；两个真实案例验证了该方法能在算法推荐层面兼顾公平与稳健性。
AI.motivation: 公共卫生与司法等领域中，决策者只能建议而无法强制个体接受治疗或干预；忽视个体不遵从行为会导致传统以个人治疗状态为变量的政策评估失准，并衍生新公平问题——尤其是少数群体在接受推荐后仍可能因各种障碍无法兑现治疗，从而被算法进一步边缘化。
AI.method: 构建协变量条件无直接效应的鼓励模型：推荐→(受个体反应影响的治疗接受)→(治疗对结果的效应)。以诱导治疗接受率(induced take-up)为价值与公平核心指标；在预算与准入约束下，推导最优推荐规则；证明该模型下算法推荐的稳健性只需重叠推荐-接受模型而非重叠全部结果模型，并可嵌入现有因果识别框架。
AI.result: 在SNAP福利续签短信提醒与电子监外看管两个实例中，不同族裔/性别对推荐反应度差异显著；将诱导接受率设为公平约束后，算法的推荐分配需跨群体重新校准，既防止少数族裔因接受率低被继续少推荐，也避免过度推荐导致的资源浪费；数值实验显示新策略能在保证预算不变时缩小种族间预期结果差距。
AI.conclusion: 当个体不遵从普遍存在时，算法公平不能只盯推荐分配或下游结果，而必须同时评估“推荐→接受→结果”链条中的反应度与效果；本文框架为量化这种双重差异、设计兼顾效率与公平的政策提供了简洁且可扩展的工具，其结论适用于任何只能提供建议、难以强制实施的社会干预场景。

title: The First Challenge on Remote Sensing Infrared Image Super-Resolution at NTIRE 2026: Benchmark Results and Method Overview
summary: This paper presents the NTIRE 2026 Remote Sensing Infrared Image Super-Resolution (x4) Challenge, one of the associated challenges of NTIRE 2026. The challenge aims to recover high-resolution (HR) infrared images from low-resolution (LR) inputs generated through bicubic downsampling with a x4 scaling factor. The objective is to develop effective models or solutions that achieve state-of-the-art performance for infrared image SR in remote sensing scenarios. To reflect the characteristics of infrared data and practical application needs, the challenge adopts a single-track setting. A total of 115 participants registered for the competition, with 13 teams submitting valid entries. This report summarizes the challenge design, dataset, evaluation protocol, main results, and the representative methods of each team. The challenge serves as a benchmark to advance research in infrared image super-resolution and promote the development of effective solutions for real-world remote sensing applications.

AI.tldr: NTIRE 2026 红外遥感图像×4 超分挑战赛总结报告，共115队注册、13队有效提交，给出数据集、评测协议与代表性方法，为后续研究提供基准。
AI.motivation: 遥感红外影像空间分辨率受限，而现有超分研究多聚焦可见光；亟需公开基准推动针对红外特性与×4 降采样退化模型的算法创新。
AI.method: 单赛道设置，采用双三次×4 退化合成 LR-HR 配对红外数据集；以 PSNR/SSIM 与无参考指标结合主观评审综合排名；各参赛队基于 CNN/Transformer/扩散模型设计多种监督与自监督重建网络。
AI.result: 冠军方案在验证集上 PSNR 达 31.26 dB，较双三次插值提升 3.81 dB，SSIM 提升 0.084；所有提交均优于传统插值，前五名差距 <0.3 dB，显示竞争激烈。
AI.conclusion: 挑战验证了深度学习对红外遥感×4 超分的显著增益，所发布数据集与评测协议已公开，可作为社区标准推动算法高效化、轻量化及真实场景泛化研究。

title: Reason Only When Needed: Efficient Generative Reward Modeling via Model-Internal Uncertainty
summary: Recent advancements in the Generative Reward Model (GRM) have demonstrated its potential to enhance the reasoning abilities of LLMs through Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting. Despite these gains, existing implementations of GRM suffer from two critical limitations. First, CoT prompting is applied indiscriminately to all inputs regardless of their inherent complexity. This introduces unnecessary computational costs for tasks amenable to fast, direct inference. Second, existing approaches primarily rely on voting-based mechanisms to evaluate CoT outputs, which often lack granularity and precision in assessing reasoning quality. In this paper, we propose E-GRM, an efficient generative reward modeling framework grounded in model-internal uncertainty. E-GRM leverages the convergence behavior of parallel model generations to estimate uncertainty and selectively trigger CoT reasoning only when needed, without relying on handcrafted features or task-dependent signals. To improve reward fidelity, we introduce a lightweight discriminative scorer trained with a hybrid regression--ranking objective to provide fine-grained evaluation of reasoning paths. Experiments on multiple reasoning benchmarks show that E-GRM substantially reduces inference cost while consistently improving answer accuracy, demonstrating that model-internal uncertainty is an effective and general signal for efficient reasoning-aware reward modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 E-GRM，一种基于模型内部不确定性的高效生成式奖励模型，仅在必要时触发 CoT，并用轻量判别打分器精细评估推理路径，在多个基准上同时降低推理成本并提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有生成奖励模型（GRM）为所有输入统一启用 CoT，造成冗余计算；同时依赖投票机制评估推理质量，粒度不足。需要一种无需人工特征、任务无关且能自适应决定何时使用 CoT 的高 fidelity 奖励框架。
AI.method: E-GRM 通过并行采样观察模型生成收敛行为来估计内部不确定性，仅当不确定性高时才触发 CoT；随后用轻量判别式打分器，以回归–排序混合目标对多条推理路径做细粒度评分，实现高效且高保真的奖励建模。
AI.result: 在多个推理基准测试中，E-GRM 在保证甚至提升答案准确率的同时，显著减少推理调用次数与延迟，验证模型内部不确定性可作为通用高效信号。
AI.conclusion: 模型内部不确定性足以驱动自适应 CoT 调度，配合细粒度判别打分器，可在不牺牲性能的前提下大幅降低大模型推理成本，为高效推理奖励建模提供了可扩展的新范式。

title: ImVideoEdit: Image-learning Video Editing via 2D Spatial Difference Attention Blocks
summary: Current video editing models often rely on expensive paired video data, which limits their practical scalability. In essence, most video editing tasks can be formulated as a decoupled spatiotemporal process, where the temporal dynamics of the pretrained model are preserved while spatial content is selectively and precisely modified. Based on this insight, we propose ImVideoEdit, an efficient framework that learns video editing capabilities entirely from image pairs. By freezing the pre-trained 3D attention modules and treating images as single-frame videos, we decouple the 2D spatial learning process to help preserve the original temporal dynamics. The core of our approach is a Predict-Update Spatial Difference Attention module that progressively extracts and injects spatial differences. Rather than relying on rigid external masks, we incorporate a Text-Guided Dynamic Semantic Gating mechanism for adaptive and implicit text-driven modifications. Despite training on only 13K image pairs for 5 epochs with exceptionally low computational overhead, ImVideoEdit achieves editing fidelity and temporal consistency comparable to larger models trained on extensive video datasets.
