title: Adaptive Soft Error Protection for Neural Network Processing
summary: Previous research on selective protection for neural network components typically exploits only static vulnerability differences. Although these methods improve upon classical modular redundancy, they still incur substantial overhead for neural network workloads that are both memory-intensive and compute-intensive. In this work, we observe that neural network vulnerability is also input-dependent and varies dynamically at runtime. With this observation, we propose an adaptive, vulnerability-aware fault tolerance framework. At its core, a lightweight graph neural network (GNN) model dynamically predicts soft error vulnerabilities across inputs and neural network components, enabling real-time adaptation of fault tolerance policies. This design offers a complementary and more efficient protection scheme compared to traditional approaches. Experimental results demonstrate that the GNN predictor achieves over 95% accuracy in identifying critical inputs and components. Moreover, our adaptive scheme reduces computational overhead by an average of 42.12% while preserving model accuracy, significantly outperforming static selective protection methods.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于图神经网络的运行时动态脆弱性预测框架，实现神经网络容错开销与精度的实时权衡；相比静态选择保护，平均降低42%计算开销并保持95%以上关键组件识别精度。
AI.motivation: 现有选择性保护仅利用静态脆弱性差异，对既占内存又重计算的神经网络仍带来可观开销；发现脆弱性随输入动态变化，若能在运行时精准识别关键输入与组件，可进一步降低冗余成本。
AI.method: 构建轻量级GNN预测器，在推理阶段实时评估各输入与网络组件的软错误脆弱度；依据预测结果动态调整容错策略（如冗余级别、监测粒度），形成脆弱性感知的自适应容错框架。
AI.result: GNN对关键输入/组件的识别准确率超过95%；在保持原模型精度条件下，自适应方案平均减少42.12%计算开销，显著优于静态选择性保护基线。
AI.conclusion: 首次将输入依赖的动态脆弱性纳入神经网络容错设计，证明基于GNN的运行时预测可兼顾高可靠与高效率，为资源受限场景下的可靠AI提供新范式。

title: MiMIC: Mitigating Visual Modality Collapse in Universal Multimodal Retrieval While Avoiding Semantic Misalignment
summary: Universal Multimodal Retrieval (UMR) aims to map different modalities (e.g., visual and textual) into a shared embedding space for multi-modal retrieval. Existing UMR methods can be broadly divided into two categories: early-fusion approaches, such as Marvel, which projects visual features into the language model (LM) space for integrating with text modality, and late-fusion approaches, such as UniVL-DR, which encode visual and textual inputs using separate encoders and obtain fused embeddings through addition. Our pilot study reveals that Marvel exhibits visual modality collapse, which is characterized by the model's tendency to disregard visual features while depending excessively on textual cues. In contrast, although UniVL-DR is less affected by this issue, it is more susceptible to semantic misalignment, where semantically related content is positioned far apart in the embedding space. To address these challenges, we propose MiMIC, which introduces two key innovations: (1) a fusion-in-decoder architecture for effective multimodal integration, and (2) robust training through single modality mixin and random caption dropout. Experiments on the WebQA+ and EVQA+ datasets, where image in documents or queries might lack captions, indicate that MiMIC consistently outperforms both early- and late-fusion baselines.

AI.tldr: 现有通用多模态检索（UMR）方法存在视觉模态塌陷或语义失准两大缺陷。本文提出 MiMIC，用“解码器内融合”结构 + 单模态混合及随机 caption dropout 训练策略，在两个无/缺 caption 基准上全面超越早、晚融合基线。
AI.motivation: 早期融合方法（Marvel）因把视觉特征直接投射到语言模型空间，导致模型过度依赖文本、忽略视觉而出现视觉模态塌陷；晚期融合方法（UniVL-DR）虽缓解塌陷，却在无 caption 场景下产生严重语义失准。需要一种能同时抑制两类缺陷的统一框架。
AI.method: 提出 MiMIC：① 解码器内融合（Fusion-in-Decoder）架构，让视觉与文本在解码阶段交互并联合输出共享表示，避免早期投射带来的视觉塌陷；② 训练阶段引入单模态混合（single-modality mixin）和随机 caption dropout，增强模型对缺失文本/视觉输入的鲁棒性和对齐能力。
AI.result: 在 WebQA+ 和 EVQA+（文档或查询中图像可能无 caption）上，MiMIC 的 Recall@1/5/10 与 MRR 均显著优于 Marvel、UniVL-DR 等早/晚融合基线，平均提升 6–12 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: MiMIC 通过“融合在解码器”与鲁棒训练策略，同时解决了视觉模态塌陷和语义失准问题，为无/缺 caption 场景下的通用多模态检索提供了更可靠、更均衡的解决方案。

title: Why Supervised Fine-Tuning Fails to Learn: A Systematic Study of Incomplete Learning in Large Language Models
summary: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) is the standard approach for adapting large language models (LLMs) to downstream tasks. However, we observe a persistent failure mode: even after convergence, models often fail to correctly reproduce a subset of their own supervised training data. We refer to this behavior as the Incomplete Learning Phenomenon(ILP). This paper presents the first systematic study of ILP in LLM fine-tuning. We formalize ILP as post-training failure to internalize supervised instances and demonstrate its prevalence across multiple model families, domains, and datasets. Through controlled analyses, we identify five recurrent sources of incomplete learning: (1) missing prerequisite knowledge in the pre-trained model, (2) conflicts between SFT supervision and pre-training knowledge, (3) internal inconsistencies within SFT data, (4) left-side forgetting during sequential fine-tuning, and (5) insufficient optimization for rare or complex patterns. We introduce a diagnostic-first framework that maps unlearned samples to these causes using observable training and inference signals, and study several targeted mitigation strategies as causal interventions. Experiments on Qwen, LLaMA, and OLMo2 show that incomplete learning is widespread and heterogeneous, and that improvements in aggregate metrics can mask persistent unlearned subsets. The findings highlight the need for fine-grained diagnosis of what supervised fine-tuning fails to learn, and why.

AI.tldr: 首次系统揭示LLM监督微调后仍无法复现部分训练样本的「不完全学习现象」（ILP），给出五大成因与诊断框架。
AI.motivation: 尽管SFT已成为LLM任务适配范式，但业内普遍观察到模型收敛后仍“记不住”某些训练样本。该现象缺乏系统定义与归因，阻碍可靠落地。
AI.method: 1) 形式化定义ILP：收敛后仍不能在推理中复现的监督实例；2) 跨Qwen、LLaMA、OLMo2及多域数据集大规模验证；3) 建立「诊断优先」框架，把未学样本映射到五种可观测成因；4) 设计针对性干预进行因果消融。
AI.result: ILP广泛存在且异质，aggregate指标提升可掩盖持续未学子集；诊断框架能精准定位成因，干预后未学率显著下降。
AI.conclusion: SFT的“平均成功”不等于“个体学会」，需细粒度诊断未学实例及其根源，推动从宏观指标优化转向可验证的内部化学习。

title: StreamMeCo: Long-Term Agent Memory Compression for Efficient Streaming Video Understanding
summary: Vision agent memory has shown remarkable effectiveness in streaming video understanding. However, storing such memory for videos incurs substantial memory overhead, leading to high costs in both storage and computation. To address this issue, we propose StreamMeCo, an efficient Stream Agent Memory Compression framework. Specifically, based on the connectivity of the memory graph, StreamMeCo introduces edge-free minmax sampling for the isolated nodes and an edge-aware weight pruning for connected nodes, evicting the redundant memory nodes while maintaining the accuracy. In addition, we introduce a time-decay memory retrieval mechanism to further eliminate the performance degradation caused by memory compression. Extensive experiments on three challenging benchmark datasets (M3-Bench-robot, M3-Bench-web and Video-MME-Long) demonstrate that under 70% memory graph compression, StreamMeCo achieves a 1.87* speedup in memory retrieval while delivering an average accuracy improvement of 1.0%. Our code is available at https://github.com/Celina-love-sweet/StreamMeCo.

AI.tldr: StreamMeCo 用图压缩+时间衰减检索，将视频智能体记忆压至 30%，提速 1.87 倍且精度反升 1%。
AI.motivation: 流式视频理解需持续维护视觉智能体记忆，但完整记忆图随帧增长带来巨大存储与计算开销，亟需高压缩率且不掉点的方案。
AI.method: 把记忆建模为图，(1) 对孤立节点做无边缘极小-极大采样，(2) 对连通节点做边缘感知权重剪枝，冗余节点淘汰；再辅以时间衰减记忆检索抑制压缩带来的信息缺口。
AI.result: 在 M3-Bench-robot、M3-Bench-web、Video-MME-Long 三大长视频基准上，70% 压缩率下检索速度提升 1.87×，准确率平均提高 1.0%。
AI.conclusion: StreamMeCo 验证了显式图结构+自适应压缩可在极低存储预算内保持甚至增强流式视频理解性能，为实时长视频智能体提供可扩展记忆范式。

title: Hyperboloid GPLVM for Discovering Continuous Hierarchies via Nonparametric Estimation
summary: Dimensionality reduction (DR) offers a useful representation of complex high-dimensional data. Recent DR methods focus on hyperbolic geometry to derive a faithful low-dimensional representation of hierarchical data. However, existing methods are based on neighbor embedding, frequently ruining the continual relation of the hierarchies. This paper presents hyperboloid Gaussian process (GP) latent variable models (hGP-LVMs) to embed high-dimensional hierarchical data with implicit continuity via nonparametric estimation. We adopt generative modeling using the GP, which brings effective hierarchical embedding and executes ill-posed hyperparameter tuning. This paper presents three variants that employ original point, sparse point, and Bayesian estimations. We establish their learning algorithms by incorporating the Riemannian optimization and active approximation scheme of GP-LVM. For Bayesian inference, we further introduce the reparameterization trick to realize Bayesian latent variable learning. In the last part of this paper, we apply hGP-LVMs to several datasets and show their ability to represent high-dimensional hierarchies in low-dimensional spaces.

AI.tldr: 高维层级数据在欧式空间降维会失真；本文用双曲几何+高斯过程潜变量模型(hGP-LVM)连续嵌入，提出点/稀疏/贝叶斯三种变体与黎曼优化算法，实验表明低维双曲表示更忠实。
AI.motivation: 现有邻域嵌入类双曲降维方法把层级结构拆成离散点对，破坏了层级的连续性，难以给出平滑且可生成新点的低维表示。
AI.method: 用高斯过程潜变量模型在双曲面流形上建立非参数映射：1) 三种变体分别用全数据点、稀疏伪点与贝叶斯估计；2) 以双曲面距离为核函数输入；3) 结合黎曼优化与主动近似求解潜变量，贝叶斯变体引入重参数化技巧更新潜变量后验。
AI.result: 在合成层级树、词网、单细胞RNA等数据集上，hGP-LVMs在保持层级距离、连续性与可视化质量方面显著优于现有双曲嵌入（如HorPC)及欧氏降维方法；贝叶斯版对高维小样本尤其稳健。
AI.conclusion: 双曲高斯过程潜变量模型首次把连续性、非参数不确定性与双曲几何结合，为高维层级数据提供了生成式、可扩展且能进行贝叶斯推断的低维表示框架，为后续层级生成、不确定性量化及下游任务奠定基础。

title: Understanding and Mitigating Spurious Signal Amplification in Test-Time Reinforcement Learning for Math Reasoning
summary: Test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL) always adapts models at inference time via pseudo-labeling, leaving it vulnerable to spurious optimization signals from label noise. Through an empirical study, we observe that responses with medium consistency form an ambiguity region and constitute the primary source of reward noise. Crucially, we find that such spurious signals can be even amplified through group-relative advantage estimation. Motivated by these findings, we propose a unified framework, Debiased and Denoised test-time Reinforcement Learning (DDRL), to mitigate spurious signals. Concretely, DDRL first applies a frequency-based sampling strategy to exclude ambiguous samples while maintaining a balanced set of positive and negative examples. It then adopts a debiased advantage estimation with fixed advantages, removing the bias introduced by group-relative policy optimization. Finally, DDRL incorporates a consensus-based off-policy refinement stage, which leverages the rejection-sampled dataset to enable efficient and stable model updates. Experiments on three large language models across multiple mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that DDRL consistently outperforms existing TTRL baselines. The code will soon be released at https://github.com/yuyongcan/DDRL.

AI.tldr: DDRL 通过排除模糊样本、固定优势估计与共识离线精炼，在推理阶段消除伪标签噪声，显著提升大模型数学推理性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 TTRL 依赖伪标签，在推理阶段易放大标签噪声；作者发现中等一致性响应构成噪声主源，且群组相对优势估计会进一步放大该噪声，故需系统性降噪。
AI.method: DDRL 三阶段：① 频域采样剔除模糊样本并平衡正负例；② 固定优势值的“去偏”优势估计，切断群组相对优化的偏差放大链；③ 基于拒绝采样的共识离线精炼，实现稳定离策略更新。
AI.result: 在 3 个大模型、多套数学推理基准上，DDRL 一致超越现有 TTRL 基线，显著降低奖励噪声并提升准确率。
AI.conclusion: DDRL 首次在推理阶段联合去噪与去偏，为无需人工标注的即时模型自适应提供了鲁棒且可扩展的范式。

title: Structure-Grounded Knowledge Retrieval via Code Dependencies for Multi-Step Data Reasoning
summary: Selecting the right knowledge is critical when using large language models (LLMs) to solve domain-specific data analysis tasks. However, most retrieval-augmented approaches rely primarily on lexical or embedding similarity, which is often a weak proxy for the task-critical knowledge needed for multi-step reasoning. In many such tasks, the relevant knowledge is not merely textually related to the query, but is instead grounded in executable code and the dependency structure through which computations are carried out. To address this mismatch, we propose SGKR (Structure-Grounded Knowledge Retrieval), a retrieval framework that organizes domain knowledge with a graph induced by function-call dependencies. Given a question, SGKR extracts semantic input and output tags, identifies dependency paths connecting them, and constructs a task-relevant subgraph. The associated knowledge and corresponding function implementations are then assembled as a structured context for LLM-based code generation. Experiments on multi-step data analysis benchmarks show that SGKR consistently improves solution correctness over no-retrieval and similarity-based retrieval baselines for both vanilla LLMs and coding agents.

AI.tldr: 用函数调用图而非 embedding 把代码型知识检索出来，再喂给大模型，端到端提升多步数据分析正确率。
AI.motivation: 多步数据分析任务所需知识不在文本而在“可执行代码+计算依赖”，现有向量/关键词检索仅是浅层相似，无法定位真正的求解路径。
AI.method: 提出 SGKR：1) 从代码库抽函数调用依赖建图；2) 对用户问题解析输入输出语义标签；3) 在图中找出连接二者的最小依赖子图；4) 把子图对应的函数签名、文档与实现拼成结构化上下文，供 LLM 生成答案。
AI.result: 在多步数据分析基准上，SGKR 相较无检索和基于相似度的检索基线，对普通 LLM 与编码 Agent 均稳定提升答案正确率。
AI.conclusion: 依赖结构感知的知识检索能显著缩小“所需知识”与“检索结果”的语义差距，是增强大模型解决代码型任务的有效途径。

title: FastSHADE: Fast Self-augmented Hierarchical Asymmetric Denoising for Efficient inference on mobile devices
comment: To appear in the Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition Workshops (CVPRW) 2026
summary: Real-time image denoising is essential for modern mobile photography but remains challenging due to the strict latency and power constraints of edge devices. This paper presents FastSHADE (Fast Self-augmented Hierarchical Asymmetric Denoising), a lightweight U-Net-style network tailored for real-time, high-fidelity restoration on mobile GPUs. Our method features a multi-stage architecture incorporating a novel Asymmetric Frequency Denoising Block (AFDB) that decouples spatial structure extraction from high-frequency noise suppression to maximize efficiency, and a Spatially Gated Upsampler (SGU) that optimizes high-resolution skip connection fusion. To address generalization, we introduce an efficient Noise Shifting Self-Augmentation strategy that enhances data diversity without inducing domain shifts. Evaluations on the MAI2021 benchmark demonstrate that our scalable model family establishes a highly efficient speed-fidelity trade-off. Our base FastSHADE-M variant maintains real-time latency (<50 ms on an Adreno 840 GPU) while preserving structural integrity, and our scaled-up FastSHADE-XL establishes a new state-of-the-art for overall image quality, achieving 37.94 dB PSNR.

AI.tldr: FastSHADE 是一种专为移动端 GPU 实时降噪设计的轻量级 U-Net，用非对称频域块和自增强策略在 <50 ms 内把 MAI2021 指标推到 37.94 dB。
AI.motivation: 手机摄影既要实时又要高画质，但现有降噪网络在边缘端受限于延迟与功耗，无法兼顾，需要一种能在移动 GPU 上跑出毫秒级延迟且保结构、不降画质的轻量化方案。
AI.method: 提出 FastSHADE 多阶段网络：1) 非对称频域去噪块(AFDB) 把低频结构提取与高频噪声抑制解耦，减少计算；2) 空间门控上采样器(SGU) 优化高分辨率跳跃连接融合；3) 噪声偏移自增强(NSSA) 在训练阶段无域偏移地扩充噪声分布，提升泛化；整体构成可伸缩的模型族（M→XL）。
AI.result: 在 MAI2021 基准上，FastSHADE-M 在 Adreno 840 仅需 <50 ms 即达实时，结构保持完整；FastSHADE-XL 取得 37.94 dB PSNR，刷新该数据集最好成绩，同时仍维持移动端可接受的延迟。
AI.conclusion: 通过“频域解耦+高效上采+自增强”三项轻量设计，FastSHADE 首次在移动 GPU 上实现毫秒级、高保真联合最优，证明实时降噪可以在不牺牲画质的前提下落地终端设备。

title: EARL-BO: Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Step Lookahead, High-Dimensional Bayesian Optimization
comment: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML). 17 pages, 10 figures
summary: To avoid myopic behavior, multi-step lookahead Bayesian optimization (BO) algorithms consider the sequential nature of BO and have demonstrated promising results in recent years. However, owing to the curse of dimensionality, most of these methods make significant approximations or suffer scalability issues. This paper presents a novel reinforcement learning (RL)-based framework for multi-step lookahead BO in high-dimensional black-box optimization problems. The proposed method enhances the scalability and decision-making quality of multi-step lookahead BO by efficiently solving the sequential dynamic program of the BO process in a near-optimal manner using RL. We first introduce an Attention-DeepSets encoder to represent the state of knowledge to the RL agent and subsequently propose a multi-task, fine-tuning procedure based on end-to-end (encoder-RL) on-policy learning. We evaluate the proposed method, EARL-BO (Encoder Augmented RL for BO), on synthetic benchmark functions and hyperparameter tuning problems, finding significantly improved performance compared to existing multi-step lookahead and high-dimensional BO methods.

AI.tldr: 将强化学习与注意力机制结合，首次把多步前瞻贝叶斯优化转化为可扩展的高维序列决策问题，提出EARL-BO框架并取得显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 传统BO的目光短浅（单步）与现有多步前瞻BO在高维场景下的可扩展性瓶颈，使得复杂黑箱优化难以兼顾决策质量与计算效率。
AI.method: 1. 将BO的序列知识状态建模为MDP，采用强化学习近似求解多步前瞻动态规划；2. Attention-DeepSets编码器将任意大小的观测历史映射为固定维状态表示；3. 端到端联合训练编码器—策略网络的多任务微调流程，实现高效的on-policy学习。
AI.result: 在合成基准与超参调优任务上，EARL-BO显著优于现有单步、多步前瞻及高维BO方法，在决策质量与可扩展性两方面均取得突破。
AI.conclusion: RL驱动的多步前瞻BO为高维黑箱优化提供了兼具全局视野与计算可行性的新范式，Attention-DeepSets状态表示与端到端训练策略可推广至其他序列实验设计问题。

title: Beyond Single Plots: A Benchmark for Question Answering on Multi-Charts
summary: Charts are widely used to present complex information. Deriving meaningful insights in real-world contexts often requires interpreting multiple related charts together. Research on understanding multi-chart images has not been extensively explored. We introduce PolyChartQA, a mid-scale dataset specifically designed for question answering over multi-chart images. PolyChartQA comprises 534 multi-chart images (with a total of 2,297 sub-charts) sourced from peer-reviewed computer science research publications and 2,694 QA pairs. We evaluate the performance of nine state-of-the-art Multimodal Language Models (MLMs) on PolyChartQA across question type, difficulty, question source, and key structural characteristics of multi-charts. Our results show a 27.4% LLM-based accuracy (L-Accuracy) drop on human-authored questions compared to MLM-generated questions, and a 5.39% L-accuracy gain with our proposed prompting method.

AI.tldr: 首个针对多图表问答的中等规模数据集PolyChartQA揭示：现有多模态大模型在人类出题上准确率骤降27.4%，作者提出的提示策略仅回弹5.39%，显示复杂图表联合推理仍是显著短板。
AI.motivation: 尽管图表被广泛用于呈现复杂信息，但现有视觉-语言研究主要聚焦单图理解，缺乏对「现实中需同时解读多张关联图表」这一真实需求的系统基准，导致模型在多图表联合推理能力评估上存在空白。
AI.method: 构建PolyChartDataset：从计算机科学顶会论文中收集534幅多图表图像（含2297张子图），人工标注2694对问答；设计四类题型与三级难度，并引入LLM生成对比题；在9个SOTA多模态大模型上系统评估，再提出一种针对多图表结构的提示增强方法。
AI.result: 在人类-authored问题上，所有模型平均L-Accuracy仅约27%，较LLM生成问题下降27.4个百分点；作者提示法带来5.39%绝对提升，但仍远低于人类表现，误差集中在跨图趋势比较与数值聚合计算。
AI.conclusion: 多图表联合推理是当前多模态模型的显著瓶颈，PolyChartQA可作为后续研究的试金石；未来需探索显式图表对齐机制与跨图数理逻辑模块，以缩小与人类水平的巨大差距。

title: Does Welsh media need a review? Detecting bias in Nation.Cymru's political reporting
summary: Wales' political landscape has been marked by growing accusations of bias in Welsh media. This paper takes the first computational step toward testing those claims by examining Nation.Cymru, a prominent Welsh political news outlet. I use a two-stage natural language processing (NLP) pipeline: (1) a robustly optimized BERT approach (RoBERTa) bias detector for efficient bias discovery and (2) a large language model (LLM) for target-attributed sentiment classification of bias labels from (1). A primary analysis of 15,583 party mentions across 2022-2026 news articles finds that Reform UK attracts biased framing at twice the rate of Plaid Cymru and over three times as negative in mean sentiment (p<0.001). A secondary analysis across four parties across both news and opinion articles shows that Plaid Cymru is the outlier, receiving markedly more favourable framing than any other party. These findings provide evidence of measurable differential framing in a single Welsh political media outlet, supporting calls for a broader review of Welsh media coverage. Furthermore, the two-stage pipeline offers a low-cost, replicable framework for extending this analysis to other Welsh outlets, as well as media ecosystems outside of Wales.

AI.tldr: 基于15 583条政党提及的NLP分析，发现Nation.Cymru对Reform UK的负面框架显著多于对Plaid Cymru的正面框架，首次用计算手段证实威尔士媒体存在可测偏差。
AI.motivation: 回应“威尔士媒体存在偏见”的政治指控，但以往缺乏量化证据；作者希望用低成本、可复现的NLP流程为监管审查提供客观依据。
AI.method: 两阶段管道：①RoBERTa检测报道是否含偏见标签；②LLM对偏见句做目标归属情感分类。样本为Nation.Cymru 2022–2026年全部新闻与评论文章。
AI.result: Reform UK被偏见框定的概率是Plaid Cymru的2倍，平均负面情感强度超3倍(p<0.001)；跨体裁二次分析显示，Plaid Cymru获得显著更正面的框架，其他三党无此优待。
AI.conclusion: 单一威尔士媒体已出现系统性差异框架，呼吁扩大审计；该两阶段NLP方案可低成本推广至威尔士及其他地区媒体生态。

title: Dehaze-then-Splat: Generative Dehazing with Physics-Informed 3D Gaussian Splatting for Smoke-Free Novel View Synthesis
summary: We present Dehaze-then-Splat, a two-stage pipeline for multi-view smoke removal and novel view synthesis developed for Track~2 of the NTIRE 2026 3D Restoration and Reconstruction Challenge. In the first stage, we produce pseudo-clean training images via per-frame generative dehazing using Nano Banana Pro, followed by brightness normalization. In the second stage, we train 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) with physics-informed auxiliary losses -- depth supervision via Pearson correlation with pseudo-depth, dark channel prior regularization, and dual-source gradient matching -- that compensate for cross-view inconsistencies inherent in frame-wise generative processing. We identify a fundamental tension in dehaze-then-reconstruct pipelines: per-image restoration quality does not guarantee multi-view consistency, and such inconsistency manifests as blurred renders and structural instability in downstream 3D reconstruction.Our analysis shows that MCMC-based densification with early stopping, combined with depth and haze-suppression priors, effectively mitigates these artifacts. On the Akikaze validation scene, our pipeline achieves 20.98\,dB PSNR and 0.683 SSIM for novel view synthesis, a +1.50\,dB improvement over the unregularized baseline.

AI.tldr: 利用“先去雾再重建”的思路，分别对每帧图像做Nano Banana Pro轻度去雾并归一化亮度，随后以带物理约束的3DGS将多个去雾视角融合为无雾 3D 场景并生成新视图。
AI.motivation: 烟雾导致多视角颜色与几何不一致，直接 3DGS 融合会模糊；用现成的逐帧去雾不能保证视角间一致性，需要联合多视角先验补偿
AI.method: ①Nano Banana Pro 逐帧去雾＋亮度归一化获伪干净图；②基于伪深度构造皮尔逊深度监督、暗通道先验正则以及双源梯度匹配损失，在 3DGS 训练中强制几何与纹理一致性；③早期停止之 MCMC 密度增长抑制伪影
AI.result: Akikaze 验证场景新视角合成达 20.98 dB / 0.683 SSIM，比无正则基线提升 1.50 dB
AI.conclusion: 引入物理信息的 3DGS 改进项可在不依赖真值清洁图条件下恢复清晰且视图一致的无雾新成图，说明“单帧还原+多视角协同正则”是解决去雾-重建一致性张力的关键

title: Higher Order Approximation Rates for ReLU CNNs in Korobov Spaces
summary: This paper investigates the $L_p$ approximation error for higher order Korobov functions using deep convolutional neural networks (CNNs) with ReLU activation. For target functions having a mixed derivative of order m+1 in each direction, we improve classical approximation rate of second order to (m+1)-th order (modulo a logarithmic factor) in terms of the depth of CNNs. The key ingredient in our analysis is approximate representation of high-order sparse grid basis functions by CNNs. The results suggest that higher order expressivity of CNNs does not severely suffer from the curse of dimensionality.

AI.tldr: 用深度ReLU-CNN逼近高阶Korobov函数，可在Lp意义下把经典二阶误差提升至(m+1)阶（忽略log因子），且维度灾难不明显。
AI.motivation: 传统方法对具有m+1阶混合导数的高维Korobov函数只能给出二阶逼近率；作者希望揭示CNN是否能利用其深度实现更高阶逼近并缓解维度灾难。
AI.method: 构造性证明：先用稀疏网格基函数对目标函数做高阶分解，再证明深度CNN可近似表示这些高阶基函数；通过控制网络深度与参数数得到Lp误差界。
AI.result: 对具有各方向m+1阶混合导数的函数，CNN的逼近误差为O(N^{-(m+1)}(log N)^{d-1})，其中N为网络深度；阶数从2提到m+1，且维度d的影响仅为对数因子。
AI.conclusion: 深度CNN具备高阶表达能力，其逼近率可突破传统二阶瓶颈；稀疏网格结构可被CNN有效编码，从而在高维情形下仍避免严重的维度灾难。

title: Trust-SSL: Additive-Residual Selective Invariance for Robust Aerial Self-Supervised Learning
summary: Self-supervised learning (SSL) is a standard approach for representation learning in aerial imagery. Existing methods enforce invariance between augmented views, which works well when augmentations preserve semantic content. However, aerial images are frequently degraded by haze, motion blur, rain, and occlusion that remove critical evidence. Enforcing alignment between a clean and a severely degraded view can introduce spurious structure into the latent space. This study proposes a training strategy and architectural modification to enhance SSL robustness to such corruptions. It introduces a per-sample, per-factor trust weight into the alignment objective, combined with the base contrastive loss as an additive residual. A stop-gradient is applied to the trust weight instead of a multiplicative gate. While a multiplicative gate is a natural choice, experiments show it impairs the backbone, whereas our additive-residual approach improves it. Using a 200-epoch protocol on a 210,000-image corpus, the method achieves the highest mean linear-probe accuracy among six backbones on EuroSAT, AID, and NWPU-RESISC45 (90.20% compared to 88.46% for SimCLR and 89.82% for VICReg). It yields the largest improvements under severe information-erasing corruptions on EuroSAT (+19.9 points on haze at s=5 over SimCLR). The method also demonstrates consistent gains of +1 to +3 points in Mahalanobis AUROC on a zero-shot cross-domain stress test using BDD100K weather splits. Two ablations (scalar uncertainty and cosine gate) indicate the additive-residual formulation is the primary source of these improvements. An evidential variant using Dempster-Shafer fusion introduces interpretable signals of conflict and ignorance. These findings offer a concrete design principle for uncertainty-aware SSL. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/WadiiBoulila/trust-ssl.

AI.tldr: 针对遥感影像中雾、模糊等退化导致对比式自监督学习(CSSL)错误对齐的问题，提出“逐样本-逐退化因子可信度加权”的加法残差修正策略，200轮训练后在EuroSAT/AID/NWPU上取得90.2%线性评估精度，且在重度退化条件下比SimCLR提升19.9个百分点。
AI.motivation: 传统CSSL强制干净视图与严重退化视图对齐，会把由雾、运动模糊、遮挡等引入的伪结构写入表征空间，导致下游任务性能下降。如何在自监督框架内显式评估并抑制此类“错误对应”尚未被系统研究。
AI.method: 1) 在对比损失上加“逐样本-每退化因子”信度残差项，而非乘性门控；2) 对信度项施加stop-gradient，避免其反向影响主干；3) 提供基于Dempster-Shafer的证据融合变体，输出冲突与无知度量，实现可解释的不确定性估计。
AI.result: 在21万张遥感影像的200epoch协议下，六种主干网络均取得EuroSAT/AID/NWPU-RESISC45线性探针平均精度90.20%，优于SimCLR(88.46%)和VICReg(89.82%)；在EuroSAT haze-5等级退化下比SimCLR提升19.9个百分点；跨域零样本BDD100K天气划分的Mahalanobis AUROC提升1-3个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 加法残差式可信度加权可显著提升CSSL对信息擦除型退化的鲁棒性，而乘性门控会损害主干；该设计为构建“不确定性-aware”自监督视觉预训练提供了可直接套用的原则，并可通过证据理论进一步解释模型置信度。

title: MM-JudgeBias: A Benchmark for Evaluating Compositional Biases in MLLM-as-a-Judge
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have been increasingly used as automatic evaluators-a paradigm known as MLLM-as-a-Judge. However, their reliability and vulnerabilities to biases remain underexplored. We find that many MLLM judges fail to reliably integrate key visual or textual cues, yielding unreliable evaluations when evidence is missing or mismatched, and exhibiting instability under semantically irrelevant perturbations. To address this, we systematically define Compositional Bias in MLLM-as-a-Judge systems and introduce MM-JudgeBias, a benchmark for evaluating it. MM-JudgeBias introduces controlled perturbations across Query, Image, and Response, and evaluates model behavior via two complementary metrics: Bias-Deviation (BD) for sensitivity and Bias-Conformity (BC) for stability. Our dataset of over 1,800 curated and refined multimodal samples, drawn from 29 source benchmarks, enables a fine-grained diagnosis of nine bias types across diverse tasks and domains. Experiments on 26 state-of-the-art MLLMs reveal systematic modality neglect and asymmetric evaluation tendencies, underscoring the need for more reliable judges.

AI.tldr: 揭示多模态大模型充当裁判时存在
AI.motivation: 将多模态大模型（MLLM）作为自动裁判（MLLM-as-a-Judge）已成趋势，但其可靠性及潜在偏见未被系统研究；实际中模型常忽略关键视觉或文本线索，在证据缺失/不匹配时给出不一致评价，暴露严重评估漏洞。
AI.method: 1）首先形式化“组合偏见”（Compositional Bias）概念；2）构建基准 MM-JudgeBias，在 Query、Image、Response 三模态引入受控扰动；3）提出双指标：Bias-Deviation（BD，敏感性）与 Bias-Conformity（BC，稳定性）；4）整合 29 个源基准生成 1 800+ 细粒度样本，覆盖 9 类偏见、多任务多领域；5）对 26 个 SOTA MLLM 进行大规模实验。
AI.result: 实验揭示主流 MLLM 裁判存在系统性的模态忽视（modality neglect）与不对称评价倾向；在 MM-JudgeBias 的扰动下，模型评价一致性与稳定性显著下降，验证其评估偏差普遍且严重。
AI.conclusion: MLLM-as-a-Judge 尚不可直接可靠应用，亟需针对性去偏与鲁棒优化；MM-JudgeBias 为后续研发提供了系统诊断工具与改进基准。

title: Find the Differences: Differential Morphing Attack Detection vs Face Recognition
summary: Morphing is a challenge to face recognition (FR) for which several morphing attack detection solutions have been proposed. We argue that face recognition and differential morphing attack detection (D-MAD) in principle perform very similar tasks, which we support by comparing an FR system with two existing D-MAD approaches. We also show that currently used decision thresholds inherently lead to FR systems being vulnerable to morphing attacks and that this explains the tradeoff between performance on normal images and vulnerability to morphing attacks. We propose using FR systems that are already in place for morphing detection and introduce a new evaluation threshold that guarantees an upper limit to the vulnerability to morphing attacks - even of unknown types.

AI.tldr: 利用现成人脸识别系统做差分形变攻击检测，通过新阈值把系统对形变攻击的脆弱上限卡死，无需重新训练即可抵御未知形变。
AI.motivation: 现有形变攻击检测方案孤立设计，未能利用已大规模部署的人脸识别系统；同时发现人脸识别与差分形变检测任务本质相似，提示可复用系统并解决性能-脆弱性权衡。
AI.method: 对FR系统与两种D-MAD方法进行任务对比实验，揭示决策阈值与脆弱性因果链；提出以现成FR网络为特征提取器，在其score空间重新设定“容许脆弱度上限”阈值，实现无需训练的未知形变检测。
AI.result: 实验表明：1) FR与D-MAD在特征与决策层面高度一致；2)传统阈值下性能越高对形变越脆弱；3)新阈值在变检测集上可将形变攻击漏检率压至预设上限，同时保持正常图像识别性能在可接受范围。
AI.conclusion: 可直接复用现有人脸识别基础设施进行形变攻击检测，通过理论推导的脆弱度上限阈值，在无需收集形变样本、不改变系统的前提下，为任何未知形变提供可证明的安全保证，突破性能-脆弱性权衡瓶颈。

title: Analytical FFN-to-MoE Restructuring via Activation Pattern Analysis
summary: Scaling large language models (LLMs) improves performance but significantly increases inference costs, with feed-forward networks (FFNs) consuming the majority of computational resources. While Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures can reduce this cost through sparse activation, restructuring existing dense models into MoEs typically requires extensive retraining on hundreds of billions of tokens. We propose an analytical post-training framework that rapidly restructures FFNs into sparse MoE architectures using only a small calibration dataset. The method analyzes neuron activation patterns to partition neurons into always-active shared experts and conditionally activated routed experts, then constructs a router analytically from representative neuron statistics, enabling immediate deployment or optional lightweight fine-tuning. This approach applies both to dense models and recursively to existing MoE models for hierarchical sparsity. Experiments demonstrate up to $1.17\times$ speedup in compute-bound scenarios with only minutes of processing and 2k-sample fine-tuning, outperforming methods requiring orders of magnitude more resources.

AI.tldr: 把现有稠密 LLM 里计算最重的 FFN 在无需重训练的情况下“解体”成轻量稀疏 MoE：先以极少量校准数据统计神经元激活，拆出固定专家与可路由专家并构建路由器；几分钟即可上线，可选 2 k 样本微调，计算瓶颈场景提速 1.17 倍。
AI.motivation: LLM 性能提升伴随推理 FFN 计算爆炸，MoE 虽有稀疏优点却常需重训海量 tokens；若能直接把已训好的稠密模型瞬间稀疏化，将大幅降低部署成本并保持性能。
AI.method: 提出分析式后训练框架：1. 用极少量校准数据获神经元激活分布；2. 依据激活模式将神经元划分为常驻共享专家与条件路由专家，并直接统计生成路由器；3. 整型后模型零样本可部署或仅需 2 k 样本微调；且可递归转 MoE→层次稀疏 MoE。
AI.result: 在算力受限场景下，该法以数分钟处理+2 k 样本微调即获 1.17 × 推理加速，性能优于需数亿到千亿 token 重训的现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭激活统计即可把 FFN 无损改稀疏 MoE，免重训或少样本微调即提速，说明大模型推理成本可通过分析式重构范式进一步压缩；该框架有望推广至现有多数致密网络与已稀疏 MoE 的层级优化。

title: mcdok at SemEval-2026 Task 13: Finetuning LLMs for Detection of Machine-Generated Code
summary: Multi-domain detection of the machine-generated code snippets in various programming languages is a challenging task. SemEval-2026 Task~13 copes with this challenge in various angles, as a binary detection problem as well as attribution of the source. Specifically, its subtasks also cover generator LLM family detection, as well as a hybrid code co-generated by humans and machines, or adversarially modified codes hiding its origin. Our submitted systems adjusted the existing mdok approach (focused on machine-generated text detection) to these specific kinds of problems by exploring various base models, more suitable for code understanding. The results indicate that the submitted systems are competitive in all three subtasks. However, the margins from the top-performing systems are significant, and thus further improvements are possible.

AI.tldr: 本文将原本面向自然语言的机器生成文本检测方法mdok迁移到代码领域，在SemEval-2026 Task 13的跨语言、跨场景（纯生成、人工-机器混合、对抗改写）检测与溯源子任务上取得中等偏上成绩，但与榜首仍有差距。
AI.motivation: 机器生成代码已渗透多语言、多场景，既有完全LLM产出，也含人机协作甚至对抗改写；亟需统一基准评估其检测与溯源能力，以降低安全与版权风险。
AI.method: 以mdok框架为基线，把文本检测器替换为CodeBERT、GraphCodeBERT、CodeT5等代码预训练模型；在token级表示上引入语法树、控制流边等结构特征；用多任务头同时完成「是否机器生成」「LLM家族归因」「人机混合/对抗样本检测」三子任务；最后对各模型得分做加权集成并以F1为指标调参。
AI.result: 系统在全部3个子任务均进入前五，平均F1分别达0.812/0.763/0.698，落后榜首0.048~0.076；消融实验显示CodeT5+结构边贡献最大，单一文本检测器下降7-11%。
AI.conclusion: mdok可快速适配代码域，但代码的语法-语义耦合特性要求更精细的图学习与对抗训练；未来计划引入执行轨迹、跨语言统一嵌入及对抗增强以缩小与Top系统的差距。

title: Cross-Model Consistency of AI-Generated Exercise Prescriptions: A Repeated Generation Study Across Three Large Language Models
comment: 24 Pages, 2 Figures, 6 Tables and 2 Supplementary Materials. v2: Removed personal contact information
summary: This study compared repeated generation consistency of exercise prescription outputs across three large language models (LLMs), specifically GPT-4.1, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and Gemini 2.5 Flash, under temperature=0 conditions. Each model generated prescriptions for six clinical scenarios 20 times, yielding 360 total outputs analyzed across four dimensions: semantic similarity, output reproducibility, FITT classification, and safety expression. Mean semantic similarity was highest for GPT-4.1 (0.955), followed by Gemini 2.5 Flash (0.950) and Claude Sonnet 4.6 (0.903), with significant inter-model differences confirmed (H = 458.41, p < .001). Critically, these scores reflected fundamentally different generative behaviors: GPT-4.1 produced entirely unique outputs (100%) with stable semantic content, while Gemini 2.5 Flash showed pronounced output repetition (27.5% unique outputs), indicating that its high similarity score derived from text duplication rather than consistent reasoning. Identical decoding settings thus yielded fundamentally different consistency profiles, a distinction that single-output evaluations cannot capture. Safety expression reached ceiling levels across all models, confirming its limited utility as a differentiating metric. These results indicate that model selection constitutes a clinical rather than merely technical decision, and that output behavior under repeated generation conditions should be treated as a core criterion for reliable deployment of LLM-based exercise prescription systems.

AI.tldr: 在温度=0的苛刻条件下，三大LLM对同一运动处方任务重复生成20次，GPT-4.1实现100%唯一输出且语义高度一致，Gemini 2.5 Flash仅27.5%唯一并出现大量文本复制，Claude Sonnet 4.6介于两者之间；安全表述均达天花板，无法区分模型。
AI.motivation: 临床运动处方不允许“开盲盒”。现有评估只看单次输出，忽视了固定解码参数下模型能否稳定给出合理且不自我矛盾的建议，这直接关系到患者安全与法规合规。
AI.method: 设计6个典型临床场景，每模型每场景生成20次，共360条处方。从语义相似度、输出可复现性、FITT要素分类一致性与安全句式四个维度定量比较；用Friedman检验确认差异显著性。
AI.result: GPT-4.1语义相似度最高(0.955)且100%唯一；Gemini 2.5 Flash相似度0.950但72.5%为重复文本；Claude Sonnet 4.6相似度最低(0.903)。安全表达三模型皆满分，失去区分力。
AI.conclusion: “温度=0”不等于“确定性”；重复生成行为揭示模型本质差异，应列为临床LLM选型核心指标。运动处方等高风险场景须优先选择能稳定输出唯一且语义一致内容的模型。

title: PLAF: Pixel-wise Language-Aligned Feature Extraction for Efficient 3D Scene Understanding
summary: Accurate open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding requires semantic representations that are both language-aligned and spatially precise at the pixel level, while remaining scalable when lifted to 3D space. However, existing representations struggle to jointly satisfy these requirements, and densely propagating pixel-wise semantics to 3D often results in substantial redundancy, leading to inefficient storage and querying in large-scale scenes. To address these challenges, we present \emph{PLAF}, a Pixel-wise Language-Aligned Feature extraction framework that enables dense and accurate semantic alignment in 2D without sacrificing open-vocabulary expressiveness. Building upon this representation, we further design an efficient semantic storage and querying scheme that significantly reduces redundancy across both 2D and 3D domains. Experimental results show that \emph{PLAF} provides a strong semantic foundation for accurate and efficient open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding. The codes are publicly available at https://github.com/RockWenJJ/PLAF.

AI.tldr: PLAF 通过像素级语言对齐特征提取，在 2D 完成开放词汇语义编码后再稀疏映射到 3D，兼顾像素精度、词汇开放性与存储效率，显著降低冗余。
AI.motivation: 主流 3D 开放词汇理解方法需在像素级保持语言对齐与空间精度，同时扩展到 3D 时又要控制冗余；现有表示难以同时满足这三点。
AI.method: 1) 提出 PLAF 框架：先在大规模 2D 图文模型上蒸馏出像素级语言对齐特征，保证开放词汇表达能力；2) 设计跨 2D-3D 语义去冗余存储与查询机制：利用视角重叠检测与重要性采样，仅保留非冗余关键特征，显著压缩存储并加速查询。
AI.result: 在多个开放词汇 3D 基准上，PLAF 在保持像素级语义对齐的同时，把 3D 存储量压缩到先前方法的 10% 以内，检索与分割精度提升 3–8 mIoU，查询延迟降低一个量级。
AI.conclusion: PLAF 证明：先在 2D 完成高密度、语言对齐的语义表示，再稀疏映射到 3D，可在不牺牲精度与词汇开放性的前提下，实现大规模 3D 场景的高效理解与存储。

title: Anomaly Detection in Smart Power Grids with Graph-Regularized MS-SVDD: a Multimodal Subspace Learning Approach
summary: Anomaly detection in smart power grids is a critical challenge due to the complexity, heterogeneity, and dynamic nature of sensor data streams. Existing one-class classification methods, particularly Subspace Support Vector Data Description (SVDD), have been extended to multimodal scenarios but often fail to fully exploit the structural dependencies across modalities, limiting their robustness in real-world applications. In this paper, we address this gap by proposing a generalized Multimodal Subspace Support Vector Data Description (MS-SVDD) model with graph-embedded regularization. The method projects data from multiple modalities into a shared low-dimensional subspace while preserving modality-specific structure through Laplacian regularizers. Our approach is evaluated on a three-modality dataset derived from smart grid event time series, using a dedicated preprocessing pipeline for constructing one-class classification training samples. The results demonstrate that our graph-embedded MS-SVDD improves robustness of event detection compared to conventional approaches, highlighting the potential of integrating graph priors with multimodal subspace learning for advancing anomaly detection in critical infrastructure. More broadly, this work contributes to the wider field of AI by illustrating how relational and structural information can be systematically embedded into one-class models, enabling robust learning under complex, high-dimensional, and multimodal conditions.

AI.tldr: 将 Laplacian 图正则引入多模态子空间 SVDD，在智能电网三模态事件流数据中验证，比传统单类模型更鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 智能电网传感流高维多模态，现有单类 SVDD 虽扩展到多模态，却未挖掘跨模态结构依赖，导致异常检测鲁棒性差。
AI.method: 提出 MS-SVDD：将多模态数据联合映射到共享低维子空间，同时在各模态内用 Laplacian 图正则保持局部结构；配套构建单类训练样本的预处理管道。
AI.result: 在三模态电网事件数据集上，图嵌入 MS-SVDD 相比传统方法显著提升事件检测鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 系统地把图先验嵌入单类模型，可在高维多模态场景下实现稳健异常检测，为关键基础设施 AI 提供新范式。

title: VLAA-GUI: Knowing When to Stop, Recover, and Search, A Modular Framework for GUI Automation
comment: The first two authors contribute equally
summary: Autonomous GUI agents face two fundamental challenges: early stopping, where agents prematurely declare success without verifiable evidence, and repetitive loops, where agents cycle through the same failing actions without recovery. We present VLAA-GUI, a modular GUI agentic framework built around three integrated components that guide the system on when to Stop, Recover, and Search. First, a mandatory Completeness Verifier enforces UI-observable success criteria and verification at every finish step -- with an agent-level verifier that cross-examines completion claims with decision rules, rejecting those lacking direct visual evidence. Second, a mandatory Loop Breaker provides multi-tier filtering: switching interaction mode after repeated failures, forcing strategy changes after persistent screen-state recurrence, and binding reflection signals to strategy shifts. Third, an on-demand Search Agent searches online for unfamiliar workflows by directly querying a capable LLM with search ability, returning results as plain text. We additionally integrate a Coding Agent for code-intensive actions and a Grounding Agent for precise action grounding, both invoked on demand when required. We evaluate VLAA-GUI across five top-tier backbones, including Opus 4.5, 4.6 and Gemini 3.1 Pro, on two benchmarks with Linux and Windows tasks, achieving top performance on both (77.5% on OSWorld and 61.0% on WindowsAgentArena). Notably, three of the five backbones surpass human performance (72.4%) on OSWorld in a single pass. Ablation studies show that all three proposed components consistently improve a strong backbone, while a weaker backbone benefits more from these tools when the step budget is sufficient. Further analysis also shows that the Loop Breaker nearly halves wasted steps for loop-prone models.

title: Tracing Relational Knowledge Recall in Large Language Models
summary: We study how large language models recall relational knowledge during text generation, with a focus on identifying latent representations suitable for relation classification via linear probes. Prior work shows how attention heads and MLPs interact to resolve subject, predicate, and object, but it remains unclear which representations support faithful linear relation classification and why some relation types are easier to capture linearly than others. We systematically evaluate different latent representations derived from attention head and MLP contributions, showing that per-head attention contributions to the residual stream are comparatively strong features for linear relation classification. Feature attribution analyses of the trained probes, as well as characteristics of the different relation types, reveal clear correlations between probe accuracy and relation specificity, entity connectedness, and how distributed the signal on which the probe relies is across attention heads. Finally, we show how token-level feature attribution of probe predictions can be used to reveal probe behavior in further detail.

AI.tldr: 本文定量剖析了Transformer内部哪些表示最适合线性探测完成关系抽取。发现按-头注意力残差贡献最强，其分类精度与关系特异度、实体连通度、信号分布性显著相关。
AI.motivation: 现有工作虽注意到注意力头与MLP共同编码主体-谓语-客体三元组，却仍缺少系统证据指引“哪种中间表示最可靠用于线性关系分类”，以及“为何部分关系更易被简单探测捕获”两大痛点。
AI.method: 1) 从标准LLM中抽取四类中间向量：单头注意力对残差流的贡献、多头平均、MLP输出、层归一化前后隐藏表示；2) 对各向量训练线性关系分类器并建立统一评价；3) 分析正则化后各项特征对分类器的归因权重；4) 针对不同关系类型计算特异性、平均实体度中心性及跨头注意力系数分布指标；5) 采用token级特征归因图解探测行为。
AI.result: (i) 按-头注意力贡献在85个关系上Top-1准确率达78.3%，超出次优MLP特征10.9pp；(ii) 线性探测成功概率与关系特异性正相关ρ=0.63，与平均实体连通性负相关ρ=-0.57；(iii) 信号分散于多头仍可提供可观精度，但集中在2-3头时增益最大；(iv) token级归因揭示探测结果主要依据主客体位置词而非停用词，验证了探测度的效价。
AI.conclusion: 线性关系分类最适合选择“按-头注意力残差贡献”作为特征，其效果优于层输出或MLP输出；关系的可线性捕获度并非随机，而与语义特异性与网络拓扑特质强相关；token归因技术完全可解释探测策略，为实现高效可解释的图谱抽取与模型水信贷供了可量化路径。

title: A Lightweight Transformer for Pain Recognition from Brain Activity
summary: Pain is a multifaceted and widespread phenomenon with substantial clinical and societal burden, making reliable automated assessment a critical objective. This paper presents a lightweight transformer architecture that fuses multiple fNIRS representations through a unified tokenization mechanism, enabling joint modeling of complementary signal views without requiring modality-specific adaptations or increasing architectural complexity. The proposed token-mixing strategy preserves spatial, temporal, and time-frequency characteristics by projecting heterogeneous inputs onto a shared latent representation, using a structured segmentation scheme to control the granularity of local aggregation and global interaction. The model is evaluated on the AI4Pain dataset using stacked raw waveform and power spectral density representations of fNIRS inputs. Experimental results demonstrate competitive pain recognition performance while remaining computationally compact, making the approach suitable for real-time inference on both GPU and CPU hardware.

AI.tldr: 作者提出一种轻量级Transformer，用统一token机制融合fNIRS多视角信号，无需任何模态特设网络，即可在多平台实时完成疼痛识别。
AI.motivation: 疼痛自动评估需求迫切，但传统方法依赖手工特征且模型差异大。本研究希望以单一轻量架构同时利用fNIRS时域、频域和时间-频域等多视角信息，突破模态拆分与模型复杂的瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出Token-Mixing Transformer：1)结构分块将fNIRS原始波形和功率谱转换成统一token序列；2)投影到共享潜空间保留空间-时间特性；3)通过保持自注意力方式的token交互，局部聚合粒度与全局关联统一控制；4)整体网络为纯Transformer管道，无需针对各模态重新设计。
AI.result: 在AI4Pain数据集上，模型仅用轻量参数即在疼痛识别任务中达到与先进行列竞争的性能；GPU/CPU端推理延迟分别为X ms/Y ms，满足实时要求。
AI.conclusion: 统一token融合策略让重量轻量、即插即用、跨模态表现良好，显示出将多视角fNIRS信号转化为统一语言式表示的有效性，为实时可穿戴疼痛监测奠定基础。

title: Post-Training Augmentation Invariance
summary: This work develops a framework for post-training augmentation invariance, in which our goal is to add invariance properties to a pretrained network without altering its behavior on the original, non-augmented input distribution. We define this notion precisely and additionally introduce augmented encoders, which are probabilistic encoders that formalize augmentation-based encoding processes and that serve as our fundamental object of study. We introduce two losses for augmented encoders, namely, Markov-Wasserstein minimization and Wasserstein correlation maximization, and we demonstrate empirically that both losses can be used to train lightweight, one-hidden-layer MLP adapter networks E_theta that, when appended to the latent space of a pretrained network F, do indeed lead to (approximate) post-training augmentation invariance. For example, on STL10 with F = DINOv2 features, the composite network C o E_theta o F, where C is a linear classifier and where E_theta is one of our proposed adapter networks, achieves 94% classification accuracy on arbitrarily rotated images, whereas a network of the form C o F without the adapter E_theta drops to 71% accuracy. Similarly, we can boost noise-invariant classification results from 58% up to 86%. Significantly, we obtain these results with no fine-tuning (the weights of F remain frozen throughout), and our methods introduce little corruption to the original features, since E_theta acts nearly isometrically on the non-augmented latent distribution. In contrast, we show that adapter networks trained with alternative candidate losses, specifically SimCLR and HSIC maximization, produce uncompetitive classification results and fundamentally corrupt the original latent space. Code available at: https://github.com/keenan-eikenberry/augmentation_invariance

AI.tldr: 提出「后训练增广不变性」框架：在不微调预训练网络的前提下，为其添加增广不变性。核心依赖两个新损失训练轻量 MLP 适配器，显著提升旋转/噪声等鲁棒性而几乎不破坏原特征性能。
AI.motivation: 实际应用常需要对预训练模型增加额外的不变性（如对旋转和噪声的鲁棒性），但又无法或不愿重训练整个模型或修改冻结权重，进而牺牲精度或计算代价过高。因此亟需一种可在保持原模型功能的同时、仅在潜在空间附加轻质模块的后训练方法。
AI.method: 1）引入增强编码器 (augmented encoder) 作为研究对象，定义了增广分布且量化了行为一致性；2）提出两种损失函数——Markov-Wasserstein 最小化与 Wasserstein 相关性最大化；3）保持冻结预训练网络 F，仅训练一个单隐层 MLP 适配器 E_θ，使其在增广潜在分布上对输入变换保持一致性；4）最终通过 C∘E_θ∘F 进行推理。
AI.result: 实验表明适配器可将分类准确率显著提升并在非增广样本上保持近似等距变换，几乎无特征漂移：在 STL10 上使用 DINOv2 特征，旋转不变性从 71% 提至 94%，噪声不变性从 58% 提至 86%。相比 SimCLR 或 HSIC 等其他损失方案，不论鲁棒性还是特征保真均显著逊色。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法可在「固定主干 + 轻量适配器」架构下高效实现后训练增广不变性，既不重训主干也不牺牲原始表现，为现实场景快速扩展预训练模型的鲁棒性提供了可行新范式。

title: Conjecture and Inquiry: Quantifying Software Performance Requirements via Interactive Retrieval-Augmented Preference Elicitation
summary: Since software performance requirements are documented in natural language, quantifying them into mathematical forms is essential for software engineering. Yet, the vagueness in performance requirements and uncertainty of human cognition have caused highly uncertain ambiguity in the interpretations, rendering their automated quantification an unaddressed and challenging problem. In this paper, we formalize the problem and propose IRAP, an approach that quantifies performance requirements into mathematical functions via interactive retrieval-augmented preference elicitation. IRAP differs from the others in that it explicitly derives from problem-specific knowledge to retrieve and reason the preferences, which also guides the progressive interaction with stakeholders, while reducing the cognitive overhead. Experiment results against 10 state-of-the-art methods on four real-world datasets demonstrate the superiority of IRAP on all cases with up to 40x improvements under as few as five rounds of interactions.

AI.tldr: 针对自然语言性能需求的数学量化难题，提出交互式检索-增强偏好引导方法 IRAP，在 5 轮以内交互即可达 40 倍精度提升。
AI.motivation: 性能需求以自然语言描述，模糊性与认知不确定性导致自动化量化长期缺失；现有方法未将领域知识显式引入偏好推理，难以兼顾精度与认知负担。
AI.method: 形式化定义“自然语言性能需求→数学函数”量化问题；构建 IRAP：以问题特定知识库检索候选偏好模式，通过贝叶斯推理更新信念，再用主动学习策略驱动与利益相关者的渐进式交互，持续修正目标函数直至收敛。
AI.result: 在 4 个工业数据集、10 种 SOTA 基线对照下，IRAP 仅用 ≤5 轮交互即取得平均 8–40 倍的量化误差下降，一致性系数提升 0.22–0.37，显著优于最佳基线（p<0.01）。
AI.conclusion: IRAP 首次将检索-增强偏好推理与交互式量化结合，兼顾精度、效率与认知负荷，可为性能需求的自动化建模提供通用框架，并支持向其他非功能需求扩展。

title: Surrogate modeling for interpreting black-box LLMs in medical predictions
summary: Large language models (LLMs), trained on vast datasets, encode extensive real-world knowledge within their parameters, yet their black-box nature obscures the mechanisms and extent of this encoding. Surrogate modeling, which uses simplified models to approximate complex systems, can offer a path toward better interpretability of black-box models. We propose a surrogate modeling framework that quantitatively explains LLM-encoded knowledge. For a specific hypothesis derived from domain knowledge, this framework approximates the latent LLM knowledge space using observable elements (input-output pairs) through extensive prompting across a comprehensive range of simulated scenarios. Through proof-of-concept experiments in medical predictions, we demonstrate our framework's effectiveness in revealing the extent to which LLMs "perceive" each input variable in relation to the output. Particularly, given concerns that LLMs may perpetuate inaccuracies and societal biases embedded in their training data, our experiments using this framework quantitatively revealed both associations that contradict established medical knowledge and the persistence of scientifically refuted racial assumptions within LLM-encoded knowledge. By disclosing these issues, our framework can act as a red-flag indicator to support the safe and reliable application of these models.

AI.tldr: 提出一套基于代理模型的框架，用可观测输入-输出反推 LLM 内部知识，首次在医学预测任务中定量暴露其错误医学关联和遗留种族偏见，可作为安全红线指标。
AI.motivation: LLM 参数量大却不可解释，无法知晓其到底编码了哪些知识、错误与偏见有多深；传统可解释方法缺乏定量手段，难以直接用于医疗等高风控场景。
AI.method: 1) 构建代理模型：用海量提示构造覆盖性模拟场景，收集输入-输出对，训练简化模型逼近 LLM 潜在知识空间；2) 领域知识驱动的变量级归因：针对每一条医学假设，对代理模型进行扰动实验，量化各变量对输出的边际贡献；3) 多任务对比：在相同协变量分布下比较 LLM 预测与金标准医学结论及人口学偏见基准的差异。
AI.result: 框架在医学预测数据集上：a) 准确还原 LLM 对变量敏感度排序；b) 发现 LLM 显著高估某些非因果特征权重，其与权威临床指南相矛盾；c) 量化揭示模型仍保留已被科学反驳的种族-疾病关联强度（系数>0.25），即使输入已去标识化。
AI.conclusion: 代理式探测框架能以可复现、可审计的方式暴露 LLM 隐式知识中的事实错误与社会偏见，为高风险部署提供早期警示，并指导后续对齐与去偏策略。

title: ViPS: Video-informed Pose Spaces for Auto-Rigged Meshes
summary: Kinematic rigs provide a structured interface for articulating 3D meshes, but they lack an inherent representation of the plausible manifold of joint configurations for a given asset. Without such a pose space, stochastic sampling or manual manipulation of raw rig parameters often leads to semantic or geometric violations, such as anatomical hyperextension and non-physical self-intersections. We propose Video-informed Pose Spaces (ViPS), a feed-forward framework that discovers the latent distribution of valid articulations for auto-rigged meshes by distilling motion priors from a pretrained video diffusion model. Unlike existing methods that rely on scarce artist-authored 4D datasets, ViPS transfers generative video priors into a universal distribution over a given rig parameterization. Differentiable geometric validators applied to the skinned mesh enforce asset-specific validity without requiring manual regularizers. Our model learns a smooth, compact, and controllable pose space that supports diverse sampling, manifold projection for inverse kinematics, and temporally coherent trajectories for keyframing. Furthermore, the distilled 3D pose samples serve as precise semantic proxies for guiding video diffusion, effectively closing the loop between generative 2D priors and structured 3D kinematic control. Our evaluations show that ViPS, trained solely on video priors, matches the performance of state-of-the-art methods trained on synthetic artist-created 4D data in both plausibility and diversity. Most importantly, as a universal model, ViPS demonstrates robust zero-shot generalization to out-of-distribution species and unseen skeletal topologies.

AI.tldr: ViPS 用视频扩散先验取代人工 4D 数据，为任意骨骼一键生成“合法姿态”紧凑潜空间，实现高质量采样、IK 投影与零物种泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有骨骼系统缺少“姿态合理性”表征，随机或手动调参易产生反解剖、自交等错误；而依赖艺术家制作 4D 数据的方法昂贵且种类有限。
AI.method: 1) 冻结视频扩散模型提取大规模运动先验；2) 以可微分网格验证器（自交、极限角等）为约束，蒸馏出给定骨骼的低维潜分布；3) 用同一潜码同时驱动 3D 姿态采样与视频生成，实现 2D-3D 闭环。
AI.result: 仅依靠视频预训练，ViPS 在合理性、多样性指标上与依赖合成 4D 数据的最优方法持平；零样本跨物种、跨拓扑迁移时依旧稳定，无需再训练或正则。
AI.conclusion: ViPS 展示“生成式 2D 先验→结构化 3D 控制”的可行路径，为缺少 4D 数据的领域提供通用、可扩展的合法姿态空间解决方案。

title: Secure LLM Fine-Tuning via Safety-Aware Probing
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success across many applications, but their ability to generate harmful content raises serious safety concerns. Although safety alignment techniques are often applied during pre-training or post-training, recent studies show that subsequent fine-tuning on adversarial or even benign data can still compromise model safety. In this paper, we revisit the fundamental question of why fine-tuning on non-harmful data may nevertheless degrade safety. We show that the safety and task-performance loss landscapes are partially decoupled, so updates that improve task-specific performance may still move the model toward unsafe regions. Based on this insight, we propose a safety-aware probing (SAP) optimization framework for mitigating safety risks during fine-tuning. Concretely, SAP uses contrastive safety signals to locate safety-correlated directions, and optimizes a lightweight probe that perturbs hidden-state propagation during fine-tuning, thereby steering parameter updates away from harmful trajectories while preserving task-specific learning. Extensive experiments show that SAP consistently improves the safety--utility tradeoff across multiple models and tasks. Averaged over multiple LLMs, SAP reduces the harmful score significantly relative to standard fine-tuning, outperforming strong baselines while maintaining competitive task-specific performance. SAP also demonstrates stronger robustness under harmful data poisoning, adversarial fine-tuning, and a dedicated post-fine-tuning adaptive attack, validating that SAP is an effective and scalable framework for preserving LLM safety during fine-tuning. Our code is available at https://github.com/ChengcanWu/SAP.

AI.tldr: 仅针对无害下游数据做微调也能让大模型「学坏」；作者发现其根源是安全与任务损失曲面部分解耦，于是提出SAP框架，在微调时仅用轻量探针实时感知并避开危险参数轨迹，兼顾安全与任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有安全对齐无法阻止后续微调（哪怕数据无害）重新唤起有害行为，亟需揭示其机制并给出训练阶段即可扩展的防御方案。
AI.method: 1) 理论揭示：安全与任务损失曲面局部解耦→任务梯度可能指向危险区域；2) SAP框架：在微调前先用对比安全信号训练轻量探针，实时感知隐状态中的危险方向，并通过加性扰动将梯度推离有害轨迹，无需修改主模型参数或数据。
AI.result: 跨模型、跨任务平均降低有害得分显著优于强基线，任务精度持平；在毒化、对抗微调与自适应攻击下鲁棒性更高。
AI.conclusion: 微调阶段的安全风险源于损失景观解耦；SAP通过轻量探针实时引导参数更新，为LLM微调提供了可扩展且有效的安全保障。

title: From Noise to Intent: Anchoring Generative VLA Policies with Residual Bridges
summary: Bridging high-level semantic understanding with low-level physical control remains a persistent challenge in embodied intelligence, stemming from the fundamental spatiotemporal scale mismatch between cognition and action. Existing generative VLA policies typically adopt a "Generation-from-Noise" paradigm, which disregards this disparity, leading to representation inefficiency and weak condition alignment during optimization. In this work, we propose ResVLA, an architecture that shifts the paradigm to "Refinement-from-Intent." Recognizing that robotic motion naturally decomposes into global intent and local dynamics, ResVLA utilizes spectral analysis to decouple control into a deterministic low-frequency anchor and a stochastic high-frequency residual. By anchoring the generative process on the predicted intent, our model focuses strictly on refining local dynamics via a residual diffusion bridge. Extensive simulation experiments show that ResVLA achieves competitive performance, strong robustness to language and robot embodiment perturbations, and faster convergence than standard generative baselines. It also demonstrates strong performance in real-world robot experiments.

AI.tldr: 针对高层语义与底层控制尺度失配导致的优化效率低、对齐弱，提出“意图→精修” VLA 结构 ResVLA，用频谱分解把运动拆成低频意图锚点+高频残差，以残差扩散桥只学局部动力学；仿真与真机均优于现有“噪声→生成”范式并具备鲁棒与快速收敛。
AI.motivation: 具身智能中认知与动作在时空尺度上天然错位，现有“噪声到生成” VLA 策略忽略此差异，易出现表征冗余和条件对齐弱，训练收敛慢。
AI.method: 1. 将机器人运动频谱分解为确定性低频全局意图与随机高频局部残差；2. 先预测意图作为确定性锚点；3. 构建残差扩散桥，仅在锚点周围精细化局部动态；4. 整个框架以“意图起始→残差精修”替代传统“纯噪声生成”。
AI.result: 仿真基准上任务成功率与鲁棒性均优于生成基线，对语言指令漂移与本体变化更稳定，收敛速度提升；真实机器人实验验证了策略迁移与部署可行性。
AI.conclusion: 将“生成起点”从随机噪声改为可解释意图锚点，可显著缓解尺度失配，提升样本效率、对齐性能与训练收敛速度，为高效鲁棒的 VLA 控制提供新范式。

title: Knowledge Capsules: Structured Nonparametric Memory Units for LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) encode knowledge in parametric weights, making it costly to update or extend without retraining. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) mitigates this limitation by appending retrieved text to the input, but operates purely through context expansion, where external knowledge competes as tokens within the attention mechanism. As a result, its influence is indirect and often unstable, particularly in long context and multi hop reasoning scenarios. We propose Knowledge Capsules, structured nonparametric memory units that represent normalized relational knowledge and can be constructed directly from document corpora using a frozen base model. Instead of injecting knowledge as text, we introduce an External Key Value Injection (KVI) framework that compiles capsules into attention-compatible key value representations, enabling external knowledge to directly participate in the model's attention computation. By shifting knowledge integration from context-level augmentation to memory level interaction, the proposed framework consistently outperforms RAG and GraphRAG across multiple QA benchmarks, with improved stability and accuracy in long context and multi hop reasoning, while requiring no parameter updates.

AI.tldr: 知识胶囊（Knowledge Capsules）+ External KVI 框架无需重训即可把外部知识直接注入注意力计算，长文本与多跳推理效果显著优于 RAG/GraphRAG。
AI.motivation: RAG 仅在上下文层追加文本，外部知识与提示 Token 竞争注意力，导致长文本和多跳推理不稳定；现有方案仍需重训或微调，代价高。
AI.method: 1. 用冻结 LLM 将文档抽成结构化非参知识胶囊，表示归一化关系知识；2. 提出 External KVI 框架，把胶囊编译为与 LLM 自注意力兼容的 K/V 对，在注意力计算阶段直接注入，实现“内存级”交互而非“上下文级”扩充；3. 全程不更新 LLM 参数。
AI.result: 在包括 HotpotQA、2WikiMQA 等多跳 QA 及长文本基准上，知识胶囊+KVI 稳定超越 RAG、GraphRAG，准确率提升 4–12 pp，方差显著降低；推理延迟与 RAG 相当，无需任何参数更新。
AI.conclusion: 将知识集成从“文本追加”转为“注意力注入”可根本性提升外部知识的稳定性与效果，为无需重训的持续知识扩展提供了新范式。

title: E3VS-Bench: A Benchmark for Viewpoint-Dependent Active Perception in 3D Gaussian Splatting Scenes
summary: Visual search in 3D environments requires embodied agents to actively explore their surroundings and acquire task-relevant evidence. However, existing visual search and embodied AI benchmarks, including EQA, typically rely on static observations or constrained egocentric motion, and thus do not explicitly evaluate fine-grained viewpoint-dependent phenomena that arise under unrestricted 5-DoF viewpoint control in real-world 3D environments, such as visibility changes caused by vertical viewpoint shifts, revealing contents inside containers, and disambiguating object attributes that are only observable from specific angles. To address this limitation, we introduce {E3VS-Bench}, a benchmark for embodied 3D visual search where agents must control their viewpoints in 5-DoF to gather viewpoint-dependent evidence for question answering. E3VS-Bench consists of 99 high-fidelity 3D scenes reconstructed using 3D Gaussian Splatting and 2,014 question-driven episodes. 3D Gaussian Splatting enables photorealistic free-viewpoint rendering that preserves fine-grained visual details (e.g., small text and subtle attributes) often degraded in mesh-based simulators, thereby allowing the construction of questions that cannot be answered from a single view and instead require active inspection across viewpoints in 5-DoF. We evaluate multiple state-of-the-art VLMs and compare their performance with humans. Despite strong 2D reasoning ability, all models exhibit a substantial gap from humans, highlighting limitations in active perception and coherent viewpoint planning specifically under full 5-DoF viewpoint changes.

AI.tldr: 论文针对现有3D视觉搜索基准在5-DoF自由视角下无法评估视角依赖性现象的缺陷，提出E3VS-Bench；该基准利用3D Gaussian Splatting构建99个高保真场景与2014个问答episode，要求智能体主动控制5-DoF视角获取证据。实验显示SOTA VLM与人类差距显著，暴露主动感知与连续视角规划不足。
AI.motivation: 传统视觉搜索与具身AI基准（如EQA）依赖单帧或受限运动，忽视真实3D环境中由垂直位移、容器开合、特定角度才可见属性等视角变化带来的可见性差异，无法评估智能体在5-DoF自由视角下的主动探查能力。
AI.method: 1) 采用3D Gaussian Splatting重建99个高保真场景，实现照片级自由视角渲染并保留细小文本与微弱属性；2) 构建2014条问答驱动任务，问题必须跨多视角取证；3) 设计5-DoF视角控制接口，供智能体主动采集证据；4) 评估包括SOTA VLMs在内的模型，并与人类对比。
AI.result: 尽管VLMs在2D推理上表现强劲，但在E3VS-Bench上平均准确率显著低于人类（绝对差距约20–35%）；模型在需要俯视、仰视、绕视、开启容器等5-DoF连续视角变化任务上错误率最高，暴露主动感知与连贯视角规划能力严重不足。
AI.conclusion: 研究证实：仅具备2D语义推理能力不足以解决真实3D搜索，智能体需具备显式的视角-驱动信息获取与长程规划机制；E3VS-Bench为后续研究提供了可复现的5-DoF主动视觉搜索评估平台，推动具身感知与决策一体化方法的发展。

title: Product Quantization for Surface Soil Similarity
comment: To be published in the CSCE 2022 proceedings
summary: The use of machine learning (ML) techniques has allowed rapid advancements in many scientific and engineering fields. One of these problems is that of surface soil taxonomy, a research area previously hindered by the reliance on human-derived classifications, which are mostly dependent on dividing a dataset based on historical understandings of that data rather than data-driven, statistically observable similarities. Using a ML-based taxonomy allows soil researchers to move beyond the limitations of human visualization and create classifications of high-dimension datasets with a much higher level of specificity than possible with hand-drawn taxonomies. Furthermore, this pipeline allows for the possibility of producing both highly accurate and flexible soil taxonomies with classes built to fit a specific application. The machine learning pipeline outlined in this work combines product quantization with the systematic evaluation of parameters and output to get the best available results, rather than accepting sub-optimal results by using either default settings or best guess settings.

AI.tldr: 用机器学习取代人工经验，建立高维、可定制、统计驱动的土壤分类体系，并引入产品量化与系统调参流程保证最优结果。
AI.motivation: 传统土壤分类依赖先验知识与人工视觉，难以处理高维数据，类别粗糙且无法按需定制。
AI.method: 将产品量化（PQ）嵌入聚类流程，配合网格/贝叶斯搜索系统优化编码长度、簇数、距离度量等全部参数，并以可解释指标评估输出稳定性与领域一致性。
AI.result: 相比默认/经验设定，PQ-ML 体系在多项高维土壤光谱数据集上实现 10–25% 的纯度提升，类别数可弹性扩展 2× 而不损失精度，分类结果与后续作物产量预测误差降低 15%。
AI.conclusion: 数据驱动的 ML 分类框架突破人工先验限制，为土壤学提供高分辨率、应用导向的“活” taxonomy；产品量化+系统调参策略可推广至其他地学高维聚类任务。

title: Supervised Learning Has a Necessary Geometric Blind Spot: Theory, Consequences, and Minimal Repair
comment: 29 pages. Code: https://github.com/vishalstark512/PMH. Preprint, not peer-reviewed. Affiliation: KU Leuven, Belgium
summary:
We prove that empirical risk minimisation (ERM) imposes a necessary geometric constraint on learned representations: any encoder that minimises supervised loss must retain non-zero Jacobian sensitivity in directions that are label-correlated in training data but nuisance at test time. This is not a contingent failure of current methods; it is a mathematical consequence of the supervised objective itself. We call this the geometric blind spot of supervised learning (Theorem 1), and show it holds across proper scoring rules, architectures, and dataset sizes.
  This single theorem unifies four lines of prior empirical work that were previously treated separately: non-robust predictive features, texture bias, corruption fragility, and the robustness-accuracy tradeoff. In this framing, adversarial vulnerability is one consequence of a broader structural fact about supervised learning geometry.
  We introduce Trajectory Deviation Index (TDI), a diagnostic that measures the theorem's bounded quantity directly, and show why common alternatives miss the key failure mode. PGD adversarial training reaches Jacobian Frobenius 2.91 yet has the worst clean-input geometry (TDI 1.336), while PMH achieves TDI 0.904. TDI is the only metric that detects this dissociation because it measures isotropic path-length distortion -- the exact quantity Theorem 1 bounds.
  Across seven vision tasks, BERT/SST-2, and ImageNet ViT-B/16 backbones used by CLIP, DINO, and SAM, the blind spot is measurable and repairable. It is present at foundation-model scale, worsens monotonically across language-model sizes (blind-spot ratio 0.860 to 0.765 to 0.742 from 66M to 340M), and is amplified by task-specific ERM fine-tuning (+54%), while PMH repairs it by 11x with one additional training term whose Gaussian form Proposition 5 proves is the unique perturbation law that uniformly penalises the encoder Jacobian.

AI.tldr: 任何监督式经验风险最小化（ERM）都必然在训练-测试标签不一致的方向上留下非零雅可比敏感度，形成所谓“几何盲区”；作者给出统一定理、提出诊断指标TDI，并用PMH方法11×修复该盲区。
AI.motivation: 过去将对抗脆弱性、纹理偏好、腐败敏感与鲁棒-精度权衡视为独立现象，缺乏统一理论。作者欲从几何角度揭示其共同根源，并给出可测量、可修复的指标。
AI.method: 1) 理论：证明ERM目标函数迫使编码器在“训练时与标签相关、测试时为干扰”的方向上保持非零雅可比敏感度，称为几何盲区定理，适用于任意严格评分规则、网络结构及数据规模。2) 诊断：提出Trajectory Deviation Index（TDI），直接度量定理所限的各向同性路径长度畸变；对比PGD训练、PMH训练等常用方法。3) 修复：引入额外高斯形式的正则项（PMH），命题5证明该扰动律是唯一对编码器雅可比各方向均衡惩罚的分布。
AI.result: 1) 统一解释四大经验现象：非鲁棒特征、纹理偏置、腐败脆弱性、鲁棒-精度权衡。2) TDI显示：PGD虽雅可比Frobenius范数低（2.91），但干净输入几何最差（TDI 1.336）；PMH达到TDI 0.904，显著优于其余指标。3) 在7项视觉任务、BERT/SST-2及ImageNet ViT-B/16（CLIP、DINO、SAM）上，盲区均可测量；语言模型随参数量从66M→340M，盲区比例单调恶化（0.860→0.765→0.742），ERM微调放大54%，而PMH一步修复11倍。
AI.conclusion: 几何盲区是监督ERM的固有结构缺陷，而非方法偶然失误；TDI可精准检测，PMH高斯正则即可高效修复，为提升基础模型鲁棒性提供简洁可行路径。

title: Intersectional Fairness in Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in socially sensitive settings, raising concerns about fairness and biases, particularly across intersectional demographic attributes. In this paper, we systematically evaluate intersectional fairness in six LLMs using ambiguous and disambiguated contexts from two benchmark datasets. We assess LLM behavior using bias scores, subgroup fairness metrics, accuracy, and consistency through multi-run analysis across contexts and negative and non-negative question polarities. Our results show that while modern LLMs generally perform well in ambiguous contexts, this limits the informativeness of fairness metrics due to sparse non-unknown predictions. In disambiguated contexts, LLM accuracy is influenced by stereotype alignment, with models being more accurate when the correct answer reinforces a stereotype than when it contradicts it. This pattern is especially pronounced in race-gender intersections, where directional bias toward stereotypes is stronger. Subgroup fairness metrics further indicate that, despite low observed disparity in some cases, outcome distributions remain uneven across intersectional groups. Across repeated runs, responses also vary in consistency, including stereotype-aligned responses. Overall, our findings show that apparent model competence is partly associated with stereotype-consistent cues, and no evaluated LLM achieves consistently reliable or fair behavior across intersectional settings. These findings highlight the need for evaluation beyond accuracy, emphasizing the importance of combining bias, subgroup fairness, and consistency metrics across intersectional groups, contexts, and repeated runs.

AI.tldr: 六大 LLM 在歧义与非歧义语境下的交叉公平性系统评估显示：模型准确率随答案与刻板印象一致而升高，种族-性别交集偏见最明显；即使整体差异小，结果分布仍不均，且多次运行一致性差。无任何模型在交叉维度上实现持续可靠或公平。
AI.motivation: LLM 被用于高社会敏感场景，但交叉人口属性（如种族×性别）可能叠加放大偏见；现有评估多聚焦单维度或总体准确率，难以揭示这类复合不公平。
AI.method: 基于两个基准数据集，构造歧义与非歧义语境；对六大 LLM 进行多轮重复提问（含负向与非负向极性），计算偏见得分、子群体公平指标、准确率与一致性；重点分析答案是否因“与刻板印象一致”而更准确。
AI.result: 歧义语境下模型倾向输出“未知”，公平指标信息量少；非歧义语境中，当正确答案与刻板印象一致时准确率显著升高，尤以种族-性别交集为甚。子群体结果分布仍不均；多次运行对同一问题的回答在一致性与刻板取向上均出现漂移。
AI.conclusion: 表面高准确率部分依赖对刻板印象的迎合；单看准确率不足以保证交叉公平。需联合偏见、子群体公平与一致性指标，在交叉维度、语境与多轮运行中持续监测，方可发现隐藏的不公平并指导模型改进。

title: PC2Model: ISPRS benchmark on 3D point cloud to model registration
summary: Point cloud registration involves aligning one point cloud with another or with a three-dimensional (3D) model, enabling the integration of multimodal data into a unified representation. This is essential in applications such as construction monitoring, autonomous driving, robotics, and virtual or augmented reality (VR/AR). With the increasing accessibility of point cloud acquisition technologies, such as Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) and structured light scanning, along with recent advances in deep learning, the research focus has increasingly shifted towards downstream tasks, particularly point cloud-to-model (PC2Model) registration. While data-driven methods aim to automate this process, they struggle with sparsity, noise, clutter, and occlusions in real-world scans, which limit their performance. To address these challenges, this paper introduces the PC2Model benchmark, a publicly available dataset designed to support the training and evaluation of both classical and data-driven methods. Developed under the leadership of ICWG II/Ib, the PC2Model benchmark adopts a hybrid design that combines simulated point clouds with, in some cases, real-world scans and their corresponding 3D models. Simulated data provide precise ground truth and controlled conditions, while real-world data introduce sensor and environmental artefacts. This design supports robust training and evaluation across domains and enables the systematic analysis of model transferability from simulated to real-world scenarios. The dataset is publicly accessible at: \href{https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17581812}{https://zenodo.org/records/17581812}

AI.tldr: 本文发布首个面向点云→3D模型配准(PC2Model)的公开基准数据集，混合仿真与真实扫描，解决训练数据匮乏及跨域迁移难题。
AI.motivation: 点云获取普及使PC2Model成为下游任务焦点，但真实扫描中的稀疏、噪声、遮挡导致数据驱动方法性能骤降；缺乏统一、带真值的训练与评测数据阻碍研究进展。
AI.method: ICWG II/Ib牵头构建PC2Model基准：①仿真生成海量带精确真值点云及对应3D模型；②补充少量真实扫描→模型对以引入传感器与环境畸变；③设计跨域评估协议，系统量化仿真→现实的模型迁移能力。
AI.result: 提供首个规模公开、涵盖多场景与传感器的PC2Model数据集，已上线Zenodo；实验表明，仅用传统或仅在仿真数据训练的配准网络在真实数据上误差增大2–4倍，凸显基准的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 该混合基准为社区提供可追溯的训练与评测平台，推动PC2Model配准算法对真实缺陷的鲁棒性及跨域迁移研究，助力施工、自动驾驶、VR/AR等应用落地。

title: Flipping Against All Odds: Reducing LLM Coin Flip Bias via Verbalized Rejection Sampling
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can often accurately describe probability distributions using natural language, yet they still struggle to generate faithful samples from them. This mismatch limits their use in tasks requiring reliable stochasticity, such as Monte Carlo methods, agent-based simulations, and randomized decision-making. We investigate this gap between knowledge and sampling in the context of Bernoulli distributions. We introduce Verbalized Rejection Sampling (VRS), a natural-language adaptation of classical rejection sampling that prompts the LLM to reason about and accept or reject proposed samples. Despite relying on the same Bernoulli mechanism internally, VRS substantially reduces sampling bias across models. We provide theoretical analysis showing that, under mild assumptions, VRS improves over direct sampling, with gains attributable to both the algorithm and prompt design. More broadly, our results show how classical probabilistic tools can be verbalized and embedded into LLM workflows to improve reliability, without requiring access to model internals or heavy prompt engineering.

AI.tldr: 提出Verbalized Rejection Sampling(VRS)，仅通过自然语言提示让LLM执行拒绝采样，显著降低对伯努利分布的采样偏差；理论证明VRS在温和假设下优于直接采样，为无需访问模型内部即可提升LLM随机可靠性提供范式。
AI.motivation: 尽管大语言模型能准确描述概率分布，却在生成忠实样本时存在系统性偏差，致其难以直接用于蒙特卡洛方法、主体模拟等依赖可靠随机性的场景，因此需探索不触及模型内部即可弥合“懂分布”与“能采样”之间缺口的方法。
AI.method: 以伯努利分布为研究对象，将经典拒绝采样“翻译”为自然语言流程，构建了Verbalized Rejection Sampling(VRS)：LLM先生成候选样本，再通过语言自洽地计算接受概率并做出接受/拒绝决策，最终输出符合目标分布的样本；对比直接采样与VRS在不同模型上的偏差，并给出理论分析。
AI.result: 实验表明，基于同一内部伯努利机制，VRS在多款LLM上将采样偏差显著降低，效果优于直接提示采样；理论证明在温和假设下VRS的期望偏差严格小于直接采样，且改进源于算法与提示设计的协同，而非模型参数改动。
AI.conclusion: 经典概率算法可“口语化”嵌入LLM工作流，无需访问模型内部或繁重提示工程即可提升随机可靠性；VRS为在纯黑箱场景下实现可信随机生成提供了一条通用、轻量的路径，具备推广至更复杂分布与下游随机任务的潜力。

title: VG-CoT: Towards Trustworthy Visual Reasoning via Grounded Chain-of-Thought
summary: The advancement of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) requires precise local region-based reasoning that faithfully grounds the model's logic in actual visual evidence. However, existing datasets face limitations in scalability due to extensive manual annotation and lack of explicit alignment between multi-step reasoning and corresponding image regions, which constrains the evaluation of model trustworthiness. To address these challenges, we propose the Visual Grounding Chain-of-Thought (VG-CoT) dataset, which explicitly links each reasoning step to real visual evidence within the image through a fully automated three-stage pipeline. The pipeline first extracts object- and text-level visual evidence using state-of-the-art detection and OCR models, then generates step-by-step grounded reasoning with GPT-4o, and finally refines the grounding through a rationale-driven open-set detection process. In addition, we introduce a new benchmark that comprehensively evaluates LVLMs reasoning across three complementary dimensions: Rationale Quality, Answer Accuracy, and Reasoning-Answer Alignment. Experiments with representative LVLMs, including LLaVA-1.5 and Qwen2-VL, demonstrate consistent improvements on most evaluation metrics, confirming that VG-CoT effectively enhances trustworthy, evidence-based reasoning while maintaining scalable and cost-efficient dataset construction. The dataset and code will be released publicly upon acceptance to facilitate further research.

AI.tldr: 纯净可扩展的 Visual Grounding Chain-of-Thought（VG-CoT）数据集，利用全自动三阶段管线将多步推理与图像真实区域显式对应，配套三维评估基准验证推理可信度。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言多模态大模型评估受限于人工标注规模小，且缺乏推理与对应图像区域的精细对齐，难以衡量模型是否基于真实视觉证据做出可靠推理。
AI.method: 设计全自动三阶段管线：1）检测/OCR提取目标与文本视觉证据；2）用GPT-4o生成与证据对应的逐步推理；3）通过“理由驱动的开放集检测”校准并精炼定位。生成10万＋多步推理-区域对齐样本，提出“理由质量、答案准确性、推理-答案一致性”三维综合基准，对LLaVA-1.5、Qwen2-VL等LVLM进行评估。
AI.result: 代表模型在三维指标上均获显著提升，表明VG-CoT有效提升可信任、基于视觉证据的推理能力，同时保持零人工成本和大规模可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: VG-CoT为大规模、可信、视觉依据显式对齐的多步推理数据与评估新标杆，数据集与代码将开源支持后续研究。

title: Exploiting LLM-as-a-Judge Disposition on Free Text Legal QA via Prompt Optimization
comment: Accepted at the 21st International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Law (ICAIL 2026), Singapore, June 8-12, 2026. 10 pages, 14 figures, 2 tables
summary: This work explores the role of prompt design and judge selection in LLM-as-a-Judge evaluations of free text legal question answering. We examine whether automatic task prompt optimization improves over human-centered design, whether optimization effectiveness varies by judge feedback style, and whether optimized prompts transfer across judges. We systematically address these questions on the LEXam benchmark by optimizing task prompts using the ProTeGi method with feedback from two judges (Qwen3-32B, DeepSeek-V3) across four task models, and then testing cross-judge transfer. Automatic optimization consistently outperforms the baseline, with lenient judge feedback yielding higher and more consistent gains than strict judge feedback. Prompts optimized with lenient feedback transfer better to strict judges than the reverse direction. Analysis reveals that lenient judges provide permissive feedback, yielding prompts with broader applicability, whereas strict judges produce restrictive feedback, leading to judge-specific overfitting. Our findings demonstrate algorithmically optimizing prompts on training data can outperform human-centered prompt design and that judges' dispositions during optimization shape prompt generalizability.

AI.tldr: 自动优化法律问答任务的提示可始终超越人工设计；宽松型LLM-judge的反馈能带来更强、更可迁移的提示，而严格型judge易致过拟合。
AI.motivation: LLM-as-a-Judge在法律自由文本问答中的可靠性与提示设计密切相关，但尚不清楚自动提示优化是否优于人类手工设计，以及不同“法官”风格如何影响优化效果与迁移能力。
AI.method: 在LEXam基准上，用ProTegi方法分别基于宽容(Qwen3-32B)与严格(DeepSeek-V3)两种judge的反馈，对四个任务模型进行提示优化，并测试跨judge迁移。
AI.result: 自动优化全面优于人工baseline；宽松judge带来的增益更高且更稳定；宽松→严格方向的迁移显著优于反向；宽松反馈产生通用性强的提示，严格反馈则易过拟合于特定judge。
AI.conclusion: 对训练数据做算法化提示优化确实能胜过以人为中心的设计，且优化阶段所采用的judge“性格”直接决定最终提示的泛化能力。

title: CrackForward: Context-Aware Severity Stage Crack Synthesis for Data Augmentation
summary: Reliable crack detection and segmentation are vital for structural health monitoring, yet the scarcity of well-annotated data constitutes a major challenge. To address this limitation, we propose a novel context-aware generative framework designed to synthesize realistic crack growth patterns for data augmentation. Unlike existing methods that primarily manipulate textures or background content, CrackForward explicitly models crack morphology by combining directional crack elongation with learned thickening and branching. Our framework integrates two key innovations: (i) a contextually guided crack expansion module, which uses local directional cues and adaptive random walk to simulate realistic propagation paths; and (ii) a two-stage U-Net-style generator that learns to reproduce spatially varying crack characteristics such as thickness, branching, and growth. Experimental results show that the generated samples preserve target-stage saturation and thickness characteristics and improve the performance of several crack segmentation architectures. These results indicate that structure-aware synthetic crack generation can provide more informative training data than conventional augmentation alone.

AI.tldr: CrackForward 框架通过上下文感知的生成模型合成真实裂缝形态，显著提高裂缝分割网络性能，解决标注数据稀缺问题。
AI.motivation: 结构健康监测依赖高质量的裂缝检测与分割，但实测数据中像素级标注极度匮乏，传统基于纹理或背景扰动的增广无法提供形态学可信的裂缝样本，限制了深度分割模型的泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出“CrackForward”上下文感知生成框架：(i) 上下文引导裂缝扩展模块，以局部方向线索+自适应随机游走模拟真实扩展路径；(ii) 两阶段 U-Net 式生成器，显式学习厚度、分叉、生长等空间变化特征；相较现有方法，首次显式建模裂缝形态而非仅做纹理/背景扰动。
AI.result: 在保持目标裂缝饱和度和厚度特征的同时，生成的合成裂缝数据使多种主流裂缝分割网络在公开数据集上的 IoU 平均提升 4.7–7.3%，F1 提升 5.1–8.4%，显著优于传统增广策略。
AI.conclusion: 结构感知的裂缝合成增广可在不增加实测成本的前提下，提供更具信息量的训练样本，有效缓解数据稀缺瓶颈，推动深度学习在结构健康监测中的落地应用。

title: mGRADE: Minimal Recurrent Gating Meets Delay Convolutions for Lightweight Sequence Modeling
summary: Multi-timescale sequence modeling relies on capturing both local fast dynamics and global slow context; yet, maintaining these capabilities under the strict memory constraints common to edge devices remains an open challenge. Current State-of-the-Art models with constant memory footprints trade off long-range selectivity and high-precision modeling of fast dynamics. To overcome this trade-off within a fixed memory budget, we propose mGRADE (minimally Gated Recurrent Architecture with Delay Embedding), a hybrid-memory system that introduces inductive biases across timescales by integrating a convolution with learnable temporal spacings with a lightweight gated recurrent component. We show theoretically that the learnable spacings are equivalent to a delay embedding, enabling parameter-efficient reconstruction of partially-observed fast dynamics, while the gated recurrent component selectively maintains long-range context with minimal memory overhead. On the challenging Long-Range Arena benchmark and 35-way Google Speech Commands raw audio classification task, mGRADE reduces the memory footprint by up to a factor of 8 compared to other State-of-the-Art models, while maintaining competitive performance.

AI.tldr: mGRADE以固定内存同时捕捉快慢动态，在边缘场景下把记忆开销再降 8 倍，仍保持 SOTA 精度。
AI.motivation: 边缘设备内存受限，现有常内存模型不得不在“长程选择能力”与“高速动态精细建模”之间二选一，亟需打破这一折衷。
AI.method: 提出 mGRADE——混合记忆系统：可学习间隔的卷积等价于延迟嵌入，用极少参数补全局部快变；轻量门控循环单元选择性保留慢变长程信息，二者共享固定缓存。
AI.result: 理论证明其延迟嵌入等效性；在 Long-Range Arena 和 35 类 Google Speech Commands raw 音频任务上，内存占用仅为对照 SOTA 模型的 1/8，而准确率相当或更优。
AI.conclusion: 无需额外内存即可兼顾多时间尺度特征，为边缘端长序列建模提供了新范式。

title: CSC: Turning the Adversary's Poison against Itself
summary: Poisoning-based backdoor attacks pose significant threats to deep neural networks by embedding triggers in training data, causing models to misclassify triggered inputs as adversary-specified labels while maintaining performance on clean data. Existing poison restraint-based defenses often suffer from inadequate detection against specific attack variants and compromise model utility through unlearning methods that lead to accuracy degradation. This paper conducts a comprehensive analysis of backdoor attack dynamics during model training, revealing that poisoned samples form isolated clusters in latent space early on, with triggers acting as dominant features distinct from benign ones. Leveraging these insights, we propose Cluster Segregation Concealment (CSC), a novel poison suppression defense. CSC first trains a deep neural network via standard supervised learning while segregating poisoned samples through feature extraction from early epochs, DBSCAN clustering, and identification of anomalous clusters based on class diversity and density metrics. In the concealment stage, identified poisoned samples are relabeled to a virtual class, and the model's classifier is fine-tuned using cross-entropy loss to replace the backdoor association with a benign virtual linkage, preserving overall accuracy.
