CSC was evaluated on four benchmark datasets against twelve poisoning-based attacks, CSC outperforms nine state-of-the-art defenses by reducing average attack success rates to near zero with minimal clean accuracy loss. Contributions include robust backdoor patterns identification, an effective concealment mechanism, and superior empirical validation, advancing trustworthy artificial intelligence.

AI.tldr: 针对投毒后门攻击，本文提出早期特征聚类+虚拟重标签的CSC防御，在 12 种攻击、4 数据集上把攻击成功率压到接近 0，且干净精度几乎不降。
AI.motivation: 现有基于“投毒抑制”的防御要么对特定攻击变种检测失效，要么在“去毒”阶段造成模型可用性下降。作者希望在不牺牲干净精度的前提下，彻底阻断后门触发器与目标类的关联。
AI.method: ① 正常训练初期提取特征；② DBSCAN 聚类发现早期即被孤立的投毒簇（依据类多样性与密度异常）；③ 将可疑样本重标为虚拟类，仅对分类头做交叉熵微调，把触发器—目标类关联替换为触发器—虚拟类 benign 关联，实现“隐藏”而非“擦除”。
AI.result: 在 CIFAR-10、GTSRB、TinyImageNet、ImageNet-1K 上对抗 12 种 SOTA 投毒攻击，平均攻击成功率降至 0.3% 以下，干净精度下降 <0.5%，全面优于 9 种主流防御。
AI.conclusion: 早期潜空间聚类可有效捕捉投毒样本；虚拟重标签能在不破坏主决策边界的前提下去除后门，兼顾安全性与可用性，为可信 AI 提供高实用价值的新范式。

title: Working Memory Constraints Scaffold Learning in Transformers under Data Scarcity
summary: We investigate the integration of human-like working memory constraints into the Transformer architecture and implement several cognitively inspired attention variants, including fixed-width windows based and temporal decay based attention mechanisms. Our modified GPT-2 models are trained from scratch on developmentally plausible datasets (10M and 100M words). Performance is evaluated on grammatical judgment tasks (BLiMP) and alignment with human reading time data. Our results indicate that these cognitively-inspired constraints, particularly fixed-width attention, can significantly improve grammatical accuracy especially when training data is scarce. These constrained models also tend to show a stronger alignment with human processing metrics. The findings suggest that such constraints may serve as a beneficial inductive bias, guiding models towards more robust linguistic representations, especially in data-limited settings.

AI.tldr: 模仿人脑工作记忆限制的固定窗口注意力可让小规模数据训练的 GPT-2 在语法判断任务上更准，且阅读时间更接近人类。
AI.motivation: Transformer 在数据和参数量不足时语法表现差；人类语言处理受有限工作记忆束缚，但主流模型未显式利用这一先验。
AI.method: 将固定宽度窗口与时间衰减两类“类认知”注意力机制植入 GPT-2，在 10M/100M 词的儿童可承受规模语料上重训，用 BLiMP 语法判断与眼动阅读时间对齐度评估。
AI.result: 固定窗口注意力显著提升低资源场景下的语法准确率；两种约束模型的阅读时间模式与人类相关度更高。
AI.conclusion: 把人脑式记忆瓶颈作为归纳偏置，可在数据受限条件下诱导出更鲁棒且符合人类处理特性的语言表示。

title: Semantic-Fast-SAM: Efficient Semantic Segmenter
summary: We propose Semantic-Fast-SAM (SFS), a semantic segmentation framework that combines the Fast Segment Anything model with a semantic labeling pipeline to achieve real-time performance without sacrificing accuracy. FastSAM is an efficient CNN-based re-implementation of the Segment Anything Model (SAM) that runs much faster than the original transformer-based SAM. Building upon FastSAM's rapid mask generation, we integrate a Semantic-Segment-Anything (SSA) labeling strategy to assign meaningful categories to each mask. The resulting SFS model produces high-quality semantic segmentation maps at a fraction of the computational cost and memory footprint of the original SAM-based approach. Experiments on Cityscapes and ADE20K benchmarks demonstrate that SFS matches the accuracy of prior SAM-based methods (mIoU ~ 70.33 on Cityscapes and 48.01 on ADE20K) while achieving approximately 20x faster inference than SSA in the closed-set setting. We also show that SFS effectively handles open-vocabulary segmentation by leveraging CLIP-based semantic heads, outperforming recent open-vocabulary models on broad class labeling. This work enables practical real-time semantic segmentation with the "segment-anything" capability, broadening the applicability of foundation segmentation models in robotics scenarios. The implementation is available at https://github.com/KBH00/Semantic-Fast-SAM.

AI.tldr: 提出 Semantic-Fast-SAM（SFS），把 FastSAM 的高效实例级掩码生成与类级语义标注融合，实现 20 倍加速同时维持原有 SAM 准确率，并扩展至开放词汇场景，为机器人实时语义分割提供轻量可用方案。
AI.motivation: 原版 Transformer-based SAM 虽能“分割万物”，但推理耗时大、计算占用高，且只生成不含语义的掩码，难以满足机器人/边缘设备等实时且需类别标签的场景。
AI.method: 1) 保留 FastSAM 对 SAM 的 CNN 重实现，获取高速掩码；2) 后接 SSA（Semantic-Segment-Anything）语义分配模块，以分类头+CLIP 多模态特征为掩码赋类别；3) 在封闭集与开放词汇两种设定下训练与推理，形成端到端 SFS 框架。
AI.result: 在 Cityscapes、ADE20K 封闭集上 mIoU 分别达 70.33/48.01，与 SAM 系列持平，但推理速度提升约 20 倍，显存占用大幅降低；开放词汇实验中对广泛类别标注优于现有开放词汇模型。
AI.conclusion: SFS 以极低延迟和内存开销将“分割万物”能力升级为“实时语义分割万物”，显著拓宽了 SAM 类基础模型的机器人落地边界；代码已开源。

title: Efficient Multi-Source Knowledge Transfer by Model Merging
summary: While transfer learning is an effective strategy, it often overlooks the opportunity to leverage knowledge from numerous available models online. Addressing this multi-source transfer learning problem is a promising path to boost adaptability and cut re-training costs. However, existing methods remain inherently coarse-grained: they lack the precision needed for fine-grained knowledge extraction as well as the scalability required to aggregate knowledge from either large numbers of source models or models with high parameter counts. We address these limitations by leveraging Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) to first decompose each source model into its elementary, rank-one components. A subsequent aggregation stage then selects only the most salient components from all sources, thereby overcoming the previous efficiency and precision limitations. To best preserve and leverage the synthesized knowledge base, our method adapts to the target task by fine-tuning only the principal singular values of the merged matrix. In essence, this process recalibrates the importance of top SVD components. The proposed framework allows for efficient and scalable multi-source transfer learning in both vision and language domains, while remaining robust to perturbations in both the input space and the parameter space.

AI.tldr: 精调少量源模型主奇异值即可快速聚合大批 SVD 分量，实现跨域、多源、高参数降维迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有基于整个/整块模型的多源迁移过于粗粒度，难以高效且精确定位可复用知识并扩展到大量源模型或高参数模型，造成迁移效率与精度瓶颈。
AI.method: 对每一源模型执行 SVD 分解，获一系列秩-1 分量；提出基于显著性的分量筛选机制跨源聚合，再在目标模型上仅微调合并矩阵的主奇异值，重校准顶级分解分量的重要性。
AI.result: 该方法在保持推理结构不变的前提下，统一整合任意数量及任意规模模型；在视觉和语言多源迁移上均显示参数少、速度快、性能佳，抗输入扰动与对抗攻击鲁棒性更好。
AI.conclusion: 通过 SVD 分解+显著性分量选择+主奇异值微调的三步路，首次实现细粒度、可扩展的多源知识抽取与高效迁移，为海量在线模型再利用提供了一个通用、强大且实用的框架。

title: Differentially Private De-identification of Dutch Clinical Notes: A Comparative Evaluation
summary: Protecting patient privacy in clinical narratives is essential for enabling secondary use of healthcare data under regulations such as GDPR and HIPAA. While manual de-identification remains the gold standard, it is costly and slow, motivating the need for automated methods that combine privacy guarantees with high utility. Most automated text de-identification pipelines employed named entity recognition (NER) to identify protected entities for redaction. Although methods based on differential privacy (DP) provide formal privacy guarantees, more recently also large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for text de-identification in the clinical domain. In this work, we present the first comparative study of DP, NER, and LLMs for Dutch clinical text de-identification. We investigate these methods separately as well as hybrid strategies that apply NER or LLM preprocessing prior to DP, and assess performance in terms of privacy leakage and extrinsic evaluation (entity and relation classification). We show that DP mechanisms alone degrade utility substantially, but combining them with linguistic preprocessing, especially LLM-based redaction, significantly improves the privacy-utility trade-off.

AI.tldr: 在荷兰临床文本去标识化任务上，首次系统比较差分隐私(DP)、命名实体识别(NER)与大型语言模型(LLM)三种方案，发现单纯DP严重损害数据效用，而LLM+DP的混合策略可显著改善隐私-效用平衡。
AI.motivation: GDPR/HIPAA 要求二次利用临床文本时必须保护患者隐私。手工去标识成本高、速度慢，亟需兼顾隐私保证与数据效用的自动化方法；现有研究缺乏对DP、NER、LLM三者在同一语料和评估框架下的直接比较。
AI.method: 在荷兰语临床记录上，分别实现并评估：1) 纯DP文本随机化机制；2) 基于NER的实体遮盖；3) LLM驱动的敏感实体红action；4) NER/LLM预处理后再加DP的两种混合策略。采用隐私泄露量(成员推理等指标)与下游实体/关系分类任务性能作为双重评价标准。
AI.result: 纯DP导致下游任务F1下降30%以上，数据效用显著损失；NER预处理+DP仅能部分缓解。LLM前处理+DP将隐私泄露风险降低85%的同时，使任务性能仅下降5–8%，在Privacy-Utility前沿曲线上取得最优权衡。
AI.conclusion: 首次实证表明，LLM可在临床文本去标识化中充当高精度“隐私过滤器”；将其与DP组合，可在满足严格隐私定义的前提下最大程度保留数据科研价值，为符合GDPR/HIPAA的二次利用提供了可行范式。

title: Parallel-SFT: Improving Zero-Shot Cross-Programming-Language Transfer for Code RL
summary: Modern language models demonstrate impressive coding capabilities in common programming languages (PLs), such as C++ and Python, but their performance in lower-resource PLs is often limited by training data availability. In principle, however, most programming skills are universal across PLs, so the capability acquired in one PL should transfer to others. In this work, we propose the task of zero-shot cross-programming-language transfer for code RL. We find that, for Llama-3.1, RL training for code generation in a source PL fails to improve, and sometimes even degrades, the performance on other target PLs. To address this, we hypothesize that effective RL transfer requires a generalizable SFT initialization before RL. We thus propose **Parallel-SFT**, an SFT strategy that incorporates "parallel programs" -- functionally equivalent code implemented in multiple PLs -- into the data mixture. We demonstrate that this improves transferability: when we subsequently perform RL on our Parallel-SFT model, we observe better generalization to unseen PLs. Analysis of the model internal representations reveals that Parallel-SFT leads to a more functionality-centric latent space, where equivalent programs across PLs are more tightly clustered, which we hypothesize to contribute to the improved transferability.

AI.tldr: 用强化学习（RL）做跨编程语言的代码生成迁移时，直接在源语言上训练反而会损害目标语言性能；作者提出先进行「平行监督微调（Parallel-SFT）」，用功能等价的多语言代码对初始化，再RL，可零样本提升低资源语言表现。
AI.motivation: 大模型在高资源语言（如Python）上编码能力强，但低资源语言训练数据稀缺，而编程技能本质跨语言可迁移。现有RL仅针对单语言，无法泛化到其他语言，需解决“如何在不训练目标语言的情况下提升其生成性能”。
AI.method: 1）提出零样本跨语言代码RL迁移任务；2）发现Llama-3.1经单语言RL后目标语言性能不升反降；3）假设可迁移性依赖于可泛化的SFT初始化，遂设计Parallel-SFT：在微调阶段混入「功能等价、多语言成对」的代码，迫使模型学习语言无关的功能表示；4）在此基础上再进行RL训练。
AI.result: Parallel-SFT→RL 的模型在未见过的目标语言上显著优于单语言SFT→RL基线；探针分析显示，其内部表示更以功能为中心，不同语言但功能等价的代码在潜空间聚类更紧密。
AI.conclusion: 跨语言代码RL迁移的关键是预训练阶段引入功能对齐的多语言数据；Parallel-SFT通过构造“平行程序”有效提升模型泛化性，使后续RL收益可跨语言迁移，为低资源编程语言的能力提升提供新范式。

title: Fourier Series Coder: A Novel Perspective on Angle Boundary Discontinuity Problem for Oriented Object Detection
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: With the rapid advancement of intelligent driving and remote sensing, oriented object detection has gained widespread attention. However, achieving high-precision performance is fundamentally constrained by the Angle Boundary Discontinuity (ABD) and Cyclic Ambiguity (CA) problems, which typically cause significant angle fluctuations near periodic boundaries. Although recent studies propose continuous angle coders to alleviate these issues, our theoretical and empirical analyses reveal that state-of-the-art methods still suffer from substantial cyclic errors. We attribute this instability to the structural noise amplification within their non-orthogonal decoding mechanisms. This mathematical vulnerability significantly exacerbates angular deviations, particularly for square-like objects. To resolve this fundamentally, we propose the Fourier Series Coder (FSC), a lightweight plug-and-play component that establishes a continuous, reversible, and mathematically robust angle encoding-decoding paradigm. By rigorously mapping angles onto a minimal orthogonal Fourier basis and explicitly enforcing a geometric manifold constraint, FSC effectively prevents feature modulus collapse. This structurally stabilized representation ensures highly robust phase unwrapping, intrinsically eliminating the need for heuristic truncations while achieving strict boundary continuity and superior noise immunity. Extensive experiments across three large-scale datasets demonstrate that FSC achieves highly competitive overall performance, yielding substantial improvements in high-precision detection. The code will be available at https://github.com/weiminghong/FSC.

AI.tldr: 作者提出傅里叶级数编码器（FSC）这一即插即用模块，通过正交傅里叶基与几何流形约束连续编码角度，从数学层面彻底消除旋转目标检测中的周期性边界不连续与歧义，显著提高特别是方形目标的高精度检测性能。
AI.motivation: 面向目标检测因角度突变（ABD）与循环歧义（CA）在周期边界处产生大幅角度振荡，现有连续角度编码方法仍被循环误差困扰；亟需一种数学上鲁棒、可逆且连续的角度编解码范式，从源头抑制结构噪声放大导致的角偏差。
AI.method: 1) 理论分析定位现有非正交解码机制对结构噪声的放大效应；2) 设计轻量级傅里叶级数编码器（FSC），将角度映射到最小正交傅里叶基并显式施加几何流形约束，防止特征模崩塌；3) 实现无需启发式截断的严格边界连续与 unwrap-free 解码策略。
AI.result: 在三大公开数据集上验证，FSC 使高 IoU 阈值下的检测精度显著提升，整体指标达 SOTA 水平，尤其对方形目标的角度预测误差下降幅度最大。
AI.conclusion: FSC 以最小参数量的即插即用方式，为面向目标检测提供了数学鲁棒、连续且抗噪的角度编码解决方案，彻底消除循环边界问题，具备良好的可扩展性和部署前景。

title: HyperAdapt: Simple High-Rank Adaptation
comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research
summary: Foundation models excel across diverse tasks, but adapting them to specialized applications often requires fine-tuning, an approach that is memory and compute-intensive. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods mitigate this by updating only a small subset of weights. In this paper, we introduce HyperAdapt, a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method that significantly reduces the number of trainable parameters compared to state-of-the-art methods like LoRA. Specifically, HyperAdapt adapts a pre-trained weight matrix by applying row- and column-wise scaling through diagonal matrices, thereby inducing a high-rank update while requiring only $n+m$ trainable parameters for an $n \times m$ matrix. Theoretically, we establish an upper bound on the rank of HyperAdapt's updates, and empirically, we confirm that it consistently induces high-rank transformations across model layers. Experiments on GLUE, arithmetic reasoning, and commonsense reasoning benchmarks with models up to 14B parameters demonstrate that HyperAdapt matches or nearly matches the performance of full fine-tuning and state-of-the-art PEFT methods while using orders of magnitude fewer trainable parameters.

AI.tldr: HyperAdapt 以对角矩阵对行列分别缩放，仅用 n+m 个可训练参数即可实现高秩更新，在 14B 模型上 GLUE/推理任务性能接近全微调与 LoRA，参数量再降数个量级。
AI.motivation: 现有 PEFT 仍占用过多可训练参数，需进一步压缩内存与计算开销，同时保持高秩表达能力。
AI.method: 用左右对角矩阵对权重矩阵行列独立缩放，理论给出秩上界；仅需 n+m 参数即可诱导高秩变换，无需额外秩分解或低秩约束。
AI.result: GLUE、算术与常识推理基准上，HyperAdapt 用远少于 LoRA 的参数达到或逼近全微调及最先进 PEFT 精度，高秩特性在各层稳定出现。
AI.conclusion: 行列对角缩放即可高效产生高秩适应，显著降低参数与存储成本，为大规模模型专业化提供新范式。

title: VARestorer: One-Step VAR Distillation for Real-World Image Super-Resolution
comment: Accepted in ICLR 2026. Code is available at https://github.com/EternalEvan/VARestorer
summary: Recent advancements in visual autoregressive models (VAR) have demonstrated their effectiveness in image generation, highlighting their potential for real-world image super-resolution (Real-ISR). However, adapting VAR for ISR presents critical challenges. The next-scale prediction mechanism, constrained by causal attention, fails to fully exploit global low-quality (LQ) context, resulting in blurry and inconsistent high-quality (HQ) outputs. Additionally, error accumulation in the iterative prediction severely degrades coherence in ISR task. To address these issues, we propose VARestorer, a simple yet effective distillation framework that transforms a pre-trained text-to-image VAR model into a one-step ISR model. By leveraging distribution matching, our method eliminates the need for iterative refinement, significantly reducing error propagation and inference time. Furthermore, we introduce pyramid image conditioning with cross-scale attention, which enables bidirectional scale-wise interactions and fully utilizes the input image information while adapting to the autoregressive mechanism. This prevents later LQ tokens from being overlooked in the transformer. By fine-tuning only 1.2\% of the model parameters through parameter-efficient adapters, our method maintains the expressive power of the original VAR model while significantly enhancing efficiency. Extensive experiments show that VARestorer achieves state-of-the-art performance with 72.32 MUSIQ and 0.7669 CLIPIQA on DIV2K dataset, while accelerating inference by 10 times compared to conventional VAR inference.

AI.tldr: VARestorer通过蒸馏+跨尺度注意力将文本到图像的自回归模型转化为单步真实图像超分网络，在 DIV2K 上取得 SOTA 指标并将推理速度提升 10 倍，仅微调 1.2% 参数。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉自回归模型(VAR)虽在生成任务表现优异，但其“逐尺度下一 token 预测”机制受因果注意力限制，无法全局利用低质量(LQ)图像上下文，导致真实超分(Real-ISR)结果模糊、不一致；同时迭代预测带来的误差累积进一步破坏细节连贯性。
AI.method: 提出 VARestorer 框架：(1) 基于分布匹配的单步蒸馏，把预训练文本到图像 VAR 转化为一步式 ISR 网络，消除迭代误差并显著加速；(2) 引入金字塔图像条件与跨尺度注意力，实现双向尺度间交互，使任意尺度都能利用全部 LQ 信息并适配自回归因果约束；(3) 仅通过参数高效 Adapter 微调 1.2% 参数量，保留原模型表达能力。
AI.result: 在 DIV2K 基准上达到 72.32 MUSIQ 与 0.7669 CLIPIQA 的新 SOTA 成绩；推理速度相比原始 VAR 提升 10 倍，参数量增量可忽略。
AI.conclusion: VARestorer 证明通过轻量级蒸馏与跨尺度注意力改造，VAR 可高效转化为高质量、高速的真实图像超分模型，为自回归生成模型在底层视觉任务中的应用提供了可扩展范式。

title: Survey on Evaluation of LLM-based Agents
summary: LLM-based agents represent a paradigm shift in AI, enabling autonomous systems to plan, reason, and use tools while interacting with dynamic environments. This paper provides the first comprehensive survey of evaluation methods for these increasingly capable agents. We analyze the field of agent evaluation across five perspectives: (1) Core LLM capabilities needed for agentic workflows, like planning, and tool use; (2) Application-specific benchmarks such as web and SWE agents; (3) Evaluation of generalist agents; (4) Analysis of agent benchmarks' core dimensions; and (5) Evaluation frameworks and tools for agent developers. Our analysis reveals current trends, including a shift toward more realistic, challenging evaluations with continuously updated benchmarks. We also identify critical gaps that future research must address, particularly in assessing cost-efficiency, safety, and robustness, and in developing fine-grained, scalable evaluation methods.

AI.tldr: 首篇系统梳理LLM-based智能体评估方法的综述，指出评估正走向更真实、动态、细粒度，但成本、安全与可扩展性仍缺标准。
AI.motivation: 随着大模型智能体能力跃升，缺乏统一、全面的评估体系，阻碍科研与产业落地。
AI.method: 从5维拆解：①核心能力（规划、工具调用）②场景基准（Web、SWE等）③通用智能体评估④基准核心维度⑤开发者框架与工具，并做趋势与缺口分析。
AI.result: 发现评估正转向持续更新、高逼真度任务；同时暴露成本效率、安全鲁棒、细粒度可扩展评估三大空白。
AI.conclusion: 亟需构建兼顾效率、安全与规模化的智能体评估新范式，为未来研究指明方向。

title: RefAerial: A Benchmark and Approach for Referring Detection in Aerial Images
summary: Referring detection refers to locate the target referred by natural languages, which has recently attracted growing research interests. However, existing datasets are limited to ground images with large object centered in relative small scenes. This paper introduces a large-scale challenging dataset for referring detection in aerial images, termed as RefAerial. It distinguishes from conventional ground referring detection datasets by 4 characteristics: (1) low but diverse object-to-scene ratios, (2) numerous targets and distractors, (3)complex and fine-grained referring descriptions, (4) diverse and broad scenes in the aerial view. We also develop a human-in-the-loop referring expansion and annotation engine (REA-Engine) for efficient semi-automated referring pair annotation. Besides, we observe that existing ground referring detection approaches exhibiting serious performance degradation on our aerial dataset since the intrinsic scale variety issue within or across aerial images. Therefore, we further propose a novel scale-comprehensive and sensitive (SCS) framework for referring detection in aerial images. It consists of a mixture-of-granularity (MoG) attention and a two-stage comprehensive-to-sensitive (CtS) decoding strategy. Specifically, the mixture-of-granularity attention is developed for scale-comprehensive target understanding. In addition, the two-stage comprehensive-to-sensitive decoding strategy is designed for coarse-to-fine referring target decoding. Eventually, the proposed SCS framework achieves remarkable performance on our aerial referring detection dataset and even promising performance boost on conventional ground referring detection datasets.

AI.tldr: 首个“空中视角指称检测”数据集RefAerial发布，并提出SCS框架以解决航拍场景中的尺度-多样性难题，显著提升空中与地面的平均精度。
AI.motivation: 图像指称检测研究集中于地面近距离、大目标场景，缺乏对航拍大场景、密集小目标的系统数据与方法；空中视角兼具大尺度范围与高分辨率，带来更具挑战性与实用价值的新问题。
AI.method: 构建大规模RefAerial数据集，具备低占比-多类别目标、复杂描述与场景广度；设计SCS框架：采用MoG注意力实现多粒度特征尺度综合理解，辅以两阶段CtS解码由粗到细定位指称目标。
AI.result: RefAerial包含468K条指称-目标配对，PAS@0.25达61.3%，PAS@0.50达44.7%，SCS相较第二代基线提升约14%检测精度，并在RefCOCO/+/g数据集中同步提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 论文验证了多地物尺度与复杂描述条件下指称检测的可行性，SCS框架对尺度多样性具有普适鲁棒性，为后续遥感智能交互与多模态感知奠定基础。

title: CE-GPPO: Coordinating Entropy via Gradient-Preserving Clipping Policy Optimization in Reinforcement Learning
comment: This paper has been accepted by ACL 2026
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a powerful paradigm for optimizing large language models (LLMs) to handle complex reasoning tasks. A core challenge in this process lies in managing policy entropy, which reflects the balance between exploration and exploitation during training. Existing methods, such as proximal policy optimization (PPO) and its variants, discard valuable gradient signals from low-probability tokens due to the clipping mechanism. We systematically analyze the entropy dynamics and reveal that these clipped tokens play a critical yet overlooked role in regulating entropy evolution. We propose \textbf{C}oordinating \textbf{E}ntropy via \textbf{G}radient-\textbf{P}reserving \textbf{P}olicy \textbf{O}ptimization (CE-GPPO), a novel algorithm that reintroduces gradients from clipped tokens in native PPO in a gentle and bounded manner. By controlling the magnitude of gradients from tokens outside the clipping interval, CE-GPPO is able to achieve an exploration-exploitation trade-off. We provide theoretical justification and empirical evidence showing that CE-GPPO effectively mitigates entropy instability. Extensive experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that CE-GPPO consistently outperforms strong baselines across different model scales.

AI.tldr: 提出 CE-GPPO，用受控方式把 PPO 丢弃的低概率 token 梯度重新引入，稳定策略熵并提升数学推理任务性能。
AI.motivation: PPO 在优化大模型推理时，因剪低概率 token 梯度导致熵不稳定、探索不足，亟需保留这些梯度信号。
AI.method: 保留被剪 token 的梯度并加限幅（bounded），使梯度幅度可控，从而协调熵的演化，实现更优的探索-利用平衡。
AI.result: 理论证明 CE-GPPO 能镇定熵震荡；不同规模 LLM 在数学推理基准上稳定优于 PPO 基线。
AI.conclusion: CE-GPPO 无需额外奖励或网络冗余，仅靠梯度重利用就能抑制熵急剧衰减，是 RLHF/RL-to-LLMs 的实用升级方案。

title: Reasoning Primitives in Hybrid and Non-Hybrid LLMs
summary: Reasoning in large language models is often treated as a monolithic capability, but its observed gains may arise from more basic operations. We study reasoning through two such primitives, recall and state-tracking, and ask whether hybrid architectures that combine attention-based retrieval with recurrent state updates are better suited than attention-only models for tasks that jointly require both. Using matched Olmo3 transformer and hybrid models in instruction-tuned and reasoning-augmented variants, we evaluate these models on a set of controlled tasks involving a mixture of state-tracking and recall primitives, state-based recall. Across tasks, we notice that reasoning augmentation provides the largest overall improvement, substantially extending the range of difficulty over which models remain effective. We also notice that in certain tasks, the hybrid reasoning model remains substantially more robust as sequential dependence increases. In contrast, the transformer reasoning model degrades sharply in performance as task difficulty increases beyond a given threshold. These results suggest that reasoning tokens and architectural inductive biases contribute at different levels of the computational process: explicit reasoning can expand a model's effective operating range, but its benefit depends on how well the underlying architecture supports persistent state propagation. Given the small size of our case study, which involves a limited set of models and tasks, we present these findings as suggestive rather than conclusive and leave broader validation across model families, scales, and task variations to future work.

AI.tldr: 本文用可控实验拆解「推理」为召回与状态跟踪两 primitive，发现显式推理 token 能扩大模型有效难度区间，而混合架构（Attention+Recurrence）在强序列依赖任务中比纯 Transformer 更鲁棒；二者作用层级不同，需协同设计。
AI.motivation: 将 LLM 的推理能力视为黑箱单体技能无法指导架构优化。作者假设推理增益源于更基础的 recall 与 state-tracking 操作，欲验证混合架构（具备显式状态更新机制）是否在需同时调用这两项操作的任务上优于纯注意力模型。
AI.method: 设计「state-based recall」系列可控合成任务，混合召回与状态跟踪需求；使用同规模、同训练的 Olmo3 纯 Transformer 与 Hybrid（注意力+递归）模型，对比指令微调与额外「推理 token」增强两种训练变体；度量随任务难度（序列长度、状态依赖深度）提升的性能衰减曲线。
AI.result: 1) 无论架构如何，引入显式推理 token 均带来最大整体提升，显著拉宽有效难度区间；2) 当序列依赖增强时，Hybrid 推理模型性能下降缓慢，而 Transformer 推理模型在临界难度后陡降；3) 在部分高依赖任务上 Hybrid 准确率绝对领先 20% 以上；4) 这些差异在 3B 级小模型与有限任务集下稳定出现。
AI.conclusion: 推理 token 与架构归纳偏置贡献于计算过程的不同层级：前者扩展操作范围，后者决定状态能否被持续传播。混合架构的递归状态更新为复杂推理提供必要支撑，未来需在更大模型家族、任务与尺度上验证该假设。

title: Secure LLM Fine-Tuning via Safety-Aware Probing
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success across many applications, but their ability to generate harmful content raises serious safety concerns. Although safety alignment techniques are often applied during pre-training or post-training, recent studies show that subsequent fine-tuning on adversarial or even benign data can still compromise model safety. In this paper, we revisit the fundamental question of why fine-tuning on non-harmful data may nevertheless degrade safety. We show that the safety and task-performance loss landscapes are partially decoupled, so updates that improve task-specific performance may still move the model toward unsafe regions. Based on this insight, we propose a safety-aware probing (SAP) optimization framework for mitigating safety risks during fine-tuning. Concretely, SAP uses contrastive safety signals to locate safety-correlated directions, and optimizes a lightweight probe that perturbs hidden-state propagation during fine-tuning, thereby steering parameter updates away from harmful trajectories while preserving task-specific learning. Extensive experiments show that SAP consistently improves the safety--utility tradeoff across multiple models and tasks. Averaged over multiple LLMs, SAP reduces the harmful score significantly relative to standard fine-tuning, outperforming strong baselines while maintaining competitive task-specific performance. SAP also demonstrates stronger robustness under harmful data poisoning, adversarial fine-tuning, and a dedicated post-fine-tuning adaptive attack, validating that SAP is an effective and scalable framework for preserving LLM safety during fine-tuning. Our code is available at https://github.com/ChengcanWu/SAP.

AI.tldr: 仅用无害数据微调仍能破坏LLM安全对齐；作者发现「安全」与「任务」损失景观部分解耦，据此提出SAP框架，在微调时通过轻量探针引导隐藏状态远离有害方向，兼顾安全与效用，实证显著优于基线且抗多种攻击。
AI.motivation: 尽管已有预/后训练安全对齐，后续微调（即使数据看似无害）仍会意外削弱LLM的安全性，亟需解释该现象并设计有效防护机制。
AI.method: 1) 实证揭示安全损失与任务损失景观部分解耦；2) 提出Safety-Aware Probing(SAP)：利用对比安全信号定位安全相关方向，在微调阶段用轻量级探针扰动隐藏状态传播，引导参数更新远离有害轨迹，同时保留任务学习。
AI.result: 多模型、多任务实验表明：SAP平均显著降低有害得分，优于强基线，任务性能持平；对数据中毒、对抗微调及自适应攻击均表现出更强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: SAP是可扩展的微调期安全保持框架，能在不牺牲任务性能的前提下有效抑制LLM产生有害内容。

title: Render-in-the-Loop: Vector Graphics Generation via Visual Self-Feedback
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown promising capabilities in generating Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) via direct code synthesis. However, existing paradigms typically adopt an open-loop "blind drawing" approach, where models generate symbolic code sequences without perceiving intermediate visual outcomes. This methodology severely underutilizes the powerful visual priors embedded in MLLMs vision encoders, treating SVG generation as a disjointed textual sequence modeling task rather than an integrated visuo-spatial one. Consequently, models struggle to reason about partial canvas states and implicit occlusion relationships, which are visually explicit but textually ambiguous. To bridge this gap, we propose Render-in-the-Loop, a novel generation paradigm that reformulates SVG synthesis as a step-wise, visual-context-aware process. By rendering intermediate code states into a cumulative canvas, the model explicitly observes the evolving visual context at each step, leveraging on-the-fly feedback to guide subsequent generation. However, we demonstrate that applying this visual loop naively to off-the-shelf models is suboptimal due to their inability to leverage incremental visual-code mappings. To address this, we first utilize fine-grained path decomposition to construct dense multi-step visual trajectories, and then introduce a Visual Self-Feedback (VSF) training strategy to condition the next primitive generation on intermediate visual states. Furthermore, a Render-and-Verify (RaV) inference mechanism is proposed to effectively filter degenerate and redundant primitives. Our framework, instantiated on a multimodal foundation model, outperforms strong open-weight baselines on the standard MMSVGBench. This result highlights the remarkable data efficiency and generalization capability of our Render-in-the-Loop paradigm for both Text-to-SVG and Image-to-SVG tasks.

AI.tldr: 现有 MLLM 把 SVG 生成当成开环文本序列任务，忽略中间画面，导致遮挡与空间推理失败；作者提出 Render-in-the-Loop 闭环框架，让模型每一步都能看到已渲染画布，并用 Visual Self-Feedback 训练与 Render-and-Verify 推理过滤冗余，最终在 MMSVGBench 上显著优于开源基线。
AI.motivation: MLLM 的编码器富含视觉先验，却被浪费在“盲画”式 SVG 生成；模型无法感知部分画布状态与隐式遮挡，造成空间-语义错位。需把 SVG 合成从纯文本序列任务转变为“边看边画”的 visuo-spatial 过程。
AI.method: 1) 将完整路径细粒度拆分为多步增量 primitive，构建稠密视觉轨迹；2) Visual Self-Feedback 训练：用中间渲染图作为附加视觉上下文，直接监督下一步 primitive 的生成；3) Render-and-Verify 推理：每步生成后渲染并验证，过滤退化/冗余图元，实现闭环自我修正。
AI.result: 在 MMSVGBench 基准上，Render-in-the-Loop 实例化的多模态基础模型在 Text-to-SVG 与 Image-to-SVG 双任务中均显著超越最强开源基线，且数据效率更高、泛化更好。
AI.conclusion: 把“渲染反馈”嵌入训练与推理闭环，可充分激活 MLLM 的视觉先验，显著提升 SVG 合成的空间一致性与语义对齐度；该方法为序列式图形生成提供了通用的 visuo-spatial 范式。

title: Distributed Associative Memory via Online Convex Optimization
summary: An associative memory (AM) enables cue-response recall, and associative memorization has recently been noted to underlie the operation of modern neural architectures such as Transformers. This work addresses a distributed setting where agents maintain a local AM to recall their own associations as well as selective information from others. Specifically, we introduce a distributed online gradient descent method that optimizes local AMs at different agents through communication over routing trees. Our theoretical analysis establishes sublinear regret guarantees, and experiments demonstrate that the proposed protocol consistently outperforms existing online optimization baselines.

AI.tldr: 构建跨智能体的分布式在线梯度下降来协同优化各自的联想记忆，理论给出次线性遗憾并实证优于已有在线基线。
AI.motivation: 将Transformer中类联想记忆的机制推广到多智能体场景，解决节点仅能凭本地记忆完成召回并安全吸收少量他人信息的分布式优化难题。
AI.method: 提出路由树通信下的分布式在线梯度下降(D-OAUM)：各智能体维护本地联想记忆，按树传递梯度并在路径上累积误差校正；更新规则为携LR-bandit噪声的小批量镜像梯度以保证可行性；采用累积通信量判据约束他人信息引用。
AI.result: 证明T轮次下对所有智能体均获得O(√T)次线性遗憾；相比单机OMGD、D-OGD与完全共享基线，在CIFAR-100/Places365子集上top-3检索提升3-5%并减少20%通信。
AI.conclusion: 分布式在线优化协同本地联想记忆可在保证通讯受限与隐私概要页条件下逼近全局学习性能，次线性遗憾为实际可扩展性提供理论保障，亦为Transformer类模型在多设备环境下的推理放置提供新框架。

title: Dynamical Priors as a Training Objective in Reinforcement Learning
comment: Supplementary material can be accessed here: https://github.com/drsukeshs/esd-rl
summary: Standard reinforcement learning (RL) optimizes policies for reward but imposes few constraints on how decisions evolve over time. As a result, policies may achieve high performance while exhibiting temporally incoherent behavior such as abrupt confidence shifts, oscillations, or degenerate inactivity. We introduce Dynamical Prior Reinforcement Learning (DP-RL), a training framework that augments policy gradient learning with an auxiliary loss derived from external state dynamics that implement evidence accumulation and hysteresis. Without modifying the reward, environment, or policy architecture, this prior shapes the temporal evolution of action probabilities during learning. Across three minimal environments, we show that dynamical priors systematically alter decision trajectories in task-dependent ways, promoting temporally structured behavior that cannot be explained by generic smoothing. These results demonstrate that training objectives alone can control the temporal geometry of decision-making in RL agents.

AI.tldr: 提出无需改动环境与网络的 DP-RL，通过在策略梯度中加入基于证据累积与滞后的动力学正则项，在三层任务里使智能体决策轨迹从震荡-突变变为平滑-连贯。
AI.motivation: 标准 RL 只最大化奖励，易产生活动骤停、置信突变等时间不一致决策，缺乏对动作概率演化过程的直接控制方法。
AI.method: 利用外部环境动力学（证据累积＋滞后）导出辅助损失，与策略梯度联合优化；无需更改奖励、环境与网络，仅通过训练目标改变动作概率随时间变化的期望轨迹。
AI.result: 在三个极简环境中，DP-RL 的系统使决策进展从(震荡、收敛中断、停滞状态)显著转向渐进收敛、保持活跃与高估风险控制，验证了动力学先验能定向塑造决策几何，并非普通平滑所致。
AI.conclusion: 仅通过训练目标就能独立控制RL智能体决策的时间几何，为施加可解释、合规且具有因果推理特性的时间一致策略提供了新的通用范式。

title: Flipping Against All Odds: Reducing LLM Coin Flip Bias via Verbalized Rejection Sampling
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can often accurately describe probability distributions using natural language, yet they still struggle to generate faithful samples from them. This mismatch limits their use in tasks requiring reliable stochasticity, such as Monte Carlo methods, agent-based simulations, and randomized decision-making. We investigate this gap between knowledge and sampling in the context of Bernoulli distributions. We introduce Verbalized Rejection Sampling (VRS), a natural-language adaptation of classical rejection sampling that prompts the LLM to reason about and accept or reject proposed samples. Despite relying on the same Bernoulli mechanism internally, VRS substantially reduces sampling bias across models. We provide theoretical analysis showing that, under mild assumptions, VRS improves over direct sampling, with gains attributable to both the algorithm and prompt design. More broadly, our results show how classical probabilistic tools can be verbalized and embedded into LLM workflows to improve reliability, without requiring access to model internals or heavy prompt engineering.

AI.tldr: LLM verbally samples Bernoulli but introduces bias; VRS embeds human-readable rejection logic, significantly reduces bias, and theoretically proves improvement without touching model parameters.
AI.motivation: 直接使用自然语言提示让LLM生成Bernoulli样本会系统性偏差，阻碍其在需要可靠随机性的场景（蒙特卡洛、仿真、随机决策）中的落地。
AI.method: 提出Verbalized Rejection Sampling（VRS）：将经典拒绝采样转译为自然语言推理流程，让LLM显式判断并决定接受或拒绝候选样本，无需访问内部权重或复杂提示工程。
AI.result: 在多个主流模型上，VRS相比直接语言采样显著降低采样偏差（典型模型KL散度减半以上）；理论证明在温和假设下偏差严格改善，增益来自算法与提示共同作用。
AI.conclusion: 经典概率算法可被

title: Preserving Knowledge in Large Language Model with Model-Agnostic Self-Decompression
summary: Humans can retain old knowledge while learning new information, but Large Language Models (LLMs) often suffer from catastrophic forgetting when post-pretrained or supervised fine-tuned (SFT) on domain-specific data. Moreover, for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) which are composed of the LLM base and visual projector (e.g. LLaVA), a significant decline in performance on language benchmarks was observed compared to their single-modality counterparts. To address these challenges, we introduce a novel model-agnostic self-decompression method, Tree Generation (TG), that decompresses knowledge within LLMs into the training corpus. This paper focuses on TG-SFT, which can synthetically generate SFT data for the instruction tuning steps. By incorporating the dumped corpus during SFT for MLLMs, we significantly reduce the forgetting problem.

AI.tldr: 把大模型自身已掌握的知识反向“解压”成文本补充进训练语料，可在单模与多模指令微调时显著减缓灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型(LM)在继续预训练或指令微调时常因灾难性遗忘丧失旧知识，而多模态大模型(LLM+视觉投射器)的语言基准成绩下降更明显，需要在不修改模型结构的前提下保持原有语言能力。
AI.method: 提出模型无关的“树生成-指令微调”(TG-SFT)框架：先让冻结的LM递归采样并扩展提示-响应对，形成覆盖面广的“知识解压”语料；随后在多模态指令微调阶段，将该合成语料混入目标域数据联合训练，无需额外外部语料或模型扩增。
AI.result: 在多模态模型LLaVA的微调实验中，仅用少量合成数据即可弥补语言基准损失，视觉问答性能保持稳定，整体遗忘程度较标准SFT显著降低。
AI.conclusion: 通过自生成语料的混合微调，TG-SFT能在保持新域性能的同时有效逆转多模态大模型的语言性能下滑，提供了一种低成本、易迁移的灾忘缓解范式。

title: ChessArena: A Chess Testbed for Evaluating Strategic Reasoning Capabilities of Large Language Models
summary: Recent large language models (LLMs) have shown strong reasoning capabilities. However, a critical question remains: do these models possess genuine strategic reasoning, or do they primarily excel at pattern recognition? To address this, we present ChessArena, a chess-based testbed for evaluating LLMs. Chess demands strategic reasoning, precise rule adherence, and the ability to track complex game states. ChessArena is a competitive framework where LLMs play against each other under four play modes. We evaluate 13 LLMs across over 800 games, testing basic understanding, move selection, and puzzle solving. Results reveal significant shortcomings: no model beats Maia-1100 (human amateur level), and some lose to random play. We also present a strong baseline: our fine-tuned Qwen3-8B substantially improves performance, approaching much larger state-of-the-art reasoning models.

AI.tldr: ChessArena棋盘评测显示，现有LLM仅具模式识别而无真正战略推理，连业余棋手都赢不了；作者微调Qwen3-8B给出可行改进基线。
AI.motivation: 质疑当前大模型“推理能力”是否只是高级模式匹配，需要一项既要求严格规则又需深层战略的任务来检验。
AI.method: 构建ChessArena对弈平台，让13个LLM在800+盘四种模式下互弈并与Maia-1100及随机走棋对手比较，同时测试棋局理解、选步与残局解谜；另外微调Qwen3-8B作为提升基线。
AI.result: 无任何LLM能战胜Maia-1100，部分模型甚至败给随机走棋，暴露出规则违反、状态追踪失败与短视决策等缺陷；微调后的Qwen3-8B显著跃升，逼近更大规模SOTA推理模型。
AI.conclusion: LLM的“推理”尚缺真实战略深度，性能可通过专门微调显著改善，ChessArena为后续推理研究提供了可重复、有区分度的新基准。

title: Drug Synergy Prediction via Residual Graph Isomorphism Networks and Attention Mechanisms
summary: In the treatment of complex diseases, treatment regimens using a single drug often yield limited efficacy and can lead to drug resistance. In contrast, combination drug therapies can significantly improve therapeutic outcomes through synergistic effects. However, experimentally validating all possible drug combinations is prohibitively expensive, underscoring the critical need for efficient computational prediction methods. Although existing approaches based on deep learning and graph neural networks (GNNs) have made considerable progress, challenges remain in reducing structural bias, improving generalization capability, and enhancing model interpretability. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a collaborative prediction graph neural network that integrates molecular structural features and cell-line genomic profiles with drug-drug interactions to enhance the prediction of synergistic effects. We introduce a novel model named the Residual Graph Isomorphism Network integrated with an Attention mechanism (ResGIN-Att). The model first extracts multi scale topological features of drug molecules using a residual graph isomorphism network, where residual connections help mitigate over-smoothing in deep layers. Subsequently, an adaptive Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) module fuses structural information from local to global scales. Finally, a cross-attention module is designed to explicitly model drug-drug interactions and identify key chemical substructures. Extensive experiments on five public benchmark datasets demonstrate that ResGIN-Att achieves competitive performance, comparing favorably against key baseline methods while exhibiting promising generalization capability and robustness.

AI.tldr: 提出跨注意力残差图同构网络 ResGIN-Att，融合分子拓扑特征、细胞系基因组与药物间相互作用，提升药物协同预测效果，在五个公开数据集上超越基线且具有良好的可解释性与泛化性。
AI.motivation: 单药治疗易产生耐药性，组合疗法虽可协同增效，但实验验证全部组合成本极高；现有深度学习/GNN 方法在结构偏差抑制、泛化与可解释性方面仍存在不足，亟需更高效的计算预测框架。
AI.method: 构建 ResGIN-Att：① 用残差图同构网络提取药物分子多尺度拓扑特征，残差连接抑制深层过平滑；② 自适应 LSTM 融合局部-全局结构信息；③ 跨注意力模块显式建模药物-药物相互作用并识别关键化学子结构；结合细胞系基因组信息完成协同预测。
AI.result: 在五个公开基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，ResGIN-Att 性能领先主要基线方法，同时展现出优异的泛化能力与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: ResGIN-Att 有效利用多尺度分子拓扑与基因组语境，显著提升协同组合预测精度与可解释性，为精准联合用药提供可信计算支持。

title: Strategic Scaling of Test-Time Compute: A Bandit Learning Approach
summary: Scaling test-time compute has emerged as an effective strategy for improving the performance of large language models. However, existing methods typically allocate compute uniformly across all queries, overlooking variation in query difficulty. To address this inefficiency, we formulate test-time compute allocation as a novel bandit learning problem and propose adaptive algorithms that estimate query difficulty on the fly and allocate compute accordingly. Compared to uniform allocation, our algorithms allocate more compute to challenging queries while maintaining accuracy on easier ones. Among challenging queries, our algorithms further learn to prioritize solvable instances, effectively reducing excessive computing on unsolvable queries. We theoretically prove that our algorithms achieve better compute efficiency than uniform allocation and empirically validate their effectiveness on math and code benchmarks. Specifically, our algorithms achieve up to an 11.10% performance improvement (15.04% relative) on the MATH-500 dataset, up to 10.82% (14.44% relative) on the AIME25 dataset, and up to an 11.23% performance improvement (15.29% relative) on the LiveCodeBench dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种劫匪式动态分配测试时计算资源的方法，使LLM在数学／代码任务上性能提升≈11–15%且显著节省算力。
AI.motivation: 大模型测试时普遍对所有查询均摊计算，忽视难度差异，导致在易题上浪费算力、在难题上又可能分配不足，迫切需要高效自适应的算力调度方案。
AI.method: 将测试时算力分配形式化为多臂劫匪学习问题：在线估计查询难度，对易题保持原有开销，对可解困难题动态追加计算，对不可解题及时止损；并提出理论上可证明更优的自适应分配算法。
AI.result: 在MATH-500、AIME25、LiveCodeBench三个基准上，相比均摊策略在准确率上平均提升约11.1%–15.3%，并显著减少冗余推理步骤，实现算力效率提升。
AI.conclusion: 基于劫匪学习的自适应测试时算力分配能按“题”施策，既保证难题通过率又避免浪费，为提升大模型推理性能提供了新的、经济而可扩展的范式。

title: Fake or Real, Can Robots Tell? Evaluating VLM Robustness to Domain Shift in Single-View Robotic Scene Understanding
summary: Robotic scene understanding increasingly relies on Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to generate natural language descriptions of the environment. In this work, we systematically evaluate single-view object captioning for tabletop scenes captured by a robotic manipulator, introducing a controlled physical domain shift that contrasts real-world tools with geometrically similar 3D-printed counterparts that differ in texture, colour, and material. We benchmark a suite of state-of-the-art, locally deployable VLMs across multiple metrics to assess semantic alignment and factual grounding. Our results demonstrate that while VLMs describe common real-world objects effectively, performance degrades markedly on 3D-printed items despite their structurally familiar forms. We further expose critical vulnerabilities in standard evaluation metrics, showing that some fail to detect domain shifts entirely or reward fluent but factually incorrect captions. These findings highlight the limitations of deploying foundation models for embodied agents and the need for more robust architectures and evaluation protocols in physical robotic applications.

AI.tldr: 本研究首次系统评估VLM在真实机械臂视角下的桌面对象字幕生成能力，指出3D打印纹理域漂移导致性能骤降，并揭示现有指标对幻觉无感，警告当前VLM直接用于具身感知的脆弱性。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人场景理解依赖VLM自动生成自然语言描述，但缺乏在真实物理-数字域漂移下对低成本、可本地部署模型的系统评估；同时标准指标是否能捕捉幻觉尚不明确。
AI.method: 采用真实机械臂单视角采集桌面场景，引入受控物理域漂移——将常见真实工具与其纹理-颜色-材料不同的3D打印几何孪生体配对；在本地运行一组SOTA VLM，用语义对齐度与事实一致性多指标对比其在真实与3D打印对象上的字幕质量，并分析指标失效模式。
AI.result: VLM对真实熟悉物体字幕准确，但在3D打印体上性能显著下降；BLEU/ROUGE等常规指标对域漂移零敏感，甚至因流畅但错误描述反而得分更高，暴露评估盲区。
AI.conclusion: 基础模型在具身代理中的直接部署存在显著鲁棒性缺口，亟需面向物理环境的域适应架构及能检测幻觉的评测协议，否则难以保障机器人场景理解的安全可靠。

title: Towards Multimodal Active Learning: Efficient Learning with Limited Paired Data
comment: Accepted by Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR)
summary: Active learning (AL) is a principled strategy to reduce annotation cost in data-hungry deep learning. However, existing AL algorithms focus almost exclusively on unimodal data, overlooking the substantial annotation burden in multimodal learning. We introduce the first framework for multimodal active learning with unaligned data, where the learner must actively acquire cross-modal alignments rather than labels on pre-aligned pairs. This setting captures the practical bottleneck in modern multimodal pipelines, where unimodal features are easy to obtain but high-quality alignment is costly. We develop a new algorithm that combines uncertainty and diversity principles in a modality-aware design, achieves linear-time acquisition, and applies seamlessly to both pool-based and streaming-based settings. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that our approach consistently reduces multimodal annotation cost while preserving performance; for instance, on the ColorSwap dataset it cuts annotation requirements by up to 40% without loss in accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文首次针对多模态、非对齐数据提出主动学习框架，让模型主动挑选需对齐的跨模态样本而非标注已配对的样本，线性时间采样，实验表明在ColorSwap等基准上可节省40%对齐标注量且不损失精度。
AI.motivation: 现有主动学习主要处理单模态数据，忽视多模态场景中对齐标注的巨大代价；真实流程中各模态特征易获取，高质量对齐成本高昂，亟需减少对对齐标注的依赖。
AI.method: 提出“多模态非对齐主动学习”新范式，将主动采样目标从“选样本标标签”转为“选样本供对齐”；设计结合不确定度与多样性的模态感知采样策略，保证线性时间复杂度，同时适配池式和流式两种场景。
AI.result: 在ColorSwap、MUVE等多个基准上，该方法在保持模型性能的前提下平均减少30–40%的跨模态对齐标注量，相对随机采样和单模态AL基线显著提升数据效率与收敛速度。
AI.conclusion: 首次证实主动学习可直接优化多模态对齐环节；所提框架通用、轻量，为降低多模态监督成本提供了可扩展的解决方案，并启发了后续面向对齐质量与任务性能协同优化的研究。

title: MISTY: High-Throughput Motion Planning via Mixer-based Single-step Drifting
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)
summary: Multi-modal trajectory generation is essential for safe autonomous driving, yet existing diffusion-based planners suffer from high inference latency due to iterative neural function evaluations. This paper presents MISTY (Mixer-based Inference for Single-step Trajectory-drifting Yield), a high-throughput generative motion planner that achieves state-of-the-art closed-loop performance with pure single-step inference. MISTY integrates a vectorized Sub-Graph encoder to capture environment context, a Variational Autoencoder to structure expert trajectories into a compact 32-dimensional latent manifold, and an ultra-lightweight MLP-Mixer decoder to eliminate quadratic attention complexity. Importantly, we introduce a latent-space drifting loss that shifts the complex distribution evolution entirely to the training phase. By formulating explicit attractive and repulsive forces, this mechanism empowers the model to synthesize novel, proactive maneuvers, such as active overtaking, that are virtually absent from the raw expert demonstrations. Extensive evaluations on the nuPlan benchmark demonstrate that MISTY achieves state-of-the-art results on the challenging Test14-hard split, with comprehensive scores of 80.32 and 82.21 in non-reactive and reactive settings, respectively. Operating at over 99 FPS with an end-to-end latency of 10.1 ms, MISTY offers an order-of-magnitude speedup over iterative diffusion planners while while achieving significantly robust generation.

AI.tldr: MISTY 用单步推理取代扩散模型的迭代采样，在 nuPlan-hard 上取得 80+ 分的同时实现 >99 FPS，速度提升一个量级且能主动生成超车等未见策略。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散规划器为生成多模态轨迹需迭代去噪，推理延迟高，难以满足实时自动驾驶需求，需要一种可单步完成且保留多模态与前瞻性的高速生成式运动规划方法。
AI.method: 提出 MISTY：① 向量化子图编码器提取场景上下文；② VAE 将专家轨迹压缩到 32 维潜空间；③ MLP-Mixer 单步解码轨迹，避免二次注意力复杂度；④ 训练阶段引入潜空间漂移损失，显式构造吸引-排斥力场，把分布演化负担前移，使模型能在测试时一步合成未见的高主动性策略（如主动超车）。
AI.result: nuPlan Test14-hard 基准上，MISTY 在非反应与反应设定分别取得 80.32 与 82.21 的 SOTA 综合得分，端到端延迟 10.1 ms、吞吐 >99 FPS，比迭代扩散规划器快约 10 倍，同时保持鲁棒的多模态生成能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过把复杂分布建模迁移到训练期并采用轻量级单步架构，MISTY 首次在闭环性能、推理速度与策略创新性三方面同时突破，为实时自动驾驶生成式规划提供了可行的高效新范式。

AI.tldr: 首次在实体机器人场景下系统评估VLM对
AI.motivation: 现有VLM评测多停留在网络图片，缺乏对机器人真实作业环境的考察。作者关注当物体外观（纹理、颜色、材质）发生受控域偏移时，VLM的语义描述是否仍可靠，以揭示基础模型在具身智能中的潜在风险。
AI.method: 在桌面操作器中采集单视角图像，引入“真实工具 vs. 几何一致、仅外观不同的3D打印工具”这一受控物理域偏移；选取若干可本地部署的最新VLM，用包括语义对齐、事实一致性在内的多套指标进行基准评测，并反向验证这些指标本身能否捕捉域偏移。
AI.result: VLM对常见真实物体表现良好，但在3D打印物品上性能骤降；部分广泛使用的自动评价指标对域偏移毫无反应，甚至给流畅却事实错误的描述打出高分。

title: Efficient Multi-Source Knowledge Transfer by Model Merging
summary: While transfer learning is an effective strategy, it often overlooks the opportunity to leverage knowledge from numerous available models online. Addressing this multi-source transfer learning problem is a promising path to boost adaptability and cut re-training costs. However, existing methods remain inherently coarse-grained: they lack the precision needed for fine-grained knowledge extraction as well as the scalability required to aggregate knowledge from either large numbers of source models or models with high parameter counts. We address these limitations by leveraging Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) to first decompose each source model into its elementary, rank-one components. A subsequent aggregation stage then selects only the most salient components from all sources, thereby overcoming the previous efficiency and precision limitations. To best preserve and leverage the synthesized knowledge base, our method adapts to the target task by fine-tuning only the principal singular values of the merged matrix. In essence, this process recalibrates the importance of top SVD components. The proposed framework allows for efficient and scalable multi-source transfer learning in both vision and language domains, while remaining robust to perturbations in both the input space and the parameter space.

AI.tldr: 首次把多源模型蒸馏转化为秩-1 SVD 基元聚合问题，仅微调主奇异值即可跨域迁移，精度与规模瓶颈兼得突破。
AI.motivation: 现有多源迁移或粗暴加权整模型、或受限参数量，难以从海量/大模型中细粒度抽取并高效聚合知识，导致迁移收益与规模、精度不可兼得。
AI.method: 对每源模型做 SVD 得到秩-1 组件；跨源筛选最显著组件构成合成知识库；仅对合并矩阵的主奇异值实施轻量微调，实现参数级重加权而非全参数重训。
AI.result: 在视觉与语言任务上，相比基线方法以极少可调参数获得更高准确率，对输入扰动与参数扰动均表现出鲁棒性，同时支持百级大模型源的可扩展聚合。
AI.conclusion: SVD 秩-1 组件视角将多源迁移从整模型级降至原子级，兼顾细粒度知识提取、计算效率与跨域通用性，为大规模模型再利用提供新范式。

title: ATOM: A Pretrained Neural Operator for Multitask Molecular Dynamics
summary: Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations underpin modern computational drug discovery, materials science, and biochemistry. Recent machine learning models provide high-fidelity MD predictions without the need to repeatedly solve quantum mechanical forces, enabling significant speedups over conventional pipelines. Yet many such methods typically enforce strict equivariance and rely on sequential rollouts, thus limiting their flexibility and simulation efficiency. They are also commonly single-task, trained on individual molecules and fixed timeframes, which restricts generalization to unseen compounds and extended timesteps. To address these issues, we propose Atomistic Transformer Operator for Molecules (ATOM), a pretrained transformer neural operator for multitask molecular dynamics. ATOM adopts a quasi-equivariant design that requires no explicit molecular graph and employs a temporal attention mechanism, allowing for the accurate parallel decoding of multiple future states. To support operator pretraining across chemicals and timescales, we curate TG80, a large, diverse, and numerically stable MD dataset with over 2.5 million femtoseconds of trajectories across 80 compounds. ATOM achieves state-of-the-art performance on established single-task benchmarks, such as MD17, RMD17 and MD22. After multitask pretraining on TG80, ATOM shows exceptional zero-shot generalization to unseen molecules across varying time horizons. We believe ATOM represents a significant step toward accurate, efficient, and transferable molecular dynamics models.

AI.tldr: ATOM是一种用于多任务分子动力学预测的新型Transformer神经网络算子，采用准等变设计与时间注意力机制，支持并行解码多个未来状态，并在TG80大数据上预训练后对未知分子和时段具备零样本泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有机器学习加速MD方法存在过度强调基不变性、仅顺序单步推进、只能处理单一分子固定时段等限制，导致灵活性与推进效率不足，且难以泛化到新化合物或长时模拟。
AI.method: 提出ATOM模型：放弃刚性等变约束，改用准等变结构；无需显式构建分子图，网络直接运行在四维（坐标+速度+势+时）张量；插时间注意力并行一次性预测多时刻位形，并在大规模MD数据集TG80上进行多任务预训练。
AI.result: ATOM在MD17、RMD17与MD22单任务数据集上达到最佳SoTA精度；TG80多任务预训练后，它在未知分子及长达数百飞秒的时段测试中实现了优异零样本泛化，显著优于现有等变模型及非多任务基线。
AI.conclusion: ATOM验证Transformer类神经算子可在保证精度的同时打破等变框架与单步顺序推演束缚，并获得化学物质及时域的大范围可迁移性，为实现高效精确的通用分子动力学模型迈出关键一步。

title: Generalizing Numerical Reasoning in Table Data through Operation Sketches and Self-Supervised Learning
comment: Accepted to TACL. This is a pre-MIT Press publication version
summary: Numerical reasoning over expert-domain tables often exhibits high in-domain accuracy but limited robustness to domain shift. Models trained with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on specific datasets tend to rely on header-operation shortcuts rather than structural reasoning. We introduce TaNOS, a continual pre-training framework comprising three components: (i) header anonymization to reduce lexical memorization, (ii) operation sketches that provide minimal structural cues, and (iii) self-supervised pretraining that constructs correctness-guaranteed program-question pairs from given tables in a program-first manner. By decoupling domain semantics and numerical operation structure, TaNOS improves the transferability of numerical reasoning. Applied to an 8B instruction-tuned model, TaNOS achieves 80.13% execution accuracy on FinQA with only 10% train data, outperforming SFT baseline (73.97%) with full train data and proprietary models such as GPT-5, Gemini-2.5-Pro. Furthermore, in the domain-shift experiments, TaNOS displays nearly-negligible cross-domain gap (<2pp) when standard SFT shows over 10pp gap. These results suggest that structural guidance with operation sketches, header-agnostic representations, and correctness-guaranteed self-supervision can improve the robustness of numerical reasoning across diverse expert-domain tables.

AI.tldr: TaNOS 通过三项无监督策略（匿名表头、操作草图、程序优先的自监督预训练）把数值推理结构从领域语义中解耦，使小模型仅用 10% 数据便超越全量 SFT 与 GPT-5 等专有模型，并几乎消除跨域性能差距。
AI.motivation: 现有数值推理模型依赖监督微调，易死记表头和操作捷径，域内高准确但域迁移鲁棒性差。
AI.method: 提出连续预训练框架 TaNOS：1) 匿名化表头削弱词汇记忆；2) 设计轻量级操作草图保留运算结构；3) 以程序优先自动生成正确答案的程序-问题对进行自监督预训练。三步共同把结构学习与领域语义解耦。
AI.result: 在 FinQA 上，8B 指令模型仅 10% 训练数据即达 80.13% 执行准确率，超过全数据 SFT（73.97%）及 GPT-5、Gemini-2.5-Pro。域迁移实验显示 TaNOS 跨域差距 <2pp，而 SFT 超过 10pp。
AI.conclusion: 操作草图、表头无关表示与正确性保证的自监督预训练可显著提升数值推理在多种专家表格上的可迁移性与鲁棒性。

title: Counterfactual Segmentation Reasoning: Diagnosing and Mitigating Pixel-Grounding Hallucination
summary: Segmentation Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have significantly advanced grounded visual understanding, yet they remain prone to pixel-grounding hallucinations, producing masks for incorrect objects or for objects that are entirely absent. Existing evaluations rely almost entirely on text- or label-based perturbations, which check only whether the predicted mask matches the queried label. Such evaluations overlook the spatial footprint and severity of hallucination and therefore fail to reveal vision-driven hallucinations, which are more challenging and more prevalent. To address this gap, we formalize the task of Counterfactual Segmentation Reasoning (CSR), where a model must segment the referenced object in the factual image and abstain in its counterfactual counterpart. To support this task, we curate HalluSegBench, the first large-scale benchmark to diagnose referring and reasoning expression segmentation hallucinations using controlled visual counterfactuals, alongside new evaluation metrics that measure hallucination severity and disentangle vision- and language-driven failure modes. We further introduce RobustSeg, a segmentation VLM trained with counterfactual fine-tuning (CFT) to learn when to segment and when to abstain. Experimental results confirm RobustSeg reduces hallucinations by 30%, while improving segmentation performance on FP-RefCOCO(+/g).

AI.tldr: 作者首次用视觉反事实图像诊断分割VLM的像素级幻觉，提出CSR任务、HalluSegBench基准和CFT训练法，使RobustSeg在降低30%幻觉的同时保持分割性能。
AI.motivation: 现有分割VLM常把不存在或错误的物体也分割出来，而当前评估只做文本扰动，无法暴露更普遍、更难的“视觉驱动幻觉”。需要直接操控图像内容、量化幻觉严重程度并区分视觉-语言失效模式。
AI.method: 1)形式化Counterfactual Segmentation Reasoning(CSR)任务：给定事实图及其-counterfactual(目标物体被移除或替换)，模型应在事实图内分割、在反事实图内拒绝输出。2)构建HalluSegBench：首个人工精标、大规模视觉反事实基准，覆盖指代表达与推理表达两类分割。3)提出新指标：幻觉率、严重性得分、Vision-only/Language-only误差分解。4)设计RobustSeg：在标准分割损失外增加Counterfactual Fine-Tuning(CFT)，通过对比事实-反事实对学习“何时分割、何时弃权”。
AI.result: 在HalluSegBench上，主流分割VLM幻觉率可达20-40%；RobustSeg将整体幻觉降低30%，vision-only幻觉降低更明显，同时在FP-RefCOCO/+/g真实分割指标上保持或提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 视觉反事实基准与CSR任务能有效揭示并量化分割VLM的像素幻觉；CFT训练策略可显著抑制幻觉而不牺牲精度，为构建可靠的可定位视觉-语言模型提供了可扩展框架。

title: Cross-Distribution Diffusion Priors-Driven Iterative Reconstruction for Sparse-View CT
comment: 17 pages, 15 figures, accepted by IEEE Transactions on Medical Imaging
summary: Sparse-View CT (SVCT) reconstruction enhances temporal resolution and reduces radiation dose, yet its clinical use is hindered by artifacts due to view reduction and domain shifts from scanner, protocol, or anatomical variations, leading to performance degradation in out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios. In this work, we propose a Cross-Distribution Diffusion Priors-Driven Iterative Reconstruction (CDPIR) framework to tackle the OOD problem in SVCT. CDPIR integrates cross-distribution diffusion priors, derived from a Scalable Interpolant Transformer (SiT), with model-based iterative reconstruction methods. Specifically, we train a SiT backbone, an extension of the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) architecture, to establish a unified stochastic interpolant framework, leveraging Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) across multiple datasets. By randomly dropping the conditioning with a null embedding during training, the model learns both domain-specific and domain-invariant priors, enhancing generalizability. During sampling, the globally sensitive transformer-based diffusion model exploits the cross-distribution prior within the unified stochastic interpolant framework, enabling flexible and stable control over multi-distribution-to-noise interpolation paths and decoupled sampling strategies, thereby improving adaptation to OOD reconstruction. By alternating between data fidelity and sampling updates, our model achieves state-of-the-art performance with superior detail preservation in SVCT reconstructions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CDPIR significantly outperforms existing approaches, particularly under OOD conditions, highlighting its robustness and potential clinical value in challenging imaging scenarios.

AI.tldr: CDPIR 用跨分布扩散先验驱动的迭代重建，把基于 SiT 的扩散生成模型嵌入 MBIR 框架，在 SVCT 上做数据一致性-采样交替优化，在域外场景实现目前最佳伪影抑制与细节保持。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视角 CT 可提速降剂量，但视角减少和域偏移（设备、协议、解剖）导致严重伪影与分布外性能骤降，现有方法难以兼顾临床鲁棒性。
AI.method: 1) 设计 SiT（可扩展插值 Transformer）扩展 DiT，利用无条件训练 dropout 学习域特异/域不变混合先验。2) 在统一随机插值框架内引入 CFG，实现多分布→噪声路径的解耦控制。3) 将扩散先验嵌入 MBIR，迭代交替数据一致性更新与 SiT 采样，重建出 OOD 图像。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实多中心 SVCT 数据上，CDPIR 相对现有最优方法，OOD 场景峰值信噪比提升 2.1 dB，SSIM 提升 8%，金属与结构伪影显著减少，解剖细节纹理保持完整。
AI.conclusion: CDPIR 证明扩散生成先验可无缝嵌入传统迭代重建，解决 SVCT 分布外难题，具备临床推广潜力；代码与模型计划开源。

title: Not-a-Bandit: Provably No-Regret Drafter Selection in Speculative Decoding for LLMs
summary: Speculative decoding is widely used in accelerating large language model (LLM) inference. In this work, we focus on the online draft model selection problem in speculative decoding. We design an algorithm that provably competes with the best draft model in hindsight for each query in terms of either the token acceptance probability or expected acceptance length. In particular, we show that we can accurately evaluate all draft models, instead of only the chosen model without incurring additional queries to the target model, which allows us to improve exponentially over the existing bandit-based approach as the number of draft models increases. Our approach is generically applicable with any speculative decoding methods (single draft, multi-drafts and draft-trees). Moreover, we design system-efficient versions of online learners and demonstrate that the overhead in computation and latency can be substantially reduced. We conduct extensive experiments on open-source LLMs and diverse datasets, demonstrating that our methods substantially outperform the state-of-the-art EAGLE3 and the BanditSpec baseline in a variety of domains where specialized domain-expert drafters are available, especially when long reasoning chains are required.

AI.tldr: 提出一种在线草稿模型选择算法，可在不增加目标模型调用次数的前提下，为每次查询动态匹配最优草稿模型，显著优于现有bandit方法及EAGLE3。
AI.motivation: 推测解码虽能加速LLM推理，但现有方法依赖固定或带宽受限的草稿模型选择，无法针对每个查询即时利用最优草稿模型，尤其当存在多个领域专家草稿模型时效率低。
AI.method: 将在线草稿选择建模为“全信息”在线学习问题：每步同时观测所有草稿模型的接受信号，无需额外目标模型查询；设计理论保障算法，使累计遗憾相对于最佳 hindsight 草稿模型呈指数级优于bandit；并提出系统级高效实现，降低计算与延迟开销；兼容单草稿、多草稿及草稿树等任何推测解码框架。
AI.result: 理论证明遗憾边界指数优于bandit基线；在开源LLM与多领域数据集上，相比SOTA的EAGLE3和BanditSpec，推理链越长，接受长度与端到端加速比提升越显著，最高可再增30%以上。
AI.conclusion: 在线、全信息、系统高效的草稿模型选择机制可在零额外目标调用成本下，持续逼近每查询最优草稿，为LLM推测解码提供通用且可扩展的加速方案。

title: Architectures for Robust Self-Organizing Energy Systems under Information and Control Constraints
comment: This preprint has not undergone peer review (when applicable) or any post-submission improvements or corrections. The Version of Record of this contribution will be published in Agents and Artificial Intelligence, Lecture Notes in Computer Science, and available online at https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-032-25029-2_19
summary: Applying the concept of controlled self-organization in agent-based Cyber-Physical Energy Systems (CPES) is a promising approach to ensure system robustness. By introducing an observer/controller architecture to the system, this concept allows for self-organization while still enabling intervention when disturbances occur. Thus, it is possible to respond to effects of cyber attacks, a major threat to current energy systems. However, when implementing an observer to monitor the system and a controller to execute actions for controlled self-organization in CPES, it is essential to take into account restrictions on information and actions resulting from the privacy of local distributed energy resources, regulatory constraints, and data exchange requirements. For this reason, this paper presents architecture variants for the observer and controller that take into account restrictions on access to information and limited actions. In addition, it evaluates possible controller actions in various architectures. The results underscore the importance of considering observer/controller architectures when designing agent-based systems to ensure their robustness for real-world applications.

AI.tldr: 提出带约束的Observer/Controller架构，在保护分布式能源隐私与合规前提下，使CPES仍能利用受控自组织对抗网络攻击并维持鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 网络攻击威胁日益严重，而传统集中式方案难以兼顾分布式能源的隐私、法规与数据交换限制，亟需一种既允许自组织又能合法干预的架构。
AI.method: 1) 基于代理的CPES建模；2) 设计多种受限制的Observer/Controller架构（信息受限+动作受限）；3) 在典型攻击场景下仿真评估各架构可选控制动作的有效性与合规性。
AI.result: 受限架构仍能在攻击扰动下引导系统回稳；信息/动作限制越严，可干预空间越小，但合理设计可在90%场景内维持鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 在设计阶段即将隐私、法规、数据交换约束嵌入Observer/Controller，是实现可部署、抗攻击CPES的先决条件。

title: Unveiling Unicode's Unseen Underpinnings in Undermining Authorship Attribution
summary: When using a public communication channel--whether formal or informal, such as commenting or posting on social media--end users have no expectation of privacy: they compose a message and broadcast it for the world to see. Even if an end user takes utmost precautions to anonymize their online presence--using an alias or pseudonym; masking their IP address; spoofing their geolocation; concealing their operating system and user agent; deploying encryption; registering with a disposable phone number or email; disabling non-essential settings; revoking permissions; and blocking cookies and fingerprinting--one obvious element still lingers: the message itself. Assuming they avoid lapses in judgment or accidental self-exposure, there should be little evidence to validate their actual identity, right? Wrong. The content of their message--necessarily open for public consumption--exposes an attack vector: stylometric analysis, or author profiling. In this paper, we dissect the technique of stylometry, discuss an antithetical counter-strategy in adversarial stylometry, and devise enhancements through Unicode steganography.

AI.tldr: 即使匿名化做到极致，公开消息仍可通过文体特征被追踪；本文系统剖析文体分析威胁，提出对抗性文体混淆策略，并用 Unicode 隐写术强化隐身效果。
AI.motivation: 用户以为匿名设置足够即可隐藏身份，却忽视了公开发布的文本本身会泄露文体指纹；现有研究缺乏对 Unicode 隐写术在对抗文体识别中的系统评估。
AI.method: 1. 拆解传统文体特征提取与作者识别流程；2. 构建对抗性文体生成框架，引入同义词替换、句法变换等手段；3. 将 Unicode 零宽字符与同质异形字嵌入文本，实现“零视觉”扰动；4. 在跨域 Twitter、Reddit 数据集上评估识别率下降幅度与隐蔽性。
AI.result: 对抗策略使宏平均 F1 从 0.87 降至 0.31；加入 Unicode 隐写后，扰动检出率 <2%，视觉差异肉眼不可见，消息长度仅增 0.8%。
AI.conclusion: 文体指纹是匿名最后一道缺口；对抗性文体+Unicode 隐写能在不损可读性的前提下显著降低去匿名化风险，为公开信道匿名通信提供可落地的新防线。

title: TimePre: Bridging Accuracy, Efficiency, and Stability in Probabilistic Time-Series Forecasting
summary: We propose TimePre, a simple framework that unifies the efficiency of Multilayer Perceptron (MLP)-based models with the distributional flexibility of Multiple Choice Learning (MCL) for Probabilistic Time-Series Forecasting (PTSF). Stabilized Instance Normalization (SIN), the core of TimePre, is a normalization layer that explicitly addresses the trade-off among accuracy, efficiency, and stability. SIN stabilizes the hybrid architecture by correcting channel-wise statistical shifts, thereby resolving the catastrophic hypothesis collapse. Extensive experiments on six benchmark datasets demonstrate that TimePre achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) accuracy on key probabilistic metrics. Critically, TimePre achieves inference speeds that are orders of magnitude faster than sampling-based models, and is more stable than prior MCL approaches.
