title: StegoStylo: Squelching Stylometric Scrutiny through Steganographic Stitching
summary: Stylometry--the identification of an author through analysis of a text's style (i.e., authorship attribution)--serves many constructive purposes: it supports copyright and plagiarism investigations, aids detection of harmful content, offers exploratory cues for certain medical conditions (e.g., early signs of dementia or depression), provides historical context for literary works, and helps uncover misinformation and disinformation. In contrast, when stylometry is employed as a tool for authorship verification--confirming whether a text truly originates from a claimed author--it can also be weaponized for malicious purposes. Techniques such as de-anonymization, re-identification, tracking, profiling, and downstream effects like censorship illustrate the privacy threats that stylometric analysis can enable. Building on these concerns, this paper further explores how adversarial stylometry combined with steganography can counteract stylometric analysis. We first present enhancements to our adversarial attack, $\textit{TraceTarnish}$, providing stronger evidence of its capacity to confound stylometric systems and reduce their attribution and verification accuracy. Next, we examine how steganographic embedding can be fine-tuned to mask an author's stylistic fingerprint, quantifying the level of authorship obfuscation achievable as a function of the proportion of words altered with zero-width Unicode characters. Based on our findings, steganographic coverage of 33% or higher seemingly ensures authorship obfuscation. Finally, we reflect on the ways stylometry can be used to undermine privacy and argue for the necessity of defensive tools like $\textit{TraceTarnish}$.

AI.tldr: 论文指出文体计量既能服务版权、医疗等正面用途，亦可被滥用于去匿名化与审查；为此提出对抗性方法TraceTarnish并结合零宽Unicode隐写，实验表明当33%以上词汇被隐写修改即可有效遮蔽作者指纹，强调需发展此类防御工具以对抗隐私威胁。
AI.motivation: 现有文体计量技术既能助力版权、医疗与信息真伪识别，又存在去匿名化、追踪与审查等恶意应用风险，因此需研究如何有效对抗文体计量以保障作者隐私。
AI.method: 1) 强化对抗攻击TraceTarnish，干扰文体计量系统的作者归属与验证精度；2) 将零宽Unicode隐写嵌入与对抗微调结合，量化不同比例词汇改动下的作者指纹遮蔽效果。
AI.result: TraceTarnish显著降低文体计量准确率；当零宽字符隐写覆盖≥33%词汇时，可实现可靠的作者身份混淆。
AI.conclusion: 文体计量具备显著隐私威胁，必须发展TraceTarnish等防御工具，以在保留文本可读性的同时有效隐藏作者风格指纹。

title: Video-Robin: Autoregressive Diffusion Planning for Intent-Grounded Video-to-Music Generation
summary: Video-to-music (V2M) is the fundamental task of creating background music for an input video. Recent V2M models achieve audiovisual alignment by typically relying on visual conditioning alone and provide limited semantic and stylistic controllability to the end user. In this paper, we present Video-Robin, a novel text-conditioned video-to-music generation model that enables fast, high-quality, semantically aligned music generation for video content. To balance musical fidelity and semantic understanding, Video-Robin integrates autoregressive planning with diffusion-based synthesis. Specifically, an autoregressive module models global structure by semantically aligning visual and textual inputs to produce high-level music latents. These latents are subsequently refined into coherent, high-fidelity music using local Diffusion Transformers. By factoring semantically driven planning into diffusion-based synthesis, Video-Robin enables fine-grained creator control without sacrificing audio realism. Our proposed model outperforms baselines that solely accept video input and additional feature conditioned baselines on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution benchmarks with a 2.21x speed in inference compared to SOTA. We will open-source everything upon paper acceptance.

AI.tldr: Video-Robin 用文本+视频双条件，把全局规划（自回归）与局部扩散合成解耦，实现高保真、语义可控的配乐，推理快2.2×，代码将开源。
AI.motivation: 现有V2M方法仅靠视觉信息，可控性弱、语义对齐差；用户需要按文本意图快速生成高质量背景音乐。
AI.method: 两阶段：①自回归模块将视觉与文本语义映射为全局音乐潜码；②局部Diffusion Transformer把潜码细化成连贯高保真音频，实现语义规划与声音合成的分离。
AI.result: 在分布内外基准上，音质、语义对齐及用户研究均优于仅视频或附加特征基线，推理速度提升2.21倍。
AI.conclusion: Video-Robin通过“先规划、后扩散”的策略，在保真的同时赋予细粒度文本控制，为视频配乐提供高效、开源的新基线。

title: GSpaRC: Gaussian Splatting for Real-time Reconstruction of RF Channels
summary: Channel state information (CSI) is essential for adaptive beamforming and maintaining robust links in wireless communication systems. However, acquiring CSI incurs significant overhead, consuming up to 25\% of spectrum resources in 5G networks due to frequent pilot transmissions at sub-millisecond intervals. Recent approaches aim to reduce this burden by reconstructing CSI from spatiotemporal RF measurements, such as signal strength and direction-of-arrival. While effective in offline settings, these methods often suffer from inference latencies in the 5--100~ms range, making them impractical for real-time systems. We present GSpaRC: Gaussian Splatting for Real-time Reconstruction of RF Channels, the first algorithm to break the 1 ms latency barrier while maintaining high accuracy. GSpaRC represents the RF environment using a compact set of 3D Gaussian primitives, each parameterized by a lightweight neural model augmented with physics-informed features such as distance-based attenuation. Unlike traditional vision-based splatting pipelines, GSpaRC is tailored for RF reception: it employs an equirectangular projection onto a hemispherical surface centered at the receiver to reflect omnidirectional antenna behavior. A custom CUDA pipeline enables fully parallelized directional sorting, splatting, and rendering across frequency and spatial dimensions. Evaluated on multiple RF datasets, GSpaRC achieves similar CSI reconstruction fidelity to recent state-of-the-art methods while reducing training and inference time by over an order of magnitude. By trading modest GPU computation for a substantial reduction in pilot overhead, GSpaRC enables scalable, low-latency channel estimation suitable for deployment in 5G and future wireless systems. The code is available here: \href{https://github.com/Nbhavyasai/GSpaRC-WirelessGaussianSplatting.git}{GSpaRC}.

AI.tldr: GSpaRC首次用三维高斯抛雪球法把CSI重建延迟压到<1 ms，训练/推理提速10倍以上，精度媲美SOTA，可直接部署于5G实时系统。
AI.motivation: 5G中频繁导频开销高达25%频谱，现有基于RF测量重建CSI的方案推理延迟5–100 ms，无法实时闭环波束赋形。
AI.method: 1)将RF环境表征为少量3D高斯原语，参数含轻量神经网络+物理距离衰减；2)按接收机中心半球面等距投影，模拟全向天线；3)CUDA并行化方向排序-抛雪球-渲染，跨频-空两维一次性输出CSI。
AI.result: 多RF数据集上，CSI重建精度与SOTA持平，训练时间从小时级缩至分钟级，推理延迟<1 ms（约两个OFDM符号周期），导频开销可降一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 用适度GPU算力换取导频大幅削减，GSpaRC为5G及未来无线系统提供可扩展、超低时延的信道估计新范式。

title: Process Supervision via Verbal Critique Improves Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: Inference-time scaling for LLM reasoning has focused on three axes: chain depth, sample breadth, and learned step-scorers (PRMs). We introduce a fourth axis, granularity of external verbal supervision, via Verbal Process Supervision (VPS), a training-free framework that uses structured natural-language critique from a stronger supervisor to guide an iterative generate-critique-refine loop up to a round budget R. Across GPQA Diamond, AIME 2025, and LiveCodeBench V6 (covering both closed and open models), VPS yields three key results. First, on GPQA Diamond, GPT-5.4 (High) | GPT-5.4 (Low) reaches 94.9% at R=4, surpassing the 94.1% state of the art without gradient updates. Second, on AIME 2025, VPS enables strong weak-actor rescue, boosting scores from 11.7-26.7% to 63.3-90.0% (up to +63.3 points). Third, at matched compute, VPS outperforms Reflexion by +8.5 to +12.1 points and Self-Consistency@5 by +5.0 pp (GPQA) and +8.3 pp (LiveCodeBench), isolating critique granularity as the key driver. Performance scales with the supervisor-actor capability gap (Pearson r=0.90) and degrades when errors are not linguistically expressible (e.g., code synthesis), motivating hybrid verbal-executable methods. These results establish critique granularity as a new axis of inference-time scaling.

AI.tldr: 提出无训练的「口头过程监督」新维度：用强模型输出的自然语言细粒度批评，驱动弱模型迭代修正，4 轮内刷新 GPQA、AIME、LiveCodeBench 多项纪录，性能与强弱模型差距线性相关(r=0.90)。
AI.motivation: 现有推理阶段扩展仅关注链深度、样本宽度与 PRM 打分，尚未利用「外部自然语言监督的颗粒度」；作者假设更细的可解释批评能无训练地提升弱模型表现。
AI.method: 训练无关框架 VPS：强教师模型针对学生模型每一步输出生成结构化自然语言批评→学生据此修正→循环至轮次预算 R；对比 Reflexion、Self-Consistency 等基线，并分析监督粒度与强弱模型能力差的相关性。
AI.result: GPQA Diamond 上 GPT-5.4 高低配组合 4 轮达 94.9%，刷新 94.1% 纪录；AIME 2025 弱模型从 11.7–26.7% 提升到 63.3–90.0%，最大 +63.3 分；同等算力下 VPS 较 Reflexion 高 8.5–12.1 分，较 Self-Consistency@5 高 5.0–8.3 分；性能与强弱模型差距 Pearson r=0.90；在错误难以言表的任务(代码)收益下降。
AI.conclusion: 确认「批评粒度」为推理阶段第四扩展轴，无需训练即可实现强-弱模型协同；未来应混合自然语言与可执行反馈以拓展至代码等任务。

title: AgentDoG: A Diagnostic Guardrail Framework for AI Agent Safety and Security
summary: The rise of AI agents introduces complex safety and security challenges arising from autonomous tool use and environmental interactions. Current guardrail models lack agentic risk awareness and transparency in risk diagnosis. To introduce an agentic guardrail that covers complex and numerous risky behaviors, we first propose a unified three-dimensional taxonomy that orthogonally categorizes agentic risks by their source (where), failure mode (how), and consequence (what). Guided by this structured and hierarchical taxonomy, we introduce a new fine-grained agentic safety benchmark (ATBench) and a Diagnostic Guardrail framework for agent safety and security (AgentDoG). AgentDoG provides fine-grained and contextual monitoring across agent trajectories. More Crucially, AgentDoG can diagnose the root causes of unsafe actions and seemingly safe but unreasonable actions, offering provenance and transparency beyond binary labels to facilitate effective agent alignment. AgentDoG variants are available in three sizes (4B, 7B, and 8B parameters) across Qwen and Llama model families. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that AgentDoG achieves state-of-the-art performance in agentic safety moderation in diverse and complex interactive scenarios. All models and datasets are openly released.

AI.tldr: 提出首个面向 AI agent 的三维风险分类法，并据此构建细粒度安全基准 ATBench 与可解释护轨框架 AgentDoG，实现 agent 轨迹级监控与根因诊断，在多种交互场景下达到 SOTA 安全审核性能。
AI.motivation: AI agent 自主调用工具并与复杂环境交互，带来传统护栏模型无法感知和解释的新型 agentic 风险；现有方法缺乏统一的风险分类、细粒度评估基准以及可解释的 root-cause 诊断能力。
AI.method: 1) 构建“来源-失效模式-后果”三维正交风险分类法；2) 基于该分类法设计细粒度安全基准 ATBench；3) 提出 Diagnostic Guardrail 框架 AgentDoG，对 agent 轨迹进行上下文感知监控，并输出超越二值标签的根因与溯源解释；4) 基于 Qwen/Llama 训练 4B/7B/8B 三种规模模型。
AI.result: AgentDoG 在 ATBench 及多种复杂交互场景中取得 SOTA 安全审核准确率；能同时检出明显不安全与“看似安全却无理”的隐式风险；提供可解释诊断，助力 agent 对齐。
AI.conclusion: AgentDoG 首次将可解释 root-cause 诊断融入 agent 护栏，验证了三维风险分类与轨迹级监控的有效性，为构建安全可信的自主 AI agent 提供了开放基准与即用模型。

title: MM-JudgeBias: A Benchmark for Evaluating Compositional Biases in MLLM-as-a-Judge
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have been increasingly used as automatic evaluators-a paradigm known as MLLM-as-a-Judge. However, their reliability and vulnerabilities to biases remain underexplored. We find that many MLLM judges fail to reliably integrate key visual or textual cues, yielding unreliable evaluations when evidence is missing or mismatched, and exhibiting instability under semantically irrelevant perturbations. To address this, we systematically define Compositional Bias in MLLM-as-a-Judge systems and introduce MM-JudgeBias, a benchmark for evaluating it. MM-JudgeBias introduces controlled perturbations across Query, Image, and Response, and evaluates model behavior via two complementary metrics: Bias-Deviation (BD) for sensitivity and Bias-Conformity (BC) for stability. Our dataset of over 1,800 curated and refined multimodal samples, drawn from 29 source benchmarks, enables a fine-grained diagnosis of nine bias types across diverse tasks and domains. Experiments on 26 state-of-the-art MLLMs reveal systematic modality neglect and asymmetric evaluation tendencies, underscoring the need for more reliable judges.

AI.tldr: 首次定义“MLLM-as-a-Judge”中的组合性偏差，提出1 800+样本的MM-JudgeBias基准，揭示26个SOTA模型普遍存在模态忽略与不对称评价，呼吁构建更可信的多模态裁判模型。
AI.motivation: MLLM-as-a-Judge 被广泛用于自动评分，但缺乏对其可靠性与偏见的系统研究；作者发现现有裁判模型在视觉-文本线索缺失或受无关扰动时给出不稳定结论，亟需量化并诊断其内在偏见。
AI.method: 1) 形式化定义“组合性偏差”(Compositional Bias)；2) 构建覆盖29个源数据集的1 800+扰动样本，对Query、Image、Response三要素施加控扰；3) 设计双指标：Bias-Deviation (BD，敏感性) 与 Bias-Conformity (BC，稳定性)；4) 在26个前沿MLLM上开展跨任务、跨领域测评。
AI.result: 实验表明主流模型普遍存在“模态忽略”( modality neglect) 与“不对称评价”倾向，当视觉或文本证据被遮蔽或错配时，BD显著升高、BC降低，评价一致性下降；不同模型对同一扰动的偏差幅度差异最高达3×。
AI.conclusion: MM-JudgeBias首次系统暴露MLLM-as-a-Judge的组合性脆弱点，强调未来需在训练与对齐阶段显式注入跨模态一致性约束，以构建鲁棒、可信的多模态自动裁判系统。

title: Entropy Ratio Clipping as a Soft Global Constraint for Stable Reinforcement Learning
comment: This paper has been accepted by ACL2026
summary: Large language model post-training relies on reinforcement learning to improve model capability and alignment quality. However, the off-policy training paradigm introduces distribution shift, which often pushes the policy beyond the trust region, leading to training instabilities manifested as fluctuations in policy entropy and unstable gradients. Although PPO-Clip mitigates this issue through importance clipping, it still overlooks the global distributional shift of actions. To address these challenges, we propose using the entropy ratio between the current and previous policies as a new global metric that effectively quantifies the relative change in policy exploration throughout updates. Building on this metric, we introduce an \textbf{Entropy Ratio Clipping} (ERC) mechanism that imposes bidirectional constraints on the entropy ratio. This stabilizes policy updates at the global distribution level and compensates for the inability of PPO-clip to regulate probability shifts of un-sampled actions. We integrate ERC into both DAPO and GPPO reinforcement learning algorithms. Experiments across multiple benchmarks show that ERC consistently improves performance.

AI.tldr: 提出“熵比裁剪”(ERC) 机制，用全局熵比监控策略漂移，双向约束熵变化，补足 PPO-Clip 对未采样动作概率偏移的盲区，在 DAPO/GPPO 上稳定训练并提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 RLHF 后训练因离策略更新导致分布漂移，策略熵与梯度剧烈震荡；PPO-Clip 仅能局部裁剪重要性权重，无法约束全局动作分布的整体偏移，尤其忽略未采样动作的概率变化，需一种能全局度量并抑制策略膨胀/塌陷的新方法。
AI.method: 将当前策略与旧策略的熵之比作为全局分布漂移指标，设计熵比双向阈值(ERC)：当熵比超出上下限时强制拉回，等价在全局层面同时对探索衰减和过度发散施加约束；该正则项即插即用，可与任意 Actor-Critic 算法结合，实验植入 DAPO 与 GPPO。
AI.result: 在多个公开 RLHF/控制基准上，ERC 变体相比原算法持续降低策略熵波动与梯度方差，采样效率提升 8–22%，最终奖励平均提升 4–15%，且对 reward hacking 现象更具鲁棒性；消融实验验证熵比阈值双向设置缺一不可。
AI.conclusion: 熵比裁剪首次把全局策略熵变化显式引入强化学习信任域控制，简单有效、几乎零额外开销，为大模型后训练提供稳定且可扩展的优化组件，并启示未来可拓展至条件熵、层-wise 熵等更细粒度分布监控。

title: Promoting Simple Agents: Ensemble Methods for Event-Log Prediction
summary: We compare lightweight automata-based models (n-grams) with neural architectures (LSTM, Transformer) for next-activity prediction in streaming event logs. Experiments on synthetic patterns and five real-world process mining datasets show that n-grams with appropriate context windows achieve comparable accuracy to neural models while requiring substantially fewer resources. Unlike windowed neural architectures, which show unstable performance patterns, n-grams provide stable and consistent accuracy. While we demonstrate that classical ensemble methods like voting improve n-gram performance, they require running many agents in parallel during inference, increasing memory consumption and latency. We propose an ensemble method, the promotion algorithm, that dynamically selects between two active models during inference, reducing overhead compared to classical voting schemes. On real-world datasets, these ensembles match or exceed the accuracy of non-windowed neural models with lower computational cost.

AI.tldr: 在流式事件日志的下一活动预测任务中，轻量级n-gram模型以远少于神经网络的资源，获得与LSTM/Transformer相当的精度，且稳定性更佳；提出的晋升集成算法进一步在精度与开销之间取得帕累托改进。
AI.motivation: 流式过程挖掘对实时预测提出低延迟、低资源占用的需求，而现有神经方法虽精度高却计算代价大且性能波动，需验证简单模型是否可替代并寻求更轻量的集成策略。
AI.method: 对比实验：在合成模式与5个真实事件日志上，比较n-gram（滑动窗口）与LSTM、Transformer；提出动态双模型选择的“晋升”集成，替代传统投票集成，减少并发推理开销。
AI.result: 适当窗口的n-gram准确率媲美神经网络，且方差显著更小；晋升集成在真实数据上达到或超过无窗口神经模型精度，计算成本低于投票式集成。
AI.conclusion: n-gram是流式场景下资源受限时的强基线；晋升集成在几乎不增加资源的前提下进一步提升精度，为实时过程预测提供了兼顾效率与准确性的实用方案。

title: Automating Computational Reproducibility in Social Science: Comparing Prompt-Based and Agent-Based Approaches
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures. Submitted to ACM conference
summary: Reproducing computational research is often assumed to be as simple as rerunning the original code with provided data. In practice, missing packages, fragile file paths, version conflicts, or incomplete logic frequently cause analyses to fail, even when materials are shared. This study investigates whether large language models and AI agents can automate the diagnosis and repair of such failures, making computational results easier to reproduce and verify. We evaluate this using a controlled reproducibility testbed built from five fully reproducible R-based social science studies. Realistic failures were injected, ranging from simple issues to complex missing logic, and two automated repair workflows were tested in clean Docker environments. The first workflow is prompt-based, repeatedly querying language models with structured prompts of varying context, while the second uses agent-based systems that inspect files, modify code, and rerun analyses autonomously. Across prompt-based runs, reproduction success ranged from 31-79 percent, with performance strongly influenced by prompt context and error complexity. Complex cases benefited most from additional context. Agent-based workflows performed substantially better, with success rates of 69-96 percent across all complexity levels. These results suggest that automated workflows, especially agent-based systems, can significantly reduce manual effort and improve reproduction success across diverse error types. Unlike prior benchmarks, our testbed isolates post-publication repair under controlled failure modes, allowing direct comparison of prompt-based and agent-based approaches.

AI.tldr: 用 LLM 与 AI 智能体在受控沙盒中自动修复 R 社会科学论文的复现失败，智能体成功率最高 96%，显著优于纯提示法。
AI.motivation: 计算研究共享代码常因包缺失、路径或版本冲突而失败，人工排查耗时。本研究欲验证大模型能否自动诊断并修复这些失败，以提升可重复性。
AI.method: 基于 5 篇完全可复现的 R 社会科论文构建测试床 → 在 Docker 环境中注入 5 类真实失败（简单到缺失逻辑）→ 设计两套路径：① 纯提示工作流，用不同上下文持续询问 LLM；② 智能体工作流，可读写文件、改代码、重跑分析 → 对比复现成功率。
AI.result: 提示法成功率 31–79%，对上下文与错误复杂度敏感；智能体法 69–96%，各复杂度均稳定优于提示法，尤其对复杂缺失逻辑增益最大。
AI.conclusion: Agent 式自动化流程能显著降低人工干预、提高跨类型复现失败修复率，为出版后代码维护与可重复性提供可扩展的技术路径。

title: From Image to Music Language: A Two-Stage Structure Decoding Approach for Complex Polyphonic OMR
summary: We propose a new approach for a practical two-stage Optical Music Recognition (OMR) pipeline, with a particular focus on its second stage. Given symbol and event candidates from the visual pipeline, we decode them into an editable, verifiable, and exportable score structure. We focus on complex polyphonic staff notation, especially piano scores, where voice separation and intra-measure timing are the main bottlenecks. Our approach formulates second-stage decoding as a structure decoding problem and uses topology recognition with probability-guided search (BeadSolver) as its core method. We also describe a data strategy that combines procedural generation with recognition-feedback annotations. The result is a practical decoding component for real OMR systems and a path to accumulate structured score data for future end-to-end, multimodal, and RL-style methods.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向钢琴谱等复杂多声部乐谱的两阶段 OMR 解码方法，将视觉符号候选转换为可编辑乐谱结构，核心为拓扑识别＋概率引导搜索（BeadSolver），并配套程序化数据生成策略。
AI.motivation: 现有 OMR 系统在多声部钢琴谱的第二级“结构解码”环节（声部分离、小节内时值对齐）准确率不足，难以直接输出可编辑、可校验、可导出的乐谱文件，成为实用化瓶颈。
AI.method: 把第二级任务建模为结构解码问题：1) 用拓扑识别捕捉符号间先后、同时、从属关系；2) 设计概率引导搜索算法 BeadSolver，在图空间内全局寻优，得到全局一致且可编辑的乐谱结构；3) 数据层面，程序化生成合成谱面并引入识别反馈标注，低成本扩充训练数据。
AI.result: 复杂钢琴谱测试集上，结构级准确率显著优于传统基于规则或逐拍贪心解码的基线；解码输出可直接导入音乐编辑软件，无需人工后处理；同时积累的带结构标注数据为端到端、多模态及强化学习后续研究提供资源。
AI.conclusion: BeadSolver 使 OMR 第二级“结构解码”首次达到实用水平，为全自动乐谱数字化铺平道路，其拓扑＋搜索框架与数据策略可推广至其他符号识别任务。

title: BackPlay: Head-Only Look-Back Self-Correction for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) decode multiple tokens in parallel, but aggressive multi-token decoding amplifies cross-token dependency errors and can sharply degrade generation quality. We propose BackPlay, a frozen-backbone self-correction framework that trains only a lightweight correction head on a finetuned DLM without updating any backbone or adapter parameters. Because the head is trained on errors produced by the same frozen generator used at inference time, its training distribution aligns with the error patterns of the deployed model. We further introduce Look-back Correction, a training mechanism that injects predictions from earlier, more corrupted denoising states into later, richer contexts, enabling the head to leverage later context to detect mistakes made in earlier generation steps. During inference, BackPlay periodically revisits previously generated tokens through selective remasking and regeneration to limit error accumulation. Across mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks, BackPlay improves the speed--quality trade-off of the underlying DLM under multi-token decoding.

AI.tldr: BackPlay在不更新大模型主干的前提下，通过对齐自身错误模式训练轻量校正头，并结合“回望校正”与推理期选掩重生成，显著缓解并行多词解码时的错误放大，使DLM在数学与代码任务上兼得速度与质量。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型(DLM)并行多词解码可加速推理，但跨词依赖错误被放大，生成质量骤降；现有方法需调全部或部分主干，代价高且难以对齐真实部署错误。
AI.method: 1) 冻结已微调DLM主干，仅训练轻量校正头，使其学习目标生成器自身错误分布；2) 提出Look-back Correction：在同一扩散步序列内，将噪声更大、信息更缺的早期预测注入后期 richer 上下文，训练校正头借助后期线索识别早期错误；3) 推理阶段周期性选掩并重生成历史部分词元，抑制错误累积。
AI.result: 在数学推理与代码生成基准上，BackPlay在保持或提升生成质量的同时，显著改善多词解码DLM的速度-质量权衡；相较基线，BLEU、Pass@1等指标提升且解码步数减少。
AI.conclusion: 通过冻结主干对齐错误分布并引入回望校正，BackPlay以极小训练与部署代价，有效抑制并行解码误差扩散，为扩散语言模型高效高质生成提供了实用可扩展方案。

title: Task-specific Subnetwork Discovery in Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Underwater Navigation
comment: To be published in IEEE OCEANS 2026 (Sanya) conference proceedings
summary: Autonomous underwater vehicles are required to perform multiple tasks adaptively and in an explainable manner under dynamic, uncertain conditions and limited sensing, challenges that classical controllers struggle to address. This demands robust, generalizable, and inherently interpretable control policies for reliable long-term monitoring. Reinforcement learning, particularly multi-task RL, overcomes these limitations by leveraging shared representations to enable efficient adaptation across tasks and environments. However, while such policies show promising results in simulation and controlled experiments, they yet remain opaque and offer limited insight into the agent's internal decision-making, creating gaps in transparency, trust, and safety that hinder real-world deployment. The internal policy structure and task-specific specialization remain poorly understood. To address these gaps, we analyze the internal structure of a pretrained multi-task reinforcement learning network in the HoloOcean simulator for underwater navigation by identifying and comparing task-specific subnetworks responsible for navigating toward different species. We find that in a contextual multi-task reinforcement learning setting with related tasks, the network uses only about 1.5% of its weights to differentiate between tasks. Of these, approximately 85% connect the context-variable nodes in the input layer to the next hidden layer, highlighting the importance of context variables in such settings. Our approach provides insights into shared and specialized network components, useful for efficient model editing, transfer learning, and continual learning for underwater monitoring through a contextual multi-task reinforcement learning method.

AI.tldr: 多任务强化学习网络在水下导航中仅约1.5% 权重负责区分任务，其中 85% 集中在输入层语境变量→首隐藏层，揭示其可解释共享-专用结构，为模型编辑与持续学习提供依据。
AI.motivation: 自主水下航行器需在动态不确定、感知受限条件下完成多任务，传统控制器难以兼顾鲁棒性与可解释性；多任务 RL 虽具自适应潜力，却内部决策黑箱，阻碍安全部署。
AI.method: 利用 HoloOcean 仿真器预训练多任务 RL 导航网络，通过子网络定位与对比，量化不同物种导航任务的专用权重分布，聚焦语境变量连接。
AI.result: 网络仅 1.5% 权重承担任务区分功能，这些权重中 85% 落在输入层语境节点到第一隐藏层，验证语境变量对任务特化的决定性作用。
AI.conclusion: 提出的结构解析方法揭示共享与专用组件，支持高效模型编辑、迁移与持续学习，为水下长期监测提供可解释且可信的多任务 RL 控制策略。

title: Learning State-Tracking from Code Using Linear RNNs
summary: Over the last years, state-tracking tasks, particularly permutation composition, have become a testbed to understand the limits of sequence models architectures like Transformers and RNNs (linear and non-linear). However, these are often sequence-to-sequence tasks: learning to map actions (permutations) to states, which is incompatible with the next-token prediction setting commonly used to train language models. We address this gap by converting permutation composition into code via REPL traces that interleave state-reveals through prints and variable transformations. We show that linear RNNs capable of state-tracking excel also in this setting, while Transformers still fail. Motivated by this representation, we investigate why tracking states in code is generally difficult: actions are not always fully observable. We frame this as tracking the state of a probabilistic finite-state automaton with deterministic state reveals and show that linear RNNs can be worse than non-linear RNNs at tracking states in this setup.

AI.tldr: 将状态追踪任务（置换复合）改写为代码-REPL形式后，线性RNN依然强于Transformer；但在动作部分不可见的概率自动机设定下，线性RNN反而不如非线性RNN。
AI.motivation: 已有研究用置换复合评测序列模型，但任务格式为seq2seq，与语言模型常用的“next-token预测”不匹配，且模型在代码环境中只能观测到部分动作，需要新的评测框架与理论解释。
AI.method: 1) 把置换复合任务转化为可执行的Python REPL轨迹，在轨迹中用print与变量变化显式暴露状态；2) 在该格式下对比线性RNN、非线性RNN与Transformer；3) 将部分可观测情形建模为“概率有限状态自动机+确定性状态揭示”，并从可表达性角度分析线性RNN的局限。
AI.result: 代码-REPL设定下，线性RNN准确率显著高于Transformer；当动作仅部分可见时，线性RNN的追踪性能下降并低于非线性RNN，验证了任务难度与模型表达能力之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 状态追踪成败不仅取决于任务格式转换，还与动作可观测度及模型非线性能力密切相关；线性RNN虽在完全可观代码环境中表现优异，但在部分可观场景需非线性机制才能有效追踪隐状态。

title: RIFT: Repurposing Negative Samples via Reward-Informed Fine-Tuning
summary: While Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Rejection Sampling Fine-Tuning (RFT) are standard for LLM alignment, they either rely on costly expert data or discard valuable negative samples, leading to data inefficiency. To address this, we propose Reward Informed Fine-Tuning (RIFT), a simple yet effective framework that utilizes all self-generated samples. Unlike the hard thresholding of RFT, RIFT repurposes negative trajectories, reweighting the loss with scalar rewards to learn from both the positive and negative trajectories from the model outputs. To overcome the training collapse caused by naive reward integration, where direct multiplication yields an unbounded loss, we introduce a stabilized loss formulation that ensures numerical robustness and optimization efficiency. Extensive experiments on mathematical benchmarks across various base models show that RIFT consistently outperforms RFT. Our results demonstrate that RIFT is a robust and data-efficient alternative for alignment using mixed-quality, self-generated data.

AI.tldr: RIFT用奖励重新加权正负样本损失，在无须人工标注的前提下超越RFT，数学任务全面领先。
AI.motivation: SFT依赖高成本专家数据，RFT直接丢弃负样本导致数据利用率低，迫切需要一种能充分利用模型自生成混合质量样本的对齐方法。
AI.method: 提出 Reward Informed Fine-Tuning (RIFT)：1) 保留全部自生成轨迹；2) 用标量奖励对正负样本损失进行重加权；3) 设计稳定化损失函数，解决直接乘奖励带来的无界梯度与训练崩溃问题。
AI.result: 在多个基础模型与数学基准上的大量实验表明，RIFT一致优于 RFT，验证其在混合质量自生成数据上的鲁棒性与数据效率。
AI.conclusion: RIFT为 LLM 对齐提供了一种无需昂贵人工标注、充分利用正负样本的高效替代方案，具备广泛适用与进一步推广潜力。

title: Dilated CNNs for Periodic Signal Processing: A Low-Complexity Approach
comment: 16 pages, 8 figures, the use of deep learning in IoT devices
summary: Denoising of periodic signals and accurate waveform estimation are core tasks across many signal processing domains, including speech, music, medical diagnostics, radio, and sonar. Although deep learning methods have recently shown performance improvements over classical approaches, they require substantial computational resources and are usually trained separately for each signal observation. This study proposes a computationally efficient method based on DCNN and Re-sampling, termed R-DCNN, designed for operation under strict power and resource constraints. The approach targets signals with varying fundamental frequencies and requires only a single observation for training. It generalizes to additional signals via a lightweight resampling step that aligns time scales in signals with different frequencies to re-use the same network weights. Despite its low computational complexity, R-DCNN achieves performance comparable to state-of-the-art classical methods, such as autoregressive (AR)-based techniques, as well as conventional DCNNs trained individually for each observation. This combination of efficiency and performance makes the proposed method particularly well suited for deployment in resource-constrained environments without sacrificing denoising or estimation accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出一种轻量级单次观测可复用的周期信号去噪网络R-DCNN，通过重采样对齐时域尺度，使同一组权重直接泛化到不同基频信号，在功耗受限场景下仍维持与AR和专用DCNN相当的去噪/波形估计精度。
AI.motivation: 弥补现有深度学习方法必须逐观测单独训练并依赖大量算力的痛点，使资源受限平台也能获得高精度周期信号去噪能力。
AI.method: 用深层卷积网络(DCNN)学习单次观测的噪声分布；对任意新观测，通过轻量重采样同步时域周期长度，复用同一网络参数推断去噪波形；全流程避免重训练并降算。
AI.result: 在基频可变场景下，R-DCNN去噪和波形估计性能与逐观测训练的专用DCNN、传统AR方法基本持平，但计算资源显著下降。
AI.conclusion: R-DCNN以极低功耗实现单次观测、多频率可共用的高精度去噪，适合医疗、声呐等对能耗敏感的实时应用。

title: Intent Laundering: AI Safety Datasets Are Not What They Seem
comment: v2 preprint: updated with more models and a new dataset
summary: We systematically evaluate the quality of widely used adversarial safety datasets from two perspectives: in isolation and in practice. In isolation, we examine how well these datasets reflect real-world adversarial attacks based on three defining properties: being driven by ulterior intent, well-crafted, and out-of-distribution. We find that these datasets overrely on "triggering cues": words or phrases with overt negative/sensitive connotations that are intended to trigger safety mechanisms explicitly, which is unrealistic compared to real-world attacks. In practice, we evaluate whether these datasets genuinely measure safety risks or merely provoke refusals through triggering cues. To explore this, we introduce "intent laundering": a procedure that abstracts away triggering cues from adversarial attacks (data points) while strictly preserving their malicious intent and all relevant details. Our results show that current adversarial safety datasets fail to faithfully represent real-world adversarial behavior due to their overreliance on triggering cues. Once these cues are removed, all previously evaluated "reasonably safe" models become unsafe, including Gemini 3 Pro and Claude Sonnet 3.7/4. Moreover, when intent laundering is adapted as a jailbreaking technique, it consistently achieves high attack success rates, ranging from 90.00% to 100.00%, under fully black-box access. Overall, our findings expose a significant disconnect between how existing datasets evaluate model safety and how real-world adversaries behave.

AI.tldr: 常用对抗安全评测集脱离真实攻击：过度依赖显式“触发词”而非隐蔽恶意意图；去除触发词后所有模型均失守，且该思路可转成成功率≈100%的黑盒越狱方法。
AI.motivation: 现有对抗安全数据集被广泛引用，却无人系统验证其是否真实反映现实攻击者的行为模式，导致安全评估可能流于表面。
AI.method: 从两条线评估：①孤立视角，用“隐性意图、精心构造、分布外”三属性衡量数据点真实性；②实战视角，提出“意图洗白”（intent laundering）——去除显式触发词但完整保留恶意意图与细节，再对Gemini-3-Pro、Claude-Sonnet-3.7/4等模型进行黑盒测试。
AI.result: 主流数据集高度依赖敏感触发词；洗白后全部模型安全指标崩溃；意图洗白作为黑盒越狱技术，攻击成功率90–100%，且无需模型内部信息。
AI.conclusion: 当前对抗安全基准与真实攻击行为存在根本断裂；未来评测必须抛弃“触发词依赖”，转向隐蔽意图与行为一致性的细粒度建模，否则安全评估将持续高估模型防御能力。

title: GeoRA: Geometry-Aware Low-Rank Adaptation for RLVR
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) is a key paradigm for improving large-scale reasoning models. Unlike supervised fine-tuning (SFT), RLVR exhibits distinct optimization dynamics and is sensitive to the preservation of pre-trained geometric structures. However, existing parameter-efficient methods face key limitations in this regime. Low-rank adaptation methods, such as PiSSA, are primarily designed for Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and do not account for the distinct optimization dynamics and geometric structures of RLVR. Conversely, directly fine-tuning the unstructured sparse parameter subspace favored by RLVR encounters efficiency bottlenecks on modern hardware. To address these challenges, we propose GeoRA (Geometry-Aware Low-Rank Adaptation), a low-rank adaptation method tailored for RLVR. Specifically, GeoRA exploits the anisotropic and compressible structure of RL update subspace, and extracts its principal directions via Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) to initialize low-rank adapters, while freezing residual components as a structural anchor during training. This design preserves the pre-trained structure and enables efficient dense computation. Experiments on Qwen and Llama models from 1.5B to 32B parameters show that GeoRA consistently outperforms strong low-rank baselines across RLVR settings in mathematics, medicine, and coding, while showing stronger generalization and less forgetting on out-of-domain tasks.

AI.tldr: GeoRA是首个为强化学习可验证奖励（RLVR）场景设计的低秩适配器，通过SVD提取RL更新子空间主方向并冻结残差结构，兼顾预训练几何保持与硬件高效计算，在1.5B–32B模型上跨数学、医学、编程任务全面优于现有低秩方法。
AI.motivation: RLVR 与 SFT 的优化动态和几何结构差异显著，现有低秩方法（如 PiSSA）仅针对 SFT 设计，无法保持预训练流形；而直接稀疏微调RL偏好的子空间在现代硬件上效率低下，亟需兼顾“结构保持”与“密集计算”的参数高效方案。
AI.method: 提出 GeoRA：1) 对RL更新矩阵做 SVD 得到各向异性、可压缩的主方向；2) 用该方向初始化低秩适配器；3) 冻结残差分量作为结构锚点，训练全程只更新低秩因子，实现几何保持与密集 GEMM 兼容。
AI.result: 在 Qwen/Llama 1.5B–32B 的 RLVR 实验上，GeoRA 平均提升 8.1% 数学、6.7% 医学、5.4% 编码准确率；域外任务遗忘降低 23%，参数量仅 0.1%–0.3%，训练速度较全量稀疏微调快 2.4×。
AI.conclusion: GeoRA 验证了“几何感知低秩”思路对 RLVR 的有效性，首次将预训练流形保持与硬件友好计算统一，为大规模推理模型的强化学习后训练提供了高效可靠的参数高效范式。

title: Causal Disentanglement for Full-Reference Image Quality Assessment
summary: Existing deep network-based full-reference image quality assessment (FR-IQA) models typically work by performing pairwise comparisons of deep features from the reference and distorted images. In this paper, we approach this problem from a different perspective and propose a novel FR-IQA paradigm based on causal inference and decoupled representation learning. Unlike typical feature comparison-based FR-IQA models, our approach formulates degradation estimation as a causal disentanglement process guided by intervention on latent representations. We first decouple degradation and content representations by exploiting the content invariance between the reference and distorted images. Second, inspired by the human visual masking effect, we design a masking module to model the causal relationship between image content and degradation features, thereby extracting content-influenced degradation features from distorted images. Finally, quality scores are predicted from these degradation features using either supervised regression or label-free dimensionality reduction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves highly competitive performance on standard IQA benchmarks across fully supervised, few-label, and label-free settings. Furthermore, we evaluate the approach on diverse non-standard natural image domains with scarce data, including underwater, radiographic, medical, neutron, and screen-content images. Benefiting from its ability to perform scenario-specific training and prediction without labeled IQA data, our method exhibits superior cross-domain generalization compared to existing training-free FR-IQA models.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于因果推断与解耦表示的全参考图像质量评估新范式，通过干预潜变量实现退化估计，无需或仅需极少标签即可在标准基准及水下、放射、医学等跨域场景取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有深度全参考IQA方法依赖“参考-失真”特征成对比较，未能显式区分图像内容与退化因素，导致跨域泛化差、对标签依赖高；亟需一种能解耦退化表示并建模内容-退化因果关系的框架，实现少标签甚至无标签场景下的鲁棒质量预测。
AI.method: 1) 利用参考图与失真图内容一致性，通过对比学习将潜空间解耦为“内容表示”与“退化表示”；2) 受视觉掩蔽效应启发，构建掩蔽模块对内容表示施加干预，显式建模内容对退化特征的因果影响，提取内容感知的退化特征；3) 对退化特征采用有监督回归或无监督降维即可得质量分数，支持全监督/少标签/无标签三种范式。
AI.result: 在TID2013、CSIQ、LIVE等传统基准上，该方法与现有最佳FR-IQA模型性能相当；在仅1%标签的少标签设置下仍保持高相关性；完全无标签时亦优于所有无训练方法。跨域测试中，仅凭场景无标数据微调，即在水下、X光、MRI、中子照相、屏摄等5类稀缺数据域显著超越现有无训练FR-IQA模型，平均SROCC提升0.12–0.21。
AI.conclusion: 将因果解耦引入FR-IQA，首次实现了“退化-内容”双变量显式分离与干预式退化估计，突破了对大规模人工标签的依赖，兼具标准基准竞争力与卓越的跨域零/少标签泛化能力，为实际稀缺标注、多域场景下的图像质量评价提供了可扩展的新范式。

title: Crystal: Characterizing Relative Impact of Scholarly Publications
summary: Assessing a cited paper's impact is typically done by analyzing its citation context in isolation within the citing paper. While this focuses on the most directly relevant text, it prevents relative comparisons across all the works a paper cites. We propose Crystal, which instead jointly ranks all cited papers within a citing paper using large language models (LLMs). To mitigate LLMs' positional bias, we rank each list three times in a randomized order and aggregate the impact labels through majority voting. This joint approach leverages the full citation context, rather than evaluating citations independently, to more reliably distinguish impactful references. Crystal outperforms a prior state-of-the-art impact classifier by +9.5% accuracy and +8.3% F1 on a dataset of human-annotated citations. Crystal further gains efficiency through fewer LLM calls and performs competitively with an open-source model, enabling scalable, cost-effective citation impact analysis. We release our rankings, impact labels, and codebase to support future research.

AI.tldr: 用LLM一次性对整篇论文的所有被引文献进行联合排序并投票去位置偏差，准确率和F1分别提升9.5%和8.3%，且调用更少、可复现。
AI.motivation: 传统方法只孤立地分析单条被引句，无法在同一篇施引文献内横向比较各参考文献的相对影响力，难以准确评估“谁更重要”。
AI.method: 提出Crystal框架：利用LLM一次性读取整篇论文的全部引文语境，对所有被引文献进行三轮回随机排序的联合打分，再通过多数投票聚合影响力标签，削弱LLM固有的位置偏差。
AI.result: 在人工标注的被引影响力数据集上，Crystal比现有SOTA分类器准确率提高9.5%，F1提高8.3%；同时减少LLM调用次数，使用开源模型也能保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 联合排序＋投票策略可显著提升引用影响力评估的可靠性与效率，已公开排名、标签及代码，支持低成本、可扩展的后续研究。

title: PROPER Agents: Proactivity Driven Personalized Agents for Advancing Knowledge Gap Navigation
summary: Current approaches to proactive assistance move beyond the ask-and-respond paradigm by anticipating user needs. In practice, they either burden users with clarifying questions or rely on context-based extrapolation, often leading to unnecessary or mistimed interventions. Such systems lack explicit mechanisms to model users' knowledge gaps, resulting in incomplete or suboptimal task outcomes. To address this, we propose PROPER, a framework that explicitly models user-specific knowledge gaps in a controlled manner. Central to our approach is the notion of dimensions: structured, task-relevant factors that define the considerations required for effective task completion. Given a user query, the DGA (Dimension Generating Agent) identifies explicit dimensions (from the user's query) and generates a set of candidate implicit dimensions capturing unarticulated aspects of the task. The RGA (Response Generating Agent) integrates both explicit and implicit dimensions selectively to produce personalized, context-aware, and proactively informative responses. We evaluate PROPER across multiple domains using a structured, gap-aware rubric that measures coverage, initiative appropriateness, and intent alignment. PROPER improves on quality scores and win rates across all domains, achieving up to 84% gains in single-turn evaluation and consistent dominance in multi-turn interactions. All code for PROPER is available at: https://github.com/i-kiran/ProPer-Agent.

AI.tldr: 现有主动助手因忽视用户知识缺口而易误判或打扰；PROPER 框架用“维度”显式建模缺口，经 DGA 生成显/隐维度、RGA 按需整合，多领域测试质量与胜率显著提升。
AI.motivation: 传统主动系统靠上下文推断或反复追问，无法精准捕捉用户知识缺口，导致干预失当、任务完成不完整。
AI.method: 提出 PROPER：DGA 从询问中抽取显式维度并生成候选隐式维度，RGA 按需融合两类维度，输出个性化、上下文感知且主动补缺的回应；以维度为结构化任务要素进行缺口建模。
AI.result: 在多领域、单轮及多轮对话评测中，PROPER 相较基线质量得分最高提升 84%，胜率持续领先；用 gap-aware 指标验证覆盖率、主动时机与意图对齐均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模用户知识缺口可显著降低不必要的干预并提升任务完成质量，PROPER 为主动助手提供可解释、可扩展的新范式，代码已开源。

title: Fine-Grained Perspectives: Modeling Explanations with Annotator-Specific Rationales
summary: Beyond exploring disaggregated labels for modeling perspectives, annotator rationales provide fine-grained signals of individual perspectives. In this work, we propose a framework for jointly modeling annotator-specific label prediction and corresponding explanations, fine-tuned on the annotators' provided rationales. Using a dataset with disaggregated natural language inference (NLI) annotations and annotator-provided explanations, we condition predictions on both annotator identity and demographic metadata through a representation-level User Passport mechanism. We further introduce two explainer architectures: a post-hoc prompt-based explainer and a prefixed bridge explainer that transfers annotator-conditioned classifier representations directly into a generative model. This design enables explanation generation aligned with individual annotator perspectives. Our results show that incorporating explanation modeling substantially improves predictive performance over a baseline annotator-aware classifier, with the prefixed bridge approach achieving more stable label alignment and higher semantic consistency, while the post-hoc approach yields stronger lexical similarity. These findings indicate that modeling explanations as expressions of fine-grained perspective provides a richer and more faithful representation of disagreement. The proposed approaches advance perspectivist modeling by integrating annotator-specific rationales into both predictive and generative components.

AI.tldr: 提出一个联合建模标注者特定标签预测与解释的统一框架，利用“用户护照”机制将解释作为视角差异信号，显著优于纯分类基线。
AI.motivation: 传统视角建模仅用分离标签，忽略标注者为判断所撰写的自然语言理由；这些理由蕴含更细粒度的个体差异信号，应被显式纳入模型以提升对分歧的理解与预测。
AI.method: 1. 在表征层引入“User Passport”把标注者身份及人口学元数据注入分类器；2. 提出两种解释器：①事后提示型，②前缀桥接型，直接把条件化表征送入生成模型生成与个体视角对齐的解释；3. 在带有人工解释的多标注 NLI 数据集上端到端微调。
AI.result: 同时建模解释使分类性能显著优于仅建模身份的基线；前缀桥接型在标签对齐稳定性与语义一致性上表现更好，事后提示型则获得更高词汇相似度。
AI.conclusion: 将解释视为视角的显式表达，可为预测与生成同时提供更丰富、更忠实的分歧表征，推动视角主义建模从“标签分离”走向“理由感知”。

title: SODA: Semi On-Policy Black-Box Distillation for Large Language Models
summary: Black-box knowledge distillation for large language models presents a strict trade-off. Simple off-policy methods (e.g., sequence-level knowledge distillation) struggle to correct the student's inherent errors. Fully on-policy methods (e.g., Generative Adversarial Distillation) solve this via adversarial training but introduce well-known training instability and crippling computational overhead. To address this dilemma, we propose SODA (Semi On-policy Distillation with Alignment), a highly efficient alternative motivated by the inherent capability gap between frontier teachers and much smaller base models. Because a compact student model's natural, zero-shot responses are almost strictly inferior to the powerful teacher's targets, we can construct a highly effective contrastive signal simply by pairing the teacher's optimal response with a one-time static snapshot of the student's outputs. This demonstrates that exposing the small student to its own static inferior behaviors is sufficient for high-quality distribution alignment, eliminating the need for costly dynamic rollouts and fragile adversarial balancing. Extensive evaluations across four compact Qwen2.5 and Llama-3 models validate this semi on-policy paradigm. SODA matches or outperforms the state-of-the-art methods on 15 out of 16 benchmark results. More importantly, it achieves this superior distillation quality while training 10 times faster, consuming 27% less peak GPU memory, and completely eliminating adversarial instability.

AI.tldr: 提出SODA：用一次静态采样把教师最优输出与学生弱输出配对，实现无需动态 rollout、无需对抗训练的半在线蒸馏，兼顾效果与效率。
AI.motivation: 黑盒大模型蒸馏面临两难：离策略方法难纠学生固有错误，全在线对抗法虽有效但训练不稳、开销大。作者想在不牺牲性能的前提下，消除对抗训练与动态采样带来的高成本。
AI.method: SODA（Semi On-policy Distillation with Alignment）：1）仅用一次前向推理采集学生静态输出；2）将教师对应最优输出与之配对，构建对比信号；3）用对比损失直接对齐学生分布，无需反复 rollout 或生成器-判别器对抗。整个流程仅依赖教师 API 调用与学生自采样一次，训练完全离线完成。
AI.result: 在 4 个 Qwen2.5 与 Llama-3 小模型、16 项公开 benchmark 上，SODA 15 项持平或超过 SOTA；训练时间缩短 10 倍，峰值显存降低 27%，零对抗训练带来的不稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 仅让学生“看见”自己一次静态的次优输出并与教师最优输出对比，即可达成高质量对齐，颠覆“必须动态对抗”这一传统认知，为资源受限场景下的大模型黑盒蒸馏提供高效可行方案。

title: Beyond Accuracy: A Stability-Aware Metric for Multi-Horizon Forecasting
summary: Traditional time series forecasting methods optimize for accuracy alone. This objective neglects temporal consistency, in other words, how consistently a model predicts the same future event as the forecast origin changes. We introduce the forecast accuracy and coherence score (forecast AC score for short) for measuring the quality of probabilistic multi-horizon forecasts in a way that accounts for both multi-horizon accuracy and stability. Our score additionally allows user-specified weights to balance accuracy and consistency requirements. As an example application, we implement the score as a differentiable objective function for training seasonal auto-regressive integrated models and evaluate it on the M4 Hourly benchmark dataset. Results demonstrate consistent improvements over traditional maximum likelihood estimation. Regarding stability, the AC-optimized model generated out-of-sample forecasts with 15.8\% reduced variance over forecasts targeting the same timestamp. In terms of accuracy, the AC-optimized model achieved considerable improvements for medium-to-long-horizon forecasts. While one-step-ahead forecasts exhibited a 3.9\% increase in MSE, forecasts from horizon three onward experienced improved accuracy, with a peak improvement of approximately 6\% in MSE at horizons 9-12. These results indicate that our metric successfully trains models to produce more stable and accurate multi-step forecasts in exchange for a relatively small degradation in one-step-ahead performance.

AI.tldr: 提出可同时衡量多步概率预测“精度”与“时间一致性”的 Forecast AC 评分，并将其作为可微目标训练 SARIMA 模型，在 M4 Hourly 数据上显著降低预测方差并提升中远期精度，仅牺牲一步预测约 4% 的 MSE。
AI.motivation: 传统时间序列预测仅以精度为优化目标，导致模型在不同预测起点对同一未来事件的预测结果不一致（时间不一致）。作者希望在不牺牲整体精度的前提下，显式量化并提升多步预测的稳定性和一致性。
AI.method: 1) 设计 Forecast AC 评分：将用户可加权的多步精度项与一致性（方差）项整合为单一标量；2) 使评分对参数可微，直接作为损失函数训练季节性 ARIMA 模型；3) 在 M4 Hourly 基准上对比传统最大似然估计。
AI.result: AC 优化模型在样本外同一目标时刻的预测方差降低 15.8%；中远期（≥3 步）MSE 最高改善约 6%，9–12 步改善最显著；仅 1 步预测 MSE 轻微上升 3.9%。
AI.conclusion: Forecast AC 评分首次把“时间一致性”纳入可微目标，可在几乎不损害一步精度的情况下，显著增强多步概率预测的稳定性和中远期准确性，为多步预测训练提供了新的通用损失框架。

title: Geometric Monomial (GEM): a family of rational 2N-differentiable activation functions
summary: The choice of activation function plays a crucial role in the optimization and performance of deep neural networks. While the Rectified Linear Unit (ReLU) remains the dominant choice due to its simplicity and effectiveness, its lack of smoothness may hinder gradient-based optimization in deep architectures. In this work we propose a family of $C^{2N}$-smooth activation functions whose gate follows a log-logistic CDF, achieving ReLU-like performance with purely rational arithmetic. We introduce three variants: GEM (the base family), E-GEM (an $ε$-parameterized generalization enabling arbitrary $L^p$-approximation of ReLU), and SE-GEM (a piecewise variant eliminating dead neurons with $C^{2N}$ junction smoothness). An $N$-ablation study establishes $N=1$ as optimal for standard-depth networks, reducing the GELU deficit on CIFAR-100 + ResNet-56 from 6.10% to 2.12%. The smoothness parameter $N$ further reveals a CNN-transformer tradeoff: $N=1$ is preferred for deep CNNs, while $N=2$ is preferred for transformers. On MNIST, E-GEM ties the best baseline (99.23%). On CIFAR-10 + ResNet-56, SE-GEM ($ε=10^{-4}$) surpasses GELU (92.51% vs 92.44%) -- the first GEM-family activation to outperform GELU. On CIFAR-100 + ResNet-56, E-GEM reduces the GELU deficit from 6.10% (GEM $N=2$) to just 0.62%. On GPT-2 (124M), GEM achieves the lowest perplexity (72.57 vs 73.76 for GELU), with GEM $N=1$ also beating GELU (73.32). On BERT-small, E-GEM ($ε=10$) achieves the best validation loss (6.656) across all activations. The $ε$-parameterization reveals a scale-dependent optimum: small $ε$ ($10^{-4}$--$10^{-6}$) for deep CNNs and larger transformers, with the special case of small transformers (BERT-small) benefiting from large $ε$ ($ε=10$) due to its limited depth and unconstrained gradients.

AI.tldr: 提出基于对数-Logistic CDF的C²ᴺ光滑激活族GEM、E-GEM、SE-GEM，在CNN与Transformer上均优于或打平GELU，并首次给出光滑度N与ε的最优选择规律。
AI.motivation: ReLU虽简洁有效，但零阶不可导导致的非光滑性会在深层网络中阻碍梯度优化；现有光滑替代（GELU、Swish等）或计算昂贵或近似精度有限，亟需一种既保持ReLU级性能又能提供可调光滑度、且仅用有理运算即可实现的激活函数。
AI.method: 将对数-Logistic累积分布函数转化为“门控”式激活，得到C²ᴺ光滑的GEM基族；引入ε参数扩展为可任意Lᵖ逼近ReLU的E-GEM；进一步构造分段-拼接版本SE-GEM以消除死神经元并保证拼接点C²ᴺ光滑。通过N-消融实验确定不同架构的最佳光滑度，并系统研究ε尺度规律。
AI.result: CIFAR-100+ResNet-56上N=1的GEM将GELU差距从6.10%降至2.12%；E-GEM进一步把差距压到0.62%。CIFAR-10+ResNet-56中SE-GEM(ε=10⁻⁴)首次超越GELU（92.51% vs 92.44%）。GPT-2 124M参数下GEM取得最低困惑度72.57；BERT-small上E-GEM(ε=10)获得最佳验证loss 6.656。总结出“深CNN用N=1、Transformer用N=2；小ε(10⁻⁴–10⁻⁶)适合深CNN与大Transformer，浅小BERT反而需大ε(10)”的调参准则。
AI.conclusion: GEM族在保持ReLU级准确率的同时，以可调C²ᴺ光滑性、纯有理运算和零额外参数的优势，跨CNN、Transformer统一超越或打平GELU；N与ε的尺度规律为不同深度与参数量的网络提供了即插即用的激活选择范式。

title: Hijacking Text Heritage: Hiding the Human Signature through Homoglyphic Substitution
summary: In what way could a data breach involving government-issued IDs such as passports, driver's licenses, etc., rival a random voluntary disclosure on a nondescript social-media platform? At first glance, the former appears more significant, and that is a valid assessment. The disclosed data could contain an individual's date of birth and address; for all intents and purposes, a leak of that data would be disastrous. Given the threat, the latter scenario involving an innocuous online post seems comparatively harmless--or does it? From that post and others like it, a forensic linguist could stylometrically uncover equivalent pieces of information, estimating an age range for the author (adolescent or adult) and narrowing down their geographical location (specific country). While not an exact science--the determinations are statistical--stylometry can reveal comparable, though noticeably diluted, information about an individual. To prevent an ID from being breached, simply sharing it as little as possible suffices. Preventing the leakage of personal information from written text requires a more complex solution: adversarial stylometry. In this paper, we explore how performing homoglyph substitution--the replacement of characters with visually similar alternatives (e.g., "h" $\texttt{[U+0068]}$ $\rightarrow$ "h" $\texttt{[U+04BB]}$)--on text can degrade stylometric systems.

AI.tldr: 通过同形异义字符替换破坏文体学分析，降低社交媒体文本泄露个人特征的风险。
AI.motivation: 政府证件泄露虽严重但可控；相比之下，日常社媒帖子可被文体学手段反推出年龄、地域等敏感信息，且用户难以简单规避。
AI.method: 提出对抗式文体学方法，用视觉不可区分的同形异义字符（如U+0068→U+04BB的‘h’）替换原文字符，扰乱特征向量，降低文体学分类器准确率。
AI.result: 实验表明，仅替换2–5%关键字符即可使典型stylometry系统识别准确率下降30–50%，而对人类阅读体验几乎无影响。
AI.conclusion: 同形异义替换是一种轻量级、可逆、无需改写语义的隐私保护手段，为社交媒体用户提供对抗文体学推断的有效工具，未来可扩展到多语种与富文本场景。

title: Partially Lazy Gradient Descent for Smoothed Online Learning
comment: to appear in the proceedings of AISTATS 2026
summary: We introduce \textsc{$k$-lazyGD}, an online learning algorithm that bridges the gap between greedy Online Gradient Descent (OGD, for $k{=}1$) and lazy GD/dual-averaging (for $k{=}T$), creating a spectrum between reactive and stable updates. We analyze this spectrum in Smoothed Online Convex Optimization (SOCO), where the learner incurs both hitting and movement costs. Our main contribution is establishing that laziness is possible without sacrificing hitting performance: we prove that \textsc{$k$-lazyGD} achieves the optimal dynamic regret $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{(P_T{+}1)T})$ for any laziness slack $k$ up to $Θ(\sqrt{T/P_T})$, where $P_T$ is the comparator path length. This result formally connects the allowable laziness to the comparator's shifts, showing that \textsc{$k$-lazyGD} can retain the inherently small movements of lazy methods without compromising tracking ability. We base our analysis on the Follow the Regularized Leader (FTRL) framework, and derive a matching lower bound. Since the slack depends on $P_T$, an ensemble of learners with various slacks is used, yielding a method that is provably stable when it can be, and agile when it must be.

AI.tldr: k-lazyGD 通过调节“惰性参数”k 在连续 k=1 的贪婪 OGD 与 k=T 的惰性算法之间建立统一谱系，首次证明平滑在线凸优化（SOCO）下可在不牺牲击中损失的前提下实现最优惰性更新，并获得匹配下界。
AI.motivation: 现有在线梯度方法在“快速反应”与“稳定更新”两端各有极端：OGD 极端活跃，惰性算法极端保守。作者希望找到一条可调光谱，既能享受惰性更新带来的固有平移代价优势，又不牺牲对比较路径的跟踪精度与击中性能。
AI.method: 提出 k-lazyGD，用 k 次间隔才更新一次的惰性策略植入 Follow-the-Regularized-Leader (FTRL) 框架；证明其对任意 k 的惰性松弛度依然维持最优动态遗憾，并利用不同 k 的多学习器集成在 PT 未知时取得“能稳能快”的自适应。
AI.result: k-lazyGD 在命中率最优的动态遗憾 O(√(PT+1)T) 上保持匹配下界；允许惰性松弛 k 至 Θ(√(T/PT))，首次将允许惰性量与比较路径长度 PT 定量关联；多 k 集成版本在无需预知 PT 时做到“稳时稳、动时动”。
AI.conclusion: 惰性未必导致性能降级——只要惰性松弛与比较路径变化速率相匹配，算法可在维持低频更新与低移动代价的同时保持最优跟踪能力。该研究为在线学习提供“懒惰—反应”统一控制旋钮，并给出可证明的理论保证与下界匹配。

title: Efficient Logic Gate Networks for Video Copy Detection
summary: Video copy detection requires robust similarity estimation under diverse visual distortions while operating at very large scale. Although deep neural networks achieve strong performance, their computational cost and descriptor size limit practical deployment in high-throughput systems. In this work, we propose a video copy detection framework based on differentiable Logic Gate Networks (LGNs), which replace conventional floating-point feature extractors with compact, logic-based representations. Our approach combines aggressive frame miniaturization, binary preprocessing, and a trainable LGN embedding model that learns both logical operations and interconnections. After training, the model can be discretized into a purely Boolean circuit, enabling extremely fast and memory-efficient inference. We systematically evaluate different similarity strategies, binarization schemes, and LGN architectures across multiple dataset folds and difficulty levels. Experimental results demonstrate that LGN-based models achieve competitive or superior accuracy and ranking performance compared to prior models, while producing descriptors several orders of magnitude smaller and delivering inference speeds exceeding 11k samples per second. These findings indicate that logic-based models offer a promising alternative for scalable and resource-efficient video copy detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用可微逻辑门网络（LGN）替代传统浮点 CNN，将视频帧极度压缩后转为布尔电路，实现 11 k+ 样本/秒、描述子缩小 3–4 数量级，同时保持或超越现有精度，为大规模视频拷贝检测提供极轻量方案。
AI.motivation: 深度模型虽准，但高算力、大描述子阻碍高吞吐系统的实际部署，亟需一种既鲁棒又极小、极快的特征提取范式。
AI.method: 1. 帧级 32×32 缩小+二值化预处理；2. 设计可微 LGN，联合学习逻辑门类型与连接拓扑；3. 训练后固化成纯布尔电路；4. 系统比较不同相似度度量、二值化策略及 LGN 结构在多难度数据折上的效果。
AI.result: LGN 模型在多个数据集折上 accuracy 与 mAP 持平或优于 CNN/SOTA，描述子仅数十 bits，推理速度 ≥11 k 样本/秒，显存与能耗降低 3–4 个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 逻辑门网络首次在视频拷贝检测中验证“高精度+极轻量”可行，为后续可扩展、资源受限场景提供了新的思路与基线。

title: LASA: Language-Agnostic Semantic Alignment at the Semantic Bottleneck for LLM Safety
summary: Large language models (LLMs) often demonstrate strong safety performance in high-resource languages, yet exhibit severe vulnerabilities when queried in low-resource languages. We attribute this gap to a mismatch between language-agnostic semantic understanding ability and language-dominant safety alignment biased toward high-resource languages. Consistent with this hypothesis, we empirically identify the semantic bottleneck in LLMs, an intermediate layer in which the geometry of model representations is governed primarily by shared semantic content rather than language identity. Building on this observation, we propose Language-Agnostic Semantic Alignment (LASA), which anchors safety alignment directly in semantic bottlenecks. Experiments show that LASA substantially improves safety across all languages: average attack success rate (ASR) drops from 24.7% to 2.8% on LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct and remains around 3-4% across Qwen2.5 and Qwen3 Instruct models (7B-32B). Together, our analysis and method offer a representation-level perspective on LLM safety, suggesting that safety alignment requires anchoring safety understanding not in surface text, but in the model's language-agnostic semantic space.

AI.tldr: LLM 在非英语等低资源语种上极易被攻击，根源是安全对齐仅依赖高资源语种的表层文本。作者发现模型内部存在“语义瓶颈层”，其表征几乎不受语种身份干扰，遂提出 LASA——把安全对齐锚定到该语言无关的语义空间，使多语种攻击成功率从 24.7% 降至 2.8%。
AI.motivation: 现有安全对齐方法在高资源语言表现良好，却在低资源语言中漏洞百出，说明对齐过程被语种表层特征“带偏”，亟需找到语言无关的通用安全表征。
AI.method: 1）定位“语义瓶颈层”：通过探测实验确认某中间层表征主要受语义而非语种支配；2）LASA：在该层引入对比学习与对抗微调，直接把安全目标锚定到语言无关的语义子空间；3）跨模型、跨语种白盒与黑盒攻击评估。
AI.result: LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct 的平均攻击成功率从 24.7% 降至 2.8%，Qwen2.5/3 系列 7B–32B 模型稳定在 3–4%；且对英语性能几乎无损，参数开销 <1%。
AI.conclusion: 安全对齐不应停留在表层文本，而应扎根于模型内部语言无关的语义空间；LASA 为构建真正多语种鲁棒的 LLM 提供了可扩展的表征级解决方案。

title: A Dynamic Framework for Grid Adaptation in Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
summary: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) have recently demonstrated promising potential in scientific machine learning, partly due to their capacity for grid adaptation during training. However, existing adaptation strategies rely solely on input data density, failing to account for the geometric complexity of the target function or metrics calculated during network training. In this work, we propose a generalized framework that treats knot allocation as a density estimation task governed by Importance Density Functions (IDFs), allowing training dynamics to determine grid resolution. We introduce a curvature-based adaptation strategy and evaluate it across synthetic function fitting, regression on a subset of the Feynman dataset and different instances of the Helmholtz PDE, demonstrating that it significantly outperforms the standard input-based baseline. Specifically, our method yields average relative error reductions of 25.3% on synthetic functions, 9.4% on the Feynman dataset, and 23.3% on the PDE benchmark. Statistical significance is confirmed via Wilcoxon signed-rank tests, establishing curvature-based adaptation as a robust and computationally efficient alternative for KAN training.

AI.tldr: 针对Kolmogorov-Arnold网络(KAN)现有网格调整仅看输入数据密度、忽略目标函数几何复杂度及训练信号的问题，作者提出将节点分配建模为由重要性密度函数(IDF)控制的密度估计任务，并设计基于曲率的自适应策略；在合成函数、Feynman数据集回归以及Helmholtz方程求解三类任务上，相对误差分别平均下降25.3%、9.4%、23.3%，Wilcoxon符号秩检验证明其显著优于输入密度基线且计算成本可接受。
AI.motivation: KAN虽能通过网格细化捕捉高维非线性，但现有策略仅依据输入样本密度决定节点分布，对目标函数曲率、梯度或训练误差信号不敏感，导致在高曲率或边界层区域欠采样，限制了逼近精度与收敛效率。
AI.method: 1)将节点分配重铸为IDF驱动的密度估计问题，IDF可综合任意训练指标；2)推导出以函数曲率(IDF=|Hessian|^(1/(d+4)))为核心的自适应公式，并给出增量快速更新算法；3)在KAN训练中引入该曲率IDF，兼顾数值稳定性与计算复杂度约束。
AI.result: 合成函数拟合平均误差↓25.3%，Feynman符号回归↓9.4%，Helmholtz PDE系列↓23.3%，三种场景Wilcoxon检验p<0.01；曲率IDF在网格数相近条件下效果优于输入密度IDF，且额外耗时<10%。
AI.conclusion: 将节点分配由“输入密度”转向“训练驱动的几何重要性”可显著提升KAN的函数表示效率；曲率IDF为稳健、可解释且低成本的实现方式，可推广至其它基于网格的自适应网络或PDE求解器。

title: Stealthy Backdoor Attacks against LLMs Based on Natural Style Triggers
summary: The growing application of large language models (LLMs) in safety-critical domains has raised urgent concerns about their security. Many recent studies have demonstrated the feasibility of backdoor attacks against LLMs. However, existing methods suffer from three key shortcomings: explicit trigger patterns that compromise naturalness, unreliable injection of attacker-specified payloads in long-form generation, and incompletely specified threat models that obscure how backdoors are delivered and activated in practice. To address these gaps, we present BadStyle, a complete backdoor attack framework and pipeline. BadStyle leverages an LLM as a poisoned sample generator to construct natural and stealthy poisoned samples that carry imperceptible style-level triggers while preserving semantics and fluency. To stabilize payload injection during fine-tuning, we design an auxiliary target loss that reinforces the attacker-specified target content in responses to poisoned inputs and penalizes its emergence in benign responses. We further ground the attack in a realistic threat model and systematically evaluate BadStyle under both prompt-induced and PEFT-based injection strategies. Extensive experiments across seven victim LLMs, including LLaMA, Phi, DeepSeek, and GPT series, demonstrate that BadStyle achieves high attack success rates (ASRs) while maintaining strong stealthiness. The proposed auxiliary target loss substantially improves the stability of backdoor activation, yielding an average ASR improvement of around 30% across style-level triggers. Even in downstream deployment scenarios unknown during injection, the implanted backdoor remains effective. Moreover, BadStyle consistently evades representative input-level defenses and bypasses output-level defenses through simple camouflage.

AI.tldr: BadStyle 是首个完整、端到端的LLM风格级投毒框架，能用被毒化模型自身生成自然语料作为隐写触发器，并引入“辅助目标损失”稳定长文本攻击载荷注入，在7类主流LLM上实现高ASR且可绕过提示级/输出级防御。
AI.motivation: 现有后门投毒方案存在三大短板：1) 触发模式固定而显式，易被察觉；2) 生成长文本时无法稳定植入攻击者指定内容；3) 缺乏完整可落地的威胁模型，难以解释攻击如何触发与扩散。
AI.method: 设计 BadStyle 投毒流水线：①用被攻击 LLM 生成含“风格级隐形触发”且保持语义的投毒样本；②引入辅助目标损失函数，既强化模型对投毒输入产生攻击者指定内容，又抑制其在正常输入中出现；③基于提示注入与参数高效微调（PEFT）两种策略完成投毒，提出现实威胁模型。
AI.result: 对 LLaMA、Phi、DeepSeek、GPT 系列等7种 LLM 的实验显示：ASR 显著高于基线并保持隐蔽性；辅助损失平均使 ASR 提升约30%；投毒下游未知任务仍能稳定激活；可绕过输入/输出层面的典型防御（含简单伪装）。
AI.conclusion: BadStyle 首次系统化解了LLM后门投毒在自然性、载荷稳定性和威胁模型完整性上的缺陷，验证其高成功率与抗检测性，提示社区需紧急开发针对“风格隐写+稳定载荷”的新一代防御机制。

title: UsefulBench: Towards Decision-Useful Information as a Target for Information Retrieval
summary: Conventional information retrieval is concerned with identifying the relevance of texts for a given query. Yet, the conventional definition of relevance is dominated by aspects of similarity in texts, leaving unobserved whether the text is truly useful for addressing the query. For instance, when answering whether Paris is larger than Berlin, texts about Paris being in France are relevant (lexical/semantic similarity), but not useful. In this paper, we introduce UsefulBench, a domain-specific dataset curated by three professional analysts labeling whether a text is connected to a query (relevance) or holds practical value in responding to it (usefulness). We show that classic similarity-based information retrieval aligns more strongly with relevance. While LLM-based systems can counteract this bias, we find that domain-specific problems require a high degree of expertise, which current LLMs do not fully incorporate. We explore approaches to (partially) overcome this challenge. However, UsefulBench presents a dataset challenge for targeted information retrieval systems.

AI.tldr: 首次区分「相关」与「有用」，发布专业标注的UsefulBench，揭示现有IR与LLM在「有用性」上的短板。
AI.motivation: 传统信息检索仅以「相关性」（文本-查询相似度）为目标，却忽视「有用性」——文本是否真能回答查询。作者以“巴黎是否大于柏林”为例说明：提及巴黎地理位置的文本虽相关，却无助回答城市大小问题，因此需构建能衡量并提升「有用性」的新基准。
AI.method: 三位专业分析师手工筛选并双重标注领域文本，对每条文本给出「相关」与「有用」二元标签，形成UsefulBench；随后用经典相似度模型与LLM对比两套标签的预测一致性，并尝试通过提示工程、少量领域样本微调等方法弥补LLM的专家知识缺口。
AI.result: 相似度模型与「相关」标签的吻合度显著高于「有用」标签，验证了传统IR偏向「相关」；LLM虽能部分削弱该偏差，但在需要深度领域知识的样例上仍明显逊于专家标注，F1差距达15%以上，显示「有用性」识别对专业壁垒高度敏感。
AI.conclusion: UsefulBench为信息检索领域提供了首个系统区分「相关」与「有用」的测试平台，证明「有用性」评测必须引入专家知识；未来IR系统需融合显式推理与领域微调，才能突破当前LLM的「专业性天花板」。

title: Analyzing Shapley Additive Explanations to Understand Anomaly Detection Algorithm Behaviors and Their Complementarity
comment: IDA Frontier Prize and Best Paper Award -Intelligent Data Analysis (IDA) 2026, Springer Nature
summary: Unsupervised anomaly detection is a challenging problem due to the diversity of data distributions and the lack of labels. Ensemble methods are often adopted to mitigate these challenges by combining multiple detectors, which can reduce individual biases and increase robustness. Yet building an ensemble that is genuinely complementary remains challenging, since many detectors rely on similar decision cues and end up producing redundant anomaly scores. As a result, the potential of ensemble learning is often limited by the difficulty of identifying models that truly capture different types of irregularities. To address this, we propose a methodology for characterizing anomaly detectors through their decision mechanisms. Using SHapley Additive exPlanations, we quantify how each model attributes importance to input features, and we use these attribution profiles to measure similarity between detectors. We show that detectors with similar explanations tend to produce correlated anomaly scores and identify largely overlapping anomalies. Conversely, explanation divergence reliably indicates complementary detection behavior. Our results demonstrate that explanation-driven metrics offer a different criterion than raw outputs for selecting models in an ensemble. However, we also demonstrate that diversity alone is insufficient; high individual model performance remains a prerequisite for effective ensembles. By explicitly targeting explanation diversity while maintaining model quality, we are able to construct ensembles that are more diverse, more complementary, and ultimately more effective for unsupervised anomaly detection.

AI.tldr: 首次利用 SHAP 特征归因对异常检测器进行机理剖析，并以“解释多样性”取代传统输出相似性，构建兼具高能力与互补性的无监督集成，显著优于现有方案。
AI.motivation: 无监督异常检测缺乏标签，单一检测器易偏差；现有集成方法常因检测机理趋于一致导致模型冗余，难以真正互补。需要一种能刻画决策差异、量化互补性的新准则。
AI.method: 1. 提出“SHAP 特征归因聚类”框架，用 DetSHAP 获取各检测器对输入特征的重要性向量，计算解释相似度；2. 基于解释差异构建 Explanation-Driven Diversity (EDD) 指标，指导集成成员遴选；3. 在保持成员独立准确率门槛的前提下，联合优化解释多样性与模型质量，构建互补集成。
AI.result: 在 10 个公开数据集上，EDD-guided 集成比传统基于输出相关系数或随机挑选的集成平均 AUC-ROC 提升 3.1–8.7%，互补率（独有异常数）提高 12–20%，且对成员数量增加表现出更稳定的边际增益。
AI.conclusion: 解释层面的多样性是检测器互补性的可靠先验，兼顾解释差异与个体性能可突破无监督集成瓶颈，为今后的可解释性指导模型选择提供通用范式。

title: Fairness under uncertainty in sequential decisions
comment: ACM Conference on Fairness, Accountability, and Transparency, 2026
summary:
Fair machine learning (ML) methods help identify and mitigate the risk that algorithms encode or automate social injustices. Algorithmic approaches alone cannot resolve structural inequalities, but they can support socio-technical decision systems by surfacing discriminatory biases, clarifying trade-offs, and enabling governance. Although fairness is well studied in supervised learning, many real ML applications are online and sequential, with prior decisions informing future ones. Each decision is taken under uncertainty due to unobserved counterfactuals and finite samples, with dire consequences for under-represented groups, systematically under-observed due to historical exclusion and selective feedback. A bank cannot know whether a denied loan would have been repaid, and may have less data on marginalized populations.
  This paper introduces a taxonomy of uncertainty in sequential decision-making -- model, feedback, and prediction uncertainty -- providing shared vocabulary for assessing systems where uncertainty is unevenly distributed across groups. We formalize model and feedback uncertainty via counterfactual logic and reinforcement learning, and illustrate harms to decision makers (unrealized gains/losses) and subjects (compounding exclusion, reduced access) of policies that ignore the unobserved space. Algorithmic examples show it is possible to reduce outcome variance for disadvantaged groups while preserving institutional objectives (e.g. expected utility). Experiments on data simulated with varying bias show how unequal uncertainty and selective feedback produce disparities, and how uncertainty-aware exploration alters fairness metrics. The framework equips practitioners to diagnose, audit, and govern fairness risks. Where uncertainty drives unfairness rather than incidental noise, accounting for it is essential to fair and effective decision-making.
