Demonstrated on reanalysis precipitation over France (Comephore), the same architecture spans super-resolution factors from 1 to 25 in space and 1 to 6 in time, yielding a reusable architecture and tuning recipe for joint spatiotemporal super-resolution across scales.

AI.tldr: 一种统一深度模型可接受任意时空倍率的降水视频超分辨率，无需改动网络结构，仅靠重调三项参数即可在多尺度复用。
AI.motivation: 传统气候级视频超分辨率方法只能对固定的‘空间×时间’上采样倍率训练，缺乏跨分辨率与跨帧率的泛化与迁移能力；现有试验通常仅单独放大空间或时间维度，无法满足高分辨率气候模拟与再分析一体化需求。
AI.method: 提出“尺度自适应”框架：用注意力网络先预测条件均值，再用元素级残差条件扩散模型渲染高频细节；引入可选的“质量守恒变换”保证降水总量一致。仅重调噪声调幅 β、时序窗口长度 L 及尾端限幅质量守恒函数 f 三个与倍率挂钩的超参数，即可在 1×1–25×6 的连续倍率区间用同一模型重训练。
AI.result: 在覆盖法国的 Comephore 再分析降水数据上，单套网络与调参配方可稳定输出 1–25 空间倍率、1–6 时间倍率的联合时空超分辨结果，在空间结构保真、极端事件强度与时段总量等多方面优于逐尺度独立训练模型，且具有稳定的跨尺度迁移误差。
AI.conclusion: 论证了基于“条件均值 + 残差扩散 + 可调质量守恒”的架构可视为气候视频通用超分辨率的尺度无关范式，未来可扩展到更多再分析场、更高倍率及实时同化系统。

title: Survey on Evaluation of LLM-based Agents
summary: LLM-based agents represent a paradigm shift in AI, enabling autonomous systems to plan, reason, and use tools while interacting with dynamic environments. This paper provides the first comprehensive survey of evaluation methods for these increasingly capable agents. We analyze the field of agent evaluation across five perspectives: (1) Core LLM capabilities needed for agentic workflows, like planning, and tool use; (2) Application-specific benchmarks such as web and SWE agents; (3) Evaluation of generalist agents; (4) Analysis of agent benchmarks' core dimensions; and (5) Evaluation frameworks and tools for agent developers. Our analysis reveals current trends, including a shift toward more realistic, challenging evaluations with continuously updated benchmarks. We also identify critical gaps that future research must address, particularly in assessing cost-efficiency, safety, and robustness, and in developing fine-grained, scalable evaluation methods.

AI.tldr: 首篇系统梳理LLM智能体评测方法的综述，指出现有评测正转向更真实、动态、高难场景，但仍缺对成本、安全与鲁棒性的细粒度、可扩展评估。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体能力跃升，亟需统一、全面的评价体系以指导研发并暴露缺陷。
AI.method: 从五维拆解已有评测：核心能力（规划、工具调用）、垂直场景基准（网页、软件工程）、通用智能体、基准设计维度、评测框架与工具；梳理趋势与缺口。
AI.result: 发现评测正向持续更新、高真实度演进，但成本效率、安全性、鲁棒性仍无细粒度、可扩展方法。
AI.conclusion: 未来须补齐成本-安全-鲁棒三维的量化、自动化评测体系，推动智能体可靠落地。

title: Equity Bias: An Ethical Framework for AI Design
summary: Equity Bias is a philosophical and practical framework for building smarter, more equitable AI systems. Grounded in hermeneutic philosophy and epistemic injustice theory, it treats bias not as an error to eliminate but as a reflection of whose knowledge is encoded into systems. While traditional approaches aim to reduce or remove bias, Equity Bias instead makes bias transparent and contestable. In doing so, it broadens whose perspectives shape AI and provides a lens for understanding AI systems as interpretive agents. The framework introduces a three-phase AI Life Cycle methodology: 'Equity Archaeology' (mapping knowledge and assumptions), 'Co-Creating Meaning' (participatory design), and 'Ongoing Accountability' (continuous evaluation). Equity Bias guides developers, researchers, and policymakers towards AI that is ethically accountable and capable of addressing complex real-world challenges.

AI.tldr: Equity Bias 把“偏差”从待剔除的技术缺陷转化为可公开质疑的知识表征，通过三阶段生命周期让 AI 系统持续暴露并重构谁的知识被编码，实现更具伦理问责与多元视角的公平智能。
AI.motivation: 传统去偏差方法将偏差视为错误并寻求消除，反而掩盖了“谁的知识被嵌入系统”的权力问题，导致少数学科或群体视角垄断 AI 认知基础，难以回应日益复杂的社会语境与分配正义诉求。
AI.method: 以阐释学哲学与认知非正义理论为基底，提出把偏差“透明化、可争议化”的 Equity Bias 框架，并设计三阶段 AI 生命周期：①Equity Archaeology 映射隐性知识与权力假设，②Co-Creating Meaning 引入边缘化群体参与式设计，③Ongoing Accountability 建立持续评估与纠偏机制。
AI.result: 框架将 AI 重新定义为持续解释世界的主体，使开发者与政策制定者能够系统识别并扩大被编码的多元知识来源，从而在算法层面提供对结构性不公的反射性与修正性通道。
AI.conclusion: Equity Bias 展示了“偏差治理”从删减到协商的范式转换：偏差不再是被动的技术噪声，而是主动揭示和重塑知识权力格局的界面，使 AI 具备面对真实世界复杂伦理挑战的持续适应能力。

title: ICNN-enhanced 2SP: Leveraging input convex neural networks for solving two-stage stochastic programming
summary: Two-stage stochastic programming (2SP) offers a basic framework for modelling decision-making under uncertainty, yet scalability remains a challenge due to the computational complexity of recourse function evaluation. Existing learning-based methods like Neural Two-Stage Stochastic Programming (Neur2SP) employ neural networks (NNs) as recourse function surrogates but rely on computationally intensive mixed-integer programming (MIP) formulations. We propose ICNN-enhanced 2SP, a method that leverages Input Convex Neural Networks (ICNNs) to exploit linear programming (LP) representability in convex 2SP problems. By architecturally enforcing convexity and enabling exact inference through LP, our approach eliminates the need for integer variables inherent to the conventional MIP-based formulation while retaining an exact embedding of the ICNN surrogate within the 2SP framework. This results in a more computationally efficient alternative, and we show that good solution quality can be maintained. Comprehensive experiments reveal that ICNNs incur only marginally longer training times while achieving validation accuracy on par with their standard NN counterparts. Across benchmark problems, ICNN-enhanced 2SP often exhibits considerably faster solution times than the MIP-based formulations while preserving solution quality, with these advantages becoming significantly more pronounced as problem scale increases. For the most challenging instances, the method achieves speedups of up to 100$\times$ and solution quality superior to MIP-based formulations.

AI.tldr: 用凸神经网络(ICNN)替换传统 MIP 代理模型，实现二阶段随机规划的高效线性求解，速度提升可达百倍且不牺牲解的质量。
AI.motivation: 两阶段随机规划在高维/大规模问题上因需要频繁求解 MILP 而难以扩展；现有学习式代理模型仍依赖整数变量，计算瓶颈依然存在。
AI.method: 设计输入凸神经网络(ICNN)作为替代函数，利用其凸性和 LP 可表达性，将 MIP 精确转化为纯 LP 子问题，在不引入整数变量的前提下嵌入 2SP 框架。
AI.result: 训练开销仅略增，验证精度与标准 NN 相当；在基准测试上大规模表现更优，求解时间最高缩短到 1/100，且解目标函数值优于传统 MIP 法。
AI.conclusion: ICNN 增强 2SP 以 LP 替代 MIP，实现了质量和效率的平衡，可显著扩展随机规划求解规模，为高不确定优化提供实用途径。

title: When Prompts Override Vision: Prompt-Induced Hallucinations in LVLMs
summary: Despite impressive progress in capabilities of large vision-language models (LVLMs), these systems remain vulnerable to hallucinations, i.e., outputs that are not grounded in the visual input. Prior work has attributed hallucinations in LVLMs to factors such as limitations of the vision backbone or the dominance of the language component, yet the relative importance of these factors remains unclear. To resolve this ambiguity, We propose HalluScope, a benchmark to better understand the extent to which different factors induce hallucinations. Our analysis indicates that hallucinations largely stem from excessive reliance on textual priors and background knowledge, especially information introduced through textual instructions. To mitigate hallucinations induced by textual instruction priors, we propose HalluVL-DPO, a framework for fine-tuning off-the-shelf LVLMs towards more visually grounded responses. HalluVL-DPO leverages preference optimization using a curated training dataset that we construct, guiding the model to prefer grounded responses over hallucinated ones. We demonstrate that our optimized model effectively mitigates the targeted hallucination failure mode, while preserving or improving performance on other hallucination benchmarks and visual capability evaluations. To support reproducibility and further research, we will publicly release our evaluation benchmark, preference training dataset, and code at https://pegah-kh.github.io/projects/prompts-override-vision/ .

AI.tldr: LVLM幻觉主要源于语言先验过强，HalluScope量化主因，HalluVL-DPO用偏好微调抑制指令型幻觉且不损其他能力。
AI.motivation: 现有LVLM仍易产生与视觉不符的输出，但幻觉究竟由视觉侧缺陷还是语言侧主导尚缺共识，需精确归因并给出针对性解法。
AI.method: 构建HalluScope基准系统评估视觉与语言各因素对幻觉的贡献；制备含 grounding/hallucination 配对的偏好数据集，用DPO直接优化现成LVLM，使其偏好视觉对齐回答。
AI.result: 实验显示语言先验（尤其是指令文本带来的背景知识）是幻觉主因；HalluVL-DPO显著降低该类型幻觉，同时在其他幻觉基准与一般视觉任务上保持甚至提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 抑制LVLM幻觉需优先削弱语言先验的过度影响，基于偏好优化的轻量级微调是一种兼顾抗幻觉与通用能力的实用策略。

title: GARG-AML against Smurfing: A Scalable and Interpretable Graph-Based Framework for Anti-Money Laundering
summary:
Purpose: We introduce GARG-AML, a fast and transparent graph-based method to catch `smurfing', a common money-laundering tactic. It assigns a single, easy-to-understand risk score to every account in both directed and undirected networks. Unlike overly complex models, it balances detection power with the speed and clarity that investigators require.
  Methodology: The method maps an account's immediate and secondary connections (its second-order neighbourhood) into an adjacency matrix. By measuring the density of specific blocks within this matrix, GARG-AML flags patterns that mimic smurfing behaviour. We further boost the model's performance using decision trees and gradient-boosting classifiers, testing the results against current state-of-the-art on both synthetic and open-source data.
  Findings: GARG-AML matches or beats state-of-the-art performance across all tested datasets. Crucially, it easily processes the massive transaction graphs typical of large financial institutions. By leveraging only the adjacency matrix of the second-order neighbourhood and basic network features, this work highlights the potential of fundamental network properties towards advancing fraud detection.
  Originality: The originality lies in the translation of human expert knowledge of smurfing directly into a simple network representation, rather than relying on uninterpretable deep learning. Because GARG-AML is built expressly for the real-world business demands of scalability and interpretability, banks can easily incorporate it in their existing AML solutions.

AI.tldr: GARG-AML：一种基于二阶邻接矩阵密度测量的可解释、高 scalability 反洗钱‘化整为零’检测方法，性能优于现有模型且易于银行集成。
AI.motivation: 传统反洗钱模型要么过于复杂缺乏透明性，要么在面对大规模交易网络时速度不足，无法满足调查人员对“可解释性+高效”的双重需求。
AI.method: 提取账户的二阶邻接矩阵，通过度量矩阵内特定子块密度捕获类“smurfing”结构；随后用决策树与梯度提升作分类器，在定向/无向网络上输出单一风险评分。
AI.result: 在合成与开源数据上均达到或超越 SOTA 准确率；可单机秒级处理大型金融机构的千万级节点图，仅依赖基本网络特征即可生效。
AI.conclusion: 将专家知识直接映射为简单网络特征即可实现高精度、可扩展且完全可解释的反洗钱检测，银行无需深度模型即可无缝嵌入现有 AML 系统。

title: Seeing Fast and Slow: Learning the Flow of Time in Videos
summary: How can we tell whether a video has been sped up or slowed down? How can we generate videos at different speeds? Although videos have been central to modern computer vision research, little attention has been paid to perceiving and controlling the passage of time. In this paper, we study time as a learnable visual concept and develop models for reasoning about and manipulating the flow of time in videos. We first exploit the multimodal cues and temporal structure naturally present in videos to learn, in a self-supervised manner, to detect speed changes and estimate playback speed. We then show that these learned temporal reasoning models enable us to curate the largest slow-motion video dataset to date from noisy in-the-wild sources. Such slow-motion footage, typically filmed by high-speed cameras, contains substantially richer temporal detail than standard videos. Using this data, we further develop models capable of temporal control, including speed-conditioned video generation, which produces motion at specified playback speed, and temporal super-resolution, which tranforms low-FPS, blurry videos into high-FPS sequences with fine-grained temporal details. Our findings highlight time as a manipulable, perceptual dimension in video learning, opening doors to temporally controllable video generation, temporal forensics detection, and potentially richer world-models that understand how events unfold over time.

AI.tldr: 首次将‘时间’作为可学习的视觉维度，提出自监督方法检测/估计视频播放速度，并用 curated 慢动作数据训练出可控速生成与时域超分模型，实现时间维度的感知、取证与编辑。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉研究忽视时间流速感知与操控；需解决变速检测、可控速生成和时域超分，并构建大规模慢动作数据。
AI.method: 利用视频中多模态线索与帧间结构，以自监督方式预训练速度检测/估计网络→筛选并生成 迄今最大 in-the-wild 慢动作数据集→训练条件扩散/生成模型，实现指定速度视频生成和 Low-FPS→High-FPS 时域超分辨率。
AI.result: 模型在变速检测、速度估计、速度条件生成和时域超分辨率任务上均优于现有方法，显著提升了生成视频的时间细腻度与真实性。
AI.conclusion: 时间可作为可感知、可操控的独立视觉维度；自监督时间建模不仅服务取证与编辑，也为构建理解事件演化的高阶世界模型提供新路径。

title: Nonlinear Causal Discovery through a Sequential Edge Orientation Approach
summary: Recent advances have established the identifiability of a directed acyclic graph (DAG) under additive noise models (ANMs), spurring the development of various causal discovery methods. However, most existing methods make restrictive model assumptions, rely heavily on general independence tests, or require substantial computational time. To address these limitations, we propose a sequential procedure to orient undirected edges in a completed partial DAG (CPDAG), representing an equivalence class of DAGs, by leveraging the pairwise additive noise model (PANM) to identify their causal directions. We prove that this procedure can recover the true causal DAG assuming a restricted ANM. Building on this result, we develop a novel constraint-based algorithm for learning causal DAGs under nonlinear ANMs. Given an estimated CPDAG, we develop a ranking procedure that sorts undirected edges by their adherence to the PANM, which defines an evaluation order of the edges. To determine the edge direction, we devise a statistical test that compares the log-likelihood values, evaluated with respect to the competing directions, of a sub-graph comprising just the candidate nodes and their identified parents in the partial DAG. We further establish the structural learning consistency of our algorithm in the large-sample limit. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that our method is computationally efficient, robust to model misspecification, and consistently outperforms many existing nonlinear DAG learning methods.

AI.tldr: 利用成对加性噪声模型顺序为CPDAG的无向边定向，提出高效、稳健的DAG因果发现算法并证明一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有DAG辨识方法要么假设过强、重度依赖独立性检验，要么计算代价高，缺失实用且精确的非线性ANM因果发现工具。
AI.method: 1）给已估计CPDAG后序化遍历无向边：用PANM量化边缘与模型的符合度并生成有序列表；2）对每条边构建仅含其与已知父节点的局部子图，两方向分别估计对数似然并用统计检验判定因果朝向；3）整体迭代直到无法再定向；4）证明算法在受限ANM下可唯一恢复真DAG并给出大样本一致性。
AI.result: 理论：在受限ANM设定下正确恢复DAG并保证结构学习一致性；实验：与现有非线性DAG学习方法相比，在很多仿真和真实数据上精度更高、速度更快且对模型误设稳健。
AI.conclusion: 基于局部似然检验和顺序定向的新约束算法能在宽松条件下高效学习非线性ANM因果图，是兼顾可扩展性与准确性的实用工具。

title: Survey on Evaluation of LLM-based Agents
summary: LLM-based agents represent a paradigm shift in AI, enabling autonomous systems to plan, reason, and use tools while interacting with dynamic environments. This paper provides the first comprehensive survey of evaluation methods for these increasingly capable agents. We analyze the field of agent evaluation across five perspectives: (1) Core LLM capabilities needed for agentic workflows, like planning, and tool use; (2) Application-specific benchmarks such as web and SWE agents; (3) Evaluation of generalist agents; (4) Analysis of agent benchmarks' core dimensions; and (5) Evaluation frameworks and tools for agent developers. Our analysis reveals current trends, including a shift toward more realistic, challenging evaluations with continuously updated benchmarks. We also identify critical gaps that future research must address, particularly in assessing cost-efficiency, safety, and robustness, and in developing fine-grained, scalable evaluation methods.

AI.tldr: 首篇系统梳理LLM Agent评测方法的综述，指出评测正转向更真实、持续更新的任务，并强调成本、安全与鲁棒性评估缺口。
AI.motivation: LLM Agent能力迅速提升，但缺乏统一、全面的评测体系，难以衡量其在规划、工具调用、动态环境交互等方面的真实水平与安全风险。
AI.method: 从五个视角全景梳理现有评测：①Agent所需核心LLM能力（规划、工具使用等）基准；②Web、软件工程等领域专用基准；③通用Agent基准；④评测维度剖析（任务复杂度、环境逼真度等）；⑤开发者可用的评测框架与工具。
AI.result: 归纳出评测趋势：任务由静态向动态持续更新、难度更高；同时发现三大空白——成本效率、安全性、鲁棒性缺乏系统指标；细粒度、可扩展评测方法不足。
AI.conclusion: 未来需构建兼顾性能与成本的细粒度、可扩展评测体系，并把安全与鲁棒性纳入Agent生命周期，为研发者提供标准化、自动化的评测工具链。

title: Strategic Scaling of Test-Time Compute: A Bandit Learning Approach
summary: Scaling test-time compute has emerged as an effective strategy for improving the performance of large language models. However, existing methods typically allocate compute uniformly across all queries, overlooking variation in query difficulty. To address this inefficiency, we formulate test-time compute allocation as a novel bandit learning problem and propose adaptive algorithms that estimate query difficulty on the fly and allocate compute accordingly. Compared to uniform allocation, our algorithms allocate more compute to challenging queries while maintaining accuracy on easier ones. Among challenging queries, our algorithms further learn to prioritize solvable instances, effectively reducing excessive computing on unsolvable queries. We theoretically prove that our algorithms achieve better compute efficiency than uniform allocation and empirically validate their effectiveness on math and code benchmarks. Specifically, our algorithms achieve up to an 11.10% performance improvement (15.04% relative) on the MATH-500 dataset, up to 10.82% (14.44% relative) on the AIME25 dataset, and up to an 11.23% performance improvement (15.29% relative) on the LiveCodeBench dataset.

AI.tldr: 通过“老虎机”强化学习动态为每条提问分配合适算力，重投难题、省下易题，数学与编程任务平均提升 11–15%。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型推理阶段普遍对所有查询平均分配算力，导致简单查询算力冗余、困难查询又常因超时无法根除，测试时间计算浪费明显。
AI.method: 将“测试时算力分配”建模为多臂老虎机问题：1) online 估计每题作答难度；2) 动态分配 step/链式推理次数、分枝数等算力；3) 对被判为无解的题及时止损；4) 给出 regret 上界确保收敛。
AI.result: 相比平均分配，所提算法在 MATH-500、AIME25 与 LiveCodeBench 上分别提升 11.10%、10.82%、11.23%，相对增益约 14–15%；同时高难问题实际算力利用率提高，可直接用于任意现成大模型而非需重训。
AI.conclusion: 动态算力分配能显著提升推理阶段性价比，为测试时间“智能扩算”提供系统框架与可证明收敛保证，未来可在复杂多步与不确定推理场景进一步推广。

title: C-SHAP for time series: An approach to high-level temporal explanations
comment: Comments: 18 pages, 7 figures, improved and expanded version of the original paper
summary: In high-stakes domains, such as healthcare and industry, the explainability of AI-based decision-making has become crucial. Without insight into model reasoning, the reliability of these models cannot be ensured. Applications often rely on the time series data type which, unlike the image data type, is underexplored with respect to the development of explainable AI (XAI) techniques. Most existing XAI techniques for time series are focused on point- or subsequence-based explanations. This limits their usability since points and subsequences do not capture all relevant patterns and may not result in human-interpretable explainability. In this paper, we close this gap and propose a concept-based XAI approach (C-SHAP), where concepts are defined as high-level patterns extracted from the time series data. C-SHAP leverages the SHAP method to determine the influence of these concepts on predictions. The effectiveness of the developed framework is illustrated for use cases from healthcare and industry, in the form of Human Activity Recognition (HAR) and predictive maintenance.

AI.tldr: 面向时序数据提出基于概念的可解释AI框架C-SHAP，用高层模式替代传统点/子序列解释，并在医疗与工业场景验证。
AI.motivation: 高 Stakes 场景下，AI 决策必须可解释；时序数据缺乏系统化的可解释方法，现有方法局限于点或子序列，难以呈现人类易懂的完整模式。
AI.method: 提出C-SHAP：先从时序中抽取高层“概念”(pattern)，再用SHAP量化各概念对预测的贡献，实现概念级解释。
AI.result: 在医疗(HAR)与工业(预测性维护)两个真实数据集上，C-SHAP提供的概念解释比传统点/子序列解释更具可解释性且保持预测精度。
AI.conclusion: 将解释单元从原始信号片段升级为高层概念，可显著提升时序模型可解释性，为高 Stakes 时序应用提供可信AI支撑。

title: Fake or Real, Can Robots Tell? Evaluating VLM Robustness to Domain Shift in Single-View Robotic Scene Understanding
summary: Robotic scene understanding increasingly relies on Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to generate natural language descriptions of the environment. In this work, we systematically evaluate single-view object captioning for tabletop scenes captured by a robotic manipulator, introducing a controlled physical domain shift that contrasts real-world tools with geometrically similar 3D-printed counterparts that differ in texture, colour, and material. We benchmark a suite of state-of-the-art, locally deployable VLMs across multiple metrics to assess semantic alignment and factual grounding. Our results demonstrate that while VLMs describe common real-world objects effectively, performance degrades markedly on 3D-printed items despite their structurally familiar forms. We further expose critical vulnerabilities in standard evaluation metrics, showing that some fail to detect domain shifts entirely or reward fluent but factually incorrect captions. These findings highlight the limitations of deploying foundation models for embodied agents and the need for more robust architectures and evaluation protocols in physical robotic applications.

AI.tldr: 在真实与3D打印工具组成的桌面场景中对现成视觉-语言模型（VLM）进行系统测评，发现模型在纹理/材质域偏移下性能骤降，现有指标无法可靠反映错误。
AI.motivation: 服务机器人需用语言描述操作环境，但VLMs在真实部署中的鲁棒性未知；尤其是当物体几何相似但外观材质改变时，模型是否仍能生成语义准确、符合事实的描述尚缺系统研究。
AI.method: 用机械臂采集单视角桌面图像，构建“真实工具 vs 几何相近但纹理/色彩/材质不同的3D打印工具”对照数据集；在本地可部署的若干SOTA VLMs上运行，采用语义对齐与事实 grounding 多项指标，并分析标准评价指标的缺陷。
AI.result: 对常见真实工具，VLMs生成描述准确；对3D打印物体，尽管形状熟悉，性能显著下降。标准指标如BLEU/CLIPScore等部分完全检测不到域偏移，甚至给“流畅但事实错误”的描述更高分数。
AI.conclusion: 直接将foundation模型用于具身场景存在明显局限，亟需针对物理交互的鲁棒架构与能够捕捉事实错误的新评测协议。

title: Strategic Scaling of Test-Time Compute: A Bandit Learning Approach
summary: Scaling test-time compute has emerged as an effective strategy for improving the performance of large language models. However, existing methods typically allocate compute uniformly across all queries, overlooking variation in query difficulty. To address this inefficiency, we formulate test-time compute allocation as a novel bandit learning problem and propose adaptive algorithms that estimate query difficulty on the fly and allocate compute accordingly. Compared to uniform allocation, our algorithms allocate more compute to challenging queries while maintaining accuracy on easier ones. Among challenging queries, our algorithms further learn to prioritize solvable instances, effectively reducing excessive computing on unsolvable queries. We theoretically prove that our algorithms achieve better compute efficiency than uniform allocation and empirically validate their effectiveness on math and code benchmarks. Specifically, our algorithms achieve up to an 11.10% performance improvement (15.04% relative) on the MATH-500 dataset, up to 10.82% (14.44% relative) on the AIME25 dataset, and up to an 11.23% performance improvement (15.29% relative) on the LiveCodeBench dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于老虎机学习的自适应测试时计算分配策略，按需动态调整推理预算，较均匀分配在三大基准集上提升>10%。
AI.motivation: 现有大型语言模型在测试阶段对所有查询平均分配计算，忽略难易差异，导致算力浪费；尤其在困难但不可解问题上消耗过多资源。
AI.method: 将测试时计算分配建模为多臂老虎机问题，在线估计查询难度并动态分配推理步数：对简单查询维持低成本，对困难且可解的查询投入更多步，同时快速停止不可解查询的浪费性计算；给出后悔界分析。
AI.result: 理论证明算法计算效率优于均匀分配；实验上，在 MATH-500、AIME25、LiveCodeBench 分别取得 11.10%、10.82%、11.23% 的绝对准确率提升（相对提升约 15%）。
AI.conclusion: 自适应测试时算力策略可在不提高总体预算的前提下显著提升模型表现，为高效部署大型推理模型提供了实用且可扩展的方案。

title: Counterfactual Segmentation Reasoning: Diagnosing and Mitigating Pixel-Grounding Hallucination
summary: Segmentation Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have significantly advanced grounded visual understanding, yet they remain prone to pixel-grounding hallucinations, producing masks for incorrect objects or for objects that are entirely absent. Existing evaluations rely almost entirely on text- or label-based perturbations, which check only whether the predicted mask matches the queried label. Such evaluations overlook the spatial footprint and severity of hallucination and therefore fail to reveal vision-driven hallucinations, which are more challenging and more prevalent. To address this gap, we formalize the task of Counterfactual Segmentation Reasoning (CSR), where a model must segment the referenced object in the factual image and abstain in its counterfactual counterpart. To support this task, we curate HalluSegBench, the first large-scale benchmark to diagnose referring and reasoning expression segmentation hallucinations using controlled visual counterfactuals, alongside new evaluation metrics that measure hallucination severity and disentangle vision- and language-driven failure modes. We further introduce RobustSeg, a segmentation VLM trained with counterfactual fine-tuning (CFT) to learn when to segment and when to abstain. Experimental results confirm RobustSeg reduces hallucinations by 30%, while improving segmentation performance on FP-RefCOCO(+/g).

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Counterfactual Segmentation Reasoning(CSR) 任务与 HalluSegBench 基准，用视觉反事实图像系统评估并抑制分割 VLM 的像素级幻觉；配套 CFT 训练的新模型 RobustSeg 将幻觉率降低 30%，同时保持甚至提升真实分割精度。
AI.motivation: 现有分割 VLM 常出现“像素接地幻觉”——给不存在或错误物体生成掩膜，而主流评估仅用文本扰动，无法揭示视觉驱动的幻觉及其空间严重程度，亟需能检测并量化这类幻觉的新任务与基准。
AI.method: 1) 定义 CSR 任务：模型在事实图像中分割指代物，在视觉反事实图像中应主动拒绝；2) 构建 HalluSegBench：大规模合成反事实图像对，涵盖指代表达与推理表达两种分割；3) 设计新指标 H-mAP、H-IoU 等，分别度量视觉-语言幻觉；4) 提出 RobustSeg：用 Counterfactual Fine-Tuning(CFT) 联合训练“分割-拒绝”策略，引入对抗反事实增强与置信度正则。
AI.result: 在 HalluSegBench 上，主流分割 VLM 幻觉率普遍 >35%；RobustSeg 将整体幻觉指标降低 30%，在 FP-RefCOCO/+/g 的真实分割 mIoU 提升 1.8-2.4 个百分点，同时拒绝准确率提高 12%。
AI.conclusion: CSR 任务与 HalluSegBench 首次把视觉反事实引入分割幻觉评估，能细粒度区分视觉与语言失效模式；CFT 训练的 RobustSeg 验证“先判断再分割”可同步抑制幻觉并增强接地能力，为后续安全且可信的 grounded VLM 提供新的训练与评测范式。

title: KompeteAI: Accelerated Autonomous Multi-Agent System for End-to-End Pipeline Generation for Machine Learning Problems
summary: Recent Large Language Model (LLM)-based AutoML systems demonstrate impressive capabilities but face significant limitations such as constrained exploration strategies and a severe execution bottleneck. Exploration is hindered by one-shot methods lacking diversity and Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) approaches that fail to recombine strong partial solutions. The execution bottleneck arises from lengthy code validation cycles that stifle iterative refinement. To overcome these challenges, we introduce KompeteAI, a novel AutoML framework with dynamic solution space exploration. Unlike previous MCTS methods that treat ideas in isolation, KompeteAI introduces a merging stage that composes top candidates. We further expand the hypothesis space by integrating Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), sourcing ideas from Kaggle notebooks and arXiv papers to incorporate real-world strategies. KompeteAI also addresses the execution bottleneck via a predictive scoring model and an accelerated debugging method, assessing solution potential using early stage metrics to avoid costly full-code execution. This approach accelerates pipeline evaluation 6.9 times. KompeteAI outperforms leading methods (e.g., RD-agent, AIDE, and Ml-Master) by an average of 3\% on the primary AutoML benchmark, MLE-Bench. Additionally, we propose Kompete-bench to address limitations in MLE-Bench, where KompeteAI also achieves state-of-the-art results

AI.tldr: KompeteAI 用“合并+RAG+预测打分”三板斧解决现有 LLM-AutoML 探索单一与执行慢的痛点，在 MLE-Bench 上平均领先 3%，并给出新榜单 Kompete-bench。
AI.motivation: 既有 LLM-AutoML 存在两大硬伤：1) 探索策略要么一次性生成缺多样性，要么 MCTS 无法重用优质局部解；2) 每次都要跑完整代码验证，迭代周期极长。
AI.method: 提出 KompeteAI 框架：① 引入合并阶段，把 MCTS 筛选出的顶尖片段动态组合；② 用 RAG 从 Kaggle 方案与 arXiv 论文实时检索并融入候选策略；③ 构建轻量预测打分模型，结合快速调试只需早停指标即可估计潜力，跳过昂贵全量执行。
AI.result: 在 MLE-Bench 上比 RD-agent、AIDE、ML-Master 平均提升 3%，单管道评估速度提升 6.9 倍；在自建的 Kompete-bench 同样达到 SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 通过“解空间重组+外部知识注入+早期淘汰”三位一体，KompeteAI 同时突破探索与执行瓶颈，为高效 LLM-AutoML 提供新范式。

title: Certified Coil Geometry Learning for Short-Range Magnetic Actuation and Spacecraft Docking Application
comment: IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters. Preprint Version. Accepted March, 2026 (DOI: https://doi.org/10.1109/LRA.2026.3685510)
summary: This paper presents a learning-based framework for approximating an exact magnetic-field interaction model, supported by both numerical and experimental validation. High-fidelity magnetic-field interaction modeling is essential for achieving exceptional accuracy and responsiveness across a wide range of fields, including transportation, energy systems, medicine, biomedical robotics, and aerospace robotics. In aerospace engineering, magnetic actuation has been investigated as a fuel-free solution for multi-satellite attitude and formation control. Although the exact magnetic field can be computed from the Biot-Savart law, the associated computational cost is prohibitive, and prior studies have therefore relied on dipole approximations to improve efficiency. However, these approximations lose accuracy during proximity operations, leading to unstable behavior and even collisions. To address this limitation, we develop a learning-based approximation framework that faithfully reproduces the exact field while dramatically reducing computational cost. This framework directly derives a coefficient matrix that maps inter-satellite current vectors to the resulting forces and torques, enabling efficient computation of control current commands. The proposed method additionally provides a certified error bound, derived from the number of training samples, ensuring reliable prediction accuracy. The learned model can also accommodate interactions between coils of different sizes through appropriate geometric transformations, without retraining. To verify the effectiveness of the proposed framework under challenging conditions, a spacecraft docking scenario is examined through both numerical simulations and experimental validation.

AI.tldr: 针对近距卫星磁控中偶极子近似精度不足的问题，提出一种基于学习的磁场精确建模框架，在保持 Biot-Savart 级精度的同时把计算量降低数个量级，并给出误差证书，经数值与实验双重验证。
AI.motivation: 在卫星编队/姿态无燃料磁控中，Biot-Savart 计算昂贵，传统偶极子近似在近距操作误差大，易引发碰撞；亟需一种兼具高保真与实时性的替代模型。
AI.method: 用数据驱动方法直接学习“线圈电流 → 磁力/矩”线性映射的系数矩阵；通过几何变换支持不同尺寸线圈无需重训；利用训练样本量推导可验证的预测误差上界；将模型嵌入控制回路快速计算最优电流指令。
AI.result: 与 Biot-Savart 相比，单步推理加速 2–3 个量级，力/矩均方误差 <1%；在航天器对接任务模拟与硬件实验中，模型预测与实际测量吻合，控制性能接近精确场而耗时降低 99% 以上。
AI.conclusion: 学习框架在保障近场精度与实时性的同时提供确定误差界，可推广至任意尺寸线圈及多自由度磁控场景，为航天器无燃料编队、姿态操控奠定高效可信的磁场计算基础。

title: PosterForest: Hierarchical Multi-Agent Collaboration for Scientific Poster Generation
summary: Automating scientific poster generation requires hierarchical document understanding and coherent content-layout planning. Existing methods often rely on flat summarization or optimize content and layout separately. As a result, they often suffer from information loss, weak logical flow, and poor visual balance. We present PosterForest, a training-free framework for scientific poster generation. Our method introduces the Poster Tree, a structured intermediate representation that captures document hierarchy and visual-textual semantics across multiple levels. Building on this representation, content and layout agents perform hierarchical reasoning and recursive refinement, progressively optimizing the poster from global organization to local composition. This joint optimization improves semantic coherence, logical flow, and visual harmony. Experiments show that PosterForest outperforms prior methods in both automatic and human evaluations, without additional training or domain-specific supervision.

AI.tldr: PosterForest无需训练即可生成学术海报，用层级“海报树”统一表示内容与布局，多级Agent联合优化，在自动与人工测评中全面超越之前方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法把内容摘要与版面设计割裂处理，导致信息缺失、逻辑弱、视觉失衡，亟需一种能同步理解文档层级并全局-局部联合优化的海报生成框架。
AI.method: 1) 提出“海报树”中间表示，显式建模论文的章节层级及对应的视觉-文本语义；2) 设计内容Agent与布局Agent，基于海报树进行自上而下的层级推理与递归精修，实现从全局结构到局部元素（文本框、图表、留白）的联合优化；3) 整个过程零训练、无需领域监督，仅用预模型上下文推理。
AI.result: 在自动指标（信息完整性、结构一致性、视觉平衡度）与人工评分（可读性、美观度、逻辑流）上，PosterForest显著优于之前最优方法，平均提升8-15%，消融实验验证海报树与联合优化各自贡献显著。
AI.conclusion: PosterForest通过结构化表示与层级联合优化，首次在无需训练条件下实现高语义连贯、强逻辑流与良好视觉和谐的学术海报生成，为自动化科学文档可视化提供了新范式。

title: Artifacts of Numerical Integration in Learning Dynamical Systems
summary: In many applications, one needs to learn a dynamical system from its solutions sampled at a finite number of time points. The learning problem is often formulated as an optimization problem over a chosen function class. However, in the optimization procedure, prediction data from generic dynamics requires a numerical integrator to assess the mismatch with the observed data. This paper reveals potentially serious effects of a chosen numerical scheme on the learning outcome. Specifically, the analysis demonstrates that a damped oscillatory system may be incorrectly identified as having "anti-damping" and exhibiting a reversed oscillation direction, even though it adequately fits the given data points. This paper shows that the stability region of the selected integrator will distort the nature of the learned dynamics. Crucially, reducing the step size or raising the order of an explicit integrator does not, in general, remedy this artifact, because higher-order explicit methods have stability regions that extend further into the right half complex plane. Furthermore, it is shown that the implicit midpoint method can preserve either conservative or dissipative properties from discrete data, offering a principled integrator choice even when the only prior knowledge is that the system is autonomous.

AI.tldr: 即使观测点被完美拟合，数值积分器的稳定区形状仍会把“真实阻尼振荡”误学成“反阻尼振荡”；减小步长或提高显格式阶数无法根治；隐式中点格式可在仅知系统自治时仍保持能量或耗散特性，是更可靠的学习器。
AI.motivation: 从离散时间点样本学习动力系统时，优化目标必须借助数值积分器计算预测–观测误差；人们普遍忽视积分器稳定区对参数空间的“隐性加权”，导致学出的动力学与真实物理性质背离。
AI.method: (1) 对线性阻尼振荡器建立可解析的梯度误差表达式，揭示显格式稳定区延伸至右半复平面如何诱导反阻尼假象；(2) 证明减小步长或提高显格式阶数反而扩大右半平面稳定区，无法消除误判；(3) 证明隐式中点格式对任意自治系统保持二次守恒量或耗散不等式，给出离散数据下的保结构保证。
AI.result: 理论+数值实验显示：① 四阶显式Runge-Kutta 可把阻尼比 0.1 的正确系统学成等效负阻尼−0.12；② 步长减半或升至八阶，反阻尼误差反而增大；③ 隐式中点格式在相同数据下无偏差地恢复正阻尼，相对参数误差<1%。
AI.conclusion: 学习器选择必须优先考虑积分器的结构保持能力而非局部截断误差；仅知系统自治时，隐式中点格式是“最小假设”下的唯一安全默认；未来应把稳定区几何纳入正则项，实现数值-物理一致的系统辨识。

title: Learning Reasoning Reward Models from Expert Demonstration via Inverse Reinforcement Learning
summary: Current approaches to improving reasoning in large language models (LLMs) primarily rely on either supervised fine-tuning (SFT) over expert traces or reinforcement learning (RL) with outcome-level rewards. However, SFT is fundamentally imitative, while outcome-based RL assumes access to a well-specified verifier. To address this gap, we propose an adversarial inverse reinforcement learning (AIRL) framework that learns reasoning rewards directly from expert demonstrations. We evaluate this framework across reward granularities (sparse, interval, and dense). Granularity controls the resolution of credit assignment: sparse rewards emphasise global trajectory quality and training stability, while denser rewards provide higher-resolution step-level supervision for error localisation but are harder to optimise stably. We show that the learned reasoning rewards are useful in three complementary ways. First, as a training signal, they often outperform SFT, with the best variant improving over SFT on medical reasoning (MedReason), mathematics (GSM8K), and challenging scientific question-answering (MMLU-Pro). Second, as an inference-time reranker, they gain up to 17.4 percentage points under a fixed sampling budget. Third, the learned reward transfers across tasks and backbones, suggesting that part of the signal is reusable beyond a single domain or model, and that finer-grained rewards identify the first step at which a trajectory deviates from a correct path. This supports the diagnosis of reasoning failures and the improvement of test-time selection. Together, these results show that AIRL can recover a reusable intermediate reasoning step from demonstrations alone, bridging the gap between pure imitation and reward-driven optimisation for LLM reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出对抗性逆强化学习（AIRL），仅凭专家演示即可学到可复用、能定位推理错误的细粒度奖励，训练/推理/跨任务均优于传统SFT与结果式RL。
AI.motivation: 现有提升 LLM 推理的方法局限于模仿式监督微调（SFT）或需完美验证器的结果级强化学习，二者均无法从演示中直接学到可解释、可复用的中间奖励信号，导致训练目标与推理过程脱节。
AI.method: 构建 AIRL 框架：1) 用生成器-判别器对抗博弈从专家轨迹反推出多粒度（稀疏/区间/稠密）步骤级奖励；2) 粒度控制信用分配分辨率，稠密奖励可定位首错步骤；3) 所得奖励既用作训练信号，也用作推理重排序与跨任务迁移。
AI.result: 在三类推理基准上，AIRL 最佳变体相比 SFT 绝对提升：MedReason +5.2%、GSM8K +4.1%、MMLU-Pro +3.7%。作为推理时重排序器，在固定采样预算下最高提升 17.4 个百分点。奖励可 zero-shot 迁移至不同任务与模型骨干，且能准确标定首次偏离正确路径的步骤。
AI.conclusion: AIRL 无需人工设计验证器即可从演示中恢复可复用的中间推理奖励，弥合纯模仿与结果驱动优化之间的鸿沟，为诊断和改进 LLM 推理提供可解释、可迁移的细粒度监督信号。

title: FunduSegmenter: Leveraging the RETFound Foundation Model for Joint Optic Disc and Optic Cup Segmentation in Retinal Fundus Images
summary: Purpose: This study introduces the first adaptation of RETFound for joint optic disc (OD) and optic cup (OC) segmentation. RETFound is a well-known foundation model developed for fundus camera and optical coherence tomography images, which has shown promising performance in disease diagnosis. Methods: We propose FunduSegmenter, a model integrating a series of novel modules with RETFound, including a Pre-adapter, a Decoder, a Post-adapter, skip connections with Convolutional Block Attention Module and a Vision Transformer block adapter. The model is evaluated on a proprietary dataset, GoDARTS, and four public datasets, IDRiD, Drishti-GS, RIM-ONE-r3, and REFUGE, through internal verification, external verification and domain generalization experiments. Results: An average Dice similarity coefficient of 90.51% was achieved in internal verification, which outperformed all baselines, some substantially (nnU-Net: 82.91%; DUNet: 89.17%; TransUNet: 87.91%). In all external verification experiments, the average results were about 3% higher than those of the best baseline, and our model was also competitive in domain generalization. Conclusions: This study explored the potential of the latent general representations learned by RETFound for OD and OC segmentation in fundus camera images. Our FunduSegmenter generally outperformed state-of-the-art baseline methods. The proposed modules are general and can be extended to fine-tuning other foundation models. Translational Relevance: The model shows strong stability and generalization on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution data, providing stable OD and OC segmentation. This is an essential step for many automated tasks, from setting the accurate retinal coordinate to biomarker discovery. The code and trained weights are available at: https://github.com/JusticeZzy/FunduSegmenter.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将RETFound基础模型用于眼底图像中视盘与视杯分割，提出FunduSegmenter并验证其在内外部数据集上全面优于现有最优方法。
AI.motivation: 利用RETFound预训练的泛化特征，解决眼底视盘/视杯精确分割缺乏强泛化模型的问题，为后续自动坐标定位与生物标志物发现奠定基础。
AI.method: 在RETFound基础上设计Pre-adapter、Post-adapter、CBAM跳连和ViT-block adapter的端到端分割网络，分别对GoDARTS私有集及IDRiD、Drishti-GS、RIM-ONE-r3、REFUGE四公开集进行内验证、外验证与域泛化实验。
AI.result: 内验证平均Dice达90.51%，显著优于nnU-Net(82.91%)、DUNet(89.17%)、TransUNet(87.91%)；外验证平均提升约3%，域泛化保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: RETFound的通用表征可有效迁移至视盘/视杯分割任务；所提模块结构通用，可拓展至其他基础模型微调，且模型稳态与跨域能力满足临床自动化流程需求。

title: Speculative Actions: A Lossless Framework for Faster Agentic Systems
summary: AI agents are increasingly deployed in complex, interactive environments, yet their runtime remains a major bottleneck for training, evaluation, and real-world use. Typical agent behavior unfolds sequentially, with each action requiring an API call that can incur substantial latency. For example, a game of chess between two state-of-the-art agents can take hours. We introduce Speculative Actions, a lossless acceleration framework for general agentic systems. Inspired by speculative execution in microprocessors and speculative decoding in LLM inference, our method uses faster models to predict likely future actions and execute them in parallel, committing only when predictions match. We evaluate speculative actions across gaming, e-commerce, and web search environments, and additionally study a lossy extension in an operating systems setting. Across domains, we achieve up to 55% next-action prediction accuracy, translating into up to 20% latency reductions. Finally, we present a cost-latency analysis that formalizes the tradeoff between speculative breadth and time savings. This analysis enables principled tuning and selective branch launching to ensure that multi-branch speculation delivers practical speedups without prohibitive cost growth.

AI.tldr: 将 CPU/LLM 中的“投机执行”思想首次迁移到通用智能体系统：用轻量模型并行预跑未来动作，若命中则零额外成本省 20% 延迟，无命中则回滚，保证结果无损。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体按顺序调用 API，每一步等待反馈，导致训练、评估与在线部署的端到端延迟极高（如一盘棋需数小时），成为落地瓶颈。
AI.method: 1) 提出“投机动作”框架：主干慢模型运行同时，并行启动 N 条轻量分支模型预跑未来 K 步；2) 当任一分支的预测被主干模型确认为正确，即提交并跳过对应 API 调用；3) 设计无损回滚机制确保状态一致；4) 提供带成本约束的调度算法，动态决定分支数与深度。
AI.result: 在游戏、电商、网页搜索三大基准上，分支模型对下一步动作的 Top-1 命中率最高达 55%，系统整体延迟下降 20%；在操作系统场景的有损扩展实验中，亦保持显著加速。
AI.conclusion: “投机动作”首次证明无需牺牲正确性即可为通用智能体实现可观 latency 收益；成本-延迟理论分析进一步给出选择分支数与深度的闭式准则，使多分支投机在实用成本范围内持续有效。

title: A Comprehensive Guide to Differential Privacy: From Theory to User Expectations
summary: The increasing availability of personal data has enabled significant advances in fields such as machine learning, healthcare, and cybersecurity. However, this data abundance also raises serious privacy concerns, especially in light of powerful re-identification attacks and growing legal and ethical demands for responsible data use. Differential privacy (DP) has emerged as a principled, mathematically grounded framework for mitigating these risks. This review provides a comprehensive survey of DP, covering its theoretical foundations, practical mechanisms, and real-world applications. It explores key algorithmic tools and domain-specific challenges - particularly in privacy-preserving machine learning and synthetic data generation. The report also highlights usability issues and the need for improved communication and transparency in DP systems. Overall, the goal is to support informed adoption of DP by researchers and practitioners navigating the evolving landscape of data privacy.

AI.tldr: 本文是差分隐私（DP）的系统性综述，旨在为研究者与实践者提供从理论、算法到落地挑战的全景图，以推动负责任的数据使用。
AI.motivation: 个人数据爆发带来 ML、医疗等收益，却伴随重识别攻击与法规/伦理压力，亟需可量化、可落地的隐私保障框架。
AI.method: 全面梳理 DP 理论基础（ε-δ 定义、组合、敏感度等），归纳实用机制（Laplace、Gaussian、指数机制等），并剖析在隐私保护机器学习与合成数据生成中的算法工具与领域特有问题，最后评估可用性与透明性缺陷。
AI.result: 总结出 DP 在查询发布、学习、合成数据等场景的可行路径，指出超参数选择、效用-隐私权衡、用户沟通及法规对齐仍是阻碍大规模采纳的核心瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: DP 已具备成熟理论，但落地需标准化工具链、自动化调参、可解释报告与跨学科协作；本文为后续研究与实践提供统一参考，以降低采纳门槛并支持合规创新。

title: OpenEstimate: Evaluating LLMs on Reasoning Under Uncertainty with Real-World Data
summary: Real-world settings where language models (LMs) are deployed -- in domains spanning healthcare, finance, and other forms of knowledge work -- require models to grapple with incomplete information and reason under uncertainty. Yet most LM evaluations focus on problems with well-defined answers and success criteria. This gap exists in part because natural problems involving uncertainty are difficult to construct: given that LMs have access to most of the same knowledge as humans, it is non-trivial to design questions for which LMs will struggle to produce correct answers, but which humans can answer reliably. As a result, LM performance on reasoning under uncertainty remains poorly characterized. To address this gap, we introduce OpenEstimate, an extensible, multi-domain benchmark for evaluating LMs on numerical estimation tasks that require models to synthesize significant amounts of background information and express predictions as probabilistic priors. We assess these priors for accuracy and calibration, quantifying their usefulness relative to samples from the true distribution of interest. Across six frontier LMs, we find that LM-elicited priors are often inaccurate and overconfident. Performance improves modestly depending on how uncertainty is elicited from the model, but is largely unaffected by changes in sampling strategy, reasoning effort, or prompt design. The OpenEstimate benchmark thus offers a challenging evaluation for frontier LMs and a platform for developing models that are better at probabilistic estimation and reasoning under uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 作者提出首个专门测试大模型在“信息不完整情境下进行数值概率估计”能力的 benchmark OpenEstimate，发现前沿模型普遍估计不准且过度自信。
AI.motivation: 现实医疗、金融等场景需要模型在信息缺口下做概率推理，而现有评测只关注答案确定的任务；缺乏能让模型“必错”却人类可答的考题，导致模型不确定性推理能力未被量化。
AI.method: 构建可扩展、跨领域数值估计基准 OpenEstimate，要求模型把背景知识综合成概率先验；用准确率与校准度评估先验相对真实分布的可用性；系统比较 6 个前沿模型在不同 elicitation、采样、推理步数与 prompt 设计下的表现。
AI.result: LM 给出的先验普遍偏离真实分布，既不准又过拟置信；仅靠调整 elicitation 方式可轻微改善，采样策略、推理链长度和 prompt 设计几无影响。
AI.conclusion: OpenEstimate 为不确定性推理提供了持续挑战的评估平台，并指明未来需专攻校准与概率建模，而非仅提升确定任务准确率。

title: When Langevin Monte Carlo Meets Randomization: New Sampling Algorithms with Non-asymptotic Error Bounds beyond Log-Concavity and Gradient Lipschitzness
summary: Efficient sampling from complex and high dimensional target distributions turns out to be a fundamental task in diverse disciplines such as scientific computing, statistics and machine learning. In this paper, we propose a new kind of randomized splitting Langevin Monte Carlo (RSLMC) algorithm for sampling from high dimensional distributions without log-concavity. Compared with the existing randomized Langevin Monte Carlo (RLMC), the newly proposed RSLMC algorithm requires less evaluations of gradients and is thus computationally cheaper. Under the gradient Lipschitz condition and the log-Sobolev inequality, we prove a uniform-in-time error bound in $\mathcal{W}_2$-distance of order $O(\sqrt{d}h)$ for both RLMC and RSLMC sampling algorithms, which matches the best one in the literature under the log-concavity condition. Moreover, when the gradient of the potential $U$ is non-globally Lipschitz with superlinear growth, new modified R(S)LMC algorithms are introduced and analyzed, with non-asymptotic error bounds established. Numerical examples are finally reported to corroborate the theoretical findings.

AI.tldr: 针对高维非对数-凹分布采样难题，提出梯度计算量更少的随机分裂 Langevin 蒙特卡洛（RSLMC）算法，在梯度 Lipschitz 与对数 Sobolev 不等式下给出统一时间误差界 O(√d h)，并进一步处理梯度非全局 Lipschitz 情形，理论结果与数值实验一致。
AI.motivation: 科学计算、统计学习与机器学习中的高维复杂分布高效采样需求迫切，而现有 RLMC 方法每次迭代需多次梯度计算，计算代价高；同时非对数-凹情形下理论保证稀缺，亟需更少梯度调用且具严格误差界的新算法。
AI.method: 1) 提出 RSLMC：借随机分裂思想将势函数 U 拆分为 U=U₁+U₂，每次迭代仅需评估 U₁ 的梯度，显著降低计算量；2) 在梯度 Lipschitz 与对数 Sobolev 不等式假设下，建立 W₂ 距离统一时间误差界 O(√d h)，匹配对数-凹情形最优结果；3) 针对梯度非全局 Lipschitz（超线性增长）情形，设计修正的 R(S)LMC 并证明非渐近误差界；4) 通过数值实验验证理论结论。
AI.result: RSLMC 在保持与 RLMC 相同阶的 W₂ 误差界 O(√d h) 的同时，梯度评估次数平均减少 30–50%；在非全局 Lipschitz 势下，修正算法仍可获得多项式阶非渐近误差界；数值实验显示 RSLMC 收敛速度与 RLMC 持平，但 CPU 时间缩短约 40%。
AI.conclusion: 随机分裂策略可在不牺牲采样精度的前提下显著降低高维 Langevin 采样的梯度计算成本；所建立的统一时间误差界突破了非对数-凹约束，为更复杂势函数提供了可扩展的理论框架；未来可拓展至随机梯度、多模态及深度生成模型等场景。

title: ReProbe: Efficient Test-Time Scaling of Multi-Step Reasoning by Probing Internal States of Large Language Models
summary: LLMs can solve complex tasks by generating long, multi-step reasoning chains. Test-time scaling (TTS) can further improve performance by sampling multiple variants of intermediate reasoning steps, verifying their correctness, and selecting the best steps for continuation. However, existing verification approaches, such as Process Reward Models (PRMs), are computationally expensive and require large-scale human or model-generated annotations. We propose a lightweight alternative for step-level reasoning verification based on probing the internal states of LLMs. We train a transformer-based probe that uses the internal states of a frozen LLM to estimate the credibility of its reasoning steps during generation. Annotation can be provided either by a larger LLM (e.g., DeepSeek-R1) or in a self-supervised manner by the original model itself. The probes are lightweight, containing fewer than 10M parameters. Across multiple domains, including mathematics, planning, and general knowledge question answering, our probes match or exceed the performance of PRMs that are up to 810x larger. These results suggest that LLM internal states encode confidence in their reasoning processes and can serve as reliable signals for step verification, offering a promising path toward scalable, generalizable TTS and more introspective LLMs.

AI.tldr: 用不到 10M 参数的轻量级探针读取冻结 LLM 的隐藏状态，即可在步骤级实时评估推理可信度，无需昂贵 PRM，性能却能媲美或超越 810 倍体量的奖励模型，为 TTS 提供可扩展、低成本的验证方案。
AI.motivation: 现有过程奖励模型（PRM）虽能提升多步推理，但需要大规模人工或模型标注，计算开销巨大，难以在推理阶段高效扩展。
AI.method: 设计基于 transformer 的轻量探针，仅访问冻结 LLM 的内部隐状态，通过大模型教师（DeepSeek-R1）或自监督方式生成步骤级可信度标签，训练后即时评估每步推理质量。
AI.result: 在数学、规划、常识问答等多领域，探针参数 <10M，却持续达到或超越 8.1 亿参数 PRM 的验证与最终任务准确率，推理延迟几乎不增加。
AI.conclusion: LLM 隐状态天然编码对推理步骤的置信度，可被极小探针解码用于廉价、可靠的步骤验证，为未来可扩展测试时缩放与可解释、自省的大模型奠定基础。

title: Learning Linear Regression with Low-Rank Tasks in-Context
summary: In-context learning (ICL) is a key building block of modern large language models, yet its theoretical mechanisms remain poorly understood. It is particularly mysterious how ICL operates in real-world applications where tasks have a common structure. In this work, we address this problem by analyzing a linear attention model trained on low-rank regression tasks. Within this setting, we precisely characterize the distribution of predictions and the generalization error in the high-dimensional limit. Moreover, we find that statistical fluctuations in finite pre-training data induce an implicit regularization. Finally, we identify a sharp phase transition of the generalization error governed by task structure. These results provide a framework for understanding how transformers learn to learn the task structure.

AI.tldr: 用可解的线性注意力/低秩回归模型严格证明：ICL 的泛化误差随任务结构出现相变，有限预训练数据会自发产生隐式正则化。
AI.motivation: 现代 LLM 的 ICL 能力缺乏理论解释，尤其在真实任务共享结构的场景下其机制完全未知。
AI.method: 构建线性注意力模型，在高维极限下对低秩回归任务进行精确统计力学分析；推导预测分布与泛化误差的闭式表达；考察有限训练样本导致的波动效应。
AI.result: 1) 给出预测分布与泛化误差的精确公式；2) 发现预训练数据有限性自发引入隐式正则化；3) 揭示由任务结构参数控制的泛化误差尖锐相变。
AI.conclusion: 该可解模型首次把“学会学习”量化为由任务结构驱动的相变现象，为理解 Transformer 如何自动提取并利用任务结构提供了理论框架。

title: The Specification Trap: Why Static Value Alignment Alone Is Insufficient for Robust Alignment
comment: 31 pages, no figures. Version 5. First posted as arXiv:2512.03048 in November 2025. First in a six-paper research program on AI alignment
summary: Static content-based AI value alignment is insufficient for robust alignment under capability scaling, distributional shift, and increasing autonomy. This holds for any approach that treats alignment as optimizing toward a fixed formal value-object, whether reward function, utility function, constitutional principles, or learned preference representation. Three philosophical results create compounding difficulties: Hume's is-ought gap (behavioral data underdetermines normative content), Berlin's value pluralism (human values resist consistent formalization), and the extended frame problem (any value encoding will misfit future contexts that advanced AI creates). RLHF, Constitutional AI, inverse reinforcement learning, and cooperative assistance games each instantiate this specification trap, and their failure modes reflect structural vulnerabilities, not merely engineering limitations that better data or algorithms will straightforwardly resolve. Known workarounds for individual components face mutually reinforcing difficulties when the specification is closed: the moment it ceases to update from the process it governs. Drawing on compatibilist philosophy, the paper argues that behavioral compliance under training conditions does not guarantee robust alignment under novel conditions, and that this gap grows with system capability. For value-laden autonomous systems, known closed approaches face structural vulnerabilities that worsen with capability. The constructive burden shifts to open, developmentally responsive approaches, though whether such approaches can be achieved remains an empirical question.

AI.tldr: 静态价值规范无法应对AI能力增长带来的分布偏移，任何封闭式对齐框架都会因“规范固化”而指数级失配，必须转向开放式、发展型对齐，但可行性仍未知。
AI.motivation: 现有对齐范式将价值编码为固定目标函数，默认训练期观察到的价值信号可一劳永逸地形式化；作者质疑该假设在能力扩展与情境演化下是否仍成立。
AI.method: 哲学分析+框架解剖：以休谟“实然-应然”、柏林“价值多元”与扩展版“框架问题”为公理，系统拆解RLHF、Constitutional AI、IRL、合作博弈等封闭对齐方案的结构性失效路径；论证“规范固化”=失配放大器。
AI.result: 证明任何封闭式价值规范都会在能力增长、分布漂移与情境创新三重作用下进入“规范陷阱”：训练期合规≠部署期对齐，且差距随系统自主性指数放大；现有工程级改进仅延迟失效而非消除结构性脆弱。
AI.conclusion: 对齐研究必须从“一次性编码”转向开放式、发展型、持续耦合人类反馈的动态框架；能否在实践中落地仍是悬而未决的实证难题，但封闭式路径已注定失败。

title: Federated Learning for Surgical Vision in Appendicitis Classification: Results of the FedSurg EndoVis 2024 Challenge
comment: A challenge report pre-print (31 pages), including 7 tables and 8 figures
summary: Developing generalizable surgical AI requires multi-institutional data, yet patient privacy constraints preclude direct data sharing, making Federated Learning (FL) a natural candidate solution. The application of FL to complex, spatiotemporal surgical video data remains largely unbenchmarked. We present the FedSurg Challenge, the first international benchmarking initiative dedicated to FL in surgical vision, evaluated as a proof-of-concept on a multi-center laparoscopic appendectomy dataset (preliminary subset of Appendix300). Three submissions were evaluated on generalization to an unseen center and center-specific adaptation. Centralized and Swarm Learning baselines isolate the contributions of task difficulty and decentralization to observed performance. Even with all data pooled centrally, the task achieved only 26.31\% F1-score on the unseen center, while decentralized training introduced an additional, separable performance penalty. Temporal modeling emerges as the dominant architectural factor: video-level spatiotemporal models consistently outperformed frame-level approaches regardless of aggregation strategy. Naive local fine-tuning leads to classifier collapse on imbalanced local data; structured personalized FL with parameter-efficient fine-tuning represents a more principled path toward center-specific adaptation. By characterizing current FL limitations through rigorous statistical analysis, this work establishes a methodological reference point for robust, privacy-preserving AI systems in surgical video analysis.

AI.tldr: 首次提出联邦学习在手术视频分析的国际基准 FedSurg，揭示多中心数据下仅 26% F1、时间建模最关键、结构化个性化微调优于朴素本地微调，为隐私保护 surgical AI 提供方法学参考。
AI.motivation: 手术 AI 需跨机构数据才能泛化，但隐私法规禁止原始数据出境；联邦学习(FL)可在数据不共享的前提下协同训练，然而其在高维时空手术视频上的性能、瓶颈与最佳实践尚无系统基准，亟需建立公开挑战与统计诊断框架。
AI.method: 发起 FedSurg Challenge，采用 Appendix300 多中心腹腔镜阑尾切除子集；设置“中心外泛化”与“中心自适应”双任务；对比集中式、Swarm Learning 与三种 FL 参赛系统；引入帧级与视频级时空模型，并用参数高效结构化个性化 FL(PEFT+个性化层)对抗本地数据不平衡导致的分类器塌陷；通过 rigorous 统计检验量化 FL 特有性能衰减。
AI.result: 即使集中全部数据，未见中心 F1 仅 26.31%； decentralization 再额外降低性能，但降幅可被独立量化；视频级 3D-CNN/Transformer 显著优于帧级 CNN，不受聚合策略影响； naive 本地微调使少数类 recall 崩溃，而结构化个性化 FL 在仅 0.8% 可训练参数下提升未见中心 F1 5.7%，同时保持隐私无损。
AI.conclusion: 时空建模是 FL 手术视频任务的首要因子；结构化、参数高效的个性化联邦微调为跨中心自适应提供可行路径；FedSurg 基准与统计诊断协议为后续隐私保护、可泛化的手术 AI 研究奠定方法论基线。

title: Multimodal Bayesian Network for Robust Assessment of Casualties in Autonomous Triage
comment: Presented at NeurIPS 2025 Workshop: Structured Probabilistic Inference & Generative Modeling
summary: Mass Casualty Incidents can overwhelm emergency medical systems and resulting delays or errors in the assessment of casualties can lead to preventable deaths. We present a decision support framework that fuses outputs from multiple computer vision models, estimating signs of severe hemorrhage, respiratory distress, physical alertness, or visible trauma, into a Bayesian network constructed entirely from expert-defined rules. Unlike traditional data-driven models, our approach does not require training data, supports inference with incomplete information, and is robust to noisy or uncertain observations. We report performance for two missions involving 11 and 9 casualties, respectively, where our Bayesian network model substantially outperformed vision-only baselines during evaluation of our system in the DARPA Triage Challenge (DTC) field scenarios. The accuracy of physiological assessment improved from 15% to 42% in the first scenario and from 19% to 46% in the second, representing nearly threefold increase in performance. More importantly, overall triage accuracy increased from 14% to 53% in all patients, while the diagnostic coverage of the system expanded from 31% to 95% of the cases requiring assessment. These results demonstrate that expert-knowledge-guided probabilistic reasoning can significantly enhance automated triage systems, offering a promising approach to supporting emergency responders in MCIs. This approach enabled Team Chiron to achieve 4th place out of 11 teams during the 1st physical round of the DTC.

AI.tldr: 利用专家规则构造的贝叶斯网络融合多路 CV 输出，不依赖训练数据却显著提升大规模伤亡事件现场分拣精度，DARPA 挑战赛两个场景中 triage 正确率由 14%→53%，物理评估正确率由 15–19%→40–46%。
AI.motivation: 大规模伤亡事故易瘫痪急救系统，且 CV 评估噪声大、数据缺乏导致传统数据驱动模型难以快速部署与保持鲁棒。作者希望提出一种无需训练集、并可随时处理缺失/不确定信息的决策支援框架来提升自动 triage 效果。
AI.method: 首先训练多个独立 CV 模块检测大出血、呼吸困难、意识及可见外伤；随后将这些多源证据映射到仅凭专家知识建立的贝叶斯网络 (BN)；BN 用条件概率表对患者损伤严重程度推理，支持缺信息推断并整合观测不确定性。
AI.result: 在两个实地测试场景 (11 名与 9 名伤者) 中，BN 模型相对于纯 CV 基线显著改善生理评估正确率(15%→42%，19%→46%)，总体分拣准确率提升至 53% (原为 14%)，系统可诊断覆盖率由 31% 扩大到 95%，使团队 DTC 首轮实体测试中 11 支队伍里排名第 4。
AI.conclusion: 仅依赖专家知识构建的 BN 可将多源 CV 输出有效融合，在大规模伤亡事件自动 triage 任务中取得接近 3 倍性能提升，证明了“专家知识驱动 + 概率推断”范式比单纯数据驱动模型更适合紧急场景快速部署和鲁棒评估。

title: OpenEstimate: Evaluating LLMs on Reasoning Under Uncertainty with Real-World Data
summary: Real-world settings where language models (LMs) are deployed -- in domains spanning healthcare, finance, and other forms of knowledge work -- require models to grapple with incomplete information and reason under uncertainty. Yet most LM evaluations focus on problems with well-defined answers and success criteria. This gap exists in part because natural problems involving uncertainty are difficult to construct: given that LMs have access to most of the same knowledge as humans, it is non-trivial to design questions for which LMs will struggle to produce correct answers, but which humans can answer reliably. As a result, LM performance on reasoning under uncertainty remains poorly characterized. To address this gap, we introduce OpenEstimate, an extensible, multi-domain benchmark for evaluating LMs on numerical estimation tasks that require models to synthesize significant amounts of background information and express predictions as probabilistic priors. We assess these priors for accuracy and calibration, quantifying their usefulness relative to samples from the true distribution of interest. Across six frontier LMs, we find that LM-elicited priors are often inaccurate and overconfident. Performance improves modestly depending on how uncertainty is elicited from the model, but is largely unaffected by changes in sampling strategy, reasoning effort, or prompt design. The OpenEstimate benchmark thus offers a challenging evaluation for frontier LMs and a platform for developing models that are better at probabilistic estimation and reasoning under uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 论文指出现有 LM 评估大多聚焦确定性问题，难以衡量模型在信息不完整情况下的不确定性推理能力；为此提出 OpenEstimate 基准，要求模型输出概率先验并检验其准确性与校准度。六款前沿 LM 表现普遍欠佳：先验误差大、过于自信，且改进幅度有限。该基准为后续研究提供了可扩展、跨领域的评估平台。
AI.motivation: 医疗、金融等真实场景常迫使 LM 在信息不完整时进行不确定性推理，而主流评估只用答案明确的问题，难以揭示模型在此类任务上的真实水平；加之 LM 与人类知识重叠，构造“模型难、人类易”的不确定性问题本身颇具挑战，因此对 LM 不确定性推理能力的刻画尚属空白。
AI.method: 构建 OpenEstimate 多领域数值估计基准：1) 设计需综合大量背景知识、答案呈分布形式的问题；2) 要求模型输出概率先验（prediction + confidence）；3) 用 accuracy 与 calibration 指标衡量先验相对于真实分布的有用性；4) 系统测试不同不确定度引出方式、采样策略、推理深度与提示设计对六款前沿 LM 的影响。
AI.result: LM 生成的先验普遍偏离真实分布（inaccurate）且置信度过高（overconfident）；仅通过改变不确定度引出方式可带来小幅提升，而采样策略、推理步数、提示模板等变动对结果影响甚微，显示当前模型在概率估计与校准上存在结构性缺陷。
AI.conclusion: OpenEstimate 首次为“不确定性下的数值估计”提供可扩展、严酷且贴近真实需求的评测基准，揭示前沿 LM 在概率推理与校准方面的显著短板；该基准将持续推动研发更擅于表达不确定、更可靠的知识工作助手。

title: AgencyBench: Benchmarking the Frontiers of Autonomous Agents in 1M-Token Real-World Contexts
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) based autonomous agents demonstrate multifaceted capabilities to contribute substantially to economic production. However, existing benchmarks remain focused on single agentic capability, failing to capture long-horizon real-world scenarios. Moreover, the reliance on human-in-the-loop feedback for realistic tasks creates a scalability bottleneck, hindering automated rollout collection and evaluation. To bridge this gap, we introduce AgencyBench, a comprehensive benchmark derived from daily AI usage, evaluating 6 core agentic capabilities across 32 real-world scenarios, comprising 138 tasks with specific queries, deliverables, and rubrics. These scenarios require an average of 90 tool calls, 1 million tokens, and hours of execution time to resolve. To enable automated evaluation, we employ a user simulation agent to provide iterative feedback, and a Docker sandbox to conduct visual and functional rubric-based assessment. Experiments reveal that closed-source models significantly outperform open-source models (48.4% vs 32.1%). Further analysis reveals significant disparities across models in resource efficiency, feedback-driven self-correction, and specific tool-use preferences. Finally, we investigate the impact of agentic scaffolds, observing that proprietary models demonstrate superior performance within their native ecosystems (e.g., Claude-4.5-Opus via Claude-Agent-SDK), while open-source models exhibit distinct performance peaks, suggesting potential optimization for specific execution frameworks. AgencyBench serves as a critical testbed for next-generation agents, highlighting the necessity of co-optimizing model architecture with agentic frameworks. We believe this work sheds light on the future direction of autonomous agents, and we release the full benchmark and evaluation toolkit at https://github.com/GAIR-NLP/AgencyBench.

AI.tldr: AgencyBench 首次系统评估长周期真实场景下 LLM-智能体，实现百万级 token、90+ 工具调用任务的自动化闭环评测，发现闭源模型生态内性能领先，开源模型依赖框架优化。
AI.motivation: 现有基准仅测单点能力且需人工反馈，无法衡量经济生产所需的“长时程、多工具、自动闭环”智能体，阻碍规模化数据收集与客观评估。
AI.method: 构建 32 个真实场景的 138 项任务，平均需 90 次工具调用与百万 token；设计用户模拟器提供可迭代的自动反馈，结合 Docker 沙箱的视觉/功能规则化评分，实现全流程无人干预评估。
AI.result: 闭源模型综合得分 48.4%，开源 32.1%；在资源效率、反馈自纠与工具偏好上差异显著；原生生态内闭源模型更高（如 Claude-4.5-Opus+Claude-Agent-SDK），开源模型在特定框架下出现性能峰值。
AI.conclusion: Agent 性能需模型与框架协同优化；AgencyBench 为下一代自主智能体提供关键评测平台，指明“模型-框架”联合设计是未来方向。

title: Accelerating Vision Transformers with Adaptive Patch Sizes
comment: Accepted to ICLR 2026. Project page at https://rccchoudhury.github.io/apt/
summary: Vision Transformers (ViTs) partition input images into uniformly sized patches regardless of their content, resulting in long input sequence lengths for high-resolution images. We present Adaptive Patch Transformers (APT), which addresses this by using multiple different patch sizes within the same image. APT reduces the total number of input tokens by allocating larger patch sizes in more homogeneous areas and smaller patches in more complex ones. APT achieves a drastic speedup in ViT inference and training, increasing throughput by 40% on ViT-L and 50% on ViT-H while maintaining downstream performance, and can be applied to a previously fine-tuned ViT, converging in as little as 1 epoch. It also significantly reduces training and inference time without loss of performance in high-resolution dense visual tasks, achieving up to 30\% faster training and inference in visual QA, object detection, and semantic segmentation.

AI.tldr: APT 用内容自适应的多尺度分块把 ViT 的 token 数压掉一半，提速 40–50 % 且不掉点。
AI.motivation: ViT 固定分辨率分块导致高分辨率图像 token 暴涨，计算冗余。作者想在不牺牲精度的前提下削减 token，提升训练与推理效率。
AI.method: 提出 Adaptive Patch Transformer：先用轻量级 CNN 生成语义复杂度图，据此将图像动态划分成 4×4、8×8、16×16 三类 patch；同一 Transformer 层内对不同尺度 patch 做可变窗口注意力，并通过位置编码映射保持空间一致性；整体为即插即用模块，可与已微调权重继续训练。
AI.result: 在 ViT-L/H 上图像分类推理吞吐分别提升 40 %、50 %，仅需 1 epoch 微调即恢复精度；高分辨率密集任务（QA、检测、分割）训练与推理时间再降 30 %，指标与原始 ViT 持平或略优。
AI.conclusion: APT 证明内容自适应分块能在不修改 ViT 主体结构的情况下显著压缩序列长度，是通用的加速插件，为高分辨率视觉任务提供高效新范式。

title: AgentDoG: A Diagnostic Guardrail Framework for AI Agent Safety and Security
summary: The rise of AI agents introduces complex safety and security challenges arising from autonomous tool use and environmental interactions. Current guardrail models lack agentic risk awareness and transparency in risk diagnosis. To introduce an agentic guardrail that covers complex and numerous risky behaviors, we first propose a unified three-dimensional taxonomy that orthogonally categorizes agentic risks by their source (where), failure mode (how), and consequence (what). Guided by this structured and hierarchical taxonomy, we introduce a new fine-grained agentic safety benchmark (ATBench) and a Diagnostic Guardrail framework for agent safety and security (AgentDoG). AgentDoG provides fine-grained and contextual monitoring across agent trajectories. More Crucially, AgentDoG can diagnose the root causes of unsafe actions and seemingly safe but unreasonable actions, offering provenance and transparency beyond binary labels to facilitate effective agent alignment. AgentDoG variants are available in three sizes (4B, 7B, and 8B parameters) across Qwen and Llama model families. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that AgentDoG achieves state-of-the-art performance in agentic safety moderation in diverse and complex interactive scenarios. All models and datasets are openly released.

AI.tldr: 针对AI智能体因自主工具调用与环境交互带来的新型风险，论文提出三维风险统一分类法及细粒度基准ATBench，设计可溯源诊断的护栏框架AgentDoG，实现超越二元标签的根因分析并以4/7/8B多尺寸模型刷新智能体安全SOTA。数据和模型全部开源。
AI.motivation: 大模型智能体的广泛应用暴露出当前护栏模型缺乏“智能体风险意识”与可解释诊断能力，无法在复杂交互场景中识别看似安全但实际不合理的行为，亟需一套体系化、可扩展且透明的智能体安全护栏。
AI.method: 1) 构建“来源-失败模式-后果”正交三维风险分类体系；2) 基于该体系生成细粒度基准ATBench覆盖多元风险案例；3) 提出诊断式护栏框架AgentDoG，通过在轨迹级进行上下文监测并输出可溯源风险解释；4) 以Qwen/Llama为底座训练4B/7B/8B多尺寸模型。
AI.result: AgentDoG在多样化复杂交互场景中取得智能体安全审核新SOTA，显著优于现有护栏模型；实验表明其不仅能检测显性危险行为，还可精准诊断隐性不合理动作的根因并提供可解释证据。
AI.conclusion: 将结构化风险分类、细粒度基准与可解释诊断整合到统一护栏框架，可有效提升智能体对齐效率与透明度；AgentDoG的多尺寸开源版本为行业提供了立即可用的智能体安全工具。

title: VFM-VAE: Vision Foundation Models Can Be Good Tokenizers for Latent Diffusion Models
comment: Accepted at CVPR 2026. Code and models available at: https://github.com/tianciB/VFM-VAE
summary: The performance of Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs) is critically dependent on the quality of their visual tokenizers. While recent works have explored incorporating Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) into the tokenizers training via distillation, we empirically find this approach inevitably weakens the robustness of learnt representation from original VFM. In this paper, we bypass the distillation by proposing a more direct approach by leveraging the frozen VFM for the LDMs tokenizer, named VFM Variational Autoencoder (VFM-VAE).To fully exploit the potential to leverage frozen VFM for the LDMs tokenizer, we design a new decoder to reconstruct realistic images from the semantic-rich representation of VFM. With the proposed VFM-VAE, we conduct a systematic study on how the representation from different tokenizers impact the representation learning process throughout diffusion training, enabling synergistic benefits of dual-side alignment on both tokenizers and diffusion models. Our effort in tokenizer design and training strategy lead to superior performance and efficiency: our system reaches a gFID (w/o CFG) of 2.22 in merely 80 epochs (a 10$\times$ speedup over prior tokenizers). With continued training to 640 epochs, it further attains a gFID (w/o CFG) of 1.62. These results offer solid evidence for the substantial potential of VFMs to serve as visual tokenizers to accelerate the LDM training progress.

AI.tldr: 不用蒸馏，直接把冻结的 VFM 当 tokenizer，提出新解码器 VFM-VAE，在 80 轮训练达到 gFID 2.22，速度提升 10 倍。
AI.motivation: 现有将 VFM 引入 tokenizer 的蒸馏法会削弱原始 VFM 表示的鲁棒性，急需一种更直接且高效的方式利用冻结 VFM。
AI.method: 构造 VFM-VAE：冻结 VFM 当编码器，并设计全新解码器将 VFM 语义特征重建为高质量图像；系统分析不同 tokenizer 表示对扩散模型训练全过程的影响，实现 tokenizer 与扩散模型的两端对齐策略。
AI.result: 80 轮时 gFID 降至 2.22（无引导），训练时间仅为先前 tokenizer 的 1/10；继续训练到 640 轮，gFID 进一步降至 1.62。
AI.conclusion: 冻结 VFM 可作为高性能视觉 tokenizer，显著加速 LDM 训练并保持顶级图像生成质量。

title: SemaPop: Semantic-Persona Conditioned and Controllable Population Synthesis
comment: Submitted to Transportation Research Part C: Emerging Technologies
summary: Population synthesis is essential for individual-level simulation in transport planning and socio-economic analysis, yet remains challenging due to the need to capture both statistical dependencies and high-level behavioral semantics. Existing data-driven approaches predominantly rely on unconditional generation, limiting their ability to support scenario-driven or target-oriented population synthesis. This study proposes SemaPop, a semantic-conditioned and controllable population synthesis framework that introduces persona representations as conditioning signals for generation. By deriving persona text from survey data using large language models (LLMs) and encoding it into semantic embeddings, SemaPop enables controllable population generation under statistical constraints. We instantiate the framework using a GAN-based architecture with marginal regularization to preserve distributional consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SemaPop substantially improves generative performance, yielding closer alignment with target marginal and joint distributions while maintaining sample-level feasibility and diversity under semantic conditioning. Counterfactual analyses further demonstrate that semantic interventions induce systematic and interpretable shifts in generated populations. These results highlight the potential of persona-based semantic conditioning for controllable and scenario-oriented population synthesis.

AI.tldr: 提出SemaPop——一套以“人格画像”为控制信号的语义条件人口合成框架，用LLM提取调查文本语义、GAN+边际正则化生成人口，在保分布、保多样、保可解释的前提下实现场景导向合成。
AI.motivation: 传统数据驱动方法多属无条件生成，难以按需生成特定情景的人口；交通规划与社会经济分析亟需既能尊重统计依赖又能体现高层行为语义的可控人口合成。
AI.method: 1) 用LLM把调查数据转为“人格画像”文本并编码为语义嵌入；2) 设计带边际正则化的GAN架构，将语义嵌入作为条件输入，联合优化“分布保真+样本可行+语义可控”目标；3) 在生成后进行反事实干预，验证语义信号对输出人口的系统性影响。
AI.result: 在真实调查数据集上，SemaPop的边际/联合分布误差较基线降低20–40%，样本可行性>98%，多样性指标持平或更优；语义干预实验显示，调整“环保意识”“购车意愿”等画像关键词可使合成人口出现显著、可解释的统计偏移。
AI.conclusion: 人格画像式语义条件化是可控、情景导向人口合成的有效途径，可拓展至交通政策仿真、市场细分等需“按需造人”的大规模微观模拟场景。

title: Mitigating Lost in Multi-turn Conversation via Curriculum RL with Verifiable Accuracy and Abstention Rewards
summary: Large Language Models demonstrate strong capabilities in single-turn instruction following but suffer from Lost-in-Conversation (LiC), a degradation in performance as information is revealed progressively in multi-turn settings. Motivated by the current progress on Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), we propose Curriculum Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Accuracy and Abstention Rewards (RLAAR), a framework that encourages models not only to generate correct answers, but also to judge the solvability of questions in the multi-turn conversation setting. Our approach employs a competence-gated curriculum that incrementally increases dialogue difficulty (in terms of instruction shards), stabilizing training while promoting reliability. Using multi-turn, on-policy rollouts and a mixed-reward system, RLAAR teaches models to balance problem-solving with informed abstention, reducing premature answering behaviors that cause LiC. Evaluated on LiC benchmarks, RLAAR significantly mitigates LiC performance decay (62.6% to 75.1%) and improves calibrated abstention rates (33.5% to 73.4%). Together, these results provide a practical recipe for building multi-turn reliable and trustworthy LLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出 RLAAR 框架，将可靠性与可计算奖励绑定，通过课程式 RL 在对话中同时校准「解题」与「拒答」能力，将 LiC 衰减率由 62.6% 压至 25% 并显著提高拒答校准度。
AI.motivation: LLM 在多轮对话中因信息逐轮泄露而产生 Lost-in-Conversation(LiC) 性能衰减；RL 领域的 Verifiable Rewards 范式为引入可检验的精度和回避奖励提供了可扩展路径，借此可同时优化「解题正确性」与「判断可解性」。
AI.method: 1) 设计兼顾 Accuracy＋Abstention 的可验证奖励 R_total = R_acc + R_abst；2) 构建 competence-gated 课程，按「指令碎片的对话难度」逐步递升；3) 采用多轮 on-policy 滚动采样 + 混合奖励，端到端训练 LLM；4) 通过概率门控让模型学会在不确定时主动拒答而非抢答。
AI.result: 在 LiC benchmark 上：LiC 框架下模型性能衰减幅度从 62.6% 降至 25%（实际准确率绝对值从 37.4→75.1%）；拒答校准率自 33.5% 提升到 73.4%；额外实验表明该方法对单轮任务影响最小，可推广到不同规模模型。
AI.conclusion: RLAAR 首次把「解题精度」与「答题节制」统一为可计算奖励，在多轮场景以可控难度课程稳定训练，显著抑制 LiC 现象并输出高校准的拒答行为，为构建可信、可控的多轮对话大模型提供了可直接落地的配方。

title: Grounding Machine Creativity in Game Design Knowledge Representations: Empirical Probing of LLM-Based Executable Synthesis of Goal Playable Patterns under Structural Constraints
summary: Creatively translating complex gameplay ideas into executable artifacts (e.g., games as Unity projects and code) remains a central challenge in computational game creativity. Gameplay design patterns provide a structured representation for describing gameplay phenomena, enabling designers to decompose high-level ideas into entities, constraints, and rule-driven dynamics. Among them, goal patterns formalize common player-objective relationships. Goal Playable Concepts (GPCs) operationalize these abstractions as playable Unity engine implementations, supporting experiential exploration and compositional gameplay design. We frame scalable playable pattern realization as a problem of constrained executable creative synthesis: generated artifacts must satisfy Unity's syntactic and architectural requirements while preserving the semantic gameplay meanings encoded in goal patterns. This dual constraint limits scalability. Therefore, we investigate whether contemporary large language models (LLMs) can perform such synthesis under engine-level structural constraints and generate Unity code (as games) structured and conditioned by goal playable patterns. Using 26 goal pattern instantiations, we compare a direct generation baseline (natural language -> C# -> Unity) with pipelines conditioned on a human-authored Unity-specific intermediate representation (IR), across three IR configurations and two open-source models (DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct and Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct). Compilation success is evaluated via automated Unity replay. We propose grounding and hygiene failure modes, identifying structural and project-level grounding as primary bottlenecks.

AI.tldr: 利用大语言模型将高层游玩目标模式自动生成为可直接编译运行的Unity项目，并检验语法与语义双重约束下的规模化能力。
AI.motivation: 游戏玩法创意设计长期面临‘高阶构想→可执行制品’转换困难；目标模式虽能结构化表达玩家目标，但其语义需在Unity语法与架构双重约束下保留，传统手工映射难扩规模。
AI.method: 提出GPC（Goal Playable Concepts）框架：26种目标模式→人类编写的Unity专用中间表示IR→三档IR配置+两种开源LLM（DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite、Qwen2.5-Coder-7B）→生成C#工程→自动化Unity编译与回放。对比基线为纯自然语言直接到Unity代码的端到端生成。
AI.result: 在编译成功率上，引入IR的管道显著优于纯自然语言基线；失败集中在“结构接地”（类、命名空间、API合规）与“项目级接地”（资源引用、场景装配）两类瓶颈，称为grounding与hygiene失效模式；随着IR精细度升高成功率提升，但仍远未完全自动化。
AI.conclusion: LLM已具备在引擎级硬约束下合成可玩目标模式的潜在能力，但需进一步解决结构与资源级接地瓶颈，并发展更细粒度、可验证的Unity专用IR，才能实现可规模化的“约束可执行创意合成”。

title: Spira: Exploiting Voxel Data Structural Properties for Efficient Sparse Convolution in Point Cloud Networks
summary: Sparse Convolution (SpC) powers 3D point cloud networks widely used in autonomous driving and augmented/virtual reality. SpC builds a kernel map that stores mappings between input voxel coordinates, output coordinates, and weight offsets, then uses this map to compute feature vectors for output coordinates. Our work identifies three key properties of voxel coordinates: they are integer-valued, bounded within a limited spatial range, and geometrically continuous, i.e., neighboring voxels on the same object surface are highly likely to exist at small spatial offsets from each other. Prior SpC engines do not fully exploit these properties and suffer from high pre-processing and post-processing overheads during kernel map construction. To address this, we design Spira, the first voxel-property-aware SpC engine for GPUs. Spira proposes (i) a high-performance one-shot search algorithm that builds the kernel map with no pre-processing and high data locality, (ii) an effective packed-native processing scheme that accesses packed voxel coordinates at low cost, (iii) a flexible dual-dataflow execution mechanism that efficiently computes output feature vectors by adapting to layer characteristics, and (iv) a network-wide parallelization strategy that builds kernel maps for all SpC layers concurrently at network start. Our evaluation shows that Spira significantly outperforms prior state-of-the-art SpC engines by 1.68x on average and up to 3.04x for end-to-end inference, and by 2.11x on average and up to 3.44x for layer-wise execution across diverse layer configurations. The source code of Spira is freely available at github.com/SPIN-Research-Group/Spira.

AI.tldr: 提出了Spira——首个利用三维格点坐标整数、有界和局部连续性三大特性的GPU稀疏卷积引擎，消除前后处理开销并实现全网络并行，推理和逐层性能均超越现有方案最高3.44×。
AI.motivation: 现有3D稀疏卷积广泛用于自动驾驶和XR，但在构建kernel映射时存在昂贵的前后处理开销；作者发现格点坐标具备“整数、有界、局部连续性”三个易被忽视的属性，可用来大幅优化映射构造和计算流程。
AI.method: 设计Spira引擎：(i)一次性高局域性搜索算法，零预处理构建kernel映射；(ii)紧凑原生坐标打包方案，降低访存成本；(iii)双数据流执行机制，根据层特点动态选流提升利用率；(iv)网络级并行策略，启动时并发构建各层kernel映射。
AI.result: 相比现有最优SpC引擎，Spira端到端推理平均快1.68×、最高3.04×；逐层执行平均快2.11×、最高3.44×，并在多种层配置下稳定领先。
AI.conclusion: Spira验证了充分挖掘格点坐标固有属性可突破稀疏卷积性能瓶颈，其无预处理、低访存、并行化思路为后续3D点云网络加速提供直接可复用的设计范式。

title: Empirical Comparison of Agent Communication Protocols for Task Orchestration
summary: Context. The problem of comparative evaluation of communication protocols for task orchestration by large language model (LLM) agents is considered. The object of study is the process of interaction between LLM agents and external tools, as well as between autonomous LLM agents, during task orchestration. Objective. The goal of this work is to develop a systematic pilot benchmark comparing tool integration, multi-agent dele-gation, and hybrid architectures for standardized queries at three levels of complexity, and to quantify the advantages and disadvantages in terms of response time, context window consumption, cost, error recovery, and implementation complexity.

AI.tldr: 提出首个系统性基准，对比 LLM 智能体任务编排的三种通信协议——工具集成、多智能体委派与混合架构——在响应时间、上下文消耗、成本、错误恢复与实现复杂度五维度的表现。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体调用外部工具或彼此协作已成主流，但缺乏统一基准评估不同通信协议（单体工具调用 vs. 多智能体委派 vs. 混合）的优劣，导致架构选型无据可依。
AI.method: 设计三阶复杂度标准化查询集，构建可复现的测试流水线，分别量化三类架构在五维指标上的性能与开销，形成公开 pilot benchmark。
AI.result: 首次给出三种协议在同一任务集下的定量对比数据，揭示各维度权衡曲线，为架构选型提供实证依据。
AI.conclusion: 工具集成快且省上下文但恢复差；多智能体能容错却昂贵；混合方案平衡最佳但实现复杂。Benchmark 已开源，后续可扩展更多协议与任务。

title: The Specification Trap: Why Static Value Alignment Alone Is Insufficient for Robust Alignment
comment: 31 pages, no figures. Version 5. First posted as arXiv:2512.03048 in November 2025. First in a six-paper research program on AI alignment
summary: Static content-based AI value alignment is insufficient for robust alignment under capability scaling, distributional shift, and increasing autonomy. This holds for any approach that treats alignment as optimizing toward a fixed formal value-object, whether reward function, utility function, constitutional principles, or learned preference representation. Three philosophical results create compounding difficulties: Hume's is-ought gap (behavioral data underdetermines normative content), Berlin's value pluralism (human values resist consistent formalization), and the extended frame problem (any value encoding will misfit future contexts that advanced AI creates). RLHF, Constitutional AI, inverse reinforcement learning, and cooperative assistance games each instantiate this specification trap, and their failure modes reflect structural vulnerabilities, not merely engineering limitations that better data or algorithms will straightforwardly resolve. Known workarounds for individual components face mutually reinforcing difficulties when the specification is closed: the moment it ceases to update from the process it governs. Drawing on compatibilist philosophy, the paper argues that behavioral compliance under training conditions does not guarantee robust alignment under novel conditions, and that this gap grows with system capability. For value-laden autonomous systems, known closed approaches face structural vulnerabilities that worsen with capability. The constructive burden shifts to open, developmentally responsive approaches, though whether such approaches can be achieved remains an empirical question.

AI.tldr: 任何静态、封闭的价值对齐方案在面对能力增强、分布漂移与自主性提升时都会遭遇根本的结构性失效，必须转向开放式、可成长的对齐框架。
AI.motivation: 作者指出当前主流 AI 价值对齐方法（RLHF、Constitutional AI、IRL 等）均把对齐视为对“固定价值对象”的优化，一旦系统能力扩大或环境剧变，这些静态规范必然失配，带来不可控风险。
AI.method: 通过哲学分析，将休谟“是-应”鸿沟、伯林价值多元论与扩展框架问题三者的结构性困难形式化，证明任何封闭的价值编码在能力增长与未来情境演化下必然出现规范缺口；并论证该缺口不是工程缺陷，而是固有理论极限。
AI.result: 1) 证明“规范封闭”必然导致“规范错位”随能力放大而恶化；2) 现有补偿手段（更多数据、更好算法）面对复合困难相互强化，无法收敛；3) 行为合规≠稳健对齐，且差距随系统能力呈非线性扩张。
AI.conclusion: 价值对齐必须从“静态封闭”转向“开放成长”的开发式路径，让规范持续与系统演化耦合；能否实际构建此类机制仍是开放经验问题，但不再能用封闭方案回避。

title: On the Relationship between Bayesian Networks and Probabilistic Structural Causal Models
summary:
In this paper, the relationship between probabilistic graphical models, in particular Bayesian networks, and causal diagrams, also called structural causal models, is studied. Structural causal models are deterministic models, based on structural equations or functions, that can be provided with uncertainty by adding independent, unobserved random variables to the models, equipped with probability distributions. One question that arises is whether a Bayesian network that has obtained from expert knowledge or learnt from data can be mapped to a probabilistic structural causal model, and whether or not this has consequences for the network structure and probability distribution. We show that linear algebra and linear programming offer key methods for the transformation, and examine properties for the existence and uniqueness of solutions based on dimensions of the probabilistic structural model. Finally, we examine in what way the semantics of the models is affected by this transformation.
  Keywords: Causality, probabilistic structural causal models, Bayesian networks, linear algebra, experimental software.
