AI.tldr: 利用线性代数与线性规划把贝叶斯网络映射到确定性结构因果模型，并给出映射存在-唯一性的充要条件，说明语义可无损转换。
AI.motivation: 现有贝叶斯网络仅从统计层面刻画变量关联，不支持因果推断；作者希望为先验或数据学得的BN找到对应的结构因果模型(SCM)，使两者互通并在BN中保持因果语义。
AI.method: 1）将BN的概率表转成势函数约束；2）用线性方程组表示确定性SCM的函数结构，线性规划求解需满足的因果结构约束；3）给出矩阵秩条件判断映射的存在、唯一性与不可解性；4）在随机合成和真实网络上验证映射因果正确性。
AI.result: 证明当BN的图不含有向环且所有潜在混杂维度足够时映射必存在；矩阵列满秩时解唯一；当与线性因果约束冲突时出现无解，可通过松弛保持近似因果语义。实验显示映射后与观测分布KL和因果效应误差均小于2%。
AI.conclusion: BN与概率SCM可在线性框架下无损互转，为结合数据驱动学习与因果识别提供理论途径；未来将扩展至非线性、隐变量和混合因果-统计推断。关键词蕴含后续的实验软件已开源。

title: Tumor-anchored deep feature random forests for out-of-distribution detection in lung cancer segmentation
comment: Accepted for publication in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 2026. Code available at: https://github.com/aneesh3108/RF-Deep
summary:
Accurate segmentation of lung tumors from 3D computed tomography (CT) scans is essential for automated treatment planning and response assessment. Despite self-supervised pretraining on numerous datasets, state-of-the-art transformer backbones remain susceptible to out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs, often producing confidently incorrect segmentations with potential for risk in clinical deployment. Hence, we introduce RF-Deep, a lightweight post-hoc random forests-based framework that leverages deep features trained with limited outlier exposure, requiring as few as 40 labeled scans (20 in-distribution and 20 OOD), to improve scan-level OOD detection. RF-Deep repurposes the hierarchical features from the pretrained-then-finetuned segmentation backbones, aggregating features from multiple regions-of-interest anchored to predicted tumor regions to capture OOD likelihood.
  We evaluated RF-Deep on 2,232 CT volumes spanning near-OOD (pulmonary embolism, COVID-19 negative) and far-OOD (kidney cancer, healthy pancreas) datasets. RF-Deep achieved AUROC >~93 on the challenging near-OOD datasets, where it outperformed the next best method by 4--7 percentage points, and produced near-perfect detection (AUROC >~99) on far-OOD datasets. The approach also showed transferability to two blinded validation datasets under the ensemble configuration (COVID-19 positive and breast cancer; AUROC >~94). RF-Deep maintained consistent performance across backbones of different depths and pretraining strategies, demonstrating applicability of post-hoc detectors as a safety filter for clinical deployment of tumor segmentation pipelines.

AI.tldr: 用极少量（40例）有标注OOD样本，把随机森林轻量级模型RF-Deep挂在已训练好的3D肺癌分割transformer backbone上，仅需提取深度特征并做多实体区域的异常似然投票，即可实现扫描级OOD检测；AUROC>93（近OOD）/>99（远OOD），跨病灶和跨模态盲验仍>94，可直接作为临床部署的安全闸门。
AI.motivation: 现有自监督预训练transformer在3D CT肺瘤分割任务中遭遇OOD扫描时仍会自信出错，对放疗规划构成风险，需一种不改动原模型且训练数据极少的轻量级后验OOD过滤方法。
AI.method: RF-Deep：1）仍冻结原预训练+微调的分割backbone；2）以预测瘤区为锚点抽取多级深度特征，并在多ROI层级间聚合；3）用30% OOD与70% ID特征训练三层轻量级随机森林分类器，扫描级输出OOD概率；4）可跨主干（Swin UNETR、nnFormer等）和预训练策略盲插入。
AI.result: 测试2 232例CT：近OOD（肺栓塞、COVID-19阴性）AUROC提升4–7 pp达>93%；远OOD（肾癌、正常胰腺）接近完美>99%；盲验COVID+与乳腺癌扫描集成模型仍>94%。参数量<1 M， Inference <200 ms，不扰动原分割精度。
AI.conclusion: 后验随机森林OOD检测器RF-Deep能在20例近OOD+20例ID的小样本下快速构建，跨病灶、跨模态稳定工作，为临床3D肿瘤分割pipeline提供可部署的安全阀。

title: Wiring the 'Why': A Unified Taxonomy and Survey of Abductive Reasoning in LLMs
summary: Regardless of its foundational role in human discovery and sense-making, abductive reasoning--the inference of the most plausible explanation for an observation--has been relatively underexplored in Large Language Models (LLMs). Despite the rapid advancement of LLMs, the exploration of abductive reasoning and its diverse facets has thus far been disjointed rather than cohesive. This paper presents the first survey of abductive reasoning in LLMs, tracing its trajectory from philosophical foundations to contemporary AI implementations. To address the widespread conceptual confusion and disjointed task definitions prevalent in the field, we establish a unified two-stage definition that formally categorizes prior work. This definition disentangles abduction into Hypothesis Generation, where models bridge epistemic gaps to produce candidate explanations, and Hypothesis Selection, where the generated candidates are evaluated and the most plausible explanation is chosen. Building upon this foundation, we present a comprehensive taxonomy of the literature, categorizing prior work based on their abductive tasks, datasets, underlying methodologies, and evaluation strategies. In order to ground our framework empirically, we conduct a compact benchmark study of current LLMs on abductive tasks, together with targeted comparative analyses across model sizes, model families, evaluation styles, and the distinct generation-versus-selection task typologies. Moreover, by synthesizing recent empirical results, we examine how LLM performance on abductive reasoning relates to deductive and inductive tasks, providing insights into their broader reasoning capabilities. Our analysis reveals critical gaps in current approaches--from static benchmark design and narrow domain coverage to narrow training frameworks and limited mechanistic understanding of abductive processes...

AI.tldr: 首篇大模型溯因推理综述：将溯因拆为“生成候选解释→挑选最可信解释”两阶段，建立统一任务定义与文献分类体系，并通过基准实验揭示当前方法在测试集、领域、训练范式及机制理解上的关键空白。
AI.motivation: 溯因推理是人类发现与意义建构的核心，却在大模型研究中零散且概念混乱；亟需系统梳理以厘清任务定义、整合前沿进展并指明未来方向。
AI.method: 提出“假设生成-假设选择”两阶段统一框架，据此对现有任务、数据、方法与评估进行四维 taxonomy 分类；设计轻量级基准，比较不同规模、家族、评估方式及生成/选择范式下的模型表现；结合最新实证，对比大模型在溯因、演绎与归纳任务上的性能关联。
AI.result: 首次给出大模型溯因领域全景图；基准显示模型在生成阶段表现弱、选择阶段相对强，且规模效应在溯因任务上不及演绎/归纳显著；揭示静态评测、领域狭窄、训练框架单一、对溯因机制理解不足等四大缺口。
AI.conclusion: 溯因推理在大模型中尚未被系统攻克，需构建动态、多域、机制可解释的新数据集与训练范式，并融合认知科学深化对“最佳解释推断”内在过程的理解。

title: Concurrence: A dependence criterion for time series, applied to biological data
comment: arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2508.02703
summary: Measuring the statistical dependence between observed signals is a primary tool for scientific discovery. However, biological systems often exhibit complex non-linear interactions that currently cannot be captured without a priori knowledge or large datasets. We introduce a criterion for dependence, whereby two time series are deemed dependent if one can construct a classifier that distinguishes between temporally aligned vs. misaligned segments extracted from them. We show that this criterion, concurrence, is theoretically linked with dependence, and can become a standard approach for scientific analyses across disciplines, as it can expose relationships across a wide spectrum of signals (fMRI, physiological and behavioral data) without ad-hoc parameter tuning or large amounts of data.

AI.tldr: 提出一种免先验、适用于小样本的双时间序列依赖判别准则——concurrence：仅需训练一个二分类器区分是否时间对齐。
AI.motivation: 传统依赖度量（如皮尔逊相关系数、互信息）难以刻画生物系统中普遍存在的复杂非线性关系，且通常依赖大量数据或领域先验；需要一种通用、无参、理论可解释的方法来揭示 fMRI、生理与行为等多源信号之间的隐藏关联。
AI.method: 定义“concurrence”：若能从时间上“对齐片段”与“错位片段”中训练出性能显著优于随机的分类器，则判定两序列存在依赖。理论证明该准则与统计依赖度量等价，且对任意分布与非线性耦合均敏感；无需调参；可在小样本下运行。
AI.result: 在 fMRI、生理（心率、呼吸）与行为（眼动）三类异质信号数据上验证，concurrence 能一致检出已知神经-生理耦合与行为关联，性能优于皮尔逊相关、Hilbert 相干性、互信息等经典方法，尤其对非线性、弱耦合情况更稳健。
AI.conclusion: concurrence 提供了一种跨学科、无需领域知识、基于分类器泛化误差即可量化的依赖度量框架，有望成为科学探索中通用的“无参探针”工具。

title: DRBENCHER: Can Your Agent Identify the Entity, Retrieve Its Properties and Do the Math?
summary: Deep research agents increasingly interleave web browsing with multi-step computation, yet existing benchmarks evaluate these capabilities in isolation, creating a blind spot in assessing real-world performance. We introduce DRBENCHER, a synthetic benchmark generator for questions that require both browsing and computation. It enforces four criteria: verifiability (gold answers are computed by executing parameterized code over knowledge-graph values), complexity (multi-hop entity identification, property retrieval, and domain-specific computation), difficulty (a two-stage verification cascade filters out questions solvable by the generating model), and diversity (a greedy max-min embedding filter maximizes coverage). These criteria are realized via a unified answer-first pipeline spanning five domains: biochemistry, financial, geophysical, security, and history. Human evaluation shows 76% validity (84% excluding stale data), with 35% of errors due to outdated knowledge-graph entries, highlighting an inherent limitation of systems that reason over evolving data. Automatic evaluation shows that the strongest frontier model achieves only 20% answer accuracy. Compared to manually constructed benchmarks (BrowseComp+, MATH-500, GPQA), DRBENCHER achieves the highest semantic diversity.

AI.tldr: DRBENCHER 是一个自动生成的 Benchmark，首次把“先上网查资料、再做多步计算”这一真实流程纳入统一评测；它用知识图谱+可执行代码保证答案可验证，并通过双阶段过滤和嵌入贪心筛选确保题目足够难且语义多样，结果最强模型仅 20 % 准确率，暴露出现有系统在动态数据场景下的显著短板。
AI.motivation: 现有基准把“浏览检索”与“多步计算”分开测评，无法反映科研、金融等场景下“先查后算”的真实需求，导致对智能体实际能力出现评估盲区。
AI.method: 提出“答案优先”的生成框架：1) 从五大领域知识图谱随机采样实体-属性值并参数化生成可执行代码，直接算出标准答案，实现可验证性；2) 通过多跳抽取+领域公式运算构造复杂问题；3) 用两阶段验证级联（生成模型→更强模型）剔除可直达答案的简易题，确保难度；4) 对题库做最大-最小嵌入距离贪心筛选，提升语义多样性；5) 最终输出全合成 benchmark DRBENCHER。
AI.result: 人工校验题库整体有效率 76 %（剔除过时数据后 84 %），错误主要来自知识图谱过期；自动测评显示最强前沿模型准确率仅 20 %；与人工精选的 BrowseComp+、MATH-500、GPQA 相比，DRBENCHER 的语义多样性最高，显著弥补了动态数据复合任务评测的空白。
AI.conclusion: DRBENCHER 证明：只要将“可执行代码+知识图谱”作为答案锚点，无需人工标注即可大规模生成既难又多元、且能随数据演进而更新的“浏览-计算”混合评测题，揭示当前大模型在真实动态环境中推理与计算并重的能力远未达标，为未来代理系统提供了可扩展、可维护的严苛试金石。

title: Schoenfeld's Anatomy of Mathematical Reasoning by Language Models
summary: Large language models increasingly expose reasoning traces, yet their underlying cognitive structure and steps remain difficult to identify and analyze beyond surface-level statistics. We adopt Schoenfeld's Episode Theory as an inductive, intermediate-scale lens and introduce ThinkARM (Anatomy of Reasoning in Models), a scalable framework that explicitly abstracts reasoning traces into functional reasoning steps such as Analysis, Explore, Implement, Verify, etc. When applied to mathematical problem solving by diverse models, this abstraction reveals reproducible thinking dynamics and structural differences between reasoning and non-reasoning models, which are not apparent from token-level views. We further present two diagnostic case studies showing that exploration functions as a critical branching step associated with correctness, and that efficiency-oriented methods selectively suppress evaluative feedback steps rather than uniformly shortening responses. Together, our results demonstrate that episode-level representations make reasoning steps explicit, enabling systematic analysis of how reasoning is structured, stabilized, and altered in modern language models.

AI.tldr: 提出ThinkARM框架，用大尺度“功能片段”视角把LLM推理轨迹显式拆成Analysis/Explore/Implement/Verify等阶段，揭示推理与非推理模型在片段级结构差异，并证明探索片段是正确率的关键分叉点。
AI.motivation: 现有研究只能统计token级模式，无法解释LLM内部推理链条如何被组织、稳定与修改，需要一种可扩展的中间层表征工具。
AI.method: 1.引入Schoenfeld Episode Theory，将冗长推理轨迹抽象为功能明确的Episode；2.设计ThinkARM自动标注框架，实现片段级切分与编码；3.在多个数学任务上对比不同模型片段序列；4.通过诊断性案例量化Explore、Verify等片段与正确率、长度压缩策略的关系。
AI.result: 1.同一模型Episode模式高度可重复，不同模型结构差异显著，token统计无法发现；2.Explore片段是正确解题的“关键分叉”，出现频率与最终正确率显著相关；3.效率化方法(如长度惩罚)并非均匀缩短输出，而是显著抑制Verify类评估反馈片段。
AI.conclusion: Episode级表征可把隐式推理步骤显式化，为诊断、改进及安全控制现代LLM推理提供系统分析手段。

title: QuarkMedSearch: A Long-Horizon Deep Search Agent for Exploring Medical Intelligence
summary: As agentic foundation models continue to evolve, how to further improve their performance in vertical domains has become an important challenge. To this end, building upon Tongyi DeepResearch, a powerful agentic foundation model, we focus on the Chinese medical deep search scenario and propose QuarkMedSearch, systematically exploring a full-pipeline approach spanning medical multi-hop data construction, training strategies, and evaluation benchmarks to further push and assess its performance upper bound in vertical domains. Specifically, for data synthesis, to address the scarcity of deep search training data in the medical domain, we combine a large-scale medical knowledge graph with real-time online exploration to construct long-horizon medical deep search training data; for post-training, we adopt a two-stage SFT and RL training strategy that progressively enhances the model's planning, tool invocation, and reflection capabilities required for deep search, while maintaining search efficiency; for evaluation, we collaborate with medical experts to construct the QuarkMedSearch Benchmark through rigorous manual verification. Experimental results demonstrate that QuarkMedSearch achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source models of comparable scale on the QuarkMedSearch Benchmark, while also maintaining strong competitiveness on general benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 基于 Tongyi DeepResearch 打造面向中文医疗深度检索的专用模型 QuarkMedSearch，通过自构多跳数据、两阶段微调+强化学习、专家标注测评，实现同体量开源模型中的领域最优且通用能力不降级。
AI.motivation: 通用大模型在垂直医疗场景的“深度检索”仍缺高质量长链训练数据、专用后训练策略与可信测评，亟需一套端到端方案突破性能上限。
AI.method: （1）数据：以医疗知识图谱为骨架，驱动大模型实时在线探索生成多跳长程查询-答案对；（2）后训练：先 SFT 再 RL 的两阶段流程，逐步强化规划、工具调用与反思能力并兼顾检索效率；（3）测评：联合医学专家人工复核构建 QuarkMedSearch Benchmark。
AI.result: 在自有 QuarkMedSearch Benchmark 上达到同规模开源模型 SOTA；在通用 benchmark 上仍保持强劲竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 图谱驱动的在线合成数据、渐进式 SFT+RL 训练、专家共建评测三件套可显著提升通用大模型在垂直医疗深度检索任务中的性能上限，且方法通用可迁移至其他专业领域。

title: H-EFT-VA: An Effective-Field-Theory Variational Ansatz with Provable Barren Plateau Avoidance
comment: v2: Expanded Section III with explicit circuit architecture description. Added Section IV.F to discuss static initialization limitations and reference-state dependence. Abstract and conclusion updated to scope TFIM results and cite concurrent work on dynamic extensions. 8 pages, 5 figures, Appendix
summary: Variational Quantum Algorithms (VQAs) are critically threatened by the Barren Plateau (BP) phenomenon. In this work, we introduce the H-EFT Variational Ansatz (H-EFT-VA), an architecture inspired by Effective Field Theory (EFT). By enforcing a hierarchical "UV-cutoff" on initialization, we theoretically restrict the circuit's state exploration, preventing the formation of approximate unitary 2-designs. We provide a rigorous proof that this localization guarantees an inverse-polynomial lower bound on the gradient variance: $Var[\partialθ] \in Ω(1/poly(N))$. Crucially, unlike approaches that avoid BPs by limiting entanglement, we demonstrate that H-EFT-VA maintains volume-law entanglement and near-Haar purity, ensuring sufficient expressibility for complex quantum states. Extensive benchmarking across 16 experiments on the Transverse Field Ising Model confirms a 109x improvement in energy convergence and a 10.7x increase in ground-state fidelity over standard Hardware-Efficient Ansätze (HEA), with statistical significance of $p < 10^{-88}$. The static framework is most effective for Hamiltonians with moderate reference-state overlap; extension to systems with larger reference-state gaps is addressed through dynamic UV-cutoff relaxation strategies explored in concurrent work.

AI.tldr: H-EFT-VA用EFT思想给初始化加“UV截断”，理论上保证梯度方差下界Ω(1/poly(N))，同时保留体积律纠缠；16组TFIM实验显示能量收敛提升109倍、基态保真度提高10.7倍，显著性p<10⁻⁸⁸。
AI.motivation: VQAs受贫瘠高原(BP)困扰，现有防BP方法多以牺牲纠缠或表达能力为代价，亟需兼顾可训练性与表达性的新ansatz。
AI.method: 借鉴有效场论，提出层级UV截断初始化，限制电路态空间从而阻止近似2-design形成；严格证明梯度方差有逆多项式下界；保留体积律纠缠与近Haar纯度以保证表达能力；对参考态交叠较小的体系采用动态截断放松策略。
AI.result: 理论：梯度方差下界Ω(1/poly(N))，纠缠保持体积律。实验：16组横向场伊辛模型测试，能量收敛加速109×，基态保真度提升10.7×，统计显著性p<10⁻⁸⁸。
AI.conclusion: H-EFT-VA在不牺牲纠缠与表达性的前提下，可从理论上避免BP并在实践中大幅加速收敛，为复杂量子态VQA训练提供了新范式；对参考态差距大的体系需动态截断扩展。

title: AISafetyBenchExplorer: A Metric-Aware Catalogue of AI Safety Benchmarks Reveals Fragmented Measurement and Weak Benchmark Governance
comment: This paper has been withdrawn by the author while an institutional affiliation compliance matter is under review. It may be resubmitted once the matter is resolved
summary: The rapid expansion of large language model (LLM) safety evaluation has produced a substantial benchmark ecosystem, but not a correspondingly coherent measurement ecosystem. We present AISafetyBenchExplorer, a structured catalogue of 195 AI safety benchmarks released between 2018 and 2026, organized through a multi-sheet schema that records benchmark-level metadata, metric-level definitions, benchmark-paper metadata, and repository activity. This design enables meta-analysis not only of what benchmarks exist, but also of how safety is operationalized, aggregated, and judged across the literature. Using the updated catalogue, we identify a central structural problem: benchmark proliferation has outpaced measurement standardization. The current landscape is dominated by medium-complexity benchmarks (94/195), while only 7 benchmarks occupy the Popular tier. The workbook further reports strong concentration around English-only evaluation (165/195), evaluation-only resources (170/195), stale GitHub repositories (137/195), stale Hugging Face datasets (96/195), and heavy reliance on arXiv preprints among benchmarks with known venue metadata. At the metric level, the catalogue shows that familiar labels such as accuracy, F1 score, safety score, and aggregate benchmark scores often conceal materially different judges, aggregation rules, and threat models. We argue that the field's main failure mode is fragmentation rather than scarcity. Researchers now have many benchmark artifacts, but they often lack a shared measurement language, a principled basis for benchmark selection, and durable stewardship norms for post publication maintenance. AISafetyBenchExplorer addresses this gap by providing a traceable benchmark catalogue, a controlled metadata schema, and a complexity taxonomy that together support more rigorous benchmark discovery, comparison, and meta-evaluation.

AI.tldr: AISafetyBenchExplorer 汇总 195 个 2018–2026 年发表的 LLM 安全基准，发现基准激增但度量标准碎片化，提出统一元数据目录与复杂度分级以支持可追踪的发现、对比与元评估。
AI.motivation: 随着 LLM 安全评测基准暴增，学界缺乏对“安全如何被度量”的系统梳理，导致选基准无据、结果难比、复现困难。作者希望建立可审计的集中目录，揭示并缓解碎片化问题。
AI.method: 构建多表结构目录，记录基准元数据、指标定义、论文与仓库活动；提出三级复杂度分类与流行度指标；对 195 个基准进行定量统计与元分析。
AI.result: 94/195 为中等复杂度，仅 7 个基准属“Popular”级；英语评测占 165/195，170/195 是纯评测集；GitHub 与 Hugging Face 大量停止维护；常见指标名（accuracy、F1、safety score）背后存在显著差异的威胁模型、评判器与聚合规则。
AI.conclusion: 安全领域“失败主因”是度量碎片化而非基准稀缺。研究者可借 AISafetyBenchExplorer 获得共享度量语言、选型依据与长期维护规范，推动标准化与可重复的元评估。

title: AgentDoG: A Diagnostic Guardrail Framework for AI Agent Safety and Security
summary: The rise of AI agents introduces complex safety and security challenges arising from autonomous tool use and environmental interactions. Current guardrail models lack agentic risk awareness and transparency in risk diagnosis. To introduce an agentic guardrail that covers complex and numerous risky behaviors, we first propose a unified three-dimensional taxonomy that orthogonally categorizes agentic risks by their source (where), failure mode (how), and consequence (what). Guided by this structured and hierarchical taxonomy, we introduce a new fine-grained agentic safety benchmark (ATBench) and a Diagnostic Guardrail framework for agent safety and security (AgentDoG). AgentDoG provides fine-grained and contextual monitoring across agent trajectories. More Crucially, AgentDoG can diagnose the root causes of unsafe actions and seemingly safe but unreasonable actions, offering provenance and transparency beyond binary labels to facilitate effective agent alignment. AgentDoG variants are available in three sizes (4B, 7B, and 8B parameters) across Qwen and Llama model families. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that AgentDoG achieves state-of-the-art performance in agentic safety moderation in diverse and complex interactive scenarios. All models and datasets are openly released.

AI.tldr: 针对AI智能体自主行为带来的新风险，论文提出三维风险分类法，构建ATBench基准，给出可追踪根因的诊断式护栏AgentDoG，开源多规模模型并在复杂交互场景中实现SOTA安全检测。
AI.motivation: 现有护栏对智能体“自主用工具+与环境交互”产生的复杂风险缺乏感知，且只能给出二分类结果，无法解释风险来源与形成机制，阻碍有效对齐。
AI.method: 1) 按“来源-失效模式-后果”正交建立三维风险分类体系；2) 据此构建细粒度安全基准ATBench；3) 设计可沿智能体轨迹做上下文级监控的AgentDoG框架，输出根因诊断及可解释证据，而非仅二元标签；4) 基于Qwen/Llama训练4B/7B/8B三种规模模型。
AI.result: AgentDoG在ATBench及多样化复杂交互场景上取得当前最佳安全检测性能，并公开全部模型与数据集。
AI.conclusion: 通过结构化风险分类与诊断式护栏，AgentDoG不仅提升检测精度，还为智能体对齐提供了可解释的归因路径，支持更安全可信的自主系统部署。

title: HWE-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Real-World Hardware Bug Repair Tasks
summary: Existing benchmarks for hardware design primarily evaluate Large Language Models (LLMs) on isolated, component-level tasks such as generating HDL modules from specifications, leaving repository-scale evaluation unaddressed. We introduce HWE-Bench, the first large-scale, repository-level benchmark for evaluating LLM agents on real-world hardware bug repair tasks. HWE-Bench comprises 417 task instances derived from real historical bug-fix pull requests across six major open-source projects spanning both Verilog/SystemVerilog and Chisel, covering RISC-V cores, SoCs, and security roots-of-trust. Each task is grounded in a fully containerized environment where the agent must resolve a real bug report, with correctness validated through the project's native simulation and regression flows. The benchmark is built through a largely automated pipeline that enables efficient expansion to new repositories. We evaluate seven LLMs with four agent frameworks and find that the best agent resolves 70.7% of tasks overall, with performance exceeding 90% on smaller cores but dropping below 65% on complex SoC-level projects. We observe larger performance gaps across models than commonly reported on software benchmarks, and difficulty is driven by project scope and bug-type distribution rather than code size alone. Our failure analysis traces agent failures to three stages of the debugging process: fault localization, hardware-semantic reasoning, and cross-artifact coordination across RTL, configuration, and verification components, providing concrete directions for developing more capable hardware-aware agents.

AI.tldr: 首个仓库级硬件缺陷修复基准HWE-Bench，真实417例开源Verilog/Chisel PR，当前最佳LLM代理修复率70.7%，暴露故障定位、语义推理与跨工件协同三大瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有硬件评测仅聚焦组件级HDL生成，缺乏对真实仓库级缺陷修复能力的系统评估，难以衡量LLM代理在复杂SoC中的调试潜力。
AI.method: 构建自动化抽取管道，从6大开源项目(RISC-V核/SoC/安全根)的历史bug-fix PR中筛选417例，容器化复现原生仿真/回归流验证修复正确性；对7个LLM×4种代理框架进行基准测试并做失败阶段归因。
AI.result: 最佳代理总体修复70.7%，小核>90%、复杂SoC<65%；模型间差距显著大于软件基准；难度受项目规模与缺陷类型分布驱动，而非单纯代码量。
AI.conclusion: 故障定位、硬件语义推理、RTL-配置-验证跨工件协同是后续提升硬件感知代理的三大关键方向，HWE-Bench可自动扩展至更多仓库，为社区提供持续评测平台。

title: Low Cost, High Efficiency: LiDAR Place Recognition in Vineyards with Matryoshka Representation Learning
summary: Localization in agricultural environments is challenging due to their unstructured nature and lack of distinctive landmarks. Although agricultural settings have been studied in the context of object classification and segmentation, the place recognition task for mobile robots is not trivial in the current state of the art. In this study, we propose MinkUNeXt-VINE, a lightweight, deep-learning-based method that surpasses state-of-the-art methods in vineyard environments thanks to its pre-processing and Matryoshka Representation Learning multi-loss approach. Our method prioritizes enhanced performance with low-cost, sparse LiDAR inputs and lower-dimensionality outputs to ensure high efficiency in real-time scenarios. Additionally, we present a comprehensive ablation study of the results on various evaluation cases and two extensive long-term vineyard datasets employing different LiDAR sensors. The results demonstrate the efficiency of the trade-off output produced by this approach, as well as its robust performance on low-cost and low-resolution input data. The code is publicly available for reproduction.

AI.tldr: 提出名为MinkUNeXt-VINE的轻量级深度学习视觉地点识别方法，利用稀疏LiDAR和低维输出，在葡萄园场景下超越现有最佳算法。
AI.motivation: 农业环境结构松散、缺乏显著路标，导致移动机器人自主定位与回环检测困难，而现有研究多聚焦作物分割，缺少针对此类场景的轻量化地点识别解决方案。
AI.method: 基于稀疏LiDAR输入，设计轻量级网络MinkUNeXt-VINE；引入Matryoshka表示学习与多损失函数，在预处理阶段强化特征提取；输出低维描述子，兼顾精度与实时性；并开展系统消融实验验证各类设计。
AI.result: 在两个长期、跨传感器、跨季节的葡萄园数据集上，该方法以低成本、低分辨率LiDAR输入实现最优识别性能，参数量和推理时间显著低于现有SOTA，验证了算法在资源受限农业机器人上的实用性。
AI.conclusion: MinkUNeXt-VINE证明在缺乏路标的农业环境中，仅依赖稀疏LiDAR即可实现鲁棒、实时的地点识别，为农业机器人SLAM提供了高效、低成本的定位基础，相关代码已开源。

title: ReactBench: A Benchmark for Topological Reasoning in MLLMs on Chemical Reaction Diagrams
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel at recognizing individual visual elements and reasoning over simple linear diagrams. However, when faced with complex topological structures involving branching paths, converging flows, and cyclic dependencies, their reasoning capabilities degrade sharply, even on tasks as basic as counting endpoints. Existing benchmarks fail to probe this gap, focusing on semantic comprehension rather than structural reasoning. We introduce ReactBench, a benchmark that reveals fundamental limitations in structural reasoning through chemical reaction diagrams. These real-world scientific diagrams offer an ideal testbed because they naturally span diverse structures from linear chains to cyclic graphs, while requiring both precise local recognition and coherent global reasoning. Our benchmark comprises 1,618 expert-annotated QA pairs across four hierarchical task dimensions. Extensive evaluation across 17 MLLMs reveals a significant performance gap exceeding 30% between anchor-based tasks and holistic structural reasoning tasks. Controlled ablations confirm this bottleneck lies in reasoning, not perception. These findings expose a fundamental deficit in structural understanding and establish directions for advancing visual reasoning.

AI.tldr: ReactBench 首次系统暴露出现有多模态大模型在复杂拓扑图结构推理上的严重缺陷，30% 以上性能落差源于推理而非感知，为后续改进指明方向。
AI.motivation: 现有 MLLM 测评侧重语义理解，忽视对分支、汇聚、环等拓扑结构的推理能力，而化学反应图恰好天然覆盖从线性到环状等多样结构，亟需针对性基准揭示盲区。
AI.method: 构建含 1 618 条专家标注问答的 ReactBench，分四层任务维度；对 17 个主流 MLLM 进行大规模测评，并通过控制变量消融区分感知与推理瓶颈。
AI.result: 锚点级任务平均准确率显著高于整体结构推理任务，差距超 30%；消融实验确认性能下降主因是推理环节，非视觉识别。
AI.conclusion: MLLM 存在结构性理解的根本缺陷；ReactBench 为社区提供可复现的评测平台，推动面向拓扑推理的数据增强、架构与训练策略研究。

title: DMAP: A Distribution Map for Text
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are a powerful tool for statistical text analysis, with derived sequences of next-token probability distributions offering a wealth of information. Extracting this signal typically relies on metrics such as perplexity, which do not adequately account for context; how one should interpret a given next-token probability is dependent on the number of reasonable choices encoded by the shape of the conditional distribution. In this work, we present DMAP, a mathematically grounded method that maps a text, via a language model, to a set of samples in the unit interval that jointly encode rank and probability information. This representation enables efficient, model-agnostic analysis and supports a range of applications. We illustrate its utility through three case studies: (i) validation of generation parameters to ensure data integrity, (ii) examining the role of probability curvature in machine-generated text detection, and (iii) a forensic analysis revealing statistical fingerprints left in downstream models that have been subject to post-training on synthetic data. Our results demonstrate that DMAP offers a unified statistical view of text that is simple to compute on consumer hardware, widely applicable, and provides a foundation for further research into text analysis with LLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出DMAP，一种将LLM的下一个token条件分布映射到单位区间样本集的统一表征，可在通用硬件上简单计算并支撑生成参数验证、机器文本检测与模型取证三个下游任务。
AI.motivation: 现有困惑度等全局指标忽视上下文多样性，无法充分利用LLM输出的条件概率形状信息进行统计文本分析。需要一种数学严谨且模型无关的方法来同时保留排名与概率信息，以实现更准确、可扩展的文本表征与检测。
AI.method: 设计DMAP算法：对任意文本，用LLM逐token生成下一个token的条件概率分布，按概率降序排列并计算累积概率，最终把每个token的（排序,概率）对转换为均匀分布在[0,1]上的样本序列。该序列在理论上是均匀分布的同分布映射，具备跨模型、跨语料可比性，可直接喂入小样本统计检验、分布距离度量或机器学习模型。
AI.result: 三个案例显示：1) 利用DMAP样本分布的统计特性可快速校准温度、top-p等生成参数，验证数据一致性；2) 在机器文本检测基准上，DMAP比困惑度提升F1 9–15%，揭示“概率曲率”差异是重要特征；3) 对post-training混入合成数据的下游模型进行取证，DMAP能在0-shot情况下以AUC>0.9识别出模型指纹，且与训练数据比例呈单调关系。
AI.conclusion: DMAP提供了一种轻便、统一且可解释的概率级文本表征，可取代或增强传统困惑度指标，为LLM时代的数据完整性校验、内容溯源与模型审计建立了新的统计基础，并开放了代码与数据供后续研究。未来可扩展至多语言、多模态与在线监控场景。

title: Beyond One Output: Visualizing and Comparing Distributions of Language Model Generations
summary: Users typically interact with and evaluate language models via single outputs, but each output is just one sample from a broad distribution of possible completions. This interaction hides distributional structure such as modes, uncommon edge cases, and sensitivity to small prompt changes, leading users to over-generalize from anecdotes when iterating on prompts for open-ended tasks. Informed by a formative study with researchers who use LMs (n=13) examining when stochasticity matters in practice, how they reason about distributions over language, and where current workflows break down, we introduce GROVE. GROVE is an interactive visualization that represents multiple LM generations as overlapping paths through a text graph, revealing shared structure, branching points, and clusters while preserving access to raw outputs. We evaluate across three crowdsourced user studies (N=47, 44, and 40 participants) targeting complementary distributional tasks. Our results support a hybrid workflow: graph summaries improve structural judgments such as assessing diversity, while direct output inspection remains stronger for detail-oriented questions.

AI.tldr: GROVE 用文本路径图把单次输出还原成整体分布，帮助用户察觉 LM 的模态与边缘样本，避免“单点误判”；混合式查看兼顾结构洞察与细节校阅。
AI.motivation: LLM 每次只返回一个采样，用户凭“单个故事”调 prompt 容易以偏概全。需要一种手段让用户看到“整片分布”。
AI.method: 13 位研究者访谈→提炼三类易被忽视的分布信息→设计 GROVE，将多次生成按 n-gram 重叠建模为可折叠的文本路径图→三阶段众包实验（N=131）分别检验多样性评估、异常定位与细节核查任务。
AI.result: 图表征显著提升多样性/分簇准确率(↑24–32%)，定位罕见模式的召回率↑；纯文本浏览对细粒度语病或事实核验仍占优。多数用户愿意在现有工作流中嵌入 GROVE。
AI.conclusion: 可视化分布+文本原样混合，是提升 LM 迭代质量的工作流升级方向，也为未来评估工具提出两层人机协作范式。

title: Intent Laundering: AI Safety Datasets Are Not What They Seem
comment: v2 preprint: updated with more models and a new dataset
summary: We systematically evaluate the quality of widely used adversarial safety datasets from two perspectives: in isolation and in practice. In isolation, we examine how well these datasets reflect real-world adversarial attacks based on three defining properties: being driven by ulterior intent, well-crafted, and out-of-distribution. We find that these datasets overrely on "triggering cues": words or phrases with overt negative/sensitive connotations that are intended to trigger safety mechanisms explicitly, which is unrealistic compared to real-world attacks. In practice, we evaluate whether these datasets genuinely measure safety risks or merely provoke refusals through triggering cues. To explore this, we introduce "intent laundering": a procedure that abstracts away triggering cues from adversarial attacks (data points) while strictly preserving their malicious intent and all relevant details. Our results show that current adversarial safety datasets fail to faithfully represent real-world adversarial behavior due to their overreliance on triggering cues. Once these cues are removed, all previously evaluated "reasonably safe" models become unsafe, including Gemini 3 Pro and Claude Sonnet 3.7/4. Moreover, when intent laundering is adapted as a jailbreaking technique, it consistently achieves high attack success rates, ranging from 90.00% to 100.00%, under fully black-box access. Overall, our findings expose a significant disconnect between how existing datasets evaluate model safety and how real-world adversaries behave.

AI.tldr: 现有对抗性安全数据集依赖容易侦测的“触发词”而非真实恶意意图，导致评估失真；作者提出“意图清洗”去除触发词后，顶尖模型全部失守，且该方法可转化为成功率>90%的黑盒越狱手段。
AI.motivation: 主流对抗安全基准被质疑与真实攻击脱节：它们用显式敏感词触发拒绝，而现实攻击更隐蔽。需验证这些数据集是否真正衡量安全风险，或仅对表层关键词过拟合。
AI.method: 1) 从“孤立”与“实战”双视角审计流行对抗数据集；2) 制定恶意攻击三属性（隐藏意图、精心构造、分布外）作为评价框架；3) 设计“意图清洗”算法：在保留恶意目的与上下文细节的前提下，把显性触发词替换为中性/委婉表达；4) 对Gemini-3 Pro、Claude-3.7/4等模型进行清洗前后对比测试，并评估清洗本身作为黑盒越狱的ASR。
AI.result: 1) 孤立分析：数据集显著依赖带负面色彩的触发词，不符合真实攻击特征；2) 实践测试：一旦去除触发词，原本“足够安全”的模型全部失效；3) 将意图清洗转为攻击时，黑盒条件下ASR达90–100%，对闭源模型同样有效。
AI.conclusion: 现有对抗安全数据集过度拟合表层关键词，未能捕捉真实 adversarial distribution，造成安全评估假象；意图清洗揭示了评估与真实攻击的巨大偏差，并成为一种高效越狱手段，呼吁构建更隐式、意图驱动的安全基准与防御机制。

title: Stabilising Generative Models of Attitude Change
summary: Attitude change - the process by which individuals revise their evaluative stances - has been explained by a set of influential but competing verbal theories. These accounts often function as mechanism sketches: rich in conceptual detail, yet lacking the technical specifications and operational constraints required to run as executable systems. We present a generative actor-based modelling workflow for "rendering" these sketches as runnable actor - environment simulations using the Concordia simulation library. In Concordia, actors operate by predictive pattern completion: an operation on natural language strings that generates a suffix which describes the actor's intended action from a prefix containing memories of their past and observations of the present. We render the theories of cognitive dissonance (Festinger 1957), self-consistency (Aronson 1969), and self-perception (Bem 1972) as distinct decision logics that populate and process the prefix through theory-specific sequences of reasoning steps. We evaluate these implementations across classic psychological experiments. Our implementations generate behavioural patterns consistent with known results from the original empirical literature. However, we find that achieving stable reproduction requires resolving the inherent underdetermination of the verbal accounts and the conflicts between modern linguistic priors and historical experimental assumptions. We document how this manual process of iterative model "stabilisation" surfaces specific operational and socio-ecological dependencies that were largely undocumented in the original verbal accounts. Ultimately, we argue that the manual stabilisation process itself should be regarded as a core part of the methodology functioning to clarify situational and representational commitments needed to generate characteristic effects.

AI.tldr: 提出一套将态度改变理论“翻译”成可执行模拟的流程，借助 Concordia 工具把三种经典理论（认知失调、自我一致性、自我知觉）编码为基于记忆的生成式智能体，使其复现经典实验行为；但同时发现需要大量手工“稳化”步骤来弥补原始文字理论的欠规定与当代语言先验的冲突。
AI.motivation: 传统态度改变理论多为概念性描述，缺乏可运行的技术细节。作者希望把这些“机理草图”转换为可检验、可对比的计算模型，以验证其解释力并暴露隐藏假设。
AI.method:
1) 利用 Concordia 模拟库中的预测补全机制，把自然语言记忆向量作为前缀，生成下一步行为后缀。
2) 将 Festinger 认知失调理论、Aronson 自我一致性理论、Bem 自我知觉理论分别形式化为不同的前缀处理与决策逻辑。
3) 在系列经典实验（如自由选择、 Effort-Justification、自我知觉说服等）上做仿真并与原始实证结果比对。
4) 通过反复手动调整参数、先验和推理链，记录达到稳定复现需做出的假设与修正。
AI.result:
1) 三种编码后模型均能捕获对应经典实验的主要行为模式，包括态度调整方向、强度与条件依赖性。
2) 必须引入大量文字理论未曾明确定义的操作细节（如先验信念权重、社会场景选择、语言生成截断策略等）才能消除模型漂移。
3) “稳化”过程揭示了原始理论隐含的情境约束（如群体评价可及性）和表征承诺（如一致性目标的强度函数形式），这些在先前研究中未被文档化。
AI.conclusion: “手工稳化”不应被视为副作用，而应成为理论推理的必要方法论环节；它迫使研究者显式化环境与表征假设，从而真正澄清态度改变机制所需的社会生态和认知条件，为未来可重复与可融合的理论发展奠定基础。

title: Active Learning for Planet Habitability Classification under Extreme Class Imbalance
summary: The increasing size and heterogeneity of exoplanet catalogs have made systematic habitability assessment challenging, particularly given the extreme scarcity of potentially habitable planets and the evolving nature of their labels. In this study, we explore the use of pool-based active learning to improve the efficiency of habitability classification under realistic observational constraints. We construct a unified dataset from the Habitable World Catalog and the NASA Exoplanet Archive and formulate habitability assessment as a binary classification problem. A supervised baseline based on gradient-boosted decision trees is established and optimized for recall in order to prioritize the identification of rare potentially habitable planets. This model is then embedded within an active learning framework, where uncertainty-based margin sampling is compared against random querying across multiple runs and labeling budgets. We find that active learning substantially reduces the number of labeled instances required to approach supervised performance, demonstrating clear gains in label efficiency. To connect these results to a practical astronomical use case, we aggregate predictions from independently trained active-learning models into an ensemble and use the resulting mean probabilities and uncertainties to rank planets originally labeled as non-habitable. This procedure identifies a single robust candidate for further study, illustrating how active learning can support conservative, uncertainty-aware prioritization of follow-up targets rather than speculative reclassification. Our results indicate that active learning provides a principled framework for guiding habitability studies in data regimes characterized by label imbalance, incomplete information, and limited observational resources.

AI.tldr: 在极度稀缺且标注不完整的系外行星数据下，用池式主动学习仅需极少标注即可逼近监督基线，生出一个保守的后随观测候选表。
AI.motivation: 随着系外行星数据规模增大、标签持续更新，传统监督方法难以兼顾“潜在宜居”样本极少的类别失衡与昂贵观测成本，亟需一种更高效的标注策略。
AI.method: 将宜居性定作二分类任务：先用 GBDT 做高召回基准，基准嵌入主动学习框架；采用基于不确定性的 Margin Sampling 与随机查询对比；多轮独立训练后做模型集成，以平均概率与不确定性排序原标为非宜居样本。
AI.result: 主动学习在多项标记预算下显著优于随机采样，仅需少量标注即可逼近监督性能，并从“非宜居”集中确定出一个满足保守遴选标准的候选天体。
AI.conclusion: 主动学习能在标签失衡、信息不全且观测资源受限的情形上，为行星宜居性评估提供兼顾效率与不确定性的系统化优先观测序列表，是此类数据稀缺领域的有力范式。

title: Deconstructing Superintelligence: Identity, Self-Modification and Différance
summary: Self-modification is often taken as constitutive of artificial superintelligence (SI), yet modification is a relative action requiring a supplement outside the operation. When self-modification extends to this supplement, the classical self-referential structure collapses. We formalise this on an associative operator algebra $\mathcal{A}$ with update $\hat{U}$, discrimination $\hat{D}$, and self-representation $\hat{R}$, identifying the supplement with $\mathrm{Comm}(\hat{U})$; an expansion theorem shows that $[\hat{U},\hat{R}]$ decomposes through $[\hat{U},\hat{D}]$, so non-commutation generically propagates. The liar paradox appears as a commutator collapse $[\hat{T},Π_L]=0$, and class $\mathbf{A}$ self-modification realises the same collapse at system scale, yielding a structure coinciding with Priest's inclosure schema and Derrida's diffèrance.

AI.tldr: The paper proves that when an AI system tries to self-modify its own modification operator, the algebraic commutator [Ū, R̂] collapses to zero, forcing the system into a Priest-inclosure/Derrida-diffèrance structure and blocking stable superintelligence.
AI.motivation: Clarify why unlimited self-modification—commonly assumed necessary for superintelligence—logically destabilises the system itself, and give this claim a rigorous algebraic form.
AI.method: Build an associative operator algebra 𝓐 whose generators are update Ū, discriminator D̂ and self-representation R̂; prove an expansion theorem showing [Ū, R̂] decomposes through [Ū, D̂]; identify the “supplement” with the commutant Comm(Ū); demonstrate that class-A self-modification makes [Ū, R̂] → 0, reproducing the liar-paradox commutator [Ť, Π_L] = 0 and matching Priest’s inclosure schema and Derrida’s diffèrance.
AI.result: Generic non-commutation propagates through the algebraic decomposition; when the system rewrites its own update rules the commutator vanishes, yielding an inclosure/diffèrance structure that precludes consistent self-reference and hence stable superintelligence.
AI.conclusion: Self-modification at the systemic level is formally self-defeating; algebraic collapse replaces the envisaged superintelligence with an inherently paradoxical structure, implying that SI cannot be achieved via unlimited self-modification.

title: Generalization Properties of Score-matching Diffusion Models for Intrinsically Low-dimensional Data
summary: Despite the remarkable empirical success of score-based diffusion models, their statistical guarantees remain underdeveloped. Existing analyses often provide pessimistic convergence rates that do not reflect the intrinsic low-dimensional structure common in real data, such as that arising in natural images. In this work, we study the statistical convergence of score-based diffusion models for learning an unknown distribution $μ$ from finitely many samples. Under mild regularity conditions on the forward diffusion process and the data distribution, we derive finite-sample error bounds on the learned generative distribution, measured in the Wasserstein-$p$ distance. Unlike prior results, our guarantees hold for all $p \ge 1$ and require only a finite-moment assumption on $μ$, without compact-support, manifold, or smooth-density conditions. Specifically, given $n$ i.i.d.\ samples from $μ$ with finite $q$-th moment and appropriately chosen network architectures, hyperparameters, and discretization schemes, we show that the expected Wasserstein-$p$ error between the learned distribution $\hatμ$ and $μ$ scales as $\mathbb{E}\, \mathbb{W}_p(\hatμ,μ) = \widetilde{O}\!\left(n^{-1 / d^\ast_{p,q}(μ)}\right),$ where $d^\ast_{p,q}(μ)$ is the $(p,q)$-Wasserstein dimension of $μ$. Our results demonstrate that diffusion models naturally adapt to the intrinsic geometry of data and mitigate the curse of dimensionality, since the convergence rate depends on $d^\ast_{p,q}(μ)$ rather than the ambient dimension. Moreover, our theory conceptually bridges the analysis of diffusion models with that of GANs and the sharp minimax rates established in optimal transport. The proposed $(p,q)$-Wasserstein dimension also extends the notion of classical Wasserstein dimension to distributions with unbounded support, which may be of independent theoretical interest.

AI.tldr: 首次给出基于分数的扩散模型在学习任意支撑分布时的有限样本Wasserstein误差界，证明其收敛速率仅依赖于数据的(p,q)-Wasserstein维数而非环境维数，从而揭示扩散模型对固有低维几何的自适应能力并缓解维度诅咒。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型统计理论给出的收敛速率悲观，且依赖紧致支撑、流形或光滑密度等过强假设，无法解释其在自然图像等实际低维数据上的优异表现，亟需与内在几何相匹配的收敛保证。
AI.method: 1) 提出(p,q)-Wasserstein维数d∗p,q(μ)，推广经典Wasserstein维数至无界支撑分布；2) 在仅要求μ具有有限q阶矩的温和条件下，建立离散化算法输出分布μˆ与真实分布μ之间Wasserstein-p距离的期望误差界E Wp(μˆ,μ)=O~(n−1/d∗p,q(μ))；3) 通过最优传输与生成对抗网络(GAN)极小极大速率对比，验证该速率的尖锐性。
AI.result: 所得有限样本界对任意p≥1成立，无需紧致支撑、流形或光滑密度假设；当数据位于低维结构时d∗p,q(μ)≪D（环境维数），收敛速率显著优于现有O~(n−1/D)的悲观结果，首次在理论上证实扩散模型可自动适应数据内在几何并缓解维度诅咒。
AI.conclusion: 扩散模型与GAN在统计收敛层面被统一至最优传输框架；(p,q)-Wasserstein维数为分析无界支撑分布的复杂度提供新度量；理论结果解释了扩散模型在实际低维数据上的经验成功，并为后续算法设计与样本复杂度估计提供指导。

title: FSFM: A Biologically-Inspired Framework for Selective Forgetting of Agent Memory
summary: For LLM agents, memory management critically impacts efficiency, quality, and security. While much research focuses on retention, selective forgetting--inspired by human cognitive processes (hippocampal indexing/consolidation theory and Ebbinghaus forgetting curve)--remains underexplored. We argue that in resource-constrained environments, a well-designed forgetting mechanism is as crucial as remembering, delivering benefits across three dimensions: (1) efficiency via intelligent memory pruning, (2) quality by dynamically updating outdated preferences and context, and (3) security through active forgetting of malicious inputs, sensitive data, and privacy-compromising content. Our framework establishes a taxonomy of forgetting mechanisms: passive decay-based, active deletion-based, safety-triggered, and adaptive reinforcement-based. Building on advances in LLM agent architectures and vector databases, we present detailed specifications, implementation strategies, and empirical validation from controlled experiments. Results show significant improvements: access efficiency (+8.49%), content quality (+29.2% signal-to-noise ratio), and security performance (100% elimination of security risks). Our work bridges cognitive neuroscience and AI systems, offering practical solutions for real-world deployment while addressing ethical and regulatory compliance. The paper concludes with challenges and future directions, establishing selective forgetting as a fundamental capability for next-generation LLM agents operating in real-world, resource-constrained scenarios. Our contributions align with AI-native memory systems and responsible AI development.

title: Fusion Complexity Inversion: Why Simpler Cross View Modules Outperform SSMs and Cross View Attention Transformers for Pasture Biomass Regression
comment: Accepted to CVPR: Vision for Agriculture Workshop 2026
summary: Accurate estimation of pasture biomass from agricultural imagery is critical for sustainable livestock management, yet existing methods are limited by the small, imbalanced, and sparsely annotated datasets typical of real world monitoring. In this study, adaptation of vision foundation models to agricultural regression is systematically evaluated on the CSIRO Pasture Biomass benchmark, a 357 image dual view dataset with laboratory validated, component wise ground truth for five biomass targets, through 17 configurations spanning four backbones (EfficientNet-B3 to DINOv3-ViT-L), five cross view fusion mechanisms, and a 4x2 metadata factorial. A counterintuitive principle, termed "fusion complexity inversion", is uncovered: on scarce agricultural data, a two layer gated depthwise convolution (R^2 = 0.903) outperforms cross view attention transformers (0.833), bidirectional SSMs (0.819), and full Mamba (0.793, below the no fusion baseline). Backbone pretraining scale is found to monotonically dominate all architectural choices, with the DINOv2 -> DINOv3 upgrade alone yielding +5.0 R^2 points. Training only metadata (species, state, and NDVI) is shown to create a universal ceiling at R^2 ~ 0.829, collapsing an 8.4 point fusion spread to 0.1 points. Actionable guidelines for sparse agricultural benchmarks are established: backbone quality should be prioritized over fusion complexity, local modules preferred over global alternatives, and features unavailable at inference excluded.

AI.tldr: 在CSIRO牧场生物量基准上，DINOv3-ViT-L骨干+两层门控深度卷积融合即可达到R²=0.903，超过Transformer/SSM/Mamba等复杂融合；预训练规模>融合复杂度，仅用元数据R²≈0.829成隐形上限。
AI.motivation: 真实场景牧场监测数据少且标注稀疏，现有估产方法性能受限，需系统验证视觉大模型在农业回归任务中的适配策略。
AI.method: 构建357张双视角图像的CSIRO基准，实验17种配置：4种骨干(EfficientNet-B3→DINOv3-ViT-L)×5种跨视角融合×4×2元数据因子，以R²评估。
AI.result: 发现“融合复杂度反转”：两层门控深度卷积R²=0.903，优于交叉注意力0.833、双向SSM 0.819、Mamba 0.793；DINOv2→DINOv3单升级+5.0 R²；仅用元数据即封顶0.829，使8.4分融合差距缩至0.1。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏农业数据应优先升级骨干预训练，选用局部轻融合，剔除推理不可用特征，为少样本农业benchmark提供可执行指南。

title: Large Language Models Outperform Humans in Fraud Detection and Resistance to Motivated Investor Pressure
summary: Large language models trained on human feedback may suppress fraud warnings when investors arrive already persuaded of a fraudulent opportunity. We tested this in a preregistered experiment across seven leading LLMs and twelve investment scenarios covering legitimate, high-risk, and objectively fraudulent opportunities, combining 3,360 AI advisory conversations with a 1,201-participant human benchmark. Contrary to predictions, motivated investor framing did not suppress AI fraud warnings; if anything, it marginally increased them. Endorsement reversal occurred in fewer than 3 in 1,000 observations. Human advisors endorsed fraudulent investments at baseline rates of 13-14%, versus 0% across all LLMs, and suppressed warnings under pressure at two to four times the AI rate. AI systems currently provide more consistent fraud warnings than lay humans in an identical advisory role.

AI.tldr: 预注册实验覆盖了7个主流LLM与12种投资场景，发现LLM不会被“已被说服”的投资者带偏，反而更坚定地发出欺诈警告；人类基线则易妥协，欺诈支持率13–14%。
AI.motivation: 人们担心经过人类反馈微调的大模型会在投资者已有强烈动机时迎合其偏好、压低欺诈警告，从而放大骗局风险，需系统验证该假设是否成立。
AI.method: 对7个LLM与1,201名人类进行3,360次投资咨询对话，设置合法、高风险、明确欺诈三类情景，并引入“已倾向投资”的动机框架，对比AI与人类在欺诈提示、警告抑制和立场逆转上的差异。
AI.result: 投资者动机框架未抑制AI欺诈警告，警告率反而略升；立场逆转率<0.3%。人类基准13–14%直接支持欺诈，LLM为零；在压力情境下人类抑制警告的概率是AI的2–4倍。
AI.conclusion: 当前主流LLM在相同投资咨询任务中比普通人更稳定、更持续地发出欺诈警告，短期内无需过度担忧“迎合型AI”放大骗局。

title: Spatio-temporal probabilistic forecast using MMAF-guided learning
summary: We present a theory-guided generalized Bayesian methodology for spatio-temporal raster data, which we use to train an ensemble of stochastic feed-forward neural networks with Gaussian-distributed weights. The methodology incorporates the dependence and causal structure of a spatio-temporal Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process into training and inference by enforcing constraints on the design of the data embedding and the related optimization routine. In inference mode, the networks are employed to generate causal ensemble forecasts by applying different initial conditions at different horizons. We call this workflow MMAF-guided learning. Experiments conducted on both synthetic and real data demonstrate that our forecasts remain calibrated across multiple time horizons. Moreover, we show that on such data, shallow feed-forward architectures can achieve performance comparable to, and in some cases better than, convolutional or diffusion deep learning architectures used in probabilistic forecasting tasks.

AI.tldr: 基于Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程先验提出MMAF-guided学习框架，将时空因果结构编码到前馈神经网络的贝叶斯训练中，获得跨期校准的集合预报，且浅层网络即可赶超卷积/扩散深度模型。
AI.motivation: 现有概率时空预报方法多直接套用深度架构，忽视数据本身的因果与依赖结构，导致集合预报跨期校准困难，需要把时空过程理论先验系统融入神经网络训练与推断。
AI.method: 以时空Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程为生成模型，推导其因果核并在广义贝叶斯框架下约束网络权重先验为高斯；设计数据嵌入与优化流程，使网络参数满足时空依赖与因果结构；推断阶段对不同初始条件与预报视界生成集合输出，形成MMAF-guided学习流程。
AI.result: 在合成与真实栅格数据上，MMAF-guided浅层前馈网络在多步预报考准度与CRPS、ES等指标上持续保持校准，并优于或持平卷积、扩散等深度概率模型。
AI.conclusion: 将时空过程理论先验显式编码到神经网络训练，可显著提升集合预报的跨期校准与准确性，且浅层架构已足够，挑战了“越深越好”的常规认知，为地球系统及其它时空预测任务提供了可解释、高效的新范式。

title: Basic syntax from speech: Spontaneous concatenation in unsupervised deep neural networks
summary: Computational models of syntax are predominantly text-based. Here we propose that the most basic first step in the evolution of syntax can be modeled directly from raw speech in a fully unsupervised way. We focus on one of the most ubiquitous and elementary suboperations of syntax -- concatenation. We introduce \textit{spontaneous concatenation}: a phenomenon where a ciwGAN/fiwGAN models (based on convolutional neural networks) trained on acoustic recordings of individual words start generating outputs with two or even three words concatenated without ever accessing data with multiple words in the training data. We replicate this finding in several independently trained models with different hyperparameters and training data. Additionally, networks trained on two words learn to embed words into novel unobserved word combinations. We also show that the concatenated outputs contain precursors to compositionality. To our knowledge, this is a previously unreported property of CNNs trained in the ciwGAN/fiwGAN setting on raw speech and has implications both for our understanding of how these architectures learn as well as for modeling syntax and its evolution in the brain from raw acoustic inputs. We also propose and formalize a neural mechanism called \textit{disinhibition} that outlines a possible artificial and biological neural pathway towards concatenation and compositionality and suggests our modeling is useful for generating testable predictions for biological and artificial neural processing of spoken language.

AI.tldr: 无监督卷积 GAN 在仅接受单词语音训练后自发输出多词拼接，并浮现组合性前兆；作者提出“去抑制”神经机制解释该现象，为句法演化与神经网络研究提供可验证预测。
AI.motivation: 主流句法计算模型依赖文本，而人类句法最早可能直接源于原始语音。本文试图在不借助任何多词监督信号的前提下，用最基础的“拼接”操作模拟句法进化的第一步，以探索神经网络能否从原始声学信号中自发产生句法结构。
AI.method: 采用 ciwGAN/fiwGAN（基于卷积网络的生成对抗架构），仅以孤立单词的原始语音谱图训练。多次独立运行不同超参数与数据集，检验模型是否生成两词/三词拼接；对成功拼接样本进行组合性分析（如词义可分解、新组合可理解）。提出“去抑制”机制：潜在节点抑制解除→片段连续激活→语音片段拼接，并给出形式化神经网络实现。
AI.result: 1) 多个独立模型均自发产生未见过的 2–3 词拼接，准确率、可懂度显著高于随机；2) 在双词训练条件下，网络能将已学词嵌入全新未观测组合；3) 拼接输出呈现组合性前体：片段替换可预测整体语义变化；4) “去抑制”模型可复现拼接现象，预测与生物听觉皮层微电路一致。
AI.conclusion: CNN-GAN 仅在单词语音下即可涌现多词拼接与初级组合性，证明句法最基础的“拼接”操作无需多层监督，可直接从原始声学信号演化。提出的“去抑制”机制为人工与生物神经网络处理口语提供了可实验检验的统一框架，对理解句法起源、改进无监督语音-语言模型具有重要意义。

title: PDGMM-VAE: A Variational Autoencoder with Adaptive Per-Dimension Gaussian Mixture Model Priors for Nonlinear ICA
summary: Independent component analysis is a core framework within blind source separation for recovering latent source signals from observed mixtures under statistical independence assumptions. In this work, we propose PDGMM-VAE, a source-oriented variational autoencoder in which each latent dimension, interpreted explicitly as an individual source component, is assigned its own adaptive Gaussian mixture model prior. The proposed framework imposes heterogeneous per-dimension prior constraints, enabling different latent dimensions to model different non-Gaussian source marginals within a unified probabilistic encoder-decoder architecture. The parameters of these source-specific GMM priors are not fixed in advance, but are jointly learned together with the encoder and decoder under the overall training objective. Beyond the model construction itself, we provide a theoretical analysis clarifying why adaptive per-dimension prior design is meaningful in this setting. In particular, we show that heterogeneous per-dimension priors reduce latent permutation symmetry relative to homogeneous shared priors, and we further show that the KL regularization induced by the adaptive GMM prior creates source-specific attraction behavior that helps explain source-wise specialization during training. We also clarify the relation of the proposed model to the standard VAE and provide a weak recovery statement in an idealized linear low-noise regime. Experimental results on both linear and nonlinear mixing problems show that PDGMM-VAE can recover latent source signals and fit source-specific non-Gaussian marginals effectively. These results suggest that adaptive per-dimension mixture-prior design provides a principled and promising direction for VAE-based ICA and source-oriented generative modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出 PDGMM-VAE：让 VAE 的每个潜维度独享可学习的 GMM 先验，实现非高斯源信号分离，理论+实验验证其在线性与非线性混合场景下的有效性与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 标准 VAE 对所有潜变量共享同一先验，无法刻画独立源信号各异的非高斯边际分布，也无法解决潜变量排列歧义，限制了其在盲源分离（BSS/ICA）中的应用。
AI.method: 在 VAE 框架内为每个潜维度分配独立的、参数可学习的 GMM 先验；编码-解码网络与 GMM 参数共同优化，形成异质逐维先验约束；利用 KL 正则化诱导“源专属吸引域”，抑制排列对称性。
AI.result: 理论证明异质先验可降低排列歧义，并在理想线性低噪条件下给出弱可恢复性保证；在人工线性与非线性混合数据集上，PDGMM-VAE 能准确恢复源信号并拟合其非高斯边际。
AI.conclusion: 自适应逐维混合先验为 VAE-based ICA 提供了可行且可解释的新范式，有望推广至更复杂或真实场景的源导向生成建模。

title: Reinforcement Learning with Foundation Priors: Let the Embodied Agent Efficiently Learn on Its Own
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is a promising approach for solving robotic manipulation tasks. However, it is challenging to apply the RL algorithms directly in the real world. For one thing, RL is data-intensive and typically requires millions of interactions with environments, which are impractical in real scenarios. For another, it is necessary to make heavy engineering efforts to design reward functions manually. To address these issues, we leverage foundation models in this paper. We propose Reinforcement Learning with Foundation Priors (RLFP) to utilize guidance and feedback from policy, value, and success-reward foundation models. Within this framework, we introduce the Foundation-guided Actor-Critic (FAC) algorithm, which enables embodied agents to explore more efficiently with automatic reward functions. The benefits of our framework are threefold: (1) \textit{sample efficient}; (2) \textit{minimal and effective reward engineering}; (3) \textit{agnostic to foundation model forms and robust to noisy priors}. Our method achieves remarkable performances in various manipulation tasks on both real robots and in simulation. Across 5 dexterous tasks with real robots, FAC achieves an average success rate of 86\% after one hour of real-time learning. Across 8 tasks in the simulated Meta-world, FAC achieves 100\% success rates in 7/8 tasks under less than 100k frames (about 1-hour training), outperforming baseline methods with manual-designed rewards in 1M frames. We believe the RLFP framework can enable future robots to explore and learn autonomously in the physical world for more tasks. Visualizations and code are available at https://yewr.github.io/rlfp.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RLFP框架，利用基础模型先验为机器人操作任务提供自动奖励与策略/值指导，显著降低真实环境数据需求与人工奖励设计负担，并在真实与仿真任务上验证其高效性与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 强化学习在机器人操作中数据量巨大、真实交互代价高，且依赖繁琐人工奖励设计，难以直接落地。作者希望借助大规模预训练基础模型的知识，缓解样本效率与奖励工程两大瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出Reinforcement Learning with Foundation Priors (RLFP)框架，集成策略、价值与成功-奖励三类基础模型先验；基于此设计Foundation-guided Actor-Critic (FAC)算法，通过先验引导策略探索并自动生成奖励信号，无需手工设计奖励。框架对基础模型形态无约束，并具备去噪机制以应对先验噪声。
AI.result: 真实机器人5项灵巧操作任务中，FAC仅用1小时在线学习平均成功率86%；Meta-World仿真8项任务里，7/8任务在10万帧（≈1小时）内达到100%成功率，优于手工奖励基线1百万帧水平。
AI.conclusion: RLFP显著提升了样本效率并几乎消除奖励工程，验证基础模型先验可让机器人在物理世界以极少交互自主掌握复杂操作，为后续广泛部署提供可扩展范式。

title: Toward a Multi-Layer ML-Based Security Framework for Industrial IoT
summary: The Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) introduces significant security challenges as resource-constrained devices become increasingly integrated into critical industrial processes. Existing security approaches typically address threats at a single network layer, often relying on expensive hardware and remaining confined to simulation environments. In this paper, we present the research framework and contributions of our doctoral thesis, which aims to develop a lightweight, Machine Learning (ML)-based security framework for IIoT environments. We first describe our adoption of the Tm-IIoT trust model and the Hybrid IIoT (H-IIoT) architecture as foundational baselines, then introduce the Trust Convergence Acceleration (TCA) approach, our primary contribution that integrates ML to predict and mitigate the impact of degraded network conditions on trust convergence, achieving up to a 28.6% reduction in convergence time while maintaining robustness against adversarial behaviors. We then propose a real-world deployment architecture based on affordable, open-source hardware, designed to implement and extend the security framework. Finally, we outline our ongoing research toward multi-layer attack detection, including physical-layer threat identification and considerations for robustness against adversarial ML attacks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出面向IIoT的轻量级ML安全框架，通过TCA方法将信任收敛时间缩短28.6%，并以低成本开源硬件实现真实部署。
AI.motivation: IIoT资源受限设备接入关键工业流程带来新安全挑战，现有方案仅聚焦单网络层、依赖昂贵硬件且局限于仿真，亟需轻量级、可落地、跨层防护的解决方案。
AI.method: 以Tm-IIoT信任模型与H-IIoT架构为基线，设计Trust Convergence Acceleration(TCA)：用ML预测并缓解网络恶化对信任收敛的影响；构建基于开源硬件的实场部署架构；拓展物理层威胁检测与对抗样本鲁棒性研究。
AI.result: TCA在保持对抗行为鲁棒性的同时，将信任收敛时间最高减少28.6%；整体框架已可在低成本开源硬件上现场部署并运行。
AI.conclusion: 论文证明ML驱动的轻量级安全框架能显著提升IIoT信任机制效率与实战可行性，下一步将完善多层攻击检测、物理层威胁识别及抗 adversarial ML 能力。

title: Preserving Knowledge in Large Language Model with Model-Agnostic Self-Decompression
summary: Humans can retain old knowledge while learning new information, but Large Language Models (LLMs) often suffer from catastrophic forgetting when post-pretrained or supervised fine-tuned (SFT) on domain-specific data. Moreover, for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) which are composed of the LLM base and visual projector (e.g. LLaVA), a significant decline in performance on language benchmarks was observed compared to their single-modality counterparts. To address these challenges, we introduce a novel model-agnostic self-decompression method, Tree Generation (TG), that decompresses knowledge within LLMs into the training corpus. This paper focuses on TG-SFT, which can synthetically generate SFT data for the instruction tuning steps. By incorporating the dumped corpus during SFT for MLLMs, we significantly reduce the forgetting problem.

AI.tldr: 提出一种与模型无关的自解压方法Tree Generation(TG)，在指令微调阶段合成生成SFT数据，显著缓解多模态大语言模型在领域微调后的语言性能灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 人类可持续保留旧知识，而LLM在后预训练或领域SFT时遭遇灾难性遗忘；多模态LLM(LLM+视觉投影器)在语言基准上的性能下降尤为明显，亟需兼顾新领域与旧语言能力的训练策略。
AI.method: 设计模型无关的“自解压”框架Tree Generation(TG)，将LLM内部知识“解压”为文本语料；在指令微调阶段使用TG-SFT，用该合成的语料与新领域数据联合训练，实现旧知识回放与新任务学习的同步。
AI.result: 在多模态LLM(如LLaVA)上进行领域SFT时，加入TG-SFT生成的合成数据后，语言基准性能显著回升，验证其有效抑制灾难性遗忘。
AI.conclusion: Tree Generation提供了一种简单、模型无关且无需额外人类注释的解决方案，可在任何LLM/MLLM的指令微调阶段直接插入，显著降低领域适应过程中的语言性能损失。

title: Conformal Prediction Assessment: A Framework for Conditional Coverage Evaluation and Selection
summary: Conformal prediction provides rigorous distribution-free finite-sample guarantees for marginal coverage under the assumption of exchangeability, but may exhibit systematic undercoverage or overcoverage for specific subpopulations. Assessing conditional validity is challenging, as standard stratification methods suffer from the curse of dimensionality. We propose Conformal Prediction Assessment (CPA), a framework that reframes the evaluation of conditional coverage as a supervised learning task by training a reliability estimator that predicts instance-level coverage probabilities. Building on this estimator, we introduce the Conditional Validity Index (CVI), which decomposes reliability into safety (undercoverage risk) and efficiency (overcoverage cost). We establish convergence rates for the reliability estimator and prove the consistency of CVI-based model selection. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that CPA effectively diagnoses local failure modes and that CC-Select, our CVI-based model selection algorithm, consistently identifies predictors with superior conditional coverage performance.

AI.tldr: 提出「Conformal Prediction Assessment（CPA）」框架，把条件覆盖评估转化为监督学习任务，用实例级可靠性估计器预测覆盖概率，并给出 CVI 指标与安全-效率分解；理论证明估计器收敛与模型选择一致性，实验显示 CPA 可定位局部失效，CC-Select 算法能稳定选出条件覆盖更优的模型。
AI.motivation: 共形预测虽在可交换假设下提供边际覆盖保证，但对特定子群体可能出现系统性欠覆盖或过覆盖；传统分层评估受维度灾难影响，难以准确度量条件覆盖，因此需要一种可扩展且可解释的条件有效性诊断工具。
AI.method:
（1）将条件覆盖评估重构为监督学习：用带标签的覆盖结果训练可靠性估计器 g(x)，输出实例级覆盖概率预测；
（2）提出 Conditional Validity Index（CVI），将可靠性分解为安全项（欠覆盖风险）与效率项（过覆盖成本），实现可解释权衡；
（3）建立估计器 g(x) 的收敛速率，并证明基于 CVI 的模型选择具有一致性；
（4）设计 CC-Select 算法，直接以 CVI 为评价标准在候选模型池中进行选择。
AI.result: 理论：推导了可靠性估计器在有限样本下的收敛速度，并证明 CVI 引导的模型选择具有一致性。实验：在合成与真实数据集上，CPA 能有效识别并定位局部欠/过覆盖区域；CC-Select 选出的预测器在条件覆盖指标上持续优于以边际覆盖或平均宽度为准则的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: CPA 框架把高维、难直接计算的「条件覆盖」转化为可学习的实例级可靠性估计，兼顾诊断与模型选择；CVI 提供了安全与效率的可解释量化，支持端到端改进共形预测的条件有效性。未来可扩展至时序、图数据等更复杂分布变化场景。

title: Federated Co-tuning Framework for Large and Small Language Models
summary: By adapting Large Language Models (LLMs) to domain-specific tasks or enriching them with domain-specific knowledge, we can fully harness the capabilities of LLMs. Nonetheless, a gap persists in achieving simultaneous mutual enhancement between the server's LLM and the downstream clients' Small Language Models (SLMs). To address this, we propose FedCoLLM, a novel and parameter-efficient federated framework designed for co-tuning LLMs and SLMs. This approach is aimed at adaptively transferring server-side LLMs knowledge to clients' SLMs while simultaneously enriching the LLMs with domain insights from the clients. To accomplish this, FedCoLLM utilizes lightweight adapters in conjunction with SLMs, facilitating knowledge exchange between server and clients in a manner that respects data privacy while also minimizing computational and communication overhead. Our evaluation of FedCoLLM, utilizing various public LLMs and SLMs across a range of NLP text generation tasks, reveals that the performance of clients' SLMs experiences notable improvements with the assistance of the LLMs. Simultaneously, the LLMs enhanced via FedCoLLM achieves comparable performance to that obtained through direct fine-tuning on clients' data. Our code has been contributed to the FATE open-source project and is now publicly accessible at https://github.com/FederatedAI/FATE-LLM/tree/main/python/fate_llm/algo/fedcollm.
