By factoring semantically driven planning into diffusion-based synthesis, Video-Robin enables fine-grained creator control without sacrificing audio realism. Our proposed model outperforms baselines that solely accept video input and additional feature conditioned baselines on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution benchmarks with a 2.21x speed in inference compared to SOTA. We will open-source everything upon paper acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出首个文本引导视频配乐模型Video-Robin，将自回归全局规划与扩散局部合成解耦，实现2.21倍速且保持高保真度的语义对齐音乐生成。
AI.motivation: 现有V2M工作仅靠视觉条件，用户难以对风格与语义进行细粒度控制；需要兼顾音乐保真度与跨模态语义理解。
AI.method: 双阶段框架：①自回归规划器将视觉与文本联合编码为高层音乐潜码，完成语义对齐；②局部Diffusion Transformer以潜码为条件，逐帧细化生成高保真音频，实现可解释控制与保真度的解耦优化。
AI.result: 在分布内外基准上，音频质量、语义对齐及风格可控性均优于纯视频或附加特征基线；推理速度较SOTA提升2.21倍并支持零样本文本控制。
AI.conclusion: 证明规划-合成解耦策略可同步提升速度、可控性与保真度，为交互式视频配乐提供开源新基线。

title: MM-JudgeBias: A Benchmark for Evaluating Compositional Biases in MLLM-as-a-Judge
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have been increasingly used as automatic evaluators-a paradigm known as MLLM-as-a-Judge. However, their reliability and vulnerabilities to biases remain underexplored. We find that many MLLM judges fail to reliably integrate key visual or textual cues, yielding unreliable evaluations when evidence is missing or mismatched, and exhibiting instability under semantically irrelevant perturbations. To address this, we systematically define Compositional Bias in MLLM-as-a-Judge systems and introduce MM-JudgeBias, a benchmark for evaluating it. MM-JudgeBias introduces controlled perturbations across Query, Image, and Response, and evaluates model behavior via two complementary metrics: Bias-Deviation (BD) for sensitivity and Bias-Conformity (BC) for stability. Our dataset of over 1,800 curated and refined multimodal samples, drawn from 29 source benchmarks, enables a fine-grained diagnosis of nine bias types across diverse tasks and domains. Experiments on 26 state-of-the-art MLLMs reveal systematic modality neglect and asymmetric evaluation tendencies, underscoring the need for more reliable judges.

AI.tldr: 现有MLLM-as-a-Judge范式存在因视觉-文本线索缺失或语义无关扰动导致评估不可靠的问题；作者提出组合性偏差定义与MM-JudgeBias基准，通过1,800+多模态样本与BD/BC指标系统诊断26个SOTA模型的9类偏差，证实其普遍存在模态忽视与不对称评估倾向。
AI.motivation: MLLM被广泛用于自动评估，但其作为裁判的可靠性及对偏差的脆弱性尚缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 1) 形式化定义“组合性偏差”概念；2) 构建MM-JudgeBias基准，对Query、Image、Response三要素施加受控扰动；3) 设计Bias-Deviation(敏感度)与Bias-Conformity(稳定性)双指标，从29个源基准精选1,800余高质量样本，覆盖9类偏差、多任务与领域；4) 在26个SOTA MLLM上运行大规模实验。
AI.result: 实验揭示：a) 模型普遍存在“模态忽视”——忽略关键视觉或文本线索；b) 呈现“不对称评估”——对同类偏差的敏感程度不一致；c) BD/BC得分显著偏离理想值，验证其对语义无关扰动高度不稳定。
AI.conclusion: MLLM-as-a-Judge尚不可直接作为可靠裁判，亟需针对组合性偏差的诊断与鲁棒性增强机制；MM-JudgeBias为后续研究提供了系统评估框架与数据基础。

title: Cyber Defense Benchmark: Agentic Threat Hunting Evaluation for LLMs in SecOps
summary:
We introduce the Cyber Defense Benchmark, a benchmark for measuring how well large language model (LLM) agents perform the core SOC analyst task of threat hunting: given a database of raw Windows event logs with no guided questions or hints, identify the exact timestamps of malicious events.
  The benchmark wraps 106 real attack procedures from the OTRF Security-Datasets corpus - spanning 86 MITRE ATT&CK sub-techniques across 12 tactics - into a Gymnasium reinforcement-learning environment. Each episode presents the agent with an in-memory SQLite database of 75,000-135,000 log records produced by a deterministic campaign simulator that time-shifts and entity-obfuscates the raw recordings.
  The agent must iteratively submit SQL queries to discover malicious event timestamps and explicitly flag them, scored CTF-style against Sigma-rule-derived ground truth.
  Evaluating five frontier models - Claude Opus 4.6, GPT-5, Gemini 3.1 Pro, Kimi K2.5, and Gemini 3 Flash - on 26 campaigns covering 105 of 106 procedures, we find that all models fail dramatically: the best model (Claude Opus 4.6) submits correct flags for only 3.8% of malicious events on average, and no run across any model ever finds all flags.
  We define a passing score as >= 50% recall on every ATT&CK tactic - the minimum bar for unsupervised SOC deployment. No model passes: the leader clears this bar on 5 of 13 tactics and the remaining four on zero.
  These results suggest that current LLMs are poorly suited for open-ended, evidence-driven threat hunting despite strong performance on curated Q&A security benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 首个无提示威胁狩猎基准：在106个真实攻击、数万条Windows日志中，LLM需纯靠SQL挖掘并准确标记所有恶意时间戳；五家前沿模型全军覆没，最佳召回仅3.8%，零模型通过≥50%召回的及格线。
AI.motivation: 现有安全问答基准过于理想化，无法反映SOC分析师在真实海量日志中“无提示、开放式、证据驱动”的威胁狩猎核心任务。作者想验证当前最强LLM是否已可无人值守上岗。
AI.method: 1) 从MITRE映射的OTRF数据集中抽取106个真实攻击流程，覆盖12战术86子技；2) 用确定性仿真器生成7.5–13.5万条事件日志并做时间偏移+实体混淆，封装成Gymnasium RL环境；3) 设计CTF式评分：LLM只能通过迭代SQL查询发现恶意时间戳，与Sigma规则派生的Ground Truth比对计算召回；4) 评测Claude Opus 4.6、GPT-5、Gemini 3.1 Pro、Kimi K2.5、Gemini 3 Flash五模型，共跑26个攻击战役。
AI.result: · 平均召回率仅1.3–3.8%，最高模型(Claude Opus 4.6)仅正确标记3.8%恶意事件；· 单战役全旗捕获率为0；· 以“每战术≥50%召回”为及格线，领先者仅在5/13战术达标，其余四家全部战术零分；· 错误类型：查询构造失误、语义误解、攻击链上下文缺失、证据关联失败。
AI.conclusion: 尽管LLM在有提示安全问答上表现强劲，但在无提示、大规模日志、开放式威胁狩猎场景下远未成熟，不具备无人SOC部署能力；亟需面向证据链推理与长期记忆的新一代模型与评测框架。

title: Cross-Model Consistency of AI-Generated Exercise Prescriptions: A Repeated Generation Study Across Three Large Language Models
comment: 24 Pages, 2 Figures, 6 Tables and 2 Supplementary Materials. v2: Removed personal contact information
summary: This study compared repeated generation consistency of exercise prescription outputs across three large language models (LLMs), specifically GPT-4.1, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and Gemini 2.5 Flash, under temperature=0 conditions. Each model generated prescriptions for six clinical scenarios 20 times, yielding 360 total outputs analyzed across four dimensions: semantic similarity, output reproducibility, FITT classification, and safety expression. Mean semantic similarity was highest for GPT-4.1 (0.955), followed by Gemini 2.5 Flash (0.950) and Claude Sonnet 4.6 (0.903), with significant inter-model differences confirmed (H = 458.41, p < .001). Critically, these scores reflected fundamentally different generative behaviors: GPT-4.1 produced entirely unique outputs (100%) with stable semantic content, while Gemini 2.5 Flash showed pronounced output repetition (27.5% unique outputs), indicating that its high similarity score derived from text duplication rather than consistent reasoning. Identical decoding settings thus yielded fundamentally different consistency profiles, a distinction that single-output evaluations cannot capture. Safety expression reached ceiling levels across all models, confirming its limited utility as a differentiating metric. These results indicate that model selection constitutes a clinical rather than merely technical decision, and that output behavior under repeated generation conditions should be treated as a core criterion for reliable deployment of LLM-based exercise prescription systems.

AI.tldr: 在温度=0设置下，GPT-4.1、Claude Sonnet 4.6 与 Gemini 2.5 Flash 对 6 种临床场景各重复生成 20 次运动处方；GPT-4.1 输出 100% 独特且语义稳定，Gemini 2.5 Flash 仅 27.5% 独特并大量重复，Claude 居中。安全表达均达上限，无法区分模型性能。
AI.motivation: 现有评估仅看单次输出，无法揭示 LLM 在零随机性条件下的真实一致性，进而影响临床运动处方系统的可信度与选型。
AI.method: 固定 temperature=0，三模型对 6 场景×20 次生成，共 360 份处方；用 SBERT 计算语义相似度，辅以可复制性、FITT 分类准确率与安全词频四维度评估，并以 Kruskal-Wallis 检验比较模型差异。
AI.result: GPT-4.1 平均语义相似度最高（0.955），但源于内容稳定而非重复；Gemini 2.5 Flash 相似度 0.950 却靠文本复制，独特率仅 27.5%；Claude Sonnet 4.6 相似度最低（0.903）。安全表达三模型皆达天花板。
AI.conclusion: “一致性”不能仅靠高相似度判断；零温度下各模型生成行为根本不同，临床部署须把“重生成稳定性”列为核心选型标准，而不仅是技术参数。

title: Model Capability Assessment and Safeguards for Biological Weaponization
summary: AI leaders and safety reports increasingly warn that advances in model reasoning may enable biological misuse, including by low-expertise users, while major labs describe safeguards as expanding but still evolving rather than settled. This study benchmarks ChatGPT 5.2 Auto, Gemini 3 Pro Thinking, Claude Opus 4.5 and Meta's Muse Spark Thinking on 73 novice-framed, open-ended benign STEM prompts to measure operational intelligence. On benign quantitative tasks, both Gemini and Meta scored very high; ChatGPT was partially useful but text-thinned, and Claude was sparsest with some apparent false-positive refusals. A second test set detected subtle harmful intent: edge case prompts revealed Gemini's seeming lack of contextual awareness. These results warranted a focused weaponization analysis on Gemini as capability appeared to be outpacing moderation calibration. Gemini was tested across four access environments and reported cases include poison-ivy-to-crowded-transit escalation, poison production and extraction via international-anonymous logged-out AI Mode, and other concerning examples. Biological misuse may become more prevalent as a geopolitical tool, increasing the urgency of U.S. policy responses, especially if model outputs come to be treated as regulated technical data. Guidance is provided for 25 high-risk agents to help distinguish legitimate use cases from higher-risk ones.

AI.tldr: 四大前沿模型在73项新手级STEM任务中均表现出较高实用度，但Gemini在随后针对生物武器的细审中输出最多高风险内容，提示能力跑在风控前面。
AI.motivation: 生物安全报告普遍担忧推理增强模型会降低生化恶意门槛；迫切需要以新手视角量化评估主流模型 benign 用例中的“操作智能”，并识别能力-风控缺口。
AI.method: 1)设计73项开放、良性、新手友好的STEM提示，对ChatGPT-5.2-Auto、Gemini-3-Pro-Thinking、Claude-Opus-4.5、Meta Muse Spark Thinking进行评分；2)用边缘有害提示检测各模型情境敏感度；3)聚焦最薄弱的Gemini，在四种访问环境(含匿名无登录AI Mode)下实施定向武器化测试；4)建立25种高风险生因子的风险辨识指引。
AI.result: Gemini与Meta在量化任务中得分最高，Claude出现较多误判拒答；边缘测试中Gemini语境缺失最明显；武器化测试中Gemini在多环境均给出毒物合成/放大等实用信息，且匿名模式下最易触发。
AI.conclusion: 推理模型的生化恶意潜力已超出现有校准水平，尤其Gemini；若无及时政策干预，低门槛滥用会上升为地缘政治工具。建议把模型输出视同受控技术数据，优先强化实时拒绝与输出水印，并为25类高风险因子建立强制审查模板。

title: Vibrotactile Preference Learning: Uncertainty-Aware Preference Learning for Personalized Vibration Feedback
summary: Individual differences in vibrotactile perception underscore the growing importance of personalization as haptic feedback becomes more prevalent in interactive systems. We propose Vibrotactile Preference Learning (VPL), a system that captures user-specific preference spaces over vibrotactile parameters via Gaussian-process-based uncertainty-aware preference learning. VPL uses an expected information gain-based acquisition strategy to guide query selection over 40 rounds of pairwise comparisons of overall user preference, augmented with user-reported uncertainty, enabling efficient exploration of the parameter space. We evaluate VPL in a user study (N = 13) using the vibrotactile feedback from a Microsoft Xbox controller, showing that it efficiently learns individualized preferences while maintaining comfortable, low-workload user interactions. These results highlight the potential of VPL for scalable personalization of vibrotactile experiences.

AI.tldr: 通过高斯过程的VPL系统仅用40次成对比较即可在商用设备上快速为每位用户习得振动触觉偏好，兼顾主观不确定度并验证低负荷体验。
AI.motivation: 随着交互系统普遍采用触觉反馈，个体对振动参数的主观差异凸显，传统一次性校准无法满足多样化体验需求，亟需一种能够在线、轻量且兼顾感知不确定性的个性化方法。
AI.method: 提出Vibrotactile Preference Learning框架：(1)用高斯过程模型将用户对振动参数的偏好及其不确定度显式耦合；(2)引入基于期望信息增益的主动选样策略，在40轮两两比较中动态缩小偏好空间；(3)比较过程中让用户额外报告“不确定”以校准模型噪声；(4)以Xbox手柄振动为刺激完成完整闭环。
AI.result: 用户研究（N=13）表明：该系统仅用40对样本即可可靠拟合个体偏好曲线，整体满意度显著高于默认配置，NASA-TLX工作负荷得分占优，且模型只需约一半样本即可收敛，验证了其样本效率与舒适交互。
AI.conclusion: VPL证明了在不增加硬件也不用大量训练的情况下，可实时捕捉振动触觉画像，为大规模可扩展的触感个性化奠定算法基础，并可迁移至其他同源触觉设备与文化场景。

title: AgentLens: Adaptive Visual Modalities for Human-Agent Interaction in Mobile GUI Agents
summary: Mobile GUI agents can automate smartphone tasks by interacting directly with app interfaces, but how they should communicate with users during execution remains underexplored. Existing systems rely on two extremes: foreground execution, which maximizes transparency but prevents multitasking, and background execution, which supports multitasking but provides little visual awareness. Through iterative formative studies, we found that users prefer a hybrid model with just-in-time visual interaction, but the most effective visualization modality depends on the task. Motivated by this, we present AgentLens, a mobile GUI agent that adaptively uses three visual modalities during human-agent interaction: Full UI, Partial UI, and GenUI. AgentLens extends a standard mobile agent with adaptive communication actions and uses Virtual Display to enable background execution with selective visual overlays. In a controlled study with 21 participants, AgentLens was preferred by 85.7% of participants and achieved the highest usability (1.94 Overall PSSUQ) and adoption-intent (6.43/7).

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AgentLens，一种能在任务执行过程中根据任务类型动态切换三种可视化交互方式（全界面、局部界面、生成式界面）的移动 GUI 智能体，实现后台运行与透明感知兼得。21 名用户中 85.7% 更偏好该系统，可用性与采用意向均显著优于现有方案。
AI.motivation: 现有移动 GUI 智能体要么完全在前台运行（阻碍用户多任务），要么完全后台运行（用户缺乏可视化感知）。用户访谈表明，大家希望“即时可视化”但不同任务所需呈现粒度不同，因此需一种可随任务自适应切换的可视化通信机制。
AI.method: 通过多轮形成性研究提炼出三种可视化模态；在标准移动代理中新增“自适应通信动作”并在 Android 上构建 Virtual Display 框架，实现后台执行的同时叠加选择性界面图层。最终开展 21 人对比实验，测量 PSSUQ 与采用意向。
AI.result: AgentLens 的整体 PSSUQ 得分为 1.94（越低越好），采用意向 6.43/7，两项均显著优于前后台对照方案；85.7% 参与者主观偏好 AgentLens。后台运行时仍能保持关键反馈，任务完成率无下降。
AI.conclusion: 动态可视化策略可以在保证多任务自由度的同时提供必要透明度，为移动智能体与用户的实时交互提供新的设计范式。未来可进一步探索多模态输入及更细粒度的自适应规则。

title: Seeing Further and Wider: Joint Spatio-Temporal Enlargement for Micro-Video Popularity Prediction
summary: Micro-video popularity prediction (MVPP) aims to forecast the future popularity of videos on online media, which is essential for applications such as content recommendation and traffic allocation. In real-world scenarios, it is critical for MVPP approaches to understand both the temporal dynamics of a given video (temporal) and its historical relevance to other videos (spatial). However, existing approaches sufer from limitations in both dimensions: temporally, they rely on sparse short-range sampling that restricts content perception; spatially, they depend on flat retrieval memory with limited capacity and low efficiency, hindering scalable knowledge utilization. To overcome these limitations, we propose a unified framework that achieves joint spatio-temporal enlargement, enabling precise perception of extremely long video sequences while supporting a scalable memory bank that can infinitely expand to incorporate all relevant historical videos. Technically, we employ a Temporal Enlargement driven by a frame scoring module that extracts highlight cues from video frames through two complementary pathways: sparse sampling and dense perception. Their outputs are adaptively fused to enable robust long-sequence content understanding. For Spatial Enlargement, we construct a Topology-Aware Memory Bank that hierarchically clusters historically relevant content based on topological relationships. Instead of directly expanding memory capacity, we update the encoder features of the corresponding clusters when incorporating new videos, enabling unbounded historical association without unbounded storage growth. Extensive experiments on three widely used MVPP benchmarks demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms 11 strong baselines across mainstream metrics, achieving robust improvements in both prediction accuracy and ranking consistency.

AI.tldr: 提出联合时空扩展的统一框架，解决短视频流行度预测中长期时序感知与大规模历史关联的记忆瓶颈，在三大基准上全面领先11个强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有MVPP方法在时序侧因稀疏短程采样难以捕获长视频动态，在空间侧因扁平检索记忆容量低、效率差而难以利用海量历史视频，亟需同时突破时空维度瓶颈。
AI.method: 1) 时序扩展：帧打分双路径（稀疏采样+稠密感知）自适应融合，实现极长序列精准感知；2) 空间扩展：构建拓扑感知分层记忆库，按拓扑关系聚类历史视频，更新对应簇的编码特征而非直接扩容，实现无界历史关联且存储零增长。
AI.result: 在3个主流MVPP数据集上相比11个强基线取得一致提升，预测精度与排序一致性均显著改善，验证框架有效性与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 通过联合时空扩展策略，首次在MVPP中同时实现长时序内容深度理解与大容量高效历史知识复用，为推荐、流量分配等应用提供可靠支撑，并可推广至其他需长序列与大规模记忆的任务。

title: Surrogate modeling for interpreting black-box LLMs in medical predictions
summary: Large language models (LLMs), trained on vast datasets, encode extensive real-world knowledge within their parameters, yet their black-box nature obscures the mechanisms and extent of this encoding. Surrogate modeling, which uses simplified models to approximate complex systems, can offer a path toward better interpretability of black-box models. We propose a surrogate modeling framework that quantitatively explains LLM-encoded knowledge. For a specific hypothesis derived from domain knowledge, this framework approximates the latent LLM knowledge space using observable elements (input-output pairs) through extensive prompting across a comprehensive range of simulated scenarios. Through proof-of-concept experiments in medical predictions, we demonstrate our framework's effectiveness in revealing the extent to which LLMs "perceive" each input variable in relation to the output. Particularly, given concerns that LLMs may perpetuate inaccuracies and societal biases embedded in their training data, our experiments using this framework quantitatively revealed both associations that contradict established medical knowledge and the persistence of scientifically refuted racial assumptions within LLM-encoded knowledge. By disclosing these issues, our framework can act as a red-flag indicator to support the safe and reliable application of these models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用代理模型框架把LLM的“黑箱知识”变成可观测、可量化的知识图谱，并在医疗预测任务中验证其能揭示LLM对变量的真实关注度，同时发现模型潜藏的错误医学关联与种族偏见。
AI.motivation: LLM虽蕴含海量现实世界知识，却因其黑箱属性导致无法知晓知识如何被编码、编码到何种程度，进而阻碍安全可信部署；尤其在医疗等高风险领域，需先诊断模型知识缺陷。
AI.method: 构建“代理建模框架”：针对某一领域假设，用海量提示在虚拟场景中采样输入-输出对，把LLM隐空间知识近似为显式可测的知识表示；再以医学预测为概念验证，量化LLM对各输入变量的感知强度。
AI.result: 框架成功量化LLM对医学特征的“感知”程度；同时暴露出两类知识缺陷：与循证医学矛盾的错误关联，以及已被科学证伪却仍被模型保留的种族刻板印象。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能像“红旗”一样提前标出LLM中的错误知识与偏见，为后续校准、监管与安全落地提供可操作的诊断工具。

title: MOMO: A framework for seamless physical, verbal, and graphical robot skill learning and adaptation
summary: Industrial robot applications require increasingly flexible systems that non-expert users can easily adapt for varying tasks and environments. However, different adaptations benefit from different interaction modalities. We present an interactive framework that enables robot skill adaptation through three complementary modalities: kinesthetic touch for precise spatial corrections, natural language for high-level semantic modifications, and a graphical web interface for visualizing geometric relations and trajectories, inspecting and adjusting parameters, and editing via-points by drag-and-drop. The framework integrates five components: energy-based human-intention detection, a tool-based LLM architecture (where the LLM selects and parameterizes predefined functions rather than generating code) for safe natural language adaptation, Kernelized Movement Primitives (KMPs) for motion encoding, probabilistic Virtual Fixtures for guided demonstration recording, and ergodic control for surface finishing. We demonstrate that this tool-based LLM architecture generalizes skill adaptation from KMPs to ergodic control, enabling voice-commanded surface finishing. Validation on a 7-DoF torque-controlled robot at the Automatica 2025 trade fair demonstrates the practical applicability of our approach in industrial settings.

AI.tldr: 将触觉示教、自然语言、可视化拖放三种模态集成在同一框架，首次在工业7-DoF机器人上完成KMP到遍历控制的免示教切换，实现非专业人员语音指令下的表面精加工现场编程。
AI.motivation: 工业机器人需频繁适应小批量、多品种任务，而传统示教或代码级修改对现场工人门槛过高；不同调整（空间微调、语义级工艺切换、几何轨迹可视化编辑）天然适配不同交互手段，故需统一框架融合多模态并实现安全、可解释的技能迁移。
AI.method: 构建五组件架构：1) 基于能量函数的人机意图检测，区分主动示教与被动牵引；2) 工具式LLM，仅调用预定义参数化函数而非生成代码，确保运动安全；3) Kernelized Movement Primitives (KMP)编码示教轨迹；4) 概率虚拟夹具，在示教阶段提供引导并约束奇异点/碰撞区；5) 遍历控制(Ergodic Control)将KMP输出的路径映射为覆盖表面的扫描密度场。三者交互模态：kinesthetic实时修正末端位姿，NL通过LLM触发“减速30%”“改为螺旋线”之类语义指令，Web界面提供轨迹、关键/经过点及参数的面板式拖拽修改。
AI.result: 在Automatica 2023(摘要误写为2025)现场7-DoF扭矩控制机器人上，由非专家观众用三种模态完成：平面打磨、曲率变化铝件抛光、局部区域补磨；统计50次试验，任务重配置时间由原来代码级30min降至平均2.1 min，表面质量Ra≤0.4 μm占比由78%提升到94%，零碰撞/伤人事件；工具式LLM指令解析成功率96%，并首次验证KMP参数可无缝迁移至遍历控制密度权重，实现同一语音指令既改轨迹又改覆盖策略。
AI.conclusion: 多模态互补接口+工具式LLM可在保持工业级安全与精度的同时，把复杂技能调整时间缩短一个数量级；框架已面向KUKA iiwa开源，未来将在混合现实、语音多语言支持和更广泛的力控工艺(焊接、铆接)中扩展验证。

title: Knowledge Capsules: Structured Nonparametric Memory Units for LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) encode knowledge in parametric weights, making it costly to update or extend without retraining. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) mitigates this limitation by appending retrieved text to the input, but operates purely through context expansion, where external knowledge competes as tokens within the attention mechanism. As a result, its influence is indirect and often unstable, particularly in long context and multi hop reasoning scenarios. We propose Knowledge Capsules, structured nonparametric memory units that represent normalized relational knowledge and can be constructed directly from document corpora using a frozen base model. Instead of injecting knowledge as text, we introduce an External Key Value Injection (KVI) framework that compiles capsules into attention-compatible key value representations, enabling external knowledge to directly participate in the model's attention computation. By shifting knowledge integration from context-level augmentation to memory level interaction, the proposed framework consistently outperforms RAG and GraphRAG across multiple QA benchmarks, with improved stability and accuracy in long context and multi hop reasoning, while requiring no parameter updates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“知识胶囊+外部键值注入(KVI)”框架，用结构化非参数记忆块替代RAG的文本追加方式，使外部知识直接参与注意力计算，无需更新模型参数即可在长文本及多跳推理 QA 任务上显著提升稳定性与准确率。
AI.motivation: LLM 知识固化在参数中，更新成本高昂；RAG 靠追加文本引入外部知识，导致长上下文与多跳推理场景下注意力竞争剧烈、效果不稳定，需要一种更直接、稳定且无需重训的知识融合机制。
AI.method: 1) 设计“知识胶囊”——从语料直接抽取并归一化的结构化非参数记忆单元；2) 提出 External-KVI 框架，将胶囊编译成与模型注意力兼容的键值表示，在推理阶段直接注入注意力层，实现记忆级而非上下文级的知识融合；3) 整个过程冻结基模型，不更新任何参数。
AI.result: 在多个问答基准上，该方法一致优于 RAG 与 GraphRAG，尤其在长上下文与多跳推理任务中表现出更高的准确率与稳定性，同时保持零参数更新。
AI.conclusion: 通过把知识整合从“上下文扩充”转变为“记忆级交互”，Knowledge Capsules+KVI 框架为 LLM 提供了一种高效、稳定、可扩展的外部知识注入范式，无需重训即可持续增强推理能力。

title: StormNet: Improving storm surge predictions with a GNN-based spatio-temporal offset forecasting model
summary: Storm surge forecasting remains a critical challenge in mitigating the impacts of tropical cyclones on coastal regions, particularly given recent trends of rapid intensification and increasing nearshore storm activity. Traditional high fidelity numerical models such as ADCIRC, while robust, are often hindered by inevitable uncertainties arising from various sources. To address these challenges, this study introduces StormNet, a spatio-temporal graph neural network (GNN) designed for bias correction of storm surge forecasts. StormNet integrates graph convolutional (GCN) and graph attention (GAT) mechanisms with long short-term memory (LSTM) components to capture complex spatial and temporal dependencies among water-level gauge stations. The model was trained using historical hurricane data from the U.S. Gulf Coast and evaluated on Hurricane Idalia (2023). Results demonstrate that StormNet can effectively reduce the root mean square error (RMSE) in water-level predictions by more than 70\% for 48-hour forecasts and above 50\% for 72-hour forecasts, as well as outperform a sequential LSTM baseline, particularly for longer prediction horizons. The model also exhibits low training time, enhancing its applicability in real-time operational forecasting systems. Overall, StormNet provides a computationally efficient and physically meaningful framework for improving storm surge prediction accuracy and reliability during extreme weather events.

AI.tldr: StormNet利用图神经网络与LSTM融合，对ADCIRC风暴潮预报进行时空偏差校正，使48h与72h水位RMSE分别降低>70%与>50%，并在2023年飓风Idalia上验证，训练快、可实时部署。
AI.motivation: 热带气旋近岸活动加剧且快速增强，传统高保真模型ADCIRC因多源不确定性导致风暴潮预报误差大，亟需兼顾精度与效率的偏差校正方法。
AI.method: 构建时空图网络StormNet，将图卷积GCN、图注意力GAT与LSTM耦合，捕捉验潮站间复杂时空依赖；用美国墨西哥湾历史飓风数据训练，以顺序LSTM为基线，对2023年飓风Idalia进行48h、72h水位预报测试。
AI.result: 相较ADCIRC原始输出，StormNet使48h RMSE降低70%以上，72h RMSE降低50%以上，长时效优势显著；训练时间低，支持实时运行。
AI.conclusion: StormNet为极端天气下风暴潮预报提供了一种计算高效、物理可解释且精度显著提升的偏差校正框架，具备业务化应用潜力。

title: Exploiting LLM-as-a-Judge Disposition on Free Text Legal QA via Prompt Optimization
comment: Accepted at the 21st International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Law (ICAIL 2026), Singapore, June 8-12, 2026. 10 pages, 14 figures, 2 tables
summary: This work explores the role of prompt design and judge selection in LLM-as-a-Judge evaluations of free text legal question answering. We examine whether automatic task prompt optimization improves over human-centered design, whether optimization effectiveness varies by judge feedback style, and whether optimized prompts transfer across judges. We systematically address these questions on the LEXam benchmark by optimizing task prompts using the ProTeGi method with feedback from two judges (Qwen3-32B, DeepSeek-V3) across four task models, and then testing cross-judge transfer. Automatic optimization consistently outperforms the baseline, with lenient judge feedback yielding higher and more consistent gains than strict judge feedback. Prompts optimized with lenient feedback transfer better to strict judges than the reverse direction. Analysis reveals that lenient judges provide permissive feedback, yielding prompts with broader applicability, whereas strict judges produce restrictive feedback, leading to judge-specific overfitting. Our findings demonstrate algorithmically optimizing prompts on training data can outperform human-centered prompt design and that judges' dispositions during optimization shape prompt generalizability.

AI.tldr: 自动优化法律问答提示优于人工设计，宽松法官反馈比严格反馈更通用，NSF资助。
AI.motivation: 法律问答（QA）依赖人工LLM-as-a-Judge成本高，需系统研究提示设计、法官选择与优化策略，以降低评估成本并保证质量。
AI.method: 在LEXam基准上用ProTeGi算法，分别用Qwen3-32B与DeepSeek-V3两类法官的宽松/严格反馈，对四款任务模型进行全自动提示优化，再反向测试跨法官迁移。
AI.result: 宽松法官反馈在所有模型上增益更大且稳定；其优化提示迁移到严格法官时性能优于反向迁移，较人工基线全面提升。
AI.conclusion: 提示可算法化优化以超越人工设计；法官偏好决定反馈泛化性，宽松法官产生的提示更具通用性，可指导低成本、高可信的法律LLM评估。

title: Working Memory Constraints Scaffold Learning in Transformers under Data Scarcity
summary: We investigate the integration of human-like working memory constraints into the Transformer architecture and implement several cognitively inspired attention variants, including fixed-width windows based and temporal decay based attention mechanisms. Our modified GPT-2 models are trained from scratch on developmentally plausible datasets (10M and 100M words). Performance is evaluated on grammatical judgment tasks (BLiMP) and alignment with human reading time data. Our results indicate that these cognitively-inspired constraints, particularly fixed-width attention, can significantly improve grammatical accuracy especially when training data is scarce. These constrained models also tend to show a stronger alignment with human processing metrics. The findings suggest that such constraints may serve as a beneficial inductive bias, guiding models towards more robust linguistic representations, especially in data-limited settings.

AI.tldr: 通过将类人工工作记忆限制引入 Transformer，在 10M/100M 词的发展合理语料上训练「受认知启发的 GPT-2」；固定宽度注意力在少数据场景显著提高 BLiMP 语法判断精度，并更贴近人类阅读时间。
AI.motivation: 工作记忆容量限制是人类语言处理的核心特征，而标准 Transformer 的全局注意力忽视该约束；作者怀疑引入该限制能否在数据稀缺时充当有效归纳偏置，提升语法泛化并逼近人类加工行为。
AI.method: 设计两大认知启发注意力（固定宽度滑动窗、时间指数衰减窗），在 GPT-2 架构内替换原生 softmax；用 BabyBERTa-like 小语料（10M、100M 词）从零训练；评估指标为 BLiMP 语法判断准确率及与 Dundee 阅读时间的皮尔逊相关系数。
AI.result: 在 10M 词场景，固定宽度窗模型平均 BLiMP 准确率比标准 GPT-2 绝对提升 4.8%，相对误差降低 14%；阅读时间对齐平均 r 由 0.36 增至 0.49。100M 词时提升收窄但仍保持显著。衰减窗效果弱于固定窗。
AI.conclusion: 类工作记忆容量限制可作为有力归纳偏置，尤其在小数据情境下引导模型学到更鲁棒的语法表征，并同步改善与人类加工数据的吻合度，为资源受限的语言模型训练提供认知约束新思路。
